scripture_data.text_orig: בגו ר פל יב היה ה לבי ויח ו

scripture_data.text_id: Zila juga melahirkan anak, yakni Tubal-Kain, bapa semua tukang tembaga dan tukang besi. Adik perempuan Tubal-Kain ialah Naama.
scripture_data.text_en: And Zillah, she also bare Tubalcain, an instructer of every artificer in brass and iron: and the sister of Tubalcain [was] Naamah.
scripture_data.text_orig: המן יקלב תחו לזרב תחן רחל ל יקלבת הדלי והג הצו

scripture_data.text_id: Berkatalah Lamekh kepada kedua isterinya itu: "Ada dan Zila, dengarkanlah suaraku: hai isteri-isteri Lamekh, pasanglah telingamu kepada perkataanku ini: Aku telah membunuh seorang laki-laki karena ia melukai aku, membunuh seorang muda karena ia memukul aku sampai bengkak;
scripture_data.text_en: And Lamech said unto his wives, Adah and Zillah, Hear my voice; ye wives of Lamech, hearken unto my speech: for I have slain a man to my wounding, and a young man to my hurt.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתרחל דליו יצפל יגרה י י יתרמ הזה מל ין ילק מ הצו הד וינל מל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: sebab jika Kain harus dibalaskan tujuh kali lipat, maka Lamekh tujuh puluh tujuh kali lipat."
scripture_data.text_en: If Cain shall be avenged sevenfold, truly Lamech seventy and sevenfold.
scripture_data.text_orig: הבו יב מלו יקי יתב י

scripture_data.text_id: Adam bersetubuh pula dengan isterinya, lalu perempuan itu melahirkan seorang anak laki-laki dan menamainya Set, sebab katanya: "Allah telah mengaruniakan kepadaku anak yang lain sebagai ganti Habel; sebab Kain telah membunuhnya."
scripture_data.text_en: And Adam knew his wife again; and she bare a son, and called his name Seth: For God, [said she], hath appointed me another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew.
scripture_data.text_orig: יק גרה י לבה תח רח רז יהל ילת י ת מת רקו דלו ת ד ד דו

scripture_data.text_id: Lahirlah seorang anak laki-laki bagi Set juga dan anak itu dinamainya Enos. Waktu itulah orang mulai memanggil nama TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And to Seth, to him also there was born a son; and he called his name Enos: then began men to call upon the name of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי רקל לחה ז נ מת רקו די ה תל

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah daftar keturunan Adam. Pada waktu manusia itu diciptakan oleh Allah, dibuat-Nyalah dia menurut rupa Allah;
scripture_data.text_en: This [is] the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, in the likeness of God made he him;
scripture_data.text_orig: ת ה יהל תמד ד יהל ר י ד תדל רפס הז

scripture_data.text_id: laki-laki dan perempuan diciptakan-Nya mereka. Ia memberkati mereka dan memberikan nama "Manusia" kepada mereka, pada waktu mereka diciptakan.
scripture_data.text_en: Male and female created he them; and blessed them, and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רה י ד מת רקו ת רביו ר הבקנ רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Adam hidup seratus tiga puluh tahun, ia memperanakkan seorang laki-laki menurut rupa dan gambarnya, lalu memberi nama Set kepadanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Adam lived an hundred and thirty years, and begat [a son] in his own likeness, after his image; and called his name Seth:
scripture_data.text_orig: ת מת רקו מלצ תמד דלו הנ תמ יל ד יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Umur Adam, setelah memperanakkan Set, delapan ratus tahun, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And the days of Adam after he had begotten Seth were eight hundred years: and he begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ הנמ תת דילה ירח דימי יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Adam mencapai umur sembilan ratus tiga puluh tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמו הנ יל הנ תמ יחר ד ימיל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Set hidup seratus lima tahun, ia memperanakkan Enos.
scripture_data.text_en: And Seth lived an hundred and five years, and begat Enos:
scripture_data.text_orig: נת דלו הנ תמ ינ מח תיחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Set masih hidup delapan ratus tujuh tahun, setelah ia memperanakkan Enos, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Seth lived after he begat Enos eight hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ הנמ ינ ב נת דילה ירח תיחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Set mencapai umur sembilan ratus dua belas tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמו הנ תמ ת הנ הר י תימיל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Enos hidup sembilan puluh tahun, ia memperanakkan Kenan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Enos lived ninety years, and begat Cainan:
scripture_data.text_orig: ניקת דלו הנ י נ יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Enos masih hidup delapan ratus lima belas tahun, setelah ia memperanakkan Kenan, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Enos lived after he begat Cainan eight hundred and fifteen years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ הנמ הנ הר מח ניקת דילה ירח נ יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Enos mencapai umur sembilan ratus lima tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמו הנ תמ ת ינ מח נ ימיל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Kenan hidup tujuh puluh tahun, ia memperanakkan Mahalaleel.
scripture_data.text_en: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begat Mahalaleel:
scripture_data.text_orig: לללהמת דלו הנ יב ניק יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Kenan masih hidup delapan ratus empat puluh tahun, setelah ia memperanakkan Mahalaleel, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Cainan lived after he begat Mahalaleel eight hundred and forty years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ הנמ הנ יר לללהמת דילה ירח ניק יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Kenan mencapai umur sembilan ratus sepuluh tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמו הנ תמ ת ינ ר ניק ימיל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Mahalaleel hidup enam puluh lima tahun, ia memperanakkan Yared.
scripture_data.text_en: And Mahalaleel lived sixty and five years, and begat Jared:
scripture_data.text_orig: דרית דלו הנ יו ינ מח לללהם יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Mahalaleel masih hidup delapan ratus tiga puluh tahun, setelah ia memperanakkan Yared, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Mahalaleel lived after he begat Jared eight hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ הנמ הנ יל דרית דילה ירח לללהם יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Mahalaleel mencapai umur delapan ratus sembilan puluh lima tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Mahalaleel were eight hundred ninety and five years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמו הנ תמ הנמ הנ יתו מח לללהם ימיל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Yared hidup seratus enam puluh dua tahun, ia memperanakkan Henokh.
scripture_data.text_en: And Jared lived an hundred sixty and two years, and he begat Enoch:
scripture_data.text_orig: נחת דלו הנ תמ הנ יו י דרייחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Yared masih hidup delapan ratus tahun, setelah ia memperanakkan Henokh, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Jared lived after he begat Enoch eight hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ הנמ נחת דילה ירח דרייחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Yared mencapai umur sembilan ratus enam puluh dua tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty and two years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף תמו הנ תמ ת הנ יו י דריימיל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Henokh hidup enam puluh lima tahun, ia memperanakkan Metusalah.
scripture_data.text_en: And Enoch lived sixty and five years, and begat Methuselah:
scripture_data.text_orig: חלתמת דלו הנ יו מח נח יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Henokh hidup bergaul dengan Allah selama tiga ratus tahun lagi, setelah ia memperanakkan Metusalah, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Enoch walked with God after he begat Methuselah three hundred years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ ל חלתמת דילה ירח יהלהת נח התו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Henokh mencapai umur tiga ratus enam puluh lima tahun.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty and five years:
scripture_data.text_orig: הנ תמ ל הנ יו מח נח ימיל יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Henokh hidup bergaul dengan Allah, lalu ia tidak ada lagi, sebab ia telah diangkat oleh Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: And Enoch walked with God: and he [was] not; for God took him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף יהל ת חקלי ניו יהלהת נח התו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Metusalah hidup seratus delapan puluh tujuh tahun, ia memperanakkan Lamekh.
scripture_data.text_en: And Methuselah lived an hundred eighty and seven years, and begat Lamech:
scripture_data.text_orig: מלת דלו הנ תמ הנ ינמ ב חלתם יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Metusalah masih hidup tujuh ratus delapan puluh dua tahun, setelah ia memperanakkan Lamekh, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Methuselah lived after he begat Lamech seven hundred eighty and two years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ ב הנ ינמ י מלת דילה ירח חלתם יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Metusalah mencapai umur sembilan ratus enam puluh sembilan tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty and nine years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף תמו הנ תמ ת הנ יו חלתם ימיל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Lamekh hidup seratus delapan puluh dua tahun, ia memperanakkan seorang anak laki-laki,
scripture_data.text_en: And Lamech lived an hundred eighty and two years, and begat a son:
scripture_data.text_orig: דלו הנ תמ הנ ינמ י מליחיו

scripture_data.text_id: dan memberi nama Nuh kepadanya, katanya: "Anak ini akan memberi kepada kita penghiburan dalam pekerjaan kita yang penuh susah payah di tanah yang telah terkutuk oleh TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: And he called his name Noah, saying, This [same] shall comfort us concerning our work and toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD hath cursed.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי רר ר המדהמ נידי במ נמ נמחני הז רמל חנ מת רקו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Lamekh masih hidup lima ratus sembilan puluh lima tahun, setelah ia memperanakkan Nuh, dan ia memperanakkan anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Lamech lived after he begat Noah five hundred ninety and five years, and begat sons and daughters:
scripture_data.text_orig: תנב ינ דלו הנ תמ מחו הנ יתו מח חנת דילה ירח מליחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi Lamekh mencapai umur tujuh ratus tujuh puluh tujuh tahun, lalu ia mati.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy and seven years: and he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמו הנ תמ ב הנ יבו ב מלימיל יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Nuh berumur lima ratus tahun, ia memperanakkan Sem, Ham dan Yafet.
scripture_data.text_en: And Noah was five hundred years old: and Noah begat Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תפיתו חת ת חנ דלו הנ תמ מח חניהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika manusia itu mulai bertambah banyak jumlahnya di muka bumi, dan bagi mereka lahir anak-anak perempuan,
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when men began to multiply on the face of the earth, and daughters were born unto them,
scripture_data.text_orig: הל די תנב המדה ינל ברל דה לחהי יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: maka anak-anak Allah melihat, bahwa anak-anak perempuan manusia itu cantik-cantik, lalu mereka mengambil isteri dari antara perempuan-perempuan itu, siapa saja yang disukai mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: That the sons of God saw the daughters of men that they [were] fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.
scripture_data.text_orig: רח ר למ ינ הל חקו הה תב י דה תנת יהלהינב רו

scripture_data.text_id: Berfirmanlah TUHAN: "Roh-Ku tidak akan selama-lamanya tinggal di dalam manusia, karena manusia itu adalah daging, tetapi umurnya akan seratus dua puluh tahun saja."
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD said, My spirit shall not always strive with man, for that he also [is] flesh: yet his days shall be an hundred and twenty years.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנ ירו המ וימי יהו רב ה לל דב יחר דיל הוהי רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu orang-orang raksasa ada di bumi, dan juga pada waktu sesudahnya, ketika anak-anak Allah menghampiri anak-anak perempuan manusia, dan perempuan-perempuan itu melahirkan anak bagi mereka; inilah orang-orang yang gagah perkasa di zaman purbakala, orang-orang yang kenamaan.
scripture_data.text_en: There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of God came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare [children] to them, the same [became] mighty men which [were] of old, men of renown.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ה ינ למ ר ירה הה הל דליו דה תנל יהלה ינ בי ר כירח גו הה ימ שרב יה ילפה

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika dilihat TUHAN, bahwa kejahatan manusia besar di bumi dan bahwa segala kecenderungan hatinya selalu membuahkan kejahatan semata-mata,
scripture_data.text_en: And GOD saw that the wickedness of man [was] great in the earth, and [that] every imagination of the thoughts of his heart [was] only evil continually.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל ר קר ל תבחם רצילכו שר דה תר הר י הוהי רו

scripture_data.text_id: maka menyesallah TUHAN, bahwa Ia telah menjadikan manusia di bumi, dan hal itu memilukan hati-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: And it repented the LORD that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him at his heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל בתו שר דהת הי הוהי חו

scripture_data.text_id: Berfirmanlah TUHAN: "Aku akan menghapuskan manusia yang telah Kuciptakan itu dari muka bumi, baik manusia maupun hewan dan binatang-binatang melata dan burung-burung di udara, sebab Aku menyesal, bahwa Aku telah menjadikan mereka."
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth; both man, and beast, and the creeping thing, and the fowls of the air; for it repenteth me that I have made them.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי י ימחנ י ימה דו מרד המהד דמ המדה ינ למ יתרר דהת החמ הוהי רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Nuh mendapat kasih karunia di mata TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: But Noah found grace in the eyes of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי יני ח צמ חנו

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah riwayat Nuh: Nuh adalah seorang yang benar dan tidak bercela di antara orang-orang sezamannya; dan Nuh itu hidup bergaul dengan Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: These [are] the generations of Noah: Noah was a just man [and] perfect in his generations, [and] Noah walked with God.
scripture_data.text_orig: חנהתה יהלהת ויתרד היה ימ קיץ י חנ חנ תדל ה

scripture_data.text_id: Nuh memperanakkan tiga orang laki-laki: Sem, Ham dan Yafet.
scripture_data.text_en: And Noah begat three sons, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תפיתו חת ת ינב הל חנ דלו

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun bumi itu telah rusak di hadapan Allah dan penuh dengan kekerasan.
scripture_data.text_en: The earth also was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.
scripture_data.text_orig: סמח שרה לו יהלה ינפל שרה תחו

scripture_data.text_id: Allah menilik bumi itu dan sungguhlah rusak benar, sebab semua manusia menjalankan hidup yang rusak di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: And God looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שרהל רת רל תיחהי התחנ ההו שרהת יהל רו

scripture_data.text_id: Berfirmanlah Allah kepada Nuh: "Aku telah memutuskan untuk mengakhiri hidup segala makhluk, sebab bumi telah penuh dengan kekerasan oleh mereka, jadi Aku akan memusnahkan mereka bersama-sama dengan bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: And God said unto Noah, The end of all flesh is come before me; for the earth is filled with violence through them; and, behold, I will destroy them with the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהת תיחם יננהו הינמ סמח שרה הלמי ינפל רל שק חנל יהל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Buatlah bagimu sebuah bahtera dari kayu gofir; bahtera itu harus kaubuat berpetak-petak dan harus kaututup dengan pakal dari luar dan dari dalam.
scripture_data.text_en: Make thee an ark of gopher wood; rooms shalt thou make in the ark, and shalt pitch it within and without with pitch.
scripture_data.text_orig: רפ שחמ תימ ת רפכו הבהת ה יק רפגיצ תב ל ה

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah engkau harus membuat bahtera itu: tiga ratus hasta panjangnya, lima puluh hasta lebarnya dan tiga puluh hasta tingginya.
scripture_data.text_en: And this [is the fashion] which thou shalt make it [of]: The length of the ark [shall be] three hundred cubits, the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמק ה יל חר ה ימח הבה ר ה תמ ל ת ה ר הזו

scripture_data.text_id: Buatlah atap pada bahtera itu dan selesaikanlah bahtera itu sampai sehasta dari atas, dan pasanglah pintunya pada lambungnya; buatlah bahtera itu bertingkat bawah, tengah dan atas.
scripture_data.text_en: A window shalt thou make to the ark, and in a cubit shalt thou finish it above; and the door of the ark shalt thou set in the side thereof; [with] lower, second, and third [stories] shalt thou make it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה יל נ ח י צ הבה חתפ הלמלמ הלכ הלו הבל ה רהצ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab sesungguhnya Aku akan mendatangkan air bah meliputi bumi untuk memusnahkan segala yang hidup dan bernyawa di kolong langit; segala yang ada di bumi akan mati binasa.
scripture_data.text_en: And, behold, I, even I, do bring a flood of waters upon the earth, to destroy all flesh, wherein [is] the breath of life, from under heaven; [and] every thing that [is] in the earth shall die.
scripture_data.text_orig: וגי שרר ל ימה תחמ יח חר ר רל תחל שרהל ים להת יבמ יננה ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi dengan engkau Aku akan mengadakan perjanjian-Ku, dan engkau akan masuk ke dalam bahtera itu: engkau bersama-sama dengan anak-anakmu dan isterimu dan isteri anak-anakmu.
scripture_data.text_en: But with thee will I establish my covenant; and thou shalt come into the ark, thou, and thy sons, and thy wife, and thy sons' wives with thee.

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun Abraham berumur seratus tahun, ketika Ishak, anaknya, lahir baginya.

scripture_data.text_id: Lagi katanya: "Siapakah tadinya yang dapat mengatakan kepada Abraham: Sara menyusui anak? Namun aku telah melahirkan seorang anak laki-laki baginya pada masa tuanya."
scripture_data.text_en: And she said, Who would have said unto Abraham, that Sarah should have given children suck? for I have born [him] a son in his old age.

scripture_data.text_id: Bertambah besarlah anak itu dan ia disapih, lalu Abraham mengadakan perjamuan besar pada hari Ishak disapih itu.

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu Sara melihat, bahwa anak yang dilahirkan Hagar, perempuan Mesir itu bagi Abraham, sedang main dengan Ishak, anaknya sendiri.
scripture_data.text_en: And Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, which she had born unto Abraham, mocking.

scripture_data.text_id: Berkatalah Sara kepada Abraham: "Usirlah hamba perempuan itu beserta anaknya, sebab anak hamba ini tidak akan menjadi ahli waris bersama-sama dengan anakku Ishak."
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore she said unto Abraham, Cast out this bondwoman and her son: for the son of this bondwoman shall not be heir with my son, [even] with Isaac.

scripture_data.text_id: Hal ini sangat menyebalkan Abraham oleh karena anaknya itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the thing was very grievous in Abraham's sight because of his son.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Allah berfirman kepada Abraham: "Janganlah sebal hatimu karena hal anak dan budakmu itu; dalam segala yang dikatakan Sara kepadamu, haruslah engkau mendengarkannya, sebab yang akan disebut keturunanmu ialah yang berasal dari Ishak.
scripture_data.text_en: And God said unto Abraham, Let it not be grievous in thy sight because of the lad, and because of thy bondwoman; in all that Sarah hath said unto thee, hearken unto her voice; for in Isaac shall thy seed be called.

scripture_data.text_id: Keesokan harinya pagi-pagi Abraham mengambil roti serta sekirbat air dan memberikannya kepada Hagar. Ia meletakkan itu beserta anaknya di atas bahu Hagar, kemudian disuruhnyalah perempuan itu pergi. Maka pergilah Hagar dan mengembara di padang gurun Bersyeba.
scripture_data.text_en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread, and a bottle of water, and gave [it] unto Hagar, putting [it] on her shoulder, and the child, and sent her away: and she departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

scripture_data.text_id: dan ia duduk agak jauh, kira-kira sepemanah jauhnya, sebab katanya: "Tidak tahan aku melihat anak itu mati." Sedang ia duduk di situ, menangislah ia dengan suara nyaring.
scripture_data.text_en: And she went, and sat her down over against [him] a good way off, as it were a bowshot: for she said, Let me not see the death of the child. And she sat over against [him], and lift up her voice, and wept.

scripture_data.text_en: And God heard the voice of the lad; and the angel of God called to Hagar out of heaven, and said unto her, What aileth thee, Hagar? fear not; for God hath heard the voice of the lad where he [is].

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu Abimelekh, beserta Pikhol, panglima tentaranya, berkata kepada Abraham: "Allah menyertai engkau dalam segala sesuatu yang engkau lakukan.
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass at that time, that Abimelech and Phichol the chief captain of his host spake unto Abraham, saying, God [is] with thee in all that thou doest:

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, bersumpahlah kepadaku di sini demi Allah, bahwa engkau tidak akan berlaku curang kepadaku, atau kepada anak-anakku, atau kepada cucu cicitku; sesuai dengan persahabatan yang kulakukan kepadamu, demikianlah harus engkau berlaku kepadaku dan kepada negeri yang kautinggali sebagai orang asing."
scripture_data.text_en: Now therefore swear unto me here by God that thou wilt not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son's son: [but] according to the kindness that I have done unto thee, thou shalt do unto me, and to the land wherein thou hast sojourned.

scripture_data.text_en: Thus they made a covenant at Beersheba: then Abimelech rose up, and Phichol the chief captain of his host, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

scripture_data.text_en: And he said, Take now thy son, thine only [son] Isaac, whom thou lovest, and get thee into the land of Moriah; and offer him there for a burnt offering upon one of the mountains which I will tell thee of.

scripture_data.text_id: Keesokan harinya pagi-pagi bangunlah Abraham, ia memasang pelana keledainya dan memanggil dua orang bujangnya beserta Ishak, anaknya; ia membelah juga kayu untuk korban bakaran itu, lalu berangkatlah ia dan pergi ke tempat yang dikatakan Allah kepadanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Abraham rose up early in the morning, and saddled his ass, and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son, and clave the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went unto the place of which God had told him.

scripture_data.text_id: Kata Abraham kepada kedua bujangnya itu: "Tinggallah kamu di sini dengan keledai ini; aku beserta anak ini akan pergi ke sana; kami akan sembahyang, sesudah itu kami kembali kepadamu."
scripture_data.text_en: And Abraham said unto his young men, Abide ye here with the ass; and I and the lad will go yonder and worship, and come again to you.

scripture_data.text_en: And Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering, and laid [it] upon Isaac his son; and he took the fire in his hand, and a knife; and they went both of them together.

scripture_data.text_en: And they came to the place which God had told him of; and Abraham built an altar there, and laid the wood in order, and bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar upon the wood.

scripture_data.text_en: And he said, Lay not thine hand upon the lad, neither do thou any thing unto him: for now I know that thou fearest God, seeing thou hast not withheld thy son, thine only [son] from me.

scripture_data.text_id: kata-Nya: "Aku bersumpah demi diri-Ku sendiri demikianlah firman TUHAN :Karena engkau telah berbuat demikian, dan engkau tidak segan-segan untuk menyerahkan anakmu yang tunggal kepada-Ku,
scripture_data.text_en: And said, By myself have I sworn, saith the LORD, for because thou hast done this thing, and hast not withheld thy son, thine only [son]:

scripture_data.text_en: That in blessing I will bless thee, and in multiplying I will multiply thy seed as the stars of the heaven, and as the sand which [is] upon the sea shore; and thy seed shall possess the gate of his enemies;

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Ishak berumur empat puluh tahun, ketika Ribka, anak Betuel, orang Aram dari Padan-Aram, saudara perempuan Laban orang Aram itu, diambilnya menjadi isterinya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Isaac was forty years old when he took Rebekah to wife, the daughter of Bethuel the Syrian of Padanaram, the sister to Laban the Syrian.

scripture_data.text_en: And Isaac intreated the LORD for his wife, because she [was] barren: and the LORD was intreated of him, and Rebekah his wife conceived.

scripture_data.text_en: And the children struggled together within her; and she said, If [it be] so, why [am] I thus? And she went to enquire of the LORD.

scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD said unto her, Two nations [are] in thy womb, and two manner of people shall be separated from thy bowels; and [the one] people shall be stronger than [the other] people; and the elder shall serve the younger.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu keluarlah adiknya; tangannya memegang tumit Esau, sebab itu ia dinamai Yakub. Ishak berumur enam puluh tahun pada waktu mereka lahir.
scripture_data.text_en: And after that came his brother out, and his hand took hold on Esau's heel; and his name was called Jacob: and Isaac [was] threescore years old when she bare them.

scripture_data.text_en: And the boys grew: and Esau was a cunning hunter, a man of the field; and Jacob [was] a plain man, dwelling in tents.

scripture_data.text_id: Maka timbullah kelaparan di negeri itu. Ini bukan kelaparan yang pertama, yang telah terjadi dalam zaman Abraham. Sebab itu Ishak pergi ke Gerar, kepada Abimelekh, raja orang Filistin.

scripture_data.text_en: Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee; for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father;

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan membuat banyak keturunanmu seperti bintang di langit; Aku akan memberikan kepada keturunanmu seluruh negeri ini, dan oleh keturunanmu semua bangsa di bumi akan mendapat berkat,
scripture_data.text_en: And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries; and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed;

scripture_data.text_id: karena Abraham telah mendengarkan firman-Ku dan memelihara kewajibannya kepada-Ku, yaitu segala perintah, ketetapan dan hukum-Ku."

scripture_data.text_en: And the men of the place asked [him] of his wife; and he said, She [is] my sister: for he feared to say, [She is] my wife; lest, [said he], the men of the place should kill me for Rebekah; because she [was] fair to look upon.

scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when he had been there a long time, that Abimelech king of the Philistines looked out at a window, and saw, and, behold, Isaac [was] sporting with Rebekah his wife.

scripture_data.text_en: And Abimelech called Isaac, and said, Behold, of a surety she [is] thy wife: and how saidst thou, She [is] my sister? And Isaac said unto him, Because I said, Lest I die for her.

scripture_data.text_en: And Abimelech said, What [is] this thou hast done unto us? one of the people might lightly have lien with thy wife, and thou shouldest have brought guiltiness upon us.

scripture_data.text_en: For he had possession of flocks, and possession of herds, and great store of servants: and the Philistines envied him.

scripture_data.text_en: And Abimelech said unto Isaac, Go from us; for thou art much mightier than we.

scripture_data.text_en: And Isaac digged again the wells of water, which they had digged in the days of Abraham his father; for the Philistines had stopped them after the death of Abraham: and he called their names after the names by which his father had called them.

scripture_data.text_en: And the herdmen of Gerar did strive with Isaac's herdmen, saying, The water [is] ours: and he called the name of the well Esek; because they strove with him.

scripture_data.text_en: And he removed from thence, and digged another well; and for that they strove not: and he called the name of it Rehoboth; and he said, For now the LORD hath made room for us, and we shall be fruitful in the land.

scripture_data.text_en: Then Abimelech went to him from Gerar, and Ahuzzath one of his friends, and Phichol the chief captain of his army.

scripture_data.text_en: The children of Ezer [are] these; Bilhan, and Zaavan, and Akan.
scripture_data.text_orig: קו וזו הל רצינ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah anak-anak Disyan: Us dan Aran.
scripture_data.text_en: The children of Dishan [are] these; Uz, and Aran.
scripture_data.text_orig: רו ש ידינב ה

scripture_data.text_id: Itulah kepala-kepala kaum orang Hori: kepala kaum Lotan, kepala kaum Syobal, kepala kaum Zibeon, kepala kaum Ana,
scripture_data.text_en: These [are] the dukes [that came] of the Horites; duke Lotan, duke Shobal, duke Zibeon, duke Anah,
scripture_data.text_orig: הנ בצ לב ל ירחה יפ ה

scripture_data.text_id: kepala kaum Disyon, kepala kaum Ezer dan kepala kaum Disyan; itulah kepala-kepala kaum orang Hori, kaum demi kaum, di tanah Seir.
scripture_data.text_en: Duke Dishon, duke Ezer, duke Dishan: these [are] the dukes [that came] of Hori, among their dukes in the land of Seir.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף רי שר היפל ירחה יפ ה י רצ

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah raja-raja yang memerintah di tanah Edom, sebelum ada seorang raja memerintah atas orang Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: And these [are] the kings that reigned in the land of Edom, before there reigned any king over the children of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי ינבל למלם ינפל ד שר כלמ ר יכלה הו

scripture_data.text_id: Di Edom yang memerintah ialah Bela bin Beor dan kotanya bernama Dinhaba.
scripture_data.text_en: And Bela the son of Beor reigned in Edom: and the name of his city [was] Dinhabah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הבהנ רי ו ר ל ד למו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Bela mati, Yobab bin Zerah dari Bozra menjadi raja menggantikan dia.
scripture_data.text_en: And Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרצמ חרז בבי ויח למו ל תמו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Yobab mati, Husyam, dari negeri orang Teman, menjadi raja menggantikan dia.
scripture_data.text_en: And Jobab died, and Husham of the land of Temani reigned in his stead.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינמיה שרמ ח ויח למו בבי תמו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Husyam mati, Hadad bin Bedad menjadi raja menggantikan dia; dialah yang memukul kalah orang Midian di daerah Moab, dan kotanya bernama Awit.
scripture_data.text_en: And Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Avith.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיו רי ו בם הד ידמת הה דד דדה ויח למו ח תמו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Hadad mati, Samla dari Masreka menjadi raja menggantikan dia.
scripture_data.text_en: And Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
scripture_data.text_orig: הקרמ הלמ ויח למו דדה תמו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Samla mati, Saul, dari Rehobot yang di pinggir sungai, menjadi raja menggantikan dia.
scripture_data.text_en: And Samlah died, and Saul of Rehoboth [by] the river reigned in his stead.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהה תבחרמ ל ויח למו הלמ תמו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Saul mati, Baal-Hanan bin Akhbor menjadi raja menggantikan dia.
scripture_data.text_en: And Saul died, and Baalhanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכ נחל ויח למו ל תמו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Baal-Hanan bin Akhbor mati, Hadar menjadi raja menggantikan dia; kotanya bernama Pahu dan isterinya bernama Mehetabeel binti Matred binti Mezahab.
scripture_data.text_en: And Baalhanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his stead: and the name of his city [was] Pau; and his wife's name [was] Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
scripture_data.text_orig: בהזימ ת דרמת לביהם ו רי ו רדה ויח למו רכ נחל תמו

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah nama kepala-kepala kaum Esau menurut kaum dan tempat mereka, dengan nama mereka masing-masing: kepala kaum Timna, kepala kaum Alwa, kepala kaum Yetet,
scripture_data.text_en: And these [are] the names of the dukes [that came] of Esau, according to their families, after their places, by their names; duke Timnah, duke Alvah, duke Jetheth,
scripture_data.text_orig: תתי הול נמ תמ תמקמל תחמל ו יפ תמ הו

scripture_data.text_id: kepala kaum Oholibama, kepala kaum Ela, kepala kaum Pinon,
scripture_data.text_en: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
scripture_data.text_orig: ני הל המבילה

scripture_data.text_id: kepala kaum Kenas, kepala kaum Teman, kepala kaum Mibzar,
scripture_data.text_en: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
scripture_data.text_orig: רצבמ מי זנק

scripture_data.text_id: kepala kaum Magdiel dan kepala kaum Iram; itulah kepala-kepala kaum Edom, menurut tempat kediaman mereka di tanah milik mereka; Edom ialah Esau, bapa orang Edom.
scripture_data.text_en: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram: these [be] the dukes of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession: he [is] Esau the father of the Edomites.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ד יב ו ה תח שר תבמל ד יפ ה רי ליגם

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun Yakub, ia diam di negeri penumpangan ayahnya, yakni di tanah Kanaan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Jacob dwelt in the land wherein his father was a stranger, in the land of Canaan.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ שר ויב ירגם שר בקי בו

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah riwayat keturunan Yakub. Yusuf, tatkala berumur tujuh belas tahun jadi masih muda biasa menggembalakan kambing domba, bersama-sama dengan saudara-saudaranya, anak-anak Bilha dan Zilpa, kedua isteri ayahnya. Dan Yusuf menyampaikan kepada ayahnya kabar tentang kejahatan saudara-saudaranya.
scripture_data.text_en: These [are] the generations of Jacob. Joseph, [being] seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brethren; and the lad [was] with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives: and Joseph brought unto his father their evil report.
scripture_data.text_orig: היבל הר תת סי בו ויב ין הלז ינתו ההלב ינת רנ הו ויחת הר היה הנ הרב סי בקי תדל ה

scripture_data.text_id: Israel lebih mengasihi Yusuf dari semua anaknya yang lain, sebab Yusuf itulah anaknya yang lahir pada masa tuanya; dan ia menyuruh membuat jubah yang maha indah bagi dia.
scripture_data.text_en: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he [was] the son of his old age: and he made him a coat of [many] colours.
scripture_data.text_orig: י תנת ל הו ל ה ינקזבי וינלמ סית בה לריו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah dilihat oleh saudara-saudaranya, bahwa ayahnya lebih mengasihi Yusuf dari semua saudaranya, maka bencilah mereka itu kepadanya dan tidak mau menyapanya dengan ramah.
scripture_data.text_en: And when his brethren saw that their father loved him more than all his brethren, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably unto him.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל ר לכי לו ת נו ויחלמ היב בה תי ויח רו

scripture_data.text_id: Pada suatu kali bermimpilah Yusuf, lalu mimpinya itu diceritakannya kepada saudara-saudaranya; sebab itulah mereka lebih benci lagi kepadanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told [it] his brethren: and they hated him yet the more.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת נ ד פסו ויחל דו לח סי לחו

scripture_data.text_id: Karena katanya kepada mereka: "Coba dengarkan mimpi yang kumimpikan ini:
scripture_data.text_en: And he said unto them, Hear, I pray you, this dream which I have dreamed:
scripture_data.text_orig: ימלח ר הה לחה נמ היל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Tampak kita sedang di ladang mengikat berkas-berkas gandum, lalu bangkitlah berkasku dan tegak berdiri; kemudian datanglah berkas-berkas kamu sekalian mengelilingi dan sujud menyembah kepada berkasku itu."
scripture_data.text_en: For, behold, we [were] binding sheaves in the field, and, lo, my sheaf arose, and also stood upright; and, behold, your sheaves stood round about, and made obeisance to my sheaf.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתלל יוחו כיתל הניסת ההו הבנגו יתל המק ההו הדה ת יל ימם נחנ ההו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu saudara-saudaranya berkata kepadanya: "Apakah engkau ingin menjadi raja atas kami? Apakah engkau ingin berkuasa atas kami?" Jadi makin bencilah mereka kepadanya karena mimpinya dan karena perkataannya itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And his brethren said to him, Shalt thou indeed reign over us? or shalt thou indeed have dominion over us? And they hated him yet the more for his dreams, and for his words.
scripture_data.text_orig: וירבלו ויתמלחל ת נ ד פסו נ למ למ ניל למ למה ויח ל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu ia memimpikan pula mimpi yang lain, yang diceritakannya kepada saudara-saudaranya. Katanya: "Aku bermimpi pula: Tampak matahari, bulan dan sebelas bintang sujud menyembah kepadaku."
scripture_data.text_en: And he dreamed yet another dream, and told it his brethren, and said, Behold, I have dreamed a dream more; and, behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars made obeisance to me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יוחמ יבכ ר דחו חרהו מה ההו ד לח ימלח הה רמו ויחל ת רסיו רח לח ד לחו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah hal ini diceritakannya kepada ayah dan saudara-saudaranya, maka ia ditegor oleh ayahnya: "Mimpi apa mimpimu itu? Masakan aku dan ibumu serta saudara-saudaramu sujud menyembah kepadamu sampai ke tanah?"
scripture_data.text_en: And he told [it] to his father, and to his brethren: and his father rebuked him, and said unto him, What [is] this dream that thou hast dreamed? Shall I and thy mother and thy brethren indeed come to bow down ourselves to thee to the earth?
scripture_data.text_orig: הצר ל תוחהל יחו ו ינ בנ בה מלח ר הה לחה המ ל רמו ויב רגו ויחלו ויבל רסיו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka iri hatilah saudara-saudaranya kepadanya, tetapi ayahnya menyimpan hal itu dalam hatinya.
scripture_data.text_en: And his brethren envied him; but his father observed the saying.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבהת רמ ויבו ויח בנקיו

scripture_data.text_id: Pada suatu kali pergilah saudara-saudaranya menggembalakan kambing domba ayahnya dekat Sikhem.
scripture_data.text_en: And his brethren went to feed their father's flock in Shechem.
scripture_data.text_orig: כ היב צת תרל ויח כלו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Israel berkata kepada Yusuf: "Bukankah saudara-saudaramu menggembalakan kambing domba dekat Sikhem? Marilah engkau kusuruh kepada mereka." Sahut Yusuf: "Ya bapa."
scripture_data.text_en: And Israel said unto Joseph, Do not thy brethren feed [the flock] in Shechem? come, and I will send thee unto them. And he said to him, Here [am I].
scripture_data.text_orig: ינה ל רמו היל חלו הכל כ יר יח לה סיל לרי רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Kata Israel kepadanya: "Pergilah engkau melihat apakah baik keadaan saudara-saudaramu dan keadaan kambing domba; dan bawalah kabar tentang itu kepadaku." Lalu Yakub menyuruh dia dari lembah Hebron, dan Yusufpun sampailah ke Sikhem.
scripture_data.text_en: And he said to him, Go, I pray thee, see whether it be well with thy brethren, and well with the flocks; and bring me word again. So he sent him out of the vale of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.
scripture_data.text_orig: המכ בו רבח קממ החלו רב ינבהו ה לתו יח לת הר נל ל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Yusuf berjalan ke sana ke mari di padang, bertemulah ia dengan seorang laki-laki, yang bertanya kepadanya: "Apakah yang kaucari?"
scripture_data.text_en: And a certain man found him, and, behold, [he was] wandering in the field: and the man asked him, saying, What seekest thou?
scripture_data.text_orig: בהם רמל יה הלו הד הת ההו י הצמו

scripture_data.text_id: Sahutnya: "Aku mencari saudara-saudaraku. Tolonglah katakan kepadaku di mana mereka menggembalakan kambing domba?"
scripture_data.text_en: And he said, I seek my brethren: tell me, I pray thee, where they feed [their flocks].
scripture_data.text_orig: יר ה הפי יל הדיה בם יכנ יחת רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu kata orang itu: "Mereka telah berangkat dari sini, sebab telah kudengar mereka berkata: Marilah kita pergi ke Dotan." Maka Yusuf menyusul saudara-saudaranya itu dan didapatinyalah mereka di Dotan.
scripture_data.text_en: And the man said, They are departed hence; for I heard them say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brethren, and found them in Dothan.
scripture_data.text_orig: תד צמו ויח רח סי לו הנית הכלנ ירמ ימ י המ סנ יה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Dari jauh ia telah kelihatan kepada mereka. Tetapi sebelum ia dekat pada mereka, mereka telah bermufakat mencari daya upaya untuk membunuhnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near unto them, they conspired against him to slay him.
scripture_data.text_orig: תימהל ת לנתו היל ברקי רב קחרמ ת רו

scripture_data.text_id: Kata mereka seorang kepada yang lain: "Lihat, tukang mimpi kita itu datang!
scripture_data.text_en: And they said one to another, Behold, this dreamer cometh.
scripture_data.text_orig: הזה תמלחה ל הה ויחל י רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Sekarang, marilah kita bunuh dia dan kita lemparkan ke dalam salah satu sumur ini, lalu kita katakan: seekor binatang buas telah menerkamnya. Dan kita akan lihat nanti, bagaimana jadinya mimpinya itu!"
scripture_data.text_en: Come now therefore, and let us slay him, and cast him into some pit, and we will say, Some evil beast hath devoured him: and we shall see what will become of his dreams.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתמלח יההם הרנו התלכ הר הח נרמו תרה דח הכלנו הגרהנו כל הו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Ruben mendengar hal ini, ia ingin melepaskan Yusuf dari tangan mereka, sebab itu katanya: "Janganlah kita bunuh dia!"
scripture_data.text_en: And Reuben heard [it], and he delivered him out of their hands; and said, Let us not kill him.
scripture_data.text_orig: פנ ן ל רמו דמ הלו בר מו

scripture_data.text_id: Lagi kata Ruben kepada mereka: "Janganlah tumpahkan darah, lemparkanlah dia ke dalam sumur yang ada di padang gurun ini, tetapi janganlah apa-apakan dia" maksudnya hendak melepaskan Yusuf dari tangan mereka dan membawanya kembali kepada ayahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Reuben said unto them, Shed no blood, [but] cast him into this pit that [is] in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him; that he might rid him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויבל ביהל דמ ת ליה מל בחלל דיו רד ר הה רהל ת כילה דכל בר הל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Baru saja Yusuf sampai kepada saudara-saudaranya, merekapun menanggalkan jubah Yusuf, jubah maha indah yang dipakainya itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when Joseph was come unto his brethren, that they stript Joseph out of his coat, [his] coat of [many] colours that [was] on him;
scripture_data.text_orig: ויל ר יה תנתת נת סית יפו ויחל סי ר יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan mereka membawa dia dan melemparkan dia ke dalam sumur. Sumur itu kosong, tidak berair.
scripture_data.text_en: And they took him, and cast him into a pit: and the pit [was] empty, [there was] no water in it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ י קר רהו הרה ת כלו החו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian duduklah mereka untuk makan. Ketika mereka mengangkat muka, kelihatanlah kepada mereka suatu kafilah orang Ismael datang dari Gilead dengan untanya yang membawa damar, balsam dan damar ladan, dalam perjalanannya mengangkut barang-barang itu ke Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And they sat down to eat bread: and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and, behold, a company of Ishmeelites came from Gilead with their camels bearing spicery and balm and myrrh, going to carry [it] down to Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: המירצמ דירהל יכלה לו ירצ תכן ינ הימג דלמ ה ילמי תחר ההו רו היני ו חללכל בו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu kata Yehuda kepada saudara-saudaranya itu: "Apakah untungnya kalau kita membunuh adik kita itu dan menyembunyikan darahnya?
scripture_data.text_en: And Judah said unto his brethren, What profit [is it] if we slay our brother, and conceal his blood?
scripture_data.text_orig: מת ניכו ניחת גרהן י צהם ויחל הדהי רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Marilah kita jual dia kepada orang Ismael ini, tetapi janganlah kita apa-apakan dia, karena ia saudara kita, darah daging kita." Dan saudara-saudaranya mendengarkan perkataannya itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Come, and let us sell him to the Ishmeelites, and let not our hand be upon him; for he [is] our brother [and] our flesh. And his brethren were content.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויח מו ה נרב ניחי ביהל נדיו ילמל רמנו כל

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika ada saudagar-saudagar Midian lewat, Yusuf diangkat ke atas dari dalam sumur itu, kemudian dijual kepada orang Ismael itu dengan harga dua puluh syikal perak. Lalu Yusuf dibawa mereka ke Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: Then there passed by Midianites merchantmen; and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmeelites for twenty [pieces] of silver: and they brought Joseph into Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: המירצמ סית יבו ס יר ילמל סית רמו רהמ סית לו כמו ירחס ינידמ ינ רבו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Ruben kembali ke sumur itu, ternyata Yusuf tidak ada lagi di dalamnya. Lalu dikoyakkannyalah bajunya,
scripture_data.text_en: And Reuben returned unto the pit; and, behold, Joseph [was] not in the pit; and he rent his clothes.
scripture_data.text_orig: וידגת רקו ר סיי ההו רהל בר בו

scripture_data.text_id: dan kembalilah ia kepada saudara-saudaranya, katanya: "Anak itu tidak ada lagi, ke manakah aku ini?"
scripture_data.text_en: And he returned unto his brethren, and said, The child [is] not; and I, whither shall I go?
scripture_data.text_orig: בינ הנ ינו ני דלה רמו ויחל בו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian mereka mengambil jubah Yusuf, dan menyembelih seekor kambing, lalu mencelupkan jubah itu ke dalam darahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And they took Joseph's coat, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the coat in the blood;
scripture_data.text_orig: תנהת לו י רי חו סי תנתת חקו

scripture_data.text_id: Jubah maha indah itu mereka suruh antarkan kepada ayah mereka dengan pesan: "Ini kami dapati. Silakanlah bapa periksa apakah jubah ini milik anak bapa atau tidak?"
scripture_data.text_en: And they sent the coat of [many] colours, and they brought [it] to their father; and said, This have we found: know now whether it [be] thy son's coat or no.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל וה נ תנתה נרה נצמ תז רמו היבל יבו יה תנתת חיו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Yakub memeriksa jubah itu, ia berkata: "Ini jubah anakku; binatang buas telah memakannya; tentulah Yusuf telah diterkam."
scripture_data.text_en: And he knew it, and said, [It is] my son's coat; an evil beast hath devoured him; Joseph is without doubt rent in pieces.
scripture_data.text_orig: סי ר ר התלכ הר הח ינ תנת רמו ריו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Yakub mengoyakkan jubahnya, lalu mengenakan kain kabung pada pinggangnya dan berkabunglah ia berhari-hari lamanya karena anaknya itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And Jacob rent his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר ימי נל לתו וינתמ ק ו ויתלמ בקי רקו

scripture_data.text_id: Sekalian anaknya laki-laki dan perempuan berusaha menghiburkan dia, tetapi ia menolak dihiburkan, serta katanya: "Tidak! Aku akan berkabung, sampai aku turun mendapatkan anakku, ke dalam dunia orang mati!" Demikianlah Yusuf ditangisi oleh ayahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And all his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him; but he refused to be comforted; and he said, For I will go down into the grave unto my son mourning. Thus his father wept for him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויב ת שבו הל לב ינל דרי רמו חנתהל מיו מחנל ויתנלכו וינלכ מקו

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun Yusuf, ia dijual oleh orang Midian itu ke Mesir, kepada Potifar, seorang pegawai istana Firaun, kepala pengawal raja.

scripture_data.text_id: Lembu yang kurus dan buruk itu memakan ketujuh ekor lembu gemuk yang mula-mula.
scripture_data.text_en: And the lean and the ill favoured kine did eat up the first seven fat kine:
scripture_data.text_orig: תירה תנרה תרה ב ת תרהו תרה תרה הנלכו

scripture_data.text_id: Lembu-lembu ini masuk ke dalam perutnya, tetapi walaupun telah masuk ke dalam perutnya, tidaklah kelihatan sedikitpun tandanya: bangunnya tetap sama buruknya seperti semula. Lalu terjagalah aku.
scripture_data.text_en: And when they had eaten them up, it could not be known that they had eaten them; but they [were] still ill favoured, as at the beginning. So I awoke.
scripture_data.text_orig: שקיו הח ר ר הירמ הנרקל בי דן לו הנרקל הנבו

scripture_data.text_id: Selanjutnya dalam mimpiku itu kulihat timbul dari satu tangkai tujuh bulir gandum yang berisi dan baik.
scripture_data.text_en: And I saw in my dream, and, behold, seven ears came up in one stalk, full and good:
scripture_data.text_orig: תבו תלם דח הנק תל יל ב ההו ימלח רו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi kemudian tampaklah juga tumbuh tujuh bulir yang kering, kurus dan layu oleh angin timur.
scripture_data.text_en: And, behold, seven ears, withered, thin, [and] blasted with the east wind, sprung up after them:
scripture_data.text_orig: הירח תחמצ ידק תפד ת תמנץ יל ב ההו

scripture_data.text_id: Bulir yang kurus itu memakan ketujuh bulir yang baik tadi. Telah kuceritakan hal ini kepada semua ahli, tetapi seorangpun tidak ada yang dapat menerangkannya kepadaku."
scripture_data.text_en: And the thin ears devoured the seven good ears: and I told [this] unto the magicians; but [there was] none that could declare [it] to me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל דים יו ירחהל רמו תבה ילה ב ת תה ילה לבו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu kata Yusuf kepada Firaun: "Kedua mimpi tuanku Firaun itu sama. Allah telah memberitahukan kepada tuanku Firaun apa yang hendak dilakukan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph said unto Pharaoh, The dream of Pharaoh [is] one: God hath shewed Pharaoh what he [is] about to do.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרפל דיה ה יהלה ר ת ה דח הר לח הרל סי רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketujuh ekor lembu yang baik itu ialah tujuh tahun, dan ketujuh bulir gandum yang baik itu ialah tujuh tahun juga; kedua mimpi itu sama.
scripture_data.text_en: The seven good kine [are] seven years; and the seven good ears [are] seven years: the dream [is] one.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה דח לח הה ינ ב תבה ילה בו הה ינ ב תבה תר ב

scripture_data.text_id: Ketujuh ekor lembu yang kurus dan buruk, yang keluar kemudian, maksudnya tujuh tahun, demikian pula ketujuh bulir gandum yang hampa dan layu oleh angin timur itu; maksudnya akan ada tujuh tahun kelaparan.
scripture_data.text_en: And the seven thin and ill favoured kine that came up after them [are] seven years; and the seven empty ears blasted with the east wind shall be seven years of famine.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר ינ ב יהי ידה תפד תקרה ילה בו הה ינ ב הירח תלה תרהו תרה תרה בו

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah maksud perkataanku, ketika aku berkata kepada tuanku Firaun: Allah telah memperlihatkan kepada tuanku Firaun apa yang hendak dilakukan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: This [is] the thing which I have spoken unto Pharaoh: What God [is] about to do he sheweth unto Pharaoh.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרת הרה ה יהלה ר הרל יר ר רבה ה

scripture_data.text_id: Ketahuilah tuanku, akan datang tujuh tahun kelimpahan di seluruh tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, there come seven years of great plenty throughout all the land of Egypt:
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרלכ לד ב ת ינ ב הה

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian akan timbul tujuh tahun kelaparan; maka akan dilupakan segala kelimpahan itu di tanah Mesir, karena kelaparan itu menguruskeringkan negeri ini.
scripture_data.text_en: And there shall arise after them seven years of famine; and all the plenty shall be forgotten in the land of Egypt; and the famine shall consume the land;
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהת ברה הכו ירצמ שר בהל חנו הירח בר ינ ב מקו

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu akan tidak kelihatan lagi bekas-bekas kelimpahan di negeri ini karena kelaparan itu, sebab sangat hebatnya kelaparan itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the plenty shall not be known in the land by reason of that famine following; for it [shall be] very grievous.
scripture_data.text_orig: דם ה דבכי כירח הה ברה ינמ שר בה דילו

scripture_data.text_id: Sampai dua kali mimpi itu diulangi bagi tuanku Firaun berarti: hal itu telah ditetapkan oleh Allah dan Allah akan segera melakukannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And for that the dream was doubled unto Pharaoh twice; [it is] because the thing [is] established by God, and God will shortly bring it to pass.
scripture_data.text_orig: תל יהלה רהממ יהלה מ רבה כני ימ הרל לחה תנה לו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, baiklah tuanku Firaun mencari seorang yang berakal budi dan bijaksana, dan mengangkatnya menjadi kuasa atas tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: Now therefore let Pharaoh look out a man discreet and wise, and set him over the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרל התייו כחו בנ י הרף רי הו

scripture_data.text_id: Baiklah juga tuanku Firaun berbuat begini, yakni menempatkan penilik-penilik atas negeri ini dan dalam ketujuh tahun kelimpahan itu memungut seperlima dari hasil tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: Let Pharaoh do [this], and let him appoint officers over the land, and take up the fifth part of the land of Egypt in the seven plenteous years.
scripture_data.text_orig: בה ינ ב ירצמ שרת חו שרהל ידק דקפיו הרף הי

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka harus mengumpulkan segala bahan makanan dalam tahun-tahun baik yang akan datang ini dan, di bawah kuasa tuanku Firaun, menimbun gandum di kota-kota sebagai bahan makanan, serta menyimpannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And let them gather all the food of those good years that come, and lay up corn under the hand of Pharaoh, and let them keep food in the cities.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמו יר לכ הרדי תח רברציו הה תה תבה ינה לכלת צקיו

scripture_data.text_id: Demikianlah segala bahan makanan itu menjadi persediaan untuk negeri ini dalam ketujuh tahun kelaparan yang akan terjadi di tanah Mesir, supaya negeri ini jangan binasa karena kelaparan itu."
scripture_data.text_en: And that food shall be for store to the land against the seven years of famine, which shall be in the land of Egypt; that the land perish not through the famine.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר שרה תרתלו ירצמ שר ייה ר ברה ינ בל שרל דפל לכה היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Usul itu dipandang baik oleh Firaun dan oleh semua pegawainya.
scripture_data.text_en: And the thing was good in the eyes of Pharaoh, and in the eyes of all his servants.
scripture_data.text_orig: וידבל יניב הרף יני רבה ביו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu berkatalah Firaun kepada para pegawainya: "Mungkinkah kita mendapat orang seperti ini, seorang yang penuh dengan Roh Allah?"
scripture_data.text_en: And Pharaoh said unto his servants, Can we find [such a one] as this [is], a man in whom the Spirit of God [is]?
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל חר ר י הזכ צמנה וידבל הר רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Kata Firaun kepada Yusuf: "Oleh karena Allah telah memberitahukan semuanya ini kepadamu, tidaklah ada orang yang demikian berakal budi dan bijaksana seperti engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Forasmuch as God hath shewed thee all this, [there is] none so discreet and wise as thou [art]:
scripture_data.text_orig: מ כחו בני תזלת ת יהל ידה ירח סיל הר רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Engkaulah menjadi kuasa atas istanaku, dan kepada perintahmu seluruh rakyatku akan taat; hanya takhta inilah kelebihanku dari padamu."
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt be over my house, and according unto thy word shall all my people be ruled: only in the throne will I be greater than thou.
scripture_data.text_orig: שמ לג ה קר יל קי ילו יתיל היה ה

scripture_data.text_id: Selanjutnya Firaun berkata kepada Yusuf: "Dengan ini aku melantik engkau menjadi kuasa atas seluruh tanah Mesir."
scripture_data.text_en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, See, I have set thee over all the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרל ל ת יתנ הר סיל הר רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu Firaun menanggalkan cincin meterainya dari jarinya dan mengenakannya pada jari Yusuf; dipakaikannyalah kepada Yusuf pakaian dari pada kain halus dan digantungkannya kalung emas pada lehernya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Pharaoh took off his ring from his hand, and put it upon Joseph's hand, and arrayed him in vestures of fine linen, and put a gold chain about his neck;
scripture_data.text_orig: רצל בהה דבר ו ידג ת לו סי דיל ת ו די למ ת הר רסו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Firaun menyuruh menaikkan Yusuf dalam keretanya yang kedua, dan berserulah orang di hadapan Yusuf: "Hormat!" Demikianlah Yusuf dilantik oleh Firaun menjadi kuasa atas seluruh tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And he made him to ride in the second chariot which he had; and they cried before him, Bow the knee: and he made him [ruler] over all the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרל ל ת תנו רב וינפל רקו לר הנה תברמ ת ברו

scripture_data.text_id: Berkatalah Firaun kepada Yusuf: "Akulah Firaun, tetapi dengan tidak setahumu, seorangpun tidak boleh bergerak di seluruh tanah Mesir."
scripture_data.text_en: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, I [am] Pharaoh, and without thee shall no man lift up his hand or foot in all the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרלכ לגרתו דית י יריל ידלב הרף ינ סיל הר רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Firaun menamai Yusuf: Zafnat-Paaneah, serta memberikan Asnat, anak Potifera, imam di On, kepadanya menjadi isterinya. Demikianlah Yusuf muncul sebagai kuasa atas seluruh tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And Pharaoh called Joseph's name Zaphnathpaaneah; and he gave him to wife Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On. And Joseph went out over [all] the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרל סי צו הל ה רפית תנסת לו חנתנפצ סי הרף רקו

scripture_data.text_id: Yusuf berumur tiga puluh tahun ketika ia menghadap Firaun, raja Mesir itu. Maka pergilah Yusuf dari depan Firaun, lalu dikelilinginya seluruh tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph [was] thirty years old when he stood before Pharaoh king of Egypt. And Joseph went out from the presence of Pharaoh, and went throughout all the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרלכ רבו הרף ינפמ סי צו ירצמלם הר ינפל דמ הנ יל סיו

scripture_data.text_id: Tanah itu mengeluarkan hasil bertumpuk-tumpuk dalam ketujuh tahun kelimpahan itu,
scripture_data.text_en: And in the seven plenteous years the earth brought forth by handfuls.
scripture_data.text_orig: יצמקל בה ינ ב שרה ו

scripture_data.text_id: maka Yusuf mengumpulkan segala bahan makanan ketujuh tahun kelimpahan yang ada di tanah Mesir, lalu disimpannya di kota-kota; hasil daerah sekitar tiap-tiap kota disimpan di dalam kota itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And he gathered up all the food of the seven years, which were in the land of Egypt, and laid up the food in the cities: the food of the field, which [was] round about every city, laid he up in the same.
scripture_data.text_orig: כת תנ היתביבס ר ריההד לכ יר לכו ירצמ שר יה ר ינ ב לכלת שקו

scripture_data.text_id: Demikianlah Yusuf menimbun gandum seperti pasir di laut, sangat banyak, sehingga orang berhenti menghitungnya, karena memang tidak terhitung.
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph gathered corn as the sand of the sea, very much, until he left numbering; for [it was] without number.
scripture_data.text_orig: רסמ יי רסל לדחי ד דם הרה ה לח ר סי רצו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebelum datang tahun kelaparan itu, lahirlah bagi Yusuf dua orang anak laki-laki, yang dilahirkan oleh Asnat, anak Potifera, imam di On.
scripture_data.text_en: And unto Joseph were born two sons before the years of famine came, which Asenath the daughter of Potipherah priest of On bare unto him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה רפית תנס הדלי ר ברה תנ ב ר ינב ינ די סיל

scripture_data.text_id: Yusuf memberi nama Manasye kepada anak sulungnya itu, sebab katanya: "Allah telah membuat aku lupa sama sekali kepada kesukaranku dan kepada rumah bapaku."
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph called the name of the firstborn Manasseh: For God, [said he], hath made me forget all my toil, and all my father's house.
scripture_data.text_orig: יב תיל תו ילמלת יהל ינני הנם רכה ת סי רקו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kepada anaknya yang kedua diberinya nama Efraim, sebab katanya: "Allah membuat aku mendapat anak dalam negeri kesengsaraanku."
scripture_data.text_en: And the name of the second called he Ephraim: For God hath caused me to be fruitful in the land of my affliction.
scripture_data.text_orig: יינ שר יהל ינרפהי ירפ רק ינה תו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah lewat ketujuh tahun kelimpahan yang ada di tanah Mesir itu,
scripture_data.text_en: And the seven years of plenteousness, that was in the land of Egypt, were ended.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שר היה ר בה ינ ב הנילכו

scripture_data.text_id: mulailah datang tujuh tahun kelaparan, seperti yang telah dikatakan Yusuf; dalam segala negeri ada kelaparan, tetapi di seluruh negeri Mesir ada roti.
scripture_data.text_en: And the seven years of dearth began to come, according as Joseph had said: and the dearth was in all lands; but in all the land of Egypt there was bread.
scripture_data.text_orig: חל היה ירצמ שרלכב תצרהלכ בר יהיו סי רמ ר בל ברה ינ ב הניחו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika seluruh negeri Mesir menderita kelaparan, dan rakyat berteriak meminta roti kepada Firaun, berkatalah Firaun kepada semua orang Mesir: "Pergilah kepada Yusuf, perbuatlah apa yang akan dikatakannya kepadamu."
scripture_data.text_en: And when all the land of Egypt was famished, the people cried to Pharaoh for bread: and Pharaoh said unto all the Egyptians, Go unto Joseph; what he saith to you, do.
scripture_data.text_orig: כל רמיר סיל כל ירצמלכל הר רמו חל הרל ה קצו ירצמ שרל ברו

scripture_data.text_id: Kelaparan itu merajalela di seluruh bumi. Maka Yusuf membuka segala lumbung dan menjual gandum kepada orang Mesir, sebab makin hebat kelaparan itu di tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And the famine was over all the face of the earth: And Joseph opened all the storehouses, and sold unto the Egyptians; and the famine waxed sore in the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שר ברה קזחו ירצמל רו ה רלת סי חפו שרה ינל ל היה ברהו

scripture_data.text_id: Juga dari seluruh bumi datanglah orang ke Mesir untuk membeli gandum dari Yusuf, sebab hebat kelaparan itu di seluruh bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: And all countries came into Egypt to Joseph for to buy [corn]; because that the famine was [so] sore in all lands.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהלכ ברה קזחי סיל רל המירצמ שרהלכו

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Yakub mendapat kabar, bahwa ada gandum di Mesir, berkatalah ia kepada anak-anaknya: "Mengapa kamu berpandang-pandangan saja?"
scripture_data.text_en: Now when Jacob saw that there was corn in Egypt, Jacob said unto his sons, Why do ye look one upon another?
scripture_data.text_orig: רת הל וינבל בקי רמו ירצמ רבי י בקי רו

scripture_data.text_id: Lagi katanya: "Telah kudengar, bahwa ada gandum di Mesir; pergilah ke sana dan belilah gandum di sana untuk kita, supaya kita tetap hidup dan jangan mati."
scripture_data.text_en: And he said, Behold, I have heard that there is corn in Egypt: get you down thither, and buy for us from thence; that we may live, and not die.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמנ לו היחנו מ נלרבו הדר ירצמ רבי י ימ הה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu pergilah sepuluh orang saudara Yusuf untuk membeli gandum di Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph's ten brethren went down to buy corn in Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ ר רל הר סייח דרו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Yakub tidak membiarkan Benyamin, adik Yusuf, pergi bersama-sama dengan saudara-saudaranya, sebab pikirnya: "Jangan-jangan ia ditimpa kecelakaan nanti."
scripture_data.text_en: But Benjamin, Joseph's brother, Jacob sent not with his brethren; for he said, Lest peradventure mischief befall him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רקי רמ י ויחת בקי חלל סי יח ימינתו

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi di antara orang yang datang membeli gandum terdapatlah juga anak-anak Israel, sebab ada kelaparan di tanah Kanaan.
scripture_data.text_en: And the sons of Israel came to buy [corn] among those that came: for the famine was in the land of Canaan.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ שר ברה היהי יה ת רל לרי ינ בו

scripture_data.text_id: Sementara itu Yusuf telah menjadi mangkubumi di negeri itu; dialah yang menjual gandum kepada seluruh rakyat negeri itu. Jadi ketika saudara-saudara Yusuf datang, kepadanyalah mereka menghadap dan sujud dengan mukanya sampai ke tanah.
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph [was] the governor over the land, [and] he [it was] that sold to all the people of the land: and Joseph's brethren came, and bowed down themselves before him [with] their faces to the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הצר י לוחו סי יח בו שרה לכל ריה ה שרהל יה ה סיו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Yusuf melihat saudara-saudaranya, segeralah mereka dikenalnya, tetapi ia berlaku seolah-olah ia seorang asing kepada mereka; ia menegor mereka dengan membentak, katanya: "Dari mana kamu?" Jawab mereka: "Dari tanah Kanaan untuk membeli bahan makanan."
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph saw his brethren, and he knew them, but made himself strange unto them, and spake roughly unto them; and he said unto them, Whence come ye? And they said, From the land of Canaan to buy food.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכרל נ שרמ רמו ת ימ הל רמו תק רדיו היל רנתו רו ויחת סי רו

scripture_data.text_id: Memang Yusuf mengenal saudara-saudaranya itu, tetapi dia tidak dikenal mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph knew his brethren, but they knew not him.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרה ל הו ויחת סי רו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu teringatlah Yusuf akan mimpi-mimpinya tentang mereka. Berkatalah ia kepada mereka: "Kamu ini pengintai, kamu datang untuk melihat-lihat di mana negeri ini tidak dijaga."
scripture_data.text_en: And Joseph remembered the dreams which he dreamed of them, and said unto them, Ye [are] spies; to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת שרה תורת תרל ילרם הל רמו הל לח ר תמלחה ת סי רזו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi jawab mereka: "Tidak tuanku! Hanyalah untuk membeli bahan makanan hamba-hambamu ini datang.
scripture_data.text_en: And they said unto him, Nay, my lord, but to buy food are thy servants come.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכרל ידבו ינד ל ויל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Kami ini sekalian anak dari satu ayah; kami ini orang jujur; hamba-hambamu ini bukanlah pengintai."
scripture_data.text_en: We [are] all one man's sons; we [are] true [men], thy servants are no spies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילרם ידב יהל נחנ ינ נחנ דחי ינ נ

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi ia berkata kepada mereka: "Tidak! Kamu datang untuk melihat-lihat di mana negeri ini tidak dijaga."
scripture_data.text_en: And he said unto them, Nay, but to see the nakedness of the land ye are come.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרל ת שרה תורי ל הל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu jawab mereka: "Hamba-hambamu ini dua belas orang, kami bersaudara, anak dari satu ayah di tanah Kanaan, tetapi yang bungsu sekarang ada pada ayah kami, dan seorang sudah tidak ada lagi."
scripture_data.text_en: And they said, Thy servants [are] twelve brethren, the sons of one man in the land of Canaan; and, behold, the youngest [is] this day with our father, and one [is] not.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu berkatalah Musa kepada bangsa itu: "Peringatilah hari ini, sebab pada hari ini kamu keluar dari Mesir, dari rumah perbudakan; karena dengan kekuatan tangan-Nya TUHAN telah membawa kamu keluar dari sana. Sebab itu tidak boleh dimakan sesuatupun yang beragi.
scripture_data.text_en: And Moses said unto the people, Remember this day, in which ye came out from Egypt, out of the house of bondage; for by strength of hand the LORD brought you out from this [place]: there shall no leavened bread be eaten.
scripture_data.text_orig: שמח לכי לו המ כת הוהי יצה די קזח י ידב תימ ירצמ תצי ר הה הת רכז הל המ רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Hari ini kamu keluar, dalam bulan Abib.
scripture_data.text_en: This day came ye out in the month Abib.

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila TUHAN telah membawa engkau ke negeri orang Kanaan, orang Het, orang Amori, orang Hewi dan orang Yebus, negeri yang telah dijanjikan-Nya dengan sumpah kepada nenek moyangmu untuk memberikannya kepadamu, suatu negeri yang berlimpah-limpah susu dan madunya, maka engkau harus melakukan ibadah ini dalam bulan ini juga.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, and the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, which he sware unto thy fathers to give thee, a land flowing with milk and honey, that thou shalt keep this service in this month.

scripture_data.text_en: Seven days thou shalt eat unleavened bread, and in the seventh day [shall be] a feast to the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Roti yang tidak beragi haruslah dimakan selama tujuh hari itu; sesuatupun yang beragi tidak boleh dilihat padamu, bahkan ragi tidak boleh dilihat padamu di seluruh daerahmu.
scripture_data.text_en: Unleavened bread shall be eaten seven days; and there shall no leavened bread be seen with thee, neither shall there be leaven seen with thee in all thy quarters.

scripture_data.text_id: Pada hari itu harus kauberitahukan kepada anakmu laki-laki: Ibadah ini adalah karena mengingat apa yang dibuat TUHAN kepadaku pada waktu aku keluar dari Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And thou shalt shew thy son in that day, saying, [This is done] because of that [which] the LORD did unto me when I came forth out of Egypt.

scripture_data.text_id: Hal itu bagimu harus menjadi tanda pada tanganmu dan menjadi peringatan di dahimu, supaya hukum TUHAN ada di bibirmu; sebab dengan tangan yang kuat TUHAN telah membawa engkau keluar dari Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be for a sign unto thee upon thine hand, and for a memorial between thine eyes, that the LORD'S law may be in thy mouth: for with a strong hand hath the LORD brought thee out of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ הוהי צה הקזח די י יפ הוהי תר היה מל יני י רזל דיל תל ל היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Haruslah kaupegang ketetapan ini pada waktunya yang sudah ditentukan, dari tahun ke tahun.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt therefore keep this ordinance in his season from year to year.

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila engkau telah dibawa TUHAN ke negeri orang Kanaan, seperti yang telah dijanjikan-Nya dengan sumpah kepadamu dan kepada nenek moyangmu, dan negeri itu telah diberikan-Nya kepadamu,
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be when the LORD shall bring thee into the land of the Canaanites, as he sware unto thee and to thy fathers, and shall give it thee,

scripture_data.text_en: That thou shalt set apart unto the LORD all that openeth the matrix, and every firstling that cometh of a beast which thou hast; the males [shall be] the LORD'S.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi setiap anak keledai yang lahir terdahulu kautebuslah dengan seekor domba; atau, jika engkau tidak menebusnya, engkau harus mematahkan batang lehernya. Tetapi mengenai manusia, setiap anak sulung di antara anak-anakmu lelaki, haruslah kautebus.
scripture_data.text_en: And every firstling of an ass thou shalt redeem with a lamb; and if thou wilt not redeem it, then thou shalt break his neck: and all the firstborn of man among thy children shalt thou redeem.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan apabila anakmu akan bertanya kepadamu di kemudian hari: Apakah artinya itu? maka haruslah engkau berkata kepadanya: Dengan kekuatan tangan-Nya TUHAN telah membawa kita keluar dari Mesir, dari rumah perbudakan.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be when thy son asketh thee in time to come, saying, What [is] this? that thou shalt say unto him, By strength of hand the LORD brought us out from Egypt, from the house of bondage:

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab ketika Firaun dengan tegar menolak untuk membiarkan kita pergi, maka TUHAN membunuh semua anak sulung di tanah Mesir, dari anak sulung manusia sampai anak sulung hewan. Itulah sebabnya maka aku biasa mempersembahkan kepada TUHAN segala binatang jantan yang lahir terdahulu dari kandungan, sedang semua anak sulung di antara anak-anakku lelaki kutebus.
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh would hardly let us go, that the LORD slew all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, both the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of beast: therefore I sacrifice to the LORD all that openeth the matrix, being males; but all the firstborn of my children I redeem.

scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be for a token upon thine hand, and for frontlets between thine eyes: for by strength of hand the LORD brought us forth out of Egypt.

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Firaun membiarkan bangsa itu pergi, Allah tidak menuntun mereka melalui jalan ke negeri orang Filistin, walaupun jalan ini yang paling dekat; sebab firman Allah: "Jangan-jangan bangsa itu menyesal, apabila mereka menghadapi peperangan, sehingga mereka kembali ke Mesir."
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when Pharaoh had let the people go, that God led them not [through] the way of the land of the Philistines, although that [was] near; for God said, Lest peradventure the people repent when they see war, and they return to Egypt:

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Allah menuntun bangsa itu berputar melalui jalan di padang gurun menuju ke Laut Teberau. Dengan siap sedia berperang berjalanlah orang Israel dari tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: But God led the people about, [through] the way of the wilderness of the Red sea: and the children of Israel went up harnessed out of the land of Egypt.

scripture_data.text_en: And Moses took the bones of Joseph with him: for he had straitly sworn the children of Israel, saying, God will surely visit you; and ye shall carry up my bones away hence with you.

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berjalan di depan mereka, pada siang hari dalam tiang awan untuk menuntun mereka di jalan, dan pada waktu malam dalam tiang api untuk menerangi mereka, sehingga mereka dapat berjalan siang dan malam.
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD went before them by day in a pillar of a cloud, to lead them the way; and by night in a pillar of fire, to give them light; to go by day and night:

scripture_data.text_id: "Katakanlah kepada orang Israel, supaya mereka balik kembali dan berkemah di depan Pi-Hahirot, antara Migdol dan laut; tepat di depan Baal-Zefon berkemahlah kamu, di tepi laut.
scripture_data.text_en: Speak unto the children of Israel, that they turn and encamp before Pihahiroth, between Migdol and the sea, over against Baalzephon: before it shall ye encamp by the sea.

scripture_data.text_en: For Pharaoh will say of the children of Israel, They [are] entangled in the land, the wilderness hath shut them in.

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mengeraskan hati Firaun, sehingga ia mengejar mereka. Dan terhadap Firaun dan seluruh pasukannya Aku akan menyatakan kemuliaan-Ku, sehingga orang Mesir mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN." Lalu mereka berbuat demikian.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will harden Pharaoh's heart, that he shall follow after them; and I will be honoured upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host; that the Egyptians may know that I [am] the LORD. And they did so.

scripture_data.text_en: And it was told the king of Egypt that the people fled: and the heart of Pharaoh and of his servants was turned against the people, and they said, Why have we done this, that we have let Israel go from serving us?

scripture_data.text_id: Demikianlah TUHAN mengeraskan hati Firaun, raja Mesir itu, sehingga ia mengejar orang Israel. Tetapi orang Israel berjalan terus dipimpin oleh tangan yang dinaikkan.
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD hardened the heart of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and he pursued after the children of Israel: and the children of Israel went out with an high hand.

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun orang Mesir, segala kuda dan kereta Firaun, orang-orang berkuda dan pasukannya, mengejar mereka dan mencapai mereka pada waktu mereka berkemah di tepi laut, dekat Pi-Hahirot di depan Baal-Zefon.
scripture_data.text_en: But the Egyptians pursued after them, all the horses [and] chariots of Pharaoh, and his horsemen, and his army, and overtook them encamping by the sea, beside Pihahiroth, before Baalzephon.

scripture_data.text_en: And when Pharaoh drew nigh, the children of Israel lifted up their eyes, and, behold, the Egyptians marched after them; and they were sore afraid: and the children of Israel cried out unto the LORD.

scripture_data.text_en: And they said unto Moses, Because [there were] no graves in Egypt, hast thou taken us away to die in the wilderness? wherefore hast thou dealt thus with us, to carry us forth out of Egypt?

scripture_data.text_id: Bukankah ini telah kami katakan kepadamu di Mesir: Janganlah mengganggu kami dan biarlah kami bekerja pada orang Mesir. Sebab lebih baik bagi kami untuk bekerja pada orang Mesir dari pada mati di padang gurun ini."
scripture_data.text_en: [Is] not this the word that we did tell thee in Egypt, saying, Let us alone, that we may serve the Egyptians? For [it had been] better for us to serve the Egyptians, than that we should die in the wilderness.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi berkatalah Musa kepada bangsa itu: "Janganlah takut, berdirilah tetap dan lihatlah keselamatan dari TUHAN, yang akan diberikan-Nya hari ini kepadamu; sebab orang Mesir yang kamu lihat hari ini, tidak akan kamu lihat lagi untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Moses said unto the people, Fear ye not, stand still, and see the salvation of the LORD, which he will shew to you to day: for the Egyptians whom ye have seen to day, ye shall see them again no more for ever.

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN akan berperang untuk kamu, dan kamu akan diam saja."

scripture_data.text_id: Dan engkau, angkatlah tongkatmu dan ulurkanlah tanganmu ke atas laut dan belahlah airnya, sehingga orang Israel akan berjalan dari tengah-tengah laut di tempat kering.

scripture_data.text_en: And I, behold, I will harden the hearts of the Egyptians, and they shall follow them: and I will get me honour upon Pharaoh, and upon all his host, upon his chariots, and upon his horsemen.
