scripture_data.text_id: Juga pada hari-hari kamu bersukaria, pada perayaan-perayaanmu dan pada bulan-bulan barumu haruslah kamu meniup nafiri itu pada waktu mempersembahkan korban-korban bakaranmu dan korban-korban keselamatanmu; maksudnya supaya kamu diingat di hadapan Allahmu; Akulah TUHAN, Allahmu."
scripture_data.text_en: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your solemn days, and in the beginnings of your months, ye shall blow with the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; that they may be to you for a memorial before your God: I [am] the LORD your God.

Sebab itu ikutlah bersama-sama dengan kami, maka kami akan berbuat baik kepadamu, sebab TUHAN telah menjanjikan yang baik tentang Israel."
scripture_data.text_en: And Moses said unto Hobab, the son of Raguel the Midianite, Moses' father in law, We are journeying unto the place of which the LORD said, I will give it you: come thou with us, and we will do thee good: for the LORD hath spoken good concerning Israel.

scripture_data.text_en: And he said, Leave us not, I pray thee; forasmuch as thou knowest how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and thou mayest be to us instead of eyes.

scripture_data.text_id: yakni perbaraan orang-orang berdosa yang telah membayarkan nyawanya, kemudian semuanya itu harus ditempa tipis-tipis menjadi salut mezbah, sebab telah dibawa ke hadapan TUHAN oleh orang-orang itu, jadi semuanya itu kudus; dengan demikian hal itu menjadi tanda bagi orang Israel."
scripture_data.text_en: The censers of these sinners against their own souls, let them make them broad plates [for] a covering of the altar: for they offered them before the LORD, therefore they are hallowed: and they shall be a sign unto the children of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Maka imam Eleazar mengambil perbaraan-perbaraan tembaga yang telah dibawa oleh orang-orang yang terbakar itu, lalu ditempa menjadi salut mezbah.
scripture_data.text_en: And Eleazar the priest took the brasen censers, wherewith they that were burnt had offered; and they were made broad [plates for] a covering of the altar:
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Itu menjadi suatu peringatan bagi orang Israel, supaya jangan tampil orang awam yang bukan dari keturunan Harun untuk membakar ukupan di hadapan TUHAN, dan jangan ia menjadi seperti Korah dan kumpulannya seperti yang difirmankan TUHAN kepadanya dengan perantaraan Musa.
scripture_data.text_en: [To be] a memorial unto the children of Israel, that no stranger, which [is] not of the seed of Aaron, come near to offer incense before the LORD; that he be not as Korah, and as his company: as the LORD said to him by the hand of Moses.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi pada keesokan harinya bersungut-sungutlah segenap umat Israel kepada Musa dan Harun, kata mereka: "Kamu telah membunuh umat TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: But on the morrow all the congregation of the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron, saying, Ye have killed the people of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika umat itu berkumpul melawan Musa dan Harun, dan mereka memalingkan mukanya ke arah Kemah Pertemuan, maka kelihatanlah awan itu menutupinya dan tampaklah kemuliaan TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when the congregation was gathered against Moses and against Aaron, that they looked toward the tabernacle of the congregation: and, behold, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu pergilah Musa dan Harun ke depan Kemah Pertemuan.
scripture_data.text_en: And Moses and Aaron came before the tabernacle of the congregation.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Maka berfirmanlah TUHAN kepada Musa:
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: "Pergilah dari tengah-tengah umat ini, supaya Kuhancurkan mereka dalam sekejap mata." Lalu sujudlah mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Get you up from among this congregation, that I may consume them as in a moment. And they fell upon their faces.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Berkatalah Musa kepada Harun: "Ambillah perbaraan, bubuhlah api ke dalamnya dari atas mezbah, dan taruhlah ukupan, dan pergilah dengan segera kepada umat itu dan adakanlah pendamaian bagi mereka, sebab murka TUHAN telah berkobar, dan tulah sedang mulai."
scripture_data.text_en: And Moses said unto Aaron, Take a censer, and put fire therein from off the altar, and put on incense, and go quickly unto the congregation, and make an atonement for them: for there is wrath gone out from the LORD; the plague is begun.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Maka Harun mengambil perbaraan, seperti yang dikatakan Musa, dan berlarilah ia ke tengah-tengah jemaah itu, dan tampaklah tulah telah mulai di antara bangsa itu; lalu dibubuhnyalah ukupan dan diadakannyalah pendamaian bagi bangsa itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And Aaron took as Moses commanded, and ran into the midst of the congregation; and, behold, the plague was begun among the people: and he put on incense, and made an atonement for the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika ia berdiri di antara orang-orang mati dan orang-orang hidup, berhentilah tulah itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And he stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Dan mereka yang mati kena tulah itu ada empat belas ribu tujuh ratus orang banyaknya, belum terhitung orang-orang yang mati karena perkara Korah.
scripture_data.text_en: Now they that died in the plague were fourteen thousand and seven hundred, beside them that died about the matter of Korah.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Harun kembali kepada Musa di depan pintu Kemah Pertemuan, tulah itu telah berhenti.
scripture_data.text_en: And Aaron returned unto Moses unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation: and the plague was stayed.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa:

scripture_data.text_en: And Moses spake unto the children of Israel, and every one of their princes gave him a rod apiece, for each prince one, according to their fathers' houses, [even] twelve rods: and the rod of Aaron [was] among their rods.

scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, that on the morrow Moses went into the tabernacle of witness; and, behold, the rod of Aaron for the house of Levi was budded, and brought forth buds, and bloomed blossoms, and yielded almonds.

scripture_data.text_en: And Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD unto all the children of Israel: and they looked, and took every man his rod.

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa: "Kembalikanlah tongkat Harun ke hadapan tabut hukum untuk disimpan menjadi tanda bagi orang-orang durhaka, sehingga engkau mengakhiri sungut-sungut mereka dan tidak Kudengar lagi, supaya mereka jangan mati."
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD said unto Moses, Bring Aaron's rod again before the testimony, to be kept for a token against the rebels; and thou shalt quite take away their murmurings from me, that they die not.

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Harun: "Engkau ini dan anak-anakmu beserta seluruh sukumu haruslah menanggung akibat setiap kesalahan terhadap tempat kudus; sedang hanya engkau beserta anak-anakmulah yang harus menanggung akibat setiap kesalahan yang dilakukan dalam jabatanmu sebagai imam.
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD said unto Aaron, Thou and thy sons and thy father's house with thee shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary: and thou and thy sons with thee shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

scripture_data.text_en: And thy brethren also of the tribe of Levi, the tribe of thy father, bring thou with thee, that they may be joined unto thee, and minister unto thee: but thou and thy sons with thee [shall minister] before the tabernacle of witness.

scripture_data.text_en: And they shall keep thy charge, and the charge of all the tabernacle: only they shall not come nigh the vessels of the sanctuary and the altar, that neither they, nor ye also, die.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka harus menggabungkan diri kepadamu dan melakukan kewajiban mereka mengenai Kemah Pertemuan sesuai dengan segala pekerjaan pada kemah itu; tetapi orang awam jangan mendekat kepadamu.
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall be joined unto thee, and keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, for all the service of the tabernacle: and a stranger shall not come nigh unto you.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kamu ini haruslah melakukan kewajibanmu mengenai tempat kudus dan kewajibanmu mengenai mezbah, supaya orang Israel jangan lagi tertimpa oleh murka.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall keep the charge of the sanctuary, and the charge of the altar: that there be no wrath any more upon the children of Israel.

scripture_data.text_en: And I, behold, I have taken your brethren the Levites from among the children of Israel: to you [they are] given [as] a gift for the LORD, to do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation.

scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thou and thy sons with thee shall keep your priest's office for every thing of the altar, and within the vail; and ye shall serve: I have given your priest's office [unto you] as a service of gift: and the stranger that cometh nigh shall be put to death.

scripture_data.text_id: Lagi berfirmanlah TUHAN kepada Harun: "Sesungguhnya Aku ini telah menyerahkan kepadamu pemeliharaan persembahan-persembahan khusus yang kepada-Ku; semua persembahan kudus orang Israel Kuberikan kepadamu dan kepada anak-anakmu sebagai bagianmu; itulah suatu ketetapan untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Aaron, Behold, I also have given thee the charge of mine heave offerings of all the hallowed things of the children of Israel; unto thee have I given them by reason of the anointing, and to thy sons, by an ordinance for ever.

scripture_data.text_en: This shall be thine of the most holy things, [reserved] from the fire: every oblation of theirs, every meat offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall render unto me, [shall be] most holy for thee and for thy sons.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebagai bagian maha kudus haruslah kamu memakannya; semua orang laki-laki boleh memakannya; haruslah itu bagian kudus bagimu.

scripture_data.text_en: And this [is] thine; the heave offering of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the children of Israel: I have given them unto thee, and to thy sons and to thy daughters with thee, by a statute for ever: every one that is clean in thy house shall eat of it.

scripture_data.text_id: Mengenai bani Lewi, sesungguhnya Aku berikan kepada mereka segala persembahan persepuluhan di antara orang Israel sebagai milik pusakanya, untuk membalas pekerjaan yang dilakukan mereka, pekerjaan pada Kemah Pertemuan.

scripture_data.text_en: But the Levites shall do the service of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they shall bear their iniquity: [it shall be] a statute for ever throughout your generations, that among the children of Israel they have no inheritance.

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa:
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

scripture_data.text_id: "Lagi haruslah engkau berbicara kepada orang Lewi dan berkata kepada mereka: Apabila kamu menerima dari pihak orang Israel persembahan persepuluhan yang Kuberikan kepadamu dari pihak mereka sebagai milik pusakamu, maka haruslah kamu mempersembahkan sebagian dari padanya sebagai persembahan khusus kepada TUHAN, yakni persembahan persepuluhanmu dari persembahan persepuluhan itu,
scripture_data.text_en: Thus speak unto the Levites, and say unto them, When ye take of the children of Israel the tithes which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then ye shall offer up an heave offering of it for the LORD, [even] a tenth [part] of the tithe.

scripture_data.text_id: dan persembahan itu akan diperhitungkan sebagai persembahan khususmu, sama seperti gandum dari tempat pengirikan dan sama seperti hasil dari tempat pemerasan anggur.

Dan yang dipersembahkan dari padanya sebagai persembahan khusus kepada TUHAN haruslah kamu serahkan kepada imam Harun.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus ye also shall offer an heave offering unto the LORD of all your tithes, which ye receive of the children of Israel; and ye shall give thereof the LORD'S heave offering to Aaron the priest.

scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall eat it in every place, ye and your households: for it [is] your reward for your service in the tabernacle of the congregation.

scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall bear no sin by reason of it, when ye have heaved from it the best of it: neither shall ye pollute the holy things of the children of Israel, lest ye die.

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa dan Harun:
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Moses and unto Aaron, saying,

scripture_data.text_id: "Inilah ketetapan hukum yang diperintahkan TUHAN dengan berfirman: Katakanlah kepada orang Israel, supaya mereka membawa kepadamu seekor lembu betina merah yang tidak bercela, yang tidak ada cacatnya dan yang belum pernah kena kuk.
scripture_data.text_en: This [is] the ordinance of the law which the LORD hath commanded, saying, Speak unto the children of Israel, that they bring thee a red heifer without spot, wherein [is] no blemish, [and] upon which never came yoke:
scripture_data.text_orig: ל היל הלל ר מ י ר המימ הד הרפ יל חקיו לרי ינל ר רמל הוהי הצר הרה תח תז

scripture_data.text_id: Dan haruslah kamu memberikannya kepada imam Eleazar, maka lembu itu harus dibawa ke luar tempat perkemahan, lalu disembelih di depan imam.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall give her unto Eleazar the priest, that he may bring her forth without the camp, and [one] shall slay her before his face:

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian imam Eleazar harus mengambil dengan jarinya sedikit dari darah lembu itu, lalu haruslah ia memercikkan sedikit ke arah sebelah depan Kemah Pertemuan sampai tujuh kali.
scripture_data.text_en: And Eleazar the priest shall take of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle of her blood directly before the tabernacle of the congregation seven times:

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu haruslah lembu itu dibakar habis di depan mata imam; kulitnya, dagingnya dan darahnya haruslah dibakar habis bersama-sama dengan kotorannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And [one] shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her flesh, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn:
scripture_data.text_orig: רי רל מתו רתו רת ויניל הרהת רו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan imam haruslah mengambil kayu aras, hisop dan kain kirmizi dan melemparkannya ke tengah-tengah api yang membakar habis lembu itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the priest shall take cedar wood, and hyssop, and scarlet, and cast [it] into the midst of the burning of the heifer.

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian haruslah imam mencuci pakaiannya dan membasuh tubuhnya dengan air, sesudah itu masuk ke tempat perkemahan, dan imam itu najis sampai matahari terbenam.
scripture_data.text_en: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the even.

scripture_data.text_id: Orang yang membakar habis lembu itu haruslah mencuci pakaiannya dengan air dan membasuh tubuhnya dengan air, dan ia najis sampai matahari terbenam.
scripture_data.text_en: And he that burneth her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the even.

scripture_data.text_id: Maka seorang yang tahir haruslah mengumpulkan abu lembu itu dan menaruhnya pada suatu tempat yang tahir di luar tempat perkemahan, supaya semuanya itu tinggal tersimpan bagi umat Israel untuk membuat air pentahiran; itulah penghapus dosa.
scripture_data.text_en: And a man [that is] clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay [them] up without the camp in a clean place, and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for a water of separation: it [is] a purification for sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: וה תח הנ ימל תרממל לריינ תדל התיהו רה קמ הנחל שחמ חיהו הרה רפ ת רה י סו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan orang yang mengumpulkan abu lembu itu haruslah mencuci pakaiannya, dan ia najis sampai matahari terbenam. Itulah suatu ketetapan untuk selama-lamanya bagi orang Israel dan bagi orang asing yang tinggal di tengah-tengahmu.
scripture_data.text_en: And he that gathereth the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the even: and it shall be unto the children of Israel, and unto the stranger that sojourneth among them, for a statute for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תחל כת רה רלו לרי ינבל התיהו ברהד מו וידגת הרה רפת סה סכו

scripture_data.text_id: Orang yang kena kepada mayat, ia najis tujuh hari lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: He that toucheth the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימי תב מו ד פנלכל תמ גה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia harus menghapus dosa dari dirinya dengan air itu pada hari yang ketiga, dan pada hari yang ketujuh ia tahir. Tetapi jika pada hari yang ketiga ia tidak menghapus dosa dari dirinya, maka tidaklah ia tahir pada hari yang ketujuh.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall purify himself with it on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean: but if he purify not himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהי ל ייבה ב יילה חתי לו רהי ייבה ב יילה בחתי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Setiap orang yang kena kepada mayat, yaitu tubuh manusia yang telah mati, dan tidak menghapus dosa dari dirinya, ia menajiskan Kemah Suci TUHAN, dan orang itu haruslah dilenyapkan dari Israel; karena air pentahiran tidak disiramkan kepadanya, maka ia najis; kenajisannya masih melekat padanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Whosoever toucheth the dead body of any man that is dead, and purifieth not himself, defileth the tabernacle of the LORD; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel: because the water of separation was not sprinkled upon him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness [is] yet upon him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב תמ ד היהי מ ויל קרזל הנ ימ י לרמ והה פה התרכנו הוהי מת חתי לו תמיר דה פנ תמ גהל

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah hukumnya, apabila seseorang mati dalam suatu kemah: setiap orang yang masuk ke dalam kemah itu dan segala yang di dalam kemah itu najis tujuh hari lamanya;

scripture_data.text_id: Juga setiap orang yang di padang, yang kena kepada seorang yang mati terbunuh oleh pedang, atau kepada mayat, atau kepada tulang-tulang seorang manusia, atau kepada kubur, orang itu najis tujuh hari lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And whosoever toucheth one that is slain with a sword in the open fields, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימי תב מי רבקב ד צב תמב ברחללח הדה ינל יר לכו

scripture_data.text_id: Bagi orang yang najis haruslah diambil sedikit abu dari korban penghapus dosa yang dibakar habis, lalu di dalam bejana abu itu dibubuhi air mengalir.
scripture_data.text_en: And for an unclean [person] they shall take of the ashes of the burnt heifer of purification for sin, and running water shall be put thereto in a vessel:

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian seorang yang tahir haruslah mengambil hisop, mencelupkannya ke dalam air itu dan memercikkannya ke atas kemah dan ke atas segala bejana dan ke atas orang-orang yang ada di sana, dan ke atas orang yang telah kena kepada tulang-tulang, atau kepada orang yang mati terbunuh, atau kepada mayat, atau kepada kubur itu;
scripture_data.text_en: And a clean person shall take hyssop, and dip [it] in the water, and sprinkle [it] upon the tent, and upon all the vessels, and upon the persons that were there, and upon him that touched a bone, or one slain, or one dead, or a grave:

scripture_data.text_id: orang yang tahir itu haruslah memercik kepada orang yang najis itu pada hari yang ketiga dan pada hari yang ketujuh, dan pada hari yang ketujuh itu haruslah ia menghapus dosa orang itu; dan orang yang najis itu haruslah mencuci pakaiannya dan membasuh badannya dengan air, lalu ia tahir pada waktu matahari terbenam.
scripture_data.text_en: And the clean [person] shall sprinkle upon the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day: and on the seventh day he shall purify himself, and wash his clothes, and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at even.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi orang yang telah najis, dan tidak menghapus dosa dari dirinya, orang itu harus dilenyapkan dari tengah-tengah jemaah itu, karena ia telah menajiskan tempat kudus TUHAN; air pentahiran tidak ada disiramkan kepadanya, jadi ia tetap najis.
scripture_data.text_en: But the man that shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the congregation, because he hath defiled the sanctuary of the LORD: the water of separation hath not been sprinkled upon him; he [is] unclean.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה מ ויל קרזל הנ ימ הוהי קמת י להה מ והה פה התרכנו חתי לו מיר יו

scripture_data.text_id: Itulah yang harus menjadi ketetapan bagi mereka untuk selama-lamanya. Orang yang menyiramkan air penyuci itu, ia harus mencuci pakaiannya, dan orang yang kena kepada air penyuci itu, ia menjadi najis sampai matahari terbenam.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be a perpetual statute unto them, that he that sprinkleth the water of separation shall wash his clothes; and he that toucheth the water of separation shall be unclean until even.

scripture_data.text_id: Segala yang diraba orang yang najis itu menjadi najis dan orang yang kena kepadanya menjadi najis juga sampai matahari terbenam."
scripture_data.text_en: And whatsoever the unclean [person] toucheth shall be unclean; and the soul that toucheth [it] shall be unclean until even.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ברהד מ תגה פהו מי מה יר לכו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian sampailah orang Israel, yakni segenap umat itu, ke padang gurun Zin, dalam bulan pertama, lalu tinggallah bangsa itu di Kadesh. Matilah Miryam di situ dan dikuburkan di situ.
scripture_data.text_en: Then came the children of Israel, [even] the whole congregation, into the desert of Zin in the first month: and the people abode in Kadesh; and Miriam died there, and was buried there.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבו ירמ תמו דק ה בו רה דח צרדמ הדהל לריינב בו

scripture_data.text_id: Pada suatu kali, ketika tidak ada air bagi umat itu, berkumpullah mereka mengerumuni Musa dan Harun,
scripture_data.text_en: And there was no water for the congregation: and they gathered themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהלו המל להו הדל ימ היהלו

scripture_data.text_id: dan bertengkarlah bangsa itu dengan Musa, katanya: "Sekiranya kami mati binasa pada waktu saudara-saudara kami mati binasa di hadapan TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: And the people chode with Moses, and spake, saying, Would God that we had died when our brethren died before the LORD!
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ינפל ניח וג נוג לו רמל רמו המ ה ברו

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa kamu membawa jemaah TUHAN ke padang gurun ini, supaya kami dan ternak kami mati di situ?
scripture_data.text_en: And why have ye brought up the congregation of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our cattle should die there?
scripture_data.text_orig: נריב נחנ תמל הה רדהל הוהי להקת תבה המלו

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa kamu memimpin kami keluar dari Mesir, untuk membawa kami ke tempat celaka ini, yang bukan tempat menabur, tanpa pohon ara, anggur dan delima, bahkan air minumpun tidak ada?"
scripture_data.text_en: And wherefore have ye made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in unto this evil place? it [is] no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither [is] there any water to drink.
scripture_data.text_orig: תל י ימ רו פגו הנת רז קם ל הה רה קהל נת יבהל ירצמ נתילה המלו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka pergilah Musa dan Harun dari umat itu ke pintu Kemah Pertemuan, lalu sujud. Kemudian tampaklah kemuliaan TUHAN kepada mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly unto the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and they fell upon their faces: and the glory of the LORD appeared unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף היל הוהידבך רו הינל לו דם לה חתל להה ינמ רהו המ בו

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa:
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,

scripture_data.text_en: And thou shalt speak unto the children of Israel, saying, If a man die, and have no son, then ye shall cause his inheritance to pass unto his daughter.

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila ia tidak mempunyai anak perempuan, maka haruslah kamu memberikan milik pusakanya itu kepada saudara-saudaranya yang laki-laki.
scripture_data.text_en: And if he have no daughter, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his brethren.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan apabila ia tidak mempunyai saudara-saudara lelaki, maka haruslah kamu memberikan milik pusakanya itu kepada saudara-saudara lelaki ayahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And if he have no brethren, then ye shall give his inheritance unto his father's brethren.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan apabila ayahnya tidak mempunyai saudara-saudara lelaki, maka haruslah kamu memberikan milik pusakanya itu kepada kerabatnya yang terdekat dari antara kaumnya, supaya dimilikinya." Itulah yang harus menjadi ketetapan hukum bagi orang Israel, seperti yang diperintahkan TUHAN kepada Musa.

scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Marah, and came unto Elim: and in Elim [were] twelve fountains of water, and threescore and ten palm trees; and they pitched there.
scripture_data.text_orig: נחו ירמ יבו ימ תני הר י ליב המלי בו הרמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Elim, lalu berkemah di tepi Laut Teberau.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Elim, and encamped by the Red sea.
scripture_data.text_orig: סיל נחו לימ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Laut Teberau, lalu berkemah di padang gurun Sin.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from the Red sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: יסרדמ נחו סמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari padang gurun Sin, lalu berkemah di Dofka.
scripture_data.text_en: And they took their journey out of the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הקפד נחו יסרדמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Dofka, lalu berkemah di Alus.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל נחו הקפמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Alus, lalu berkemah di Rafidim, dan di sana tidak ada air minum untuk bangsa itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Alush, and encamped at Rephidim, where was no water for the people to drink.
scripture_data.text_orig: תל ל ימ היהלו דיפר נחו למ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Rafidim, lalu berkemah di padang gurun Sinai.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Rephidim, and pitched in the wilderness of Sinai.
scripture_data.text_orig: יניס רדמ נחו דיפרמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari padang gurun Sinai, lalu berkemah di Kibrot-Taawa.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from the desert of Sinai, and pitched at Kibrothhattaavah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהתרבק נחו יניס רדמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Kibrot-Taawa, lalu berkemah di Hazerot.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Kibrothhattaavah, and encamped at Hazeroth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרצח נחו הוהתרבמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Hazerot, lalu berkemah di Ritma.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Hazeroth, and pitched in Rithmah.
scripture_data.text_orig: המתר נחו תרצחמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Ritma, lalu berkemah di Rimon-Peros.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Rithmah, and pitched at Rimmonparez.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרר נחו המתרמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Rimon-Peros, lalu berkemah di Libna.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Rimmonparez, and pitched in Libnah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנבל נחו שררמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Libna, lalu berkemah di Risa.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Libnah, and pitched at Rissah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר נחו הנבמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Risa, lalu berkemah di Kehelata.
scripture_data.text_en: And they journeyed from Rissah, and pitched in Kehelathah.
scripture_data.text_orig: התלהק נחו הרמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Kehelata, lalu berkemah di Har-Syafer.
scripture_data.text_en: And they went from Kehelathah, and pitched in mount Shapher.
scripture_data.text_orig: רפרה נחו התלהמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Har-Syafer, lalu berkemah di Harada.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from mount Shapher, and encamped in Haradah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדרח נחו רפרהמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Harada, lalu berkemah di Makhelot.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Haradah, and pitched in Makheloth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תלהקמ נחו הדרחמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Makhelot, lalu berkemah di Tahat.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Makheloth, and encamped at Tahath.
scripture_data.text_orig: תחת נחו תלהקמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Tahat, lalu berkemah di Tarah.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Tahath, and pitched at Tarah.
scripture_data.text_orig: חרת נחו תחמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Tarah, lalu berkemah di Mitka.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Tarah, and pitched in Mithcah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הקתמ נחו חרמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Mitka, lalu berkemah di Hasmona.
scripture_data.text_en: And they went from Mithcah, and pitched in Hashmonah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנמח נחו הקתמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Hasmona, lalu berkemah di Moserot.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Hashmonah, and encamped at Moseroth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרסמ נחו הנמחמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Moserot, lalu berkemah di Bene-Yaakan.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Moseroth, and pitched in Benejaakan.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיינב נחו תרסמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Bene-Yaakan, lalu berkemah di Hor-Gidgad.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Benejaakan, and encamped at Horhagidgad.
scripture_data.text_orig: דדהרח נחו קיינמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Hor-Gidgad, lalu berkemah di Yotbata.
scripture_data.text_en: And they went from Horhagidgad, and pitched in Jotbathah.
scripture_data.text_orig: התבי נחו דדהרחמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Yotbata, lalu berkemah di Abrona.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Jotbathah, and encamped at Ebronah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנרב נחו התבמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Abrona, lalu berkemah di Ezion-Geber.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Ebronah, and encamped at Eziongaber.
scripture_data.text_orig: רביצ נחו הנרבמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Ezion-Geber, lalu berkemah di padang gurun Zin, yaitu Kadesh.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Eziongaber, and pitched in the wilderness of Zin, which [is] Kadesh.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק וה צרדמב נחו רביצמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Kadesh, lalu berkemah di gunung Hor, di perbatasan tanah Edom.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Kadesh, and pitched in mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד שר הצק רהה רה נחו דמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika itu imam Harun naik ke gunung Hor sesuai dengan titah TUHAN, dan di situ ia mati pada tahun keempat puluh sesudah orang Israel keluar dari tanah Mesir, pada bulan yang kelima, pada tanggal satu bulan itu;
scripture_data.text_en: And Aaron the priest went up into mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Egypt, in the first [day] of the fifth month.
scripture_data.text_orig: דחל דח יימחה דח ירצמ שרמ לריינ תצל ירה תנ תמו הוהי יל רהה רהל הה רה לו

scripture_data.text_id: Harun berumur seratus dua puluh tiga tahun, ketika ia mati di gunung Hor.
scripture_data.text_en: And Aaron [was] an hundred and twenty and three years old when he died in mount Hor.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רהה רה תמ הנ תמ ירו ל רהו

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu raja negeri Arad, orang Kanaan itu, yang tinggal di Tanah Negeb di tanah Kanaan, mendengar kabar tentang kedatangan orang Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: And king Arad the Canaanite, which dwelt in the south in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי ינ ב נ שר בג ביהו דר למ יננה מו

scripture_data.text_id: Berangkatlah mereka dari gunung Hor, lalu berkemah di Zalmona.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from mount Hor, and pitched in Zalmonah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנמלצ נחו רהה רהמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Zalmona, lalu berkemah di Funon.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Zalmonah, and pitched in Punon.
scripture_data.text_orig: נפ נחו הנמלמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Funon, lalu berkemah di Obot.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Punon, and pitched in Oboth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תב נחו נמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Obot, lalu berkemah dekat reruntuhan di Abarim di daerah Moab.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Oboth, and pitched in Ijeabarim, in the border of Moab.
scripture_data.text_orig: בם לבג ירבהי נחו תבמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari reruntuhan itu, lalu berkemah di Dibon-Gad.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from Iim, and pitched in Dibongad.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ביד נחו ימ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Dibon-Gad, lalu berkemah di Almon-Diblataim.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Dibongad, and encamped in Almondiblathaim.
scripture_data.text_orig: המיתלבמל נחו ד בימ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari Almon-Diblataim, lalu berkemah di pegunungan Abarim di depan Nebo.
scripture_data.text_en: And they removed from Almondiblathaim, and pitched in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.
scripture_data.text_orig: בן ינפל ירבה ירה נחו המיתלבמלמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berangkat dari pegunungan Abarim, lalu berkemah di dataran Moab di tepi sungai Yordan dekat Yerikho.
scripture_data.text_en: And they departed from the mountains of Abarim, and pitched in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho.
scripture_data.text_orig: חרי רי ל בם תבר נחו ירבה ירהמ סו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berkemah di tepi sungai Yordan, dari Bet-Yesimot sampai ke Abel-Sitim di dataran Moab.
scripture_data.text_en: And they pitched by Jordan, from Bethjesimoth [even] unto Abelshittim in the plains of Moab.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס בם תבר יהלב ד תמיהתימ רהל נחו

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa di dataran Moab di tepi sungai Yordan dekat Yerikho:
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Moses in the plains of Moab by Jordan [near] Jericho, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל חרי ריל בם תבר המל הוהי רדיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Berbicaralah kepada orang Israel dan katakanlah kepada mereka: Apabila kamu menyeberangi sungai Yordan ke tanah Kanaan,
scripture_data.text_en: Speak unto the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye are passed over Jordan into the land of Canaan;
scripture_data.text_orig: נ שרל רהת ירב י הל רמו לרי ינל ר

scripture_data.text_id: maka haruslah kamu menghalau semua penduduk negeri itu dari depanmu dan membinasakan segala batu berukir kepunyaan mereka; juga haruslah kamu membinasakan segala patung tuangan mereka dan memusnahkan segala bukit pengorbanan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Then ye shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their pictures, and destroy all their molten images, and quite pluck down all their high places:
scripture_data.text_orig: דימ תמל תו ד תכם ימלצל תו תמל ת דו כינמ שרה יבילת רהו

scripture_data.text_id: Haruslah kamu menduduki negeri itu dan diam di sana, sebab kepadamulah Kuberikan negeri itu untuk diduduki.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall dispossess [the inhabitants] of the land, and dwell therein: for I have given you the land to possess it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת תרל שרהת יתנ כל י ביו שרהת רהו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka haruslah kamu membagi negeri itu sebagai milik pusaka dengan membuang undi menurut kaummu: kepada yang besar jumlahnya haruslah kamu memberikan milik pusaka yang besar, dan kepada yang kecil jumlahnya haruslah kamu memberikan milik pusaka yang kecil; yang ditunjuk oleh undi bagi masing-masing, itulah bagian undiannya; menurut suku nenek moyangmu haruslah kamu membagi milik pusaka itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall divide the land by lot for an inheritance among your families: [and] to the more ye shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer ye shall give the less inheritance: every man's [inheritance] shall be in the place where his lot falleth; according to the tribes of your fathers ye shall inherit.
scripture_data.text_orig: לחנת כיתב תמל היהי ל לרה ה ל ציר ל תלחנת ימ מלו תלחנת ר ברל כיתחמל לרג שרהת לחנתהו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi jika kamu tidak menghalau penduduk negeri itu dari depanmu, maka orang-orang yang kamu tinggalkan hidup dari mereka akan menjadi seperti selumbar di matamu dan seperti duri yang menusuk lambungmu, dan mereka akan menyesatkan kamu di negeri yang kamu diami itu.
scripture_data.text_en: But if ye will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you; then it shall come to pass, that those which ye let remain of them [shall be] pricks in your eyes, and thorns in your sides, and shall vex you in the land wherein ye dwell.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבי ר שרהל כת ררצו כיצ נינצלו כיני יל המ רית ר היהו כינמ שרה יבית ירת לו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka akan Kulakukan kepadamu seperti yang Kurancang melakukan kepada mereka."
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover it shall come to pass, [that] I shall do unto you, as I thought to do unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף כל ה הל תל יתי ר היהו

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa:
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ המל הוהי רדיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Perintahkanlah kepada orang Israel dan katakanlah kepada mereka: Apabila kamu masuk ke negeri Kanaan, maka inilah negeri yang akan jatuh kepadamu sebagai milik pusaka, yakni tanah Kanaan menurut batas-batasnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Command the children of Israel, and say unto them, When ye come into the land of Canaan; (this [is] the land that shall fall unto you for an inheritance, [even] the land of Canaan with the coasts thereof:)
scripture_data.text_orig: היתלבגל נ שר הלחנ כל ל ר שרה תז נ שרהל י י הל רמו לרי ינת וצ

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun sisi selatanmu ialah dari padang gurun Zin menyusur Edom, maka batas selatanmu mulai dari ujung Laut Asin di sebelah timur.
scripture_data.text_en: Then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the coast of Edom, and your south border shall be the outmost coast of the salt sea eastward:
scripture_data.text_orig: המדק חלהי הצקמ בגנ לב כל היהו ד ידיל צרדמ בגנת כל היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu batasmu membelok di selatan pendakian Akrabim, terus ke Zin dan berakhir di sebelah selatan Kadesh-Barnea. Sesudah itu ia mencapai Hazar-Adar, dan terus ke Azmon.
scripture_data.text_en: And your border shall turn from the south to the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass on to Zin: and the going forth thereof shall be from the south to Kadeshbarnea, and shall go on to Hazaraddar, and pass on to Azmon:
scripture_data.text_orig: הנמץ רבו ררצח ציו נרדקל בגמ ויתצ יהו היהו הנצ רבו ירק הלמל בגמ לבה כל בסנו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian batas itu membelok dari Azmon ke sungai Mesir dan berakhir ke laut.
scripture_data.text_en: And the border shall fetch a compass from Azmon unto the river of Egypt, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
scripture_data.text_orig: הה ויתצת יהו ירצמ הלחנ מצמ לבה בסנו

scripture_data.text_id: Batas baratmu ialah laut besar dan pantainya; itulah batas baratmu.
scripture_data.text_en: And [as for] the western border, ye shall even have the great sea for a border: this shall be your west border.
scripture_data.text_orig: י לב כל היהיהז לבג לדה ה כל היהו י לבג

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah batas utaramu: mulai dari laut besar haruslah kamu buat tanda batas ke gunung Hor,
scripture_data.text_en: And this shall be your north border: from the great sea ye shall point out for you mount Hor:
scripture_data.text_orig: רהה רה כל ת לדה המ פצ לב כל היהיהזו

scripture_data.text_id: dari gunung Hor harus kamu buat tanda batas ke jalan yang menuju ke Hamat, lalu batas itu mencapai Zedad.
scripture_data.text_en: From mount Hor ye shall point out [your border] unto the entrance of Hamath; and the goings forth of the border shall be to Zedad:
scripture_data.text_orig: הדדץ לבה תצ יהו תמח בל ת רהה רהמ

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian batas itu mencapai Zifron dan berakhir di Hazar-Enan; itulah batas utaramu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the border shall go on to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazarenan: this shall be your north border.
scripture_data.text_orig: פצ לב כל היהיהז נירצח ויתצת יהו הנרפז לבה ציו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebagai batasmu di sebelah timur haruslah kamu membuat tanda batas dari Hazar-Enan ke Sefam.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall point out your east border from Hazarenan to Shepham:
scripture_data.text_orig: המפ נירצחמ המדק לבגל כל תיתהו

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Sefam batas itu turun ke Ribla, di sebelah timur Ain; kemudian batas itu turun lagi dan mencapai tebing danau Kineret di sebelah timur.
scripture_data.text_en: And the coast shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall descend, and shall reach unto the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward:
scripture_data.text_orig: המדק תרי תל החמ לבה דריו יל דמ הלברה פמ לבה דריו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu batas itu turun ke sungai Yordan dan berakhir di Laut Asin. Itulah negerimu menurut batas-batasnya sekeliling."
scripture_data.text_en: And the border shall go down to Jordan, and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea: this shall be your land with the coasts thereof round about.
scripture_data.text_orig: ביבס היתלבגל שרה כל היה תז חלה י ויתצת יהו הנרה לבה דריו

scripture_data.text_id: Musa memerintahkan kepada orang Israel: "Itulah negeri yang akan kamu bagi sebagai milik pusaka dengan membuang undi, yang diperintahkan TUHAN untuk diberikan kepada suku yang sembilan setengah itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, This [is] the land which ye shall inherit by lot, which the LORD commanded to give unto the nine tribes, and to the half tribe:
scripture_data.text_orig: הה יצחו תה תתל תתל הוהי הצ ר לרג ת לחנת ר שרה תז רמל לרי ינת המ וציו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab suku bani Ruben menurut puak-puak mereka dan suku bani Gad menurut puak-puak mereka telah menerima milik pusakanya; juga suku Manasye yang setengah itu telah menerimanya.
scripture_data.text_en: For the tribe of the children of Reuben according to the house of their fathers, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to the house of their fathers, have received [their inheritance]; and half the tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance:
scripture_data.text_orig: תלחן חקל הנם הם יצחו תב תיבל ידהינב המ תב תיבל ינברה ינב הם חקל י

scripture_data.text_id: Dua setengah suku itu telah menerima milik pusaka mereka di seberang sungai Yordan di dekat Yerikho, ke sebelah timur."
scripture_data.text_en: The two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance on this side Jordan [near] Jericho eastward, toward the sunrising.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף החרזמ המדק חרי ריל רבמ תלחן חקל הה יצחו תה ינ

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN berfirman kepada Musa:
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ המל הוהי רדיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Inilah nama orang-orang yang harus membagikan tanah itu kepadamu sebagai milik pusaka: imam Eleazar dan Yosua bin Nun.
scripture_data.text_en: These [are] the names of the men which shall divide the land unto you: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ היו הה רזל שרהת כל לחניר ינה תמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Lagi haruslah kamu mengambil seorang pemimpin dari setiap suku untuk membagikan tanah itu sebagai milik pusaka.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land by inheritance.

scripture_data.text_id: Seorang Amon atau seorang Moab janganlah masuk jemaah TUHAN, bahkan keturunannya yang kesepuluhpun tidak boleh masuk jemaah TUHAN sampai selama-lamanya,
scripture_data.text_en: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the LORD for ever:
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהי להק ל ביל ירי ר הוהי להק רזמם ביל

scripture_data.text_id: karena mereka tidak menyongsong kamu dengan roti dan air pada waktu perjalananmu keluar dari Mesir, dan karena mereka mengupah Bileam bin Beor dari Petor di Aram-Mesopotamia melawan engkau, supaya dikutukinya engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: לד הוהי להק הל ביל ירי ר הוהי להק יבמ ינ ביל

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi TUHAN, Allahmu, tidak mau mendengarkan Bileam dan TUHAN, Allahmu, telah mengubah kutuk itu menjadi berkat bagimu, karena TUHAN, Allahmu, mengasihi engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: Nevertheless the LORD thy God would not hearken unto Balaam; but the LORD thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee, because the LORD thy God loved thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: שללקל ירהנר רתמ ר לת יל רכ רו ירצמ כתצ ר יב ח כת מקל ר רבל

scripture_data.text_id: Selama engkau hidup, janganlah engkau mengikhtiarkan kesejahteraan dan kebahagiaan mereka sampai selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל הוהי בה י הכרבל הללהת יהל הוהי פהו לל מל יהל הוהי הבלו

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah engkau menganggap keji orang Edom, sebab dia saudaramu. Janganlah engkau menganggap keji orang Mesir, sebab engkaupun dahulu adalah orang asing di negerinya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he [is] thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לל ימיל תבו מל רדתל

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak yang lahir bagi mereka dalam keturunan yang ketiga, boleh masuk jemaah TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.
scripture_data.text_orig: צרב תייה רגי ירצמ בתתל ס ה יח י ימד בתתל

scripture_data.text_id: "Apabila engkau maju dengan tentaramu melawan musuhmu, maka haruslah engkau menjaga diri terhadap segala yang jahat.
scripture_data.text_en: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהי להק הל בי ייל ר הל דליר ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila ada di antaramu seorang laki-laki yang tidak tahir disebabkan oleh sesuatu yang terjadi atasnya pada malam hari, maka haruslah ia pergi ke luar perkemahan, janganlah ia masuk ke dalam perkemahan.
scripture_data.text_en: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:
scripture_data.text_orig: ר רב למ רמנו יביל הנחם צתי

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian menjelang senja haruslah ia mandi dengan air, dan pada waktu matahari terbenam, ia boleh masuk kembali ke dalam perkemahan.
scripture_data.text_en: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash [himself] with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp [again].
scripture_data.text_orig: הנחה ל בי ל הנחל שחמל ציו הלילהרמ רה היהיל ר י ב היהיי

scripture_data.text_id: Di luar perkemahan itu haruslah ada bagimu suatu tempat ke mana engkau pergi untuk kada hajat.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:
scripture_data.text_orig: הנחה ל בי מה בכ י שחרי ברתנפל היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Di antara perlengkapanmu haruslah ada padamu sekop kecil dan apabila engkau jongkok kada hajat, haruslah engkau menggali lobang dengan itu dan menimbuni kotoranmu.
scripture_data.text_en: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:
scripture_data.text_orig: שח ה תציו הנחל שחמ ל היה דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab TUHAN, Allahmu, berjalan dari tengah-tengah perkemahanmu untuk melepaskan engkau dan menyerahkan musuhmu kepadamu; sebab itu haruslah perkemahanmu itu kudus, supaya jangan Ia melihat sesuatu yang tidak senonoh di antaramu, lalu berbalik dari padamu."
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצת תיכו בו ב הרפחו שח ב היהו נזל ל היה דתיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Janganlah kauserahkan kepada tuannya seorang budak yang melarikan diri dari tuannya kepadamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירחמ בו רב תור ב הרילו דק ינחם היהו ינפל יבי תתלו ליהל נחם ברק התמ יהל הוהי י

scripture_data.text_id: Bersama-sama engkau ia boleh tinggal, di tengah-tengahmu, di tempat yang dipilihnya di salah satu tempatmu, yang dirasanya baik; janganlah engkau menindas dia."
scripture_data.text_en: He shall dwell with thee, [even] among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינד מ יל לציר וינדל דב ריסתל

scripture_data.text_id: "Di antara anak-anak perempuan Israel janganlah ada pelacur bakti, dan di antara anak-anak lelaki Israel janganlah ada semburit bakti.
scripture_data.text_en: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס נ ל ל ב יר דח רחביר ק רק בי

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah kaubawa upah sundal atau uang semburit ke dalam rumah TUHAN, Allahmu, untuk menepati salah satu nazar, sebab keduanya itu adalah kekejian bagi TUHAN, Allahmu."
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD thy God for any vow: for even both these [are] abomination unto the LORD thy God.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי ינמ דק היהילו לרי תנמ הדק היהתל

scripture_data.text_id: "Janganlah engkau membungakan kepada saudaramu, baik uang maupun bahan makanan atau apapun yang dapat dibungakan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:
scripture_data.text_orig: הינ יהל הוהי תבת י רדנלכל יהל הוהי תי בל ריחמ הנז נת יבתל

scripture_data.text_id: Dari orang asing boleh engkau memungut bunga, tetapi dari saudaramu janganlah engkau memungut bunga supaya TUHAN, Allahmu, memberkati engkau dalam segala usahamu di negeri yang engkau masuki untuk mendudukinya."
scripture_data.text_en: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ר רבל נ לכ נ ס נ יחל יתל

scripture_data.text_id: "Apabila engkau bernazar kepada TUHAN, Allahmu, janganlah engkau menunda-nunda memenuhinya, sebab tentulah TUHAN, Allahmu, akan menuntutnya dari padamu, sehingga hal itu menjadi dosa bagimu.
scripture_data.text_en: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the LORD thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the LORD thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רל הב הר שרהל די חלמ לכ יהל הוהי כרבי מל ית ל יחל ית ירכל

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi apabila engkau tidak bernazar, maka hal itu bukan menjadi dosa bagimu.
scripture_data.text_en: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ח ב היהו מ יהל הוהי רדי רי מל רחת ל יהל הוהיל רדנ רתי

scripture_data.text_id: Apa yang keluar dari bibirmu haruslah kaulakukan dengan setia, sebab dengan sukarela kaunazarkan kepada TUHAN, Allahmu, sesuatu yang kaukatakan dengan mulutmu sendiri."
scripture_data.text_en: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform; [even] a freewill offering, according as thou hast vowed unto the LORD thy God, which thou hast promised with thy mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ח ב היהיל רנל לחת יכו

scripture_data.text_id: "Apabila engkau melalui kebun anggur sesamamu, engkau boleh makan buah anggur sepuas-puas hatimu, tetapi tidak boleh kaumasukkan ke dalam bungkusanmu.
scripture_data.text_en: When thou comest into thy neighbour's vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put [any] in thy vessel.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יפ ר ר הבדן יהל הוהיל רדנ ר תיו רמ יתפ צם

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila engkau melalui ladang gandum sesamamu yang belum dituai, engkau boleh memetik bulir-bulirnya dengan tanganmu, tetapi sabit tidak boleh kauayunkan kepada gandum sesamamu itu."
scripture_data.text_en: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour's standing corn.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ת ל יללו ב פנ יבנ לכו ר רכ בת י

scripture_data.text_id: "Apabila seseorang mengambil seorang perempuan dan menjadi suaminya, dan jika kemudian ia tidak menyukai lagi perempuan itu, sebab didapatinya yang tidak senonoh padanya, lalu ia menulis surat cerai dan menyerahkannya ke tangan perempuan itu, sesudah itu menyuruh dia pergi dari rumahnya,
scripture_data.text_en: When a man hath taken a wife, and married her, and it come to pass that she find no favour in his eyes, because he hath found some uncleanness in her: then let him write her a bill of divorcement, and give [it] in her hand, and send her out of his house.
scripture_data.text_orig: תימ חו די תנו תתיר רפס ל בתכו רב תור ב צמי ויני חצמת ל היהו לב ה י חיי

scripture_data.text_id: dan jika perempuan itu keluar dari rumahnya dan pergi dari sana, lalu menjadi isteri orang lain,
scripture_data.text_en: And when she is departed out of his house, she may go and be another man's [wife].
scripture_data.text_orig: רחיל התיהו הכלהו תימ הציו

scripture_data.text_id: dan jika laki-laki yang kemudian ini tidak cinta lagi kepadanya, lalu menulis surat cerai dan menyerahkannya ke tangan perempuan itu serta menyuruh dia pergi dari rumahnya, atau jika laki-laki yang kemudian mengambil dia menjadi isterinya itu mati,
scripture_data.text_en: And [if] the latter husband hate her, and write her a bill of divorcement, and giveth [it] in her hand, and sendeth her out of his house; or if the latter husband die, which took her [to be] his wife;
scripture_data.text_orig: הל ל חקלר רחה יה תמי יכ תימ חו די תנו תתיר רפס ל בתכו רחה יה נ

scripture_data.text_id: maka suaminya yang pertama, yang telah menyuruh dia pergi itu, tidak boleh mengambil dia kembali menjadi isterinya, setelah perempuan itu dicemari; sebab hal itu adalah kekejian di hadapan TUHAN. Janganlah engkau mendatangkan dosa atas negeri yang diberikan TUHAN, Allahmu, kepadamu menjadi milik pusakamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Her former husband, which sent her away, may not take her again to be his wife, after that she is defiled; for that [is] abomination before the LORD: and thou shalt not cause the land to sin, which the LORD thy God giveth thee [for] an inheritance.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הלחן ל תנ יהל הוהי ר שרהת יחת לו הוהי ינפל וה הבתי הה ר ירח הל ל תיהל חקל בל חר רה ל לכיל

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila baru saja seseorang mengambil isteri, janganlah ia keluar bersama-sama dengan tentara maju berperang atau dibebankan sesuatu pekerjaan; satu tahun lamanya ia harus dibebaskan untuk keperluan rumah tangganya dan menyukakan hati perempuan yang telah diambilnya menjadi isterinya."
scripture_data.text_en: When a man hath taken a new wife, he shall not go out to war, neither shall he be charged with any business: [but] he shall be free at home one year, and shall cheer up his wife which he hath taken.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס חקלר ת חו תח הנ תיבל היהי יקנ רבלכל ויל רבילו ב צי ל הדח ה י חיי

scripture_data.text_id: "Janganlah mengambil kilangan atau batu kilangan atas sebagai gadai, karena yang demikian itu mengambil nyawa orang sebagai gadai.
scripture_data.text_en: No man shall take the nether or the upper millstone to pledge: for he taketh [a man's] life to pledge.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לבח ה פני בכרו יחר לבחיל

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila seseorang kedapatan sedang menculik orang, salah seorang saudaranya, dari antara orang Israel, lalu memperlakukan dia sebagai budak dan menjual dia, maka haruslah penculik itu mati. Demikianlah harus kauhapuskan yang jahat itu dari tengah-tengahmu.
scripture_data.text_en: If a man be found stealing any of his brethren of the children of Israel, and maketh merchandise of him, or selleth him; then that thief shall die; and thou shalt put evil away from among you.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ רה רב הה בה תמ רכמ רתהו לרי ינמ ויחמ פנ בנ י ציי

scripture_data.text_id: Hati-hatilah dalam hal penyakit kusta dan lakukanlah dengan tepat segala yang diajarkan imam-imam orang Lewi kepadamu; apa yang kuperintahkan kepada mereka haruslah kamu lakukan dengan setia.
scripture_data.text_en: Take heed in the plague of leprosy, that thou observe diligently, and do according to all that the priests the Levites shall teach you: as I commanded them, [so] ye shall observe to do.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תל רמ תיצ ר ולה ינהה כת ריר לכ תלו דם רמל תרהגנ רמה

scripture_data.text_id: Ingatlah apa yang dilakukan TUHAN, Allahmu, kepada Miryam pada waktu perjalananmu keluar dari Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: Remember what the LORD thy God did unto Miriam by the way, after that ye were come forth out of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירצמ כתצ ר ירמל יהל הוהי הר ת רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila engkau meminjamkan sesuatu kepada sesamamu, janganlah engkau masuk ke rumahnya untuk mengambil gadai dari padanya.
scripture_data.text_en: When thou dost lend thy brother any thing, thou shalt not go into his house to fetch his pledge.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב בל תיל בתל המם תם רב התי

scripture_data.text_id: Haruslah engkau tinggal berdiri di luar, dan orang yang kauberi pinjaman itu haruslah membawa gadai itu ke luar kepadamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt stand abroad, and the man to whom thou dost lend shall bring out the pledge abroad unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: הצחה בהת יל יצי ב הנ ה ר יהו דמ שח

scripture_data.text_id: Jika ia seorang miskin, janganlah engkau tidur dengan barang gadaiannya;
scripture_data.text_en: And if the man [be] poor, thou shalt not sleep with his pledge:
scripture_data.text_orig: ב בת ל ה ינ יו

scripture_data.text_id: kembalikanlah gadaian itu kepadanya pada waktu matahari terbenam, supaya ia dapat tidur dengan memakai kainnya sendiri dan memberkati engkau. Maka engkau akan menjadi benar di hadapan TUHAN, Allahmu.
scripture_data.text_en: In any case thou shalt deliver him the pledge again when the sun goeth down, that he may sleep in his own raiment, and bless thee: and it shall be righteousness unto thee before the LORD thy God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יהל הוהי ינפל הקדץ היה ל שכרב תמל בכו מה ב בהת ל בי בה

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah engkau memeras pekerja harian yang miskin dan menderita, baik ia saudaramu maupun seorang asing yang ada di negerimu, di dalam tempatmu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not oppress an hired servant [that is] poor and needy, [whether he be] of thy brethren, or of thy strangers that [are] in thy land within thy gates:
scripture_data.text_orig: יר צר ר רמ יחמ יבו ינ ריכ קתל

scripture_data.text_id: Pada hari itu juga haruslah engkau membayar upahnya sebelum matahari terbenam; ia mengharapkannya, karena ia orang miskin; supaya ia jangan berseru kepada TUHAN mengenai engkau dan hal itu menjadi dosa bagimu.
scripture_data.text_en: At his day thou shalt give [him] his hire, neither shall the sun go down upon it; for he [is] poor, and setteth his heart upon it: lest he cry against thee unto the LORD, and it be sin unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ח ב היהו הוהיל יל רקילו פנת נ ה וילו ה ינ י מה ויל בתלו רכ ת מי

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah ayah dihukum mati karena anaknya, janganlah juga anak dihukum mati karena ayahnya; setiap orang harus dihukum mati karena dosanya sendiri.
scripture_data.text_en: The fathers shall not be put to death for the children, neither shall the children be put to death for the fathers: every man shall be put to death for his own sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמי ח י תבל תמיל ינב ינל תב תמיל

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah engkau memperkosa hak orang asing dan anak yatim; juga janganlah engkau mengambil pakaian seorang janda menjadi gadai.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not pervert the judgment of the stranger, [nor] of the fatherless; nor take a widow's raiment to pledge:
scripture_data.text_orig: הנמל דג לבחת לו תי ר מ הת ל

scripture_data.text_id: Haruslah kauingat, bahwa engkaupun dahulu budak di Mesir dan engkau ditebus TUHAN, Allahmu, dari sana; itulah sebabnya aku memerintahkan engkau melakukan hal ini.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in Egypt, and the LORD thy God redeemed thee thence: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הה רבהת תל צם יכנ ל מ יהל הוהי פו ירצמ תייה דב י רכזו

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila engkau menuai di ladangmu, lalu terlupa seberkas di ladang, maka janganlah engkau kembali untuk mengambilnya; itulah bagian orang asing, anak yatim dan janda supaya TUHAN, Allahmu, memberkati engkau dalam segala pekerjaanmu.
scripture_data.text_en: When thou cuttest down thine harvest in thy field, and hast forgot a sheaf in the field, thou shalt not go again to fetch it: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all the work of thine hands.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידי הם לכ יהל הוהי כרבי מל היהי הנמללו תל רל חקל בת ל הד רמ חכו דב ריצק רצקת י

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila engkau memetik hasil pohon zaitunmu dengan memukul-mukulnya, janganlah engkau memeriksa dahan-dahannya sekali lagi; itulah bagian orang asing, anak yatim dan janda.
scripture_data.text_en: When thou beatest thine olive tree, thou shalt not go over the boughs again: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היהי הנמללו תל רל ירח רפת ל תיז חת י

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila engkau mengumpulkan hasil kebun anggurmu, janganlah engkau mengadakan pemetikan sekali lagi; itulah bagian orang asing, anak yatim dan janda.
scripture_data.text_en: When thou gatherest the grapes of thy vineyard, thou shalt not glean [it] afterward: it shall be for the stranger, for the fatherless, and for the widow.
scripture_data.text_orig: היהי הנמללו תל רל ירח ללת ל מר רצבת י

scripture_data.text_id: Haruslah kauingat, bahwa engkaupun dahulu budak di tanah Mesir; itulah sebabnya aku memerintahkan engkau melakukan hal ini."
scripture_data.text_en: And thou shalt remember that thou wast a bondman in the land of Egypt: therefore I command thee to do this thing.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הה רבהת תל צם יכנ ל ירצמ שר תייה דבי רכזו

scripture_data.text_id: "Apabila ada perselisihan di antara beberapa orang, lalu mereka pergi ke pengadilan, dan mereka diadili dengan dinyatakannya siapa yang benar dan siapa yang salah,
