scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu Rehabeam meminta nasihat dari para tua-tua yang selama hidup Salomo mendampingi Salomo, ayahnya, katanya: "Apakah nasihatmu untuk menjawab rakyat itu?"
scripture_data.text_en: And king Rehoboam consulted with the old men, that stood before Solomon his father while he yet lived, and said, How do ye advise that I may answer this people?
scripture_data.text_orig: רב הההת ביהל יצן י רמל יח תיה ויב המל ינת ידמ יהר ינקהת בחר לה שו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berkata: "Jika hari ini engkau mau menjadi hamba rakyat, mau mengabdi kepada mereka dan menjawab mereka dengan kata-kata yang baik, maka mereka menjadi hamba-hambamu sepanjang waktu."
scripture_data.text_en: And they spake unto him, saying, If thou wilt be a servant unto this people this day, and wilt serve them, and answer them, and speak good words to them, then they will be thy servants for ever.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi ia mengabaikan nasihat yang diberikan para tua-tua itu, lalu ia meminta nasihat kepada orang-orang muda yang sebaya dengan dia dan yang mendampinginya,
scripture_data.text_en: But he forsook the counsel of the old men, which they had given him, and consulted with the young men that were grown up with him, [and] which stood before him:

scripture_data.text_id: katanya kepada mereka: "Apakah nasihatmu, supaya kita dapat menjawab rakyat yang mengatakan kepadaku: Ringankanlah tanggungan yang dipikulkan kepada kami oleh ayahmu?"

scripture_data.text_id: Diangkatnyalah dia, dibawanya pulang kepada ibunya. Duduklah dia di pangkuan ibunya sampai tengah hari, tetapi sesudah itu matilah dia.
scripture_data.text_en: And when he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees till noon, and [then] died.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu naiklah perempuan itu, dibaringkannyalah dia di atas tempat tidur abdi Allah itu, ditutupnyalah pintu dan pergi, sehingga anak itu saja di dalam kamar.
scripture_data.text_en: And she went up, and laid him on the bed of the man of God, and shut [the door] upon him, and went out.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu ia memanggil suaminya serta berkata: "Suruh kepadaku salah seorang bujang dengan membawa seekor keledai betina; aku mau pergi dengan segera kepada abdi Allah itu, dan akan terus pulang."
scripture_data.text_en: And she called unto her husband, and said, Send me, I pray thee, one of the young men, and one of the asses, that I may run to the man of God, and come again.

scripture_data.text_id: Berkatalah suaminya: "Mengapakah pada hari ini engkau hendak pergi kepadanya? Padahal sekarang bukan bulan baru dan bukan hari Sabat." Jawab perempuan itu: "Jangan kuatir."
scripture_data.text_en: And he said, Wherefore wilt thou go to him to day? [it is] neither new moon, nor sabbath. And she said, [It shall be] well.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל רמו ת לו דחל ה ויל תכלה יכלה י מ רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Dipelanainyalah keledai itu dan berkatalah ia kepada bujangnya: "Tuntunlah dan majulah, jangan tahan-tahan aku dalam perjalananku, kecuali apabila kukatakan kepadamu."
scripture_data.text_en: Then she saddled an ass, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; slack not [thy] riding for me, except I bid thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ירמ י ברל ילרצל לו גהן רנל רמו תה בחו

scripture_data.text_id: Demikianlah perempuan itu berangkat dan pergi kepada abdi Allah di gunung Karmel. Segera sesudah abdi Allah melihat dia dari jauh, berkatalah ia kepada Gehazi, bujangnya: "Lihat, perempuan Sunem itu datang!
scripture_data.text_en: So she went and came unto the man of God to mount Carmel. And it came to pass, when the man of God saw her afar off, that he said to Gehazi his servant, Behold, [yonder is] that Shunammite:
scripture_data.text_orig: זה תינה הה רן יזחיל רמו דגמ ת יהלהי תר יהיו למרה רהל יהלה יל בו לו

scripture_data.text_id: Larilah menyongsongnya dan katakanlah kepadanya: Selamatkah engkau, selamatkah suamimu, selamatkah anak itu?" Jawab perempuan itu: "Selamat!"
scripture_data.text_en: Run now, I pray thee, to meet her, and say unto her, [Is it] well with thee? [is it] well with thy husband? [is it] well with the child? And she answered, [It is] well.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל רמו דלל לה יל לה ל לה לרמו תרקל נשר ה

scripture_data.text_id: Dan sesudah ia sampai ke gunung itu, dipegangnyalah kaki abdi Allah itu, tetapi Gehazi mendekat hendak mengusir dia. Lalu berkatalah abdi Allah: "Biarkanlah dia, hatinya pedih! TUHAN menyembunyikan hal ini dari padaku, tidak memberitahukannya kepadaku."
scripture_data.text_en: And when she came to the man of God to the hill, she caught him by the feet: but Gehazi came near to thrust her away. And the man of God said, Let her alone; for her soul [is] vexed within her: and the LORD hath hid [it] from me, and hath not told me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל דיה לו ימ ילה הוהיו להרמ פני להרה יהלה י רמו פדהל יזחי ו וילגר קזחו רההל יהלה יל בו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu berkatalah perempuan itu: "Adakah kuminta seorang anak laki-laki dari pada tuanku? Bukankah telah kukatakan: Jangan aku diberi harapan kosong?"
scripture_data.text_en: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? did I not say, Do not deceive me?
scripture_data.text_orig: ית הלת ל ירמ לה ינד תמ ב ילה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka berkatalah Elisa kepada Gehazi: "Ikatlah pinggangmu, bawalah tongkatku di tanganmu dan pergilah. Apabila engkau bertemu dengan seseorang, janganlah beri salam kepadanya dan apabila seseorang memberi salam kepadamu, janganlah balas dia, kemudian taruhlah tongkatku ini di atas anak itu."
scripture_data.text_en: Then he said to Gehazi, Gird up thy loins, and take my staff in thine hand, and go thy way: if thou meet any man, salute him not; and if any salute thee, answer him not again: and lay my staff upon the face of the child.
scripture_data.text_orig: רה ינל ינמ מו נת ל י כרבייכו כרבת ל י צמתי לו דיב ינמ חקו ינתמ רגח יזחיגל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi berkatalah ibu anak itu: "Demi TUHAN yang hidup dan demi hidupmu sendiri, sesungguhnya aku tidak akan meninggalkan engkau." Lalu bangunlah Elisa dan berjalan mengikuti perempuan itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the mother of the child said, [As] the LORD liveth, and [as] thy soul liveth, I will not leave thee. And he arose, and followed her.

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun Gehazi telah berjalan mendahului mereka dan telah menaruh tongkat di atas anak itu, tetapi tidak ada suara, dan tidak ada tanda hidup. Lalu kembalilah ia menemui Elisa serta memberitahukan kepadanya, katanya: "Anak itu tidak bangun!"
scripture_data.text_en: And Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff upon the face of the child; but [there was] neither voice, nor hearing. Wherefore he went again to meet him, and told him, saying, The child is not awaked.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan ketika Elisa masuk ke rumah, ternyata anak itu sudah mati dan terbaring di atas tempat tidurnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And when Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, [and] laid upon his bed.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah ia masuk, ditutupnyalah pintu, sehingga ia sendiri dengan anak itu di dalam kamar, kemudian berdoalah ia kepada TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: He went in therefore, and shut the door upon them twain, and prayed unto the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהיל לתו הינ ד תלה רסו בו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu ia membaringkan dirinya di atas anak itu dengan mulutnya di atas mulut anak itu, dan matanya di atas mata anak itu, serta telapak tangannya di atas telapak tangan anak itu; dan karena ia meniarap di atas anak itu, maka menjadi panaslah badan anak itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And he went up, and lay upon the child, and put his mouth upon his mouth, and his eyes upon his eyes, and his hands upon his hands: and he stretched himself upon the child; and the flesh of the child waxed warm.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu ia berdiri kembali dan berjalan dalam rumah itu sekali ke sana dan sekali ke sini, kemudian meniarap pulalah ia di atas anak itu. Maka bersinlah anak itu sampai tujuh kali, lalu membuka matanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Then he returned, and walked in the house to and fro; and went up, and stretched himself upon him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian Elisa memanggil Gehazi dan berkata: "Panggillah perempuan Sunem itu!" Dipanggilnyalah dia, lalu datanglah ia kepadanya, maka berkatalah Elisa: "Angkatlah anakmu ini!"
scripture_data.text_en: And he called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. And when she was come in unto him, he said, Take up thy son.
scripture_data.text_orig: נב י רמו ויל בו הרקו תה תינהל רק רמו יזחיל רקו

scripture_data.text_id: Masuklah perempuan itu, lalu tersungkur di depan kaki Elisa dan sujud menyembah dengan mukanya sampai ke tanah. Kemudian diangkatnyalah anaknya, lalu keluar.
scripture_data.text_en: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground, and took up her son, and went out.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף צו נת ו הצר חו וילגרל לו בו

scripture_data.text_id: Elisa kembali ke Gilgal pada waktu ada kelaparan di negeri itu. Dan ketika pada suatu kali rombongan nabi duduk di depannya, berkatalah ia kepada bujangnya: "Taruhlah kuali yang paling besar di atas api dan masaklah sesuatu makanan bagi rombongan nabi itu."
scripture_data.text_en: And Elisha came again to Gilgal: and [there was] a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets [were] sitting before him: and he said unto his servant, Set on the great pot, and seethe pottage for the sons of the prophets.
scripture_data.text_orig: ייבה ינבל דיזנ לב הלדה ריה תפ רנל רמו וינפל יבי ייבה ינב שר ברהו הללה ב ילו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu keluarlah seorang dari mereka ke ladang untuk mengumpulkan sayur-sayuran; ia menemui pohon sulur-suluran liar dan memetik dari padanya labu liar, serangkul penuh dalam jubahnya. Sesudah ia pulang, teruslah ia mengiris-irisnya ke dalam kuali masakan tadi, sebab mereka tidak mengenalnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And one went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered thereof wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred [them] into the pot of pottage: for they knew [them] not.

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian dicedoklah dari masakan tadi bagi orang-orang itu untuk dimakan dan segera sesudah mereka memakannya, berteriaklah mereka serta berkata: "Maut ada dalam kuali itu, hai abdi Allah!" Dan tidak tahan mereka memakannya.
scripture_data.text_en: So they poured out for the men to eat. And it came to pass, as they were eating of the pottage, that they cried out, and said, O [thou] man of God, [there is] death in the pot. And they could not eat [thereof].
scripture_data.text_orig: לכל לכי לו יהלה י רי תומ רמו קצ ההו דיזהמ לכ יהיו לכל ינל קצו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi berkatalah Elisa: "Ambillah tepung!" Dilemparkannyalah itu ke dalam kuali serta berkata: "Cedoklah sekarang bagi orang-orang ini, supaya mereka makan!" Maka tidak ada lagi sesuatu bahaya dalam kuali itu.
scripture_data.text_en: But he said, Then bring meal. And he cast [it] into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. And there was no harm in the pot.

scripture_data.text_id: Datanglah seseorang dari Baal-Salisa dengan membawa bagi abdi Allah roti hulu hasil, yaitu dua puluh roti jelai serta gandum baru dalam sebuah kantong. Lalu berkatalah Elisa: "Berilah itu kepada orang-orang ini, supaya mereka makan."
scripture_data.text_en: And there came a man from Baalshalisha, and brought the man of God bread of the firstfruits, twenty loaves of barley, and full ears of corn in the husk thereof. And he said, Give unto the people, that they may eat.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכיו ל רמו נלקצ למרכו יר חליר יר חל יהלה יל בו הללמ יו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi pelayannya itu berkata: "Bagaimanakah aku dapat menghidangkan ini di depan seratus orang?" Jawabnya: "Berikanlah kepada orang-orang itu, supaya mereka makan, sebab beginilah firman TUHAN: Orang akan makan, bahkan akan ada sisanya."
scripture_data.text_en: And his servitor said, What, should I set this before an hundred men? He said again, Give the people, that they may eat: for thus saith the LORD, They shall eat, and shall leave [thereof].
scripture_data.text_orig: רתהו לכ הוהי רמ הכ י לכיו ל רמו י המ ינפל הז המ תרם רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu dihidangkannyalah di depan mereka, maka makanlah mereka dan ada sisanya, sesuai dengan firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: So he set [it] before them, and they did eat, and left [thereof], according to the word of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי רבד רתו לכו הינפל ו

scripture_data.text_id: Naaman, panglima raja Aram, adalah seorang terpandang di hadapan tuannya dan sangat disayangi, sebab oleh dia TUHAN telah memberikan kemenangan kepada orang Aram. Tetapi orang itu, seorang pahlawan tentara, sakit kusta.
scripture_data.text_en: Now Naaman, captain of the host of the king of Syria, was a great man with his master, and honourable, because by him the LORD had given deliverance unto Syria: he was also a mighty man in valour, [but he was] a leper.
scripture_data.text_orig: רצם ליח ר היה יהו רל ה הוהיתנ בי ינפ נ וינד ינפל לד י היה רלם בצר מנו

scripture_data.text_id: Orang Aram pernah keluar bergerombolan dan membawa tertawan seorang anak perempuan dari negeri Israel. Ia menjadi pelayan pada isteri Naaman.
scripture_data.text_en: And the Syrians had gone out by companies, and had brought away captive out of the land of Israel a little maid; and she waited on Naaman's wife.
scripture_data.text_orig: מן ת ינפל יהו הק הרן לרי שרמ ו ידדג צי רו

scripture_data.text_id: Berkatalah gadis itu kepada nyonyanya: "Sekiranya tuanku menghadap nabi yang di Samaria itu, maka tentulah nabi itu akan menyembuhkan dia dari penyakitnya."
scripture_data.text_en: And she said unto her mistress, Would God my lord [were] with the prophet that [is] in Samaria! for he would recover him of his leprosy.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ ת סי ז רמ ר יבה ינפל ינד ילח רבל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu pergilah Naaman memberitahukan kepada tuannya, katanya: "Begini-beginilah dikatakan oleh gadis yang dari negeri Israel itu."
scripture_data.text_en: And [one] went in, and told his lord, saying, Thus and thus said the maid that [is] of the land of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי שרמ ר הרה הר תזכו תז רמל וינדל דו בו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka jawab raja Aram: "Baik, pergilah dan aku akan mengirim surat kepada raja Israel." Lalu pergilah Naaman dan membawa sebagai persembahan sepuluh talenta perak dan enam ribu syikal emas dan sepuluh potong pakaian.
scripture_data.text_en: And the king of Syria said, Go to, go, and I will send a letter unto the king of Israel. And he departed, and took with him ten talents of silver, and six thousand [pieces] of gold, and ten changes of raiment.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידג תפילח רו בהז יפל תו סכיר ר די חו לו לרי למל רפס החלו ל רלם רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menyampaikan surat itu kepada raja Israel, yang berbunyi: "Sesampainya surat ini kepadamu, maklumlah kiranya, bahwa aku menyuruh kepadamu Naaman, pegawaiku, supaya engkau menyembuhkan dia dari penyakit kustanya."
scripture_data.text_en: And he brought the letter to the king of Israel, saying, Now when this letter is come unto thee, behold, I have [therewith] sent Naaman my servant to thee, that thou mayest recover him of his leprosy.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ פסו יב מנת יל יחל הה יל הה רפה ב הו רמל לרי למל רפה בו

scripture_data.text_id: Segera sesudah raja Israel membaca surat itu, dikoyakkannyalah pakaiannya serta berkata: "Allahkah aku ini yang dapat mematikan dan menghidupkan, sehingga orang ini mengirim pesan kepadaku, supaya kusembuhkan seorang dari penyakit kustanya? Tetapi sesungguhnya, perhatikanlah dan lihatlah, ia mencari gara-gara terhadap aku."
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when the king of Israel had read the letter, that he rent his clothes, and said, [Am] I God, to kill and to make alive, that this man doth send unto me to recover a man of his leprosy? wherefore consider, I pray you, and see how he seeketh a quarrel against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ה התמי ר נ י רמ י סל יל חל הזי תיחהל תימהל ינ יהלה רמו וידג רקו רפהת לרילם רק יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Segera sesudah didengar Elisa, abdi Allah itu, bahwa raja Israel mengoyakkan pakaiannya, dikirimnyalah pesan kepada raja, bunyinya: "Mengapa engkau mengoyakkan pakaianmu? Biarlah ia datang kepadaku, supaya ia tahu bahwa ada seorang nabi di Israel."
scripture_data.text_en: And it was [so], when Elisha the man of God had heard that the king of Israel had rent his clothes, that he sent to the king, saying, Wherefore hast thou rent thy clothes? let him come now to me, and he shall know that there is a prophet in Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי יבנ י י דיו יל נבי ידג רק הל רמל להל חלו וידגת לרילם רקי יהלהי יל מ יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah Naaman dengan kudanya dan keretanya, lalu berhenti di depan pintu rumah Elisa.
scripture_data.text_en: So Naaman came with his horses and with his chariot, and stood at the door of the house of Elisha.

scripture_data.text_id: Elisa menyuruh seorang suruhan kepadanya mengatakan: "Pergilah mandi tujuh kali dalam sungai Yordan, maka tubuhmu akan pulih kembali, sehingga engkau menjadi tahir."
scripture_data.text_en: And Elisha sent a messenger unto him, saying, Go and wash in Jordan seven times, and thy flesh shall come again to thee, and thou shalt be clean.
scripture_data.text_orig: רה ל ר ביו ר ימב צחרו לה רמל לם יל ויל חלו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi pergilah Naaman dengan gusar sambil berkata: "Aku sangka bahwa setidak-tidaknya ia datang ke luar dan berdiri memanggil nama TUHAN, Allahnya, lalu menggerak-gerakkan tangannya di atas tempat penyakit itu dan dengan demikian menyembuhkan penyakit kustaku!
scripture_data.text_en: But Naaman was wroth, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of the LORD his God, and strike his hand over the place, and recover the leper.
scripture_data.text_orig: רצה סו קהל די ינהו ויהל הוהי רקו דמו צי צי יל ירמ הה רמו לו מן צקו

scripture_data.text_id: Bukankah Abana dan Parpar, sungai-sungai Damsyik, lebih baik dari segala sungai di Israel? Bukankah aku dapat mandi di sana dan menjadi tahir?" Kemudian berpalinglah ia dan pergi dengan panas hati.
scripture_data.text_en: [Are] not Abana and Pharpar, rivers of Damascus, better than all the waters of Israel? may I not wash in them, and be clean? So he turned and went away in a rage.
scripture_data.text_orig: המח לו פו ירהו ה שחרלה לרי ימימ למ ק תרהן ררפ הנמ הנב ב לה

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi pegawai-pegawainya datang mendekat serta berkata kepadanya: "Bapak, seandainya nabi itu menyuruh perkara yang sukar kepadamu, bukankah bapak akan melakukannya? Apalagi sekarang, ia hanya berkata kepadamu: Mandilah dan engkau akan menjadi tahir."
scripture_data.text_en: And his servants came near, and spake unto him, and said, My father, [if] the prophet had bid thee [do some] great thing, wouldest thou not have done [it]? how much rather then, when he saith to thee, Wash, and be clean?
scripture_data.text_orig: רה שחר יל רמי ו הת לה יל ר יבה לד רב יב רמו ויל רדיו וידב ו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka turunlah ia membenamkan dirinya tujuh kali dalam sungai Yordan, sesuai dengan perkataan abdi Allah itu. Lalu pulihlah tubuhnya kembali seperti tubuh seorang anak dan ia menjadi tahir.
scripture_data.text_en: Then went he down, and dipped himself seven times in Jordan, according to the saying of the man of God: and his flesh came again like unto the flesh of a little child, and he was clean.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהו ק רנ רב ר בו יהלה י רבד ימ ב ר לו דרו

scripture_data.text_id: Yohanan memperanakkan Azarya; dialah yang memegang jabatan imam di Bait Suci yang didirikan Salomo di Yerusalem.
scripture_data.text_en: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he [it is] that executed the priest's office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
scripture_data.text_orig: תמיחו ימ הנקל ינב

scripture_data.text_id: Azarya memperanakkan Amarya; Amarya memperanakkan Ahitub;
scripture_data.text_en: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
scripture_data.text_orig: נ תחנו נ יפץ הנקל ינ נ הנקל

scripture_data.text_id: Ahitub memperanakkan Zadok; Zadok memperanakkan Salum;
scripture_data.text_en: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
scripture_data.text_orig: נב הנקל נ חרי נ ביל

scripture_data.text_id: Salum memperanakkan Hilkia; Hilkia memperanakkan Azarya;
scripture_data.text_en: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הבו ינו רכה למ ינב

scripture_data.text_id: Azarya memperanakkan Seraya; Seraya memperanakkan Yozadak;
scripture_data.text_en: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
scripture_data.text_orig: נב ה נב ימ נב ינבל ילחם יררם ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Yozadak turut diangkut ketika TUHAN membiarkan orang Yehuda dan Yerusalem diangkut ke dalam pembuangan oleh Nebukadnezar.
scripture_data.text_en: And Jehozadak went [into captivity], when the LORD carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף נב הי נב הח נב מ

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak Lewi ialah Gerson, Kehat dan Merari.
scripture_data.text_en: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
scripture_data.text_orig: רה חנמ הוהי תי ריידיל דיו דימה ר הו

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah nama anak-anak Gerson: Libni dan Simei.
scripture_data.text_en: And these [be] the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
scripture_data.text_orig: תדבל מך דמו לרי הוהי תית המל תנד רי דמלה מ ינפל יתרם יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak Kehat ialah Amram, Yizhar, Hebron dan Uziel.
scripture_data.text_en: And the sons of Kohath [were], Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
scripture_data.text_orig: למ לי ררמה מיה יתהה ינמ הינב ידמה הו

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak Merari ialah Mahli dan Musi. Inilah kaum-kaum suku Lewi dalam puak-puak mereka:
scripture_data.text_en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these [are] the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
scripture_data.text_orig: ח ליל חרי הנקל

scripture_data.text_id: dari pada Gerson ialah Libni, anaknya, dan anak orang ini ialah Yahat, dan anak orang ini ialah Zima,
scripture_data.text_en: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ תחמ הנקל צ יצ

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Yoah, dan anak orang ini ialah Ido, dan anak orang ini ialah Zerah, dan anak orang ini ialah Yeatrai.
scripture_data.text_en: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
scripture_data.text_orig: הינפצ הירז לי הנקל

scripture_data.text_id: Keturunan Kehat ialah Aminadab, anaknya, dan anak orang ini ialah Korah, dan anak orang ini ialah Asir,
scripture_data.text_en: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: חרק סיב רי תח

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Elkana, dan anak orang ini ialah Ebyasaf, dan anak orang ini ialah Asir,
scripture_data.text_en: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי יול תהק רהצי

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Tahat, dan anak orang ini ialah Uriel, dan anak orang ini ialah Uzia, dan anak orang ini ialah Saul.
scripture_data.text_en: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ היכר ס נימיל דמה ס ויחו

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak Elkana ialah Amasai dan Ahimot,
scripture_data.text_en: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלמ הי לכימ

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Elkana, dan anak orang ini ialah Zofai, dan anak orang ini ialah Nahat,
scripture_data.text_en: [As for] Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: היד חרזב ינת

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Eliab, dan anak orang ini ialah Yeroham, dan anak orang ini ialah Elkana.
scripture_data.text_en: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ הז תי

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak Samuel ialah Yoel, anak sulung dan anak yang kedua ialah Abia.
scripture_data.text_en: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יול ר תחי

scripture_data.text_id: Keturunan Merari ialah Mahli, dan anak orang ini ialah Libni, anak orang ini ialah Simei, dan anak orang ini ialah Uza,
scripture_data.text_en: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: מ יב ייק תי לומהל היח יררם ינב

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Simea, dan anak orang ini ialah Hagia, dan anak orang ini ialah Asaya.
scripture_data.text_en: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
scripture_data.text_orig: הקלח היצמב היבח

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah orang-orang yang ditugaskan oleh Daud memimpin nyanyian di rumah TUHAN sejak tabut itu mendapat tempat perhentian.
scripture_data.text_en: And these [are they] whom David set over the service of song in the house of the LORD, after that the ark had rest.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ ינב יצמ

scripture_data.text_id: Di hadapan Kemah Suci, yakni Kemah Pertemuan, mereka melayani sebagai penyanyi sampai Salomo mendirikan rumah TUHAN di Yerusalem. Mereka melakukan tugas jabatannya sesuai dengan peraturannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem: and [then] they waited on their office according to their order.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יול יררמ ימ ילחמ

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah orang-orang yang memegang tugas itu dengan anak-anak mereka: dari bani Kehat ialah Heman, penyanyi itu, anak Yoel bin Samuel
scripture_data.text_en: And these [are] they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלה תי מ תדבלכל ינתן ולה היחו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Elkana bin Yeroham bin Eliel bin Toah
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
scripture_data.text_orig: ף יהלה דב המ הצ ר לכ לריל רכל ידה דק תכלם לכל תרה חזמלו הלה חזמל יריקם וינב רהו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Zuf bin Elkana bin Mahat bin Amasai
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
scripture_data.text_orig: נ יב נ סחני נ רזל רה ינ הו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Elkana bin Yoel bin Azaria bin Zefanya
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
scripture_data.text_orig: נב היחרז נב י נב י

scripture_data.text_id: bin Tahat bin Asir bin Ebyasaf bin Korah
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
scripture_data.text_orig: נ ביח נב הירמ נ תירם

scripture_data.text_id: bin Yizhar bin Kehat bin Lewi bin Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס נ שמיח נ קדצ

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian di sebelah kanannya berdiri Asaf, saudara sesukunya, yaitu Asaf bin Berekhya bin Simea
scripture_data.text_en: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, [even] Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
scripture_data.text_orig: לרה היה הל י יתהה תחמל רה ינבל לבג תריל תבם הו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Mikhael bin Baaseya bin Malkia
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
scripture_data.text_orig: היתביבס הירגמתו הדהי שר רבחת הל נו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Etai bin Zerah bin Adaya
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הפי בלכל נתנ הירצחתו ריה הדתו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Etan bin Zima bin Simei
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו מתו ריתו הירגמתו הנבלתו רבחת לקה ירת נתנ רה ינבלו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Yahat bin Gerson bin Lewi.
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו ריבת הירגמתו זליחתו

scripture_data.text_id: Di sebelah kiri berdiri dari bani Merari, saudara-saudara sesuku mereka, Etan bin Kisi bin Abdi bin Malukh
scripture_data.text_en: And their brethren the sons of Merari [stood] on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הירגמתו מתיתו הירגמתו תו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Hasabya bin Amazia bin Hilkia
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היתחמ רי הרל הירל הירגמתו תתנתו הירגמתו תמלתו הירגמתו בת מינב המ

scripture_data.text_id: bin Amzi bin Bani bin Semer
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ר יר לר הנם יצח הם תיצחמ הה תחמ ירתה תהק ינבלו

scripture_data.text_id: bin Mahli bin Musi bin Merari bin Lewi.
scripture_data.text_en: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הר ל יר הנם המ ילפן המ ר המ רכי המ תחמל רג ינבלו

scripture_data.text_id: Saudara-saudara sesuku mereka, orang-orang Lewi yang lain, diserahkan melakukan segala pekerjaan di Kemah Suci, rumah Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: Their brethren also the Levites [were] appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר י יר לר לבז המ דגהמ בר המ תחמל יררם ינבל

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Harun dan anak-anaknya berkewajiban membakar korban di atas mezbah korban bakaran dan di atas mezbah pembakaran ukupan, dan melakukan segala pekerjaan di tempat maha kudus serta mengadakan pendamaian bagi orang Israel, tepat seperti yang diperintahkan Musa, hamba Allah itu.
scripture_data.text_en: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, [and were appointed] for all the work of the [place] most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו ירהת ולל לריינב נו

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah keturunan Harun: Eleazar, anaknya, dan anak orang ini ialah Pinehas, dan anak orang ini ialah Abisua,
scripture_data.text_en: And these [are] the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמ הת רקיר הה ירה ת מינב ינ המ מינב המ הדהיינב המ לרב נו

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Buki, dan anak orang ini ialah Uzi, dan anak orang ini ialah Zerahya
scripture_data.text_en: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: ירפ המ לבג יר יהיו תהק ינ תחמ

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Merayot, dan anak orang ini ialah Amarya, dan anak orang ini ialah Ahitub,
scripture_data.text_en: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו רזתו ירפ רה הירגמתו כת לקה ירת הל נו

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak orang ini ialah Zadok, dan anak orang ini ialah Ahimaas.
scripture_data.text_en: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו רחתיתו הירגמתו מקיתו

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah tempat-tempat kediaman mereka menurut tempat-tempat perkemahan mereka di daerah mereka: kepada keturunan Harun yang termasuk kaum orang Kehat karena bagi merekalah undian yang pertama
scripture_data.text_en: Now these [are] their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הירגמתו רתתו הירגמתו לתו

scripture_data.text_id: kepada mereka diberikan Hebron di tanah Yehuda dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaan di sekelilingnya,
scripture_data.text_en: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ירתה תהקינבל תחמל הירגמתו לתו הירגמתו רנת הנם הם תיצחמ

scripture_data.text_id: tetapi tanah ladang kota tadi dengan desa-desanya telah diberikan kepada Kaleb bin Yefune.
scripture_data.text_en: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הירגמתו תרתו הירגמתו לת הנם הם יצח תחמ ר ינבל

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada keturunan Harun diberikan Hebron kota perlindungan itu, kemudian Libna dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya, dan Yatir, lalu Estemoa dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya;
scripture_data.text_en: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, [namely], Hebron, [the city] of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו תרבת הירגמתו דקת רכי המ

scripture_data.text_id: Hilen dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya, Debir dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya;
scripture_data.text_en: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הירגמתו נתו הירגמתו תמרתו

scripture_data.text_id: Asan dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya, dan Bet-Semes dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya;
scripture_data.text_en: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Bethshemesh with her suburbs:
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו בתו הירגמתו למת ר המ

scripture_data.text_id: dan dari suku Benyamin: Geba dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya, Alemet dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya dan Anatot dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya. Seluruhnya kota-kota mereka ada tiga belas yang dibagikan di antara kaum-kaum mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families [were] thirteen cities.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו בחרתו הירגמתו קקחתו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan keturunan Kehat yang selebihnya mendapat dengan undian sepuluh kota dari kaum suku itu, yakni dari suku Manasye yang setengah itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And unto the sons of Kohath, [which were] left of the family of that tribe, [were cities given] out of the half tribe, [namely, out of] the half [tribe] of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הירגמתו יתירקתו הירגמתו חתו הירגמתו ליל דקת ילפן המ

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada keturunan Gerson menurut kaum-kaum mereka diberikan tiga belas kota dari suku Isakhar, dari suku Asyer, dari suku Naftali dan dari suku Manasye yang di Basan.
scripture_data.text_en: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו רבת הירגמתו נרת לבז המ ירתה יררם ינבל

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada keturunan Merari menurut kaum-kaum mereka diberikan dengan diundi dua belas kota dari suku Ruben, dari suku Gad dan dari suku Zebulon.
scripture_data.text_en: Unto the sons of Merari [were given] by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו הצהיתו הירגמתו רד רצת בר המ רה חרזמל חרי ריל רבמ

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi orang Israel memberikan kepada orang Lewi kota-kota itu dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites [these] cities with their suburbs.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו תפימתו הירגמתו תמדקתו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka memberikan juga dengan diundi kota-kota tadi, yang mereka sebutkan nama-namanya, dari suku bani Yehuda, dari suku bani Simeon dan dari suku bani Benyamin.
scripture_data.text_en: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by [their] names.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירגמתו ינחמתו הירגמתו דל תמרת דגהמ

scripture_data.text_id: Kaum-kaum yang lain dari keturunan Kehat mendapat kota-kota dari suku Efraim sebagai daerah mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And [the residue] of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הירגמתו ריזיתו הירגמתו חתו

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada mereka diberikan Sikhem, kota perlindungan itu, dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya, di pegunungan Efraim, lalu Gezer dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya,
scripture_data.text_en: And they gave unto them, [of] the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; [they gave] also Gezer with her suburbs,
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Yokmeam dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya, Bet-Horon dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya,
scripture_data.text_en: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Bethhoron with her suburbs,
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Ayalon dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya dan Gat-Rimon dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gathrimmon with her suburbs:
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Dan dari suku Manasye yang setengah itu: Aner dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya dan Bileam dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya. Jadi kota-kota itu diberikan kepada kaum-kaum yang selebihnya dari keturunan Kehat.
scripture_data.text_en: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Keturunan Gerson mendapat dari kaum suku Manasye yang setengah itu; Golan yang di Basan dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya, lalu Asytarot dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya;
scripture_data.text_en: Unto the sons of Gershom [were given] out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: dari suku Isakhar: Kedesh dengan tanah-tanah penggembalaannya; Daberat dengan tanah-tanah pengembalaannya,

scripture_data.text_en: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: [they were] not of double heart.

scripture_data.text_id: Sekaliannya itu, prajurit-prajurit, orang-orang dalam barisan tempur, datang ke Hebron dengan tulus hati untuk mengangkat Daud menjadi raja atas seluruh Israel; memang juga seluruh orang Israel yang lain dengan bulat hati hendak mengangkat Daud menjadi raja.
scripture_data.text_en: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel [were] of one heart to make David king.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka tinggal di sana bersama-sama Daud tiga hari lamanya, makan dan minum, sebab saudara-saudara mereka menyajikan makanan bagi mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.

scripture_data.text_id: Juga orang-orang yang tinggal dekat mereka, bahkan dari Isakhar, Zebulon dan Naftali, membawa makanan dengan memakai keledai, unta, bagal dan lembu, yakni bahan makanan tepung, kue ara dan kue kismis, anggur dan minyak, lembu sapi dan kambing domba, dalam jumlah besar, sebab ada sukacita di Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover they that were nigh them, [even] unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, [and] meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for [there was] joy in Israel.

scripture_data.text_id: Daud berunding dengan pemimpin-pemimpin pasukan seribu dan pasukan seratus dan dengan semua pemuka.
scripture_data.text_en: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, [and] with every leader.

scripture_data.text_id: Berkatalah Daud kepada seluruh jemaah Israel: "Jika kamu anggap baik dan jika diperkenankan TUHAN, Allah kita, baiklah kita menyuruh orang kepada saudara-saudara kita yang masih tinggal di daerah-daerah orang Israel, dan di samping itu kepada para imam dan orang-orang Lewi yang ada di kota-kota yang dikelilingi tanah penggembalaan mereka, supaya mereka berkumpul kepada kita.
scripture_data.text_en: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If [it seem] good unto you, and [that it be] of the LORD our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, [that are] left in all the land of Israel, and with them [also] to the priests and Levites [which are] in their cities [and] suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
scripture_data.text_orig: ניל צביו הירגמ יר ולהו ינהה הו לרי תצר לכ ירה ניחל החלנ הצרפנ ניהל הוהימ ב כיל לרי להק לכל דיו רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan baiklah kita memindahkan tabut Allah kita ke tempat kita, sebab pada zaman Saul kita tidak mengindahkannya."
scripture_data.text_en: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we enquired not at it in the days of Saul.

scripture_data.text_id: Maka seluruh jemaah itu berkata, bahwa mereka akan berbuat demikian, sebab usul itu dianggap baik oleh segenap bangsa itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Daud mengumpulkan semua orang Israel dari sungai Sikhor di Mesir sampai ke jalan yang menuju Hamat, untuk menjemput tabut Allah dari Kiryat-Yearim.
scripture_data.text_en: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjathjearim.

scripture_data.text_en: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, [that is], to Kirjathjearim, which [belonged] to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the LORD, that dwelleth [between] the cherubims, whose name is called [on it].

scripture_data.text_en: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.

scripture_data.text_en: And David and all Israel played before God with all [their] might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.

scripture_data.text_en: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.

scripture_data.text_en: So David brought not the ark [home] to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obededom the Gittite.

scripture_data.text_en: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu tahulah Daud, bahwa TUHAN telah menegakkan dia sebagai raja atas Israel, sebab martabat pemerintahannya terangkat tinggi oleh karena Israel umat-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: And David perceived that the LORD had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.

scripture_data.text_en: So they came up to Baalperazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baalperazim.

scripture_data.text_id: maka bertanyalah lagi Daud kepada Allah, lalu Allah menjawab: "Janganlah maju di belakang mereka, tetapi buatlah gerakan lingkaran terhadap mereka, sehingga engkau dapat menyerang mereka dari jurusan pohon-pohon kertau.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore David enquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.

scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, [that] then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.

scripture_data.text_en: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him upon all nations.

scripture_data.text_id: Daud membuat bagi dirinya gedung-gedung di kota Daud, lalu ia menyiapkan tempat bagi tabut Allah dan membentangkan kemah untuk itu.

scripture_data.text_en: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Daud memanggil Zadok dan Abyatar, imam-imam itu, dan orang-orang Lewi, yakni Uriel, Asaya, Yoel, Semaya, Eliel dan Aminadab,
scripture_data.text_en: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
scripture_data.text_orig: בדניו לילו הימ ליו הי לירל וללו ינהה רתיבל קדצל דיוד רקו

scripture_data.text_id: dan berkata kepada mereka: "Hai kamu ini, para kepala puak dari orang Lewi, kuduskanlah dirimu, kamu ini dan saudara-saudara sepuakmu, supaya kamu mengangkut tabut TUHAN, Allah Israel, ke tempat yang telah kusiapkan untuk itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And said unto them, Ye [are] the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, [both] ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto [the place that] I have prepared for it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל יתניכהל לרי יהל הוהי ר ת תילהו כיחו קתה ולל תבה יר הל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab oleh karena pada pertama kali kamu tidak hadir, maka TUHAN, Allah kita, telah menyambar di tengah-tengah kita, sebab kita tidak meminta petunjuk-Nya seperti seharusnya."
scripture_data.text_en: For because ye [did it] not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנרד לי נ ניהל הוהי שר ל הנרמל י

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi para imam dan orang-orang Lewi menguduskan dirinya untuk mengangkut tabut TUHAN, Allah Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי יהל הוהי רת תלהל ולהו ינהה קתו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian bani Lewi mengangkat tabut Allah itu dengan gandar pengusung di atas bahu mereka, seperti yang diperintahkan Musa, sesuai dengan firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Daud memerintahkan para kepala orang Lewi itu, supaya mereka menyuruh berdiri saudara-saudara sepuak mereka, yakni para penyanyi, dengan membawa alat-alat musik seperti gambus, kecapi dan ceracap, untuk memperdengarkan dengan nyaring lagu-lagu gembira.
scripture_data.text_en: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren [to be] the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף החמל לקירהל יימם ילצמ תרכו ילבן ריילכ יררמה היחת דימהל ולה ירל דיו רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka orang Lewi itu menyuruh berdiri Heman bin Yoel; dan dari saudara-saudara sepuaknya: Asaf bin Berekhya; dari bani Merari, saudara-saudara sepuak mereka: Etan bin Kusaya;

scripture_data.text_en: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obededom and Jehiah [were] doorkeepers for the ark.

scripture_data.text_en: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obededom with joy.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan oleh karena Allah menolong orang Lewi yang mengangkat tabut perjanjian TUHAN itu, maka dipersembahkanlah tujuh ekor lembu jantan dan tujuh ekor domba jantan.
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.

scripture_data.text_id: Daud memakai jubah dari kain lenan halus, juga segala orang Lewi yang mengangkat tabut itu dan para penyanyi, dan Kenanya yang mengepalai pengangkutan dan para penyanyi. Daud juga memakai baju efod dari kain lenan.
scripture_data.text_en: And David [was] clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also [had] upon him an ephod of linen.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד דפ דיולו יררמה ה רה היננכ יררמהו רהת יה ולהלכו ש לימ לרכם דיודו

scripture_data.text_id: Seluruh orang Israel mengangkut tabut perjanjian TUHAN itu dengan diiringi sorak dan bunyi sangkakala, nafiri dan ceracap, sambil memperdengarkan permainan gambus dan kecapi.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika tabut perjanjian TUHAN itu sampai ke kota Daud, maka Mikhal, anak perempuan Saul, menjenguk dari jendela, lalu melihat raja Daud melompat-lompat dan menari-nari. Sebab itu ia memandang rendah Daud dalam hatinya.
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass, [as] the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ל ל זבו קחמ דרם דיו להת רו חה ד הפקנ לת לכימ דיו ריד הוהי תיר ר יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Tabut Allah itu dibawa masuk, lalu diletakkan di tengah-tengah kemah yang dipasang Daud untuk itu, kemudian mereka mempersembahkan korban bakaran dan korban keselamatan di hadapan Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.

scripture_data.text_en: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu dibagikannya kepada setiap orang Israel, baik laki-laki maupun perempuan, kepada masing-masing sekeping roti, sekerat daging dan sepotong kue kismis.
scripture_data.text_en: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon [of wine].

scripture_data.text_id: Juga diangkatnya dari orang Lewi itu beberapa orang sebagai pelayan di hadapan tabut TUHAN untuk memasyhurkan TUHAN, Allah Israel dan menyanyikan syukur dan puji-pujian bagi-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: And he appointed [certain] of the Levites to minister before the ark of the LORD, and to record, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel:

scripture_data.text_en: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obededom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
scripture_data.text_orig: ימם ילצמ סו תרכב ילבן ילכ לייו דדבו הינב בילו היתמ ליחיו תמרימ ליי הירכז הנמ רה ס

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian pada hari itu juga, maka Daud untuk pertama kali menyuruh Asaf dan saudara-saudara sepuaknya menyanyikan syukur bagi TUHAN:
scripture_data.text_en: Then on that day David delivered first [this psalm] to thank the LORD into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ויחו סדי הוהיל תדהל ר דיו תנ ז הה

scripture_data.text_id: Bersyukurlah kepada TUHAN, panggillah nama-Nya, perkenalkanlah perbuatan-Nya di antara bangsa-bangsa!
scripture_data.text_en: Give thanks unto the LORD, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.

scripture_data.text_id: Bernyanyilah bagi-Nya, bermazmurlah bagi-Nya, percakapkanlah segala perbuatan-Nya yang ajaib!
scripture_data.text_en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתלפנלכ חי לרז ל רי

scripture_data.text_id: Bermegahlah di dalam nama-Nya yang kudus, biarlah bersukahati orang-orang yang mencari TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Carilah TUHAN dan kekuatan-Nya, carilah wajah-Nya selalu!

scripture_data.text_orig: דימ וינפ ו הוהי ר

scripture_data.text_id: Ingatlah perbuatan-perbuatan ajaib yang dilakukan-Nya, mujizat-mujizat-Ny dan penghukuman-penghukuman yang diucapkan-Nya,
scripture_data.text_en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

scripture_data.text_id: hai anak cucu Israel, hamba-Nya, hai anak-anak Yakub, orang-orang pilihan-Nya!

scripture_data.text_id: Dialah TUHAN, Allah kita, di seluruh bumi berlaku penghukuman-Nya.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab besar TUHAN dan terpuji sangat, dan lebih dahsyat Ia dari pada segala allah.

scripture_data.text_id: Keagungan dan semarak ada di hadapan-Nya, kekuatan dan sukacita ada di tempat-Nya.

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada TUHAN, hai suku-suku bangsa, kepada TUHAN sajalah kemuliaan dan kekuatan!

scripture_data.text_id: Berilah kepada TUHAN kemuliaan nama-Nya, bawalah persembahan dan masuklah menghadap Dia! Sujudlah menyembah kepada TUHAN dengan berhiaskan kekudusan.
scripture_data.text_en: Give unto the LORD the glory [due] unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

scripture_data.text_id: Gemetarlah di hadapan-Nya hai segenap bumi; sungguh tegak dunia, tidak bergoyang.

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah langit bersukacita dan bumi bersorak-sorak, biarlah orang berkata di antara bangsa-bangsa: "TUHAN itu Raja!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let [men] say among the nations, The LORD reigneth.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan katakanlah: "Selamatkanlah kami, ya TUHAN Allah, Penyelamat kami, dan kumpulkanlah dan lepaskanlah kami dari antara bangsa-bangsa, supaya kami bersyukur kepada nama-Mu yang kudus, dan bermegah dalam puji-pujian kepada-Mu."
scripture_data.text_en: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, [and] glory in thy praise.

scripture_data.text_id: Terpujilah TUHAN, Allah Israel, dari selama-lamanya sampai selama-lamanya. Maka seluruh umat mengatakan: "Amin! Pujilah TUHAN!"
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהיל להו מ הלכ רמו לה דו להמ לרי יהל הוהי ר

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Daud meninggalkan di sana di hadapan tabut perjanjian TUHAN itu Asaf dan saudara-saudara sepuaknya untuk tetap melayani di hadapan tabut itu seperti yang patut dilakukan setiap hari;
scripture_data.text_en: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the LORD Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day's work required:

scripture_data.text_id: juga Obed-Edom dan saudara-saudara sepuaknya yang enam puluh delapan orang itu; Obed-Edom bin Yedutun dan Hosa adalah penunggu-penunggu pintu gerbang.
scripture_data.text_en: And Obededom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obededom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah [to be] porters:

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Zadok, imam itu, dan saudara-saudara sepuaknya, para imam, ditinggalkannya di hadapan Kemah Suci TUHAN di bukit pengorbanan yang di Gibeon,
scripture_data.text_en: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the LORD in the high place that [was] at Gibeon,

scripture_data.text_id: supaya pagi dan petang tetap dipersembahkan korban bakaran kepada TUHAN di atas mezbah korban bakaran, dan supaya dikerjakan segala yang tertulis dalam Taurat TUHAN yang diperintahkan-Nya kepada orang Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: To offer burnt offerings unto the LORD upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and [to do] according to all that is written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;

scripture_data.text_id: Dan bersama-sama mereka ikut Heman dan Yedutun dan selebihnya dari orang-orang yang terpilih, yang ditunjuk dengan disebut namanya untuk menyanyikan: "Syukur bagi TUHAN. Bahwasanya untuk selama-lamanya kasih setia-Nya."
scripture_data.text_en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy [endureth] for ever;

scripture_data.text_id: Pada Heman dan Yedutun itu ada nafiri dan ceracap untuk para pemain, juga alat-alat musik pengiring nyanyian untuk Allah. Dan anak-anak Yedutun harus menjaga pintu gerbang.
scripture_data.text_en: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun [were] porters.

scripture_data.text_en: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah Daud menetap di rumahnya, berkatalah ia kepada nabi Natan: "Lihatlah, aku ini diam dalam rumah dari kayu aras, padahal tabut perjanjian TUHAN itu ada di bawah tenda-tenda."
scripture_data.text_en: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD [remaineth] under curtains.

scripture_data.text_en: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that [is] in thine heart; for God [is] with thee.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi pada malam itu juga datanglah firman Allah kepada Natan, demikian:
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל תנל יהלרב יהיו הה הלי יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Pergilah, katakanlah kepada hamba-Ku Daud: Beginilah firman TUHAN: Bukanlah engkau yang akan mendirikan rumah bagi-Ku untuk didiami.
scripture_data.text_en: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the LORD, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:

scripture_data.text_id: Aku tidak pernah diam dalam rumah sejak Aku menuntun orang Israel keluar sampai hari ini, tetapi Aku mengembara dari kemah ke kemah, dan dari kediaman ke kediaman.
scripture_data.text_en: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from [one] tabernacle [to another].
scripture_data.text_orig: מ להל להמ היהו הה ה ד לרית יתילה ר המ תיב יבי ל י

scripture_data.text_id: Selama Aku mengembara bersama-sama seluruh orang Israel, pernahkah Aku mengucapkan firman kepada salah seorang hakim orang Israel, yang Kuperintahkan menggembalakan umat-Ku, demikian: Mengapa kamu tidak mendirikan bagi-Ku rumah dari kayu aras?
scripture_data.text_en: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
scripture_data.text_orig: יזר תי יל תינבל הל רמל ית תרל יתיצ ר לרי יפ דחת יר רבדה לרילכ יכהתהר לכ

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, beginilah kaukatakan kepada hamba-Ku Daud: Beginilah firman TUHAN semesta alam: Akulah yang mengambil engkau dari padang, ketika menggiring kambing domba, untuk menjadi raja atas umat-Ku Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the LORD of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, [even] from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי י ל דיגנ תיהל ה ירחמ הוהמ יחקל ינ תבץ הוהי רמ ה ס דיודל יבל רמתה הו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku telah menyertai engkau di segala tempat yang kaujalani dan telah melenyapkan segala musuhmu dari depanmu. Aku akan membuat namamu seperti nama orang-orang besar yang ada di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that [are] in the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר ר ילדה ל יתיו ינמ יבילת תירכו כלה ר לכ היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan menentukan tempat bagi umat-Ku Israel dan akan menanamkannya, sehingga ia dapat diam di tempatnya sendiri dengan tidak lagi dikejutkan dan tidak pula ditekan oleh orang-orang lalim seperti dahulu,
scripture_data.text_en: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
scripture_data.text_orig: הנר ר תבל הלוינב פיסילו ד זרי לו ויח כו הינ לרי יל קמ ימו

scripture_data.text_id: sejak Aku mengangkat hakim-hakim atas umat-Ku Israel. Aku akan menundukkan segala musuhmu. Juga Aku beritahukan kepadamu: TUHAN akan membangun suatu keturunan bagimu.
scripture_data.text_en: And since the time that I commanded judges [to be] over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the LORD will build thee an house.

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila umurmu sudah genap untuk pergi mengikuti nenek moyangmu, maka Aku akan membangkitkan keturunanmu yang kemudian, salah seorang anakmu sendiri, dan Aku akan mengokohkan kerajaannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go [to be] with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

scripture_data.text_id: Dialah yang akan mendirikan rumah bagi-Ku dan Aku akan mengokohkan takhtanya untuk selama-lamanya.

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan menjadi Bapanya, dan ia akan menjadi anak-Ku. Tetapi kasih setia-Ku tidak akan Kuhilangkan dari padanya seperti yang Kuhilangkan dari pada orang yang mendahului engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took [it] from [him] that was before thee:

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Aku akan menegakkan dia dalam rumah-Ku dan dalam kerajaan-Ku untuk selama-lamanya dan takhtanya akan kokoh untuk selama-lamanya."
scripture_data.text_en: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.

scripture_data.text_id: Tepat seperti perkataan ini dan tepat seperti penglihatan ini Natan berbicara kepada Daud.
scripture_data.text_en: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף דיול תנ ר הה זחה לככ הה ירבה לכ

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu masuklah raja Daud ke dalam, kemudian duduklah ia di hadapan TUHAN sambil berkata: "Siapakah aku ini, ya TUHAN Allah, dan siapakah keluargaku, sehingga Engkau membawa aku sampai sedemikian ini?
scripture_data.text_en: And David the king came and sat before the LORD, and said, Who [am] I, O LORD God, and what [is] mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
scripture_data.text_orig: להד ינתיבה י יתיב ימ יהל הוהי ינימ רמו הוהי ינפל בו דיו לה בו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan hal ini masih kurang di mata-Mu, ya Allah; sebab itu Engkau telah berfirman juga tentang keluarga hamba-Mu ini dalam masa yang masih jauh dan telah memperlihatkan kepadaku serentetan manusia yang akan datang, ya TUHAN Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: And [yet] this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast [also] spoken of thy servant's house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O LORD God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל הוהי הלה דה רת ינתיר קחרמל בתיל רדו יהל יני תז קו

scripture_data.text_id: Apakah lagi yang dapat ditambahkan Daud kepada-Mu dalam hal Engkau memuliakan hamba-Mu ini? Bukankah Engkau yang mengenal hamba-Mu ini?
scripture_data.text_en: What can David [speak] more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
scripture_data.text_orig: די בת הו בת דבכל יל דיו ד יסהם

scripture_data.text_id: Ya TUHAN, oleh karena hamba-Mu ini dan menurut hati-Mu Engkau telah melakukan segala perkara yang besar ini dengan memberitahukan segala perkara yang besar itu.
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD, for thy servant's sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all [these] great things.
scripture_data.text_orig: תדהלת ידהל תה הדהל ת תי לכ ב רב הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Ya TUHAN, tidak ada yang sama seperti Engkau dan tidak ada Allah selain Engkau menurut segala yang kami tangkap dengan telinga kami.
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD, [there is] none like thee, neither [is there any] God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
scripture_data.text_orig: נינז נמר לכ תלז יהל יו מ י הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Dan bangsa manakah di bumi seperti umat-Mu Israel, yang Allahnya pergi membebaskannya menjadi umat-Nya, untuk mendapat nama bagi-Mu dengan perbuatan-perbuatan yang besar dan dahsyat, dan dengan menghalau bangsa-bangsa dari depan umat-Mu yang telah Kaubebaskan dari Mesir?
scripture_data.text_en: And what one nation in the earth [is] like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem [to be] his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
scripture_data.text_orig: י ירצמ תידר ינמ רגל תרנו תד ל ל ל תפל יהלה לה ר שר דח י לרי ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau telah membuat umat-Mu Israel menjadi umat-Mu untuk selama-lamanya dan Engkau, ya TUHAN, menjadi Allah mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, LORD, becamest their God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל הל תייה הוהי הו לד ל ל לרי ת ו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan sekarang, ya TUHAN, diteguhkanlah untuk selama-lamanya janji yang Kauucapkan mengenai hamba-Mu ini dan mengenai keluarganya dan lakukanlah seperti yang Kaujanjikan itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore now, LORD, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.

scripture_data.text_id: Maka nama-Mu akan menjadi teguh dan besar untuk selama-lamanya, sehingga orang berkata: TUHAN semesta alam, Allah Israel adalah Allah bagi orang Israel; maka keluarga hamba-Mu Daud akan tetap kokoh di hadapan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The LORD of hosts [is] the God of Israel, [even] a God to Israel: and [let] the house of David thy servant [be] established before thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינפל כנ ב דיותיב לריל יהל לרי יהל תבץ הוהי רמל לד מ לגיו מיו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkau, ya Allahku, telah menyatakan kepada hamba-Mu ini, bahwa Engkau akan membangun keturunan baginya. Itulah sebabnya hamba-Mu ini telah memberanikan diri untuk memanjatkan doa ke hadapan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found [in his heart] to pray before thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינפל לתהל ב צמ ל תי ל תנבל ב זת תיל יהל ה י

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, ya TUHAN, Engkaulah Allah dan telah menjanjikan perkara yang baik ini kepada hamba-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: And now, LORD, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
scripture_data.text_orig: תה הבה בל רדו יהלה הה הוהי הו

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya Engkau sekarang berkenan memberkati keluarga hamba-Mu ini, supaya tetap ada di hadapan-Mu untuk selama-lamanya. Sebab apa yang Engkau berkati, ya TUHAN, diberkati untuk selama-lamanya."
scripture_data.text_en: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O LORD, and [it shall be] blessed for ever.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu Daud memukul kalah orang Filistin dan menundukkan mereka; lalu ia merebut Gat dan segala anak kotanya dari tangan orang Filistin.
scripture_data.text_en: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

scripture_data.text_id: Selanjutnya Daud memukul kalah Hadadezer, raja Zoba, dekat Hamat, ketika ia pergi menegakkan kekuasaannya pada sungai Efrat.
scripture_data.text_en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

scripture_data.text_id: Daud merebut dari padanya seribu kereta, tujuh ribu orang pasukan berkuda dan dua puluh ribu orang pasukan berjalan kaki, lalu Daud menyuruh memotong urat keting segala kuda kereta, tetapi dengan meninggalkan seratus ekor kuda kereta.
scripture_data.text_en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot [horses], but reserved of them an hundred chariots.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu orang Aram dari Damsyik datang menolong Hadadezer, raja Zoba, tetapi dari antara orang Aram itu Daud menewaskan dua puluh dua ribu orang.
scripture_data.text_en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian Daud menempatkan pasukan-pasukan pendudukan di daerah orang Aram dari Damsyik, dan orang Aram itu menjadi budak Daud yang harus mempersembahkan upeti. TUHAN memberi kemenangan kepada Daud ke manapun ia pergi berperang.
scripture_data.text_en: Then David put [garrisons] in Syriadamascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, [and] brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.

scripture_data.text_en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan dari Tibhat dan dari Kun, yaitu kota-kotanya Hadadezer, Daud mengangkut amat banyak tembaga; dari padanya Salomo membuat "laut" tembaga, tiang-tiang dan perlengkapan tembaga.
scripture_data.text_en: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika didengar Tou, raja Hamat, bahwa Daud telah memukul kalah seluruh tentara Hadadezer, raja Zoba,
scripture_data.text_en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;

scripture_data.text_id: maka ia mengutus Hadoram, anaknya, kepada raja Daud untuk menyampaikan salam dan mengucapkan selamat kepadanya, karena ia telah berperang melawan Hadadezer dan memukul dia kalah, sebab Hadadezer sering memerangi Tou. Dan Hadoram membawa pelbagai barang-barang emas, perak dan tembaga.
scripture_data.text_en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and [with him] all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.

scripture_data.text_en: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.

scripture_data.text_id: Selanjutnya untuk ibadah Daud dan para panglima menunjuk anak-anak Asaf, anak-anak Heman dan anak-anak Yedutun. Mereka bernubuat dengan diiringi kecapi, gambus dan ceracap. Daftar orang-orang yang bekerja dalam ibadah ini ialah yang berikut:
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:

scripture_data.text_en: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.

scripture_data.text_en: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka ini sekalian adalah anak-anak Heman, pelihat raja, menurut janji Allah untuk meninggikan tanduk kekuatannya; sebab Allah telah memberikan kepada Heman empat belas orang anak laki-laki dan tiga orang anak perempuan.
scripture_data.text_en: All these [were] the sons of Heman the king's seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תנב ר הר ינ מיהל יהלה ו רק ירהל יהלה ירבד לה הזח מיהל ינב הל

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka ini sekalian berada di bawah pimpinan ayah mereka pada waktu menyanyikan nyanyian di rumah TUHAN dengan diiringi ceracap, gambus dan kecapi untuk ibadah di rumah Allah dengan petunjuk raja. Demikianlah keadaan bani Asaf, Yedutun dan Heman.
scripture_data.text_en: All these [were] under the hands of their father for song [in] the house of the LORD, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king's order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
scripture_data.text_orig: מיהו תדיו ס ס לה ידי ל יהלה תי תדבל תרכו ילבן ילצמ הוהי תי רי היב ידיל הל

scripture_data.text_id: Bagi Semaya, anak Obed-Edom itu, lahir anak-anak. Mereka memegang pemerintahan di antara puak mereka, sebab mereka itu adalah pahlawan-pahlawan yang gagah perkasa.
scripture_data.text_en: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they [were] mighty men of valour.

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak Semaya ialah Otni, Refael, Obed dan Elzabad serta saudara-saudaranya, yakni Elihu dan Semakhya, orang-orang gagah perkasa.
scripture_data.text_en: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren [were] strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka sekalian adalah dari keturunan Obed-Edom, yakni mereka sendiri, anak-anak mereka dan saudara-saudara mereka, masing-masing orang yang gagah perkasa, cakap untuk pekerjaan itu, enam puluh dua orang jumlahnya dari Obed-Edom.

scripture_data.text_en: [And] of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, [were] officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the LORD, and in the service of the king.

scripture_data.text_id: Dari orang Hebron adalah Yeria yang menjadi kepala. Tentang orang Hebron, mengenai keturunannya dan puaknya, dalam tahun keempat puluh zaman pemerintahan Daud diadakan penyelidikan tentang mereka dan ternyata, bahwa di antara mereka ada pahlawan-pahlawan yang gagah perkasa di Yaezer-Gilead.
scripture_data.text_en: Among the Hebronites [was] Jerijah the chief, [even] among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.

scripture_data.text_id: Sanak saudara Yeria, orang-orang yang gagah perkasa, kepala-kepala puak ada dua ribu tujuh ratus orang. Mereka itu diangkat raja Daud mengawasi orang Ruben, orang Gad dan suku Manasye yang setengah itu dalam segala perkara untuk Allah dan segala perkara untuk raja.
scripture_data.text_en: And his brethren, men of valour, [were] two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun orang Israel, inilah daftar para kepala puak, para panglima pasukan seribu dan pasukan seratus dan para pengatur yang melayani raja dalam segala hal mengenai rombongan orang-orang yang bertugas dan libur, bulan demi bulan, sepanjang tahun. Setiap rombongan berjumlah dua puluh empat ribu orang.
scripture_data.text_en: Now the children of Israel after their number, [to wit], the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang mengepalai rombongan bulan yang kedua ialah Dodai, orang Ahohi, sedang pemimpin rombongannya yang berjumlah dua puluh empat ribu orang, adalah Miklot.
scripture_data.text_en: And over the course of the second month [was] Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course [was] Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_id: Panglima yang ketiga untuk bulan yang ketiga ialah Benaya, anak imam kepala Yoyada, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.
scripture_data.text_en: The third captain of the host for the third month [was] Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang keempat untuk bulan yang keempat ialah Asael, saudara Yoab, kemudian ia digantikan oleh Zebaja, anaknya, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.
scripture_data.text_en: The fourth [captain] for the fourth month [was] Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_en: The fifth captain for the fifth month [was] Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang ketujuh untuk bulan yang ketujuh ialah Heles, orang Peloni, dari bani Efraim, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang kedelapan untuk bulan yang kedelapan ialah Sibkhai, orang Husa dari orang Zerah itu, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.
scripture_data.text_en: The eighth [captain] for the eighth month [was] Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang kesembilan untuk bulan yang kesembilan ialah Abiezer, orang Anatot itu, dari bani Benyamin, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.
scripture_data.text_en: The ninth [captain] for the ninth month [was] Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang kesepuluh untuk bulan yang kesepuluh ialah Maharai, orang Netofa dari orang Zerah itu, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang kesebelas untuk bulan yang kesebelas ialah Benaya, orang Piraton, dari bani Efraim, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.
scripture_data.text_en: The eleventh [captain] for the eleventh month [was] Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course [were] twenty and four thousand.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang kedua belas untuk bulan yang kedua belas ialah Heldai, orang Netofa itu, keturunan Otniel, dan dalam rombongannya ada dua puluh empat ribu orang.
