scripture_data.text_en: Who provideth for the raven his food? when his young ones cry unto God, they wander for lack of meat.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכילבל תי י לל וידלי ודליי דיצ ברל יכי ימ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-4) Apakah engkau mengetahui waktunya kambing gunung beranak, atau mengamat-amati rusa waktu sakit beranak?
scripture_data.text_en: Knowest thou the time when the wild goats of the rock bring forth? [or] canst thou mark when the hinds do calve?
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ תל ללח לסילי תדל ת דיה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-5) Dapatkah engkau menghitung berapa lamanya sampai genap bulannya, dan mengetahui waktunya beranak?
scripture_data.text_en: Canst thou number the months [that] they fulfil? or knowest thou the time when they bring forth?
scripture_data.text_orig: הנדל ת דיו הנמ יחרי רס

scripture_data.text_id: (39-6) Dengan membungkukkan diri mereka melahirkan anak-anaknya, dan mengeluarkan isi kandungannya.
scripture_data.text_en: They bow themselves, they bring forth their young ones, they cast out their sorrows.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנח הילבח הנחפ הידלי הנרכ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-7) Anak-anaknya menjadi kuat dan besar di padang, mereka pergi dan tidak kembali lagi kepada induknya.
scripture_data.text_en: Their young ones are in good liking, they grow up with corn; they go forth, and return not unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל בלו צי רב רי הינב מלחי

scripture_data.text_id: (39-8) Siapakah yang mengumbar keledai liar, atau siapakah yang membuka tali tambatan keledai jalang?
scripture_data.text_en: Who hath sent out the wild ass free? or who hath loosed the bands of the wild ass?
scripture_data.text_orig: חפ ימ דר תרסמ יפח ר חימ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-9) Kepadanya telah Kuberikan tanah dataran sebagai tempat kediamannya dan padang masin sebagai tempat tinggalnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Whose house I have made the wilderness, and the barren land his dwellings.
scripture_data.text_orig: החלם ויתנמ תיב הבר ימר

scripture_data.text_id: (39-10) Ia menertawakan keramaian kota, tidak mendengarkan teriak si penggiring;
scripture_data.text_en: He scorneth the multitude of the city, neither regardeth he the crying of the driver.
scripture_data.text_orig: מי ל גנ ת הירק מהל קחי

scripture_data.text_id: (39-11) ia menjelajah gunung-gunung padang rumputnya, dan mencari apa saja yang hijau.
scripture_data.text_en: The range of the mountains [is] his pasture, and he searcheth after every green thing.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדי קריל רחו הרמ ירה רתי

scripture_data.text_id: (39-12) Apakah lembu hutan mau takluk kepadamu, atau bermalam dekat palunganmu?
scripture_data.text_en: Will the unicorn be willing to serve thee, or abide by thy crib?
scripture_data.text_orig: סבל ילי דב י הביה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-13) Dapatkah engkau memaksa lembu hutan mengikuti alur bajak dengan keluan, atau apakah ia akan menyisir tanah lembah mengikuti engkau?
scripture_data.text_en: Canst thou bind the unicorn with his band in the furrow? or will he harrow the valleys after thee?
scripture_data.text_orig: ירח יקמ די תב לת יררקתה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-14) Percayakah engkau kepadanya, karena kekuatannya sangat besar? Atau kauserahkankah kepadanya pekerjaanmu yang berat?
scripture_data.text_en: Wilt thou trust him, because his strength [is] great? or wilt thou leave thy labour to him?
scripture_data.text_orig: יגי ויל בזתו ח ברי חבתה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-15) Apakah engkau menaruh kepercayaan kepadanya, bahwa ia akan membawa pulang hasil tanahmu, dan mengumpulkannya di tempat pengirikanmu?
scripture_data.text_en: Wilt thou believe him, that he will bring home thy seed, and gather [it into] thy barn?
scripture_data.text_orig: סי נרגו רז ביי ביי ימתה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-16) Dengan riang sayap burung unta berkepak-kepak, tetapi apakah kepak dan bulu itu menaruh kasih sayang?
scripture_data.text_en: [Gavest thou] the goodly wings unto the peacocks? or wings and feathers unto the ostrich?
scripture_data.text_orig: הצנו הדיסח הרב הסלן יננרנ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-17) Sebab telurnya ditinggalkannya di tanah, dan dibiarkannya menjadi panas di dalam pasir,
scripture_data.text_en: Which leaveth her eggs in the earth, and warmeth them in dust,
scripture_data.text_orig: ח רפלו היצ שרל בזתי

scripture_data.text_id: (39-18) tetapi lupa, bahwa telur itu dapat terpijak kaki, dan diinjak-injak oleh binatang-binatang liar.
scripture_data.text_en: And forgetteth that the foot may crush them, or that the wild beast may break them.
scripture_data.text_orig: הד הדה תחו הרז לגרי חו

scripture_data.text_id: (39-19) Ia memperlakukan anak-anaknya dengan keras seolah-olah bukan anaknya sendiri; ia tidak peduli, kalau jerih payahnya sia-sia,
scripture_data.text_en: She is hardened against her young ones, as though [they were] not hers: her labour is in vain without fear;
scripture_data.text_orig: דחפיל יגי קירל לל הינ חיקה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-20) karena Allah tidak memberikannya hikmat, dan tidak membagikan pengertian kepadanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Because God hath deprived her of wisdom, neither hath he imparted to her understanding.
scripture_data.text_orig: הני ל קלחלו המכח ל הי

scripture_data.text_id: (39-21) Apabila ia dengan megah mengepakkan sayapnya, maka ia menertawakan kuda dan penunggangnya.
scripture_data.text_en: What time she lifteth up herself on high, she scorneth the horse and his rider.
scripture_data.text_orig: בכרל סל קח ירמ ר ת

scripture_data.text_id: (39-22) Engkaukah yang memberi tenaga kepada kuda? Engkaukah yang mengenakan surai pada tengkuknya?
scripture_data.text_en: Hast thou given the horse strength? hast thou clothed his neck with thunder?
scripture_data.text_orig: המר רץ ילתה הרב סל תה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-23) Engkaukah yang membuat dia melompat seperti belalang? Ringkiknya yang dahsyat mengerikan.
scripture_data.text_en: Canst thou make him afraid as a grasshopper? the glory of his nostrils [is] terrible.
scripture_data.text_orig: המי רחן דה הר ירתה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-24) Ia menggaruk tanah lembah dengan gembira, dengan kekuatan ia maju menghadapi senjata.
scripture_data.text_en: He paweth in the valley, and rejoiceth in [his] strength: he goeth on to meet the armed men.
scripture_data.text_orig: קנתרקל צי חכ ייו קמב רחי

scripture_data.text_id: (39-25) Kedahsyatan ditertawakannya, ia tidak pernah kecut hati, dan ia pantang mundur menghadapi pedang.
scripture_data.text_en: He mocketh at fear, and is not affrighted; neither turneth he back from the sword.
scripture_data.text_orig: ברחינמ בילו תחי לו דחפל קחי

scripture_data.text_id: (39-26) Di atas dia tabung panah gemerencing, tombak dan lembing gemerlapan;
scripture_data.text_en: The quiver rattleth against him, the glittering spear and the shield.
scripture_data.text_orig: דיכו תינח בהל ה הנר ויל

scripture_data.text_id: (39-27) dengan garang dan galak dilulurnya tanah, dan ia meronta-ronta kalau kedengaran bunyi sangkakala;
scripture_data.text_en: He swalloweth the ground with fierceness and rage: neither believeth he that [it is] the sound of the trumpet.
scripture_data.text_orig: רפ לקי ימילו שרגי זגרו ר

scripture_data.text_id: (39-28) ia meringkik setiap kali sangkakala ditiup; dan dari jauh sudah diciumnya perang, gertak para panglima dan pekik.
scripture_data.text_en: He saith among the trumpets, Ha, ha; and he smelleth the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרת יר ר המחלמ חירי קחרמ חה רמי רפ יד

scripture_data.text_id: (39-29) Oleh pengertianmukah burung elang terbang, mengembangkan sayapnya menuju ke selatan?
scripture_data.text_en: Doth the hawk fly by thy wisdom, [and] stretch her wings toward the south?
scripture_data.text_orig: מיתל ויפנ ופנ רפי שנרבי תנימה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-30) Atas perintahmukah rajawali terbang membubung, dan membuat sarangnya di tempat yang tinggi?
scripture_data.text_en: Doth the eagle mount up at thy command, and make her nest on high?
scripture_data.text_orig: ק ירי יכו רנ יגי יל

scripture_data.text_id: (39-31) Ia diam dan bersarang di bukit batu, di puncak bukit batu dan di gunung yang sulit didatangi.
scripture_data.text_en: She dwelleth and abideth on the rock, upon the crag of the rock, and the strong place.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדצמ לסל נלתיו י לס

scripture_data.text_id: (39-32) Dari sana ia mengintai mencari mangsa, dari jauh matanya mengamat-amati;
scripture_data.text_en: From thence she seeketh the prey, [and] her eyes behold afar off.
scripture_data.text_orig: יי ויני קחרמל לכרפח מ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-33) anak-anaknya menghirup darah, dan di mana ada yang tewas, di situlah dia."
scripture_data.text_en: Her young ones also suck up blood: and where the slain [are], there [is] she.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ה יללח רב דלי ויחרפו וחרפו

scripture_data.text_id: (39-34) Maka jawab TUHAN kepada Ayub:
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover the LORD answered Job, and said,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמו בת הוהי ו

scripture_data.text_id: (39-35) "Apakah si pengecam hendak berbantah dengan Yang Mahakuasa? Hendaklah yang mencela Allah menjawab!"
scripture_data.text_en: Shall he that contendeth with the Almighty instruct [him]? he that reproveth God, let him answer it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הני ל חיכם רי י ברה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-36) Maka jawab Ayub kepada TUHAN:
scripture_data.text_en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמו הוהית ב ו

scripture_data.text_id: (39-37) "Sesungguhnya, aku ini terlalu hina; jawab apakah yang dapat kuberikan kepada-Mu? Mulutku kututup dengan tangan.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, I am vile; what shall I answer thee? I will lay mine hand upon my mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפמל ימ ידי שבי המ יתק ה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-38) Satu kali aku berbicara, tetapi tidak akan kuulangi; bahkan dua kali, tetapi tidak akan kulanjutkan."
scripture_data.text_en: Once have I spoken; but I will not answer: yea, twice; but I will proceed no further.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף יס לו י הנ לו יר תח

scripture_data.text_id: (40-1) Maka dari dalam badai TUHAN menjawab Ayub:
scripture_data.text_en: Then answered the LORD unto Job out of the whirlwind, and said,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמו הרס מ הרס מ בת הוהיו

scripture_data.text_id: (40-2) "Bersiaplah engkau sebagai laki-laki; Aku akan menanyai engkau, dan engkau memberitahu Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Gird up thy loins now like a man: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינידהו ל יצלח רבגך נרז

scripture_data.text_id: (40-3) Apakah engkau hendak meniadakan pengadilan-Ku, mempersalahkan Aku supaya engkau dapat membenarkan dirimu?
scripture_data.text_en: Wilt thou also disannul my judgment? wilt thou condemn me, that thou mayest be righteous?
scripture_data.text_orig: קצ מל יניר ימ רפ ה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-4) Apakah lenganmu seperti lengan Allah, dan dapatkah engkau mengguntur seperti Dia?
scripture_data.text_en: Hast thou an arm like God? or canst thou thunder with a voice like him?
scripture_data.text_orig: רת המ לקב ל ל רזו

scripture_data.text_id: (40-5) Hiasilah dirimu dengan kemegahan dan keluhuran, kenakanlah keagungan dan semarak!
scripture_data.text_en: Deck thyself now [with] majesty and excellency; and array thyself with glory and beauty.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל רדהו דהו בגו ג נ הד

scripture_data.text_id: (40-6) Luapkanlah marahmu yang bergelora; amat-amatilah setiap orang yang congkak dan rendahkanlah dia!
scripture_data.text_en: Cast abroad the rage of thy wrath: and behold every one [that is] proud, and abase him.
scripture_data.text_orig: הליהו הלכ הר תרב שפה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-7) Amat-amatilah setiap orang yang congkak, tundukkanlah dia, dan hancurkanlah orang-orang fasik di tempatnya!
scripture_data.text_en: Look on every one [that is] proud, [and] bring him low; and tread down the wicked in their place.
scripture_data.text_orig: ח יר דהו הינכה הלכ הר

scripture_data.text_id: (40-8) Pendamlah mereka bersama-sama dalam debu, kurunglah mereka di tempat yang tersembunyi.
scripture_data.text_en: Hide them in the dust together; [and] bind their faces in secret.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ בח הינ דחי רפ נמ

scripture_data.text_id: (40-9) Maka Akupun akan memuji engkau, karena tangan kananmu memberi engkau kemenangan."
scripture_data.text_en: Then will I also confess unto thee that thine own right hand can save thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימי ל תי שד ינגו

scripture_data.text_id: (40-10) "Perhatikanlah kuda Nil, yang telah Kubuat seperti juga engkau. Ia makan rumput seperti lembu.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold now behemoth, which I made with thee; he eateth grass as an ox.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכי רק ריצח יתיר תמהב נהה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-11) Perhatikanlah tenaga di pinggangnya, kekuatan pada urat-urat perutnya!
scripture_data.text_en: Lo now, his strength [is] in his loins, and his force [is] in the navel of his belly.
scripture_data.text_orig: נב יריר נו וינתמב חכ נהה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-12) Ia meregangkan ekornya seperti pohon aras, otot-otot pahanya berjalin-jalinan.
scripture_data.text_en: He moveth his tail like a cedar: the sinews of his stones are wrapped together.
scripture_data.text_orig: גרי וידחפ ודחפ ידי זרמך בנז שחי

scripture_data.text_id: (40-13) Tulang-tulangnya seperti pembuluh tembaga, kerangkanya seperti batang besi.
scripture_data.text_en: His bones [are as] strong pieces of brass; his bones [are] like bars of iron.
scripture_data.text_orig: לזר לימ וימר החן יקיפ וימצ

scripture_data.text_id: (40-14) Dia yang pertama dibuat Allah, makhluk yang diberi-Nya bersenjatakan pedang;
scripture_data.text_en: He [is] the chief of the ways of God: he that made him can make his sword to approach [unto him].
scripture_data.text_orig: רח י ה ליכר תיר ה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-15) ya, bukit-bukit mengeluarkan hasil baginya, di mana binatang-binatang liar bermain-main.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely the mountains bring him forth food, where all the beasts of the field play.
scripture_data.text_orig: קחי הדה תחלכו לי ירה לבי

scripture_data.text_id: (40-16) Di bawah tumbuhan teratai ia menderum, tersembunyi dalam gelagah dan paya.
scripture_data.text_en: He lieth under the shady trees, in the covert of the reed, and fens.
scripture_data.text_orig: הב הנק רתס בי ילצתח

scripture_data.text_id: (40-17) Tumbuhan-tumbuhan teratai menaungi dia dengan bayang-bayangnya, pohon-pohon gandarusa mengelilinginya.
scripture_data.text_en: The shady trees cover him [with] their shadow; the willows of the brook compass him about.
scripture_data.text_orig: לחניבר הסי ללצ ילץ הסי

scripture_data.text_id: (40-18) Sesungguhnya, biarpun sungai sangat kuat arusnya, ia tidak gentar; ia tetap tenang, biarpun sungai Yordan meluap melanda mulutnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, he drinketh up a river, [and] hasteth not: he trusteth that he can draw up Jordan into his mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: היל רי חיגיי חבי זחי ל רהנ קי ה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-19) Dapatkah orang menangkap dia dari muka, mencocok hidungnya dengan keluan?"
scripture_data.text_en: He taketh it with his eyes: [his] nose pierceth through snares.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקני יקמ חי ויני

scripture_data.text_id: (40-20) "Dapatkah engkau menarik buaya dengan kail, atau mengimpit lidahnya dengan tali?
scripture_data.text_en: Canst thou draw out leviathan with an hook? or his tongue with a cord [which] thou lettest down?
scripture_data.text_orig: לי וירמל גה הבזכנ לחה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-21) Dapatkah engkau mengenakan tali rotan pada hidungnya, mencocok rahangnya dengan kaitan?
scripture_data.text_en: Canst thou put an hook into his nose? or bore his jaw through with a thorn?
scripture_data.text_orig: ביתי ינפל ה ימ רי י רזכל

scripture_data.text_id: (40-22) Mungkinkah ia mengajukan banyak permohonan belas kasihan kepadamu, atau berbicara dengan lemah lembut kepadamu?
scripture_data.text_en: Will he make many supplications unto thee? will he speak soft [words] unto thee?
scripture_data.text_orig: היל ימהל תח ו ינמיקה ימ

scripture_data.text_id: (40-23) Mungkinkah ia mengikat perjanjian dengan engkau, sehingga engkau mengambil dia menjadi hamba untuk selama-lamanya?
scripture_data.text_en: Will he make a covenant with thee? wilt thou take him for a servant for ever?
scripture_data.text_orig: ר יחו תרברבד וי ירחלל

scripture_data.text_id: (40-24) Dapatkah engkau bermain-main dengan dia seperti dengan burung, dan mengikat dia untuk anak-anakmu perempuan?
scripture_data.text_en: Wilt thou play with him as [with] a bird? or wilt thou bind him for thy maidens?
scripture_data.text_orig: בי ימ נסר לפכ בל ינ הגימ

scripture_data.text_id: (40-25) Mungkinkah kawan-kawan nelayan memperdagangkan dia, atau membagi-bagikan dia di antara pedagang-pedagang?
scripture_data.text_en: Shall the companions make a banquet of him? shall they part him among the merchants?
scripture_data.text_orig: המי וי תביבס חפ ימ וינפ יתל

scripture_data.text_id: (40-26) Dapatkah engkau menusuki kulitnya dengan serampang, dan kepalanya dengan tempuling?
scripture_data.text_en: Canst thou fill his skin with barbed irons? or his head with fish spears?
scripture_data.text_orig: רצ תח רגס יגמ יקיפ הו

scripture_data.text_id: (40-27) Letakkan tanganmu ke atasnya! Ingatlah pertarungannya! Engkau takkan melakukannya lagi!
scripture_data.text_en: Lay thine hand upon him, remember the battle, do no more.
scripture_data.text_orig: היניב ביל חרו י דח דח

scripture_data.text_id: (40-28) Sesungguhnya, harapanmu hampa! Baru saja melihat dia, orang sudah terbanting.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, the hope of him is in vain: shall not [one] be cast down even at the sight of him?
scripture_data.text_orig: דרתי לו דלתי קדי היחי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-1) Orang yang nekatpun takkan berani membangkitkan marahnya. Siapakah yang dapat bertahan di hadapan Aku?
scripture_data.text_en: None [is so] fierce that dare stir him up: who then is able to stand before me?
scripture_data.text_orig: רחיפ ויניו ר לה ויתי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-2) Siapakah yang menghadapi Aku, yang Kubiarkan tetap selamat? Apa yang ada di seluruh kolong langit, adalah kepunyaan-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: Who hath prevented me, that I should repay [him? whatsoever is] under the whole heaven is mine.
scripture_data.text_orig: מתי ידדי כלהי ידיל וימ

scripture_data.text_id: (41-3) Aku tidak akan berdiam diri tentang anggota-anggota badannya, tentang keperkasaannya dan perawakannya yang tampan.
scripture_data.text_en: I will not conceal his parts, nor his power, nor his comely proportion.
scripture_data.text_orig: מגו חפנ דד צי ויריחמ

scripture_data.text_id: (41-4) Siapakah dapat menyingkapkan pakaian luarnya? Baju zirahnya yang berlapis dua, siapakah dapat menembusnya?
scripture_data.text_en: Who can discover the face of his garment? [or] who can come [to him] with his double bridle?
scripture_data.text_orig: צי וימ בהלו הל ילח פנ

scripture_data.text_id: (41-5) Siapa dapat membuka pintu moncongnya? Di sekeliling giginya ada kengerian.
scripture_data.text_en: Who can open the doors of his face? his teeth [are] terrible round about.
scripture_data.text_orig: הב שד וינפל ז ילי רצ

scripture_data.text_id: (41-6) Punggungnya adalah perisai-perisai yang bersusun, terlekat rapat seperti meterai.
scripture_data.text_en: [His] scales [are his] pride, shut up together [as with] a close seal.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ויל קצי קבד רב ילם

scripture_data.text_id: (41-7) Rapat hubungannya yang satu dengan yang lain, sehingga angin tidak dapat masuk;
scripture_data.text_en: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיח חלפ קציו במ קצי ל

scripture_data.text_id: (41-8) yang satu melekat pada yang lain, bertautan tak terceraikan lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: They are joined one to another, they stick together, that they cannot be sundered.
scripture_data.text_orig: חתי ירבמ יל רגי תמ

scripture_data.text_id: (41-9) Bersinnya menyinarkan cahaya, matanya laksana merekahnya fajar.
scripture_data.text_en: By his neesings a light doth shine, and his eyes [are] like the eyelids of the morning.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירו ם תינח קת יל ברח הגים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-10) Dari dalam mulutnya keluar suluh, dan berpancaran bunga api.
scripture_data.text_en: Out of his mouth go burning lamps, [and] sparks of fire leap out.
scripture_data.text_orig: החן בר של לזר בתל בחי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-11) Dari dalam lubang hidungnya mengepul uap bagaikan dari dalam belanga yang mendidih dan menggelegak isinya.
scripture_data.text_en: Out of his nostrils goeth smoke, as [out] of a seething pot or caldron.
scripture_data.text_orig: לקינב לכהן קל תקב חירביל

scripture_data.text_id: (41-12) Nafasnya menyalakan bara, dan nyala api keluar dari dalam mulutnya.
scripture_data.text_en: His breath kindleth coals, and a flame goeth out of his mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: די רל קחיו חתת בחן ק

scripture_data.text_id: (41-13) Di dalam tengkuknya ada kekuatan; ketakutan berlompatan di hadapannya.
scripture_data.text_en: In his neck remaineth strength, and sorrow is turned into joy before him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ייל שרח דרי רח ידח ויח

scripture_data.text_id: (41-14) Daging gelambirnya berlekatan, melekat padanya, tidak tergerak.
scripture_data.text_en: The flakes of his flesh are joined together: they are firm in themselves; they cannot be moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: החקר יי י הלצם רי חירי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-15) Hatinya keras seperti batu, keras seperti batu kilangan bawah.
scripture_data.text_en: His heart is as firm as a stone; yea, as hard as a piece of the nether [millstone].
scripture_data.text_orig: הביל ה בחי ביתנ ריי וירח

scripture_data.text_id: (41-16) Bila ia bangkit, maka semua yang berkuasa menjadi gentar, menjadi bingung karena ketakutan.
scripture_data.text_en: When he raiseth up himself, the mighty are afraid: by reason of breakings they purify themselves.
scripture_data.text_orig: תחילבל ה למ רפלי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-17) Bila ia diserang dengan pedang, ia tidak mempan, demikian juga dengan tombak, seligi atau lembing.
scripture_data.text_en: The sword of him that layeth at him cannot hold: the spear, the dart, nor the habergeon.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שחינלל למ ה הרי בלת

scripture_data.text_id: (41-18) Besi dirasanya seperti jerami, tembaga seperti kayu lapuk.
scripture_data.text_en: He esteemeth iron as straw, [and] brass as rotten wood.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-19) Anak panah tidak dapat menghalau dia, batu umban seolah-olah berubah padanya menjadi jerami.
scripture_data.text_en: The arrow cannot make him flee: slingstones are turned with him into stubble.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-20) Gada dianggapnya jerami dan ia menertawakan desingan lembing.
scripture_data.text_en: Darts are counted as stubble: he laugheth at the shaking of a spear.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-21) Pada bagian bawahnya ada tembikar yang runcing; ia membujur di atas lumpur seperti pengeretan pengirik.
scripture_data.text_en: Sharp stones [are] under him: he spreadeth sharp pointed things upon the mire.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-22) Lubuk dibuatnya berbual-bual seperti periuk, laut dijadikannya tempat memasak campuran rempah-rempah.
scripture_data.text_en: He maketh the deep to boil like a pot: he maketh the sea like a pot of ointment.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-23) Ia meninggalkan jejak yang bercahaya, sehingga samudera raya disangka orang rambut putih.
scripture_data.text_en: He maketh a path to shine after him; [one] would think the deep [to be] hoary.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-24) Tidak ada taranya di atas bumi; itulah makhluk yang tidak mengenal takut.
scripture_data.text_en: Upon earth there is not his like, who is made without fear.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (41-25) Segala yang tinggi takut kepadanya; ia adalah raja atas segala binatang yang ganas."
scripture_data.text_en: He beholdeth all high [things]: he [is] a king over all the children of pride.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Maka jawab Ayub kepada TUHAN:
scripture_data.text_en: Then Job answered the LORD, and said,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמו הוהית ב ו

scripture_data.text_id: "Aku tahu, bahwa Engkau sanggup melakukan segala sesuatu, dan tidak ada rencana-Mu yang gagal.
scripture_data.text_en: I know that thou canst do every [thing], and [that] no thought can be withholden from thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: הזם מ רצילו לכ לכי ידי די

scripture_data.text_id: Firman-Mu: Siapakah dia yang menyelubungi keputusan tanpa pengetahuan? Itulah sebabnya, tanpa pengertian aku telah bercerita tentang hal-hal yang sangat ajaib bagiku dan yang tidak kuketahui.
scripture_data.text_en: Who [is] he that hideth counsel without knowledge? therefore have I uttered that I understood not; things too wonderful for me, which I knew not.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד לו ימ תלפנ יב לו ידה כל תד יל הצ ילם הז ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Firman-Mu: Dengarlah, maka Akulah yang akan berfirman; Aku akan menanyai engkau, supaya engkau memberitahu Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Hear, I beseech thee, and I will speak: I will demand of thee, and declare thou unto me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינידהו ל רד יכנו נמ

scripture_data.text_id: Hanya dari kata orang saja aku mendengar tentang Engkau, tetapi sekarang mataku sendiri memandang Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: I have heard of thee by the hearing of the ear: but now mine eye seeth thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: תר יני הו ימ זמל

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu aku mencabut perkataanku dan dengan menyesal aku duduk dalam debu dan abu."
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore I abhor [myself], and repent in dust and ashes.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף רפו רפל ימחנו סמ ל

scripture_data.text_id: Setelah TUHAN mengucapkan firman itu kepada Ayub, maka firman TUHAN kepada Elifas, orang Teman: "Murka-Ku menyala terhadap engkau dan terhadap kedua sahabatmu, karena kamu tidak berkata benar tentang Aku seperti hamba-Ku Ayub.
scripture_data.text_en: And it was [so], that after the LORD had spoken these words unto Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, My wrath is kindled against thee, and against thy two friends: for ye have not spoken of me [the thing that is] right, as my servant Job [hath].
scripture_data.text_orig: ב יב הנכן יל רד ל י יר ינב ב י הרח ינמיה זפילל הוהי רמו בל הה ירבהת הוהי ר רח יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, ambillah tujuh ekor lembu jantan dan tujuh ekor domba jantan dan pergilah kepada hamba-Ku Ayub, lalu persembahkanlah semuanya itu sebagai korban bakaran untuk dirimu, dan baiklah hamba-Ku Ayub meminta doa untuk kamu, karena hanya permintaannyalah yang akan Kuterima, supaya Aku tidak melakukan aniaya terhadap kamu, sebab kamu tidak berkata benar tentang Aku seperti hamba-Ku Ayub."
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore take unto you now seven bullocks and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you: for him will I accept: lest I deal with you [after your] folly, in that ye have not spoken of me [the thing which is] right, like my servant Job.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב יב הנכן יל רד ל י הלבן כ ת ילבל וינ י כיל לתי יב בו כד הל תילהו ב יבל כל ילי הבו ירפהב כלחק הו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka pergilah Elifas, orang Teman, Bildad, orang Suah, dan Zofar, orang Naama, lalu mereka melakukan seperti apa yang difirmankan TUHAN kepada mereka. Dan TUHAN menerima permintaan Ayub.
scripture_data.text_en: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite [and] Zophar the Naamathite went, and did according as the LORD commanded them: the LORD also accepted Job.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב ינת הוהי ו הוהי היל ר ר ו יתמה רפצ יחה דלב ינמיה זפיל כלו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu TUHAN memulihkan keadaan Ayub, setelah ia meminta doa untuk sahabat-sahabatnya, dan TUHAN memberikan kepada Ayub dua kali lipat dari segala kepunyaannya dahulu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD turned the captivity of Job, when he prayed for his friends: also the LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah kepadanya semua saudaranya laki-laki dan perempuan dan semua kenalannya yang lama, dan makan bersama-sama dengan dia di rumahnya. Mereka menyatakan turut berdukacita dan menghibur dia oleh karena segala malapetaka yang telah ditimpakan TUHAN kepadanya, dan mereka masing-masing memberi dia uang satu kesita dan sebuah cincin emas.
scripture_data.text_en: Then came there unto him all his brethren, and all his sisters, and all they that had been of his acquaintance before, and did eat bread with him in his house: and they bemoaned him, and comforted him over all the evil that the LORD had brought upon him: every man also gave him a piece of money, and every one an earring of gold.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס דח בהז זנ יו תח היק י לנו ויל הוהי יבהר הרהל ל ת מחניו ל דנו תיב חל לכו ינפל וידילכו ויתיח ויתיחלכו ויחל ויל בו

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN memberkati Ayub dalam hidupnya yang selanjutnya lebih dari pada dalam hidupnya yang dahulu; ia mendapat empat belas ribu ekor kambing domba, dan enam ribu unta, seribu pasang lembu, dan seribu ekor keledai betina.
scripture_data.text_en: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning: for he had fourteen thousand sheep, and six thousand camels, and a thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand she asses.

scripture_data.text_id: dan anak perempuan yang pertama diberinya nama Yemima, yang kedua Kezia dan yang ketiga Kerenhapukh.

scripture_data.text_id: Di seluruh negeri tidak terdapat perempuan yang secantik anak-anak Ayub, dan mereka diberi ayahnya milik pusaka di tengah-tengah saudara-saudaranya laki-laki.
scripture_data.text_en: And in all the land were no women found [so] fair as the daughters of Job: and their father gave them inheritance among their brethren.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu Ayub masih hidup seratus empat puluh tahun lamanya; ia melihat anak-anaknya dan cucu-cucunya sampai keturunan yang keempat.
scripture_data.text_en: After this lived Job an hundred and forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons' sons, [even] four generations.

scripture_data.text_id: Berbahagialah orang yang tidak berjalan menurut nasihat orang fasik, yang tidak berdiri di jalan orang berdosa, dan yang tidak duduk dalam kumpulan pencemooh,

scripture_data.text_en: But his delight [is] in the law of the LORD; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלילו מי ההי תרתב צפח הוהי תרת י

scripture_data.text_id: Ia seperti pohon, yang ditanam di tepi aliran air, yang menghasilkan buahnya pada musimnya, dan yang tidak layu daunnya; apa saja yang diperbuatnya berhasil.
scripture_data.text_en: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.
scripture_data.text_orig: חילצי היר לכו ליל הלו י יר ר ימ יגלל לת ש היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Bukan demikian orang fasik: mereka seperti sekam yang ditiupkan angin.

scripture_data.text_orig: חר פר ש י ירה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu orang fasik tidak akan tahan dalam penghakiman, begitu pula orang berdosa dalam perkumpulan orang benar;
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.
scripture_data.text_orig: יקיץ תד יחו יר מקיל ל

scripture_data.text_id: sebab TUHAN mengenal jalan orang benar, tetapi jalan orang fasik menuju kebinasaan.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב יר רדו יקיץ ר הוהי דיי

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa rusuh bangsa-bangsa, mengapa suku-suku bangsa mereka-reka perkara yang sia-sia?
scripture_data.text_en: Why do the heathen rage, and the people imagine a vain thing?
scripture_data.text_orig: קירהי יל יג גר הל

scripture_data.text_id: Raja-raja dunia bersiap-siap dan para pembesar bermufakat bersama-sama melawan TUHAN dan yang diurapi-Nya:
scripture_data.text_en: The kings of the earth set themselves, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his anointed, [saying],
scripture_data.text_orig: חימלו הוהיל דחידסן ינזרו שריכלם ביתי

scripture_data.text_id: "Marilah kita memutuskan belenggu-belenggu mereka dan membuang tali-tali mereka dari pada kita!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.
scripture_data.text_orig: מיתב מ הכילנו מיתרסמת הקננ

scripture_data.text_id: Dia, yang bersemayam di sorga, tertawa; Tuhan mengolok-olok mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: He that sitteth in the heavens shall laugh: the Lord shall have them in derision.
scripture_data.text_orig: מלגלי ינד קחי ימ בי

scripture_data.text_id: Maka berkatalah Ia kepada mereka dalam murka-Nya dan mengejutkan mereka dalam kehangatan amarah-Nya:
scripture_data.text_en: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.
scripture_data.text_orig: מלהבי נרחב ב מיל רדי ז

scripture_data.text_id: "Akulah yang telah melantik raja-Ku di Sion, gunung-Ku yang kudus!"
scripture_data.text_en: Yet have I set my king upon my holy hill of Zion.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידקרה צל ילם יכסנ ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku mau menceritakan tentang ketetapan TUHAN; Ia berkata kepadaku: "Anak-Ku engkau! Engkau telah Kuperanakkan pada hari ini.
scripture_data.text_en: I will declare the decree: the LORD hath said unto me, Thou [art] my Son; this day have I begotten thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידלי ה ינ ה ינ יל רמ הוהי קח ל הרס

scripture_data.text_id: Mintalah kepada-Ku, maka bangsa-bangsa akan Kuberikan kepadamu menjadi milik pusakamu, dan ujung bumi menjadi kepunyaanmu.
scripture_data.text_en: Ask of me, and I shall give [thee] the heathen [for] thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth [for] thy possession.
scripture_data.text_orig: שריספ תחו תלחן יג הנו ימ ל

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau akan meremukkan mereka dengan gada besi, memecahkan mereka seperti tembikar tukang periuk."
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter's vessel.
scripture_data.text_orig: צנ רצי ילכ לזר ב ר

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, hai raja-raja, bertindaklah bijaksana, terimalah pengajaran, hai para hakim dunia!
scripture_data.text_en: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר יפ רסה ליה יכלם הו

scripture_data.text_id: Beribadahlah kepada TUHAN dengan takut dan ciumlah kaki-Nya dengan gemetar,
scripture_data.text_en: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדר ליגו הרי הוהית דב

scripture_data.text_id: supaya Ia jangan murka dan kamu binasa di jalan, sebab mudah sekali murka-Nya menyala. Berbahagialah semua orang yang berlindung pada-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish [from] the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed [are] all they that put their trust in him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב יסחל יר מ רביי רד דבתו ני רבקן

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Daud, ketika ia lari dari Absalom, anaknya. (3-2) Ya TUHAN, betapa banyaknya lawanku! Banyak orang yang bangkit menyerang aku;
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son.> LORD, how are they increased that trouble me! many [are] they that rise up against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ לב ינמ חרב דודל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: (3-3) banyak orang yang berkata tentang aku: "Baginya tidak ada pertolongan dari pada Allah." Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Many [there be] which say of my soul, [There is] no help for him in God. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ימק יר ירצ רהמ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (3-4) Tetapi Engkau, TUHAN, adalah perisai yang melindungi aku, Engkaulah kemuliaanku dan yang mengangkat kepalaku.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou, O LORD, [art] a shield for me; my glory, and the lifter up of mine head.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יהלב התי י יפנל ירמ יר

scripture_data.text_id: (3-5) Dengan nyaring aku berseru kepada TUHAN, dan Ia menjawab aku dari gunung-Nya yang kudus. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: I cried unto the LORD with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר ירמ ידב יד גמ הוהי הו

scripture_data.text_id: (3-6) Aku membaringkan diri, lalu tidur; aku bangun, sebab TUHAN menopang aku!
scripture_data.text_en: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the LORD sustained me.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס דק רהמ יננו רק הוהיל ילק

scripture_data.text_id: (3-7) Aku tidak takut kepada puluhan ribu orang yang siap mengepung aku.
scripture_data.text_en: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set [themselves] against me round about.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינכמסי הוהי י יתציקה הניו יבכ ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (3-8) Bangkitlah, TUHAN, tolonglah aku, ya Allahku! Ya, Engkau telah memukul rahang semua musuhku, dan mematahkan gigi orang-orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: Arise, O LORD; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies [upon] the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ת ביבס ר תבברמ ריל

scripture_data.text_id: (3-9) Dari TUHAN datang pertolongan. Berkat-Mu atas umat-Mu! Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Salvation [belongeth] unto the LORD: thy blessing [is] upon thy people. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר יר י יחל יבילת תיהי יהל יניה הוהי המק

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan kecapi. Mazmur Daud. (4-2) Apabila aku berseru, jawablah aku, ya Allah, yang membenarkan aku. Di dalam kesesakan Engkau memberi kelegaan kepadaku. Kasihanilah aku dan dengarkanlah doaku!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm of David.> Hear me when I call, O God of my righteousness: thou hast enlarged me [when I was] in distress; have mercy upon me, and hear my prayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ תניגנ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (4-3) Hai orang-orang, berapa lama lagi kemuliaanku dinodai, berapa lama lagi kamu mencintai yang sia-sia dan mencari kebohongan? Sela
scripture_data.text_en: O ye sons of men, how long [will ye turn] my glory into shame? [how long] will ye love vanity, [and] seek after leasing? Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתפ מ ינח י בחרה ר יקדצ יהל יננ ירק

scripture_data.text_id: (4-4) Ketahuilah, bahwa TUHAN telah memilih bagi-Nya seorang yang dikasihi-Nya; TUHAN mendengarkan, apabila aku berseru kepada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: But know that the LORD hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the LORD will hear when I call unto him.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס בזכ קב קיר בה הלכל ידבך המד י ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (4-5) Biarlah kamu marah, tetapi jangan berbuat dosa; berkata-katalah dalam hatimu di tempat tidurmu, tetapi tetaplah diam. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויל ירק מי הוהי ל דיסח הוהי הלפהי ד

scripture_data.text_id: (4-6) Persembahkanlah korban yang benar dan percayalah kepada TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס דו כבמל כבבלב רמ חלו זגר

scripture_data.text_id: (4-7) Banyak orang berkata: "Siapa yang akan memperlihatkan yang baik kepada kita?" Biarlah cahaya wajah-Mu menyinari kami, ya TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: [There be] many that say, Who will shew us [any] good? LORD, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon us.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהיל חב קדציחבז חבז

scripture_data.text_id: (4-8) Engkau telah memberikan sukacita kepadaku, lebih banyak dari pada mereka ketika mereka kelimpahan gandum dan anggur.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time [that] their corn and their wine increased.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ינ ר נילהסן ב נריימ ירמ יר

scripture_data.text_id: (4-9) Dengan tenteram aku mau membaringkan diri, lalu segera tidur, sebab hanya Engkaulah, ya TUHAN, yang membiarkan aku diam dengan aman.
scripture_data.text_en: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, LORD, only makest me dwell in safety.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר ריתו נג תמ ילב החמ התנ

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan suling. Mazmur Daud. (5-2) Berilah telinga kepada perkataanku, ya TUHAN, indahkanlah keluh kesahku.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Nehiloth, A Psalm of David.> Give ear to my words, O LORD, consider my meditation.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ תליחהל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (5-3) Perhatikanlah teriakku minta tolong, ya Rajaku dan Allahku, sebab kepada-Mulah aku berdoa.
scripture_data.text_en: Hearken unto the voice of my cry, my King, and my God: for unto thee will I pray.
scripture_data.text_orig: יגיגה הני הוהי הניזה ירמ

scripture_data.text_id: (5-4) TUHAN, pada waktu pagi Engkau mendengar seruanku, pada waktu pagi aku mengatur persembahan bagi-Mu, dan aku menunggu-nunggu.
scripture_data.text_en: My voice shalt thou hear in the morning, O LORD; in the morning will I direct [my prayer] unto thee, and will look up.
scripture_data.text_orig: לת ילי יהלו ילם יו לקל הביקה

scripture_data.text_id: (5-5) Sebab Engkau bukanlah Allah yang berkenan kepada kefasikan; orang jahat takkan menumpang pada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou [art] not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: הצו לר רק ילק מ רק הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (5-6) Pembual tidak akan tahan di depan mata-Mu; Engkau membenci semua orang yang melakukan kejahatan.
scripture_data.text_en: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר רגי ל ה ר שפחל ל י

scripture_data.text_id: (5-7) Engkau membinasakan orang-orang yang berkata bohong, TUHAN jijik melihat penumpah darah dan penipu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the LORD will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.
scripture_data.text_orig: ו ילל תנ יני דגנל יללה ביתיל

scripture_data.text_id: (5-8) Tetapi aku, berkat kasih setia-Mu yang besar, aku akan masuk ke dalam rumah-Mu, sujud menyembah ke arah bait-Mu yang kudus dengan takut akan Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: But as for me, I will come [into] thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: [and] in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי בתי המרמ ימי בזכ ירב ד

scripture_data.text_id: (5-9) TUHAN, tuntunlah aku dalam keadilan-Mu karena seteruku; ratakanlah jalan-Mu di depanku.
scripture_data.text_en: Lead me, O LORD, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרי דקלכיהל הוח תיב ב סח בר ינו

scripture_data.text_id: (5-10) Sebab perkataan mereka tidak ada yang jujur, batin mereka penuh kebusukan, kerongkongan mereka seperti kubur ternganga, lidah mereka merayu-rayu.
scripture_data.text_en: For [there is] no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part [is] very wickedness; their throat [is] an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר ינפל ריה רה ירר מל תקדצב ינחן הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (5-11) Biarlah mereka menanggung kesalahan mereka, ya Allah, biarlah mereka jatuh karena rancangannya sendiri; buanglah mereka karena banyaknya pelanggaran mereka, sebab mereka memberontak terhadap Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: קילחי נל נר חתרבק תה רק הנכן היפ י י

scripture_data.text_id: (5-12) Tetapi semua orang yang berlindung pada-Mu akan bersukacita, mereka akan bersorak-sorai selama-lamanya, karena Engkau menaungi mereka; dan karena Engkau akan bersukaria orang-orang yang mengasihi nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב רמי מחיה הי בר היתצמ לי יהל מיה

scripture_data.text_id: (5-13) Sebab Engkaulah yang memberkati orang benar, ya TUHAN; Engkau memagari dia dengan anugerah-Mu seperti perisai.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou, LORD, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as [with] a shield.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ יבה ב צליו מיל סתו נרי לל ב יסחלכ חמיו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan kecapi. Menurut lagu: Yang kedelapan. Mazmur Daud. (6-2) Ya TUHAN, janganlah menghukum aku dalam murka-Mu, dan janganlah menghajar aku dalam kepanasan amarah-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.> O LORD, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ תינימהל תניגנ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (6-3) Kasihanilah aku, TUHAN, sebab aku merana; sembuhkanlah aku, TUHAN, sebab tulang-tulangku gemetar,
scripture_data.text_en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; for I [am] weak: O LORD, heal me; for my bones are vexed.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינרית תמחלו ינחיכת ל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (6-4) dan jiwakupun sangat terkejut; tetapi Engkau, TUHAN, berapa lama lagi?
scripture_data.text_en: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O LORD, how long?
scripture_data.text_orig: ימצ להבנ י הוהי ינפר ינ ללמ י הוהי ינח

scripture_data.text_id: (6-5) Kembalilah pula, TUHAN, luputkanlah jiwaku, selamatkanlah aku oleh karena kasih setia-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Return, O LORD, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies' sake.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתמד הוהי הו ו דם הלהבנ יפנו

scripture_data.text_id: (6-6) Sebab di dalam maut tidaklah orang ingat kepada-Mu; siapakah yang akan bersyukur kepada-Mu di dalam dunia orang mati?
scripture_data.text_en: For in death [there is] no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?
scripture_data.text_orig: סח מל יניה יפן הצח הוהי הב

scripture_data.text_id: (6-7) Lesu aku karena mengeluh; setiap malam aku menggenangi tempat tidurku, dengan air mataku aku membanjiri ranjangku.
scripture_data.text_en: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדי ימ ל רכז תו י י

scripture_data.text_id: (6-8) Mataku mengidap karena sakit hati, rabun karena semua lawanku.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: הסמ יר יתמד יתמ הליללכב הח יתחנ יגי

scripture_data.text_id: (6-9) Menjauhlah dari padaku, kamu sekalian yang melakukan kejahatan, sebab TUHAN telah mendengar tangisku;
scripture_data.text_en: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the LORD hath heard the voice of my weeping.
scripture_data.text_orig: יררצלכ הקת יני סמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: (6-10) TUHAN telah mendengar permohonanku, TUHAN menerima doaku.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath heard my supplication; the LORD will receive my prayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: ייכ לק הוהי מי ו ילל ימ רס

scripture_data.text_id: (6-11) Semua musuhku mendapat malu dan sangat terkejut; mereka mundur dan mendapat malu dalam sekejap mata.
scripture_data.text_en: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return [and] be ashamed suddenly.
scripture_data.text_orig: חי יתפ הוהי יתח הוהי מ

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyian ratapan Daud, yang dinyanyikan untuk TUHAN karena Kush, orang Benyamin itu. (7-2) Ya TUHAN, Allahku, pada-Mu aku berlindung; selamatkanlah aku dari semua orang yang mengejar aku dan lepaskanlah aku,
scripture_data.text_en: <Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the LORD, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite.> O LORD my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:
scripture_data.text_orig: ינימי כירבל הוהיל רר דודל י

scripture_data.text_id: (7-3) supaya jangan mereka seperti singa menerkam aku dan menyeret aku, dengan tidak ada yang melepaskan.
scripture_data.text_en: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending [it] in pieces, while [there is] none to deliver.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינליהו יפדרלמ יניה יתיסח יהל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (7-4) Ya TUHAN, Allahku, jika aku berbuat ini: jika ada kecurangan di tanganku,
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;
scripture_data.text_orig: לים יו קר יפן היר רי

scripture_data.text_id: (7-5) jika aku melakukan yang jahat terhadap orang yang hidup damai dengan aku, atau merugikan orang yang melawan aku dengan tidak ada alasannya,
scripture_data.text_en: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)
scripture_data.text_orig: יכ לוי תז יתי יהל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (7-6) maka musuh kiranya mengejar aku sampai menangkap aku, dan menginjak-injak hidupku ke tanah, dan menaruh kemuliaanku ke dalam debu. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take [it]; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיר יררץ הצחו ר ימל ילמ

scripture_data.text_id: (7-7) Bangkitlah, TUHAN, dalam murka-Mu, berdirilah menghadapi geram orang-orang yang melawan aku, bangunlah untukku, ya Engkau yang telah memerintahkan penghakiman!
scripture_data.text_en: Arise, O LORD, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me [to] the judgment [that] thou hast commanded.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס י רפל ידבכ יח שרל סמריו גיו יפן בי רי

scripture_data.text_id: (7-8) Biarlah bangsa-bangsa berkumpul mengelilingi Engkau, dan bertakhtalah di atas mereka di tempat yang tinggi.
scripture_data.text_en: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיצ מ יל הרו יררץ תרב ה הוהי המק

scripture_data.text_id: (7-9) TUHAN mengadili bangsa-bangsa. Hakimilah aku, TUHAN, apakah aku benar, dan apakah aku tulus ikhlas.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD shall judge the people: judge me, O LORD, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity [that is] in me.
scripture_data.text_orig: הב רל הילו שבבס יל תדו

scripture_data.text_id: (7-10) Biarlah berakhir kejahatan orang fasik, tetapi teguhkanlah orang yang benar, Engkau, yang menguji hati dan batin orang, ya Allah yang adil.
scripture_data.text_en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יתכ יקדצ הוהי ינפ י ידי הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (7-11) Perisai bagiku adalah Allah, yang menyelamatkan orang-orang yang tulus hati;
scripture_data.text_en: My defence [is] of God, which saveth the upright in heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיץ יהל תילכ תל חב קיצ נכת יר ר נרמגי

scripture_data.text_id: (7-12) Allah adalah Hakim yang adil dan Allah yang murka setiap saat.
scripture_data.text_en: God judgeth the righteous, and God is angry [with the wicked] every day.
scripture_data.text_orig: בלירי ימ יהלל יגמ

scripture_data.text_id: (7-13) Sungguh, kembali ia mengasah pedangnya, melentur busurnya dan membidik.
scripture_data.text_en: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילכ ז לו קיץ פ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (7-14) Terhadap dirinya ia mempersiapkan senjata-senjata yang mematikan, dan membuat anak panahnya menjadi menyala.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.
scripture_data.text_orig: הננכיו רד ק לי רח בי ל

scripture_data.text_id: (7-15) Sesungguhnya, orang itu hamil dengan kejahatan, ia mengandung kelaliman dan melahirkan dusta.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.
scripture_data.text_orig: לפי יקלדל ויח תומיל יכה לו

scripture_data.text_id: (7-16) Ia membuat lobang dan menggalinya, tetapi ia sendiri jatuh ke dalam pelubang yang dibuatnya.
scripture_data.text_en: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch [which] he made.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק דליו למ הרהו ולחי הה

scripture_data.text_id: (7-17) Kelaliman yang dilakukannya kembali menimpa kepalanya, dan kekerasannya turun menimpa batu kepalanya.
scripture_data.text_en: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.
scripture_data.text_orig: לפי תח לו הרחו הר ר

scripture_data.text_id: (7-18) Aku hendak bersyukur kepada TUHAN karena keadilan-Nya, dan bermazmur bagi nama TUHAN, Yang Mahatinggi.
scripture_data.text_en: I will praise the LORD according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the LORD most high.
scripture_data.text_orig: דרי סמח דקדק לו רב למ בי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Gitit. Mazmur Daud. (8-2) Ya TUHAN, Tuhan kami, betapa mulianya nama-Mu di seluruh bumi! Keagungan-Mu yang mengatasi langit dinyanyikan.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of David.> O LORD our Lord, how excellent [is] thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ תיהל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (8-3) Dari mulut bayi-bayi dan anak-anak yang menyusu telah Kauletakkan dasar kekuatan karena lawan-Mu, untuk membungkamkan musuh dan pendendam.
scripture_data.text_en: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימהל דה הנ ר שרהלכ מ ריהמ נינד הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (8-4) Jika aku melihat langit-Mu, buatan jari-Mu, bulan dan bintang-bintang yang Kautempatkan:
scripture_data.text_en: When I consider thy heavens, the work of thy fingers, the moon and the stars, which thou hast ordained;
scripture_data.text_orig: נתמ בי תיהל יררץ מל ז די יקניו ילל ימ

scripture_data.text_id: (8-5) apakah manusia, sehingga Engkau mengingatnya? Apakah anak manusia, sehingga Engkau mengindahkannya?
scripture_data.text_en: What is man, that thou art mindful of him? and the son of man, that thou visitest him?
scripture_data.text_orig: הננ ר יבככו חרי יתצ ים ימ הרי

scripture_data.text_id: (8-6) Namun Engkau telah membuatnya hampir sama seperti Allah, dan telah memahkotainya dengan kemuliaan dan hormat.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou hast made him a little lower than the angels, and hast crowned him with glory and honour.
scripture_data.text_orig: דקפת י דב רזתי נהמ

scripture_data.text_id: (8-7) Engkau membuat dia berkuasa atas buatan tangan-Mu; segala-galanya telah Kauletakkan di bawah kakinya:
scripture_data.text_en: Thou madest him to have dominion over the works of thy hands; thou hast put all [things] under his feet:
scripture_data.text_orig: הר רדהו דבכו יהלמ הרחו

scripture_data.text_id: (8-8) kambing domba dan lembu sapi sekalian, juga binatang-binatang di padang;
scripture_data.text_en: All sheep and oxen, yea, and the beasts of the field;
scripture_data.text_orig: וילגרתחת ה ל ידי ימ הלימ

scripture_data.text_id: (8-9) burung-burung di udara dan ikan-ikan di laut, dan apa yang melintasi arus lautan.
scripture_data.text_en: The fowl of the air, and the fish of the sea, [and whatsoever] passeth through the paths of the seas.
scripture_data.text_orig: יד תמה גו יפלו הנצ

scripture_data.text_id: (8-10) Ya TUHAN, Tuhan kami, betapa mulianya nama-Mu di seluruh bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD our Lord, how excellent [is] thy name in all the earth!
scripture_data.text_orig: יי תחר רב ה יגד ימ רצ

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Mut-Laben. Mazmur Daud. (9-2) Aku mau bersyukur kepada TUHAN dengan segenap hatiku, aku mau menceritakan segala perbuatan-Mu yang ajaib;
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Muthlabben, A Psalm of David.> I will praise [thee], O LORD, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ ל תמל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (9-3) aku mau bersukacita dan bersukaria karena Engkau, bermazmur bagi nama-Mu, ya Mahatinggi,
scripture_data.text_en: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתלפנל הרס יללכ הוהי הד

scripture_data.text_id: (9-4) sebab musuhku mundur, tersandung jatuh dan binasa di hadapan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל מ הרז ב הצלו החמ

scripture_data.text_id: (9-5) Sebab Engkau membela perkaraku dan hakku, sebagai Hakim yang adil Engkau duduk di atas takhta.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינמ דביו לי רח יביב

scripture_data.text_id: (9-6) Engkau telah menghardik bangsa-bangsa, telah membinasakan orang-orang fasik; nama mereka telah Kauhapuskan untuk seterusnya dan selama-lamanya;
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: קדץ פ כל בי ינידו ימ תיי

scripture_data.text_id: (9-7) musuh telah habis binasa, menjadi timbunan puing senantiasa: kota-kota telah Kauruntuhkan; lenyaplah ingatan kepadanya.
scripture_data.text_en: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.
scripture_data.text_orig: דו לל תיחמ מ ר ד יג ר

scripture_data.text_id: (9-8) Tetapi TUHAN bersemayam untuk selama-lamanya, takhta-Nya didirikan-Nya untuk menjalankan penghakiman.
scripture_data.text_en: But the LORD shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.
scripture_data.text_orig: הה רכז דב תנ ירו חצנל תברח ביה

scripture_data.text_id: (9-9) Dialah yang menghakimi dunia dengan keadilan dan mengadili bangsa-bangsa dengan kebenaran.
scripture_data.text_en: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ל נ בי לל הוהיו

scripture_data.text_id: (9-10) Demikianlah TUHAN adalah tempat perlindungan bagi orang yang terinjak, tempat perlindungan pada waktu kesesakan.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירימ יל ידי קדצ לבי הו

scripture_data.text_id: (9-11) Orang yang mengenal nama-Mu percaya kepada-Mu, sebab tidak Kautinggalkan orang yang mencari Engkau, ya TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, LORD, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר תל במ ל במ הוהי יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: (9-12) Bermazmurlah bagi TUHAN, yang bersemayam di Sion, beritakanlah perbuatan-Nya di antara bangsa-bangsa,
scripture_data.text_en: Sing praises to the LORD, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ירד בזל י מ ידי ב חביו

scripture_data.text_id: (9-13) sebab Dia, yang membalas penumpahan darah, ingat kepada orang yang tertindas; teriak mereka tidaklah dilupakan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: When he maketh inquisition for blood, he remembereth them: he forgetteth not the cry of the humble.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתליל יב דיה צ בי הוהיל רז

scripture_data.text_id: (9-14) Kasihanilah aku, ya TUHAN; lihatlah sengsaraku, disebabkan oleh orang-orang yang membenci aku, ya Engkau, yang mengangkat aku dari pintu gerbang maut,
scripture_data.text_en: Have mercy upon me, O LORD; consider my trouble [which I suffer] of them that hate me, thou that liftest me up from the gates of death:
scripture_data.text_orig: יונ ינ תקץ חכל רכז ת ימ רדי

scripture_data.text_id: (9-15) supaya aku menceritakan segala perbuatan-Mu yang terpuji dan bersorak-sorak di pintu gerbang puteri Sion karena keselamatan yang dari pada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: תומ ירמ יממרמ ינמ יינ הר הוהי ינננח

scripture_data.text_id: (9-16) Bangsa-bangsa terbenam dalam pelubang yang dibuatnya, kakinya tertangkap dalam jaring yang dipasangnya sendiri.
scripture_data.text_en: The heathen are sunk down in the pit [that] they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי הליג צתב יר יתהל הרס מל

scripture_data.text_id: (9-17) TUHAN telah memperkenalkan diri-Nya, Ia menjalankan penghakiman; orang fasik terjerat dalam perbuatan tangannya sendiri. Higayon. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD is known [by] the judgment [which] he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: לגר הדלנ נמ זתר תח יג ב

scripture_data.text_id: (9-18) Orang-orang fasik akan kembali ke dunia orang mati, ya, segala bangsa yang melupakan Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked shall be turned into hell, [and] all the nations that forget God.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יה ר קן וי לפ ה מ הוהי דנ

scripture_data.text_id: (9-19) Sebab bukan untuk seterusnya orang miskin dilupakan, bukan untuk selamanya hilang harapan orang sengsara.
scripture_data.text_en: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall [not] perish for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל יחכ יל הלל יר בי

scripture_data.text_id: (9-20) Bangkitlah, TUHAN, janganlah manusia merajalela; biarlah bangsa-bangsa dihakimi di hadapan-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Arise, O LORD; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.
scripture_data.text_orig: דל דב ינ יונ תוק יב חכי חצנל ל י

scripture_data.text_id: (9-21) Biarlah mereka menjadi takut, ya TUHAN, sehingga bangsa-bangsa itu mengakui, bahwa mereka manusia saja. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Put them in fear, O LORD: [that] the nations may know themselves [to be but] men. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינל יג פי נ זיל הוהי המק

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa Engkau berdiri jauh-jauh, ya TUHAN, dan menyembunyikan diri-Mu dalam waktu-waktu kesesakan?
scripture_data.text_en: Why standest thou afar off, O LORD? [why] hidest thou [thyself] in times of trouble?
scripture_data.text_orig: הר תל יל קחר דמ הוהי המל

scripture_data.text_id: Karena congkak orang fasik giat memburu orang yang tertindas; mereka terjebak dalam tipu daya yang mereka rancangkan.
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked in [his] pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.
scripture_data.text_orig: בח ז תזמ פי ינ קלדי ר תוג

scripture_data.text_id: Karena orang fasik memuji-muji keinginan hatinya, dan orang yang loba mengutuki dan menista TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: For the wicked boasteth of his heart's desire, and blesseth the covetous, [whom] the LORD abhorreth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי שנ ר צב פן תול ר להי

scripture_data.text_id: Kata orang fasik itu dengan batang hidungnya ke atas: "Allah tidak akan menuntut! Tidak ada Allah!", itulah seluruh pikirannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek [after God]: God [is] not in all his thoughts.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתזמל יהל י רדיל בג ר

scripture_data.text_id: Tindakan-tindakannya selalu berhasil; hukum-hukum-Mu tinggi sekali, jauh dari dia; ia menganggap remeh semua lawannya.
scripture_data.text_en: His ways are always grievous; thy judgments [are] far above out of his sight: [as for] all his enemies, he puffeth at them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה חיפי ויררצל גמ ימ רמ תלכ ויכרד וכרד ליחי

scripture_data.text_id: Ia berkata dalam hatinya: "Aku takkan goyang. Aku tidak akan ditimpa malapetaka turun-temurun."
scripture_data.text_en: He hath said in his heart, I shall not be moved: for [I shall] never [be] in adversity.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבל ר רדו רדל ל ל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Mulutnya penuh dengan sumpah serapah, dengan tipu dan penindasan; di lidahnya ada kelaliman dan kejahatan.
scripture_data.text_en: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue [is] mischief and vanity.
scripture_data.text_orig: וו למ נל תח תו תמרמ למ הי הל

scripture_data.text_id: Ia duduk menghadang di gubuk-gubuk, di tempat yang tersembunyi ia membunuh orang yang tak bersalah. Matanya mengintip orang yang lemah;
scripture_data.text_en: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.
scripture_data.text_orig: נצי הכלחל ויני יקנ גרהי ירס ירצח ברמ בי

scripture_data.text_id: ia mengendap di tempat yang tersembunyi seperti singa di dalam semak-semak; ia mengendap untuk menangkap orang yang tertindas. Ia menangkap orang yang tertindas itu dengan menariknya ke dalam jaringnya.
scripture_data.text_en: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב כמ ינ חי ינ חל ברי הסב היר רס ברי

scripture_data.text_id: Ia membungkuk, dan meniarap, lalu orang-orang lemah jatuh ke dalam cakarnya yang kuat.
scripture_data.text_en: He croucheth, [and] humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ליח ילח וימצ לפנו חי הדי הכדו

scripture_data.text_id: Ia berkata dalam hatinya: "Allah melupakannya; Ia menyembunyikan wajah-Nya, dan tidak akan melihatnya untuk seterusnya."
scripture_data.text_en: He hath said in his heart, God hath forgotten: he hideth his face; he will never see [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: חצנל הרל וינ ריסה ל חכ ל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Bangkitlah, TUHAN! Ya Allah, ulurkanlah tangan-Mu, janganlah lupakan orang-orang yang tertindas.
scripture_data.text_en: Arise, O LORD; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.
scripture_data.text_orig: יונ ינ חל די ן ל הוהי המק

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa orang fasik menista Allah, sambil berkata dalam hatinya: "Engkau tidak menuntut?"
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore doth the wicked contemn God? he hath said in his heart, Thou wilt not require [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: רד ל ל רמ יהל ר שנ המל

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau memang melihatnya, sebab Engkaulah yang melihat kesusahan dan sakit hati, supaya Engkau mengambilnya ke dalam tangan-Mu sendiri. Kepada-Mulah orang lemah menyerahkan diri; untuk anak yatim Engkau menjadi penolong.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast seen [it]; for thou beholdest mischief and spite, to requite [it] with thy hand: the poor committeth himself unto thee; thou art the helper of the fatherless.
scripture_data.text_orig: רז תייה ה תי הכלח בזי יל די תתל י סכו למ הי התר

scripture_data.text_id: Patahkanlah lengan orang fasik dan orang jahat, tuntutlah kefasikannya, sampai Engkau tidak menemuinya lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil [man]: seek out his wickedness [till] thou find none.
scripture_data.text_orig: צמלב ררד רו ר רז רב

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN adalah Raja untuk seterusnya dan selama-lamanya. Bangsa-bangsa lenyap dari tanah-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.
scripture_data.text_orig: צרמ יג דב דו ל למ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Keinginan orang-orang yang tertindas telah Kaudengarkan, ya TUHAN; Engkau menguatkan hati mereka, Engkau memasang telinga-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: LORD, thou hast heard the desire of the humble: thou wilt prepare their heart, thou wilt cause thine ear to hear:
scripture_data.text_orig: נז ביק ל יכ הוהי מ יונ תו

scripture_data.text_id: untuk memberi keadilan kepada anak yatim dan orang yang terinjak; supaya tidak ada lagi seorang manusia di bumi yang berani menakut-nakuti.
scripture_data.text_en: To judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that the man of the earth may no more oppress.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהמ נ שרל ד יסיל דו תי ל

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari Daud. Pada TUHAN aku berlindung, bagaimana kamu berani berkata kepadaku: "Terbanglah ke gunung seperti burung!"
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David.> In the LORD put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee [as] a bird to your mountain?
scripture_data.text_orig: רצ כרה ידנ דנ יפנל רמ י יתיסח הוהי דודל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab, lihat orang fasik melentur busurnya, mereka memasang anak panahnya pada tali busur, untuk memanah orang yang tulus hati di tempat gelap.
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, the wicked bend [their] bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: בליריל לפמ תריל רתיל ח ננ תק כרדי ירה הה י

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila dasar-dasar dihancurkan, apakah yang dapat dibuat oleh orang benar itu?
scripture_data.text_en: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?
scripture_data.text_orig: להם קיצ סרהי תתה י

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN ada di dalam bait-Nya yang kudus; TUHAN, takhta-Nya di sorga; mata-Nya mengamat-amati, sorot mata-Nya menguji anak-anak manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] in his holy temple, the LORD'S throne [is] in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ינ נחבי ויף זחי ויני ס ימ הוהי דק לכיה הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN menguji orang benar dan orang fasik, dan Ia membenci orang yang mencintai kekerasan.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.
scripture_data.text_orig: פן הנ סמח בהו רו חבי קיץ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menghujani orang-orang fasik dengan arang berapi dan belerang; angin yang menghanguskan, itulah isi piala mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: [this shall be] the portion of their cup.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תנם תפלז חרו תירפגו יח ירל רמי

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab TUHAN adalah adil dan Ia mengasihi keadilan; orang yang tulus akan memandang wajah-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: For the righteous LORD loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.
scripture_data.text_orig: מינפ זחי רי בה תקדץ הוהי קיצי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Yang kedelapan. Mazmur Daud. (12-2) Tolonglah kiranya, TUHAN, sebab orang saleh telah habis, telah lenyap orang-orang yang setia dari antara anak-anak manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David.> Help, LORD; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ תינימהל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (12-3) Mereka berkata dusta, yang seorang kepada yang lain, mereka berkata dengan bibir yang manis dan hati yang bercabang.
scripture_data.text_en: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: [with] flattering lips [and] with a double heart do they speak.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ינמ ינמ פי דיסח רמגי הוהי היה

scripture_data.text_id: (12-4) Biarlah TUHAN mengerat segala bibir yang manis dan setiap lidah yang bercakap besar,
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD shall cut off all flattering lips, [and] the tongue that speaketh proud things:
scripture_data.text_orig: רדי בלו בל תקלח תפ הרת י רדי ו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-5) dari mereka yang berkata: "Dengan lidah kami, kami menang! Bibir kami menyokong kami! Siapakah tuan atas kami?"
scripture_data.text_en: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips [are] our own: who [is] lord over us?
scripture_data.text_orig: תלד תרדם ל תקלח יתפל הוהי תרכי

scripture_data.text_id: (12-6) Oleh karena penindasan terhadap orang-orang yang lemah, oleh karena keluhan orang-orang miskin, sekarang juga Aku bangkit, firman TUHAN; Aku memberi keselamatan kepada orang yang menghauskannya.
scripture_data.text_en: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the LORD; I will set [him] in safety [from him that] puffeth at him.
scripture_data.text_orig: נל ד ימ נ ניתפ ריגנ ננלל רמ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (12-7) Janji TUHAN adalah janji yang murni, bagaikan perak yang teruji, tujuh kali dimurnikan dalam dapur peleburan di tanah.
scripture_data.text_en: The words of the LORD [are] pure words: [as] silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל חיפי י תי הוהי רמי ק ה יניב תקנמ ינ דמ

scripture_data.text_id: (12-8) Engkau, TUHAN, yang akan menepatinya, Engkau akan menjaga kami senantiasa terhadap angkatan ini.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt keep them, O LORD, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתב קזמ שרל ליל רצ ס תרה תרמ הוהי תרמ

scripture_data.text_id: (12-9) Orang-orang fasik berjalan ke mana-mana, sementara kebusukan muncul di antara anak-anak manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked walk on every side, when the vilest men are exalted.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל ז רהמ ר רמ הוהיה

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur Daud. (13-2) Berapa lama lagi, TUHAN, Kaulupakan aku terus-menerus? Berapa lama lagi Kausembunyikan wajah-Mu terhadap aku?
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.> How long wilt thou forget me, O LORD? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (13-3) Berapa lama lagi aku harus menaruh kekuatiran dalam diriku, dan bersedih hati sepanjang hari? Berapa lama lagi musuhku meninggikan diri atasku?
scripture_data.text_en: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, [having] sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ ינת ריס הנד חצן ינח הוהי הנד

scripture_data.text_id: (13-4) Pandanglah kiranya, jawablah aku, ya TUHAN, Allahku! Buatlah mataku bercahaya, supaya jangan aku tertidur dan mati,
scripture_data.text_en: Consider [and] hear me, O LORD my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the [sleep of] death;
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יבי רי הנד מי יבבל גי יפנ תצ תי הנד

scripture_data.text_id: (13-5) supaya musuhku jangan berkata: "Aku telah mengalahkan dia," dan lawan-lawanku bersorak-sorak, apabila aku goyah.
scripture_data.text_en: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; [and] those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: תוה י יני הריה יהל הוהי יננ היה

scripture_data.text_id: (13-6a) Tetapi aku, kepada kasih setia-Mu aku percaya, hatiku bersorak-sorak karena penyelamatan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ליגי ירצ וילכי יבי רמי

scripture_data.text_id: (13-6b) Aku mau menyanyi untuk TUHAN, karena Ia telah berbuat baik kepadaku.
scripture_data.text_en: I will sing unto the LORD, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל למג י הוהיל הרי תי יל לגי יחב סח ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari Daud. Orang bebal berkata dalam hatinya: "Tidak ada Allah." Busuk dan jijik perbuatan mereka, tidak ada yang berbuat baik.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David.> The fool hath said in his heart, [There is] no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, [there is] none that doeth good.
scripture_data.text_orig: בה י הליל ביתה תיחה יהל י ל לבנ רמ דודל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN memandang ke bawah dari sorga kepada anak-anak manusia untuk melihat, apakah ada yang berakal budi dan yang mencari Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, [and] seek God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלת ר לים יה תרל דינל יקה יממ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka semua telah menyeleweng, semuanya telah bejat; tidak ada yang berbuat baik, seorangpun tidak.
scripture_data.text_en: They are all gone aside, they are [all] together become filthy: [there is] none that doeth good, no, not one.
scripture_data.text_orig: דח י בה י חלנ וחי רס לה

scripture_data.text_id: Tidak sadarkah semua orang yang melakukan kejahatan, yang memakan habis umat-Ku seperti memakan roti, dan yang tidak berseru kepada TUHAN?
scripture_data.text_en: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people [as] they eat bread, and call not upon the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק ל הוהי חל לכ י ילכ ו ילל די לה

scripture_data.text_id: Di sanalah mereka ditimpa kekejutan yang besar, sebab Allah menyertai angkatan yang benar.
scripture_data.text_en: There were they in great fear: for God [is] in the generation of the righteous.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיץ רד יהלי דחפ דח

scripture_data.text_id: Kamu dapat mengolok-olok maksud orang yang tertindas, tetapi TUHAN adalah tempat perlindungannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the LORD [is] his refuge.
scripture_data.text_orig: הסחם הוהי י יבת ינתץ

scripture_data.text_id: Ya, datanglah kiranya dari Sion keselamatan bagi Israel! Apabila TUHAN memulihkan keadaan umat-Nya, maka Yakub akan bersorak-sorak, Israel akan bersukacita.
scripture_data.text_en: Oh that the salvation of Israel [were come] out of Zion! when the LORD bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי חמי בקי לגי תב הוהי ב לרי תי מ י ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Daud. TUHAN, siapa yang boleh menumpang dalam kemah-Mu? Siapa yang boleh diam di gunung-Mu yang kudus?
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of David.> LORD, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?
scripture_data.text_orig: דק רה יימ לה רגיימ הוהי דודל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: Yaitu dia yang berlaku tidak bercela, yang melakukan apa yang adil dan yang mengatakan kebenaran dengan segenap hatinya,
scripture_data.text_en: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: בבל תמ רבדו קדץ לפ ימ לה

scripture_data.text_id: yang tidak menyebarkan fitnah dengan lidahnya, yang tidak berbuat jahat terhadap temannya dan yang tidak menimpakan cela kepada tetangganya;
scripture_data.text_en: [He that] backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.
scripture_data.text_orig: ברקל נל הרחו הר הרל הל נלל לגרל

scripture_data.text_id: yang memandang hina orang yang tersingkir, tetapi memuliakan orang yang takut akan TUHAN; yang berpegang pada sumpah, walaupun rugi;
scripture_data.text_en: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the LORD. [He that] sweareth to [his own] hurt, and changeth not.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמי לו רהל נ דכי הוהי יריתו סמנ ויני הזבנ
