scripture_data.text_id: (31-14) Sebab aku mendengar banyak orang berbisik-bisik, ada kegentaran dari segala pihak! mereka bersama-sama bermufakat mencelakakan aku, mereka bermaksud mencabut nyawaku.
scripture_data.text_en: For I have heard the slander of many: fear [was] on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב ילכ יתייה במ תמ יחנ

scripture_data.text_id: (31-15) Tetapi aku, kepada-Mu aku percaya, ya TUHAN, aku berkata: "Engkaulah Allahku!"
scripture_data.text_en: But I trusted in thee, O LORD: I said, Thou [art] my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ממז יפן תחקל יל דחי דסה ביבמ רגמ יר ת ימ י

scripture_data.text_id: (31-16) Masa hidupku ada dalam tangan-Mu, lepaskanlah aku dari tangan musuh-musuhku dan orang-orang yang mengejar aku!
scripture_data.text_en: My times [are] in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה יהל ירמ הוהי יחב יל ינו

scripture_data.text_id: (31-17) Buatlah wajah-Mu bercahaya atas hamba-Mu, selamatkanlah aku oleh kasih setia-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies' sake.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפדרמ יבידמ ינליה ית די

scripture_data.text_id: (31-18) TUHAN, janganlah membiarkan aku mendapat malu, sebab aku berseru kepada-Mu; biarlah orang-orang fasik mendapat malu dan turun ke dunia orang mati dan bungkam.
scripture_data.text_en: Let me not be ashamed, O LORD; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, [and] let them be silent in the grave.
scripture_data.text_orig: סחב יניה בל ינפ הריה

scripture_data.text_id: (31-19) Biarlah bibir dusta menjadi kelu, yang mencaci maki orang benar dengan kecongkakan dan penghinaan!
scripture_data.text_en: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל מי יר בי יתרק י הבל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (31-20) Alangkah limpahnya kebaikan-Mu yang telah Kausimpan bagi orang yang takut akan Engkau, yang telah Kaulakukan bagi orang yang berlindung pada-Mu, di hadapan manusia!
scripture_data.text_en: [Oh] how great [is] thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; [which] thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!
scripture_data.text_orig: זבו הוג קת קיצל תרבה רק יתפ הנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (31-21) Engkau menyembunyikan mereka dalam naungan wajah-Mu terhadap persekongkolan orang-orang; Engkau melindungi mereka dalam pondok terhadap perbantahan lidah.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ינ דגנ יסחל ל ירי נפצר בבר המ

scripture_data.text_id: (31-22) Terpujilah TUHAN, sebab kasih setia-Nya ditunjukkan-Nya kepadaku dengan ajaib pada waktu kesesakan!
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [be] the LORD: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנל בירמ הס נצ י יסכרמ ינ רתס ריס

scripture_data.text_id: (31-23) Aku menyangka dalam kebingunganku: "Aku telah terbuang dari hadapan mata-Mu." Tetapi sesungguhnya Engkau mendengarkan suara permohonanku, ketika aku berteriak kepada-Mu minta tolong.
scripture_data.text_en: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: רצמ רי יל סח ילפה י הוהי ר

scripture_data.text_id: (31-24) Kasihilah TUHAN, hai semua orang yang dikasihi-Nya! TUHAN menjaga orang-orang yang setiawan, tetapi orang-orang yang berbuat congkak diganjar-Nya dengan tidak tanggung-tanggung.
scripture_data.text_en: O love the LORD, all ye his saints: [for] the LORD preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל י יננח לק מ כ יני דגמ יזרגנ יזפחב ירמ ינו

scripture_data.text_id: (31-25) Kuatkanlah dan teguhkanlah hatimu, hai semua orang yang berharap kepada TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוג ה רתיל מ הוהי רצנ ינמ וידיסחל הוהית בה

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Daud. Nyanyian pengajaran. Berbahagialah orang yang diampuni pelanggarannya, yang dosanya ditutupi!
scripture_data.text_en: <[A Psalm] of David, Maschil.> Blessed [is he whose] transgression [is] forgiven, [whose] sin [is] covered.
scripture_data.text_orig: הח יס ין יר לימ דודל

scripture_data.text_id: Berbahagialah manusia, yang kesalahannya tidak diperhitungkan TUHAN, dan yang tidak berjiwa penipu!
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [is] the man unto whom the LORD imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit [there is] no guile.
scripture_data.text_orig: המר חר יו ו ל הוהי בחי ל ד יר

scripture_data.text_id: Selama aku berdiam diri, tulang-tulangku menjadi lesu karena aku mengeluh sepanjang hari;
scripture_data.text_en: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל יתג ימצ ל ירחהי

scripture_data.text_id: sebab siang malam tangan-Mu menekan aku dengan berat, sumsumku menjadi kering, seperti oleh teriknya musim panas. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס שיק ינברח יל הן די יל דכ הלילו מי י

scripture_data.text_id: Dosaku kuberitahukan kepada-Mu dan kesalahanku tidaklah kusembunyikan; aku berkata: "Aku akan mengaku kepada TUHAN pelanggaran-pelanggaranku," dan Engkau mengampuni kesalahan karena dosaku. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the LORD; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יתח ו תנ הו הוהיל יפ יל הד ירמ יתיכל ינוו יד יתח

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu hendaklah setiap orang saleh berdoa kepada-Mu, selagi Engkau dapat ditemui; sesungguhnya pada waktu banjir besar terjadi, itu tidak melandanya.
scripture_data.text_en: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.
scripture_data.text_orig: יי ל ויל יר ימ ל קר צמ תל יל דיסחל לתי תזל

scripture_data.text_id: Engkaulah persembunyian bagiku, terhadap kesesakan Engkau menjaga aku, Engkau mengelilingi aku, sehingga aku luput dan bersorak. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thou [art] my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ינבבס ף יר ינר רמ יל רתס ה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku hendak mengajar dan menunjukkan kepadamu jalan yang harus kautempuh; Aku hendak memberi nasihat, mata-Ku tertuju kepadamu.
scripture_data.text_en: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.
scripture_data.text_orig: יני יל הצי לת זרד רו לי

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah seperti kuda atau bagal yang tidak berakal, yang kegarangannya harus dikendalikan dengan tali les dan kekang, kalau tidak, ia tidak akan mendekati engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: Be ye not as the horse, [or] as the mule, [which] have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ברק ל לבל יד סרוגתמ יבה י דרפ סס יהל

scripture_data.text_id: Banyak kesakitan diderita orang fasik, tetapi orang percaya kepada TUHAN dikelilingi-Nya dengan kasih setia.
scripture_data.text_en: Many sorrows [shall be] to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the LORD, mercy shall compass him about.
scripture_data.text_orig: בבסי דסח הוהי חהו רל יבכם יר

scripture_data.text_id: Bersukacitalah dalam TUHAN dan bersorak-soraklah, hai orang-orang benar; bersorak-sorailah, hai orang-orang jujur!
scripture_data.text_en: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all [ye that are] upright in heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: בליריל נינרהו יקיץ ליגו הוהיב חמ

scripture_data.text_id: Bersorak-sorailah, hai orang-orang benar, dalam TUHAN! Sebab memuji-muji itu layak bagi orang-orang jujur.
scripture_data.text_en: Rejoice in the LORD, O ye righteous: [for] praise is comely for the upright.
scripture_data.text_orig: ההת הונ יריל הוהי יקיצ נר

scripture_data.text_id: Bersyukurlah kepada TUHAN dengan kecapi, bermazmurlah bagi-Nya dengan gambus sepuluh tali!
scripture_data.text_en: Praise the LORD with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery [and] an instrument of ten strings.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרז ר לבנ רכ הוהיל דה

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyikanlah bagi-Nya nyanyian baru; petiklah kecapi baik-baik dengan sorak-sorai!
scripture_data.text_en: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרת נ בייה דח רי לרי

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab firman TUHAN itu benar, segala sesuatu dikerjakan-Nya dengan kesetiaan.
scripture_data.text_en: For the word of the LORD [is] right; and all his works [are done] in truth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנמ המלכו הוהירב ריי

scripture_data.text_id: Ia senang kepada keadilan dan hukum; bumi penuh dengan kasih setia TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: He loveth righteousness and judgment: the earth is full of the goodness of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה הלמ הוהי דסח מ הקדץ בה

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh firman TUHAN langit telah dijadikan, oleh nafas dari mulut-Nya segala tentaranya.
scripture_data.text_en: By the word of the LORD were the heavens made; and all the host of them by the breath of his mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: בצל וי חרב ן ימ הוהי רבד

scripture_data.text_id: Ia mengumpulkan air laut seperti dalam bendungan, Ia menaruh samudera raya ke dalam wadah.
scripture_data.text_en: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמה תרצ תנ ה ימ ד סנ

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah segenap bumi takut kepada TUHAN, biarlah semua penduduk dunia gentar terhadap Dia!
scripture_data.text_en: Let all the earth fear the LORD: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.
scripture_data.text_orig: לבת יביל רגי מ שרהל הוהימ ריי

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Dia berfirman, maka semuanya jadi; Dia memberi perintah, maka semuanya ada.
scripture_data.text_en: For he spake, and it was [done]; he commanded, and it stood fast.
scripture_data.text_orig: דמו הצה יהו רמ ה י

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN menggagalkan rencana bangsa-bangsa; Ia meniadakan rancangan suku-suku bangsa;
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.
scripture_data.text_orig: י תבחם ינה יתץ ריפה הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: tetapi rencana TUHAN tetap selama-lamanya, rancangan hati-Nya turun-temurun.
scripture_data.text_en: The counsel of the LORD standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדו רדל ל תבחם דמ לל הוהי תצ

scripture_data.text_id: Berbahagialah bangsa, yang Allahnya ialah TUHAN, suku bangsa yang dipilih-Nya menjadi milik-Nya sendiri!
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [is] the nation whose God [is] the LORD; [and] the people [whom] he hath chosen for his own inheritance.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל הלחנל רח ה ויהל הוהיר יה יר

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN memandang dari sorga, Ia melihat semua anak manusia;
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.
scripture_data.text_orig: דה ינלת הר הוהי יה יממ

scripture_data.text_id: dari tempat kediaman-Nya Ia menilik semua penduduk bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה יביל ל חיה בכמ

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang membentuk hati mereka sekalian, yang memperhatikan segala pekerjaan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.
scripture_data.text_orig: הימלל יבה ל דחי רצה

scripture_data.text_id: Seorang raja tidak akan selamat oleh besarnya kuasa; seorang pahlawan tidak akan tertolong oleh besarnya kekuatan.
scripture_data.text_en: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.
scripture_data.text_orig: חבר לציל ר ליחבר ן להי

scripture_data.text_id: Kuda adalah harapan sia-sia untuk mencapai kemenangan, yang sekalipun besar ketangkasannya tidak dapat memberi keluputan.
scripture_data.text_en: An horse [is] a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver [any] by his great strength.
scripture_data.text_orig: מי ל ליח ברב התל סה רק

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, mata TUHAN tertuju kepada mereka yang takut akan Dia, kepada mereka yang berharap akan kasih setia-Nya,
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, the eye of the LORD [is] upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;
scripture_data.text_orig: סחל ילחימל ויריל הוהי י הה

scripture_data.text_id: untuk melepaskan jiwa mereka dari pada maut dan memelihara hidup mereka pada masa kelaparan.
scripture_data.text_en: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר תחל פן תומ ליהל

scripture_data.text_id: Jiwa kita menanti-nantikan TUHAN. Dialah penolong kita dan perisai kita!
scripture_data.text_en: Our soul waiteth for the LORD: he [is] our help and our shield.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה נגמ נרז הוהיל התח נפנ

scripture_data.text_id: Ya, karena Dia hati kita bersukacita, sebab kepada nama-Nya yang kudus kita percaya.
scripture_data.text_en: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: נחב דק ב י נל חמי בי

scripture_data.text_id: Kasih setia-Mu, ya TUHAN, kiranya menyertai kami, seperti kami berharap kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Let thy mercy, O LORD, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל נלחי ר ניל הוהי סחיהי

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Daud, pada waktu ia pura-pura tidak waras pikirannya di depan Abimelekh, sehingga ia diusir, lalu pergi. (34-2) Aku hendak memuji TUHAN pada segala waktu; puji-pujian kepada-Nya tetap di dalam mulutku.
scripture_data.text_en: <[A Psalm] of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed.> I will bless the LORD at all times: his praise [shall] continually [be] in my mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: לו הרגיו למיב ינפל מת ת דודל

scripture_data.text_id: (34-3) Karena TUHAN jiwaku bermegah; biarlah orang-orang yang rendah hati mendengarnya dan bersukacita.
scripture_data.text_en: My soul shall make her boast in the LORD: the humble shall hear [thereof], and be glad.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפ תה דימ תלכ הוהית הכרב

scripture_data.text_id: (34-4) Muliakanlah TUHAN bersama-sama dengan aku, marilah kita bersama-sama memasyhurkan nama-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: O magnify the LORD with me, and let us exalt his name together.
scripture_data.text_orig: חמיו יונ מי יפן להת הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (34-5) Aku telah mencari TUHAN, lalu Ia menjawab aku, dan melepaskan aku dari segala kegentaranku.
scripture_data.text_en: I sought the LORD, and he heard me, and delivered me from all my fears.
scripture_data.text_orig: וחי מ הממרנ י הוהיל ל

scripture_data.text_id: (34-6) Tujukanlah pandanganmu kepada-Nya, maka mukamu akan berseri-seri, dan tidak akan malu tersipu-sipu.
scripture_data.text_en: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינליה יתרגמלמ יננו הוהית יר

scripture_data.text_id: (34-7) Orang yang tertindas ini berseru, dan TUHAN mendengar; Ia menyelamatkan dia dari segala kesesakannya.
scripture_data.text_en: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard [him], and saved him out of all his troubles.
scripture_data.text_orig: רחיל הינפ רהנו ויל יה

scripture_data.text_id: (34-8) Malaikat TUHAN berkemah di sekeliling orang-orang yang takut akan Dia, lalu meluputkan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: The angel of the LORD encampeth round about them that fear him, and delivereth them.
scripture_data.text_orig: יה ויתרצלמ מ הוהיו רק ינ הז

scripture_data.text_id: (34-9) Kecaplah dan lihatlah, betapa baiknya TUHAN itu! Berbahagialah orang yang berlindung pada-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: O taste and see that the LORD [is] good: blessed [is] the man [that] trusteth in him.
scripture_data.text_orig: צחיו ויריל ביבס הוהילם הנח

scripture_data.text_id: (34-10) Takutlah akan TUHAN, hai orang-orang-Nya yang kudus, sebab tidak berkekurangan orang yang takut akan Dia!
scripture_data.text_en: O fear the LORD, ye his saints: for [there is] no want to them that fear him.
scripture_data.text_orig: הסחי רבה יר הוהי בי ר מ

scripture_data.text_id: (34-11) Singa-singa muda merana kelaparan, tetapi orang-orang yang mencari TUHAN, tidak kekurangan sesuatupun yang baik.
scripture_data.text_en: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the LORD shall not want any good [thing].
scripture_data.text_orig: ויריל רסחמ יי וידק הוהית רי

scripture_data.text_id: (34-12) Marilah anak-anak, dengarkanlah aku, takut akan TUHAN akan kuajarkan kepadamu!
scripture_data.text_en: Come, ye children, hearken unto me: I will teach you the fear of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: בלכ רסחיל הוהי ירדו ברו ר יריפ

scripture_data.text_id: (34-13) Siapakah orang yang menyukai hidup, yang mengingini umur panjang untuk menikmati yang baik?
scripture_data.text_en: What man [is he that] desireth life, [and] loveth [many] days, that he may see good?
scripture_data.text_orig: כדל הוהי תרי ילמ ינבכל

scripture_data.text_id: (34-14) Jagalah lidahmu terhadap yang jahat dan bibirmu terhadap ucapan-ucapan yang menipu;
scripture_data.text_en: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב תרל ימי בה יח שפחה יהימ

scripture_data.text_id: (34-15) jauhilah yang jahat dan lakukanlah yang baik, carilah perdamaian dan berusahalah mendapatkannya!
scripture_data.text_en: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.
scripture_data.text_orig: המרמ רמ יתפ רמ נל רצן

scripture_data.text_id: (34-16) Mata TUHAN tertuju kepada orang-orang benar, dan telinga-Nya kepada teriak mereka minta tolong;
scripture_data.text_en: The eyes of the LORD [are] upon the righteous, and his ears [are open] unto their cry.
scripture_data.text_orig: הפדרו ל בהו רמ רס

scripture_data.text_id: (34-17) wajah TUHAN menentang orang-orang yang berbuat jahat untuk melenyapkan ingatan kepada mereka dari muka bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: The face of the LORD [is] against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תול וינזו יקיצל הוהי יני

scripture_data.text_id: (34-18) Apabila orang-orang benar itu berseru-seru, maka TUHAN mendengar, dan melepaskan mereka dari segala kesesakannya.
scripture_data.text_en: [The righteous] cry, and the LORD heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכז שרמ תירכהל ר י הוהי ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (34-19) TUHAN itu dekat kepada orang-orang yang patah hati, dan Ia menyelamatkan orang-orang yang remuk jiwanya.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליה תרצלמ מ הוהיו קצ

scripture_data.text_id: (34-20) Kemalangan orang benar banyak, tetapi TUHAN melepaskan dia dari semuanya itu;
scripture_data.text_en: Many [are] the afflictions of the righteous: but the LORD delivereth him out of them all.
scripture_data.text_orig: יי חריתו בלירנל הוהי ברק

scripture_data.text_id: (34-21) Ia melindungi segala tulangnya, tidak satupun yang patah.
scripture_data.text_en: He keepeth all his bones: not one of them is broken.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ליי מ קיץ תר תר

scripture_data.text_id: (34-22) Kemalangan akan mematikan orang fasik, dan siapa yang membenci orang benar akan menanggung hukuman.
scripture_data.text_en: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרנ ל ההמ תח ויתמצל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: (34-23) TUHAN membebaskan jiwa hamba-hamba-Nya, dan semua orang yang berlindung pada-Nya tidak akan menanggung hukuman.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.
scripture_data.text_orig: מי קיץ ינו הר ר תתמ

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Daud. Berbantahlah, TUHAN, melawan orang yang berbantah dengan aku, berperanglah melawan orang yang berperang melawan aku!
scripture_data.text_en: <[A Psalm] of David.> Plead [my cause], O LORD, with them that strive with me: fight against them that fight against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימחלת חל יבירית הוהי הביר דודל

scripture_data.text_id: Peganglah perisai dan utar-utar, bangunlah menolong aku,
scripture_data.text_en: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for mine help.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתרז המקו הצו גמ קזחה

scripture_data.text_id: cabutlah tombak dan kapak menghadapi orang-orang yang mengejar aku; katakanlah kepada jiwaku: "Akulah keselamatanmu!"
scripture_data.text_en: Draw out also the spear, and stop [the way] against them that persecute me: say unto my soul, I [am] thy salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ תי יפנל רמ יפדר תרקל רגס תינח קרהו

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah mendapat malu dan kena noda, orang-orang yang ingin mencabut nyawaku; biarlah mundur dan tersipu-sipu orang-orang yang merancang kecelakaanku!
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתר יבח רחיו רח גי יפנ יקבם מליו בי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah mereka seperti sekam dibawa angin, didorong Malaikat TUHAN;
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be as chaff before the wind: and let the angel of the LORD chase [them].
scripture_data.text_orig: הח הוהי למ חרינפל שמ יהי

scripture_data.text_id: biarlah jalan mereka gelap dan licin, dan Malaikat TUHAN mengejar mereka!
scripture_data.text_en: Let their way be dark and slippery: and let the angel of the LORD persecute them.
scripture_data.text_orig: פדר הוהי למ תלקלחו ח רדיהי

scripture_data.text_id: Karena tanpa alasan mereka memasang jaring terhadap aku, tanpa alasan mereka menggali pelubang untuk nyawaku.
scripture_data.text_en: For without cause have they hid for me their net [in] a pit, [which] without cause they have digged for my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפנל רפח ח ר תח ילנמ חי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah kebinasaan mendatangi dia dengan tidak disangka-sangka, jerat yang dipasangnya, biarlah menangkap dia sendiri, biarlah ia jatuh dan musnah!
scripture_data.text_en: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.
scripture_data.text_orig: לי ה דל מר רו דיל ה הב

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi aku bersorak-sorak karena TUHAN, aku girang karena keselamatan dari pada-Nya;
scripture_data.text_en: And my soul shall be joyful in the LORD: it shall rejoice in his salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי י הוהי ליג יפנו

scripture_data.text_id: segala tulangku berkata: "Ya, TUHAN, siapakah yang seperti Engkau, yang melepaskan orang sengsara dari tangan orang yang lebih kuat dari padanya, orang sengsara dan miskin dari tangan orang yang merampasi dia?"
scripture_data.text_en: All my bones shall say, LORD, who [is] like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?
scripture_data.text_orig: לזמ יבו ינו מ קזחמ ינ לים מכ ימ הוהי הנרמ יתמץ ל

scripture_data.text_id: Saksi-saksi yang gemar kekerasan bangkit berdiri, apa yang tidak kuketahui, itulah yang mereka tuntut dari padaku.
scripture_data.text_en: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge [things] that I knew not.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינלי ידיל ר סמח יד מקי

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka membalas kebaikanku dengan kejahatan; perasaan bulus mencekam aku.
scripture_data.text_en: They rewarded me evil for good [to] the spoiling of my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפנל לכ הב תח הר ינמי

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi aku, ketika mereka sakit, aku memakai pakaian kabung; aku menyiksa diriku dengan berpuasa, dan doaku kembali timbul dalam dadaku,
scripture_data.text_en: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing [was] sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.
scripture_data.text_orig: בת יקיחל יתפת יפן ב יתי ק יבל תלח ינו

scripture_data.text_id: seolah-olah temanku atau saudarakulah yang sakit, demikianlah aku berlaku; seperti orang yang berkeluh kesah karena kematian ibu, demikianlah aku tunduk dengan pakaian kabung.
scripture_data.text_en: I behaved myself as though [he had been] my friend [or] brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth [for his] mother.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתח רדק לב יכהתה יל חר

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi ketika aku tersandung jatuh, bersukacitalah mereka dan berkerumun, berkerumun melawan aku; orang-orang asing yang tidak kukenal menista aku dengan tidak henti-hentinya;
scripture_data.text_en: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: [yea], the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew [it] not; they did tear [me], and ceased not:
scripture_data.text_orig: דלו רק ידי לו יכנ יל פסן פסנו חמ ילצב

scripture_data.text_id: dengan fasik mereka mengolok-olok terus, menggertakkan giginya terhadap aku.
scripture_data.text_en: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.
scripture_data.text_orig: מי יל קרח גמ יגל יפנח

scripture_data.text_id: Sampai berapa lama, Tuhan, Engkau memandangi saja? Selamatkanlah jiwaku dari perusakan mereka, nyawaku dari singa-singa muda!
scripture_data.text_en: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתדיחי יריפמ הימ יפנ הביה הר ה ינד

scripture_data.text_id: Aku mau menyanyikan syukur kepada-Mu dalam jemaah yang besar, di tengah-tengah rakyat yang banyak aku mau memuji-muji Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.
scripture_data.text_orig: שללה צ בר להק ד

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah sekali-kali bersukacita atas aku orang-orang yang memusuhi aku tanpa sebab, atau mengedip-ngedipkan mata orang-orang yang membenci aku tanpa alasan.
scripture_data.text_en: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: [neither] let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.
scripture_data.text_orig: יצרקי ח ינ רק יבי ילחמיל

scripture_data.text_id: Karena mereka tidak membicarakan damai, dan terhadap orang-orang yang rukun di negeri mereka merancangkan penipuan,
scripture_data.text_en: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against [them that are] quiet in the land.
scripture_data.text_orig: בחי תמרמ ירב שריגר לו רדי ל ל י

scripture_data.text_id: mereka membuka mulutnya lebar-lebar terhadap aku dan berkata: "Syukur, syukur, mata kami telah melihatnya!"
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, [and] said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ניני התר חה חה רמ הי יל ביחרו

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau telah melihatnya, TUHAN, janganlah berdiam diri, ya Tuhan, janganlah jauh dari padaku!
scripture_data.text_en: [This] thou hast seen, O LORD: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ קחרל ינד רחל הוהי התיר

scripture_data.text_id: Terjagalah dan bangunlah membela hakku, membela perkaraku, ya Allahku dan Tuhanku!
scripture_data.text_en: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, [even] unto my cause, my God and my Lord.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבירל ינדו יהל ימל הציקהו הריה

scripture_data.text_id: Hakimilah aku sesuai dengan keadilan-Mu, ya TUHAN Allahku, supaya mereka jangan bersukacita atasku!
scripture_data.text_en: Judge me, O LORD my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילחמילו יהל הוהי קדצכ ינפ

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah mereka berkata dalam hatinya: "Syukur, itulah keinginan kami!" Dan janganlah mereka berkata: "Kami telah menelannya!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנ רמיל נפן חה לב רמיל

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah bersama-sama mendapat malu dan tersipu-sipu orang-orang yang bersukacita atas kemalanganku; biarlah berpakaian malu dan noda orang-orang yang membesarkan dirinya terhadap aku!
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify [themselves] against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יליגה הלכ תבלי יתר יחמ וחי רחיו בי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah bersorak-sorai dan bersukacita orang-orang yang ingin melihat aku dibenarkan! Biarlah mereka tetap berkata: "TUHAN itu besar, Dia menginginkan keselamatan hamba-Nya!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the LORD be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב ל שפחה הוהי לגי דימת רמיו יקדצ יצפח חמיו רי

scripture_data.text_id: Dan lidahku akan menyebut-nyebut keadilan-Mu, memuji-muji Engkau sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness [and] of thy praise all the day long.
scripture_data.text_orig: תה הל קדצ הה ינל

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari hamba TUHAN, dari Daud. (36-2) Dosa bertutur di lubuk hati orang fasik; rasa takut kepada Allah tidak ada pada orang itu,
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David the servant of the LORD.> The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, [that there is] no fear of God before his eyes.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל הוהידבל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (36-3) sebab ia membujuk dirinya, sampai orang mendapati kesalahannya dan membencinya.
scripture_data.text_en: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויני דגנל יהל דחי יל ברק רל ן

scripture_data.text_id: (36-4) Perkataan dari mulutnya ialah kejahatan dan tipu daya, ia berhenti berlaku bijaksana dan berbuat baik.
scripture_data.text_en: The words of his mouth [are] iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, [and] to do good.
scripture_data.text_orig: נל נו צמל ויני ויל קילחהי

scripture_data.text_id: (36-5) Kejahatan dirancangkannya di tempat tidurnya, ia menempatkan dirinya di jalan yang tidak baik; apa yang jahat tidak ditolaknya.
scripture_data.text_en: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way [that is] not good; he abhorreth not evil.
scripture_data.text_orig: בייהל ליהל לדח המרמ ו ויפירב

scripture_data.text_id: (36-6) Ya TUHAN, kasih-Mu sampai ke langit, setia-Mu sampai ke awan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy mercy, O LORD, [is] in the heavens; [and] thy faithfulness [reacheth] unto the clouds.
scripture_data.text_orig: סמי ל ר בל רל ביתי במל בחי ו

scripture_data.text_id: (36-7) Keadilan-Mu adalah seperti gunung-gunung Allah, hukum-Mu bagaikan samudera raya yang hebat. Manusia dan hewan Kauselamatkan, ya TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy righteousness [is] like the great mountains; thy judgments [are] a great deep: O LORD, thou preservest man and beast.
scripture_data.text_orig: יקחד תנמ סח ימה הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (36-8) Betapa berharganya kasih setia-Mu, ya Allah! Anak-anak manusia berlindung dalam naungan sayap-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: How excellent [is] thy lovingkindness, O God! therefore the children of men put their trust under the shadow of thy wings.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ית המהבד הר ה מ ליררה תקדצ

scripture_data.text_id: (36-9) Mereka mengenyangkan dirinya dengan lemak di rumah-Mu; Engkau memberi mereka minum dari sungai kesenangan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.
scripture_data.text_orig: יסחי יפנ לצ ד ינב יהל סח רקהם

scripture_data.text_id: (36-10) Sebab pada-Mu ada sumber hayat, di dalam terang-Mu kami melihat terang.
scripture_data.text_en: For with thee [is] the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.
scripture_data.text_orig: קת ינד לחנו תי מ יורי

scripture_data.text_id: (36-11) Lanjutkanlah kasih setia-Mu bagi orang yang mengenal Engkau, dan keadilan-Mu bagi orang yang tulus hati!
scripture_data.text_en: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהרנ ר יח רקם י

scripture_data.text_id: (36-12) Janganlah kiranya kaki orang-orang congkak menginjak aku, dan tangan orang fasik mengusir aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.
scripture_data.text_orig: בליריל תקדצו ידיל סח ם

scripture_data.text_id: (36-13) Lihat, orang-orang yang melakukan kejahatan itu jatuh; mereka dibanting dan tidak dapat bangun lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינדנל ירדיו הו לגר ינבל

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Daud. Jangan marah karena orang yang berbuat jahat, jangan iri hati kepada orang yang berbuat curang;
scripture_data.text_en: <[A Psalm] of David.> Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלו י קל יר רחתל דודל

scripture_data.text_id: sebab mereka segera lisut seperti rumput dan layu seperti tumbuh-tumbuhan hijau.
scripture_data.text_en: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.
scripture_data.text_orig: לי קריכ לי הרהם ריצחכ י

scripture_data.text_id: Percayalah kepada TUHAN dan lakukanlah yang baik, diamlah di negeri dan berlakulah setia,
scripture_data.text_en: Trust in the LORD, and do good; [so] shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנמ הר שרכ בהו הוהי ח

scripture_data.text_id: dan bergembiralah karena TUHAN; maka Ia akan memberikan kepadamu apa yang diinginkan hatimu.
scripture_data.text_en: Delight thyself also in the LORD; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תלמ ליו הוהיל גתהו

scripture_data.text_id: Serahkanlah hidupmu kepada TUHAN dan percayalah kepada-Nya, dan Ia akan bertindak;
scripture_data.text_en: Commit thy way unto the LORD; trust also in him; and he shall bring [it] to pass.
scripture_data.text_orig: הי הו ויל חב ר הוהיל ל

scripture_data.text_id: Ia akan memunculkan kebenaranmu seperti terang, dan hakmu seperti siang.
scripture_data.text_en: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירה מ קדצ רכ יצהו

scripture_data.text_id: Berdiam dirilah di hadapan TUHAN dan nantikanlah Dia; jangan marah karena orang yang berhasil dalam hidupnya, karena orang yang melakukan tipu daya.
scripture_data.text_en: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.
scripture_data.text_orig: תזם ה י ר חילצמ רחתל ל ללחתהו הוהיל

scripture_data.text_id: Berhentilah marah dan tinggalkanlah panas hati itu, jangan marah, itu hanya membawa kepada kejahatan.
scripture_data.text_en: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath: fret not thyself in any wise to do evil.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהל רחתל המח בזו מ רה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab orang-orang yang berbuat jahat akan dilenyapkan, tetapi orang-orang yang menanti-nantikan TUHAN akan mewarisi negeri.
scripture_data.text_en: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the LORD, they shall inherit the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרריי הה הוהי יוקו תרי ירמי

scripture_data.text_id: Karena sedikit waktu lagi, maka lenyaplah orang fasik; jika engkau memperhatikan tempatnya, maka ia sudah tidak ada lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: For yet a little while, and the wicked [shall] not [be]: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it [shall] not [be].
scripture_data.text_orig: ניו מקמל ננתהו ר יו מ דו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi orang-orang yang rendah hati akan mewarisi negeri dan bergembira karena kesejahteraan yang berlimpah-limpah.
scripture_data.text_en: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ברל גתהו שרריי יונו

scripture_data.text_id: Orang fasik merencanakan kejahatan terhadap orang benar dan menggertakkan giginya terhadap dia;
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.
scripture_data.text_orig: וי ויל קרחו קיל ר מז

scripture_data.text_id: Tuhan menertawakan orang fasik itu, sebab Ia melihat bahwa harinya sudah dekat.
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord shall laugh at him: for he seeth that his day is coming.
scripture_data.text_orig: מי ביי הרי לקחי ינד

scripture_data.text_id: Orang-orang fasik menghunus pedang dan melentur busur mereka untuk merobohkan orang-orang sengsara dan orang-orang miskin, untuk membunuh orang-orang yang hidup jujur;
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, [and] to slay such as be of upright conversation.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדירי חבל יבו ינ ליהל ק כרדו יר חת ברח

scripture_data.text_id: tetapi pedang mereka akan menikam dada mereka sendiri, dan busur mereka akan dipatahkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנרב תתקו לב ב רח

scripture_data.text_id: Lebih baik yang sedikit pada orang benar dari pada yang berlimpah-limpah pada orang fasik;
scripture_data.text_en: A little that a righteous man hath [is] better than the riches of many wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר יר מהמ קיל מב

scripture_data.text_id: sebab lengan orang-orang fasik dipatahkan, tetapi TUHAN menopang orang-orang benar.
scripture_data.text_en: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the LORD upholdeth the righteous.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יקיץ מסו הנרב יר תרז י

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN mengetahui hari-hari orang yang saleh, dan milik pusaka mereka akan tetap selama-lamanya;
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: היה לל תלחנו מימת ימי הוהי די

scripture_data.text_id: mereka tidak akan mendapat malu pada waktu kecelakaan, dan mereka akan menjadi kenyang pada hari-hari kelaparan.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.
scripture_data.text_orig: י בר ימיב הר ת ביל

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, orang-orang fasik akan binasa; musuh TUHAN seperti keindahan padang rumput: mereka habis lenyap, habis lenyap bagaikan asap.
scripture_data.text_en: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the LORD [shall be] as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ב ל יר רקי הוהי יביו דבי יר י

scripture_data.text_id: Orang fasik meminjam dan tidak membayar kembali, tetapi orang benar adalah pengasih dan pemurah.
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנו נח קיצו י לו ר הול

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, orang-orang yang diberkati-Nya akan mewarisi negeri, tetapi orang-orang yang dikutuki-Nya akan dilenyapkan.
scripture_data.text_en: For [such as be] blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and [they that be] cursed of him shall be cut off.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרי וילקמ שר ריי ויכרבמ י

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN menetapkan langkah-langkah orang yang hidupnya berkenan kepada-Nya;
scripture_data.text_en: The steps of a [good] man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
scripture_data.text_orig: שחי רדו ננ רבגידצמ הוהימ

scripture_data.text_id: apabila ia jatuh, tidaklah sampai tergeletak, sebab TUHAN menopang tangannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the LORD upholdeth [him with] his hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: די מס הוהיי ליל ליי

scripture_data.text_id: Dahulu aku muda, sekarang telah menjadi tua, tetapi tidak pernah kulihat orang benar ditinggalkan, atau anak cucunya meminta-minta roti;
scripture_data.text_en: I have been young, and [now] am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.
scripture_data.text_orig: חלבם רזו בזן קיץ יתירלו ינקז יתייה רנ

scripture_data.text_id: tiap hari ia menaruh belas kasihan dan memberi pinjaman, dan anak cucunya menjadi berkat.
scripture_data.text_en: [He is] ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed [is] blessed.
scripture_data.text_orig: הכרבל רזו הולמ נח הל

scripture_data.text_id: Jauhilah yang jahat dan lakukanlah yang baik, maka engkau akan tetap tinggal untuk selama-lamanya;
scripture_data.text_en: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל כ בהו רמ רס

scripture_data.text_id: sebab TUHAN mencintai hukum, dan Ia tidak meninggalkan orang-orang yang dikasihi-Nya. Sampai selama-lamanya mereka akan terpelihara, tetapi anak cucu orang-orang fasik akan dilenyapkan.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD loveth judgment, and forsaketh not his saints; they are preserved for ever: but the seed of the wicked shall be cut off.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרכנ יר רזו רמנ לל וידיסחת בזילו מ בה הוהי י

scripture_data.text_id: Orang-orang benar akan mewarisi negeri dan tinggal di sana senantiasa.
scripture_data.text_en: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: היל דל ניו שרריי יקיץ

scripture_data.text_id: Mulut orang benar mengucapkan hikmat, dan lidahnya mengatakan hukum;
scripture_data.text_en: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ רד נל המכח ההי קיצי

scripture_data.text_id: Taurat Allahnya ada di dalam hatinya, langkah-langkahnya tidak goyah.
scripture_data.text_en: The law of his God [is] in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויר דמת ל ל ויהל תר

scripture_data.text_id: Orang fasik mengintai orang benar dan berikhtiar membunuhnya;
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.
scripture_data.text_orig: תימהל במ קיל ר הפץ

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN tidak menyerahkan orang benar itu ke dalam tangannya, Ia tidak membiarkannya dinyatakan fasik pada waktu diadili.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.
scripture_data.text_orig: פה ירי לו דיב בזיל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Nantikanlah TUHAN dan tetap ikutilah jalan-Nya, maka Ia akan mengangkat engkau untuk mewarisi negeri, dan engkau akan melihat orang-orang fasik dilenyapkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Wait on the LORD, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: הר יר תרה שר תרל ממריו ר רמ הוהיל הק

scripture_data.text_id: Aku melihat seorang fasik yang gagah sombong, yang tumbuh mekar seperti pohon aras Libanon;
scripture_data.text_en: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.
scripture_data.text_orig: נר חרז הרתמ שיר ר יתיר

scripture_data.text_id: ketika aku lewat, lenyaplah ia, aku mencarinya, tetapi tidak ditemui.
scripture_data.text_en: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he [was] not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.
scripture_data.text_orig: צמנ לו הקבו ני ההו רבו

scripture_data.text_id: Perhatikanlah orang yang tulus dan lihatlah kepada orang yang jujur, sebab pada orang yang suka damai akan ada masa depan;
scripture_data.text_en: Mark the perfect [man], and behold the upright: for the end of [that] man [is] peace.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל יל תירחי רי הר רמ

scripture_data.text_id: tetapi pendurhaka-pendurhaka akan dibinasakan bersama-sama, dan masa depan orang-orang fasik akan dilenyapkan.
scripture_data.text_en: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.
scripture_data.text_orig: התרכנ יר תירח וחי דמנ יפ

scripture_data.text_id: Orang-orang benar diselamatkan oleh TUHAN; Ia adalah tempat perlindungan mereka pada waktu kesesakan;
scripture_data.text_en: But the salvation of the righteous [is] of the LORD: [he is] their strength in the time of trouble.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרצ ת מ הוהימ יקיצ תת

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN menolong mereka dan meluputkan mereka, Ia meluputkan mereka dari tangan orang-orang fasik dan menyelamatkan mereka, sebab mereka berlindung pada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: And the LORD shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב סחי ייו ירמ פי פיו הוהי רזו

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Daud pada waktu mempersembahkan korban peringatan. (38-2) TUHAN, janganlah menghukum aku dalam geram-Mu, dan janganlah menghajar aku dalam kepanasan murka-Mu;
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance.> O LORD, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.
scripture_data.text_orig: ריזהל דודל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: (38-3) sebab anak panah-Mu menembus aku, tangan-Mu telah turun menimpa aku.
scripture_data.text_en: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינרית תמחב ינחיכת צקל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (38-4) Tidak ada yang sehat pada dagingku oleh karena amarah-Mu, tidak ada yang selamat pada tulang-tulangku oleh karena dosaku;
scripture_data.text_en: [There is] no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither [is there any] rest in my bones because of my sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: די יל תחנו יב תחנ יחי

scripture_data.text_id: (38-5) sebab kesalahanku telah menimpa kepalaku; semuanya seperti beban berat yang menjadi terlalu berat bagiku.
scripture_data.text_en: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתח ינמ ימצ לי מז ינמ ירב תמי

scripture_data.text_id: (38-6) Luka-lukaku berbau busuk, bernanah oleh karena kebodohanku;
scripture_data.text_en: My wounds stink [and] are corrupt because of my foolishness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ דכי דבכ מ יר רב יתנו י

scripture_data.text_id: (38-7) aku terbungkuk-bungkuk, sangat tertunduk; sepanjang hari aku berjalan dengan dukacita.
scripture_data.text_en: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ינמ יתרח מנ יבה

scripture_data.text_id: (38-8) Sebab pinggangku penuh radang, tidak ada yang sehat pada dagingku;
scripture_data.text_en: For my loins are filled with a loathsome [disease]: and [there is] no soundness in my flesh.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכה רדק הל דמד יתח יתיון

scripture_data.text_id: (38-9) aku kehabisan tenaga dan remuk redam, aku merintih karena degap-degup jantungku.
scripture_data.text_en: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירב תמ יו הלקנ למ ילסכי

scripture_data.text_id: (38-10) Tuhan, Engkau mengetahui segala keinginanku, dan keluhkupun tidak tersembunyi bagi-Mu;
scripture_data.text_en: Lord, all my desire [is] before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל תמהמ יג דמד יתידנו יתגפן

scripture_data.text_id: (38-11) jantungku berdebar-debar, kekuatanku hilang, dan cahaya matakupun lenyap dari padaku.
scripture_data.text_en: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרסנל מ יתחנו יתולכ גן ינד

scripture_data.text_id: (38-12) Sahabat-sahabatku dan teman-temanku menyisih karena penyakitku, dan sanak saudaraku menjauh.
scripture_data.text_en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.
scripture_data.text_orig: י י ה ינירו יחכ ינבז רחרחס יל

scripture_data.text_id: (38-13) Orang-orang yang ingin mencabut nyawaku memasang jerat, orang-orang yang mengikhtiarkan celakaku, memikirkan kehancuran dan merancangkan tipu daya sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: They also that seek after my life lay snares [for me]: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.
scripture_data.text_orig: דמ קחרמ יברק דמי יגנ דגמ ירו יבה

scripture_data.text_id: (38-14) Tetapi aku ini seperti orang tuli, aku tidak mendengar, seperti orang bisu yang tidak membuka mulutnya;
scripture_data.text_en: But I, as a deaf [man], heard not; and [I was] as a dumb man [that] openeth not his mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הי הל תמרמ תה ר יתר ירדו יפן יקבם קניו

scripture_data.text_id: (38-15) ya, aku ini seperti orang yang tidak mendengar, yang tak ada bantahan dalam mulutnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth [are] no reproofs.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויחפי ל כ מ ל רחכ ינו

scripture_data.text_id: (38-16) Sebab kepada-Mu, ya TUHAN, aku berharap; Engkaulah yang akan menjawab, ya Tuhan, Allahku.
scripture_data.text_en: For in thee, O LORD, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: תחכ ויפ יו מל ר י יהו

scripture_data.text_id: (38-17) Pikirku: "Asal mereka jangan beria-ria karena aku, jangan membesarkan diri terhadap aku apabila kakiku goyah!"
scripture_data.text_en: For I said, [Hear me], lest [otherwise] they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify [themselves] against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל ינד הנת ה ילחה הוהי לי

scripture_data.text_id: (38-18) Sebab aku mulai jatuh karena tersandung, dan aku selalu dirundung kesakitan;
scripture_data.text_en: For I [am] ready to halt, and my sorrow [is] continually before me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליגה יל ילגר מ ילחמי ירמי

scripture_data.text_id: (38-19) ya, aku mengaku kesalahanku, aku cemas karena dosaku.
scripture_data.text_en: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: דימת יגן יבכמ כנ לצל יני

scripture_data.text_id: (38-20) Orang-orang yang memusuhi aku besar jumlahnya, banyaklah orang-orang yang membenci aku tanpa sebab;
scripture_data.text_en: But mine enemies [are] lively, [and] they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתחמ גד די ינוי

scripture_data.text_id: (38-21) mereka membalas yang jahat kepadaku ganti yang baik, mereka memusuhi aku, karena aku mengejar yang baik.
scripture_data.text_en: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow [the thing that] good [is].
scripture_data.text_orig: רק ינ רו מצ יח יביו

scripture_data.text_id: (38-22) Jangan tinggalkan aku, ya TUHAN, Allahku, janganlah jauh dari padaku!
scripture_data.text_en: Forsake me not, O LORD: O my God, be not far from me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ביפדריפדר תח ינני הב תח הר יממ

scripture_data.text_id: (38-23) Segeralah menolong aku, ya Tuhan, keselamatanku!
scripture_data.text_en: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ קחרל יהל הוהי ינבזל

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Untuk Yedutun. Mazmur Daud. (39-2) Pikirku: "Aku hendak menjaga diri, supaya jangan aku berdosa dengan lidahku; aku hendak menahan mulutku dengan kekang selama orang fasik masih ada di depanku."
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, [even] to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.> I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ תדיל תידיל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (39-3) Aku kelu, aku diam, aku membisu, aku jauh dari hal yang baik; tetapi penderitaanku makin berat.
scripture_data.text_en: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, [even] from good; and my sorrow was stirred.
scripture_data.text_orig: יגנל ר ד סחם יפל הרמ ינלב חמ יכרד הרמ ירמ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-4) Hatiku bergejolak dalam diriku, menyala seperti api, ketika aku berkeluh kesah; aku berbicara dengan lidahku:
scripture_data.text_en: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: [then] spake I with my tongue,
scripture_data.text_orig: רן יבכ במ יתיחה המד ימלן

scripture_data.text_id: (39-5) "Ya TUHAN, beritahukanlah kepadaku ajalku, dan apa batas umurku, supaya aku mengetahui betapa fananya aku!
scripture_data.text_en: LORD, make me to know mine end, and the measure of my days, what it [is; that] I may know how frail I [am].
scripture_data.text_orig: ינל יר רבת יגיגה ירק ילח

scripture_data.text_id: (39-6) Sungguh, hanya beberapa telempap saja Kautentukan umurku; bagi-Mu hidupku seperti sesuatu yang hampa. Ya, setiap manusia hanyalah kesia-siaan! Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, thou hast made my days [as] an handbreadth; and mine age [is] as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state [is] altogether vanity. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ לדחהם הד יההם ימי תמ יק הוהי ינידה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-7) Ia hanyalah bayangan yang berlalu! Ia hanya mempeributkan yang sia-sia dan menimbun, tetapi tidak tahu, siapa yang meraupnya nanti.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely every man walketh in a vain shew: surely they are disquieted in vain: he heapeth up [riches], and knoweth not who shall gather them.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס בנ דל לבהל גן יך ילחו ימי התנ תחפ הה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-8) Dan sekarang, apakah yang kunanti-nantikan, ya Tuhan? Kepada-Mulah aku berharap.
scripture_data.text_en: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope [is] in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: פסימ דילו רצי ימהי לבה יהתי לצ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-9) Lepaskanlah aku dari segala pelanggaranku, jangan jadikan aku celaan orang bebal!
scripture_data.text_en: Deliver me from all my transgressions: make me not the reproach of the foolish.
scripture_data.text_orig: יה ל ילח ינד יתיהם הו

scripture_data.text_id: (39-10) Aku kelu, tidak kubuka mulutku, sebab Engkau sendirilah yang bertindak.
scripture_data.text_en: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ינמיל לבנ תרח ינליה ילמ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-11) Hindarkanlah aku dari pada pukulan-Mu, aku remuk karena serangan tangan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Remove thy stroke away from me: I am consumed by the blow of thine hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי ה י יחפ ל ימלנ

scripture_data.text_id: (39-12) Engkau menghajar seseorang dengan hukuman karena kesalahannya, dan menghancurkan keelokannya sama seperti gegat; sesungguhnya, setiap manusia adalah kesia-siaan belaka. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: When thou with rebukes dost correct man for iniquity, thou makest his beauty to consume away like a moth: surely every man [is] vanity. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתילכ ינ די תרגמ גנ ילמ רסה

scripture_data.text_id: (39-13) Dengarkanlah doaku, ya TUHAN, dan berilah telinga kepada teriakku minta tolong, janganlah berdiam diri melihat air mataku! Sebab aku menumpang pada-Mu, aku pendatang seperti semua nenek moyangku.
scripture_data.text_en: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and give ear unto my cry; hold not thy peace at my tears: for I [am] a stranger with thee, [and] a sojourner, as all my fathers [were].
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס דל לבה דמח סמו י רי ול תחכת

scripture_data.text_id: (39-14) Alihkanlah pandangan-Mu dari padaku, supaya aku bersukacita sebelum aku pergi dan tidak ada lagi!"
scripture_data.text_en: O spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go hence, and be no more.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתבלכ ב יכנ רג י רחל יתמל הניזה יתוו הוהי יתפתהמ

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur Daud. (40-2) Aku sangat menanti-nantikan TUHAN; lalu Ia menjenguk kepadaku dan mendengar teriakku minta tolong.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.> I waited patiently for the LORD; and he inclined unto me, and heard my cry.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמזמ דודל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (40-3) Ia mengangkat aku dari lobang kebinasaan, dari lumpur rawa; Ia menempatkan kakiku di atas bukit batu, menetapkan langkahku,
scripture_data.text_en: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, [and] established my goings.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתו מו יל ו הוהי יתיק הק

scripture_data.text_id: (40-4) Ia memberikan nyanyian baru dalam mulutku untuk memuji Allah kita. Banyak orang akan melihatnya dan menjadi takut, lalu percaya kepada TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, [even] praise unto our God: many shall see [it], and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר נ ילגר לסל קו וה ימ רמ ינלו

scripture_data.text_id: (40-5) Berbahagialah orang, yang menaruh kepercayaannya pada TUHAN, yang tidak berpaling kepada orang-orang yang angkuh, atau kepada orang-orang yang telah menyimpang kepada kebohongan!
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [is] that man that maketh the LORD his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי חביו רייו יר רי ניהלל הה דח רי יפ ו

scripture_data.text_id: (40-6) Banyaklah yang telah Kaulakukan, ya TUHAN, Allahku, perbuatan-Mu yang ajaib dan maksud-Mu untuk kami. Tidak ada yang dapat disejajarkan dengan Engkau! Aku mau memberitakan dan mengatakannya, tetapi terlalu besar jumlahnya untuk dihitung.
scripture_data.text_en: Many, O LORD my God, [are] thy wonderful works [which] thou hast done, and thy thoughts [which are] to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: [if] I would declare and speak [of them], they are more than can be numbered.
scripture_data.text_orig: בזכ יו יבהרל הנפלו חבמ הוהי ר רבה יר

scripture_data.text_id: (40-7) Engkau tidak berkenan kepada korban sembelihan dan korban sajian, tetapi Engkau telah membuka telingaku; korban bakaran dan korban penghapus dosa tidak Engkau tuntut.
scripture_data.text_en: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ מצ הרדו הדי יל ר י ניל יתבחמ יתלפנ יהל הוהי ה תי תר

scripture_data.text_id: (40-8) Lalu aku berkata: "Sungguh, aku datang; dalam gulungan kitab ada tertulis tentang aku;
scripture_data.text_en: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book [it is] written of me,
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ל החו הל י תיר ינז צפחל החנמ חבז

scripture_data.text_id: (40-9) aku suka melakukan kehendak-Mu, ya Allahku; Taurat-Mu ada dalam dadaku."
scripture_data.text_en: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law [is] within my heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל בת רפסתגמ יתבהה ירמ ז

scripture_data.text_id: (40-10) Aku mengabarkan keadilan dalam jemaah yang besar; bahkan tidak kutahan bibirku, Engkau juga yang tahu, ya TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O LORD, thou knowest.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ ת תרתו יצפח יהל נצרתל

scripture_data.text_id: (40-11) Keadilan tidaklah kusembunyikan dalam hatiku, kesetiaan-Mu dan keselamatan dari pada-Mu kubicarakan, kasih-Mu dan kebenaran-Mu tidak kudiamkan kepada jemaah yang besar.
scripture_data.text_en: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.
scripture_data.text_orig: די ה הוהי לכ ל יתפ הה בר להק קדצ יר

scripture_data.text_id: (40-12) Engkau, TUHAN, janganlah menahan rahmat-Mu dari padaku, kasih-Mu dan kebenaran-Mu kiranya menjaga aku selalu!
scripture_data.text_en: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O LORD: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר להקל מו סח ידחכל ירמ תת תנמ יל ת יתיכל תקדצ

scripture_data.text_id: (40-13) Sebab malapetaka mengepung aku sampai tidak terbilang banyaknya. Aku telah terkejar oleh kesalahanku, sehingga aku tidak sanggup melihat; lebih besar jumlahnya dari rambut di kepalaku, sehingga hatiku menyerah.
scripture_data.text_en: For innumerable evils have compassed me about: mine iniquities have taken hold upon me, so that I am not able to look up; they are more than the hairs of mine head: therefore my heart faileth me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינרי דימ מו סח ימ ימחר לכתל הוהי ה

scripture_data.text_id: (40-14) Berkenanlah kiranya Engkau, ya TUHAN, untuk melepaskan aku; TUHAN, segeralah menolong aku!
scripture_data.text_en: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me: O LORD, make haste to help me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינבז ילו יר תרמ מצ תרל ילכילו יתנו ינגיה רסמ יד תר ילפפ י

scripture_data.text_id: (40-15) Biarlah mendapat malu dan tersipu-sipu mereka semua yang ingin mencabut nyawaku; biarlah mundur dan kena noda mereka yang mengingini kecelakaanku!
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.
scripture_data.text_orig: הח יתרזל הוהי ינליהל הוהי הצר

scripture_data.text_id: (40-16) Biarlah terdiam karena malu mereka yang mengatai aku: "Syukur, syukur!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתר יצפח מליו רח גי תסל יפן יקבם דחי רחיו בי

scripture_data.text_id: (40-17) Biarlah bergembira dan bersukacita karena Engkau semua orang yang mencari Engkau; biarlah mereka yang mencintai keselamatan dari pada-Mu tetap berkata: "TUHAN itu besar!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The LORD be magnified.
scripture_data.text_orig: חה חה יל ירמה בקל י

scripture_data.text_id: (40-18) Aku ini sengsara dan miskin, tetapi Tuhan memperhatikan aku. Engkaulah yang menolong aku dan meluputkan aku, ya Allahku, janganlah berlambat!
scripture_data.text_en: But I [am] poor and needy; [yet] the Lord thinketh upon me: thou [art] my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת יבה הוהי לגי דימת רמי יקבמל חמיו יי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur Daud. (41-2) Berbahagialah orang yang memperhatikan orang lemah! TUHAN akan meluputkan dia pada waktu celaka.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.> Blessed [is] he that considereth the poor: the LORD will deliver him in time of trouble.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (41-3) TUHAN akan melindungi dia dan memelihara nyawanya, sehingga ia disebut berbahagia di bumi; Engkau takkan membiarkan dia dipermainkan musuhnya!
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive; [and] he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי המי הר י לל לים יר

scripture_data.text_id: (41-4) TUHAN membantu dia di ranjangnya waktu sakit; di tempat tidurnya Kaupulihkannya sama sekali dari sakitnya.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויבי פנ הנלו שר רו רי החיו הרמי הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-5) Kalau aku, kataku: "TUHAN, kasihanilah aku, sembuhkanlah aku, sebab terhadap Engkaulah aku berdosa!"
scripture_data.text_en: I said, LORD, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילחב כפה במל יו רל דסי הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-6) Musuhku mengatakan yang jahat tentang aku: "Bilakah ia mati, dan namanya hilang lenyap?"
scripture_data.text_en: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?
scripture_data.text_orig: ל יתחי יפנ הפר ינח הוהי ירמינ

scripture_data.text_id: (41-7) Orang yang datang menjenguk, berkata dusta; hatinya penuh kejahatan, lalu ia keluar menceritakannya di jalan.
scripture_data.text_en: And if he come to see [me], he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; [when] he goeth abroad, he telleth [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: מ דבו תמי יתמ יל ר רמי יבי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-8) Semua orang yang benci kepadaku berbisik-bisik bersama-sama tentang aku, mereka merancangkan yang jahat terhadap aku:
scripture_data.text_en: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדי שחל צי ל ושקי ל רדי ו תרל ו

scripture_data.text_id: (41-9) "Penyakit jahanam telah menimpa dia, sekali ia berbaring, takkan bangun-bangun lagi."
scripture_data.text_en: An evil disease, [say they], cleaveth fast unto him: and [now] that he lieth he shall rise up no more.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל הר בחי יל ינל חלתי יל דחי

scripture_data.text_id: (41-10) Bahkan sahabat karibku yang kupercayai, yang makan rotiku, telah mengangkat tumitnya terhadap aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, mine own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, which did eat of my bread, hath lifted up [his] heel against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: קל יסיל בכ רו קצי ללרב

scripture_data.text_id: (41-11) Tetapi Engkau, ya TUHAN, kasihanilah aku dan tegakkanlah aku, maka aku hendak mengadakan pembalasan terhadap mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou, O LORD, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.
scripture_data.text_orig: בק יל ליגה ימחל לכ ב יחר ימל י

scripture_data.text_id: (41-12) Dengan demikian aku tahu, bahwa Engkau berkenan kepadaku, apabila musuhku tidak bersorak-sorai karena aku.
scripture_data.text_en: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל המו ינמיקהו ינח הוהי הו

scripture_data.text_id: (41-13) Tetapi aku, Engkau menopang aku karena ketulusanku, Engkau membuat aku tegak di hadapan-Mu untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יבי יריל י י צפחי ידי תז

scripture_data.text_id: (41-14) Terpujilah TUHAN, Allah Israel, dari selama-lamanya sampai selama-lamanya! Amin, ya amin.
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [be] the LORD God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל ינפל ינביו י כמ ית ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Nyanyian pengajaran bani Korah. (42-2) Seperti rusa yang merindukan sungai yang berair, demikianlah jiwaku merindukan Engkau, ya Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah.> As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.
scripture_data.text_orig: חרקינבל לים חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (42-3) Jiwaku haus kepada Allah, kepada Allah yang hidup. Bilakah aku boleh datang melihat Allah?
scripture_data.text_en: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל יל גרת יפן ימיקיפל גר ל

scripture_data.text_id: (42-4) Air mataku menjadi makananku siang dan malam, karena sepanjang hari orang berkata kepadaku: "Di mana Allahmu?"
scripture_data.text_en: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where [is] thy God?
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל ינ הרו ב יתמ יח לל יהלל יפן המצ

scripture_data.text_id: (42-5) Inilah yang hendak kuingat, sementara jiwaku gundah-gulana; bagaimana aku berjalan maju dalam kepadatan manusia, mendahului mereka melangkah ke rumah Allah dengan suara sorak-sorai dan nyanyian syukur, dalam keramaian orang-orang yang mengadakan perayaan.
scripture_data.text_en: When I remember these [things], I pour out my soul in me: for I had gone with the multitude, I went with them to the house of God, with the voice of joy and praise, with a multitude that kept holyday.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל ה הל יל רמ הלילו מי חל יתמד יהתיה

scripture_data.text_id: (42-6) Mengapa engkau tertekan, hai jiwaku, dan gelisah di dalam diriku? Berharaplah kepada Allah! Sebab aku akan bersyukur lagi kepada-Nya, penolongku dan Allahku!
scripture_data.text_en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and [why] art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him [for] the help of his countenance.
scripture_data.text_orig: גגח מה הדתו הרלק יהל תיד רב י יפן יל הכו הרז ה

scripture_data.text_id: (42-7) Jiwaku tertekan dalam diriku, sebab itu aku teringat kepada-Mu dari tanah sungai Yordan dan pegunungan Hermon, dari gunung Mizar.
scripture_data.text_en: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינ תי ד די יהלל יליחה יל ימהו יפן יחחהם

scripture_data.text_id: (42-8) Samudera raya berpanggil-panggilan dengan deru air terjun-Mu; segala gelora dan gelombang-Mu bergulung melingkupi aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.
scripture_data.text_orig: רצמ רהמ ינמרחו רי שרמ רז ל חחת יפן יל יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (42-9) TUHAN memerintahkan kasih setia-Nya pada siang hari, dan pada malam hari aku menyanyikan nyanyian, suatu doa kepada Allah kehidupanku.
scripture_data.text_en: [Yet] the LORD will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song [shall be] with me, [and] my prayer unto the God of my life.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב יל יגו ירמל ירצ לקל רק הלה

scripture_data.text_id: (42-10) Aku berkata kepada Allah, gunung batuku: "Mengapa Engkau melupakan aku? Mengapa aku harus hidup berkabung di bawah impitan musuh?"
scripture_data.text_en: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
scripture_data.text_orig: יח לל הפ י רי הרי הליב סח הוהי הצי מי

scripture_data.text_id: (42-11) Seperti tikaman maut ke dalam tulangku lawanku mencela aku, sambil berkata kepadaku sepanjang hari: "Di mana Allahmu?"
scripture_data.text_en: [As] with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where [is] thy God?
scripture_data.text_orig: בי שחל ל רדקהל ינחכ המל ילס לל הרמ

scripture_data.text_id: (42-12) Mengapa engkau tertekan, hai jiwaku, dan mengapa engkau gelisah di dalam diriku? Berharaplah kepada Allah! Sebab aku bersyukur lagi kepada-Nya, penolongku dan Allahku!
scripture_data.text_en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל ה הל יל רמ יררץ ינפרח יתמצ חצר

scripture_data.text_id: Berilah keadilan kepadaku, ya Allah, dan perjuangkanlah perkaraku terhadap kaum yang tidak saleh! Luputkanlah aku dari orang penipu dan orang curang!
scripture_data.text_en: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינפת הלוו המרמימ דיסחל ימ יביר הבירו יהל ינפ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkaulah Allah tempat pengungsianku. Mengapa Engkau membuang aku? Mengapa aku harus hidup berkabung di bawah impitan musuh?
scripture_data.text_en: For thou [art] the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?
scripture_data.text_orig: בי שחל הת רדקהל ינחנז המל ימ יהל הי

scripture_data.text_id: Suruhlah terang-Mu dan kesetiaan-Mu datang, supaya aku dituntun dan dibawa ke gunung-Mu yang kudus dan ke tempat kediaman-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתנמלו דקרהל יניבי ינחני הה מו רחל

scripture_data.text_id: Maka aku dapat pergi ke mezbah Allah, menghadap Allah, yang adalah sukacitaku dan kegembiraanku, dan bersyukur kepada-Mu dengan kecapi, ya Allah, ya Allahku!
scripture_data.text_en: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל יהל רכב דו ילי תחמ לל יהל חזמל הבו

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa engkau tertekan, hai jiwaku, dan mengapa engkau gelisah di dalam diriku? Berharaplah kepada Allah! Sebab aku bersyukur lagi kepada-Nya, penolongku dan Allahku!
scripture_data.text_en: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, [who is] the health of my countenance, and my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלו ינ תי ד די יהלל יליחה יל ימההמ יפן יחחהם

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari bani Korah. Nyanyian pengajaran. (44-2) Ya Allah, dengan telinga kami sendiri telah kami dengar, nenek moyang kami telah menceritakan kepada kami perbuatan yang telah Kaulakukan pada zaman mereka, pada zaman purbakala.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil.> We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, [what] work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.
scripture_data.text_orig: לים חרקינבל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (44-3) Engkau sendiri, dengan tangan-Mu, telah menghalau bangsa-bangsa, tetapi mereka ini Kaubiarkan bertumbuh; suku-suku bangsa telah Kaucelakakan, tetapi mereka ini Kaubiarkan berkembang.
scripture_data.text_en: [How] thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; [how] thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק ימי הימיב ל ל נלרס ניתב נמ נינז יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (44-4) Sebab bukan dengan pedang mereka menduduki negeri, bukan lengan mereka yang memberikan mereka kemenangan, melainkan tangan kanan-Mu dan lengan-Mu dan cahaya wajah-Mu, sebab Engkau berkenan kepada mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: חו יל ר ו רה י די ה

scripture_data.text_id: (44-5) Engkaulah Rajaku dan Allahku yang memerintahkan kemenangan bagi Yakub.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיצר י ינ רו רז נימיי מ היהל רז שר רי רחב ל י

scripture_data.text_id: (44-6) Dengan Engkaulah kami menanduk para lawan kami, dengan nama-Mulah kami menginjak-injak orang-orang yang bangkit menyerang kami.
scripture_data.text_en: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי תי הצ יהל ילם הה

scripture_data.text_id: (44-7) Sebab bukan kepada panahku aku percaya, dan pedangkupun tidak memberi aku kemenangan,
scripture_data.text_en: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימק סבנ מ חנן נירצ

scripture_data.text_id: (44-8) tetapi Engkaulah yang memberi kami kemenangan terhadap para lawan kami, dan orang-orang yang membenci kami Kauberi malu.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינית ל ירחו חב יקב ל י

scripture_data.text_id: (44-9) Karena Allah kami nyanyikan puji-pujian sepanjang hari, dan bagi nama-Mu kami mengucapkan syukur selama-lamanya. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיבה נינמ נירמ נה י

scripture_data.text_id: (44-10) Namun Engkau telah membuang kami dan membiarkan kami kena umpat, Engkau tidak maju bersama-sama dengan bala tentara kami.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס הדן לל מו הלכ נלה יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (44-11) Engkau membuat kami mundur dari pada lawan kami, dan orang-orang yang membenci kami mengadakan perampokan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניתבצ צתלו נמילכו חנז

scripture_data.text_id: (44-12) Engkau menyerahkan kami sebagai domba sembelihan dan menyerakkan kami di antara bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast given us like sheep [appointed] for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל ס נינמ רצימ רח נבי

scripture_data.text_id: (44-13) Engkau menjual umat-Mu dengan cuma-cuma dan tidak mengambil keuntungan apa-apa dari penjualan itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou sellest thy people for nought, and dost not increase [thy wealth] by their price.
scripture_data.text_orig: נתירז יב לכם צ ננ

scripture_data.text_id: (44-14) Engkau membuat kami menjadi cela bagi tetangga-tetangga kami, menjadi olok-olok dan cemooh bagi orang-orang sekeliling kami.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.
scripture_data.text_orig: היריחמ תירלו הלב רמ

scripture_data.text_id: (44-15) Engkau membuat kami menjadi sindiran di antara bangsa-bangsa, menyebabkan suku-suku bangsa menggeleng-geleng kepala.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניתביבסל סלקו גל נינכל הרח נמי

scripture_data.text_id: (44-16) Sepanjang hari aku dihadapkan dengan nodaku, dan malu menyelimuti mukaku,
scripture_data.text_en: My confusion [is] continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,
scripture_data.text_orig: יל רדנם י למ נמי

scripture_data.text_id: (44-17) karena kata-kata orang yang mencela dan menista, di hadapan musuh dan pendendam.
scripture_data.text_en: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינת ינ תב יגן יתל הל

scripture_data.text_id: (44-18) Semuanya ini telah menimpa kami, tetapi kami tidak melupakan Engkau, dan tidak mengkhianati perjanjian-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.
scripture_data.text_orig: נתמ בי ינמ גמ רחם למ

scripture_data.text_id: (44-19) Hati kami tidak membangkang dan langkah kami tidak menyimpang dari jalan-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;
scripture_data.text_orig: תירב נרלו נחכ לו נת תזל

scripture_data.text_id: (44-20) walaupun Engkau telah meremukkan kami di tempat serigala, dan menyelimuti kami dengan kekelaman.
scripture_data.text_en: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.
scripture_data.text_orig: חר ימ ניר ו נל רח גסנל

scripture_data.text_id: (44-21) Seandainya kami melupakan nama Allah kami, dan menadahkan tangan kami kepada allah lain,
scripture_data.text_en: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or stretched out our hands to a strange god;
scripture_data.text_orig: תומלצב ניל סכו י קמ נתיד י
