scripture_data.text_id: (44-22) masakan Allah tidak akan menyelidikinya? Karena Ia mengetahui rahasia hati!
scripture_data.text_en: Shall not God search this out? for he knoweth the secrets of the heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: רז לל ני רפו ניהל נחכ

scripture_data.text_id: (44-23) Oleh karena Engkau kami ada dalam bahaya maut sepanjang hari, kami dianggap sebagai domba-domba sembelihan.
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל תמל די הי תזרקחי יהל לה

scripture_data.text_id: (44-24) Terjagalah! Mengapa Engkau tidur, ya Tuhan? Bangunlah! Janganlah membuang kami terus-menerus!
scripture_data.text_en: Awake, why sleepest thou, O Lord? arise, cast [us] not off for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: החב צ נבחנ הלכ נגרה ילי

scripture_data.text_id: (44-25) Mengapa Engkau menyembunyikan wajah-Mu dan melupakan penindasan dan impitan terhadap kami?
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, [and] forgettest our affliction and our oppression?
scripture_data.text_orig: חצנל חנזל הציקה ינד ית הל הר

scripture_data.text_id: (44-26) Sebab jiwa kami tertanam dalam debu, tubuh kami terhampar di tanah.
scripture_data.text_en: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: נצחלו נינ ח ריסת ינפהל

scripture_data.text_id: (44-27) Bersiaplah menolong kami, bebaskanlah kami karena kasih setia-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies' sake.
scripture_data.text_orig: ננ שרל הקב נפן רפל הח י

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Bunga bakung. Dari bani Korah. Nyanyian pengajaran; nyanyian kasih. (45-2) Hatiku meluap dengan kata-kata indah, aku hendak menyampaikan sajakku kepada raja; lidahku ialah pena seorang jurutulis yang mahir.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves.> My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue [is] the pen of a ready writer.
scripture_data.text_orig: תדידי רי לימ חרקינבל יל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (45-3) Engkau yang terelok di antara anak-anak manusia, kemurahan tercurah pada bibirmu, sebab itu Allah telah memberkati engkau untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou art fairer than the children of men: grace is poured into thy lips: therefore God hath blessed thee for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: ריהמ רפס ינל למל ים ינ רמ ב רב יל חר

scripture_data.text_id: (45-4) Ikatlah pedangmu pada pinggang, hai pahlawan, dalam keagunganmu dan semarakmu!
scripture_data.text_en: Gird thy sword upon [thy] thigh, O [most] mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל יהל כר ל יתתפ ח קצה ד ינמ תיפיפי

scripture_data.text_id: (45-5) Dalam semarakmu itu majulah demi kebenaran, perikemanusiaan dan keadilan! Biarlah tangan kananmu mengajarkan engkau perbuatan-perbuatan yang dahsyat!
scripture_data.text_en: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness [and] righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדהו דה ר ריל רחרגח

scripture_data.text_id: (45-6) Anak-anak panahmu tajam, menembus jantung musuh raja; bangsa-bangsa jatuh di bawah kakimu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thine arrows [are] sharp in the heart of the king's enemies; [whereby] the people fall under thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימי תרן רתו קדצהונו תמרבל בכר חלץ רדהו

scripture_data.text_id: (45-7) Takhtamu kepunyaan Allah, tetap untuk seterusnya dan selamanya, dan tongkat kerajaanmu adalah tongkat kebenaran.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy throne, O God, [is] for ever and ever: the sceptre of thy kingdom [is] a right sceptre.
scripture_data.text_orig: לה יבי בל לי יח י יננ יח

scripture_data.text_id: (45-8) Engkau mencintai keadilan dan membenci kefasikan; sebab itu Allah, Allahmu, telah mengurapi engkau dengan minyak sebagai tanda kesukaan, melebihi teman-teman sekutumu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou lovest righteousness, and hatest wickedness: therefore God, thy God, hath anointed thee with the oil of gladness above thy fellows.
scripture_data.text_orig: תכלם ב רימ ב דו ל יהל ס

scripture_data.text_id: (45-9) Segala pakaianmu berbau mur, gaharu dan cendana; dari istana gading permainan kecapi menyukakan engkau;
scripture_data.text_en: All thy garments [smell] of myrrh, and aloes, [and] cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירבחמ מ יהל יהל חם ל ר נו קד בה

scripture_data.text_id: (45-10) di antara mereka yang disayangi terdapat puteri-puteri raja, di sebelah kananmu berdiri permaisuri berpakaian emas dari Ofir.
scripture_data.text_en: Kings' daughters [were] among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.
scripture_data.text_orig: ח ימ ילכיהמ יתדגל תיצק תלהורמ

scripture_data.text_id: (45-11) Dengarlah, hai puteri, lihatlah, dan sendengkanlah telingamu, lupakanlah bangsamu dan seisi rumah ayahmu!
scripture_data.text_en: Hearken, O daughter, and consider, and incline thine ear; forget also thine own people, and thy father's house;
scripture_data.text_orig: ריפ תכ נימיל לג הבנ יתרי יכלמ תנ

scripture_data.text_id: (45-12) Biarlah raja menjadi gairah karena keelokanmu, sebab dialah tuanmu! Sujudlah kepadanya!
scripture_data.text_en: So shall the king greatly desire thy beauty: for he [is] thy Lord; and worship thou him.
scripture_data.text_orig: יב תיב יחכו נז יהו יר תבימ

scripture_data.text_id: (45-13) Puteri Tirus datang dengan pemberian-pemberian; orang-orang kaya di antara rakyat akan mengambil muka kepadamu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the daughter of Tyre [shall be there] with a gift; [even] the rich among the people shall intreat thy favour.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליוחהו ינד הי יפי לה ותיו

scripture_data.text_id: (45-14) Keindahan belaka puteri raja itu di dalam, pakaiannya berpakankan emas.
scripture_data.text_en: The king's daughter [is] all glorious within: her clothing [is] of wrought gold.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירי חי ינ החנמ רצתב

scripture_data.text_id: (45-15) Dengan pakaian bersulam berwarna-warna ia dibawa kepada raja; anak-anak dara mengikutinya, yakni teman-temannya, yang didatangkan untuk dia.
scripture_data.text_en: She shall be brought unto the king in raiment of needlework: the virgins her companions that follow her shall be brought unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל בהז תצמ המינ למתב הבל

scripture_data.text_id: (45-16) Dengan sukacita dan sorak-sorai mereka dibawa, mereka masuk ke dalam istana raja.
scripture_data.text_en: With gladness and rejoicing shall they be brought: they shall enter into the king's palace.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תבמ היתר הירח תלת לל לב תמקרל

scripture_data.text_id: (45-17) Para bapa leluhurmu hendaknya diganti oleh anak-anakmu nanti; engkau akan mengangkat mereka menjadi pembesar di seluruh bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Instead of thy fathers shall be thy children, whom thou mayest make princes in all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: לם לכיה הניב ליגו תחמ הנלב

scripture_data.text_id: (45-18) Aku mau memasyhurkan namamu turun-temurun; sebab itu bangsa-bangsa akan bersyukur kepadamu untuk seterusnya dan selamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: I will make thy name to be remembered in all generations: therefore shall the people praise thee for ever and ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהלכ ירל מתי ינב יהי יתב תח

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari bani Korah. Dengan lagu: Alamot. Nyanyian. (46-2) Allah itu bagi kita tempat perlindungan dan kekuatan, sebagai penolong dalam kesesakan sangat terbukti.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth.> God [is] our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי תמלל חרקינבל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (46-3) Sebab itu kita tidak akan takut, sekalipun bumi berubah, sekalipun gunung-gunung goncang di dalam laut;
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;
scripture_data.text_orig: דם צמנ תרצב הרז זו הסחם נל יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (46-4) sekalipun ribut dan berbuih airnya, sekalipun gunung-gunung goyang oleh geloranya. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: [Though] the waters thereof roar [and] be troubled, [though] the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יי בל ירה מב שר רימה רינל ל

scripture_data.text_id: (46-5) Kota Allah, kediaman Yang Mahatinggi, disukakan oleh aliran-aliran sebuah sungai.
scripture_data.text_en: [There is] a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy [place] of the tabernacles of the most High.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס תוג ירהרי וימימ רמחי מהי

scripture_data.text_id: (46-6) Allah ada di dalamnya, kota itu tidak akan goncang; Allah akan menolongnya menjelang pagi.
scripture_data.text_en: God [is] in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, [and that] right early.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ינמ דק יהלרי חי ויגל רהנ

scripture_data.text_id: (46-7) Bangsa-bangsa ribut, kerajaan-kerajaan goncang, Ia memperdengarkan suara-Nya, dan bumipun hancur.
scripture_data.text_en: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק תנפל יהל הרזי ל רק יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (46-8) TUHAN semesta alam menyertai kita, kota benteng kita ialah Allah Yakub. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר גמ לק תנ תכלמם מ יג מה

scripture_data.text_id: (46-9) Pergilah, pandanglah pekerjaan TUHAN, yang mengadakan pemusnahan di bumi,
scripture_data.text_en: Come, behold the works of the LORD, what desolations he hath made in the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס בקי יהל נלבמ נ תבץ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (46-10) yang menghentikan peperangan sampai ke ujung bumi, yang mematahkan busur panah, menumpulkan tombak, membakar kereta-kereta perang dengan api!
scripture_data.text_en: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר ת ר הוהי תלפמ זחכל

scripture_data.text_id: (46-11) "Diamlah dan ketahuilah, bahwa Akulah Allah! Aku ditinggikan di antara bangsa-bangsa, ditinggikan di bumi!"
scripture_data.text_en: Be still, and know that I [am] God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי תלג תינח שקו רי תק שרה הצקד תמחלמ תים

scripture_data.text_id: (46-12) TUHAN semesta alam menyertai kita, kota benteng kita ialah Allah Yakub. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD of hosts [is] with us; the God of Jacob [is] our refuge. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר ר י ר יהל יכני ד רה

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari bani Korah. Mazmur. (47-2) Hai segala bangsa, bertepuktanganlah, elu-elukanlah Allah dengan sorak-sorai!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.> O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמזמ חרקינבל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (47-3) Sebab TUHAN, Yang Mahatinggi, adalah dahsyat, Raja yang besar atas seluruh bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD most high [is] terrible; [he is] a great King over all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר לק יהלל ירה כק יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (47-4) Ia menaklukkan bangsa-bangsa ke bawah kuasa kita, suku-suku bangsa ke bawah kaki kita,
scripture_data.text_en: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהלל לד למ רן יל הוהיי

scripture_data.text_id: (47-5) Ia memilih bagi kita tanah pusaka kita, kebanggaan Yakub yang dikasihi-Nya. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: נילגר תח יל ניח י רדי

scripture_data.text_id: (47-6) Allah telah naik dengan diiringi sorak-sorai, ya TUHAN itu, dengan diiringi bunyi sangkakala.
scripture_data.text_en: God is gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס בהר בקי ת נתלחנת נלרחבי

scripture_data.text_id: (47-7) Bermazmurlah bagi Allah, bermazmurlah, bermazmurlah bagi Raja kita, bermazmurlah!
scripture_data.text_en: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.
scripture_data.text_orig: רפ לק הוהי הרת יהל הל

scripture_data.text_id: (47-8) Sebab Allah adalah Raja seluruh bumi, bermazmurlah dengan nyanyian pengajaran!
scripture_data.text_en: For God [is] the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.
scripture_data.text_orig: רז נלמל רז רז יהל רז

scripture_data.text_id: (47-9) Allah memerintah sebagai raja atas bangsa-bangsa, Allah bersemayam di atas takhta-Nya yang kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.
scripture_data.text_orig: לים רז יהל שרהל למ י

scripture_data.text_id: (47-10) Para pemuka bangsa-bangsa berkumpul sebagai umat Allah Abraham. Sebab Allah yang empunya perisai-perisai bumi; Ia sangat dimuliakan.
scripture_data.text_en: The princes of the people are gathered together, [even] the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth [belong] unto God: he is greatly exalted.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק ל בי יהל יל יהל למ

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyian. Mazmur bani Korah. (48-2) Besarlah TUHAN dan sangat terpuji di kota Allah kita!
scripture_data.text_en: <A Song [and] Psalm for the sons of Korah.> Great [is] the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, [in] the mountain of his holiness.
scripture_data.text_orig: חרקינבל רמזמ רי

scripture_data.text_id: (48-3) Gunung-Nya yang kudus, yang menjulang permai, adalah kegirangan bagi seluruh bumi; gunung Sion itu, jauh di sebelah utara, kota Raja Besar.
scripture_data.text_en: Beautiful for situation, the joy of the whole earth, [is] mount Zion, [on] the sides of the north, the city of the great King.
scripture_data.text_orig: דקרה ניהל רי דם להמ הוהי לד

scripture_data.text_id: (48-4) Dalam puri-purinya Allah memperkenalkan diri-Nya sebagai benteng.
scripture_data.text_en: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר למ תירק פצ יתרי צרה שרהל ם ן הפי

scripture_data.text_id: (48-5) Sebab lihat, raja-raja datang berkumpul, mereka bersama-sama berjalan maju;
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.
scripture_data.text_orig: במל דן היתנמר יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (48-6) demi mereka melihatnya, mereka tercengang-cengang, terkejut, lalu lari kebingungan.
scripture_data.text_en: They saw [it, and] so they marvelled; they were troubled, [and] hasted away.
scripture_data.text_orig: וחי רב דן יכלה ההי

scripture_data.text_id: (48-7) Kegentaran menimpa mereka di sana; mereka kesakitan seperti perempuan yang hendak melahirkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Fear took hold upon them there, [and] pain, as of a woman in travail.
scripture_data.text_orig: זחן להבנ המ ר הה

scripture_data.text_id: (48-8) Dengan angin timur Engkau memecahkan kapal-kapal Tarsis.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדל ליח תזח הדר

scripture_data.text_id: (48-9) Seperti yang telah kita dengar, demikianlah juga kita lihat, di kota TUHAN semesta alam, di kota Allah kita; Allah menegakkannya untuk selama-lamanya. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: As we have heard, so have we seen in the city of the LORD of hosts, in the city of our God: God will establish it for ever. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר תנ ר ידק חר

scripture_data.text_id: (48-10) Kami mengingat, ya Allah, kasih setia-Mu di dalam bait-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס לד הננכי יהל ניהל רי תבצ הוהירי ניר נמ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (48-11) Seperti nama-Mu, ya Allah, demikianlah kemasyhuran-Mu sampai ke ujung bumi; tangan kanan-Mu penuh dengan keadilan.
scripture_data.text_en: According to thy name, O God, so [is] thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכיה ברק סח יהל ני

scripture_data.text_id: (48-12) Biarlah gunung Sion bersukacita; biarlah anak-anak perempuan Yehuda bersorak-sorak oleh karena penghukuman-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימי הלמ קדצ שריוצקל תה יהל מ

scripture_data.text_id: (48-13) Kelilingilah Sion dan edarilah dia, hitunglah menaranya,
scripture_data.text_en: Walk about Zion, and go round about her: tell the towers thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ מל הדהי תנ הנלג צרה חמי

scripture_data.text_id: (48-14) perhatikanlah temboknya, jalanilah puri-purinya, supaya kamu dapat menceriterakannya kepada angkatan yang kemudian:
scripture_data.text_en: Mark ye well her bulwarks, consider her palaces; that ye may tell [it] to the generation following.
scripture_data.text_orig: הילגמ רפס הפיהו צ ס

scripture_data.text_id: (48-15) Sesungguhnya inilah Allah, Allah kitalah Dia seterusnya dan untuk selamanya! Dialah yang memimpin kita!
scripture_data.text_en: For this God [is] our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide [even] unto death.
scripture_data.text_orig: רח רדל רס מל היתנמר ג הליחל כל תי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari bani Korah. Mazmur. (49-2) Dengarlah, hai bangsa-bangsa sekalian, pasanglah telinga, hai semua penduduk dunia,
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.> Hear this, all [ye] people; give ear, all [ye] inhabitants of the world:
scripture_data.text_orig: רמזמ חרקינבל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (49-3) baik yang hina maupun yang mulia, baik yang kaya maupun yang miskin bersama-sama!
scripture_data.text_en: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.
scripture_data.text_orig: דלח יביל ניזה יהל תזמ

scripture_data.text_id: (49-4) Mulutku akan mengucapkan hikmat, dan yang direnungkan hatiku ialah pengertian.
scripture_data.text_en: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart [shall be] of understanding.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבו רי דחי יינ ד ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (49-5) Aku akan menyendengkan telingaku kepada amsal, akan mengutarakan peribahasaku dengan bermain kecapi.
scripture_data.text_en: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנבת יל תגהו תמכח רדי י

scripture_data.text_id: (49-6) Mengapa aku takut pada hari-hari celaka pada waktu aku dikepung oleh kejahatan pengejar-pengejarku,
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, [when] the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?
scripture_data.text_orig: יתדיח רכ חפ ינז למל ה

scripture_data.text_id: (49-7) mereka yang percaya akan harta bendanya, dan memegahkan diri dengan banyaknya kekayaan mereka?
scripture_data.text_en: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;
scripture_data.text_orig: ינסי יבק ו ר ימי רי הל

scripture_data.text_id: (49-8) Tidak seorangpun dapat membebaskan dirinya, atau memberikan tebusan kepada Allah ganti nyawanya,
scripture_data.text_en: None [of them] can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:
scripture_data.text_orig: להתי ר ברב ליחל יחה

scripture_data.text_id: (49-9) karena terlalu mahal harga pembebasan nyawanya, dan tidak memadai untuk selama-lamanya
scripture_data.text_en: (For the redemption of their soul [is] precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)
scripture_data.text_orig: רפ יהלל יל י הפי הדפל ח

scripture_data.text_id: (49-10) supaya ia tetap hidup untuk seterusnya, dan tidak melihat lobang kubur.
scripture_data.text_en: That he should still live for ever, [and] not see corruption.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל לדחו פן יד רקיו

scripture_data.text_id: (49-11) Sungguh, akan dilihatnya: orang-orang yang mempunyai hikmat mati, orang-orang bodoh dan dungupun binasa bersama-sama dan meninggalkan harta benda mereka untuk orang lain.
scripture_data.text_en: For he seeth [that] wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.
scripture_data.text_orig: תחה הרי ל חצנל דיחיו

scripture_data.text_id: (49-12) Kubur mereka ialah rumah mereka untuk selama-lamanya, tempat kediaman mereka turun-temurun; mereka menganggap ladang-ladang milik mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Their inward thought [is, that] their houses [shall continue] for ever, [and] their dwelling places to all generations; they call [their] lands after their own names.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליח ירחל בזו דבי רבו ליס דחי תמי ימכח הרי י

scripture_data.text_id: (49-13) Tetapi dengan segala kegemilangannya manusia tidak dapat bertahan, ia boleh disamakan dengan hewan yang dibinasakan.
scripture_data.text_en: Nevertheless man [being] in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts [that] perish.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמד יל תמב רק רדו רדל תנמ לל מי רק

scripture_data.text_id: (49-14) Inilah jalannya orang-orang yang percaya kepada dirinya sendiri, ajal orang-orang yang gemar akan perkataannya sendiri. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: This their way [is] their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: מדנ תמה למנ יליל רקי דו

scripture_data.text_id: (49-15) Seperti domba mereka meluncur ke dalam dunia orang mati, digembalakan oleh maut; mereka turun langsung ke kubur, perawakan mereka hancur, dunia orang mati menjadi tempat kediaman mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס צרי היפ הירחו מל לס רד הז

scripture_data.text_id: (49-16) Tetapi Allah akan membebaskan nyawaku dari cengkeraman dunia orang mati, sebab Ia akan menarik aku. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל לבמ ל תבל רצו ריצו רקל ירי ב רו רי תומ לל

scripture_data.text_id: (49-17) Janganlah takut, apabila seseorang menjadi kaya, apabila kemuliaan keluarganya bertambah,
scripture_data.text_en: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ינחי י לדמ יפנ הפי יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (49-18) sebab pada waktu matinya semuanya itu tidak akan dibawanya serta, kemuliaannya tidak akan turun mengikuti dia.
scripture_data.text_en: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי דב הריי י ריי ריל

scripture_data.text_id: (49-19) Sekalipun ia menganggap dirinya berbahagia pada masa hidupnya, sekalipun orang menyanjungnya, karena ia berbuat baik terhadap dirinya sendiri,
scripture_data.text_en: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and [men] will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב וירח דריל לה חי תמב ל י

scripture_data.text_id: (49-20) namun ia akan sampai kepada angkatan nenek moyangnya, yang tidak akan melihat terang untuk seterusnya.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל בייתי דיו רבי ויח פני

scripture_data.text_id: (49-21) Manusia, yang dengan segala kegemilangannya tidak mempunyai pengertian, boleh disamakan dengan hewan yang dibinasakan.
scripture_data.text_en: Man [that is] in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts [that] perish.
scripture_data.text_orig: ררי ל חצנד ויתב רד ב

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Asaf. Yang Mahakuasa, TUHAN Allah, berfirman dan memanggil bumi, dari terbitnya matahari sampai kepada terbenamnya.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of Asaph.> The mighty God, [even] the LORD, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: במד מחרזמ שררקו ר הוהי יהל ל סל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Sion, puncak keindahan, Allah tampil bersinar.
scripture_data.text_en: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפה יהל יפיללכמ מ

scripture_data.text_id: Allah kita datang dan tidak akan berdiam diri, di hadapan-Nya api menjilat, sekeliling-Nya bertiup badai yang dahsyat.
scripture_data.text_en: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.
scripture_data.text_orig: דם הרנ ויביבס לכ וינפל רחילו ניהל בי

scripture_data.text_id: Ia berseru kepada langit di atas, dan kepada bumi untuk mengadili umat-Nya:
scripture_data.text_en: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידל שרהלו למ ימהל רקי

scripture_data.text_id: "Bawalah kemari orang-orang yang Kukasihi, yang mengikat perjanjian dengan Aku berdasarkan korban sembelihan!"
scripture_data.text_en: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.
scripture_data.text_orig: חבזיל יתירב יתר ידיסח ילפס

scripture_data.text_id: Langit memberitakan keadilan-Nya, sebab Allah sendirilah Hakim. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God [is] judge himself. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ה פ יהלי קדצ ימ דיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Dengarlah, hai umat-Ku, Aku hendak berfirman, hai Israel, Aku hendak bersaksi terhadap kamu: Akulah Allah, Allahmu!
scripture_data.text_en: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I [am] God, [even] thy God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכנ יהל יהל הדיו לרי הרדו י המ

scripture_data.text_id: Bukan karena korban sembelihanmu Aku menghukum engkau; bukankah korban bakaranmu tetap ada di hadapan-Ku?
scripture_data.text_en: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, [to have been] continually before me.
scripture_data.text_orig: דימת יגנל יתלו חיכ יחבזל ל

scripture_data.text_id: Tidak usah Aku mengambil lembu dari rumahmu atau kambing jantan dari kandangmu,
scripture_data.text_en: I will take no bullock out of thy house, [nor] he goats out of thy folds.
scripture_data.text_orig: יד יתלכמ רפ תימ חל

scripture_data.text_id: sebab punya-Kulah segala binatang hutan, dan beribu-ribu hewan di gunung.
scripture_data.text_en: For every beast of the forest [is] mine, [and] the cattle upon a thousand hills.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליררה תמה ריתיחלכ ילי

scripture_data.text_id: Aku kenal segala burung di udara, dan apa yang bergerak di padang adalah dalam kuasa-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field [are] mine.
scripture_data.text_orig: יד יד זיזו ירה ל ידי

scripture_data.text_id: Jika Aku lapar, tidak usah Kukatakan kepadamu, sebab punya-Kulah dunia dan segala isinya.
scripture_data.text_en: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world [is] mine, and the fulness thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: למ לבת ילי ל רמל בר

scripture_data.text_id: Daging lembu jantankah Aku makan, atau darah kambing jantankah Aku minum?
scripture_data.text_en: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
scripture_data.text_orig: ה יד דו ירי ר לכה

scripture_data.text_id: Persembahkanlah syukur sebagai korban kepada Allah dan bayarlah nazarmu kepada Yang Mahatinggi!
scripture_data.text_en: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:
scripture_data.text_orig: ירדן ילל ו הד יהלל חבז

scripture_data.text_id: Berserulah kepada-Ku pada waktu kesesakan, Aku akan meluputkan engkau, dan engkau akan memuliakan Aku." Sela
scripture_data.text_en: And call upon me in the day of trouble: I will deliver thee, and thou shalt glorify me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינדכת צח הרצ י ינרק

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi kepada orang fasik Allah berfirman: "Apakah urusanmu menyelidiki ketetapan-Ku, dan menyebut-nyebut perjanjian-Ku dengan mulutmu,
scripture_data.text_en: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or [that] thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?
scripture_data.text_orig: יפיל יתירב ו יח רסל הם יהל רמ רלו

scripture_data.text_id: padahal engkaulah yang membenci teguran, dan mengesampingkan firman-Ku?
scripture_data.text_en: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירח ירב לו רסם תנ הו

scripture_data.text_id: Jika engkau melihat pencuri, maka engkau berkawan dengan dia, dan bergaul dengan orang berzinah.
scripture_data.text_en: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.
scripture_data.text_orig: קלח יפנם ו שרו בג תיר

scripture_data.text_id: Mulutmu kaubiarkan mengucapkan yang jahat, dan pada lidahmu melekat tipu daya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.
scripture_data.text_orig: המרמ דימצ נל הרב חל י

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau duduk, dan mengata-ngatai saudaramu, memfitnah anak ibumu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou sittest [and] speakest against thy brother; thou slanderest thine own mother's son.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפ ב רדת יח ב

scripture_data.text_id: Itulah yang engkau lakukan, tetapi Aku berdiam diri; engkau menyangka, bahwa Aku ini sederajat dengan engkau. Aku akan menghukum engkau dan membawa perkara ini ke hadapanmu.
scripture_data.text_en: These [things] hast thou done, and I kept silence; thou thoughtest that I was altogether [such an one] as thyself: [but] I will reprove thee, and set [them] in order before thine eyes.
scripture_data.text_orig: יניל הכרו חיכ מכ היהתיה תי ירחהו תי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Perhatikanlah ini, hai kamu yang melupakan Allah; supaya jangan Aku menerkam, dan tidak ada yang melepaskan.
scripture_data.text_en: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear [you] in pieces, and [there be] none to deliver.
scripture_data.text_orig: לים יו ר ל יחכ תז נני

scripture_data.text_id: Siapa yang mempersembahkan syukur sebagai korban, ia memuliakan Aku; siapa yang jujur jalannya, keselamatan yang dari Allah akan Kuperlihatkan kepadanya."
scripture_data.text_en: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth [his] conversation [aright] will I shew the salvation of God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל י ר ר ו יננדכי הד חבז

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur dari Daud, (51-2) ketika nabi Natan datang kepadanya setelah ia menghampiri Batsyeba. (51-3) Kasihanilah aku, ya Allah, menurut kasih setia-Mu, hapuskanlah pelanggaranku menurut rahmat-Mu yang besar!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, when Nathan the prophet came unto him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba.> Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (51-4) Bersihkanlah aku seluruhnya dari kesalahanku, dan tahirkanlah aku dari dosaku!
scripture_data.text_en: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: בתל ר יבה תנ וילב

scripture_data.text_id: (51-5) Sebab aku sendiri sadar akan pelanggaranku, aku senantiasa bergumul dengan dosaku.
scripture_data.text_en: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin [is] ever before me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יף החם ימחר בר סח יהל ינח

scripture_data.text_id: (51-6) Terhadap Engkau, terhadap Engkau sajalah aku telah berdosa dan melakukan apa yang Kauanggap jahat, supaya ternyata Engkau adil dalam putusan-Mu, bersih dalam penghukuman-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done [this] evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, [and] be clear when thou judgest.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינרה יתחמ ינומ ינס ברה הרה

scripture_data.text_id: (51-7) Sesungguhnya, dalam kesalahan aku diperanakkan, dalam dosa aku dikandung ibuku.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me.
scripture_data.text_orig: דימת יגן יתחו ד ינ יפי

scripture_data.text_id: (51-8) Sesungguhnya, Engkau berkenan akan kebenaran dalam batin, dan dengan diam-diam Engkau memberitahukan hikmat kepadaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden [part] thou shalt make me to know wisdom.
scripture_data.text_orig: פב הז רבד קצ מל יתי יני רהו יתח בל ל

scripture_data.text_id: (51-9) Bersihkanlah aku dari pada dosaku dengan hisop, maka aku menjadi tahir, basuhlah aku, maka aku menjadi lebih putih dari salju!
scripture_data.text_en: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ינתמחי חב יללח וה

scripture_data.text_id: (51-10) Biarlah aku mendengar kegirangan dan sukacita, biarlah tulang yang Kauremukkan bersorak-sorak kembali!
scripture_data.text_en: Make me to hear joy and gladness; [that] the bones [which] thou hast broken may rejoice.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינידת המכח תסב תחב צפח תמה

scripture_data.text_id: (51-11) Sembunyikanlah wajah-Mu terhadap dosaku, hapuskanlah segala kesalahanku!
scripture_data.text_en: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל גלמ ינסכ רהו בזב ינח

scripture_data.text_id: (51-12) Jadikanlah hatiku tahir, ya Allah, dan perbaharuilah batinku dengan roh yang teguh!
scripture_data.text_en: Create in me a clean heart, O God; and renew a right spirit within me.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי תמצ הנלג החמו ינימ

scripture_data.text_id: (51-13) Janganlah membuang aku dari hadapan-Mu, dan janganlah mengambil roh-Mu yang kudus dari padaku!
scripture_data.text_en: Cast me not away from thy presence; and take not thy holy spirit from me.
scripture_data.text_orig: החם יתנולכו יחמ ינ רסה

scripture_data.text_id: (51-14) Bangkitkanlah kembali padaku kegirangan karena selamat yang dari pada-Mu, dan lengkapilah aku dengan roh yang rela!
scripture_data.text_en: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation; and uphold me [with thy] free spirit.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירק ח כנ חרו יהל ילר רה בל

scripture_data.text_id: (51-15) Maka aku akan mengajarkan jalan-Mu kepada orang-orang yang melakukan pelanggaran, supaya orang-orang berdosa berbalik kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: [Then] will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ חל דק חרו ינפמ ינכילל

scripture_data.text_id: (51-16) Lepaskanlah aku dari hutang darah, ya Allah, Allah keselamatanku, maka lidahku akan bersorak-sorai memberitakan keadilan-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: [and] my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינכמסת הבידן חרו י י הביה

scripture_data.text_id: (51-17) Ya Tuhan, bukalah bibirku, supaya mulutku memberitakan puji-pujian kepada-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי יל יחו יכר יפ הדל

scripture_data.text_id: (51-18) Sebab Engkau tidak berkenan kepada korban sembelihan; sekiranya kupersembahkan korban bakaran, Engkau tidak menyukainya.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give [it]: thou delightest not in burnt offering.
scripture_data.text_orig: תקדצ ינל ר ית יהל יהל יממ ינליה

scripture_data.text_id: (51-19) Korban sembelihan kepada Allah ialah jiwa yang hancur; hati yang patah dan remuk tidak akan Kaupandang hina, ya Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: The sacrifices of God [are] a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.
scripture_data.text_orig: תה דיי יפ חפ יתפ ינד

scripture_data.text_id: (51-20) Lakukanlah kebaikan kepada Sion menurut kerelaan hati-Mu bangunkanlah tembok-tembok Yerusalem!
scripture_data.text_en: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.
scripture_data.text_orig: הצרת ל הל הנו חבז שחתל י

scripture_data.text_id: (51-21) Maka Engkau akan berkenan kepada korban yang benar, korban bakaran dan korban yang terbakar seluruhnya; maka orang akan mengorbankan lembu jantan di atas mezbah-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.
scripture_data.text_orig: הזבת ל יהל הדנו רנבל הרנ חר יהל יחבז

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Nyanyian pengajaran Daud, (52-2) ketika Doeg, orang Edom itu, datang memberitahukan kepada Saul, bahwa Daud telah sampai di rumah Ahimelekh. (52-3) Mengapa engkau memegahkan diri dengan kejahatan, hai pahlawan, terhadap orang yang dikasihi Allah sepanjang hari?
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech.> Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God [endureth] continually.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל לים חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (52-4) Engkau merancangkan penghancuran, lidahmu seperti pisau cukur yang diasah, hai engkau, penipu!
scripture_data.text_en: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.
scripture_data.text_orig: למיח תיל דוד ל רמו לל דו ימדה ג ב

scripture_data.text_id: (52-5) Engkau mencintai yang jahat lebih dari pada yang baik, dan dusta lebih dari pada perkataan yang benar. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thou lovest evil more than good; [and] lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל ל דסח רה הר להתהם

scripture_data.text_id: (52-6) Engkau mencintai segala perkataan yang mengacaukan, hai lidah penipu!
scripture_data.text_en: Thou lovest all devouring words, O [thou] deceitful tongue.
scripture_data.text_orig: המר ה למ רת נל בח תה

scripture_data.text_id: (52-7) Tetapi Allah akan merobohkan engkau untuk seterusnya, Ia akan merebut engkau dan mencabut engkau dari dalam kemah, membantun engkau dari dalam negeri orang-orang hidup. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of [thy] dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס קדצ רמ רק במ בה

scripture_data.text_id: (52-8) Maka orang-orang benar akan melihatnya dan menjadi takut, dan mereka akan menertawakannya:
scripture_data.text_en: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:
scripture_data.text_orig: המרמ ל לבירבלכ בה

scripture_data.text_id: (52-9) "Lihatlah orang itu yang tidak menjadikan Allah tempat pengungsiannya, yang percaya akan kekayaannya yang melimpah, dan berlindung pada tindakan penghancurannya!"
scripture_data.text_en: Lo, [this is] the man [that] made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, [and] strengthened himself in his wickedness.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יח שרמ רו להמ חיו חי חצנל צי ל

scripture_data.text_id: (52-10) Tetapi aku ini seperti pohon zaitun yang menghijau di dalam rumah Allah; aku percaya akan kasih setia Allah untuk seterusnya dan selamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: But I [am] like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: קחי וילו רייו יקיץ ריו

scripture_data.text_id: (52-11) Aku hendak bersyukur kepada-Mu selama-lamanya, sebab Engkaulah yang bertindak; karena nama-Mu baik, aku hendak memasyhurkannya di depan orang-orang yang Kaukasihi!
scripture_data.text_en: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done [it]: and I will wait on thy name; for [it is] good before thy saints.
scripture_data.text_orig: תה זי ר בר חבו מ יהל יי ל רבה הה

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Mahalat. Nyanyian pengajaran Daud. (53-2) Orang bebal berkata dalam hatinya: "Tidak ada Allah!" Busuk dan jijik kecurangan mereka, tidak ada yang berbuat baik.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David.> The fool hath said in his heart, [There is] no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: [there is] none that doeth good.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל לים תלחמל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (53-3) Allah memandang ke bawah dari sorga kepada anak-anak manusia, untuk melihat apakah ada yang berakal budi dan yang mencari Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were [any] that did understand, that did seek God.
scripture_data.text_orig: בה י לו ביתהו תיחה יהל י ל לבנ רמ

scripture_data.text_id: (53-4) Mereka semua telah menyimpang, sekaliannya telah bejat; tidak ada yang berbuat baik, seorangpun tidak.
scripture_data.text_en: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; [there is] none that doeth good, no, not one.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלת ר לים יה תרל ד ינל יקה יממ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (53-5) Tidak sadarkah orang-orang yang melakukan kejahatan, yang memakan habis umat-Ku seperti memakan roti, dan yang tidak berseru kepada Allah?
scripture_data.text_en: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people [as] they eat bread: they have not called upon God.
scripture_data.text_orig: דח י בה י חלנ וחי גס

scripture_data.text_id: (53-6) Di sanalah mereka ditimpa kekejutan yang besar, padahal tidak ada yang mengejutkan; sebab Allah menghamburkan tulang-tulang para pengepungmu; mereka akan dipermalukan, sebab Allah telah menolak mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: There were they in great fear, [where] no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth [against] thee: thou hast put [them] to shame, because God hath despised them.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק ל יהל חל לכ י ילכ ו יל די לה

scripture_data.text_id: (53-7) Ya, datanglah kiranya dari Sion keselamatan bagi Israel! Apabila Allah memulihkan keadaan umat-Nya, maka Yakub akan bersorak-sorak, Israel akan bersukacita.
scripture_data.text_en: Oh that the salvation of Israel [were come] out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, [and] Israel shall be glad.
scripture_data.text_orig: סם יהלי התבה נח תמץ ר יהלי דחפ היהל דחפדח

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan kecapi. Nyanyian pengajaran Daud, (54-2) ketika orang Zifi datang mengatakan kepada Saul: "Daud bersembunyi kepada kami." (54-3) Ya Allah, selamatkanlah aku karena nama-Mu, berilah keadilan kepadaku karena keperkasaan-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us?> Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל לים תניגנ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (54-4) Ya Allah, dengarkanlah doaku, berilah telinga kepada ucapan mulutku!
scripture_data.text_en: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ רסמ דוד לה לל רמו יפיה ב

scripture_data.text_id: (54-5) Sebab orang-orang yang angkuh bangkit menyerang aku, orang-orang yang sombong ingin mencabut nyawaku; mereka tidak mempedulikan Allah. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יננידת תרבגב יניה מ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (54-6) Sesungguhnya, Allah adalah penolongku; Tuhanlah yang menopang aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, God [is] mine helper: the Lord [is] with them that uphold my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפירמל הניזה יתפ מ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (54-7) Biarlah kejahatan itu berbalik kepada seteru-seteruku; binasakanlah mereka karena kesetiaan-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס גנל יהל מ ל יפן ק יצירו יל מק ירז י

scripture_data.text_id: (54-8) Dengan rela hati aku akan mempersembahkan korban kepada-Mu, bersyukur sebab nama-Mu baik, ya TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O LORD; for [it is] good.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן יכמס ינד יל רז יהל הה

scripture_data.text_id: (54-9) Sebab Ia melepaskan aku dari segala kesesakan, dan mataku memandangi musuhku.
scripture_data.text_en: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen [his desire] upon mine enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: תימצה מ יררל רה ביי בי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan kecapi. Nyanyian pengajaran Daud. (55-2) Berilah telinga, ya Allah, kepada doaku, janganlah bersembunyi terhadap permohonanku!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, [A Psalm] of David.> Give ear to my prayer, O God; and hide not thyself from my supplication.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל לים תניגנ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (55-3) Perhatikanlah aku dan jawablah aku! Aku mengembara dan menangis karena cemas,
scripture_data.text_en: Attend unto me, and hear me: I mourn in my complaint, and make a noise;
scripture_data.text_orig: יתחמ תלו יתפ יהל הניזה

scripture_data.text_id: (55-4) karena teriakan musuh, karena aniaya orang fasik; sebab mereka menimpakan kemalangan kepadaku, dan dengan geramnya mereka memusuhi aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked: for they cast iniquity upon me, and in wrath they hate me.
scripture_data.text_orig: המיהו יחי דיר יננו י הביקה

scripture_data.text_id: (55-5) Hatiku gelisah, kengerian maut telah menimpa aku.
scripture_data.text_en: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינמי ב ו יל ימיי ר תק ינמ בי למ

scripture_data.text_id: (55-6) Aku dirundung takut dan gentar, perasaan seram meliputi aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל לפנ תומ תמיו ירק ליחי יל

scripture_data.text_id: (55-7) Pikirku: "Sekiranya aku diberi sayap seperti merpati, aku akan terbang dan mencari tempat yang tenang,
scripture_data.text_en: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! [for then] would I fly away, and be at rest.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצ ינכו יב בי דרו הרי

scripture_data.text_id: (55-8) bahkan aku akan lari jauh-jauh dan bermalam di padang gurun. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Lo, [then] would I wander far off, [and] remain in the wilderness. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנו הפ הנ רב ייימ רמו

scripture_data.text_id: (55-9) Aku akan segera mencari tempat perlindungan terhadap angin ribut dan badai."
scripture_data.text_en: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm [and] tempest.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס רד יל דדן קיחר הה

scripture_data.text_id: (55-10) Bingungkanlah mereka, kacaukanlah percakapan mereka, ya Tuhan, sebab aku melihat kekerasan dan perbantahan dalam kota!
scripture_data.text_en: Destroy, O Lord, [and] divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ הס חרמ יל לפמ היח

scripture_data.text_id: (55-11) Siang malam mereka mengelilingi kota itu di atas tembok-temboknya, dan di dalamnya ada kemalangan dan bencana;
scripture_data.text_en: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow [are] in the midst of it.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי בירו סמח יתירי נל ג ינד

scripture_data.text_id: (55-12) penghancuran ada di tengah-tengahnya, di tanah lapangnya tidak habis-habisnya ada penindasan dan tipu.
scripture_data.text_en: Wickedness [is] in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק למו וו היתמחל הבבסי הלילו מי

scripture_data.text_id: (55-13) Kalau musuhku yang mencela aku, aku masih dapat menanggungnya; kalau pembenciku yang membesarkan diri terhadap aku, aku masih dapat menyembunyikan diri terhadap dia.
scripture_data.text_en: For [it was] not an enemy [that] reproached me; then I could have borne [it]: neither [was it] he that hated me [that] did magnify [himself] against me; then I would have hid myself from him:
scripture_data.text_orig: המרמ בחרמ ימילו רק תה

scripture_data.text_id: (55-14) Tetapi engkau orang yang dekat dengan aku, temanku dan orang kepercayaanku:
scripture_data.text_en: But [it was] thou, a man mine equal, my guide, and mine acquaintance.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ רתו ליגה יל ינמל ו ינפרחי ביל י

scripture_data.text_id: (55-15) kami yang bersama-sama bergaul dengan baik, dan masuk rumah Allah di tengah-tengah keramaian.
scripture_data.text_en: We took sweet counsel together, [and] walked unto the house of God in company.
scripture_data.text_orig: יימ יפ יר נ הו

scripture_data.text_id: (55-16) Biarlah maut menyergap mereka, biarlah mereka turun hidup-hidup ke dalam dunia orang mati! Sebab kejahatan ada di kediaman mereka, ya dalam batin mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Let death seize upon them, [and] let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness [is] in their dwellings, [and] among them.
scripture_data.text_orig: גר הן יהל תיב דס קימן וחי ר

scripture_data.text_id: (55-17) Tetapi aku berseru kepada Allah, dan TUHAN akan menyelamatkan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: As for me, I will call upon God; and the LORD shall save me.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק רגמ תרי יח ל דרי מיל תומ יי תומיי

scripture_data.text_id: (55-18) Di waktu petang, pagi dan tengah hari aku cemas dan menangis; dan Ia mendengar suaraku.
scripture_data.text_en: Evening, and morning, and at noon, will I pray, and cry aloud: and he shall hear my voice.
scripture_data.text_orig: יניי הוהיו רק יהלל ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (55-19) Ia membebaskan aku dengan aman dari serangan terhadap aku, sebab berduyun-duyun mereka melawan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle [that was] against me: for there were many with me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילק מו המהו החי ירהצו רקבו בר

scripture_data.text_id: (55-20) Allah akan mendengar dan merendahkan mereka, Dia yang bersemayam sejak purbakala. Sela Karena mereka tidak berubah dan mereka tidak takut akan Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יד יה ירבי ילברמ יפנ לב הד

scripture_data.text_id: (55-21) Orang itu mengacungkan tangannya kepada mereka yang hidup damai dengan dia, janjinya dilanggarnya;
scripture_data.text_en: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל רי לו מל תפילח י ר הלס דק ביו ניו ל מי

scripture_data.text_id: (55-22) mulutnya lebih licin dari mentega, tetapi ia berniat menyerang; perkataannya lebih lembut dari minyak, tetapi semuanya adalah pedang terhunus.
scripture_data.text_en: [The words] of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war [was] in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet [were] they drawn swords.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיר לח וימל וידי חל

scripture_data.text_id: (55-23) Serahkanlah kuatirmu kepada TUHAN, maka Ia akan memelihara engkau! Tidak untuk selama-lamanya dibiarkan-Nya orang benar itu goyah.
scripture_data.text_en: Cast thy burden upon the LORD, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: תחתף ההו ממ וירבד ר לברק וי תמחם קלח

scripture_data.text_id: (55-24) Tetapi Engkau, ya Allah, akan menjerumuskan mereka ke lubang sumur yang dalam; orang penumpah darah dan penipu tidak akan mencapai setengah umurnya. Tetapi aku ini percaya kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיל מ לל יל ללכי הו בהי הוהיל לה

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Merpati di pohon-pohon tarbantin yang jauh. Miktam dari Daud, ketika orang Filistin menangkap dia di Gat. (56-2) Kasihanilah aku, ya Allah, sebab orang-orang menginjak-injak aku, sepanjang hari orang memerangi dan mengimpit aku!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Jonathelemrechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath.> Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.
scripture_data.text_orig: תג ילף ת זח כמ דודל יקחר ל תניל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (56-3) Seteru-seteruku menginjak-injak aku sepanjang hari, bahkan banyak orang yang memerangi aku dengan sombong.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine enemies would daily swallow [me] up: for [they be] many that fight against me, O thou most High.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינצחלי חל הל נ ינפי יהל ינח

scripture_data.text_id: (56-4) Waktu aku takut, aku ini percaya kepada-Mu;
scripture_data.text_en: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ יל ימחל ירי הל ירר פ

scripture_data.text_id: (56-5) kepada Allah, yang firman-Nya kupuji, kepada Allah aku percaya, aku tidak takut. Apakah yang dapat dilakukan manusia terhadap aku?
scripture_data.text_en: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.
scripture_data.text_orig: חב יל ינ רי י

scripture_data.text_id: (56-6) Sepanjang hari mereka mengacaukan perkaraku; mereka senantiasa bermaksud jahat terhadap aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts [are] against me for evil.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל רב ההם רי ל יח יהל רב לה יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (56-7) Mereka mau menyerbu, mereka mengintip, mengamat-amati langkahku, seperti orang-orang yang ingin mencabut nyawaku.
scripture_data.text_en: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: רל תבחמל יל בי ירב הל

scripture_data.text_id: (56-8) Apakah mereka dapat luput dengan kejahatan mereka? Runtuhkanlah bangsa-bangsa dengan murka-Mu, ya Allah!
scripture_data.text_en: Shall they escape by iniquity? in [thine] anger cast down the people, O God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן ק ר רמי יבק הה נצי ניצי רגי

scripture_data.text_id: (56-9) Sengsaraku Engkaulah yang menghitung-hitung, air mataku Kautaruh ke dalam kirbat-Mu. Bukankah semuanya telah Kaudaftarkan?
scripture_data.text_en: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: [are they] not in thy book?
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל דרה י מל ול

scripture_data.text_id: (56-10) Maka musuhku akan mundur pada waktu aku berseru; aku yakin, bahwa Allah memihak kepadaku.
scripture_data.text_en: When I cry [unto thee], then shall mine enemies turn back: this I know; for God [is] for me.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרפס לה דנב יתמד המי ה הרפס ידנ

scripture_data.text_id: (56-11) Kepada Allah, firman-Nya kupuji, kepada TUHAN, firman-Nya kupuji,
scripture_data.text_en: In God will I praise [his] word: in the LORD will I praise [his] word.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יהלי ידיהז רק י רח יבי בי ז

scripture_data.text_id: (56-12) kepada Allah aku percaya, aku tidak takut. Apakah yang dapat dilakukan manusia terhadap aku?
scripture_data.text_en: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב לה הוהי רב לה יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (56-13) Nazarku kepada-Mu, ya Allah, akan kulaksanakan, dan korban syukur akan kubayar kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy vows [are] upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ד ההם רי ל יח יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (56-14) Sebab Engkau telah meluputkan aku dari pada maut, bahkan menjaga kakiku, sehingga tidak tersandung; maka aku boleh berjalan di hadapan Allah dalam cahaya kehidupan.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death: [wilt] not [thou deliver] my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living?
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תד ירדן יהל יל

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Jangan memusnahkan. Miktam Dari Daud, ketika ia lari dari pada Saul, ke dalam gua. (57-2) Kasihanilah aku, ya Allah, kasihanilah aku, sebab kepada-Mulah jiwaku berlindung; dalam naungan sayap-Mu aku akan berlindung, sampai berlalu penghancuran itu.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David, when he fled from Saul in the cave.> Be merciful unto me, O God, be merciful unto me: for my soul trusteth in thee: yea, in the shadow of thy wings will I make my refuge, until [these] calamities be overpast.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר לינמ חרב כמ דודל תחל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (57-3) Aku berseru kepada Allah, Yang Mahatinggi, kepada Allah yang menyelesaikannya bagiku.
scripture_data.text_en: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth [all things] for me.
scripture_data.text_orig: תה רבי ד הסח יפנלצב יפנ היסח ב י ינח יהל ינח

scripture_data.text_id: (57-4) Kiranya Ia mengirim utusan dari sorga dan menyelamatkan aku, mencela orang-orang yang menginjak-injak aku. Sela Kiranya Allah mengirim kasih setia dan kebenaran-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall send from heaven, and save me [from] the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל רמ לל יל יהלל רק

scripture_data.text_id: (57-5) Aku terbaring di tengah-tengah singa yang suka menerkam anak-anak manusia, yang giginya laksana tombak dan panah, dan lidahnya laksana pedang tajam.
scripture_data.text_en: My soul [is] among lions: [and] I lie [even among] them that are set on fire, [even] the sons of men, whose teeth [are] spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.
scripture_data.text_orig: מו סח יהל חלי הלס יפ רח ינייו יממ חלי

scripture_data.text_id: (57-6) Tinggikanlah diri-Mu mengatasi langit, ya Allah! Biarlah kemuliaan-Mu mengatasi seluruh bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens; [let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הח ברח נל יחו תינח הי דינ יהל הב בל ת יפן

scripture_data.text_id: (57-7) Mereka memasang jaring terhadap langkah-langkahku, ditundukkannya jiwaku, mereka menggali lobang di depanku, tetapi mereka sendiri jatuh ke dalamnya. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen [themselves]. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב שרהל ל יהל ימהל המר

scripture_data.text_id: (57-8) Hatiku siap, ya Allah, hatiku siap; aku mau menyanyi, aku mau bermazmur.
scripture_data.text_en: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס כתב לפנ החי ינפל ר יפנ פ ימפל ניכה תר

scripture_data.text_id: (57-9) Bangunlah, hai jiwaku, bangunlah, hai gambus dan kecapi, aku mau membangunkan fajar!
scripture_data.text_en: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I [myself] will awake early.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרזו הרי יל כנ יהל יל כנ

scripture_data.text_id: (57-10) Aku mau bersyukur kepada-Mu di antara bangsa-bangsa, ya Tuhan, aku mau bermazmur bagi-Mu di antara suku-suku bangsa;
scripture_data.text_en: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
scripture_data.text_orig: רח הרי רכו לבה הר ידבך הר

scripture_data.text_id: (57-11) sebab kasih setia-Mu besar sampai ke langit, dan kebenaran-Mu sampai ke awan-awan.
scripture_data.text_en: For thy mercy [is] great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל רז ינד יב ד

scripture_data.text_id: (57-12) Tinggikanlah diri-Mu mengatasi langit, ya Allah! Biarlah kemuliaan-Mu mengatasi seluruh bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: [let] thy glory [be] above all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ יקחדו סח ימד לדגי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Jangan memusnahkan. Miktam dari Daud. (58-2) Sungguhkah kamu memberi keputusan yang adil, hai para penguasa? Apakah kamu hakimi anak-anak manusia dengan jujur?
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David.> Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
scripture_data.text_orig: כמ דודל תחל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (58-3) Malah sesuai dengan niatmu kamu melakukan kejahatan, tanganmu, menjalankan kekerasan di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ינ ירימ רד קדצ ל נמה

scripture_data.text_id: (58-4) Sejak lahir orang-orang fasik telah menyimpang, sejak dari kandungan pendusta-pendusta telah sesat.
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ספ כידי סמח שר לפ תל בל

scripture_data.text_id: (58-5) Bisa mereka serupa bisa ular, mereka seperti ular tedung tuli yang menutup telinganya,
scripture_data.text_en: Their poison [is] like the poison of a serpent: [they are] like the deaf adder [that] stoppeth her ear;
scripture_data.text_orig: בזכ ירב מ חרמ יר רז

scripture_data.text_id: (58-6) yang tidak mendengarkan suara tukang-tukang serapah atau suara pembaca mantera yang pandai.
scripture_data.text_en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
scripture_data.text_orig: נז י רח תפמ חנתמח תמד מלתמח

scripture_data.text_id: (58-7) Ya Allah, hancurkanlah gigi mereka dalam mulutnya, patahkanlah gigi geligi singa-singa muda, ya TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: חם ירבח רבח יחלם לקל מיל ר

scripture_data.text_id: (58-8) Biarlah mereka hilang seperti air yang mengalir lenyap! Biarlah mereka menjadi layu seperti rumput di jalan!
scripture_data.text_en: Let them melt away as waters [which] run continually: [when] he bendeth [his bow to shoot] his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי שתן יריפ תלם מיפ מיסרה יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (58-9) Biarlah mereka seperti siput yang menjadi lendir, seperti guguran perempuan yang tidak melihat matahari.
scripture_data.text_en: As a snail [which] melteth, let [every one of them] pass away: [like] the untimely birth of a woman, [that] they may not see the sun.
scripture_data.text_orig: ללמתי מ ויח ח רדי מלכהתי יממך סי

scripture_data.text_id: (58-10) Sebelum periuk-periukmu merasakan api semak duri, telah dilanda-Nya baik yang hidup segar maupun yang hangus.
scripture_data.text_en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in [his] wrath.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ זחל ת לפנ להי סמ לל מ

scripture_data.text_id: (58-11) Orang benar itu akan bersukacita, sebab ia memandang pembalasan, ia akan membasuh kakinya dalam darah orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי רחמ יחמ ד כיתרי ניבי ר

scripture_data.text_id: (58-12) Dan orang akan berkata: "Sesungguhnya ada pahala bagi orang benar, sesungguhnya ada Allah yang memberi keadilan di bumi."
scripture_data.text_en: So that a man shall say, Verily [there is] a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: רה ד שחרי וימ קנ הזחי קיצ חמי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Jangan memusnahkan. Miktam dari Daud, ketika Saul menyuruh orang mengawasi rumahnya untuk membunuh dia. (59-2) Lepaskanlah aku dari pada musuhku, ya Allahku; bentengilah aku terhadap orang-orang yang bangkit melawan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, Altaschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him.> Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: תימהל תיהת רמו ל חל כמ דודל תחל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (59-3) Lepaskanlah aku dari pada orang-orang yang melakukan kejahatan dan selamatkanlah aku dari pada penumpah-penumpah darah.
scripture_data.text_en: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינב יממקתמ יהל יבימ ינליה

scripture_data.text_id: (59-4) Sebab sesungguhnya, mereka menghadang nyawaku; orang-orang perkasa menyerbu aku, padahal aku tidak melakukan pelanggaran, aku tidak berdosa, ya TUHAN,
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not [for] my transgression, nor [for] my sin, O LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: יניה ימד ינמ ו ילמ ינליה

scripture_data.text_id: (59-5) aku tidak bersalah, merekalah yang lari dan bersiap-siap. Marilah mendapatkan aku, dan lihatlah!
scripture_data.text_en: They run and prepare themselves without [my] fault: awake to help me, and behold.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יתחלו יפל יז יל רגי יפנל בר הה י

scripture_data.text_id: (59-6) Engkau, TUHAN, Allah semesta alam, adalah Allah Israel. Bangunlah untuk menghukum segala bangsa; janganlah mengasihani mereka yang melakukan kejahatan dengan berkhianat! Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thou therefore, O LORD God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר יתרקל הר נניו צרי ויל

scripture_data.text_id: (59-7) Pada waktu senja mereka datang kembali, mereka melolong seperti anjing dan mengelilingi kota.
scripture_data.text_en: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ו ידגל חל יהל דקפל הציקה לרי יהל תבץ יהלהוהי הו

scripture_data.text_id: (59-8) Sesungguhnya, mereka menyindir dengan mulutnya; cemooh ada di bibir mereka, sebab siapakah yang mendengarnya?
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords [are] in their lips: for who, [say they], doth hear?
scripture_data.text_orig: רי בבסיו בלך מהי ברל בי

scripture_data.text_id: (59-9) Tetapi Engkau, TUHAN, menertawakan mereka, Engkau mengolok-olok segala bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou, O LORD, shalt laugh at them; thou shalt have all the heathen in derision.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ ימי היתתפ תברח היפ יי הה

scripture_data.text_id: (59-10) Ya kekuatanku, aku mau berpegang pada-Mu, sebab Allah adalah kota bentengku.
scripture_data.text_en: [Because of] his strength will I wait upon thee: for God [is] my defence.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילכל גל מלקח הוהי הו

scripture_data.text_id: (59-11) Allahku dengan kasih setia-Nya akan menyongsong aku; Allah akan membuat aku memandang rendah seteru-seteruku.
scripture_data.text_en: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see [my desire] upon mine enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ יהלי הרמ יל

scripture_data.text_id: (59-12) Janganlah membunuh mereka, supaya bangsaku tidak lupa, halaulah mereka kian ke mari dengan kuasa-Mu, dan jatuhkanlah mereka, ya Tuhan, perisai kami!
scripture_data.text_en: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.
scripture_data.text_orig: יררב ינרי יהל ינמקי יסח סח יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (59-13) Karena dosa mulut mereka adalah perkataan bibirnya, biarlah mereka tertangkap dalam kecongkakannya. Oleh karena sumpah serapah dan dusta yang mereka ceritakan,
scripture_data.text_en: [For] the sin of their mouth [and] the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying [which] they speak.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינד נגמ מדירהו ליחב מינה י חי גרהל

scripture_data.text_id: (59-14) habisilah mereka dalam geram, habisilah, sehingga mereka tidak ada lagi, supaya mereka sadar bahwa Allah memerintah di antara keturunan Yakub, sampai ke ujung bumi. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Consume [them] in wrath, consume [them], that they [may] not [be]: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: רסי חמ הלמ נגב דכיו מיתפרב מיתח

scripture_data.text_id: (59-15) Pada waktu senja mereka datang kembali, mereka melolong seperti anjing dan mengelilingi kota.
scripture_data.text_en: And at evening let them return; [and] let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס שרה יספל בקי למ יהלי דיו מניו ה המחב ה

scripture_data.text_id: (59-16) Mereka mengembara mencari makan; apabila mereka tidak kenyang, maka mereka mengaum.
scripture_data.text_en: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי בבסיו בלך מהי ברל ביו

scripture_data.text_id: (59-17) Tetapi aku mau menyanyikan kekuatan-Mu, pada waktu pagi aku mau bersorak-sorai karena kasih setia-Mu; sebab Engkau telah menjadi kota bentengku, tempat pelarianku pada waktu kesesakanku.
scripture_data.text_en: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.
scripture_data.text_orig: נילו י ל לכל יני ני הה

scripture_data.text_id: (59-18) Ya kekuatanku, bagi-Mu aku mau bermazmur; sebab Allah adalah kota bentengku, Allahku dengan kasih setia-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God [is] my defence, [and] the God of my mercy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילרץ י סנמ יל במ תייהי סח רקל רו רי ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Bunga bakung kesaksian. Miktam dari Daud untuk diajarkan, (60-2) ketika ia memerangi orang Aram-Mesopotamia dan orang Aram-Zoba, dan ketika Yoab pada waktu pulang telah memukul kalah dua belas ribu orang Edom di Lembah Asin. (60-3) Ya Allah, Engkau telah membuang kami, menembus pertahanan kami; Engkau telah murka; pulihkanlah kami!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Shushaneduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aramnaharaim and with Aramzobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand.> O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.
scripture_data.text_orig: דלל דודל כמ תד ל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (60-4) Engkau telah menggoncangkan bumi dan membelahnya; perbaikilah retak-retaknya, sebab bumi telah goyang.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ר ינ חלמיג דת ו בי בו הבצרתו ירהנר ת תה

scripture_data.text_id: (60-5) Engkau telah membuat umat-Mu mengalami penderitaan yang berat, Engkau telah memberi kami minum anggur yang memusingkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.
scripture_data.text_orig: נל בב פנ נצרף נחנז יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (60-6) Kepada mereka yang takut kepada-Mu telah Kauberikan panji-panji, tanda untuk berlindung terhadap panah. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: המיכ הירב הפר מצ שר הרה

scripture_data.text_id: (60-7) Supaya terluput orang-orang yang Kaucintai, berikanlah keselamatan dengan tangan kanan-Mu dan jawablah kami!
scripture_data.text_en: That thy beloved may be delivered; save [with] thy right hand, and hear me.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלר יי נתיקה הק התירה

scripture_data.text_id: (60-8) Allah telah berfirman di tempat kudus-Nya: "Aku hendak beria-ria, Aku hendak membagi-bagikan Sikhem, dan lembah Sukot hendak Kuukur.
scripture_data.text_en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ק ינמ ססנתהל ס ירי התנ

scripture_data.text_id: (60-9) Punya-Ku Gilead dan punya-Ku Manasye, Efraim ialah pelindung kepala-Ku, Yehuda ialah tongkat kerajaan-Ku;
scripture_data.text_en: Gilead [is] mine, and Manasseh [is] mine; Ephraim also [is] the strength of mine head; Judah [is] my lawgiver;
scripture_data.text_orig: יננו ננו נימי היה ידידי צלחי מל

scripture_data.text_id: (60-10) Moab ialah tempat pembasuhan-Ku, kepada Edom Aku melemparkan kasut-Ku, karena Filistea Aku bersorak-sorai."
scripture_data.text_en: Moab [is] my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.
scripture_data.text_orig: דמ תס קמו כ הקח הזל דק ר יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (60-11) Siapakah yang akan membawa aku ke kota yang berkubu? Siapakah yang menuntun aku ke Edom?
scripture_data.text_en: Who will bring me [into] the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
scripture_data.text_orig: יקקחם הדהי יר זמ ירפו הנם ילו דלג יל

scripture_data.text_id: (60-12) Bukankah Engkau, ya Allah, yang telah membuang kami, dan yang tidak maju, ya Allah, bersama-sama bala tentara kami?
scripture_data.text_en: [Wilt] not thou, O God, [which] hadst cast us off? and [thou], O God, [which] didst not go out with our armies?
scripture_data.text_orig: ירתה תל יל ילן יל דל יצחר ריס בם

scripture_data.text_id: (60-13) Berikanlah kepada kami pertolongan terhadap lawan, sebab sia-sia penyelamatan dari manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: Give us help from trouble: for vain [is] the help of man.
scripture_data.text_orig: דד ינחנ ימ רצמ רי ינלבי ימ

scripture_data.text_id: (60-14) Dengan Allah akan kita lakukan perbuatan-perbuatan gagah perkasa, sebab Ia sendiri akan menginjak-injak para lawan kita.
scripture_data.text_en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he [it is that] shall tread down our enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניתבצ יהל צתלו נחנז יהל הלה

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan kecapi. Dari Daud. (61-2) Dengarkanlah kiranya seruanku, ya Allah, perhatikanlah doaku!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Neginah, [A Psalm] of David.> Hear my cry, O God; attend unto my prayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל תניגנל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (61-3) Dari ujung bumi aku berseru kepada-Mu, karena hatiku lemah lesu; tuntunlah aku ke gunung batu yang terlalu tinggi bagiku.
scripture_data.text_en: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock [that] is higher than I.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתפ הביקה יתר יהל המ

scripture_data.text_id: (61-4) Sungguh Engkau telah menjadi tempat perlindunganku, menara yang kuat terhadap musuh.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou hast been a shelter for me, [and] a strong tower from the enemy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינחנת ימ רירצ יל רק יל שרה הצקמ

scripture_data.text_id: (61-5) Biarlah aku menumpang di dalam kemah-Mu untuk selama-lamanya, biarlah aku berlindung dalam naungan sayap-Mu! Sela
scripture_data.text_en: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי ינמ זלגמ יל הסחם תייהי

scripture_data.text_id: (61-6) Sungguh, Engkau, ya Allah, telah mendengarkan nazarku, telah memenuhi permintaan orang-orang yang takut akan nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given [me] the heritage of those that fear thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל יפנ רתסב הסח ימל להב הרג

scripture_data.text_id: (61-7) Tambahilah umur raja, tahun-tahun hidupnya kiranya sampai turun-temurun;
scripture_data.text_en: Thou wilt prolong the king's life: [and] his years as many generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ ירי תרי תנ ירדנל מ יהל הי

scripture_data.text_id: (61-8) kiranya ia bersemayam di hadapan Allah selama-lamanya, titahkanlah kasih setia dan kebenaran menjaga dia.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, [which] may preserve him.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדו רדמ ויתנ יס למימיל ימי

scripture_data.text_id: (61-9) Maka aku hendak memazmurkan nama-Mu untuk selamanya, sedang aku membayar nazarku hari demi hari.
scripture_data.text_en: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרצני מ תמו דסח יהל ינפל ל בי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut: Yedutun. Mazmur Daud. (62-2) Hanya dekat Allah saja aku tenang, dari pada-Nyalah keselamatanku.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David.> Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him [cometh] my salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ תדיל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (62-3) Hanya Dialah gunung batuku dan keselamatanku, kota bentengku, aku tidak akan goyah.
scripture_data.text_en: He only [is] my rock and my salvation; [he is] my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתי מ יפן המ יהלל

scripture_data.text_id: (62-4) Berapa lamakah kamu hendak menyerbu seseorang, hendak meremukkan dia, hai kamu sekalian, seperti terhadap dinding yang miring, terhadap tembok yang hendak roboh?
scripture_data.text_en: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall [shall ye be, and as] a tottering fence.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר ל ימ יתיו ירצ ה

scripture_data.text_id: (62-5) Mereka hanya bermaksud menghempaskan dia dari kedudukannya yang tinggi; mereka suka kepada dusta; dengan mulutnya mereka memberkati, tetapi dalam hatinya mereka mengutuki. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: They only consult to cast [him] down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: היחה רד ינ ריק ככ חר י ל תתה הנד

scripture_data.text_id: (62-6) Hanya pada Allah saja kiranya aku tenang, sebab dari pada-Nyalah harapanku.
scripture_data.text_en: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation [is] from him.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלסללקי רקב כרבי ויפ בזכ צרי חיהל צי תמ

scripture_data.text_id: (62-7) Hanya Dialah gunung batuku dan keselamatanku, kota bentengku, aku tidak akan goyah.
scripture_data.text_en: He only [is] my rock and my salvation: [he is] my defence; I shall not be moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתוק מי יפן י יהלל

scripture_data.text_id: (62-8) Pada Allah ada keselamatanku dan kemuliaanku; gunung batu kekuatanku, tempat perlindunganku ialah Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: In God [is] my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, [and] my refuge, [is] in God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ימ יתיו ירצ ה

scripture_data.text_id: (62-9) Percayalah kepada-Nya setiap waktu, hai umat, curahkanlah isi hatimu di hadapan-Nya; Allah ialah tempat perlindungan kita. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Trust in him at all times; [ye] people, pour out your heart before him: God [is] a refuge for us. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל יסחמ ירץ ידבכ יי יהלל

scripture_data.text_id: (62-10) Hanya angin saja orang-orang yang hina, suatu dusta saja orang-orang yang mulia. Pada neraca mereka naik ke atas, mereka sekalian lebih ringan dari pada angin.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely men of low degree [are] vanity, [and] men of high degree [are] a lie: to be laid in the balance, they [are] altogether [lighter] than vanity.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס נהסחם יהל כבבל וינפלכפ תלכב ב ח

scripture_data.text_id: (62-11) Janganlah percaya kepada pemerasan, janganlah menaruh harap yang sia-sia kepada perampasan; apabila harta makin bertambah, janganlah hatimu melekat padanya.
