scripture_data.text_en: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart [upon them].
scripture_data.text_orig: דחי לבהמ הה תלל ינזמ י ינ בז דינ לבה

scripture_data.text_id: (62-12) Satu kali Allah berfirman, dua hal yang aku dengar: bahwa kuasa dari Allah asalnya,
scripture_data.text_en: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power [belongeth] unto God.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל תיל בניי ליח להל לזגב קב חבל

scripture_data.text_id: (62-13) dan dari pada-Mu juga kasih setia, ya Tuhan; sebab Engkau membalas setiap orang menurut perbuatannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Also unto thee, O Lord, [belongeth] mercy: for thou renderest to every man according to his work.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל ז י ימ זי יהל ר תח

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Daud, ketika ia ada di padang gurun Yehuda. (63-2) Ya Allah, Engkaulah Allahku, aku mencari Engkau, jiwaku haus kepada-Mu, tubuhku rindu kepada-Mu, seperti tanah yang kering dan tandus, tiada berair.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah.> O God, thou [art] my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;
scripture_data.text_orig: הדהי רדמ תיה דודל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: (63-3) Demikianlah aku memandang kepada-Mu di tempat kudus, sambil melihat kekuatan-Mu dan kemuliaan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: To see thy power and thy glory, so [as] I have seen thee in the sanctuary.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימיל יו הצשר ירב ל מ יפן ל המצ שרח ה יל יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (63-4) Sebab kasih setia-Mu lebih baik dari pada hidup; bibirku akan memegahkan Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: Because thy lovingkindness [is] better than life, my lips shall praise thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: דבכ תרל יתיזח ד

scripture_data.text_id: (63-5) Demikianlah aku mau memuji Engkau seumur hidupku dan menaikkan tanganku demi nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: נחי יתפ יחמ סח בי

scripture_data.text_id: (63-6) Seperti dengan lemak dan sumsum jiwaku dikenyangkan, dan dengan bibir yang bersorak-sorai mulutku memuji-muji.
scripture_data.text_en: My soul shall be satisfied as [with] marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise [thee] with joyful lips:
scripture_data.text_orig: יך מ יחב כרב

scripture_data.text_id: (63-7) Apabila aku ingat kepada-Mu di tempat tidurku, merenungkan Engkau sepanjang kawal malam,
scripture_data.text_en: When I remember thee upon my bed, [and] meditate on thee in the [night] watches.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילהי תננר יתפו יפן דו בלח מ

scripture_data.text_id: (63-8) sungguh Engkau telah menjadi pertolonganku, dan dalam naungan sayap-Mu aku bersorak-sorai.
scripture_data.text_en: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.
scripture_data.text_orig: הה תרמ יציל ירכז

scripture_data.text_id: (63-9) Jiwaku melekat kepada-Mu, tangan kanan-Mu menopang aku.
scripture_data.text_en: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר יפנ לצב י התרז תייהי

scripture_data.text_id: (63-10) Tetapi orang-orang yang berikhtiar mencabut nyawaku, akan masuk ke bagian-bagian bumi yang paling bawah.
scripture_data.text_en: But those [that] seek my soul, to destroy [it], shall go into the lower parts of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימי הכמ י ירח יפן הקב

scripture_data.text_id: (63-11) Mereka akan diserahkan kepada kuasa pedang, mereka akan menjadi makanan anjing hutan.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה תחת בי יפן קבי הל ההו

scripture_data.text_id: (63-12) Tetapi raja akan bersukacita di dalam Allah; setiap orang, yang bersumpah demi Dia, akan bermegah, karena mulut orang-orang yang mengatakan dusta akan disumbat.
scripture_data.text_en: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהי יל תנם ברחידיל הריי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur Daud. (64-2) Ya Allah, dengarlah suaraku pada waktu aku mengaduh, jagalah nyawaku terhadap musuh yang dahsyat.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.> Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (64-3) Sembunyikanlah aku terhadap persepakatan orang jahat, terhadap kerusuhan orang-orang yang melakukan kejahatan,
scripture_data.text_en: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:
scripture_data.text_orig: יח ר בי דחמ יחיב ילק יהלמ

scripture_data.text_id: (64-4) yang menajamkan lidahnya seperti pedang, yang membidikkan kata yang pahit seperti panah,
scripture_data.text_en: Who whet their tongue like a sword, [and] bend [their bows to shoot] their arrows, [even] bitter words:
scripture_data.text_orig: ו יל תגרמ ירם דמ ינריס

scripture_data.text_id: (64-5) untuk menembak orang yang tulus hati dari tempat yang tersembunyi; sekonyong-konyong mereka menembak dia dengan tidak takut-takut.
scripture_data.text_en: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ רב ח כר נל ברחך ננ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (64-6) Mereka berpegang teguh pada maksud yang jahat, mereka membicarakan hendak memasang perangkap dengan sembunyi; kata mereka: "Siapa yang melihatnya?"
scripture_data.text_en: They encourage themselves [in] an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?
scripture_data.text_orig: ריי לו הרי ת ירס תריל

scripture_data.text_id: (64-7) Mereka merancang kecurangan-kecurangan: "Kami sudah siap, rancangan sudah rampung." Alangkah dalamnya batin dan hati orang!
scripture_data.text_en: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward [thought] of every one [of them], and the heart, [is] deep.
scripture_data.text_orig: מהרי ימ רמ יקם מל רסי ר רב מלקחי

scripture_data.text_id: (64-8) Tetapi Allah menembak mereka dengan panah; sekonyong-konyong mereka terluka.
scripture_data.text_en: But God shall shoot at them [with] an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.
scripture_data.text_orig: קמ בלו י ברקו חם פח נמ תלחי

scripture_data.text_id: (64-9) Ia membuat mereka tergelincir karena lidah mereka; setiap orang yang melihat mereka menggeleng kepala.
scripture_data.text_en: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.
scripture_data.text_orig: תם יה ת שח יהל רו

scripture_data.text_id: (64-10) Maka semua orang takut dan memberitakan perbuatan Allah, dan mengakui pekerjaan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב הרל דדנתי נל מיל הליכו

scripture_data.text_id: (64-11) Orang benar akan bersukacita karena TUHAN dan berlindung pada-Nya; semua orang yang jujur akan bermegah.
scripture_data.text_en: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליה המ יהל ל דיו דל ריו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur Daud. Nyanyian. (65-2) Bagi-Mulah puji-pujian di Sion, ya Allah; dan kepada-Mulah orang membayar nazar.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm [and] Song of David.> Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי דודל רמזמ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (65-3) Engkau yang mendengarkan doa. Kepada-Mulah datang semua yang hidup
scripture_data.text_en: O thou that hearest prayer, unto thee shall all flesh come.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדני ל צ יהל ההת המד ל

scripture_data.text_id: (65-4) karena bersalah. Bilamana pelanggaran-pelanggaran kami melebihi kekuatan kami, Engkaulah yang menghapuskannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Iniquities prevail against me: [as for] our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי רל יד הפ מ

scripture_data.text_id: (65-5) Berbahagialah orang yang Engkau pilih dan yang Engkau suruh mendekat untuk diam di pelataran-Mu! Kiranya kami menjadi kenyang dengan segala yang baik di rumah-Mu, di bait-Mu yang kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [is the man whom] thou choosest, and causest to approach [unto thee, that] he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, [even] of thy holy temple.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכת ה ני ים רב תנו ירב

scripture_data.text_id: (65-6) Dengan perbuatan-perbuatan yang dahsyat dan dengan keadilan Engkau menjawab kami, ya Allah yang menyelamatkan kami, Engkau, yang menjadi kepercayaan segala ujung bumi dan pulau-pulau yang jauh-jauh;
scripture_data.text_en: [By] terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; [who art] the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off [upon] the sea:
scripture_data.text_orig: לכיה דק תי ב הנ ירצח י ברקת רחב יר

scripture_data.text_id: (65-7) Engkau, yang menegakkan gunung-gunung dengan kekuatan-Mu, sedang pinggang-Mu berikatkan keperkasaan;
scripture_data.text_en: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; [being] girded with power:
scripture_data.text_orig: יקחר יו שריוצקל חבמ ני יהל ננ קדצ תרנ

scripture_data.text_id: (65-8) Engkau, yang meredakan deru lautan, deru gelombang-gelombangnya dan kegemparan bangsa-bangsa!
scripture_data.text_en: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרבג רזנ חכ ירה יכמ

scripture_data.text_id: (65-9) Sebab itu orang-orang yang diam di ujung-ujung bumi takut kepada tanda-tanda mujizat-Mu; tempat terbitnya pagi dan petang Kaubuat bersorak-sorai.
scripture_data.text_en: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל מהו הי יי חים

scripture_data.text_id: (65-10) Engkau mengindahkan tanah itu, mengaruniainya kelimpahan, dan membuatnya sangat kaya. Batang air Allah penuh air; Engkau menyediakan gandum bagi mereka. Ya, demikianlah Engkau menyediakannya:
scripture_data.text_en: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, [which] is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינר ברו רקביצמ יתתמ תוצק יבי ריו

scripture_data.text_id: (65-11) Engkau mengairi alur bajaknya, Engkau membasahi gumpalan-gumpalan tanahnya, dengan dirus hujan Engkau menggemburkannya; Engkau memberkati tumbuh-tumbuhannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: הניכ כי נג יכ ימ למ יהל גל הר תר הקקו שרה דק

scripture_data.text_id: (65-12) Engkau memahkotai tahun dengan kebaikan-Mu, jejak-Mu mengeluarkan lemak;
scripture_data.text_en: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב חמצ הגגמ יביבר הידד תחן הר הימל

scripture_data.text_id: (65-13) tanah-tanah padang gurun menitik, bukit-bukit berikatpinggangkan sorak-sorai;
scripture_data.text_en: They drop [upon] the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.
scripture_data.text_orig: פרי ילמ תב תנ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (65-14) padang-padang rumput berpakaikan kawanan kambing domba, lembah-lembah berselimutkan gandum, semuanya bersorak-sorai dan bernyanyi-nyanyi.
scripture_data.text_en: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנרח תב ליגו רדמ תן פרי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Nyanyian Mazmur. Bersorak-sorailah bagi Allah, hai seluruh bumi,
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Song [or] Psalm.> Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהל יהלל ירה רמזמ רי חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: mazmurkanlah kemuliaan nama-Nya, muliakanlah Dia dengan puji-pujian!
scripture_data.text_en: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.
scripture_data.text_orig: תה דבכ מי מדבך רז

scripture_data.text_id: Katakanlah kepada Allah: "Betapa dahsyatnya segala pekerjaan-Mu; oleh sebab kekuatan-Mu yang besar musuh-Mu tunduk menjilat kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Say unto God, How terrible [art thou in] thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבי ל חכי בר ים רהם יהלל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Seluruh bumi sujud menyembah kepada-Mu, dan bermazmur bagi-Mu, memazmurkan nama-Mu." Sela
scripture_data.text_en: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing [to] thy name. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס מ רזי לרזיו ל וחי שרהל

scripture_data.text_id: Pergilah dan lihatlah pekerjaan-pekerjaan Allah; Ia dahsyat dalam perbuatan-Nya terhadap manusia:
scripture_data.text_en: Come and see the works of God: [he is] terrible [in his] doing toward the children of men.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ינל הליל רן יהל תלפמ ר כל

scripture_data.text_id: Ia mengubah laut menjadi tanah kering, dan orang-orang itu berjalan kaki menyeberangi sungai. Oleh sebab itu kita bersukacita karena Dia,
scripture_data.text_en: He turned the sea into dry [land]: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.
scripture_data.text_orig: החמנ לגרב רבי רה היל י פה

scripture_data.text_id: yang memerintah dengan perkasa untuk selama-lamanya, yang mata-Nya mengawasi bangsa-bangsa. Pemberontak-pemberontak tidak dapat meninggikan diri. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס מל מרי מיריל יררה הניצ י ויני ל תרבג למ

scripture_data.text_id: Pujilah Allah kami, hai bangsa-bangsa, dan perdengarkanlah puji-pujian kepada-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:
scripture_data.text_orig: תה לק ימהו ניהל י כר

scripture_data.text_id: Ia mempertahankan jiwa kami di dalam hidup dan tidak membiarkan kaki kami goyah.
scripture_data.text_en: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלגר ל תנלו יח נפנ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkau telah menguji kami, ya Allah, telah memurnikan kami, seperti orang memurnikan perak.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.
scripture_data.text_orig: סרצ נפרצ יהל ננחבי

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau telah membawa kami ke dalam jaring, mengenakan beban pada pinggang kami;
scripture_data.text_en: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.
scripture_data.text_orig: נינתמב הקם מ הדצב נתבה

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau telah membiarkan orang-orang melintasi kepala kami, kami telah menempuh api dan air; tetapi Engkau telah mengeluarkan kami sehingga bebas.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy [place].
scripture_data.text_orig: היורל ניצו יב בנ נרל נ ברה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan masuk ke dalam rumah-Mu dengan membawa korban-korban bakaran, aku akan membayar kepada-Mu nazarku,
scripture_data.text_en: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,
scripture_data.text_orig: ירדן ל תלב תיב ב

scripture_data.text_id: yang telah diucapkan bibirku, dan dikatakan mulutku pada waktu aku susah.
scripture_data.text_en: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילר ירדו יתפ צר

scripture_data.text_id: Korban-korban bakaran dari binatang gemuk akan kupersembahkan kepada-Mu, dengan asap korban dari domba-domba jantan; aku akan menyediakan lembu-lembu dan kambing-kambing jantan. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יד רקב ה ילי תרק הל יחמ תל

scripture_data.text_id: Marilah, dengarlah, hai kamu sekalian yang takut akan Allah, aku hendak menceritakan apa yang dilakukan-Nya terhadap diriku.
scripture_data.text_en: Come [and] hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפנל ה ר יהל יריל הרסו מכל

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada-Nya aku telah berseru dengan mulutku, kini dengan lidahku aku menyanyikan pujian.
scripture_data.text_en: I cried unto him with my mouth, and he was extolled with my tongue.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינל תח מרו יתרקי ויל

scripture_data.text_id: Seandainya ada niat jahat dalam hatiku, tentulah Tuhan tidak mau mendengar.
scripture_data.text_en: If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear [me]:
scripture_data.text_orig: ינד מי ל ילב יתיר ו

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, Allah telah mendengar, Ia telah memperhatikan doa yang kuucapkan.
scripture_data.text_en: [But] verily God hath heard [me]; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתפ לק ביקה יהל מ כ

scripture_data.text_id: Terpujilah Allah, yang tidak menolak doaku dan tidak menjauhkan kasih setia-Nya dari padaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [be] God, which hath not turned away my prayer, nor his mercy from me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ סחו יתפ ריסהל ר יהל ר

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan kecapi. Mazmur. Nyanyian. (67-2) Kiranya Allah mengasihani kita dan memberkati kita, kiranya Ia menyinari kita dengan wajah-Nya, Sela
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song.> God be merciful unto us, and bless us; [and] cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי רמזמ תניגנ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (67-3) supaya jalan-Mu dikenal di bumi, dan keselamatan-Mu di antara segala bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס נ וינ רי נכרביו נחי יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (67-4) Kiranya bangsa-bangsa bersyukur kepada-Mu, ya Allah; kiranya bangsa-bangsa semuanya bersyukur kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי ילכ ר שר תדל

scripture_data.text_id: (67-5) Kiranya suku-suku bangsa bersukacita dan bersorak-sorai, sebab Engkau memerintah bangsa-bangsa dengan adil, dan menuntun suku-suku bangsa di atas bumi. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: י די יהל י די

scripture_data.text_id: (67-6) Kiranya bangsa-bangsa bersyukur kepada-Mu, ya Allah, kiranya bangsa-bangsa semuanya bersyukur kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס חנ שר יל רימ י תי יל נריו חמי

scripture_data.text_id: (67-7) Tanah telah memberi hasilnya; Allah, Allah kita, memberkati kita.
scripture_data.text_en: [Then] shall the earth yield her increase; [and] God, [even] our own God, shall bless us.
scripture_data.text_orig: י די יהל י די

scripture_data.text_id: (67-8) Allah memberkati kita; kiranya segala ujung bumi takut akan Dia!
scripture_data.text_en: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניהל יהל נכרבי לבי הנתנ שר

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur Daud. Nyanyian. (68-2) Allah bangkit, maka terseraklah musuh-musuh-Nya, orang-orang yang membenci Dia melarikan diri dari hadapan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm [or] Song of David.> Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי רמזמ דודל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-3) Seperti asap hilang tertiup, seperti lilin meleleh di depan api, demikianlah orang-orang fasik binasa di hadapan Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: As smoke is driven away, [so] drive [them] away: as wax melteth before the fire, [so] let the wicked perish at the presence of God.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינמ וינמ סניו ויבי צפי יהל קי

scripture_data.text_id: (68-4) Tetapi orang-orang benar bersukacita, mereka beria-ria di hadapan Allah, bergembira dan bersukacita.
scripture_data.text_en: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל ינמ יר דבי ינמ גנ סה נ נה

scripture_data.text_id: (68-5) Bernyanyilah bagi Allah, mazmurkanlah nama-Nya, buatlah jalan bagi Dia yang berkendaraan melintasi awan-awan! Nama-Nya ialah TUHAN; beria-rialah di hadapan-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name JAH, and rejoice before him.
scripture_data.text_orig: החמב ייו יהל ינפל צלי חמי יקיצו

scripture_data.text_id: (68-6) Bapa bagi anak yatim dan Pelindung bagi para janda, itulah Allah di kediaman-Nya yang kudus;
scripture_data.text_en: A father of the fatherless, and a judge of the widows, [is] God in his holy habitation.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינפל זלו מ י תבר בכרל ס מ רז יהלל רי

scripture_data.text_id: (68-7) Allah memberi tempat tinggal kepada orang-orang sebatang kara, Ia mengeluarkan orang-orang tahanan, sehingga mereka bahagia, tetapi pemberontak-pemberontak tinggal di tanah yang gundul.
scripture_data.text_en: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry [land].
scripture_data.text_orig: דק מ יהל תנמל דו ימתי יב

scripture_data.text_id: (68-8) Ya Allah, ketika Engkau maju berperang di depan umat-Mu, ketika Engkau melangkah di padang belantara, Sela
scripture_data.text_en: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:
scripture_data.text_orig: החיחץ נכ יררס תר יריס יצם התי ידיחי בימ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-9) bergoncanglah bumi, bahkan langit mencurahkan hujan di hadapan Allah; Sinai bergoyang di hadapan Allah, Allah Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: [even] Sinai itself [was moved] at the presence of God, the God of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס מייב צ ינפל תצ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-10) Hujan yang melimpah Engkau siramkan, ya Allah; Engkau memulihkan tanah milik-Mu yang gersang,
scripture_data.text_en: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי יהל יהל ינמ יניס הז יהל ינמ פנ ימ הר שר

scripture_data.text_id: (68-11) sehingga kawanan hewan-Mu menetap di sana; dalam kebaikan-Mu Engkau memenuhi kebutuhan orang yang tertindas, ya Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.
scripture_data.text_orig: ננך ה הלנו תלחן יהל ינ תבדנ

scripture_data.text_id: (68-12) Tuhan menyampaikan sabda; orang-orang yang membawa kabar baik itu merupakan tentara yang besar:
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord gave the word: great [was] the company of those that published [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל ינל תב יכ בבי תח

scripture_data.text_id: (68-13) Raja-raja segala tentara melarikan diri, melarikan diri, dan perempuan di rumah membagi-bagi jarahan.
scripture_data.text_en: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר בצ תרבמה רמי ינד

scripture_data.text_id: (68-14) Maukah kamu berbaring di antara kandang-kandang? Sayap-sayap merpati bersalut dengan perak, bulu kepaknya dengan emas berkilau-kilauan.
scripture_data.text_en: Though ye have lien among the pots, [yet shall ye be as] the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל קח תי תונ די די תבצ יכלם

scripture_data.text_id: (68-15) Ketika Yang Mahakuasa menyerakkan raja-raja di sana, turunlah salju di atas gunung Zalmon.
scripture_data.text_en: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was [white] as snow in Salmon.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרח קרקרי היתרבו סב החן הני יפנ יפ י ב

scripture_data.text_id: (68-16) Gunung Allah gunung Basan itu, gunung yang berpuncak banyak gunung Basan itu!
scripture_data.text_en: The hill of God [is as] the hill of Bashan; an high hill [as] the hill of Bashan.
scripture_data.text_orig: מלצ גל יכלם י רפ

scripture_data.text_id: (68-17) Hai gunung-gunung yang berpuncak banyak, mengapa kamu menjeling cemburu, kepada gunung yang dikehendaki Allah menjadi tempat kedudukan-Nya? Sesungguhnya TUHAN akan diam di sana untuk seterusnya!
scripture_data.text_en: Why leap ye, ye high hills? [this is] the hill [which] God desireth to dwell in; yea, the LORD will dwell [in it] for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: רה ינב רה רה יהלרה

scripture_data.text_id: (68-18) Kereta-kereta Allah puluhan ribu, bahkan beribu-ribu banyaknya; Tuhan telah datang dari Sinai, masuk ke tempat kudus!
scripture_data.text_en: The chariots of God [are] twenty thousand, [even] thousands of angels: the Lord [is] among them, [as in] Sinai, in the holy [place].
scripture_data.text_orig: חצנל י הוהי בל יהל דמח רהה ינב ירה דר הל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-19) Engkau telah naik ke tempat tinggi, telah membawa tawanan-tawanan; Engkau telah menerima persembahan-persembahan di antara manusia, bahkan dari pemberontak-pemberontak untuk diam di sana, ya TUHAN Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive: thou hast received gifts for men; yea, [for] the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell [among them].
scripture_data.text_orig: ד יניס ב ינד נ יפל יתר יהל בכר

scripture_data.text_id: (68-20) Terpujilah Tuhan! Hari demi hari Ia menanggung bagi kita; Allah adalah keselamatan kita. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [be] the Lord, [who] daily loadeth us [with benefits, even] the God of our salvation. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל י ל יררס ו ד תנמ חקל יב תיב רל תיל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-21) Allah bagi kita adalah Allah yang menyelamatkan, ALLAH, Tuhanku, memberi keluputan dari maut.
scripture_data.text_en: [He that is] our God [is] the God of salvation; and unto GOD the Lord [belong] the issues from death.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס נתי לה נלסמי י י ינד ר

scripture_data.text_id: (68-22) Sesungguhnya, Allah meremukkan kepala musuh-Nya, tempurung kepala yang berambut dari orang yang tetap hidup dalam kesalahan-kesalahannya.
scripture_data.text_en: But God shall wound the head of his enemies, [and] the hairy scalp of such an one as goeth on still in his trespasses.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצ תול ינד הוהילו תמל ל נל לה

scripture_data.text_id: (68-23) Tuhan telah berfirman: "Dari Basan akan Kubawa kembali, akan Kubawa kembali dari tempat yang dalam,
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring [my people] again from the depths of the sea:
scripture_data.text_orig: וימ התמ ר דקדק ויבי ר שחמי יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-24) supaya engkau membasuh kakimu dalam darah, dan lidah anjing-anjingmu mendapat bagiannya dari pada musuh."
scripture_data.text_en: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of [thine] enemies, [and] the tongue of thy dogs in the same.
scripture_data.text_orig: י תלצמ בי בי מ ינד רמ

scripture_data.text_id: (68-25) Orang melihat perarakan-Mu, ya Allah, perarakan Allahku, Rajaku, ke dalam tempat kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: They have seen thy goings, O God; [even] the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.
scripture_data.text_orig: המ יבימ יבל ל ד לגר שחמ מל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-26) Di depan berjalan penyanyi-penyanyi, di belakang pemetik-pemetik kecapi, di tengah-tengah dayang-dayang yang memalu rebana.
scripture_data.text_en: The singers went before, the players on instruments [followed] after; among [them were] the damsels playing with timbrels.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב ילם יל תכילה יהל יתכילה ר

scripture_data.text_id: (68-27) "Dalam jemaah pujilah Allah, yakni TUHAN, hai kamu yang berasal dari sumber Israel!"
scripture_data.text_en: Bless ye God in the congregations, [even] the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: תפפ תמל ת ינגנ רח יר מק

scripture_data.text_id: (68-28) Itu Benyamin, yang bungsu, yang berjalan di depan mereka, pemuka-pemuka Yehuda berbondong-bondong, pemuka-pemuka Zebulon, pemuka-pemuka Naftali.
scripture_data.text_en: There [is] little Benjamin [with] their ruler, the princes of Judah [and] their council, the princes of Zebulun, [and] the princes of Naphtali.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי רקמ הוהי יהל כר תלהקמ

scripture_data.text_id: (68-29) Kerahkanlah kekuatan-Mu, ya Allah, tunjukkanlah kekuatan-Mu, ya Allah, Engkau yang telah bertindak bagi kami.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילפן יר לבז יר תמגר הדהי יר דר ריצ מינ

scripture_data.text_id: (68-30) Demi bait-Mu di Yerusalem, raja-raja menyampaikan persembahan kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ ל ז יהל ה יהל הצ

scripture_data.text_id: (68-31) Hardiklah binatang-binatang di teberau, kawanan orang-orang kuat, penguasa-penguasa bangsa-bangsa! Injaklah mereka yang mengejar perak; serakkanlah bangsa-bangsa yang suka berperang!
scripture_data.text_en: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, [till every one] submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people [that] delight in war.
scripture_data.text_orig: י יכלם ליבי ל לריל לכיהמ

scripture_data.text_id: (68-32) Dari Mesir orang membawa barang-barang tembaga, Etiopia bersegera mengulurkan tangannya kepada Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.
scripture_data.text_orig: צחי תברק י ר סכיר סרתמ י ילג ירי תד הנק תח ר

scripture_data.text_id: (68-33) Hai kerajaan-kerajaan bumi, menyanyilah bagi Allah, bermazmurlah bagi Tuhan; Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל וידי שיר ירצמ ימ ימח יתי

scripture_data.text_id: (68-34) bagi Dia yang berkendaraan melintasi langit purbakala. Perhatikanlah, Ia memperdengarkan suara-Nya, suara-Nya yang dahsyat!
scripture_data.text_en: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, [which were] of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, [and that] a mighty voice.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ינד רז יהלל רי שרה תכלמם

scripture_data.text_id: (68-35) Akuilah kekuasaan Allah; kemegahan-Nya ada di atas Israel, kekuasaan-Nya di dalam awan-awan.
scripture_data.text_en: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency [is] over Israel, and his strength [is] in the clouds.
scripture_data.text_orig: ז לק לק י ה דקימ ימ בכרל

scripture_data.text_id: (68-36) Allah adalah dahsyat dari dalam tempat kudus-Nya; Allah Israel, Dia mengaruniakan kekuasaan dan kekuatan kepada umat-Nya. Terpujilah Allah!
scripture_data.text_en: O God, [thou art] terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel [is] he that giveth strength and power unto [his] people. Blessed [be] God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יקח ו תו לריל יהלל ז נ

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Bunga bakung. Dari Daud. (69-2) Selamatkanlah aku, ya Allah, sebab air telah naik sampai ke leherku!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, [A Psalm] of David.> Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto [my] soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל יל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (69-3) Aku tenggelam ke dalam rawa yang dalam, tidak ada tempat bertumpu; aku telah terperosok ke air yang dalam, gelombang pasang menghanyutkan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: I sink in deep mire, where [there is] no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.
scripture_data.text_orig: פנד ימ ב י יהל יניה

scripture_data.text_id: (69-4) Lesu aku karena berseru-seru, kerongkonganku kering; mataku nyeri karena mengharapkan Allahku.
scripture_data.text_en: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינתפ תלו ימיממב ית דממ יו הלצמ וי יב

scripture_data.text_id: (69-5) Orang-orang yang membenci aku tanpa alasan lebih banyak dari pada rambut di kepalaku; terlalu besar jumlah orang-orang yang hendak membinasakan aku, yang memusuhi aku tanpa sebab; aku dipaksa untuk mengembalikan apa yang tidak kurampas.
scripture_data.text_en: They that hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of mine head: they that would destroy me, [being] mine enemies wrongfully, are mighty: then I restored [that] which I took not away.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל לחימ יני ל ינר רחנ ירקב יגי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-6) Ya Allah, Engkau mengetahui kebodohanku, kesalahan-kesalahanku tidak tersembunyi bagi-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי ז ילזגל ר רק יבי יתימצמ מצ ח ינ יר תרמ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (69-7) Janganlah mendapat malu oleh karena aku orang-orang yang menantikan Engkau, ya Tuhan, ALLAH semesta alam! Janganlah kena noda oleh karena aku orang-orang yang mencari Engkau, ya Allah Israel!
scripture_data.text_en: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord GOD of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: דחכנל מ יתמו ילל די ה יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (69-8) Sebab oleh karena Engkaulah aku menanggung cela, noda meliputi mukaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Because for thy sake I have borne reproach; shame hath covered my face.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי יהל יקבם יב מליל תבץ הוהי ינד יוק יב ביל

scripture_data.text_id: (69-9) Aku telah menjadi orang luar bagi saudara-saudaraku, orang asing bagi anak-anak ibuku;
scripture_data.text_en: I am become a stranger unto my brethren, and an alien unto my mother's children.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינפ הלך הת הרח יתנ ילי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-10) sebab cinta untuk rumah-Mu menghanguskan aku, dan kata-kata yang mencela Engkau telah menimpa aku.
scripture_data.text_en: For the zeal of thine house hath eaten me up; and the reproaches of them that reproached thee are fallen upon me.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ינבל ירכנו יחל יתייה רזמ

scripture_data.text_id: (69-11) Aku meremukkan diriku dengan berpuasa, tetapi itupun menjadi cela bagiku;
scripture_data.text_en: When I wept, [and chastened] my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל לפנ יפרח תרחו ינתלכ תי תנקי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-12) aku membuat kain kabung menjadi pakaianku, aku menjadi sindiran bagi mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל תפרחל יהו יפן ב הבו

scripture_data.text_id: (69-13) Aku menjadi buah bibir orang-orang yang duduk di pintu gerbang, dengan kecapi peminum-peminum menyanyi tentang aku.
scripture_data.text_en: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I [was] the song of the drunkards.
scripture_data.text_orig: למל הל יהו ק יבל הנו

scripture_data.text_id: (69-14) Tetapi aku, aku berdoa kepada-Mu, ya TUHAN, pada waktu Engkau berkenan, ya Allah; demi kasih setia-Mu yang besar jawablah aku dengan pertolongan-Mu yang setia!
scripture_data.text_en: But as for me, my prayer [is] unto thee, O LORD, [in] an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכ ית תניגנ ר יבי יב חיי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-15) Lepaskanlah aku dari dalam lumpur, supaya jangan aku tenggelam, biarlah aku dilepaskan dari orang-orang yang membenci aku, dan dari air yang dalam!
scripture_data.text_en: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.
scripture_data.text_orig: י תמ יננ סחבר יהל צר ת הוהי ליתפת ינו

scripture_data.text_id: (69-16) Janganlah gelombang air menghanyutkan aku, atau tubir menelan aku, atau sumur menutup mulutnya di atasku.
scripture_data.text_en: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימיממ ינמ הלצ הלו ימ ינליה

scripture_data.text_id: (69-17) Jawablah aku, ya TUHAN, sebab kasih setia-Mu baik, berpalinglah kepadaku menurut rahmat-Mu yang besar!
scripture_data.text_en: Hear me, O LORD; for thy lovingkindness [is] good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.
scripture_data.text_orig: הי ר ילרלו הלצם ינלבלו ימ תל ינפל

scripture_data.text_id: (69-18) Janganlah sembunyikan wajah-Mu kepada hamba-Mu, sebab aku tersesak; segeralah menjawab aku!
scripture_data.text_en: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל הנ ימחר בר סח בי הוהי יננ

scripture_data.text_id: (69-19) Datanglah kepadaku, tebuslah aku, bebaskanlah aku oleh karena musuh-musuhku.
scripture_data.text_en: Draw nigh unto my soul, [and] redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: יננ רהם ילרצי במ ינ רסלו

scripture_data.text_id: (69-20) Engkau mengenal celaku, maluku dan nodaku; semua lawanku ada di hadapan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries [are] all before thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינד יבי מל לג יפנל הברק

scripture_data.text_id: (69-21) Cela itu telah mematahkan hatiku, dan aku putus asa; aku menantikan belas kasihan, tetapi sia-sia, menantikan penghibur-penghibur, tetapi tidak kudapati.
scripture_data.text_en: Reproach hath broken my heart; and I am full of heaviness: and I looked [for some] to take pity, but [there was] none; and for comforters, but I found none.
scripture_data.text_orig: יררצל גנ יתלכ יב יתרח די ה

scripture_data.text_id: (69-22) Bahkan, mereka memberi aku makan racun, dan pada waktu aku haus, mereka memberi aku minum anggur asam.
scripture_data.text_en: They gave me also gall for my meat; and in my thirst they gave me vinegar to drink.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתצמ לו ימחנמלו יו דנל הקו הנו יל הרב הרח

scripture_data.text_id: (69-23) Biarlah jamuan yang di depan mereka menjadi jerat, dan selamatan mereka menjadi perangkap.
scripture_data.text_en: Let their table become a snare before them: and [that which should have been] for [their] welfare, [let it become] a trap.
scripture_data.text_orig: שמח ינקי ימצלו ר יתרב נו

scripture_data.text_id: (69-24) Biarlah mata mereka menjadi gelap, sehingga mereka tidak melihat; buatlah pinggang mereka goyah senantiasa!
scripture_data.text_en: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.
scripture_data.text_orig: קמל ימללו חפל הינפל נחליהי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-25) Tumpahkanlah amarah-Mu ke atas mereka, dan biarlah murka-Mu yang menyala-nyala menimpa mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Pour out thine indignation upon them, and let thy wrathful anger take hold of them.
scripture_data.text_orig: דמה דימ הינתמ תרמ היני הנכח

scripture_data.text_id: (69-26) Biarlah perkemahan mereka menjadi sunyi, dan biarlah kemah-kemah mereka tidak ada penghuninya.
scripture_data.text_en: Let their habitation be desolate; [and] let none dwell in their tents.
scripture_data.text_orig: גיי רחו מז הילפ

scripture_data.text_id: (69-27) Sebab mereka mengejar orang yang Kaupukul, mereka menambah kesakitan orang-orang yang Kautikam.
scripture_data.text_en: For they persecute [him] whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי יהיל הילה הן תרייה

scripture_data.text_id: (69-28) Tambahkanlah salah kepada salah mereka, dan janganlah sampai Engkau membenarkan mereka!
scripture_data.text_en: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.
scripture_data.text_orig: רסי יללח בכמלו פדר תיהר הי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-29) Biarlah mereka dihapuskan dari kitab kehidupan, janganlah mereka tercatat bersama-sama dengan orang-orang yang benar!
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.
scripture_data.text_orig: תקדצ בילו נול והנ

scripture_data.text_id: (69-30) Tetapi aku ini tertindas dan kesakitan, keselamatan dari pada-Mu, ya Allah, kiranya melindungi aku!
scripture_data.text_en: But I [am] poor and sorrowful: let thy salvation, O God, set me up on high.
scripture_data.text_orig: בתיל יקיצ ו יח רפמ חי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-31) Aku akan memuji-muji nama Allah dengan nyanyian, mengagungkan Dia dengan nyanyian syukur;
scripture_data.text_en: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינב יהל תי בכו ינ ינו

scripture_data.text_id: (69-32) pada pemandangan Allah itu lebih baik dari pada sapi jantan, dari pada lembu jantan yang bertanduk dan berkuku belah.
scripture_data.text_en: [This] also shall please the LORD better than an ox [or] bullock that hath horns and hoofs.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדתב לגו רי יהל הללה

scripture_data.text_id: (69-33) Lihatlah, hai orang-orang yang rendah hati, dan bersukacitalah; kamu yang mencari Allah, biarlah hatimu hidup kembali!
scripture_data.text_en: The humble shall see [this, and] be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.
scripture_data.text_orig: סירפם רקם ר רמ הוהיל ביתו

scripture_data.text_id: (69-34) Sebab TUHAN mendengarkan orang-orang miskin, dan tidak memandang hina orang-orang-Nya dalam tahanan.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.
scripture_data.text_orig: כבבל יחיו יהל יר חמי יונ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (69-35) Biarlah langit dan bumi memuji-muji Dia, lautan dan segala yang bergerak di dalamnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.
scripture_data.text_orig: הזב ל ויריסתו הוהי יניבל מי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-36) Sebab Allah akan menyelamatkan Sion dan membangun kota-kota Yehuda, supaya orang-orang diam di sana dan memilikinya;
scripture_data.text_en: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.
scripture_data.text_orig: מרלכו יי שרו ימ הללהי

scripture_data.text_id: (69-37) anak cucu hamba-hamba-Nya akan mewarisinya, dan orang-orang yang mencintai nama-Nya akan diam di situ.
scripture_data.text_en: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.
scripture_data.text_orig: הריו ביו הדהי יר הנביו צ יי יהל י

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dari Daud, pada waktu mempersembahkan korban peringatan. (70-2) Ya Allah, bersegeralah melepaskan aku, menolong aku, ya TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, [A Psalm] of David, to bring to remembrance.> [Make haste], O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ריזהל דודל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (70-3) Biarlah mendapat malu dan tersipu-sipu mereka yang ingin mencabut nyawaku; biarlah mundur dan kena noda mereka yang mengingini kecelakaanku;
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.
scripture_data.text_orig: הח יתרזל הוהי ינליהל יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (70-4) biarlah berbalik karena malu mereka yang mengatakan: "Syukur, syukur!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתר יצפח מליו רח גי יפנ יקבם רחיו בי

scripture_data.text_id: (70-5) Biarlah bergirang dan bersukacita karena Engkau semua orang yang mencari Engkau; biarlah mereka yang mencintai keselamatan dari pada-Mu selalu berkata: "Allah itu besar!"
scripture_data.text_en: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.
scripture_data.text_orig: חה חה ירמה בקל בי

scripture_data.text_id: (70-6) Tetapi aku ini sengsara dan miskin ya Allah, segeralah datang! Engkaulah yang menolong aku dan meluputkan aku; ya TUHAN, janganlah lambat datang!
scripture_data.text_en: But I [am] poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou [art] my help and my deliverer; O LORD, make no tarrying.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי יבה יהל לגי דימת רמיו יקבמל חמיו יי

scripture_data.text_id: Pada-Mu, ya TUHAN, aku berlindung, janganlah sekali-kali aku mendapat malu.
scripture_data.text_en: In thee, O LORD, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל הבל יתיסח הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Lepaskanlah aku dan luputkanlah aku oleh karena keadilan-Mu, sendengkanlah telinga-Mu kepadaku dan selamatkanlah aku!
scripture_data.text_en: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יניהו נז ילהה ינפת ינלי תקדצ

scripture_data.text_id: Jadilah bagiku gunung batu, tempat berteduh, kubu pertahanan untuk menyelamatkan aku; sebab Engkaulah bukit batuku dan pertahananku.
scripture_data.text_en: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou [art] my rock and my fortress.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה יתדצמ ילסי יניהל תיצ דימ בל מ רצל יל היה

scripture_data.text_id: Ya Allahku, luputkanlah aku dari tangan orang fasik, dari cengkeraman orang-orang lalim dan kejam.
scripture_data.text_en: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.
scripture_data.text_orig: שמחו לם מ ר דמ ינ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkaulah harapanku, ya Tuhan, kepercayaanku sejak masa muda, ya ALLAH.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou [art] my hope, O Lord GOD: [thou art] my trust from my youth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירמ יחבמ הוהי ינד יתוקת הי

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada-Mulah aku bertopang mulai dari kandungan, Engkau telah mengeluarkan aku dari perut ibuku; Engkau yang selalu kupuji-puji.
scripture_data.text_en: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother's bowels: my praise [shall be] continually of thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: דימת יתהת יזג ה י ימ מ יכמסנ יל

scripture_data.text_id: Bagi banyak orang aku seperti tanda ajaib, karena Engkaulah tempat perlindunganku yang kuat.
scripture_data.text_en: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou [art] my strong refuge.
scripture_data.text_orig: זיסחם הו ירל יתייה תפמ

scripture_data.text_id: Mulutku penuh dengan puji-pujian kepada-Mu, dengan penghormatan kepada-Mu sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: Let my mouth be filled [with] thy praise [and with] thy honour all the day.
scripture_data.text_orig: רפ הל תה יפ לי

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah membuang aku pada masa tuaku, janganlah meninggalkan aku apabila kekuatanku habis.
scripture_data.text_en: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינבזל יח תלכ הנקז תל ינכילל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab musuh-musuhku berkata-kata tentang aku, orang-orang yang mengincar nyawaku berunding bersama-sama
scripture_data.text_en: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,
scripture_data.text_orig: וחי צן יפנ ירמו יל יבי רמי

scripture_data.text_id: dan berkata: "Allah telah meninggalkan dia, kejar dan tangkaplah dia, sebab tidak ada yang melepaskan dia!"
scripture_data.text_en: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for [there is] none to deliver [him].
scripture_data.text_orig: לים יי הפתו פדר בז יהל רמל

scripture_data.text_id: Ya Allah, janganlah jauh dari padaku! Allahku, segeralah menolong aku!
scripture_data.text_en: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.
scripture_data.text_orig: הח היח יתרזל יהל ימ קחרל יהל

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah mendapat malu dan menjadi habis orang-orang yang memusuhi jiwaku; biarlah berselubungkan cela dan noda orang-orang yang mengikhtiarkan celakaku!
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be confounded [and] consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered [with] reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתר יקבמ הלכ הרח י יפנ ינ לכי בי

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi aku senantiasa mau berharap dan menambah puji-pujian kepada-Mu;
scripture_data.text_en: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.
scripture_data.text_orig: תהלל יפסהו לחי דימ ינו

scripture_data.text_id: mulutku akan menceritakan keadilan-Mu dan keselamatan yang dari pada-Mu sepanjang hari, sebab aku tidak dapat menghitungnya.
scripture_data.text_en: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness [and] thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers [thereof].
scripture_data.text_orig: תרפס ידי ל י ת הל תקדצ רסי י

scripture_data.text_id: Aku datang dengan keperkasaan-keperkasaan Tuhan ALLAH, hendak memasyhurkan hanya keadilan-Mu saja!
scripture_data.text_en: I will go in the strength of the Lord GOD: I will make mention of thy righteousness, [even] of thine only.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל תקדצ ריז הוהי ינד תרבג ב

scripture_data.text_id: Ya Allah, Engkau telah mengajar aku sejak kecilku, dan sampai sekarang aku memberitakan perbuatan-Mu yang ajaib;
scripture_data.text_en: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתלפנ די ההדו ירמ ינדל יהל

scripture_data.text_id: juga sampai masa tuaku dan putih rambutku, ya Allah, janganlah meninggalkan aku, supaya aku memberitakan kuasa-Mu kepada angkatan ini, keperkasaan-Mu kepada semua orang yang akan datang.
scripture_data.text_en: Now also when I am old and grayheaded, O God, forsake me not; until I have shewed thy strength unto [this] generation, [and] thy power to every one [that] is to come.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרב בילכל רדל רז דיד ינבזל יהל הביו הנקזד גו

scripture_data.text_id: Keadilan-Mu, ya Allah, sampai ke langit. Engkau yang telah melakukan hal-hal yang besar, ya Allah, siapakah seperti Engkau?
scripture_data.text_en: Thy righteousness also, O God, [is] very high, who hast done great things: O God, who [is] like unto thee!
scripture_data.text_orig: מכ ימ יהל תלדג תיר רמד יהל תקדצו

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau yang telah membuat aku mengalami banyak kesusahan dan malapetaka, Engkau akan menghidupkan aku kembali, dan dari samudera raya bumi Engkau akan menaikkan aku kembali.
scripture_data.text_en: [Thou], which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינל ב שרה תמהמ יניח ניח ב תרו תר תרצ ינתירה נתירה ר

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau akan menambah kebesaranku dan akan berpaling menghibur aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינמחנ בתו יתד בר

scripture_data.text_id: Akupun mau menyanyikan syukur bagi-Mu dengan gambus atas kesetiaan-Mu, ya Allahku, menyanyikan mazmur bagi-Mu dengan kecapi, ya Yang Kudus Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, [even] thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי דק רכב ל הרז יהל מ לבנילכב ד ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Bibirku bersorak-sorai sementara menyanyikan mazmur bagi-Mu, juga jiwaku yang telah Kaubebaskan.
scripture_data.text_en: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיד ר יפנו הרז י יתפ הר

scripture_data.text_id: Lidahku juga menyebut-nyebut keadilan-Mu sepanjang hari, sebab akan mendapat malu dan tersipu-sipu orang-orang yang mengikhtiarkan celakaku.
scripture_data.text_en: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתר יקבם רפחיכ בי תקדצ הה הל ינל

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Salomo. Ya Allah, berikanlah hukum-Mu kepada raja dan keadilan-Mu kepada putera raja!
scripture_data.text_en: <[A Psalm] for Solomon.> Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king's son.
scripture_data.text_orig: למבל תקדצו למל ימ יהל המלל

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya ia mengadili umat-Mu dengan keadilan dan orang-orang-Mu yang tertindas dengan hukum!
scripture_data.text_en: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.
scripture_data.text_orig: מב ינו קדצב ידי

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya gunung-gunung membawa damai sejahtera bagi bangsa, dan bukit-bukit membawa kebenaran!
scripture_data.text_en: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.
scripture_data.text_orig: הקדצ תבג ל ל ירה י

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya ia memberi keadilan kepada orang-orang yang tertindas dari bangsa itu, menolong orang-orang miskin, tetapi meremukkan pemeras-pemeras!
scripture_data.text_en: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.
scripture_data.text_orig: ק דיו יב ינבל יי ינ י

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya lanjut umurnya selama ada matahari, dan selama ada bulan, turun-temurun!
scripture_data.text_en: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר ר חרי ינפלו מ ריי

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya ia seperti hujan yang turun ke atas padang rumput, seperti dirus hujan yang menggenangi bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers [that] water the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר יזרז יביבר זל רמ דרי

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya keadilan berkembang dalam zamannya dan damai sejahtera berlimpah, sampai tidak ada lagi bulan!
scripture_data.text_en: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.
scripture_data.text_orig: חרי ילד ל ברו קיץ וימיחרפי

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya ia memerintah dari laut ke laut, dari sungai Efrat sampai ke ujung bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, and from the river unto the ends of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שריספד רהמ יד מ ריו

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya penghuni padang belantara berlutut di depannya, dan musuh-musuhnya menjilat debu;
scripture_data.text_en: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.
scripture_data.text_orig: כחלי רפ ויביו יצ רכי וינפל

scripture_data.text_id: kiranya raja-raja dari Tarsis dan pulau-pulau membawa persembahan-persemb kiranya raja-raja dari Syeba dan Seba menyampaikan upeti!
scripture_data.text_en: The kings of Tarshish and of the isles shall bring presents: the kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.
scripture_data.text_orig: בירקי ר בס ב יכלם ביי החנמ יו ירת יכלם

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya semua raja sujud menyembah kepadanya, dan segala bangsa menjadi hambanya!
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדבי יל יכלמלכ לוחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab ia akan melepaskan orang miskin yang berteriak minta tolong, orang yang tertindas, dan orang yang tidak punya penolong;
scripture_data.text_en: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and [him] that hath no helper.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל רזיו ינו ם יב לייי

scripture_data.text_id: ia akan sayang kepada orang lemah dan orang miskin, ia akan menyelamatkan nyawa orang miskin.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.
scripture_data.text_orig: יי יניב תפנו יבו לל סחי

scripture_data.text_id: Ia akan menebus nyawa mereka dari penindasan dan kekerasan, darah mereka mahal di matanya.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויני מ רקייו פן לגי סמחמ מ

scripture_data.text_id: Hiduplah ia! Kiranya dipersembahkan kepadanya emas Syeba! Kiranya ia didoakan senantiasa, dan diberkati sepanjang hari!
scripture_data.text_en: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; [and] daily shall he be praised.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנכרבי הל דימת ד לתיו ב בהמ ליו יחיו

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah tanaman gandum berlimpah-limpah di negeri, bergelombang di puncak pegunungan; biarlah buahnya mekar bagaikan Libanon, bulir-bulirnya berkembang bagaikan rumput di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and [they] of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה ב רימ ציציו יר נב רי ירה ר שר רתפ יהי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah namanya tetap selama-lamanya, kiranya namanya semakin dikenal selama ada matahari. Kiranya segala bangsa saling memberkati dengan namanya, dan menyebut dia berbahagia.
scripture_data.text_en: His name shall endure for ever: his name shall be continued as long as the sun: and [men] shall be blessed in him: all nations shall call him blessed.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרי יל ב כרתיו מ י יני מינפל לל מ יהי

scripture_data.text_id: Terpujilah TUHAN, Allah Israel, yang melakukan perbuatan yang ajaib seorang diri!
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [be] the LORD God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל תלפנ ה לרי יהל יהל הוהי ר

scripture_data.text_id: Dan terpujilah kiranya nama-Nya yang mulia selama-lamanya, dan kiranya kemuliaan-Nya memenuhi seluruh bumi. Amin, ya amin.
scripture_data.text_en: And blessed [be] his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled [with] his glory; Amen, and Amen.
scripture_data.text_orig: מו מ שרה לת דבכ ליו לל דב רב

scripture_data.text_id: Sekianlah doa-doa Daud bin Isai.
scripture_data.text_en: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.
scripture_data.text_orig: יי דו תפת

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Asaf. Sesungguhnya Allah itu baik bagi mereka yang tulus hatinya, bagi mereka yang bersih hatinya.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of Asaph.> Truly God [is] good to Israel, [even] to such as are of a clean heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: בבל ירבל יהל לריל ב סל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi aku, sedikit lagi maka kakiku terpeleset, nyaris aku tergelincir.
scripture_data.text_en: But as for me, my feet were almost gone; my steps had well nigh slipped.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר כ הכ י ילגר ינ ינ מ ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab aku cemburu kepada pembual-pembual, kalau aku melihat kemujuran orang-orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: For I was envious at the foolish, [when] I saw the prosperity of the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר יר ל יללה יתקי

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab kesakitan tidak ada pada mereka, sehat dan gemuk tubuh mereka;
scripture_data.text_en: For [there are] no bands in their death: but their strength [is] firm.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ירב תמל תצרח י י

scripture_data.text_id: mereka tidak mengalami kesusahan manusia, dan mereka tidak kena tulah seperti orang lain.
scripture_data.text_en: They [are] not in trouble [as other] men; neither are they plagued like [other] men.
scripture_data.text_orig: ני ל דו מני נ למ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu mereka berkalungkan kecongkakan dan berpakaian kekerasan.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore pride compasseth them about as a chain; violence covereth them [as] a garment.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל סמח תיי הוג מתקנ כל

scripture_data.text_id: Karena kegemukan, kesalahan mereka menyolok, hati mereka meluap-luap dengan sangkaan.
scripture_data.text_en: Their eyes stand out with fatness: they have more than heart could wish.
scripture_data.text_orig: בבל תם רב מני בלחמ צי

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka menyindir dan mengata-ngatai dengan jahatnya, hal pemerasan dibicarakan mereka dengan tinggi hati.
scripture_data.text_en: They are corrupt, and speak wickedly [concerning] oppression: they speak loftily.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדי רמ ק רב רדיו קימי

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka membuka mulut melawan langit, dan lidah mereka membual di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: They set their mouth against the heavens, and their tongue walketh through the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר לה נל הי ימב

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu orang-orang berbalik kepada mereka, mendapatkan mereka seperti air yang berlimpah-limpah.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore his people return hither: and waters of a full [cup] are wrung out to them.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל צי למ ימ לה בי ביי כל

scripture_data.text_id: Dan mereka berkata: "Bagaimana Allah tahu hal itu, adakah pengetahuan pada Yang Mahatinggi?"
scripture_data.text_en: And they say, How doth God know? and is there knowledge in the most High?
scripture_data.text_orig: ילב ה יו לדי הכי רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, itulah orang-orang fasik: mereka menambah harta benda dan senang selamanya!
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, these [are] the ungodly, who prosper in the world; they increase [in] riches.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליחה ל יולו יר ההה

scripture_data.text_id: Sia-sia sama sekali aku mempertahankan hati yang bersih, dan membasuh tanganku, tanda tak bersalah.
scripture_data.text_en: Verily I have cleansed my heart [in] vain, and washed my hands in innocency.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ינ שחרו יבבל יתיז קיר

scripture_data.text_id: Namun sepanjang hari aku kena tulah, dan kena hukum setiap pagi.
scripture_data.text_en: For all the day long have I been plagued, and chastened every morning.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירקל יחכתו הל גנ יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Seandainya aku berkata: "Aku mau berkata-kata seperti itu," maka sesungguhnya aku telah berkhianat kepada angkatan anak-anakmu.
scripture_data.text_en: If I say, I will speak thus; behold, I should offend [against] the generation of thy children.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידגב ינ רד הה מך הרס ירמ

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi ketika aku bermaksud untuk mengetahuinya, hal itu menjadi kesulitan di mataku,
scripture_data.text_en: When I thought to know this, it [was] too painful for me;
scripture_data.text_orig: יניב ה יה למ תז תדל הבחו

scripture_data.text_id: sampai aku masuk ke dalam tempat kudus Allah, dan memperhatikan kesudahan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Until I went into the sanctuary of God; [then] understood I their end.
scripture_data.text_orig: תירחל הניב ליקמל בד

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya di tempat-tempat licin Kautaruh mereka, Kaujatuhkan mereka sehingga hancur.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely thou didst set them in slippery places: thou castedst them down into destruction.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמל לה מל תי תקלח

scripture_data.text_id: Betapa binasa mereka dalam sekejap mata, lenyap, habis oleh karena kedahsyatan!
scripture_data.text_en: How are they [brought] into desolation, as in a moment! they are utterly consumed with terrors.
scripture_data.text_orig: תהמ ת פס גרך הל יה י

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti mimpi pada waktu terbangun, ya Tuhan, pada waktu terjaga, rupa mereka Kaupandang hina.
scripture_data.text_en: As a dream when [one] awaketh; [so], O Lord, when thou awakest, thou shalt despise their image.
scripture_data.text_orig: הזב מלץ רי ינד שיקהמ לח

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika hatiku merasa pahit dan buah pinggangku menusuk-nusuk rasanya,
scripture_data.text_en: Thus my heart was grieved, and I was pricked in my reins.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ יתילכו יבבל שחתי י

scripture_data.text_id: aku dungu dan tidak mengerti, seperti hewan aku di dekat-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: So foolish [was] I, and ignorant: I was [as] a beast before thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתייה תמה ד לו רבינו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi aku tetap di dekat-Mu; Engkau memegang tangan kananku.
scripture_data.text_en: Nevertheless I [am] continually with thee: thou hast holden [me] by my right hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינימידי זח דימת ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan nasihat-Mu Engkau menuntun aku, dan kemudian Engkau mengangkat aku ke dalam kemuliaan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt guide me with thy counsel, and afterward receive me [to] glory.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינח דב רחו ינחנת תצ

scripture_data.text_id: Siapa gerangan ada padaku di sorga selain Engkau? Selain Engkau tidak ada yang kuingini di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Whom have I in heaven [but thee]? and [there is] none upon earth [that] I desire beside thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרב יצפחל ו ימב ילימ

scripture_data.text_id: Sekalipun dagingku dan hatiku habis lenyap, gunung batuku dan bagianku tetaplah Allah selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: My flesh and my heart faileth: [but] God [is] the strength of my heart, and my portion for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל יהל יקלחו יבבלרץ יבבל יר הל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab sesungguhnya, siapa yang jauh dari pada-Mu akan binasa; Kaubinasakan semua orang, yang berzinah dengan meninggalkan Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring from thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: שמ הנזל המצה דבי יקחר ההי

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi aku, aku suka dekat pada Allah; aku menaruh tempat perlindunganku pada Tuhan ALLAH, supaya dapat menceritakan segala pekerjaan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: But [it is] good for me to draw near to God: I have put my trust in the Lord GOD, that I may declare all thy works.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתכלמל רסל יסחם הוהי ינד י ביל יהל תברק ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyian pengajaran Asaf. Mengapa, ya Allah, Kaubuang kami untuk seterusnya? Mengapa menyala murka-Mu terhadap kambing domba gembalaan-Mu?
scripture_data.text_en: <Maschil of Asaph.> O God, why hast thou cast [us] off for ever? [why] doth thine anger smoke against the sheep of thy pasture?
scripture_data.text_orig: תירם צ י חצנל חנז יהל המל סל לים

scripture_data.text_id: Ingatlah akan umat-Mu yang telah Kauperoleh pada zaman purbakala, yang Kautebus menjadi bangsa milik-Mu sendiri! Ingatlah akan gunung Sion yang Engkau diami.
scripture_data.text_en: Remember thy congregation, [which] thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, [which] thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.
scripture_data.text_orig: נכ הז צרה תלחן ב ל ד תינק תד רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Ringankanlah langkah-Mu ke tempat yang rusak terus-menerus; segala-galanya telah dimusnahkan musuh di tempat kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; [even] all [that] the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד בי רהל חצן תמל ימפ המירה

scripture_data.text_id: Lawan-lawan-Mu mengaum di tempat pertemuan-Mu dan telah mendirikan panji-panji mereka sebagai tanda.
scripture_data.text_en: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns [for] signs.
scripture_data.text_orig: תת תת מ דם ברק יררצ ג

scripture_data.text_id: Kelihatannya seperti orang mengayunkan tinggi-tinggi sebuah kapak kepada kayu-kayuan yang lebat,
scripture_data.text_en: [A man] was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרק שבס הלמל יבמ די

scripture_data.text_id: dan sekarang ukir-ukirannya seluruhnya dipalu mereka dengan kapak dan beliung;
scripture_data.text_en: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.
scripture_data.text_orig: מלהי תליכו ליכ דח היח הו תו

scripture_data.text_id: mereka menyulut tempat kudus-Mu dengan api, mereka menajiskan tempat kediaman nama-Mu sampai pada tanah;
scripture_data.text_en: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled [by casting down] the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.
scripture_data.text_orig: ממ לח שרל קמ ב חל

scripture_data.text_id: mereka berkata dalam hatinya: "Baiklah kita menindas mereka semuanya!" Mereka membakar segala tempat pertemuan Allah di negeri.
scripture_data.text_en: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר לידמלכ פר דחי נינ לב רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Tanda-tanda kami tidak kami lihat, tidak ada lagi nabi, dan tidak ada di antara kami yang mengetahui berapa lama lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: We see not our signs: [there is] no more any prophet: neither [is there] among us any that knoweth how long.
scripture_data.text_orig: המד די נלו יבנ די ניר ל ניתת

scripture_data.text_id: Berapa lama lagi, ya Allah, lawan itu mencela, dan musuh menista nama-Mu terus-menerus?
scripture_data.text_en: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?
scripture_data.text_orig: חצנל מ בי שני רצ רחי יהל יתמד

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa Engkau menarik kembali tangan-Mu, menaruh tangan kanan-Mu di dada?
scripture_data.text_en: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck [it] out of thy bosom.
scripture_data.text_orig: הך קיח קח ברמ נימיו די בית הל

scripture_data.text_id: Namun Engkau, ya Allah adalah Rajaku dari zaman purbakala, yang melakukan penyelamatan di atas bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: For God [is] my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה ברק תי ל דמ ילם יהלו

scripture_data.text_id: Engkaulah yang membelah laut dengan kekuatan-Mu, yang memecahkan kepala ular-ular naga di atas muka air.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל ינית יר ר י ב ררף ה

scripture_data.text_id: Engkaulah yang meremukkan kepala-kepala Lewiatan, yang memberikannya menjadi makanan penghuni-penghuni padang belantara.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, [and] gavest him [to be] meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.
scripture_data.text_orig: יצל ל לכמ נ תיול יר צר ה

scripture_data.text_id: Engkaulah yang membelah mata air dan sungai; Engkaulah yang mengeringkan sungai-sungai yang selalu mengalir.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי תרהן בה ה לחנו ים קב ה

scripture_data.text_id: Punya-Mulah siang, punya-Mulah juga malam. Engkaulah yang menaruh benda penerang dan matahari.
scripture_data.text_en: The day [is] thine, the night also [is] thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.
scripture_data.text_orig: מו רמ תניכה ה הליל ל י ל

scripture_data.text_id: Engkaulah yang menetapkan segala batas bumi, musim kemarau dan musim hujan Engkaulah yang membuat-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.
scripture_data.text_orig: רצי ה רחו שיק שר תלבל בה ה

scripture_data.text_id: Ingatlah ini: musuh mencela, ya TUHAN, dan bangsa yang bebal itu menista nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Remember this, [that] the enemy hath reproached, O LORD, and [that] the foolish people have blasphemed thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ צנ לבנ ו הוהי רח בי תזרכז

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah berikan nyawa merpati-Mu kepada binatang liar! Janganlah lupakan terus-menerus nyawa orang-orang-Mu yang tertindas!
scripture_data.text_en: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude [of the wicked]: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: חצנל חל ינ תח ר פנ תחל ל

scripture_data.text_id: Pandanglah kepada perjanjian, sebab tempat-tempat gelap di bumi penuh sarang-sarang kekerasan.
scripture_data.text_en: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.
scripture_data.text_orig: סמח תן שריחם למ י תירל ה

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah biarkan orang yang terinjak-injak kembali dengan kena noda. Biarlah orang sengsara dan orang miskin memuji-muji nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ ללהי יבו ינ לכנ ביל

scripture_data.text_id: Bangunlah, ya Allah, lakukanlah perjuangan-Mu! Ingatlah akan cela kepada-Mu dari pihak orang bebal sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל לבנימ תרח רכז ביר הביר יהל המק

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah lupa suara lawan-Mu, deru orang-orang yang bangkit melawan Engkau, yang terus-menerus makin keras.
scripture_data.text_en: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.
scripture_data.text_orig: דימת הל ימק יררצ לק חל

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Jangan memusnahkan. Mazmur Asaf. Nyanyian. (75-2) Kami bersyukur kepada-Mu, ya Allah, kami bersyukur, dan orang-orang yang menyerukan nama-Mu menceritakan perbuatan-perbuatan-Mu yang ajaib.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, Altaschith, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.> Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, [unto thee] do we give thanks: for [that] thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי סל רמזמ תחל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (75-3) "Apabila Aku menetapkan waktunya, Aku sendiri akan menghakimi dengan kebenaran.
scripture_data.text_en: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתלפנ רס מ ברקו נידה יהל נידה

scripture_data.text_id: (75-4) Bumi hancur dan semua penduduknya; tetapi Akulah yang mengokohkan tiang-tiangnya." Sela
scripture_data.text_en: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירימ ינ דם ח י

scripture_data.text_id: (75-5) Aku berkata kepada pembual-pembual: "Jangan membual." Dan kepada orang-orang fasik: "Jangan meninggikan tanduk!
scripture_data.text_en: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:
scripture_data.text_orig: הל היד ינת יכנ היבילכו שר יגמן

scripture_data.text_id: (75-6) Jangan mengangkat tandukmu tinggi-tinggi, jangan berbicara dengan bertegang leher!"
scripture_data.text_en: Lift not up your horn on high: speak [not with] a stiff neck.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק מירל ירלו הל יללהל ירמ

scripture_data.text_id: (75-7) Sebab bukan dari timur atau dari barat dan bukan dari padang gurun datangnya peninggian itu,
scripture_data.text_en: For promotion [cometh] neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.
scripture_data.text_orig: קת רצב רד כנרק רל מירל

scripture_data.text_id: (75-8) tetapi Allah adalah Hakim: direndahkan-Nya yang satu dan ditinggikan-Nya yang lain.
scripture_data.text_en: But God [is] the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירה רדמ לו ברמ צמ ל י

scripture_data.text_id: (75-9) Sebab sebuah piala ada di tangan TUHAN, berisi anggur berbuih, penuh campuran bumbu; Ia menuang dari situ; sungguh, ampasnya akan dihirup dan diminum oleh semua orang fasik di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: For in the hand of the LORD [there is] a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring [them] out, [and] drink [them].
scripture_data.text_orig: ירי הזו ליי הז פ יהלי

scripture_data.text_id: (75-10) Tetapi aku hendak bersorak-sorak untuk selama-lamanya, aku hendak bermazmur bagi Allah Yakub.
scripture_data.text_en: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.
scripture_data.text_orig: שריר ל י צמי הירמ המ רו סם למ רמח ייו הוהידי סכ י

scripture_data.text_id: (75-11) Segala tanduk orang-orang fasik akan dihancurkan-Nya, tetapi tanduk-tanduk orang benar akan ditinggikan.
scripture_data.text_en: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; [but] the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי יהלל הרז לל די ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Dengan permainan kecapi. Mazmur Asaf. Nyanyian. (76-2) Allah terkenal di Yehuda, nama-Nya masyhur di Israel!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm [or] Song of Asaph.> In Judah [is] God known: his name [is] great in Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי סל רמזמ תניגנ חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (76-3) Di Salem sudah ada pondok-Nya, dan kediaman-Nya di Sion!
scripture_data.text_en: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ לד לרי יהל הדהי דן

scripture_data.text_id: (76-4) Di sanalah dipatahkan-Nya panah yang berkilat, perisai dan pedang dan alat perang. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: צב תנמ ס לב יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: (76-5) Cemerlang Engkau, lebih mulia dari pada pegunungan yang ada sejak purba.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou [art] more glorious [and] excellent than the mountains of prey.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס המחלמ ברחו גמ תקיפר ר ה

scripture_data.text_id: (76-6) Orang-orang yang berani telah dijarah, mereka terlelap dalam tidurnya, dan semua orang yang gagah perkasa kehilangan kekuatannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.
scripture_data.text_orig: ריררהמ רי ה רנ

scripture_data.text_id: (76-7) Oleh sebab hardik-Mu, ya Allah Yakub, tertidur lelap baik pengendara maupun kuda.
scripture_data.text_en: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.
scripture_data.text_orig: הידי ליחינלכ צמלו תנ מנ בל ירי לל

scripture_data.text_id: (76-8) Dahsyat Engkau! Siapakah yang tahan berdiri di hadapan-Mu pada saat Engkau murka?
scripture_data.text_en: Thou, [even] thou, [art] to be feared: and who may stand in thy sight when once thou art angry?
scripture_data.text_orig: ססו בכרו רנ בקי יהל תרמ

scripture_data.text_id: (76-9) Dari langit Engkau memperdengarkan keputusan-Mu; bumi takut dan tertegun,
scripture_data.text_en: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,
scripture_data.text_orig: זמ ינפל דמיימ ה רנ ה

scripture_data.text_id: (76-10) pada waktu Allah bangkit untuk memberi penghukuman, untuk menyelamatkan semua yang tertindas di bumi. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הקו הרי שר י מה יממ

scripture_data.text_id: (76-11) Sesungguhnya panas hati manusia akan menjadi syukur bagi-Mu, dan sisa panas hati itu akan Kauperikatpinggangkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely the wrath of man shall praise thee: the remainder of wrath shalt thou restrain.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס שריונל יהל יהל לק
