scripture_data.text_id: (76-12) Bernazarlah dan bayarlah nazarmu itu kepada TUHAN, Allahmu! Biarlah semua orang yang di sekeliling-Nya menyampaikan persembahan kepada Dia yang ditakuti,
scripture_data.text_en: Vow, and pay unto the LORD your God: let all that be round about him bring presents unto him that ought to be feared.
scripture_data.text_orig: רח תמח תיר שד ד תמחי

scripture_data.text_id: (76-13) Dia yang mematahkan semangat para pemimpin, Dia yang dahsyat bagi raja-raja di bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: [he is] terrible to the kings of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: רל י ליבי ויביבסל כיהל הוהיל מו רדנ

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut: Yedutun. Mazmur Asaf. (77-2) Aku mau berseru-seru dengan nyaring kepada Allah, dengan nyaring kepada Allah, supaya Ia mendengarkan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph.> I cried unto God with my voice, [even] unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמזמ סל תדי תידיל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (77-3) Pada hari kesusahanku aku mencari Tuhan; malam-malam tanganku terulur dan tidak menjadi lesu, jiwaku enggan dihiburkan.
scripture_data.text_en: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יזהו יהלל ילק הקצו יהלל ילק

scripture_data.text_id: (77-4) Apabila aku mengingat Allah, maka aku mengerang, apabila aku merenung, makin lemah lesulah semangatku. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן חה הנמ גפת לו הרנ הליל ידי יר ינד יתרצ י

scripture_data.text_id: (77-5) Engkau membuat mataku tetap terbuka; aku gelisah, sehingga tidak dapat berkata-kata.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יחר תתו החי הימהו יהל הרז

scripture_data.text_id: (77-6) Aku memikir-mikir hari-hari zaman purbakala, tahun-tahun zaman dahulu aku ingat.
scripture_data.text_en: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.
scripture_data.text_orig: רד לו ימפנ יני תרמ זח

scripture_data.text_id: (77-7) Aku sebut-sebut pada waktu malam dalam hatiku, aku merenung, dan rohku mencari-cari:
scripture_data.text_en: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימל תנ דמ ימי יבח

scripture_data.text_id: (77-8) "Untuk selamanyakah Tuhan menolak dan tidak kembali bermurah hati lagi?
scripture_data.text_en: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?
scripture_data.text_orig: יחר חיו החי יבבל הלי יתניגן הרז

scripture_data.text_id: (77-9) Sudah lenyapkah untuk seterusnya kasih setia-Nya, telah berakhirkah janji itu berlaku turun-temurun?
scripture_data.text_en: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth [his] promise fail for evermore?
scripture_data.text_orig: ד תצרל יסילו ינד חנזי ימללה

scripture_data.text_id: (77-10) Sudah lupakah Allah menaruh kasihan, atau ditutup-Nyakah rahmat-Nya karena murka-Nya?" Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדו רדל רמ רמ סח חצנל ספה

scripture_data.text_id: (77-11) Maka kataku: "Inilah yang menikam hatiku, bahwa tangan kanan Yang Mahatinggi berubah."
scripture_data.text_en: And I said, This [is] my infirmity: [but I will remember] the years of the right hand of the most High.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס וימחר שפק ל תח חכה

scripture_data.text_id: (77-12) Aku hendak mengingat perbuatan-perbuatan TUHAN, ya, aku hendak mengingat keajaiban-keajaiban-Mu dari zaman purbakala.
scripture_data.text_en: I will remember the works of the LORD: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ימי תנ יה יתח רמו

scripture_data.text_id: (77-13) Aku hendak menyebut-nyebut segala pekerjaan-Mu, dan merenungkan perbuatan-perbuatan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל דמ הרזי ייללם רז ריז

scripture_data.text_id: (77-14) Ya Allah, jalan-Mu adalah kudus! Allah manakah yang begitu besar seperti Allah kami?
scripture_data.text_en: Thy way, O God, [is] in the sanctuary: who [is so] great a God as [our] God?
scripture_data.text_orig: החי יתלילב ללכב יתיגהו

scripture_data.text_id: (77-15) Engkaulah Allah yang melakukan keajaiban; Engkau telah menyatakan kuasa-Mu di antara bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou [art] the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל לד לימ ר ד יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (77-16) Dengan lengan-Mu Engkau telah menebus umat-Mu, bani Yakub dan bani Yusuf. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast with [thine] arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יב דה לף ה לה ה

scripture_data.text_id: (77-17) Air telah melihat Engkau, ya Allah, air telah melihat Engkau, lalu menjadi gentar, bahkan samudera raya gemetar.
scripture_data.text_en: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס סיו בקיינ רז ל

scripture_data.text_id: (77-18) Awan-awan mencurahkan air, awan-gemawan bergemuruh, bahkan anak-anak panah-Mu beterbangan.
scripture_data.text_en: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמהת זרי ליחי י ר יהל י ר

scripture_data.text_id: (77-19) Deru guntur-Mu menggelinding, kilat-kilat menerangi dunia, bumi gemetar dan bergoncang.
scripture_data.text_en: The voice of thy thunder [was] in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.
scripture_data.text_orig: כהתי יצצח יקח נתנ לק תב ימ מרז

scripture_data.text_id: (77-20) Melalui laut jalan-Mu dan lorong-Mu melalui muka air yang luas, tetapi jejak-Mu tidak kelihatan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy way [is] in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה רו הזגר לב יקרב ריה לל מר לק

scripture_data.text_id: (77-21) Engkau telah menuntun umat-Mu seperti kawanan domba dengan perantaraan Musa dan Harun.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
scripture_data.text_orig: דנ ל יתבו יר ימ ליב יליב ר

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyian pengajaran Asaf. Pasanglah telinga untuk pengajaranku, hai bangsaku, sendengkanlah telingamu kepada ucapan mulutku.
scripture_data.text_en: <Maschil of Asaph.> Give ear, O my people, [to] my law: incline your ears to the words of my mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפירמל כנז ה יתר י הניזה סל לים

scripture_data.text_id: Aku mau membuka mulut mengatakan amsal, aku mau mengucapkan teka-teki dari zaman purbakala.
scripture_data.text_en: I will open my mouth in a parable: I will utter dark sayings of old:
scripture_data.text_orig: דקימ תדיח הי י למב החפ

scripture_data.text_id: Yang telah kami dengar dan kami ketahui, dan yang diceritakan kepada kami oleh nenek moyang kami,
scripture_data.text_en: Which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלרס ניתבו דו נמ ר

scripture_data.text_id: kami tidak hendak sembunyikan kepada anak-anak mereka, tetapi kami akan ceritakan kepada angkatan yang kemudian puji-pujian kepada TUHAN dan kekuatan-Nya dan perbuatan-perbuatan ajaib yang telah dilakukan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: We will not hide [them] from their children, shewing to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, and his strength, and his wonderful works that he hath done.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה ר ויתלפנו זזו הוהי תה ירסמ רח רדל הינמ דחכן ל

scripture_data.text_id: Telah ditetapkan-Nya peringatan di Yakub dan hukum Taurat diberi-Nya di Israel; nenek moyang kita diperintahkan-Nya untuk memperkenalkannya kepada anak-anak mereka,
scripture_data.text_en: For he established a testimony in Jacob, and appointed a law in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children:
scripture_data.text_orig: הינבל ידהל ניתבת הצ ר לרי הרתו בקי תד קו

scripture_data.text_id: supaya dikenal oleh angkatan yang kemudian, supaya anak-anak, yang akan lahir kelak, bangun dan menceritakannya kepada anak-anak mereka,
scripture_data.text_en: That the generation to come might know [them, even] the children [which] should be born; [who] should arise and declare [them] to their children:
scripture_data.text_orig: הינבל רסיו מקי דלי ינ רח ר די מל

scripture_data.text_id: supaya mereka menaruh kepercayaan kepada Allah dan tidak melupakan perbuatan-perbuatan Allah, tetapi memegang perintah-perintah-Nya;
scripture_data.text_en: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:
scripture_data.text_orig: רצני ויתוצמ ליללם חי לו לס יהלב מייו

scripture_data.text_id: dan jangan seperti nenek moyang mereka, angkatan pendurhaka dan pemberontak, angkatan yang tidak tetap hatinya dan tidak setia jiwanya kepada Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation [that] set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.
scripture_data.text_orig: חר לת הנמנלו ל יכהל ר הרמ ררס ר תב יהי לו

scripture_data.text_id: Bani Efraim, pemanah-pemanah yang bersenjata lengkap, berbalik pada hari pertempuran;
scripture_data.text_en: The children of Ephraim, [being] armed, [and] carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.
scripture_data.text_orig: ברק י כפה תקימר יקן ירפינ

scripture_data.text_id: mereka tidak berpegang pada perjanjian Allah dan enggan hidup menurut Taurat-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: They kept not the covenant of God, and refused to walk in his law;
scripture_data.text_orig: תכלל נמ תרתב יהל תיר רמ ל

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka melupakan pekerjaan-pekerjaan-Nya dan perbuatan-perbuatan-Nya yang ajaib, yang telah diperlihatkan-Nya kepada mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And forgat his works, and his wonders that he had shewed them.
scripture_data.text_orig: רה ר ויתלפנו ויתליל חו

scripture_data.text_id: Di hadapan nenek moyang mereka dilakukan-Nya keajaiban-keajaiban, di tanah Mesir, di padang Zoan;
scripture_data.text_en: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, [in] the field of Zoan.
scripture_data.text_orig: צהד ירצמ שר לף ה תב דגנ

scripture_data.text_id: dibelah-Nya laut, diseberangkan-Nya mereka; didirikan-Nya air sebagai bendungan,
scripture_data.text_en: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.
scripture_data.text_orig: דנמ ימבו ריבו י ק

scripture_data.text_id: dituntun-Nya mereka dengan awan pada waktu siang, dan semalam suntuk dengan terang api;
scripture_data.text_en: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר הליהלכו מי נ חנו

scripture_data.text_id: dibelah-Nya gunung batu di padang gurun, diberi-Nya mereka minum banyak air seperti dari samudera raya;
scripture_data.text_en: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave [them] drink as [out of] the great depths.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר תמהת קו רד ירצ בי

scripture_data.text_id: dibuat-Nya aliran air keluar dari bukit batu, dan dibuat-Nya air turun seperti sungai.
scripture_data.text_en: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ תרה דרו למ ילזן צו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi mereka terus berbuat dosa terhadap Dia, dengan memberontak terhadap Yang Mahatinggi di padang kering.
scripture_data.text_en: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה יל תרמל לחל ד פיסו

scripture_data.text_en: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: תה רסנ רדו רדל לל הדנ תירם צו נחנו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Bunga bakung. Kesaksian Asaf. Mazmur. (80-2) Hai gembala Israel, pasanglah telinga, Engkau yang menggiring Yusuf sebagai kawanan domba! Ya Engkau, yang duduk di atas para kerub, tampillah bersinar
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Shoshannimeduth, A Psalm of Asaph.> Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest [between] the cherubims, shine forth.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמזמ סל תד יל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (80-3) di depan Efraim dan Benyamin dan Manasye! Bangkitkanlah keperkasaan-Mu dan datanglah untuk menyelamatkan kami.
scripture_data.text_en: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come [and] save us.
scripture_data.text_orig: היפה יברה בי סי גהנ הניזה לרי הר

scripture_data.text_id: (80-4) Ya Allah, pulihkanlah kami, buatlah wajah-Mu bersinar, maka kami akan selamat.
scripture_data.text_en: Turn us again, O God, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ התיל הכל תרבת הרר הנמ מינב ירפ ינפל

scripture_data.text_id: (80-5) TUHAN, Allah semesta alam, berapa lama lagi murka-Mu menyala sekalipun umat-Mu berdoa?
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD God of hosts, how long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?
scripture_data.text_orig: הנו ינ רהו נביה יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (80-6) Engkau memberi mereka makan roti cucuran air mata, Engkau memberi mereka minum air mata berlimpah-limpah,
scripture_data.text_en: Thou feedest them with the bread of tears; and givest them tears to drink in great measure.
scripture_data.text_orig: תפת נ יתמד תבץ יהל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (80-7) Engkau membuat kami menjadi pokok percederaan tetangga-tetangga kami, dan musuh-musuh kami mengolok-olok kami.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbours: and our enemies laugh among themselves.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל תמד מקו המ חל לכה

scripture_data.text_id: (80-8) Ya Allah semesta alam, pulihkanlah kami, buatlah wajah-Mu bersinar, maka kami akan selamat.
scripture_data.text_en: Turn us again, O God of hosts, and cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
scripture_data.text_orig: מלגלי ניביו נינכל דמ נמי

scripture_data.text_id: (80-9) Telah Kauambil pohon anggur dari Mesir, telah Kauhalau bangsa-bangsa, lalu Kautanam pohon itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנו ינ רהו נביה תבץ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (80-10) Engkau telah menyediakan tempat bagi dia, maka berakarlah ia dalam-dalam dan memenuhi negeri;
scripture_data.text_en: Thou preparedst [room] before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.
scripture_data.text_orig: הו י רג י ירצמ פ

scripture_data.text_id: (80-11) gunung-gunung terlindung oleh bayang-bayangnya, dan pohon-pohon aras Allah oleh cabang-cabangnya;
scripture_data.text_en: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof [were like] the goodly cedars.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרמו היר רו הינפל תי

scripture_data.text_id: (80-12) dijulurkannya ranting-rantingnya sampai ke laut, dan pucuk-pucuknya sampai ke sungai Efrat.
scripture_data.text_en: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליזר היפנו צ ירה

scripture_data.text_id: (80-13) Mengapa Engkau melanda temboknya, sehingga ia dipetik oleh setiap orang yang lewat?
scripture_data.text_en: Why hast thou [then] broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?
scripture_data.text_orig: היתקני רהנלו יד הריצק ח

scripture_data.text_id: (80-14) Babi hutan menggerogotinya dan binatang-binatang di padang memakannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.
scripture_data.text_orig: רד ירבל הרו הירדג צר הל

scripture_data.text_id: (80-15) Ya Allah semesta alam, kembalilah kiranya, pandanglah dari langit, dan lihatlah! Indahkanlah pohon anggur ini,
scripture_data.text_en: Return, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine;
scripture_data.text_orig: הרי יד זיזו רמ ריזח המסרכי

scripture_data.text_id: (80-16) batang yang ditanam oleh tangan kanan-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: And the vineyard which thy right hand hath planted, and the branch [that] thou madest strong for thyself.
scripture_data.text_orig: תז פ דקפ הר יממ ה נב תבץ יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (80-17) Mereka telah membakarnya dengan api dan menebangnya; biarlah mereka hilang lenyap oleh hardik wajah-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: [It is] burned with fire, [it is] cut down: they perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.
scripture_data.text_orig: הצ לו נימי הנר הכו

scripture_data.text_id: (80-18) Kiranya tangan-Mu melindungi orang yang di sebelah kanan-Mu, anak manusia yang telah Kauteguhkan bagi diri-Mu itu,
scripture_data.text_en: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, upon the son of man [whom] thou madest strong for thyself.
scripture_data.text_orig: דבי ינ תרמ החס ב הפר

scripture_data.text_id: (80-19) maka kami tidak akan menyimpang dari pada-Mu. Biarkanlah kami hidup, maka kami akan menyerukan nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: So will not we go back from thee: quicken us, and we will call upon thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: צ דל נימי יל דייה

scripture_data.text_id: (80-20) Ya TUHAN, Allah semesta alam, pulihkanlah kami, buatlah wajah-Mu bersinar, maka kami akan selamat.
scripture_data.text_en: Turn us again, O LORD God of hosts, cause thy face to shine; and we shall be saved.
scripture_data.text_orig: רקנ מב נח שמ גסנלו

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Gitit. Dari Asaf. (81-2) Bersorak-sorailah bagi Allah, kekuatan kita, bersorak-soraklah bagi Allah Yakub.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Gittith, [A Psalm] of Asaph.> Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.
scripture_data.text_orig: סל תיהל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (81-3) Angkatlah lagu, bunyikanlah rebana, kecapi yang merdu, diiringi gambus.
scripture_data.text_en: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי יהלל ירה נ יהלל נינרה

scripture_data.text_id: (81-4) Tiuplah sangkakala pada bulan baru, pada bulan purnama, pada hari raya kita.
scripture_data.text_en: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.
scripture_data.text_orig: לבנ ינ ר תנת הרמז

scripture_data.text_id: (81-5) Sebab hal itu adalah suatu ketetapan bagi Israel, suatu hukum dari Allah Yakub.
scripture_data.text_en: For this [was] a statute for Israel, [and] a law of the God of Jacob.
scripture_data.text_orig: נח יל הס רפ דחב ק

scripture_data.text_id: (81-6) Sebagai suatu peringatan bagi Yusuf ditetapkan-Nya hal itu, pada waktu Ia maju melawan tanah Mesir. Aku mendengar bahasa yang tidak kukenal:
scripture_data.text_en: This he ordained in Joseph [for] a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: [where] I heard a language [that] I understood not.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי יהלל מ ה לריל קח י

scripture_data.text_id: (81-7) "Aku telah mengangkat beban dari bahunya, tangannya telah bebas dari keranjang pikulan;
scripture_data.text_en: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ ידיל תפ ירצמ שרל תצ מ סהי תד

scripture_data.text_id: (81-8) dalam kesesakan engkau berseru, maka Aku meluputkan engkau; Aku menjawab engkau dalam persembunyian guntur, Aku telah menguji engkau dekat air Meriba. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנרב דמ וי מכ לבמ יתריסה

scripture_data.text_id: (81-9) Dengarlah hai umat-Ku, Aku hendak memberi peringatan kepadamu; hai Israel, jika engkau mau mendengarkan Aku!
scripture_data.text_en: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס הבירם ימל נחב ר רתס נ שצחו תרק הר

scripture_data.text_id: (81-10) Janganlah ada di antaramu allah lain, dan janganlah engkau menyembah kepada allah asing.
scripture_data.text_en: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילמ לרי הדיו י מ

scripture_data.text_id: (81-11) Akulah TUHAN, Allahmu, yang menuntun engkau keluar dari tanah Mesir: bukalah mulutmu lebar-lebar, maka Aku akan membuatnya penuh.
scripture_data.text_en: I [am] the LORD thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכנ לל הוחת לו רז ל ב היהיל

scripture_data.text_id: (81-12) Tetapi umat-Ku tidak mendengarkan suara-Ku, dan Israel tidak suka kepada-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלמו יבחרה ירצמ שרמ לה יהל הוהי יכנ

scripture_data.text_id: (81-13) Sebab itu Aku membiarkan dia dalam kedegilan hatinya; biarlah mereka berjalan mengikuti rencananya sendiri!
scripture_data.text_en: So I gave them up unto their own hearts' lust: [and] they walked in their own counsels.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל הבל לריו ילקל י מלו

scripture_data.text_id: (81-14) Sekiranya umat-Ku mendengarkan Aku! Sekiranya Israel hidup menurut jalan yang Kutunjukkan!
scripture_data.text_en: Oh that my people had hearkened unto me, [and] Israel had walked in my ways!
scripture_data.text_orig: היתצמ כלי ל תריר החו

scripture_data.text_id: (81-15) Seketika itu juga musuh mereka Aku tundukkan, dan terhadap para lawan mereka Aku balikkan tangan-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: I should soon have subdued their enemies, and turned my hand against their adversaries.
scripture_data.text_orig: כהי יכרד לרי יל מ י ל

scripture_data.text_id: (81-16) Orang-orang yang membenci TUHAN akan tunduk menjilat kepada-Nya, dan itulah nasib mereka untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: The haters of the LORD should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידי בי הירצ לו ינכ היבי מ

scripture_data.text_id: (81-17) Tetapi umat-Ku akan Kuberi makan gandum yang terbaik dan dengan madu dari gunung batu Aku akan mengenyangkannya."
scripture_data.text_en: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל יהיו לחכי הוהי ינם

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Asaf. Allah berdiri dalam sidang ilahi, di antara para allah Ia menghakimi:
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of Asaph.> God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.
scripture_data.text_orig: י יהל ברק לתד בנ יהל סל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: "Berapa lama lagi kamu menghakimi dengan lalim dan memihak kepada orang fasik? Sela
scripture_data.text_en: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יר ינפ לו יתמד

scripture_data.text_id: Berilah keadilan kepada orang yang lemah dan kepada anak yatim, belalah hak orang sengsara dan orang yang kekurangan!
scripture_data.text_en: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיצה רו ינ תיו לדפ

scripture_data.text_id: Luputkanlah orang yang lemah dan yang miskin, lepaskanlah mereka dari tangan orang fasik!"
scripture_data.text_en: Deliver the poor and needy: rid [them] out of the hand of the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליה יר דמ יבו לד

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka tidak tahu dan tidak mengerti apa-apa, dalam kegelapan mereka berjalan; goyanglah segala dasar bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: They know not, neither will they understand; they walk on in darkness: all the foundations of the earth are out of course.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר ידסמל י כהתי הכח ניבי לו די ל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku sendiri telah berfirman: "Kamu adalah allah, dan anak-anak Yang Mahatinggi kamu sekalian.
scripture_data.text_en: I have said, Ye [are] gods; and all of you [are] children of the most High.
scripture_data.text_orig: כ יל ינב יהל ירמינ

scripture_data.text_id: Namun seperti manusia kamu akan mati dan seperti salah seorang pembesar kamu akan tewas."
scripture_data.text_en: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ירה דחכ תמ ד כ

scripture_data.text_id: Bangunlah ya Allah, hakimilah bumi, sebab Engkaulah yang memiliki segala bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלכ לחנת הי שרה הפ יהל המק

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Asaf: suatu nyanyian. (83-2) Ya Allah, janganlah Engkau bungkam, janganlah berdiam diri dan janganlah berpangku tangan, ya Allah!
scripture_data.text_en: <A Song [or] Psalm of Asaph.> Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.
scripture_data.text_orig: סל רמזמ רי

scripture_data.text_id: (83-3) Sebab sesungguhnya musuh-musuh-Mu ribut, orang-orang yang membenci Engkau meninggikan kepala.
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, thine enemies make a tumult: and they that hate thee have lifted up the head.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל קלו רחל לימל יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (83-4) Mereka mengadakan permufakatan licik melawan umat-Mu, dan mereka berunding untuk melawan orang-orang yang Kaulindungi.
scripture_data.text_en: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר נ ינמ ימהי יבי ההי

scripture_data.text_id: (83-5) Kata mereka: "Marilah kita lenyapkan mereka sebagai bangsa, sehingga nama Israel tidak diingat lagi!"
scripture_data.text_en: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from [being] a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינפצל ציתיו דס מירי ל

scripture_data.text_id: (83-6) Sungguh, mereka telah berunding dengan satu hati, mereka telah mengadakan perjanjian melawan Engkau:
scripture_data.text_en: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:
scripture_data.text_orig: ד לרי רכילו ימ דיחכנו כל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: (83-7) Penghuni kemah-kemah Edom dan orang Ismael, Moab dan orang Hagar,
scripture_data.text_en: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;
scripture_data.text_orig: תרכי תיר יל וחי בל צן י

scripture_data.text_id: (83-8) Gebal dan Amon dan Amalek, Filistea beserta penduduk Tirus,
scripture_data.text_en: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;
scripture_data.text_orig: ירגהו בם ילמיו ד ילה

scripture_data.text_id: (83-9) juga Asyur telah bergabung dengan mereka, menjadi kaki tangan bani Lot. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: רץ יבי תל קלמו ו לב

scripture_data.text_id: (83-10) Perlakukanlah mereka seperti Midian, seperti Sisera, seperti Yabin dekat sungai Kison,
scripture_data.text_en: Do unto them as [unto] the Midianites; as [to] Sisera, as [to] Jabin, at the brook of Kison:
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס לינבל רז יה הולנ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (83-11) yang sudah dipunahkan di En-Dor, menjadi pupuk bagi tanah.
scripture_data.text_en: [Which] perished at Endor: they became [as] dung for the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יק לחנ יביכ רסיס ידמ הלה

scripture_data.text_id: (83-12) Buatlah para pemuka mereka seperti Oreb dan Zeeb, seperti Zebah dan Salmuna semua pemimpin mereka,
scripture_data.text_en: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:
scripture_data.text_orig: המדל מ יה ריב דמנ

scripture_data.text_id: (83-13) yang berkata: "Marilah kita menduduki tempat-tempat kediaman Allah!"
scripture_data.text_en: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.
scripture_data.text_orig: מכיסנל מלצכ חבזכ בזכו בר מבידנ מתי

scripture_data.text_id: (83-14) Ya Allahku, buatlah mereka seperti dedak yang beterbangan, seperti jerami yang ditiup angin!
scripture_data.text_en: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל תן ת נ הרינ רמ ר

scripture_data.text_id: (83-15) Seperti api yang membakar hutan, dan seperti nyala api yang menghanguskan gunung-gunung,
scripture_data.text_en: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;
scripture_data.text_orig: חרינפל ק ללך מתי יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (83-16) kejarlah mereka dengan badai-Mu, dan kejutkanlah mereka dengan puting beliung-Mu;
scripture_data.text_en: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירה הל הבהלכ רירב

scripture_data.text_id: (83-17) penuhilah muka mereka dengan kehinaan, supaya mereka mencari nama-Mu, ya TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: להבת תפסב רס פר

scripture_data.text_id: (83-18) Biarlah mereka mendapat malu dan terkejut selama-lamanya; biarlah mereka tersipu-sipu dan binasa,
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי מ קביו לק הינף ם

scripture_data.text_id: (83-19) supaya mereka tahu bahwa Engkau sajalah yang bernama TUHAN, Yang Mahatinggi atas seluruh bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: That [men] may know that thou, whose name alone [is] JEHOVAH, [art] the most high over all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: דביו רחיו דיד להיו בי

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Gitit. Mazmur bani Korah. (84-2) Betapa disenangi tempat kediaman-Mu, ya TUHAN semesta alam!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.> How amiable [are] thy tabernacles, O LORD of hosts!
scripture_data.text_orig: רמזמ חרקינבל תיהל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (84-3) Jiwaku hancur karena merindukan pelataran-pelataran TUHAN; hatiku dan dagingku bersorak-sorai kepada Allah yang hidup.
scripture_data.text_en: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the LORD: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.
scripture_data.text_orig: תבץ הוהי יתנמ תדידהם

scripture_data.text_id: (84-4) Bahkan burung pipit telah mendapat sebuah rumah, dan burung layang-layang sebuah sarang, tempat menaruh anak-anaknya, pada mezbah-mezbah-Mu, ya TUHAN semesta alam, ya Rajaku dan Allahku!
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, [even] thine altars, O LORD of hosts, my King, and my God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחל ל נרי ירב יל הוהי תרצחל יפן התלגו הפסכנ

scripture_data.text_id: (84-5) Berbahagialah orang-orang yang diam di rumah-Mu, yang terus-menerus memuji-muji Engkau. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [are] they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלו ילמ תבץ הוהי יתחזמת היחרפ התר ל ק ררד תיב הצמ רצ

scripture_data.text_id: (84-6) Berbahagialah manusia yang kekuatannya di dalam Engkau, yang berhasrat mengadakan ziarah!
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [is] the man whose strength [is] in thee; in whose heart [are] the ways [of them].
scripture_data.text_orig: הל ללהי ד תיב יבי יר

scripture_data.text_id: (84-7) Apabila melintasi lembah Baka, mereka membuatnya menjadi tempat yang bermata air; bahkan hujan pada awal musim menyelubunginya dengan berkat.
scripture_data.text_en: [Who] passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.
scripture_data.text_orig: בבל תסמ ב לז ד יר

scripture_data.text_id: (84-8) Mereka berjalan makin lama makin kuat, hendak menghadap Allah di Sion.
scripture_data.text_en: They go from strength to strength, [every one of them] in Zion appeareth before God.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרם הי תכר התיי ים כה קמ ירב

scripture_data.text_id: (84-9) Ya TUHAN, Allah semesta alam, dengarkanlah doaku, pasanglah telinga, ya Allah Yakub. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: צ יהלל הרי ליחל ליחמ כלי

scripture_data.text_id: (84-10) Lihatlah perisai kami, ya Allah, pandanglah wajah orang yang Kauurapi!
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס בקי יהל הניזה יתפת המ תבצ יהל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (84-11) Sebab lebih baik satu hari di pelataran-Mu dari pada seribu hari di tempat lain; lebih baik berdiri di ambang pintu rumah Allahku dari pada diam di kemah-kemah orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: For a day in thy courts [is] better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.
scripture_data.text_orig: חים ינ הו יהל הר נגמ

scripture_data.text_id: (84-12) Sebab TUHAN Allah adalah matahari dan perisai; kasih dan kemuliaan Ia berikan; Ia tidak menahan kebaikan dari orang yang hidup tidak bercela.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD God [is] a sun and shield: the LORD will give grace and glory: no good [thing] will he withhold from them that walk uprightly.
scripture_data.text_orig: רילה רמ יהל תיב פסה ירח למ ירצח יב י

scripture_data.text_id: (84-13) Ya TUHAN semesta alam, berbahagialah manusia yang percaya kepada-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD of hosts, blessed [is] the man that trusteth in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימת יכלהל בנמי ל הוהי י דבכו ח יהל הוהי גמ מ י

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur bani Korah. (85-2) Engkau telah berkenan kepada tanah-Mu, ya TUHAN, telah memulihkan keadaan Yakub.
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah.> LORD, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמזמ חרקינבל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: (85-3) Engkau telah mengampuni kesalahan umat-Mu, telah menutupi segala dosa mereka. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי תיב תב ב צר הוהי תיצר

scripture_data.text_id: (85-4) Engkau telah menyurutkan segala gemas-Mu, telah meredakan murka-Mu yang menyala-nyala.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned [thyself] from the fierceness of thine anger.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס תחלכ תי ו תנ

scripture_data.text_id: (85-5) Pulihkanlah kami, ya Allah penyelamat kami, dan tiadakanlah sakit hati-Mu kepada kami.
scripture_data.text_en: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.
scripture_data.text_orig: רחמ תביה תרבלכ פס

scripture_data.text_id: (85-6) Untuk selamanyakah Engkau murka atas kami dan melanjutkan murka-Mu turun-temurun?
scripture_data.text_en: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?
scripture_data.text_orig: נ ס רפהו ני יהל נב

scripture_data.text_id: (85-7) Apakah Engkau tidak mau menghidupkan kami kembali, sehingga umat-Mu bersukacita karena Engkau?
scripture_data.text_en: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?
scripture_data.text_orig: רדו רדל מ ננ ללה

scripture_data.text_id: (85-8) Perlihatkanlah kepada kami kasih setia-Mu, ya TUHAN, dan berikanlah kepada kami keselamatan dari pada-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Shew us thy mercy, O LORD, and grant us thy salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: בחמי ו נח ב הלה

scripture_data.text_id: (85-9) Aku mau mendengar apa yang hendak difirmankan Allah, TUHAN. Bukankah Ia hendak berbicara tentang damai kepada umat-Nya dan kepada orang-orang yang dikasihi-Nya, supaya jangan mereka kembali kepada kebodohan?
scripture_data.text_en: I will hear what God the LORD will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.
scripture_data.text_orig: נל יו סח הוהי נרה

scripture_data.text_id: (85-10) Sesungguhnya keselamatan dari pada-Nya dekat pada orang-orang yang takut akan Dia, sehingga kemuliaan diam di negeri kita.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely his salvation [is] nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלסכל בילו וידיסחלו ל ל רדי י הוהי לה רדיהם המ

scripture_data.text_id: (85-11) Kasih dan kesetiaan akan bertemu, keadilan dan damai sejahtera akan bercium-ciuman.
scripture_data.text_en: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed [each other].
scripture_data.text_orig: נצר דב ל י ויריל ברק

scripture_data.text_id: (85-12) Kesetiaan akan tumbuh dari bumi, dan keadilan akan menjenguk dari langit.
scripture_data.text_en: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.
scripture_data.text_orig: קנ לו קדצ פנ תמודסח

scripture_data.text_id: (85-13) Bahkan TUHAN akan memberikan kebaikan, dan negeri kita akan memberi hasilnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, the LORD shall give [that which is] good; and our land shall yield her increase.
scripture_data.text_orig: קנ יממ קדצו חמצ שרמ תמ

scripture_data.text_id: (85-14) Keadilan akan berjalan di hadapan-Nya, dan akan membuat jejak kaki-Nya menjadi jalan.
scripture_data.text_en: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set [us] in the way of his steps.
scripture_data.text_orig: לבי נצרו בה י הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Doa Daud. Sendengkanlah telinga-Mu, ya TUHAN, jawablah aku, sebab sengsara dan miskin aku.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Prayer of David.> Bow down thine ear, O LORD, hear me: for I [am] poor and needy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ יבו יני יננ נז הוהיהה דודל הפ

scripture_data.text_id: Peliharalah nyawaku, sebab aku orang yang Kaukasihi, selamatkanlah hamba-Mu yang percaya kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Preserve my soul; for I [am] holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל חה יהל ה ב ה ינ דיסחי יפן הרמ

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau adalah Allahku, kasihanilah aku, ya Tuhan, sebab kepada-Mulah aku berseru sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל רק יל י ינד ינח

scripture_data.text_id: Buatlah jiwa hamba-Mu bersukacita, sebab kepada-Mulah, ya Tuhan, kuangkat jiwaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן ינד יל י ב פנ ח

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkau, ya Tuhan, baik dan suka mengampuni dan berlimpah kasih setia bagi semua orang yang berseru kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou, Lord, [art] good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירקלכל דסחברו חסו ב ינד הי

scripture_data.text_id: Pasanglah telinga kepada doaku, ya TUHAN, dan perhatikanlah suara permohonanku.
scripture_data.text_en: Give ear, O LORD, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתננח לק הביקהו יתפ הוהי הניזה

scripture_data.text_id: Pada hari kesesakanku aku berseru kepada-Mu, sebab Engkau menjawab aku.
scripture_data.text_en: In the day of my trouble I will call upon thee: for thou wilt answer me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יננת י שרק יתרצ י

scripture_data.text_id: Tidak ada seperti Engkau di antara para allah, ya Tuhan, dan tidak ada seperti apa yang Kaubuat.
scripture_data.text_en: Among the gods [there is] none like unto thee, O Lord; neither [are there any works] like unto thy works.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ יו ינד יהלב מי

scripture_data.text_id: Segala bangsa yang Kaujadikan akan datang sujud menyembah di hadapan-Mu, ya Tuhan, dan akan memuliakan nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל דכיו ינד ינפל וחיו בי תי ר יל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkau besar dan melakukan keajaiban-keajaiban; Engkau sendiri saja Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou [art] great, and doest wondrous things: thou [art] God alone.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל יהל ה תלפנ הו ה לדגי

scripture_data.text_id: Tunjukkanlah kepadaku jalan-Mu, ya TUHAN, supaya aku hidup menurut kebenaran-Mu; bulatkanlah hatiku untuk takut akan nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Teach me thy way, O LORD; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ הריל יבבל דחי מ ה ר הוהי ינרה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku hendak bersyukur kepada-Mu, ya Tuhan, Allahku, dengan segenap hatiku, dan memuliakan nama-Mu untuk selama-lamanya;
scripture_data.text_en: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל מ הדכו יבבללכ יהל ינד ד

scripture_data.text_id: sebab kasih setia-Mu besar atas aku, dan Engkau telah melepaskan nyawaku dari dunia orang mati yang paling bawah.
scripture_data.text_en: For great [is] thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.
scripture_data.text_orig: הח למ יפנ להו יל לד סחי

scripture_data.text_id: Ya Allah, orang-orang yang angkuh telah bangkit menyerang aku, dan gerombolan orang-orang yang sombong ingin mencabut nyawaku, dan tidak mempedulikan Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent [men] have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.
scripture_data.text_orig: גנל מ לו יפן ק יציר תדו ילמק ידז יהל

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Engkau, ya Tuhan, Allah penyayang dan pengasih, panjang sabar dan berlimpah kasih dan setia.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou, O Lord, [art] a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמו דסחברו י ר חו חרל ינד הו

scripture_data.text_id: Berpalinglah kepadaku dan kasihanilah aku, berilah kekuatan-Mu kepada hamba-Mu, dan selamatkanlah anak laki-laki hamba-Mu perempuan!
scripture_data.text_en: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמבל היהו בל הנ ינחו יל הנ

scripture_data.text_id: Lakukanlah kepadaku suatu tanda kebaikan, supaya orang-orang yang membenci aku melihat dengan malu, bahwa Engkau, ya TUHAN, telah menolong dan menghiburkan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see [it], and be ashamed: because thou, LORD, hast holpen me, and comforted me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינמחנו ינרז הוהי הי ביו ינ ריו הבל ת יה

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur bani Korah: suatu nyanyian. Di gunung-gunung yang kudus ada kota yang dibangunkan-Nya:
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm [or] Song for the sons of Korah.> His foundation [is] in the holy mountains.
scripture_data.text_orig: דקיררה תדסי רי רמזמ חרקינבל

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN lebih mencintai pintu-pintu gerbang Sion dari pada segala tempat kediaman Yakub.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי תנמ למ צ יר הוהי בה

scripture_data.text_id: Hal-hal yang mulia dikatakan tentang engkau, ya kota Allah. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס יהלה רי רדם תדכנ

scripture_data.text_id: Aku menyebut Rahab dan Babel di antara orang-orang yang mengenal Aku, bahkan Filistea, Tirus dan Etiopia: "Ini dilahirkan di sana."
scripture_data.text_en: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this [man] was born there.
scripture_data.text_orig: די הז רצו תלף הה ידיל לבב בהר ריז

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi tentang Sion dikatakan: "Seorang demi seorang dilahirkan di dalamnya," dan Dia, Yang Mahatinggi, menegakkannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל הננכי הו די יו י רמי צל

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN menghitung pada waktu mencatat bangsa-bangsa: "Ini dilahirkan di sana." Sela
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD shall count, when he writeth up the people, [that] this [man] was born there. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס די הז י בתכ רסי הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Dan orang menyanyi-nyanyi sambil menari beramai-ramai: "Segala mata airku ada di dalammu."
scripture_data.text_en: As well the singers as the players on instruments [shall be there]: all my springs [are] in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינימל יללח ירו

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyian. Mazmur bani Korah. Untuk pemimpin biduan. Menurut lagu: Mahalat Leanot. Nyanyian pengajaran Heman, orang Ezrahi. (88-2) Ya TUHAN, Allah yang menyelamatkan aku, siang hari aku berseru-seru, pada waktu malam aku menghadap Engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Song [or] Psalm for the sons of Korah, to the chief Musician upon Mahalath Leannoth, Maschil of Heman the Ezrahite.> O LORD God of my salvation, I have cried day [and] night before thee:
scripture_data.text_orig: יחרזה מיהל לימ תל תלחמל חנמל חרק ינבל רמזמ רי

scripture_data.text_id: (88-3) Biarlah doaku datang ke hadapan-Mu, sendengkanlah telinga-Mu kepada teriakku;
scripture_data.text_en: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;
scripture_data.text_orig: גן הליב יקצי יתי יהל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (88-4) sebab jiwaku kenyang dengan malapetaka, dan hidupku sudah dekat dunia orang mati.
scripture_data.text_en: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתרל נזהה יתפ ינפל ב

scripture_data.text_id: (88-5) Aku telah dianggap termasuk orang-orang yang turun ke liang kubur; aku seperti orang yang tidak berkekuatan.
scripture_data.text_en: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man [that hath] no strength:
scripture_data.text_orig: יה לל יחו יפן תרב הבי

scripture_data.text_id: (88-6) Aku harus tinggal di antara orang-orang mati, seperti orang-orang yang mati dibunuh, terbaring dalam kubur, yang tidak Kauingat lagi, sebab mereka terputus dari kuasa-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליי רבג יתייה רב ידרי יבחנ

scripture_data.text_id: (88-7) Telah Kautaruh aku dalam liang kubur yang paling bawah, dalam kegelapan, dalam tempat yang dalam.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
scripture_data.text_orig: רזגנ דמ ההו ד רכז ל ר רבק יבכ יללח מ יפח ית

scripture_data.text_id: (88-8) Aku tertekan oleh panas murka-Mu, dan segala pecahan ombak-Mu Kautindihkan kepadaku. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted [me] with all thy waves. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: תלצמ יחמ תח רב ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (88-9) Telah Kaujauhkan kenalan-kenalanku dari padaku, telah Kaubuat aku menjadi kekejian bagi mereka. Aku tertahan dan tidak dapat keluar;
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: [I am] shut up, and I cannot come forth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל תי ירמלכו תמח הכמס יל

scripture_data.text_id: (88-10) mataku merana karena sengsara. Aku telah berseru kepada-Mu, ya TUHAN, sepanjang hari, telah mengulurkan tanganku kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: LORD, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: צ לו ל מל תבת ינ ימ יים קחרה

scripture_data.text_id: (88-11) Apakah Kaulakukan keajaiban bagi orang-orang mati? Masakan arwah bangkit untuk bersyukur kepada-Mu? Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise [and] praise thee? Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יך יל יח ילכ הוהי יתרק ינ ימ הבד יני

scripture_data.text_id: (88-12) Dapatkah kasih-Mu diberitakan di dalam kubur, dan kesetiaan-Mu di tempat kebinasaan?
scripture_data.text_en: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? [or] thy faithfulness in destruction?
scripture_data.text_orig: הל די מקי יפר לה יתלה

scripture_data.text_id: (88-13) Diketahui orangkah keajaiban-keajaiban-Mu dalam kegelapan, dan keadilan-Mu di negeri segala lupa?
scripture_data.text_en: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?
scripture_data.text_orig: ב תנמ סח רב רסיה

scripture_data.text_id: (88-14) Tetapi aku ini, ya TUHAN, kepada-Mu aku berteriak minta tolong, dan pada waktu pagi doaku datang ke hadapan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: But unto thee have I cried, O LORD; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: הן שר תקדצו ל ח דיה

scripture_data.text_id: (88-15) Mengapa, ya TUHAN, Kaubuang aku, Kausembunyikan wajah-Mu dari padaku?
scripture_data.text_en: LORD, why castest thou off my soul? [why] hidest thou thy face from me?
scripture_data.text_orig: שמקת יתפ רקב י הוהי יל ינו

scripture_data.text_id: (88-16) Aku tertindas dan menjadi inceran maut sejak kecil, aku telah menanggung kengerian dari pada-Mu, aku putus asa.
scripture_data.text_en: I [am] afflicted and ready to die from [my] youth up: [while] I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ ינ ריס יפן חנז הוהי המל

scripture_data.text_id: (88-17) Kehangatan murka-Mu menimpa aku, kedahsyatan-Mu membungkamkan aku,
scripture_data.text_en: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנפ ימ יתנ רמ וגו ינ ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (88-18) mengelilingi aku seperti air banjir sepanjang hari, mengepung aku serentak.
scripture_data.text_en: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינתתצ ית ינרח רב יל

scripture_data.text_id: (88-19) Telah Kaujauhkan dari padaku sahabat dan teman, kenalan-kenalanku adalah kegelapan.
scripture_data.text_en: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, [and] mine acquaintance into darkness.
scripture_data.text_orig: דחי יל פיה הל יכ ינס

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyian pengajaran Etan, orang Ezrahi. (89-2) Aku hendak menyanyikan kasih setia TUHAN selama-lamanya, hendak memperkenalkan kesetiaan-Mu dengan mulutku turun-temurun.
scripture_data.text_en: <Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite.> I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחרזה תיל לימ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-3) Sebab kasih setia-Mu dibangun untuk selama-lamanya; kesetiaan-Mu tegak seperti langit.
scripture_data.text_en: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפ תנמ יד רדו רדל הרי ל הוהי ידסח

scripture_data.text_id: (89-4) Engkau telah berkata: "Telah Kuikat perjanjian dengan orang pilihan-Ku, Aku telah bersumpah kepada Daud, hamba-Ku:
scripture_data.text_en: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,
scripture_data.text_orig: הב תנמ כ ימ הני דסח ל ירמי

scripture_data.text_id: (89-5) Untuk selama-lamanya Aku hendak menegakkan anak cucumu, dan membangun takhtamu turun-temurun." Sela
scripture_data.text_en: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יב דודל ינ יריחבל תירב יר

scripture_data.text_id: (89-6) Sebab itu langit bersyukur karena keajaiban-keajaiban-Mu, ya TUHAN, bahkan karena kesetiaan-Mu di antara jemaah orang-orang kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ס רדורדל יתינב רז יכ לד

scripture_data.text_id: (89-7) Sebab siapakah di awan-awan yang sejajar dengan TUHAN, yang sama seperti TUHAN di antara penghuni sorgawi?
scripture_data.text_en: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? [who] among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?
scripture_data.text_orig: ידק להק תנמ הוהי ל ימ דיו

scripture_data.text_id: (89-8) Allah disegani dalam kalangan orang-orang kudus, dan sangat ditakuti melebihi semua yang ada di sekeliling-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all [them that are] about him.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ינב הוהיל המדי הוהיל רי קחב ימ י

scripture_data.text_id: (89-9) Ya TUHAN, Allah semesta alam, siapakah seperti Engkau? Engkau kuat, ya TUHAN, dan kesetiaan-Mu ada di sekeliling-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD God of hosts, who [is] a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?
scripture_data.text_orig: ויביבסלל רנו הר ידקדס שרנ ל

scripture_data.text_id: (89-10) Engkaulah yang memerintah kecongkakan laut, pada waktu naik gelombang-gelombangnya, Engkau juga yang meredakannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתביבס תנמו י יסח מכימ תבץ יהל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (89-11) Engkaulah yang meremukkan Rahab seperti orang terbunuh, dengan lengan-Mu yang kuat Engkau telah mencerai-beraikan musuh-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.
scripture_data.text_orig: חת ה ויג ה תג למ ה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-12) Punya-Mulah langit, punya-Mulah juga bumi, dunia serta isinya Engkaulah yang mendasarkannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The heavens [are] thine, the earth also [is] thine: [as for] the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבי ר רז בהר ללחך תד ה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-13) Utara dan selatan, Engkaulah yang menciptakannya, Tabor dan Hermon bersorak-sorai karena nama-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: דסי ה למ לב שר ל ימ ל

scripture_data.text_id: (89-14) Punya-Mulah lengan yang perkasa, kuat tangan-Mu dan tinggi tangan kanan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, [and] high is thy right hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: נרי מ מרחו רב תרב ה ימיו פצ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-15) Keadilan dan hukum adalah tumpuan takhta-Mu, kasih dan kesetiaan berjalan di depan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Justice and judgment [are] the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימי ר די ז הרב רז ל

scripture_data.text_id: (89-16) Berbahagialah bangsa yang tahu bersorak-sorai, ya TUHAN, mereka hidup dalam cahaya wajah-Mu;
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [is] the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינפ מקי תמו דסח ס כם מ קדצ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-17) karena nama-Mu mereka bersorak-sorak sepanjang hari, dan karena keadilan-Mu mereka bermegah.
scripture_data.text_en: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.
scripture_data.text_orig: כהי ינר הוהי הרת ידי ה יר

scripture_data.text_id: (89-18) Sebab Engkaulah kemuliaan kekuatan mereka, dan karena Engkau berkenan, tanduk kami meninggi.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou [art] the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.
scripture_data.text_orig: מרי תקדצב הל ליגי מ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-19) Sebab perisai kita kepunyaan TUHAN, dan raja kita kepunyaan Yang Kudus Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD [is] our defence; and the Holy One of Israel [is] our king.
scripture_data.text_orig: ננרק ר יר נצרב ה מ תרפתי

scripture_data.text_id: (89-20) Pernah Engkau berbicara dalam penglihatan kepada orang-orang yang Kaukasihi, kata-Mu: "Telah Kutaruh mahkota di atas kepala seorang pahlawan, telah Kutinggikan seorang pilihan dari antara bangsa itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon [one that is] mighty; I have exalted [one] chosen out of the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלם לרי דקלו נגמ הוהיל י

scripture_data.text_id: (89-21) Aku telah mendapat Daud, hamba-Ku; Aku telah mengurapinya dengan minyak-Ku yang kudus,
scripture_data.text_en: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:
scripture_data.text_orig: מ רחב יתמירה רל רז יתי רמו ידיסחל זחבר ז

scripture_data.text_id: (89-22) maka tangan-Ku tetap dengan dia, bahkan lengan-Ku meneguhkan dia.
scripture_data.text_en: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויחם ידק מ יב דו יתצמ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-23) Musuh tidak akan menyergapnya, dan orang curang tidak akan menindasnya.
scripture_data.text_en: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.
scripture_data.text_orig: צת ירז ידי ר

scripture_data.text_id: (89-24) Aku akan menghancurkan lawannya dari hadapannya, dan orang-orang yang membencinya akan Kubunuh.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ל הלוב בי יל

scripture_data.text_id: (89-25) Kesetiaan-Ku dan kasih-Ku menyertai dia, dan oleh karena nama-Ku tanduknya akan meninggi.
scripture_data.text_en: But my faithfulness and my mercy [shall be] with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינמ וירצ וינמ יתכו

scripture_data.text_id: (89-26) Aku akan membuat tangannya menguasai laut, dan tangan kanannya menguasai sungai-sungai.
scripture_data.text_en: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.
scripture_data.text_orig: נרק ר ימב יסחו יתנמו

scripture_data.text_id: (89-27) Diapun akan berseru kepada-Ku: 'Bapaku Engkau, Allahku dan gunung batu keselamatanku.'
scripture_data.text_en: He shall cry unto me, Thou [art] my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימי תרהב די ב ימו

scripture_data.text_id: (89-28) Akupun juga akan mengangkat dia menjadi anak sulung, menjadi yang mahatinggi di antara raja-raja bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Also I will make him [my] firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתי רצו יל ה יב ינרקי ה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-29) Aku akan memelihara kasih setia-Ku bagi dia untuk selama-lamanya, dan perjanjian-Ku teguh bagi dia.
scripture_data.text_en: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.
scripture_data.text_orig: שריכלמל יל הנ רכ ינ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-30) Aku menjamin akan adanya anak cucunya sampai selama-lamanya, dan takhtanya seumur langit.
scripture_data.text_en: His seed also will I make [to endure] for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תנמן יתירב יסח לרמרמ לל

scripture_data.text_id: (89-31) Jika anak-anaknya meninggalkan Taurat-Ku dan mereka tidak hidup menurut hukum-Ku,
scripture_data.text_en: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ ימי סכו רז דל ימו

scripture_data.text_id: (89-32) jika ketetapan-Ku mereka langgar dan tidak berpegang pada perintah-perintah-Ku,
scripture_data.text_en: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;
scripture_data.text_orig: כלי ל ימב יתר וינב בזי

scripture_data.text_id: (89-33) maka Aku akan membalas pelanggaran mereka dengan gada, dan kesalahan mereka dengan pukulan-pukulan.
scripture_data.text_en: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמי ל יתוצמ לחי יתח

scripture_data.text_id: (89-34) Tetapi kasih setia-Ku tidak akan Kujauhkan dari padanya dan Aku tidak akan berlaku curang dalam hal kesetiaan-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.
scripture_data.text_orig: נו יגנב בב ידקפ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-35) Aku tidak akan melanggar perjanjian-Ku, dan apa yang keluar dari bibir-Ku tidak akan Kuubah.
scripture_data.text_en: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתנמ רלו מ ריפל יסחו

scripture_data.text_id: (89-36) Sekali Aku bersumpah demi kekudusan-Ku, tentulah Aku tidak akan berbohong kepada Daud:
scripture_data.text_en: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה ל יתפ צמ יתיר לחל

scripture_data.text_id: (89-37) Anak cucunya akan ada untuk selama-lamanya, dan takhtanya seperti matahari di depan mata-Ku,
scripture_data.text_en: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.
scripture_data.text_orig: בכ דודל ידקב ינ תח

scripture_data.text_id: (89-38) seperti bulan yang ada selama-lamanya, suatu saksi yang setia di awan-awan." Sela
scripture_data.text_en: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and [as] a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: יגן מך סכו היהי לל רז

scripture_data.text_id: (89-39) Tetapi Engkau sendiri menolak dan membuang, menjadi gemas kepada orang yang Kauurapi,
scripture_data.text_en: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס מן קח דו ל י חרי

scripture_data.text_id: (89-40) membatalkan perjanjian dengan hamba-Mu, menajiskan mahkotanya laksana debu,
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown [by casting it] to the ground.
scripture_data.text_orig: חימ רתה סמו חנז הו

scripture_data.text_id: (89-41) melanda segala temboknya, membuat kubu-kubunya menjadi reruntuhan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.
scripture_data.text_orig: רזנ שרל לח ב תיר הרנ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-42) Semua orang yang lewat di jalan merampoknya, dan ia menjadi cela bagi tetangganya.
scripture_data.text_en: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.
scripture_data.text_orig: החם וירצבמ מ ויתרדלכ צר

scripture_data.text_id: (89-43) Engkau telah meninggikan tangan kanan para lawannya, telah membuat semua musuhnya bersukacita.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינכל הרח היה רד ירבל ה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-44) Juga Kaubalikkan mata pedangnya, dan tidak membuat dia dapat bertahan dalam peperangan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויביל חמה וירצ ימי תמירה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-45) Engkau menghentikan kegemilangannya, dan takhtanya Kaucampakkan ke bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.
scripture_data.text_orig: המחל תמיקה לו רח רצ בי

scripture_data.text_id: (89-46) Kaupendekkan masa mudanya, Kauselubungi dia dengan malu. Sela
scripture_data.text_en: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרמ שרל סכו רהמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-47) Berapa lama lagi, ya TUHAN, Engkau bersembunyi terus-menerus, berkobar-kobar murka-Mu laksana api?
scripture_data.text_en: How long, LORD? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס ה ויל תיה וימל ימי רצקה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-48) Ingatlah apa umur hidup itu, betapa sia-sia Kauciptakan semua anak manusia!
scripture_data.text_en: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?
scripture_data.text_orig: תמח מ רב חצנל רת הוהי המד

scripture_data.text_id: (89-49) Siapakah orang yang hidup dan yang tidak mengalami kematian, yang dapat meluputkan nyawanya dari kuasa dunia orang mati? Sela
scripture_data.text_en: What man [is he that] liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.
scripture_data.text_orig: דינלכ תר והמל דלחהם ינרכז

scripture_data.text_id: (89-50) Di manakah kasih setia-Mu yang mula-mula, ya Tuhan, yang telah Kaujanjikan dengan sumpah kepada Daud demi kesetiaan-Mu?
scripture_data.text_en: Lord, where [are] thy former lovingkindnesses, [which] thou swarest unto David in thy truth?
scripture_data.text_orig: הלס לדמ פן מי תוהרי לו היחי רבג ימ

scripture_data.text_id: (89-51) Ingatlah cela hamba-Mu, ya Tuhan, bahwa dalam dadaku aku menanggung penghinaan segala bangsa,
scripture_data.text_en: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; [how] I do bear in my bosom [the reproach of] all the mighty people;
scripture_data.text_orig: תנמ דודל נ ינד ינרה ידסח ה

scripture_data.text_id: (89-52) yang dilontarkan oleh musuh-musuh-Mu, ya TUHAN, yang dilontarkan mencela jejak langkah orang yang Kauurapi.
scripture_data.text_en: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O LORD; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ירל יקיחב ית ידב תרח ינד רכז

scripture_data.text_id: (89-53) Terpujilah TUHAN untuk selama-lamanya! Amin, ya amin.
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [be] the LORD for evermore. Amen, and Amen.
scripture_data.text_orig: חים תב פרח ר הוהי יבי פרח ר

scripture_data.text_id: Doa Musa, abdi Allah. Tuhan, Engkaulah tempat perteduhan kami turun-temurun.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Prayer of Moses the man of God.> Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדו רד נ תייה ה מ ינד יהלהי המל הפ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebelum gunung-gunung dilahirkan, dan bumi dan dunia diperanakkan, bahkan dari selama-lamanya sampai selama-lamanya Engkaulah Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou [art] God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ה לד למ לבתו שר ללחו די ירה ר

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau mengembalikan manusia kepada debu, dan berkata: "Kembalilah, hai anak-anak manusia!"
scripture_data.text_en: Thou turnest man to destruction; and sayest, Return, ye children of men.
scripture_data.text_orig: דינב ב רמו ד נ ב

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab di mata-Mu seribu tahun sama seperti hari kemarin, apabila berlalu, atau seperti suatu giliran jaga di waktu malam.
scripture_data.text_en: For a thousand years in thy sight [are but] as yesterday when it is past, and [as] a watch in the night.
scripture_data.text_orig: הליב הרמו רבי י למת י יני ינ ל י

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau menghanyutkan manusia; mereka seperti mimpi, seperti rumput yang bertumbuh,
scripture_data.text_en: Thou carriest them away as with a flood; they are [as] a sleep: in the morning [they are] like grass [which] groweth up.
scripture_data.text_orig: לחי ריצח רק יהי הנ מרז

scripture_data.text_id: di waktu pagi berkembang dan bertumbuh, di waktu petang lisut dan layu.
scripture_data.text_en: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ביו ללמי ברל לחו שיצי רק

scripture_data.text_id: Sungguh, kami habis lenyap karena murka-Mu, dan karena kehangatan amarah-Mu kami terkejut.
scripture_data.text_en: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלהבנ תמחב ב נילכי

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau menaruh kesalahan kami di hadapan-Mu, dan dosa kami yang tersembunyi dalam cahaya wajah-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret [sins] in the light of thy countenance.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ רמל נמל גנל ניתנו ה

scripture_data.text_id: Sungguh, segala hari kami berlalu karena gemas-Mu, kami menghabiskan tahun-tahun kami seperti keluh.
scripture_data.text_en: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale [that is told].
scripture_data.text_orig: הגהמך נינ ני תרבב נ נימילכ י

scripture_data.text_id: Masa hidup kami tujuh puluh tahun dan jika kami kuat, delapan puluh tahun, dan kebanggaannya adalah kesukaran dan penderitaan; sebab berlalunya buru-buru, dan kami melayang lenyap.
scripture_data.text_en: The days of our years [are] threescore years and ten; and if by reason of strength [they be] fourscore years, yet [is] their strength labour and sorrow; for it is soon cut off, and we fly away.
scripture_data.text_orig: הפו יח זגי וו למ הרו הנ ינמ תרבג ו הנ יב הב ניתנימי

scripture_data.text_id: Siapakah yang mengenal kekuatan murka-Mu dan takut kepada gemas-Mu?
scripture_data.text_en: Who knoweth the power of thine anger? even according to thy fear, [so is] thy wrath.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרב תריכ ז דיימ

scripture_data.text_id: Ajarlah kami menghitung hari-hari kami sedemikian, hingga kami beroleh hati yang bijaksana.
scripture_data.text_en: So teach [us] to number our days, that we may apply [our] hearts unto wisdom.
scripture_data.text_orig: המכח בבל בנו דה נימי תנמל

scripture_data.text_id: Kembalilah, ya TUHAN berapa lama lagi? dan sayangilah hamba-hamba-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Return, O LORD, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידבל חהו יתמד הוהי הב

scripture_data.text_id: Kenyangkanlah kami di waktu pagi dengan kasih setia-Mu, supaya kami bersorak-sorai dan bersukacita semasa hari-hari kami.
scripture_data.text_en: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימילכ החמנו הנרנ סח רקב נ

scripture_data.text_id: Buatlah kami bersukacita seimbang dengan hari-hari Engkau menindas kami, seimbang dengan tahun-tahun kami mengalami celaka.
scripture_data.text_en: Make us glad according to the days [wherein] thou hast afflicted us, [and] the years [wherein] we have seen evil.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר ניר תנ נתי תמי נח

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah kelihatan kepada hamba-hamba-Mu perbuatan-Mu, dan semarak-Mu kepada anak-anak mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Let thy work appear unto thy servants, and thy glory unto their children.
scripture_data.text_orig: הינל רדהו לפ ידבל הרי

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya kemurahan Tuhan, Allah kami, atas kami, dan teguhkanlah perbuatan tangan kami, ya, perbuatan tangan kami, teguhkanlah itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And let the beauty of the LORD our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.
scripture_data.text_orig: הננ נידי המ ניל הננ נידי המ ניל ניהל ינד נ יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Orang yang duduk dalam lindungan Yang Mahatinggi dan bermalam dalam naungan Yang Mahakuasa
scripture_data.text_en: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלתי י לצ יל רתס בי

scripture_data.text_id: akan berkata kepada TUHAN: "Tempat perlindunganku dan kubu pertahananku, Allahku, yang kupercayai."
scripture_data.text_en: I will say of the LORD, [He is] my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.
scripture_data.text_orig: חב יהל יתדצמ יסחם הוהיל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Sungguh, Dialah yang akan melepaskan engkau dari jerat penangkap burung, dari penyakit sampar yang busuk.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, [and] from the noisome pestilence.
scripture_data.text_orig: תה רבמ קי חמ ליי ה י

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan kepak-Nya Ia akan menudungi engkau, di bawah sayap-Nya engkau akan berlindung, kesetiaan-Nya ialah perisai dan pagar tembok.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth [shall be thy] shield and buckler.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ הרחסו הצ הסח ויפנתחתו ל סי תרב

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau tak usah takut terhadap kedahsyatan malam, terhadap panah yang terbang di waktu siang,
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; [nor] for the arrow [that] flieth by day;
scripture_data.text_orig: מי י שחמ הליל דחמ ריתל

scripture_data.text_id: terhadap penyakit sampar yang berjalan di dalam gelap, terhadap penyakit menular yang mengamuk di waktu petang.
scripture_data.text_en: [Nor] for the pestilence [that] walketh in darkness; [nor] for the destruction [that] wasteth at noonday.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירהצ די במ להי לפ רבמ

scripture_data.text_id: Walau seribu orang rebah di sisimu, dan sepuluh ribu di sebelah kananmu, tetapi itu tidak akan menimpamu.
scripture_data.text_en: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; [but] it shall not come nigh thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ל יל נימימ הבבר ל מ לי

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau hanya menontonnya dengan matamu sendiri dan melihat pembalasan terhadap orang-orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר יר תמו ית יני קר

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab TUHAN ialah tempat perlindunganmu, Yang Mahatinggi telah kaubuat tempat perteduhanmu,
scripture_data.text_en: Because thou hast made the LORD, [which is] my refuge, [even] the most High, thy habitation;
scripture_data.text_orig: נם מ יל יסחם הוהי הי

scripture_data.text_id: malapetaka tidak akan menimpa kamu, dan tulah tidak akan mendekat kepada kemahmu;
scripture_data.text_en: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.
scripture_data.text_orig: לה ברקיל גנו הר יל התל

scripture_data.text_id: sebab malaikat-malaikat-Nya akan diperintahkan-Nya kepadamu untuk menjaga engkau di segala jalanmu.
scripture_data.text_en: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכרלכ רמל הצי ויכלמ י

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan menatang engkau di atas tangannya, supaya kakimu jangan terantuk kepada batu.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall bear thee up in [their] hands, lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.
scripture_data.text_orig: לגר ב ני יל

scripture_data.text_id: Singa dan ular tedung akan kaulangkahi, engkau akan menginjak anak singa dan ular naga.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתו ריפ סמר רד תפו לחל

scripture_data.text_id: "Sungguh, hatinya melekat kepada-Ku, maka Aku akan meluputkannya, Aku akan membentenginya, sebab ia mengenal nama-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: Because he hath set his love upon me, therefore will I deliver him: I will set him on high, because he hath known my name.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ דיי הב הפו קח יב י

scripture_data.text_id: Bila ia berseru kepada-Ku, Aku akan menjawab, Aku akan menyertai dia dalam kesesakan, Aku akan meluputkannya dan memuliakannya.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall call upon me, and I will answer him: I [will be] with him in trouble; I will deliver him, and honour him.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדכו הצח הרצב יכנ הנו ינרקי

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan panjang umur akan Kukenyangkan dia, dan akan Kuperlihatkan kepadanya keselamatan dari pada-Ku."
scripture_data.text_en: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתי הרו הי ימי ר

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur. Nyanyian untuk hari Sabat. (92-2) Adalah baik untuk menyanyikan syukur kepada TUHAN, dan untuk menyanyikan mazmur bagi nama-Mu, ya Yang Mahatinggi,
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm [or] Song for the sabbath day.> [It is a] good [thing] to give thanks unto the LORD, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:
scripture_data.text_orig: תה יל רי רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: (92-3) untuk memberitakan kasih setia-Mu di waktu pagi dan kesetiaan-Mu di waktu malam,
scripture_data.text_en: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,
scripture_data.text_orig: יל מל רזל הוהיל תדהל ב

scripture_data.text_id: (92-4) dengan bunyi-bunyian sepuluh tali dan dengan gambus, dengan iringan kecapi.
scripture_data.text_en: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.
scripture_data.text_orig: תלי תנמו סח רק דיהל

scripture_data.text_id: (92-5) Sebab telah Kaubuat aku bersukacita, ya TUHAN, dengan pekerjaan-Mu, karena perbuatan tangan-Mu aku akan bersorak-sorai.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou, LORD, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכ יה יל לבנילו ריל

scripture_data.text_id: (92-6) Betapa besarnya pekerjaan-pekerjaan-Mu, ya TUHAN, dan sangat dalamnya rancangan-rancangan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD, how great are thy works! [and] thy thoughts are very deep.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר ידי ימ לפ הוהי ינח י

scripture_data.text_id: (92-7) Orang bodoh tidak akan mengetahui, dan orang bebal tidak akan mengerti hal itu.
scripture_data.text_en: A brutish man knoweth not; neither doth a fool understand this.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתבחם קמ דמ הוהי ים לדהם

scripture_data.text_id: (92-8) Apabila orang-orang fasik bertunas seperti tumbuh-tumbuhan, dan orang-orang yang melakukan kejahatan berkembang, ialah supaya mereka dipunahkan untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; [it is] that they shall be destroyed for ever:
scripture_data.text_orig: תזת יביל ליסכ די ל רי

scripture_data.text_id: (92-9) Tetapi Engkau di tempat yang tinggi untuk selama-lamanya, ya TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: But thou, LORD, [art most] high for evermore.
scripture_data.text_orig: דיד דמהל ו ילל ציצו ב מ יר חרפ

scripture_data.text_id: (92-10) Sebab, sesungguhnya musuh-Mu, ya TUHAN, sebab, sesungguhnya musuh-Mu akan binasa, semua orang yang melakukan kejahatan akan diceraiberaikan.
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, thine enemies, O LORD, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי לל רמ הו

scripture_data.text_id: (92-11) Tetapi Kautinggikan tandukku seperti tanduk banteng, aku dituangi dengan minyak baru;
scripture_data.text_en: But my horn shalt thou exalt like [the horn of] an unicorn: I shall be anointed with fresh oil.
scripture_data.text_orig: ו ילל דרתי דבי יבי ההי הוהי יבי הה י

scripture_data.text_id: (92-12) mataku memandangi seteruku, telingaku mendengar perihal orang-orang jahat yang bangkit melawan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eye also shall see [my desire] on mine enemies, [and] mine ears shall hear [my desire] of the wicked that rise up against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: נר מ ית ינרק יר רו

scripture_data.text_id: (92-13) Orang benar akan bertunas seperti pohon korma, akan tumbuh subur seperti pohon aras di Libanon;
scripture_data.text_en: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינז הנמ ירם יל ימ יר יני ו

scripture_data.text_id: (92-14) mereka yang ditanam di bait TUHAN akan bertunas di pelataran Allah kita.
scripture_data.text_en: Those that be planted in the house of the LORD shall flourish in the courts of our God.
scripture_data.text_orig: הי נב זר חרפי רמ קיצ

scripture_data.text_id: (92-15) Pada masa tua pun mereka masih berbuah, menjadi gemuk dan segar,
