scripture_data.text_en: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;
scripture_data.text_orig: חירפי ניהל תרצח הוהי תיב ילת

scripture_data.text_id: (92-16) untuk memberitakan, bahwa TUHAN itu benar, bahwa Ia gunung batuku dan tidak ada kecurangan pada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: To shew that the LORD [is] upright: [he is] my rock, and [there is] no unrighteousness in him.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהי ינרו ינ הבי בני ד

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN adalah Raja, Ia berpakaian kemegahan, TUHAN berpakaian, berikat pinggang kekuatan. Sungguh, telah tegak dunia, tidak bergoyang;
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD reigneth, he is clothed with majesty; the LORD is clothed with strength, [wherewith] he hath girded himself: the world also is stablished, that it cannot be moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל לב רתה ז הוהי בל בל ת למ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: takhta-Mu tegak sejak dahulu kala, dari kekal Engkau ada.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy throne [is] established of old: thou [art] from everlasting.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה למ זמ ס כנ

scripture_data.text_id: Sungai-sungai telah mengangkat, ya TUHAN, sungai-sungai telah mengangkat suaranya, sungai-sungai mengangkat bunyi hempasannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The floods have lifted up, O LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכ תרהן י לק תרהן נ הוהי תרהן נ

scripture_data.text_id: Dari pada suara air yang besar, dari pada pecahan ombak laut yang hebat, lebih hebat TUHAN di tempat tinggi.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD on high [is] mightier than the noise of many waters, [yea, than] the mighty waves of the sea.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ר רי יירמ ירי יר ימ תלמ

scripture_data.text_id: Peraturan-Mu sangat teguh; bait-Mu layak kudus, ya TUHAN, untuk sepanjang masa.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O LORD, for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימי רל הוהי דקהון תיבל דם נמן יתד

scripture_data.text_id: Ya Allah pembalas, ya TUHAN, ya Allah pembalas, tampillah!
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפה תמקן ל הוהי תמקנל

scripture_data.text_id: Bangunlah, ya Hakim bumi, balaslah kepada orang-orang congkak apa yang mereka lakukan!
scripture_data.text_en: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל למ בה שרה פ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Berapa lama lagi orang-orang fasik, ya TUHAN, berapa lama lagi orang-orang fasik beria-ria?
scripture_data.text_en: LORD, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?
scripture_data.text_orig: זלי יר יתמד הוהי יר יתמד

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka memuntahkan kata-kata yang kurang ajar dan semua orang yang melakukan kejahatan itu menyombong.
scripture_data.text_en: [How long] shall they utter [and] speak hard things? [and] all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?
scripture_data.text_orig: ו ילל רתי קת רדי יי

scripture_data.text_id: Umat-Mu, ya TUHAN, mereka remukkan, dan milik-Mu sendiri mereka tindas;
scripture_data.text_en: They break in pieces thy people, O LORD, and afflict thine heritage.
scripture_data.text_orig: י תלחנו די הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: janda dan orang asing mereka sembelih, dan anak-anak yatim mereka bunuh;
scripture_data.text_en: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.
scripture_data.text_orig: חרי ימתיו גרהי רגו הנמל

scripture_data.text_id: dan mereka berkata: "TUHAN tidak melihatnya, dan Allah Yakub tidak mengindahkannya."
scripture_data.text_en: Yet they say, The LORD shall not see, neither shall the God of Jacob regard [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי יהל יבילו הרי ל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Perhatikanlah, hai orang-orang bodoh di antara rakyat! Hai orang-orang bebal, bilakah kamu memakai akal budimu?
scripture_data.text_en: Understand, ye brutish among the people: and [ye] fools, when will ye be wise?
scripture_data.text_orig: לי יתמ יליסכ יר ני

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang menanamkan telinga, masakan tidak mendengar? Dia yang membentuk mata, masakan tidak memandang?
scripture_data.text_en: He that planted the ear, shall he not hear? he that formed the eye, shall he not see?
scripture_data.text_orig: יי לה י רצי מי לה ז נה

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang menghajar bangsa-bangsa, masakan tidak akan menghukum? Dia yang mengajarkan pengetahuan kepada manusia?
scripture_data.text_en: He that chastiseth the heathen, shall not he correct? he that teacheth man knowledge, [shall not he know]?
scripture_data.text_orig: ת ד דלמה חיכי לה י רסיה

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN mengetahui rancangan-rancangan manusia; sesungguhnya semuanya sia-sia belaka.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD knoweth the thoughts of man, that they [are] vanity.
scripture_data.text_orig: לבה ההי ד תבחם די הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Berbahagialah orang yang Kauhajar, ya TUHAN, dan yang Kauajari dari Taurat-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [is] the man whom thou chastenest, O LORD, and teachest him out of thy law;
scripture_data.text_orig: דלת תרמ ריר רבה יר

scripture_data.text_id: untuk menenangkan dia terhadap hari-hari malapetaka, sampai digali lobang untuk orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: תח רל הרי ד ר ימימ ל יקהל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab TUHAN tidak akan membuang umat-Nya, dan milik-Nya sendiri tidak akan ditinggalkan-Nya;
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.
scripture_data.text_orig: בזי ל תלחנו הוהי יל י

scripture_data.text_id: sebab hukum akan kembali kepada keadilan, dan akan diikuti oleh semua orang yang tulus hati.
scripture_data.text_en: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.
scripture_data.text_orig: בליריל וירחו מ בי קדצדי

scripture_data.text_id: Siapakah yang bangkit bagiku melawan orang-orang jahat, siapakah yang tampil bagiku melawan orang-orang yang melakukan kejahatan?
scripture_data.text_en: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? [or] who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?
scripture_data.text_orig: ו יל יל ביתיימ ירמ יל קיימ

scripture_data.text_id: Jika bukan TUHAN yang menolong aku, nyaris aku diam di tempat sunyi.
scripture_data.text_en: Unless the LORD [had been] my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן המד הנכ מ י התרז הוהי ילל

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika aku berpikir: "Kakiku goyang," maka kasih setia-Mu, ya TUHAN, menyokong aku.
scripture_data.text_en: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O LORD, held me up.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינדסי הוהי סח ילגר המ ירמ

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila bertambah banyak pikiran dalam batinku, penghiburan-Mu menyenangkan jiwaku.
scripture_data.text_en: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן י ימחנ ירק יר בר

scripture_data.text_id: Masakan bersekutu dengan Engkau takhta kebusukan, yang merancangkan bencana berdasarkan ketetapan?
scripture_data.text_en: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?
scripture_data.text_orig: קחיל למ רצי תה רבחיה

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka bersekongkol melawan jiwa orang benar, dan menyatakan fasik darah orang yang tidak bersalah.
scripture_data.text_en: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירי יקנ דו קיץ פנל גי

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi TUHAN adalah kota bentengku dan Allahku adalah gunung batu perlindunganku.
scripture_data.text_en: But the LORD is my defence; and my God [is] the rock of my refuge.
scripture_data.text_orig: יסחם רצל יהלו במל יל הוהי יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Ia akan membalas kepada mereka perbuatan jahat mereka, dan karena kejahatan mereka Ia akan membinasakan mereka; TUHAN, Allah kita, akan membinasakan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; [yea], the LORD our God shall cut them off.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניהל הוהי תימצי תימצי תרב נת היל בו

scripture_data.text_id: Marilah kita bersorak-sorai untuk TUHAN, bersorak-sorak bagi gunung batu keselamatan kita.
scripture_data.text_en: O come, let us sing unto the LORD: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.
scripture_data.text_orig: ני רצל הירנ הוהיל הנרן כל

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah kita menghadap wajah-Nya dengan nyanyian syukur, bersorak-sorak bagi-Nya dengan nyanyian mazmur.
scripture_data.text_en: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ירנ תרמז הדת וינפ המקן

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab TUHAN adalah Allah yang besar, dan Raja yang besar mengatasi segala allah.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD [is] a great God, and a great King above all gods.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהללל לד למ הוהי לד ל י

scripture_data.text_id: Bagian-bagian bumi yang paling dalam ada di tangan-Nya, puncak gunung-gunungpun kepunyaan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: In his hand [are] the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills [is] his also.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ירה תפתו שרירקחם די ר

scripture_data.text_id: Kepunyaan-Nya laut, Dialah yang menjadikannya, dan darat, tangan-Nyalah yang membentuknya.
scripture_data.text_en: The sea [is] his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry [land].
scripture_data.text_orig: רצי וידי תיו ה הו ה לר

scripture_data.text_id: Masuklah, marilah kita sujud menyembah, berlutut di hadapan TUHAN yang menjadikan kita.
scripture_data.text_en: O come, let us worship and bow down: let us kneel before the LORD our maker.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ הוהיינפל הכרבנ הרכנו הוחנ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Dialah Allah kita, dan kitalah umat gembalaan-Nya dan kawanan domba tuntunan tangan-Nya. Pada hari ini, sekiranya kamu mendengar suara-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: For he [is] our God; and we [are] the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,
scripture_data.text_orig: מת לק ה די צו תירמ נחנו ניהל ה י

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah keraskan hatimu seperti di Meriba, seperti pada hari di Masa di padang gurun,
scripture_data.text_en: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, [and] as [in] the day of temptation in the wilderness:
scripture_data.text_orig: רד המ י הבירמ כבבל קל

scripture_data.text_id: pada waktu nenek moyangmu mencobai Aku, menguji Aku, padahal mereka melihat perbuatan-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילפ ר יננח כיתב יננ ר

scripture_data.text_id: Empat puluh tahun Aku jemu kepada angkatan itu, maka kata-Ku: "Mereka suatu bangsa yang sesat hati, dan mereka itu tidak mengenal jalan-Ku."
scripture_data.text_en: Forty years long was I grieved with [this] generation, and said, It [is] a people that do err in their heart, and they have not known my ways:
scripture_data.text_orig: יכרד דיל הו ה בבל י רמו רד ק הנ יר

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu Aku bersumpah dalam murka-Ku: "Mereka takkan masuk ke tempat perhentian-Ku."
scripture_data.text_en: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתחנמל בי יב ינר

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyikanlah nyanyian baru bagi TUHAN, menyanyilah bagi TUHAN, hai segenap bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: O sing unto the LORD a new song: sing unto the LORD, all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהל הוהיל רי דח רי הוהיל רי

scripture_data.text_id: Menyanyilah bagi TUHAN, pujilah nama-Nya, kabarkanlah keselamatan yang dari pada-Nya dari hari ke hari.
scripture_data.text_en: Sing unto the LORD, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי ילמ ר מ כר הוהיל רי

scripture_data.text_id: Ceritakanlah kemuliaan-Nya di antara bangsa-bangsa dan perbuatan-perbuatan yang ajaib di antara segala suku bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתלפנ יהלכ דב יב רס

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab TUHAN maha besar dan terpuji sangat, Ia lebih dahsyat dari pada segala allah.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD [is] great, and greatly to be praised: he [is] to be feared above all gods.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהללל ה רן דם להמ הוהי לדג י

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab segala allah bangsa-bangsa adalah hampa, tetapi Tuhanlah yang menjadikan langit.
scripture_data.text_en: For all the gods of the nations [are] idols: but the LORD made the heavens.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה ימ הוהיו יליל יה יהלל י

scripture_data.text_id: Keagungan dan semarak ada di hadapan-Nya, kekuatan dan kehormatan ada di tempat kudus-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Honour and majesty [are] before him: strength and beauty [are] in his sanctuary.
scripture_data.text_orig: קמ תרפתו ז וינפל רדהודה

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada TUHAN, hai suku-suku bangsa, kepada TUHAN sajalah kemuliaan dan kekuatan!
scripture_data.text_en: Give unto the LORD, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the LORD glory and strength.
scripture_data.text_orig: זו דב הוהיל בה י תחמ הוהיל בה

scripture_data.text_id: Berilah kepada TUHAN kemuliaan nama-Nya, bawalah persembahan dan masuklah ke pelataran-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: Give unto the LORD the glory [due unto] his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתרצחל ב החנמ מ דב הוהיל בה

scripture_data.text_id: Sujudlah menyembah kepada TUHAN dengan berhiaskan kekudusan, gemetarlah di hadapan-Nya, hai segenap bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: O worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהל וינמ ליח דקתרדה הוהיל וחה

scripture_data.text_id: Katakanlah di antara bangsa-bangsa: "TUHAN itu Raja! Sungguh tegak dunia, tidak goyang. Ia akan mengadili bangsa-bangsa dalam kebenaran."
scripture_data.text_en: Say among the heathen [that] the LORD reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירימ י ידי ל לב למ הוהי יב רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah langit bersukacita dan bumi bersorak-sorak, biarlah gemuruh laut serta isinya,
scripture_data.text_en: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: למ ה רי שרה לגתו ימה חמי

scripture_data.text_id: biarlah beria-ria padang dan segala yang di atasnya, maka segala pohon di hutan bersorak-sorai
scripture_data.text_en: Let the field be joyful, and all that [is] therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice
scripture_data.text_orig: רייצל נרי ז רלכו יד זלי

scripture_data.text_id: di hadapan TUHAN, sebab Ia datang, sebab Ia datang untuk menghakimi bumi. Ia akan menghakimi dunia dengan keadilan, dan bangsa-bangsa dengan kesetiaan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Before the LORD: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנמ יו קדצ לבי שרה ל ב י ב י הוהי ינפל

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN adalah Raja! Biarlah bumi bersorak-sorak, biarlah banyak pulau bersukacita!
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad [thereof].
scripture_data.text_orig: יר י חמי שרה לג למ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Awan dan kekelaman ada sekeliling Dia, keadilan dan hukum adalah tumpuan takhta-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Clouds and darkness [are] round about him: righteousness and judgment [are] the habitation of his throne.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס כם מ קדצ ויביבס לפרו נ

scripture_data.text_id: Api menjalar di hadapan-Nya, dan menghanguskan para lawan-Nya sekeliling.
scripture_data.text_en: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.
scripture_data.text_orig: וירצ ביבס הלת ל וינפל

scripture_data.text_id: Kilat-kilat-Nya menerangi dunia, bumi melihatnya dan gemetar.
scripture_data.text_en: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה לחו התר לב ויקרב ריה

scripture_data.text_id: Gunung-gunung luluh seperti lilin di hadapan TUHAN, di hadapan Tuhan seluruh bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהל ד ינפמ הוהי ינפמ מנ גנ ירה

scripture_data.text_id: Langit memberitakan keadilan-Nya, dan segala bangsa melihat kemuliaan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב יהלכ רו קדצ ימה דיה

scripture_data.text_id: Semua orang yang beribadah kepada patung akan mendapat malu, orang yang memegahkan diri karena berhala-berhala; segala allah sujud menyembah kepada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all [ye] gods.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל לוחה יליל יללהתה לספ ידבל בי

scripture_data.text_id: Sion mendengarnya dan bersukacita, puteri-puteri Yehuda bersorak-sorak, oleh karena penghukuman-Mu, ya TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ימ מל הדהי תנ הנלגו צ חמו המ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkaulah, ya TUHAN, Yang Mahatinggi di atas seluruh bumi, Engkau sangat dimuliakan di atas segala allah.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou, LORD, [art] high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהללל תילנ דם שרהלל יל הוהי הי

scripture_data.text_id: Hai orang-orang yang mengasihi TUHAN, bencilah kejahatan! Dia, yang memelihara nyawa orang-orang yang dikasihi-Nya, akan melepaskan mereka dari tangan orang-orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: Ye that love the LORD, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליי יר דמ וידיסח תפן רמ ר נ הוהי יבה

scripture_data.text_id: Terang sudah terbit bagi orang benar, dan sukacita bagi orang-orang yang tulus hati.
scripture_data.text_en: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: החמ בליריל קיל רז ר

scripture_data.text_id: Bersukacitalah karena TUHAN, hai orang-orang benar, dan nyanyikanlah syukur bagi nama-Nya yang kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: Rejoice in the LORD, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק רכזל דהו הוהי יקיצ חמ

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur. Nyanyikanlah nyanyian baru bagi TUHAN, sebab Ia telah melakukan perbuatan-perbuatan yang ajaib; keselamatan telah dikerjakan kepada-Nya oleh tangan kanan-Nya, oleh lengan-Nya yang kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm.> O sing unto the LORD a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק רז נימי היה ה תלפני דח רי הוהיל רי רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN telah memperkenalkan keselamatan yang dari pada-Nya, telah menyatakan keadilan-Nya di depan mata bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.
scripture_data.text_orig: תקדצ ה יה יניל תי הוהי ידה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia mengingat kasih setia dan kesetiaan-Nya terhadap kaum Israel, segala ujung bumi telah melihat keselamatan yang dari pada Allah kita.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניהל תי ת שריספלכ ר לרי תיבל תנמו סח רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Bersorak-soraklah bagi TUHAN, hai seluruh bumi, bergembiralah, bersorak-sorailah dan bermazmurlah!
scripture_data.text_en: Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.
scripture_data.text_orig: רזו נרו חצ שרהל הוהיל ירה

scripture_data.text_id: Bermazmurlah bagi TUHAN dengan kecapi, dengan kecapi dan lagu yang nyaring,
scripture_data.text_en: Sing unto the LORD with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרמז לקו רכ רכ הוהיל רז

scripture_data.text_id: dengan nafiri dan sangkakala yang nyaring bersorak-soraklah di hadapan Raja, yakni TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the LORD, the King.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי לה ינפל ירה רפ לקו תרצצח

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah gemuruh laut serta isinya, dunia serta yang diam di dalamnya!
scripture_data.text_en: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב יביו לב למ ה רי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah sungai-sungai bertepuk tangan, dan gunung-gunung bersorak-sorai bersama-sama
scripture_data.text_en: Let the floods clap [their] hands: let the hills be joyful together
scripture_data.text_orig: נרי ירה דחי כחמי תרהן

scripture_data.text_id: di hadapan TUHAN, sebab Ia datang untuk menghakimi bumi. Ia akan menghakimi dunia dengan keadilan, dan bangsa-bangsa dengan kebenaran.
scripture_data.text_en: Before the LORD; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירימ יו קדצ לבי שרה ל ב י הוהיינפל

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN itu Raja, maka bangsa-bangsa gemetar. Ia duduk di atas kerub-kerub, maka bumi goyang.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth [between] the cherubims; let the earth be moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה נ יבר בי י זרי למ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN itu maha besar di Sion, dan Ia tinggi mengatasi segala bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] great in Zion; and he [is] high above all the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל ה רו לד צ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah mereka menyanyikan syukur bagi nama-Mu yang besar dan dahsyat; Kuduslah Ia!
scripture_data.text_en: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; [for] it [is] holy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה דק רנו לד מ די

scripture_data.text_id: Raja yang kuat, yang mencintai hukum, Engkaulah yang menegakkan kebenaran; hukum dan keadilan di antara keturunan Yakub, Engkaulah yang melakukannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The king's strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי ה בקי הקדצ מ ירימ ננ ה בה מ לם זו

scripture_data.text_id: Tinggikanlah TUHAN, Allah kita, dan sujudlah menyembah kepada tumpuan kaki-Nya! Kuduslah Ia!
scripture_data.text_en: Exalt ye the LORD our God, and worship at his footstool; [for] he [is] holy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה דק וילגר דהל וחהו ניהל הוהי ממר

scripture_data.text_id: Musa dan Harun di antara imam-imam-Nya, dan Samuel di antara orang-orang yang menyerukan nama-Nya. Mereka berseru kepada TUHAN dan Ia menjawab mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Moses and Aaron among his priests, and Samuel among them that call upon his name; they called upon the LORD, and he answered them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ני הו הוהיל ירק מ ירק למ וינהכ רהו המ

scripture_data.text_id: Dalam tiang awan Ia berbicara kepada mereka; mereka telah berpegang pada peringatan-peringatan-Nya dan ketetapan yang diberikan-Nya kepada mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: He spake unto them in the cloudy pillar: they kept his testimonies, and the ordinance [that] he gave them.
scripture_data.text_orig: מלתנ קחו ויתד רמ היל רדי נ ד

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN, Allah kami, Engkau telah menjawab mereka, Engkau Allah yang mengampuni bagi mereka, tetapi yang membalas perbuatan-perbuatan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou answeredst them, O LORD our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.
scripture_data.text_orig: תלילל קנו הל תייה נ ל תינ ה ניהל הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Tinggikanlah TUHAN, Allah kita, dan sujudlah menyembah di hadapan gunung-Nya yang kudus! Sebab kuduslah TUHAN, Allah kita!
scripture_data.text_en: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the LORD our God [is] holy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניהל הוהי דקי דק רהל וחהו ניהל הוהי ממר

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur untuk korban syukur. Bersorak-soraklah bagi TUHAN, hai seluruh bumi!
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of praise.> Make a joyful noise unto the LORD, all ye lands.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהל הוהיל ירה הדתל רמזמ

scripture_data.text_id: Beribadahlah kepada TUHAN dengan sukacita, datanglah ke hadapan-Nya dengan sorak-sorai!
scripture_data.text_en: Serve the LORD with gladness: come before his presence with singing.
scripture_data.text_orig: הננר וינפל החמ הוהית דב

scripture_data.text_id: Ketahuilah, bahwa Tuhanlah Allah; Dialah yang menjadikan kita dan punya Dialah kita, umat-Nya dan kawanan domba gembalaan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Know ye that the LORD he [is] God: [it is] he [that] hath made us, and not we ourselves; [we are] his people, and the sheep of his pasture.
scripture_data.text_orig: תירם צו נחנ לו לו נה יהל ה הוהיי

scripture_data.text_id: Masuklah melalui pintu gerbang-Nya dengan nyanyian syukur, ke dalam pelataran-Nya dengan puji-pujian, bersyukurlah kepada-Nya dan pujilah nama-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, [and] into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, [and] bless his name.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ כר לדה ההת ויתרצח הדת ויר

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab TUHAN itu baik, kasih setia-Nya untuk selama-lamanya, dan kesetiaan-Nya tetap turun-temurun.
scripture_data.text_en: For the LORD [is] good; his mercy [is] everlasting; and his truth [endureth] to all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנמ רדו רדו סח לל הוהי בי

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Daud. Aku hendak menyanyikan kasih setia dan hukum, aku hendak bermazmur bagi-Mu, ya TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of David.> I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O LORD, will I sing.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרז הוהי ל הרי מדסח רמזמ דודל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku hendak memperhatikan hidup yang tidak bercela: Bilakah Engkau datang kepadaku? Aku hendak hidup dalam ketulusan hatiku di dalam rumahku.
scripture_data.text_en: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתי ברק יבבלת הת יל ב יתמ ימ רד הלי

scripture_data.text_id: Tiada kutaruh di depan mataku perkara dursila; perbuatan murtad aku benci, itu takkan melekat padaku.
scripture_data.text_en: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; [it] shall not cleave to me.
scripture_data.text_orig: י קדי ל יתנ יסה ללרב יני דגנל תיל

scripture_data.text_id: Hati yang bengkok akan menjauh dari padaku, kejahatan aku tidak mau tahu.
scripture_data.text_en: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked [person].
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ל ר ימ רסי בבל

scripture_data.text_id: Orang yang sembunyi-sembunyi mengumpat temannya, dia akan kubinasakan. Orang yang sombong dan tinggi hati, aku tidak suka.
scripture_data.text_en: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכ ל ת בבל בחר יניב תימצ ת הר רתב ינלמ ינלמ

scripture_data.text_id: Mataku tertuju kepada orang-orang yang setiawan di negeri, supaya mereka diam bersama-sama dengan aku. Orang yang hidup dengan cara yang tak bercela, akan melayani aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eyes [shall be] upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינתרי ה ימ רד לה יד תבל שרינמנ יני

scripture_data.text_id: Orang yang melakukan tipu daya tidak akan diam di dalam rumahku, orang yang berbicara dusta tidak akan tegak di depan mataku.
scripture_data.text_en: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.
scripture_data.text_orig: יני דגנל יל ירק רב המר ה יתי ברק ביל

scripture_data.text_id: Setiap pagi akan kubinasakan semua orang fasik di negeri; akan kulenyapkan dari kota TUHAN, semua orang yang melakukan kejahatan.
scripture_data.text_en: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ו ילל הוהירימ תירכהל שרירל תימצ ירקל

scripture_data.text_id: Doa seorang sengsara, pada waktu ia lemah lesu dan mencurahkan pengaduhannya ke hadapan TUHAN. (102-2) TUHAN, dengarkanlah doaku, dan biarlah teriakku minta tolong sampai kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: <A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the LORD.> Hear my prayer, O LORD, and let my cry come unto thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: חי י הוהי ינפלו ייכ ינל הפ

scripture_data.text_id: (102-3) Janganlah sembunyikan wajah-Mu terhadap aku pada hari aku tersesak. Sendengkanlah telinga-Mu kepadaku; pada hari aku berseru, segeralah menjawab aku!
scripture_data.text_en: Hide not thy face from me in the day [when] I am in trouble; incline thine ear unto me: in the day [when] I call answer me speedily.
scripture_data.text_orig: בת יל יתוו יתפת המ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: (102-4) Sebab hari-hariku habis seperti asap, tulang-tulangku membara seperti perapian.
scripture_data.text_en: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יננ רהם רק י נז ילהה יל רצ י ימ ינ רסל

scripture_data.text_id: (102-5) Hatiku terpukul dan layu seperti rumput, sehingga aku lupa makan rotiku.
scripture_data.text_en: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.
scripture_data.text_orig: רחנ דקמ יתמצו ימי ב לכי

scripture_data.text_id: (102-6) Oleh sebab keluhanku yang nyaring, aku tinggal tulang-belulang.
scripture_data.text_en: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימחל לכמ יחכי יל בו בכהה

scripture_data.text_id: (102-7) Aku sudah menyerupai burung undan di padang gurun, sudah menjadi seperti burung ponggok pada reruntuhan.
scripture_data.text_en: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירבל ימצ הקב יתחנ למ

scripture_data.text_id: (102-8) Aku tak bisa tidur dan sudah menjadi seperti burung terpencil di atas sotoh.
scripture_data.text_en: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.
scripture_data.text_orig: תברח סכ יתייה רדמ תקל יתימ

scripture_data.text_id: (102-9) Sepanjang hari aku dicela oleh musuh-musuhku, orang-orang yang mempermainkan aku menyumpah dengan menyebut namaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; [and] they that are mad against me are sworn against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: גל דד רצ היהו ידק

scripture_data.text_id: (102-10) Sebab aku makan abu seperti roti, dan mencampur minumanku dengan tangisan,
scripture_data.text_en: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,
scripture_data.text_orig: נ י יללהמ יבי ינפרח הל

scripture_data.text_id: (102-11) oleh karena marah-Mu dan geram-Mu, sebab Engkau telah mengangkat aku dan melemparkan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכסמ יכב יוו ילכ ח רפי

scripture_data.text_id: (102-12) Hari-hariku seperti bayang-bayang memanjang, dan aku sendiri layu seperti rumput.
scripture_data.text_en: My days [are] like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינכילו ינתנ י צקו מזינמ

scripture_data.text_id: (102-13) Tetapi Engkau, ya TUHAN, bersemayam untuk selama-lamanya, dan nama-Mu tetap turun-temurun.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou, O LORD, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי ב ינו ינ לצ ימי

scripture_data.text_id: (102-14) Engkau sendiri akan bangun, akan menyayangi Sion, sebab sudah waktunya untuk mengasihaninya, sudah tiba saatnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt arise, [and] have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדו רדל רכזו ב לל הוהי הו

scripture_data.text_id: (102-15) Sebab hamba-hamba-Mu sayang kepada batu-batunya, dan merasa kasihan akan debunya.
scripture_data.text_en: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: דם בי ננחל תי צ חר קת ה

scripture_data.text_id: (102-16) Maka bangsa-bangsa menjadi takut akan nama TUHAN, dan semua raja bumi akan kemuliaan-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: So the heathen shall fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.
scripture_data.text_orig: ננחי רפתו הינבת ידב צרי

scripture_data.text_id: (102-17) bila TUHAN sudah membangun Sion, sudah menampakkan diri dalam kemuliaan-Nya,
scripture_data.text_en: When the LORD shall build up Zion, he shall appear in his glory.
scripture_data.text_orig: דבת שרה יכלמלכו הוהי ת יג רייו

scripture_data.text_id: (102-18) sudah berpaling mendengarkan doa orang-orang yang bulus, dan tidak memandang hina doa mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: דבכ הרנ צ הוהי הנבי

scripture_data.text_id: (102-19) Biarlah hal ini dituliskan bagi angkatan yang kemudian, dan bangsa yang diciptakan nanti akan memuji-muji TUHAN,
scripture_data.text_en: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: תפת הזבלו ררה תפל הנ

scripture_data.text_id: (102-20) sebab Ia telah memandang dari ketinggian-Nya yang kudus, TUHAN memandang dari sorga ke bumi,
scripture_data.text_en: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the LORD behold the earth;
scripture_data.text_orig: ילהי רבנ ו רח רדל תז בת

scripture_data.text_id: (102-21) untuk mendengar keluhan orang tahanan, untuk membebaskan orang-orang yang ditentukan mati dibunuh,
scripture_data.text_en: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;
scripture_data.text_orig: יה שרל יממ הוהי דק רמ יקהי

scripture_data.text_id: (102-22) supaya nama TUHAN diceritakan di Sion, dan Dia dipuji-puji di Yerusalem,
scripture_data.text_en: To declare the name of the LORD in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;
scripture_data.text_orig: התמת ינ חפל ריס תקנ מל

scripture_data.text_id: (102-23) apabila berkumpul bersama-sama bangsa-bangsa dan kerajaan-kerajaan untuk beribadah kepada TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי תהת הוהי צ רסל

scripture_data.text_id: (102-24) Ia telah mematahkan kekuatanku di jalan, dan memperpendek umurku.
scripture_data.text_en: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהית דבל תכלממ וחי י שבה

scripture_data.text_id: (102-25) Aku berkata: "Ya Allahku, janganlah mengambil aku pada pertengahan umurku! Tahun-tahun-Mu tetap turun-temurun!"
scripture_data.text_en: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years [are] throughout all generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימי רק יח ח רב ה

scripture_data.text_id: (102-26) Dahulu sudah Kauletakkan dasar bumi, dan langit adalah buatan tangan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens [are] the work of thy hands.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתנ יר רד ימי יצח ינלל יל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: (102-27) Semuanya itu akan binasa, tetapi Engkau tetap ada, dan semuanya itu akan menjadi usang seperti pakaian, seperti jubah Engkau akan mengubah mereka, dan mereka berubah;
scripture_data.text_en: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ ידי המ דסי שרה ינפל

scripture_data.text_id: (102-28) tetapi Engkau tetap sama, dan tahun-tahun-Mu tidak berkesudahan.
scripture_data.text_en: But thou [art] the same, and thy years shall have no end.
scripture_data.text_orig: פלחיו פילח ב לבי דג כו דמת הו דבי הה

scripture_data.text_id: (102-29) Anak hamba-hamba-Mu akan diam dengan tenteram, dan anak cucu mereka akan tetap ada di hadapan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ל יתנ ההו

scripture_data.text_id: Dari Daud. Pujilah TUHAN, hai jiwaku! Pujilah nama-Nya yang kudus, hai segenap batinku!
scripture_data.text_en: <[A Psalm] of David.> Bless the LORD, O my soul: and all that is within me, [bless] his holy name.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק ת יברקלכו הוהית יפנ יכר דודל

scripture_data.text_id: Pujilah TUHAN, hai jiwaku, dan janganlah lupakan segala kebaikan-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:
scripture_data.text_orig: וילמל יחלו הוהית יפנ יכר

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang mengampuni segala kesalahanmu, yang menyembuhkan segala penyakitmu,
scripture_data.text_en: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;
scripture_data.text_orig: יכילחלכל פרה יכנולכל חלה

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang menebus hidupmu dari lobang kubur, yang memahkotai engkau dengan kasih setia dan rahmat,
scripture_data.text_en: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;
scripture_data.text_orig: ימחרו דסח יכרמה יכיח תחמ לה

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang memuaskan hasratmu dengan kebaikan, sehingga masa mudamu menjadi baru seperti pada burung rajawali.
scripture_data.text_en: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good [things; so that] thy youth is renewed like the eagle's.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכירן ר חת יד ב יה

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN menjalankan keadilan dan hukum bagi segala orang yang diperas.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.
scripture_data.text_orig: יקלכל ימ הוהי תקדץ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia telah memperkenalkan jalan-jalan-Nya kepada Musa, perbuatan-perbuatan-kepada orang Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתליל לרי ינבל המל ויכר ידי

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN adalah penyayang dan pengasih, panjang sabar dan berlimpah kasih setia.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy.
scripture_data.text_orig: דסחברו י ר הוהי חו חר

scripture_data.text_id: Tidak selalu Ia menuntut, dan tidak untuk selama-lamanya Ia mendendam.
scripture_data.text_en: He will not always chide: neither will he keep [his anger] for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי לל לו בירי חצנלל

scripture_data.text_id: Tidak dilakukan-Nya kepada kita setimpal dengan dosa kita, dan tidak dibalas-Nya kepada kita setimpal dengan kesalahan kita,
scripture_data.text_en: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניל למ ניתנוכ לו נל ה ניחכ ל

scripture_data.text_id: tetapi setinggi langit di atas bumi, demikian besarnya kasih setia-Nya atas orang-orang yang takut akan Dia;
scripture_data.text_en: For as the heaven is high above the earth, [so] great is his mercy toward them that fear him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויריל סח רב שרהל ימ בגכ י

scripture_data.text_id: sejauh timur dari barat, demikian dijauhkan-Nya dari pada kita pelanggaran kita.
scripture_data.text_en: As far as the east is from the west, [so] far hath he removed our transgressions from us.
scripture_data.text_orig: נית מ קיחרה ברמ חרזמ קחר

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti bapa sayang kepada anak-anaknya, demikian TUHAN sayang kepada orang-orang yang takut akan Dia.
scripture_data.text_en: Like as a father pitieth [his] children, [so] the LORD pitieth them that fear him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויריל הוהי חר ינל ב חר

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Dia sendiri tahu apa kita, Dia ingat, bahwa kita ini debu.
scripture_data.text_en: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we [are] dust.
scripture_data.text_orig: נחנ רפי רכז נרצי די הי

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun manusia, hari-harinya seperti rumput, seperti bunga di padang demikianlah ia berbunga;
scripture_data.text_en: [As for] man, his days [are] as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שיצי הדה שיצ וימי ריצח נ

scripture_data.text_id: apabila angin melintasinya, maka tidak ada lagi ia, dan tempatnya tidak mengenalnya lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.
scripture_data.text_orig: מקם ד ריילו ניו הרב חר י

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi kasih setia TUHAN dari selama-lamanya sampai selama-lamanya atas orang-orang yang takut akan Dia, dan keadilan-Nya bagi anak cucu,
scripture_data.text_en: But the mercy of the LORD [is] from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children's children;
scripture_data.text_orig: ינב ינבל תקדצו ויריל לדו למ הוהי דסחו

scripture_data.text_id: bagi orang-orang yang berpegang pada perjanjian-Nya dan yang ingat untuk melakukan titah-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.
scripture_data.text_orig: תל וידפ ירכזל תירב ירמל

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN sudah menegakkan takhta-Nya di sorga dan kerajaan-Nya berkuasa atas segala sesuatu.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלמ ל תכלמ ס יכה ימ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Pujilah TUHAN, hai malaikat-malaikat-Nya, hai pahlawan-pahlawan perkasa yang melaksanakan firman-Nya dengan mendengarkan suara firman-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Bless the LORD, ye his angels, that excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב לק מל רבד י חכ יר ויכלם הוהי כר

scripture_data.text_id: Pujilah TUHAN, hai segala tentara-Nya, hai pejabat-pejabat-Nya yang melakukan kehendak-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Bless ye the LORD, all [ye] his hosts; [ye] ministers of his, that do his pleasure.
scripture_data.text_orig: נצר י ויתרמ ויבצל הוהי כר

scripture_data.text_id: Pujilah TUHAN, hai segala buatan-Nya, di segala tempat kekuasaan-Nya! Pujilah TUHAN, hai jiwaku!
scripture_data.text_en: Bless the LORD, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the LORD, O my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהית יפנ יכר למם תמקמלכ וימל הוהי כר

scripture_data.text_id: Pujilah TUHAN, hai jiwaku! TUHAN, Allahku, Engkau sangat besar! Engkau yang berpakaian keagungan dan semarak,
scripture_data.text_en: Bless the LORD, O my soul. O LORD my God, thou art very great; thou art clothed with honour and majesty.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל רדהו דה ד לד יהל הוהי הוהית יפן יכר

scripture_data.text_id: yang berselimutkan terang seperti kain, yang membentangkan langit seperti tenda,
scripture_data.text_en: Who coverest [thyself] with light as [with] a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:
scripture_data.text_orig: הירי ימ הן המל רה

scripture_data.text_id: yang mendirikan kamar-kamar loteng-Mu di air, yang menjadikan awan-awan sebagai kendaraan-Mu, yang bergerak di atas sayap angin,
scripture_data.text_en: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:
scripture_data.text_orig: חריפנל המה בכר יבה ויתל יב הרקמה

scripture_data.text_id: yang membuat angin sebagai suruhan-suruhan-Mu, dan api yang menyala sebagai pelayan-pelayan-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:
scripture_data.text_orig: הל ויתרמ תחר ויכלם ה

scripture_data.text_id: yang telah mendasarkan bumi di atas tumpuannya, sehingga takkan goyang untuk seterusnya dan selamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: [Who] laid the foundations of the earth, [that] it should not be removed for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: דו ל ל הינכמל שרדסי

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan samudera raya Engkau telah menyelubunginya; air telah naik melampaui gunung-gunung.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou coveredst it with the deep as [with] a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימדמי ירהל תי ב ה

scripture_data.text_id: Terhadap hardik-Mu air itu melarikan diri, lari kebingungan terhadap suara guntur-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.
scripture_data.text_orig: זפחי מר לקמ סני תרמ

scripture_data.text_id: naik gunung, turun lembah ke tempat yang Kautetapkan bagi mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל דסי הז קמל תקב דרי ירה לי

scripture_data.text_id: Batas Kautentukan, takkan mereka lewati, takkan kembali mereka menyelubungi bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה תכל ביל רביל מלב

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau yang melepas mata-mata air ke dalam lembah-lembah, mengalir di antara gunung-gunung,
scripture_data.text_en: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, [which] run among the hills.
scripture_data.text_orig: כהי ירה י ילח ינימ חמה

scripture_data.text_id: memberi minum segala binatang di padang, memuaskan haus keledai-keledai hutan;
scripture_data.text_en: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.
scripture_data.text_orig: מץ ירף רי יד תיחל קי

scripture_data.text_id: di dekatnya diam burung-burung di udara, bersiul dari antara daun-daunan.
scripture_data.text_en: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, [which] sing among the branches.
scripture_data.text_orig: לקני יפ ימ י ימה היל

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau yang memberi minum gunung-gunung dari kamar-kamar loteng-Mu, bumi kenyang dari buah pekerjaan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה ימ ירמ ויתלמ ירה הקם

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau yang menumbuhkan rumput bagi hewan dan tumbuh-tumbuhan untuk diusahakan manusia, yang mengeluarkan makanan dari dalam tanah
scripture_data.text_en: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהמ חל יצהל דה תדבל בו המהל ריצח חימצם

scripture_data.text_id: dan anggur yang menyukakan hati manusia, yang membuat muka berseri karena minyak, dan makanan yang menyegarkan hati manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: And wine [that] maketh glad the heart of man, [and] oil to make [his] face to shine, and bread [which] strengtheneth man's heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: דסי נבבל חלו ממ ינ ליהצהל נבבל חי ייו

scripture_data.text_id: Kenyang pohon-pohon TUHAN, pohon-pohon aras di Libanon yang ditanam-Nya,
scripture_data.text_en: The trees of the LORD are full [of sap]; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;
scripture_data.text_orig: נ ר נבל יזר הוהי יצ י

scripture_data.text_id: di mana burung-burung bersarang, burung ranggung yang rumahnya di pohon-pohon sanobar;
scripture_data.text_en: Where the birds make their nests: [as for] the stork, the fir trees [are] her house.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי יר הדיסח נקי ירצ ר

scripture_data.text_id: gunung-gunung tinggi adalah bagi kambing-kambing hutan, bukit-bukit batu adalah tempat perlindungan bagi pelanduk.
scripture_data.text_en: The high hills [are] a refuge for the wild goats; [and] the rocks for the conies.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפל הסחם ילס ילל יהבה ירה

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau yang telah membuat bulan menjadi penentu waktu, matahari yang tahu akan saat terbenamnya.
scripture_data.text_en: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.
scripture_data.text_orig: בם די מ ידמל חרי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila Engkau mendatangkan gelap, maka haripun malamlah; ketika itulah bergerak segala binatang hutan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep [forth].
scripture_data.text_orig: ריתיחל מרת הליל יהיו חת

scripture_data.text_id: Singa-singa muda mengaum-aum akan mangsa, dan menuntut makanannya dari Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכ למ בל רל יג יריפה

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila matahari terbit, berkumpullah semuanya dan berbaring di tempat perteduhannya;
scripture_data.text_en: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.
scripture_data.text_orig: צרי תנמלו פסי מה חרז

scripture_data.text_id: manusiapun keluarlah ke pekerjaannya, dan ke usahanya sampai petang.
scripture_data.text_en: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.
scripture_data.text_orig: בריד תדבלו לפל ד צי

scripture_data.text_id: Betapa banyak perbuatan-Mu, ya TUHAN, sekaliannya Kaujadikan dengan kebijaksanaan, bumi penuh dengan ciptaan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD, how manifold are thy works! in wisdom hast thou made them all: the earth is full of thy riches.
scripture_data.text_orig: נינק שרה הלמ תי המכח הוהי ים רהמ

scripture_data.text_id: Lihatlah laut itu, besar dan luas wilayahnya, di situ bergerak, tidak terbilang banyaknya, binatang-binatang yang kecil dan besar.
scripture_data.text_en: [So is] this great and wide sea, wherein [are] things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.
scripture_data.text_orig: תלד תק תח רסמ יו מר ידי בחר לד ה הז

scripture_data.text_id: Di situ kapal-kapal berlayar dan Lewiatan yang telah Kaubentuk untuk bermain dengannya.
scripture_data.text_en: There go the ships: [there is] that leviathan, [whom] thou hast made to play therein.
scripture_data.text_orig: קחל רציהז תיול כהי תנ

scripture_data.text_id: Semuanya menantikan Engkau, supaya diberikan makanan pada waktunya.
scripture_data.text_en: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give [them] their meat in due season.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכ תתל רי יל

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila Engkau memberikannya, mereka memungutnya; apabila Engkau membuka tangan-Mu, mereka kenyang oleh kebaikan.
scripture_data.text_en: [That] thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב י די חפ קלי הל

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila Engkau menyembunyikan wajah-Mu, mereka terkejut; apabila Engkau mengambil roh mereka, mereka mati binasa dan kembali menjadi debu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי רפלו וגי חר ס להי ינ ריס

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila Engkau mengirim roh-Mu, mereka tercipta, dan Engkau membaharui muka bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou sendest forth thy spirit, they are created: and thou renewest the face of the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: המד ינ חת רי חר ח

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah kemuliaan TUHAN tetap untuk selama-lamanya, biarlah TUHAN bersukacita karena perbuatan-perbuatan-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: The glory of the LORD shall endure for ever: the LORD shall rejoice in his works.
scripture_data.text_orig: וימ הוהי חמי לל הוהי דבך יהי

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang memandang bumi sehingga bergentar, yang menyentuh gunung-gunung sehingga berasap.
scripture_data.text_en: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניו ירה י דרו שרל יה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku hendak menyanyi bagi TUHAN selama aku hidup, aku hendak bermazmur bagi Allahku selagi aku ada.
scripture_data.text_en: I will sing unto the LORD as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
scripture_data.text_orig: יד יהלל הרז יח הוהיל הרי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah renunganku manis kedengaran kepada-Nya! Aku hendak bersukacita karena TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי חמ יכנ יחי ויל ברי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah habis orang-orang berdosa dari bumi, dan biarlah orang-orang fasik tidak ada lagi! Pujilah TUHAN, hai jiwaku! Haleluya!
scripture_data.text_en: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the LORD, O my soul. Praise ye the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: יללה הוהית יפנ יכר ני ד יר שרהמ יח י

scripture_data.text_id: Bersyukurlah kepada TUHAN, serukanlah nama-Nya, perkenalkanlah perbuatan-Nya di antara bangsa-bangsa!
scripture_data.text_en: O give thanks unto the LORD; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתליל יב ידה מ רק הוהיל דה

scripture_data.text_id: Bernyanyilah bagi-Nya, bermazmurlah bagi-Nya, percakapkanlah segala perbuatan-Nya yang ajaib!
scripture_data.text_en: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתלפנלכ חי לרז לרי

scripture_data.text_id: Bermegahlah di dalam nama-Nya yang kudus, biarlah bersukahati orang-orang yang mencari TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יקבם בל חמי דק ללהתה

scripture_data.text_id: Carilah TUHAN dan kekuatan-Nya, carilah wajah-Nya selalu!
scripture_data.text_en: Seek the LORD, and his strength: seek his face evermore.
scripture_data.text_orig: דימ וינפ ו הוהי ר

scripture_data.text_id: Ingatlah perbuatan-perbuatan ajaib yang dilakukan-Nya, mujizat-mujizat-Ny dan penghukuman-penghukuman yang diucapkan-Nya,
scripture_data.text_en: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
scripture_data.text_orig: ויפימ ויתפמ הר ויתלפנ רכז

scripture_data.text_id: hai anak cucu Abraham, hamba-Nya, hai anak-anak Yakub, orang-orang pilihan-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויריח בקי ינ ב הרב רז

scripture_data.text_id: Dialah TUHAN, Allah kita, di seluruh bumi berlaku penghukuman-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: He [is] the LORD our God: his judgments [are] in all the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: וימ שרהלכ ניהל הוהי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia ingat untuk selama-lamanya akan perjanjian-Nya, firman yang diperintahkan-Nya kepada seribu angkatan,
scripture_data.text_en: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word [which] he commanded to a thousand generations.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר לל הצ רב תיר לל רכז

scripture_data.text_id: yang diikat-Nya dengan Abraham, dan akan sumpah-Nya kepada Ishak;
scripture_data.text_en: Which [covenant] he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;
scripture_data.text_orig: קחיל תב הרבת תר ר

scripture_data.text_id: diadakan-Nya hal itu menjadi ketetapan bagi Yakub, menjadi perjanjian kekal bagi Israel,
scripture_data.text_en: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, [and] to Israel [for] an everlasting covenant:
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תיר לריל קחל בקיל הדימו

scripture_data.text_id: firman-Nya: "Kepadamu akan Kuberikan tanah Kanaan, sebagai milik pusaka yang ditentukan bagimu."
scripture_data.text_en: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:
scripture_data.text_orig: כתלחן לבח נשרת ל רמל

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika jumlah mereka tidak seberapa, sedikit saja, dan mereka orang-orang asing di sana,
scripture_data.text_en: When they were [but] a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירגו מ רסמ יתם תיה

scripture_data.text_id: dan mengembara dari bangsa yang satu ke bangsa yang lain, dari kerajaan yang satu ke suku bangsa yang lain,
scripture_data.text_en: When they went from one nation to another, from [one] kingdom to another people;
scripture_data.text_orig: רח ל הכלממ יל ימ כהתו

scripture_data.text_id: Ia tidak membiarkan seorangpun memeras mereka, raja-raja dihukum-Nya oleh karena mereka:
scripture_data.text_en: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;
scripture_data.text_orig: יכלם היל חכו קל ד חיהל

scripture_data.text_id: "Jangan mengusik orang-orang yang Kuurapi, dan jangan berbuat jahat kepada nabi-nabi-Ku!"
scripture_data.text_en: [Saying], Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
scripture_data.text_orig: רל ייבנלו יחימב ל

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Ia mendatangkan kelaparan ke atas negeri itu, dan menghancurkan seluruh persediaan makanan,
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב חלהמל שרהל בר רקו

scripture_data.text_id: diutus-Nyalah seorang mendahului mereka: Yusuf, yang dijual menjadi budak.
scripture_data.text_en: He sent a man before them, [even] Joseph, [who] was sold for a servant:

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka mengimpit kakinya dengan belenggu, lehernya masuk ke dalam besi,

scripture_data.text_id: sampai saat firman-Nya sudah genap, dan janji TUHAN membenarkannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Until the time that his word came: the word of the LORD tried him.
scripture_data.text_orig: התפרץ הוהי תרמ רבד תד

scripture_data.text_id: Raja menyuruh melepaskannya, penguasa bangsa-bangsa membebaskannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The king sent and loosed him; [even] the ruler of the people, and let him go free.
scripture_data.text_orig: החפיו י למ הריו למ חל

scripture_data.text_id: Dijadikannya dia tuan atas istananya, dan kuasa atas segala harta kepunyaannya,
scripture_data.text_en: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:
scripture_data.text_orig: נינקלכ למ תיבל ד מ

scripture_data.text_id: untuk memberikan petunjuk kepada para pembesarnya sekehendak hatinya dan mengajarkan hikmat kepada para tua-tuanya.
scripture_data.text_en: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.
scripture_data.text_orig: חי וינקז פנ ויר רסל

scripture_data.text_id: Demikianlah Israel datang ke Mesir, dan Yakub tinggal sebagai orang asing di tanah Ham.
scripture_data.text_en: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.
scripture_data.text_orig: חשר ר בקיו ירצמ לרי בו

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN membuat umat-Nya sangat subur, dan menjadikannya lebih kuat dari pada para lawannya;
scripture_data.text_en: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: וירמ המצו דם ת רפו

scripture_data.text_id: diubah-Nya hati mereka untuk membenci umat-Nya, untuk memperdayakan hamba-hamba-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.
scripture_data.text_orig: וידב לנתהל נל ל פה

scripture_data.text_id: Diutus-Nya Musa, hamba-Nya, dan Harun yang telah dipilih-Nya;

scripture_data.text_orig: רח ר רה ב המ חל

scripture_data.text_id: keduanya mengadakan tanda-tanda-Nya di antara mereka, dan mujizat-mujizat di tanah Ham:

scripture_data.text_orig: ח שר יתפמ ויתת ירב במ

scripture_data.text_id: dikirim-Nya kegelapan, maka hari menjadi gelap, tetapi mereka memberontak terhadap firman-Nya;
scripture_data.text_en: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב וורבת רמלו חו ח חל

scripture_data.text_id: diubah-Nya air mereka menjadi darah, dan dimatikan-Nya ikan-ikan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.
scripture_data.text_orig: תגת תמו דל הימימת פה

scripture_data.text_id: Katak-katak berkeriapan di negeri mereka, bahkan di kamar-kamar raja mereka;
scripture_data.text_en: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.
scripture_data.text_orig: היכלם ירדח ירפץ צר שר

scripture_data.text_id: Ia berfirman, maka datanglah lalat pikat, dan nyamuk-nyamuk di seluruh daerah mereka;
scripture_data.text_en: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, [and] lice in all their coasts.
scripture_data.text_orig: לבלכ י בר בו רמ

scripture_data.text_id: dicurahkan-Nya hujan es ganti hujan mereka, dan api yang menyala-nyala di negeri mereka;
scripture_data.text_en: He gave them hail for rain, [and] flaming fire in their land.
scripture_data.text_orig: צר תבהל דר הימ תנ

scripture_data.text_id: dirubuhkan-Nya pohon anggur dan pohon ara mereka, dan ditumbangkan-Nya pohon di daerah mereka;
scripture_data.text_en: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.
scripture_data.text_orig: לב ש ריו תנת נפ ו

scripture_data.text_id: Ia berfirman, maka datanglah belalang dan belalang pelompat tidak terbilang banyaknya,
scripture_data.text_en: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,
scripture_data.text_orig: רסמ יו קליו הר בו רמ

scripture_data.text_id: yang memakan segala tumbuh-tumbuhan di negeri mereka, dan memakan hasil tanah mereka;
scripture_data.text_en: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמד יר לכו צר בל לכו

scripture_data.text_id: dibunuh-Nya semua anak sulung di negeri mereka, mula segala kegagahan mereka:
scripture_data.text_en: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלכל תיר צר רכל ו

scripture_data.text_id: Dituntun-Nya mereka keluar membawa perak dan emas, dan di antara suku-suku mereka tidak ada yang tergelincir.
scripture_data.text_en: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and [there was] not one feeble [person] among their tribes.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ויב יו בהזו סכ יצו

scripture_data.text_id: Orang Mesir bersukacita, ketika mereka keluar, sebab orang-orang Mesir itu ditimpa ketakutan terhadap mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.
scripture_data.text_orig: היל ח לפני תצ ירצמ חמ

scripture_data.text_id: Dibentangkan-Nya awan menjadi tudung, dan api untuk menerangi malam.
scripture_data.text_en: He spread a cloud for a covering; and fire to give light in the night.
scripture_data.text_orig: הליל ריהל ו סמל נ ר

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka meminta, maka didatangkan-Nya burung puyuh, dan dengan roti dari langit dikenyangkan-Nya mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: [The people] asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
scripture_data.text_orig: יי ימ חלו ול בו ל

scripture_data.text_id: Dibuka-Nya gunung batu, maka terpancarlah air, lalu mengalir di padang-padang kering seperti sungai;
scripture_data.text_en: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהנ ת כלה ימ בזו רצ חת

scripture_data.text_id: sebab Ia ingat akan firman-Nya yang kudus, akan Abraham, hamba-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: For he remembered his holy promise, [and] Abraham his servant.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב הרבת דק רבת רכזי

scripture_data.text_id: Dituntun-Nya umat-Nya keluar dengan kegirangan dan orang-orang pilihan-Nya dengan sorak-sorai.
scripture_data.text_en: And he brought forth his people with joy, [and] his chosen with gladness:

scripture_data.text_id: Diberikan-Nya kepada mereka negeri-negeri bangsa-bangsa, sehingga mereka memiliki hasil jerih payah suku-suku bangsa,
scripture_data.text_en: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;
scripture_data.text_orig: ריי יל למו י תצר הל ו

scripture_data.text_id: agar supaya mereka tetap mengikuti ketetapan-Nya, dan memegang segala pengajaran-Nya. Haleluya!
scripture_data.text_en: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: יללה רצני ויתרתו ויח רמי רב

scripture_data.text_id: Haleluya! Bersyukurlah kepada TUHAN, sebab Ia baik! Bahwasanya untuk selama-lamanya kasih setia-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for [he is] good: for his mercy [endureth] for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: סח לל י בי הוהיל דה יללה

scripture_data.text_id: Siapakah yang dapat memberitahukan keperkasaan TUHAN, memperdengarkan segala pujian kepada-Nya?
scripture_data.text_en: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? [who] can shew forth all his praise?

scripture_data.text_id: Berbahagialah orang-orang yang berpegang pada hukum, yang melakukan keadilan di segala waktu!
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed [are] they that keep judgment, [and] he that doeth righteousness at all times.
scripture_data.text_orig: תלכב הקדץ ה מ ירמ יר

scripture_data.text_id: Ingatlah aku, ya TUHAN, demi kemurahan terhadap umat-Mu, perhatikanlah aku, demi keselamatan dari pada-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour [that thou bearest unto] thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

scripture_data.text_id: supaya aku melihat kebaikan pada orang-orang pilihan-Mu, supaya aku bersukacita dalam sukacita umat-Mu, dan supaya aku bermegah bersama-sama milik-Mu sendiri.
scripture_data.text_en: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

scripture_data.text_id: Kami dan nenek moyang kami telah berbuat dosa, kami telah bersalah, telah berbuat fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.
scripture_data.text_orig: נרה ניוה ניתב נח

scripture_data.text_id: Nenek moyang kami di Mesir tidak mengerti perbuatan-perbuatan-Mu yang ajaib, tidak ingat besarnya kasih setia-Mu, tetapi mereka memberontak terhadap Yang Mahatinggi di tepi Laut Teberau.
scripture_data.text_en: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked [him] at the sea, [even] at the Red sea.

scripture_data.text_id: Namun diselamatkan-Nya mereka oleh karena nama-Nya, untuk memperkenalkan keperkasaan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Nevertheless he saved them for his name's sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרבת ידהל מ מל יו

scripture_data.text_id: Dihardik-Nya Laut Teberau, sehingga kering, dibawa-Nya mereka berjalan melalui samudera raya seperti melalui padang gurun.
scripture_data.text_en: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.
scripture_data.text_orig: רד תמה כילו ברחו סי רגו

scripture_data.text_id: Demikian diselamatkan-Nya mereka dari tangan pembenci, ditebus-Nya mereka dari tangan musuh;
scripture_data.text_en: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated [them], and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי דמ לגו נ דמ יו

scripture_data.text_id: air menutupi para lawan mereka, seorangpun dari pada mereka tiada tinggal.
scripture_data.text_en: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika itu percayalah mereka kepada segala firman-Nya, mereka menyanyikan puji-pujian kepada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi segera mereka melupakan perbuatan-perbuatan-Nya, dan tidak menantikan nasihat-Nya;
scripture_data.text_en: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

scripture_data.text_id: Diberikan-Nya kepada mereka apa yang mereka minta, dan didatangkan-Nya penyakit paru-paru di antara mereka.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka cemburu kepada Musa di perkemahan, dan kepada Harun, orang kudus TUHAN.
