scripture_data.text_id: tetapi orang miskin dibentengi-Nya terhadap penindasan, dan dibuat-Nya kaum-kaum mereka seperti kawanan domba banyaknya.
scripture_data.text_en: Yet setteth he the poor on high from affliction, and maketh [him] families like a flock.
scripture_data.text_orig: תחמ ו ינמ יב ביו

scripture_data.text_id: Orang-orang benar melihatnya, lalu bersukacita, tetapi segala kecurangan tutup mulut.
scripture_data.text_en: The righteous shall see [it], and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הי הצפק הלולכו חמיו ירי רי

scripture_data.text_id: Siapa yang mempunyai hikmat? Biarlah ia berpegang pada semuanya ini, dan memperhatikan segala kemurahan TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Whoso [is] wise, and will observe these [things], even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ידסח ננתיו הרמיו כחימ

scripture_data.text_id: Nyanyian. Mazmur Daud. (108-2) Hatiku siap, ya Allah, aku mau menyanyi, aku mau bermazmur. Bangunlah, hai jiwaku,
scripture_data.text_en: <A Song [or] Psalm of David.> O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.
scripture_data.text_orig: דודל רמזמ רי

scripture_data.text_id: (108-3) bangunlah, hai gambus dan kecapi, aku mau membangunkan fajar.
scripture_data.text_en: Awake, psaltery and harp: I [myself] will awake early.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידב הרזו הרי יהל יל כנ

scripture_data.text_id: (108-4) Aku mau bersyukur kepada-Mu di antara bangsa-bangsa, ya TUHAN, dan aku mau bermazmur bagi-Mu di antara suku-suku bangsa;
scripture_data.text_en: I will praise thee, O LORD, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
scripture_data.text_orig: רח הרי רכו לבה הר

scripture_data.text_id: (108-5) sebab kasih-Mu besar mengatasi langit, dan setia-Mu sampai ke awan-awan.
scripture_data.text_en: For thy mercy [is] great above the heavens: and thy truth [reacheth] unto the clouds.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל רזו הוהי יב ד

scripture_data.text_id: (108-6) Tinggikanlah diri-Mu mengatasi langit, ya Allah, dan biarlah kemuliaan-Mu mengatasi seluruh bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: and thy glory above all the earth;
scripture_data.text_orig: מ יקחדו סח ימלמ לדגי

scripture_data.text_id: (108-7) Supaya terluput orang-orang yang Kaucintai, selamatkanlah dengan tangan kanan-Mu dan jawablah aku!
scripture_data.text_en: That thy beloved may be delivered: save [with] thy right hand, and answer me.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב שרהל לו יהל ימל המר

scripture_data.text_id: (108-8) Allah telah berfirman di tempat kudus-Nya: "Aku hendak beria-ria, Aku hendak membagi-bagikan Sikhem, dan lembah Sukot hendak Kuukur.
scripture_data.text_en: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יננו נימי היה ידידי צלחי מל

scripture_data.text_id: (108-9) Gilead punya-Ku, Manasye punya-Ku, Efraim ialah pelindung kepala-Ku, Yehuda ialah tongkat kerajaan-Ku,
scripture_data.text_en: Gilead [is] mine; Manasseh [is] mine; Ephraim also [is] the strength of mine head; Judah [is] my lawgiver;
scripture_data.text_orig: דמ תס קמו כ הקח הזל דק ר יהל

scripture_data.text_id: (108-10) Moab ialah tempat pembasuhan-Ku, kepada Edom Aku melemparkan kasut-Ku, dan karena Filistea Aku bersorak-sorai."
scripture_data.text_en: Moab [is] my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.
scripture_data.text_orig: יקקחם הדהי יר זמ ירפו הנם יל דלג יל

scripture_data.text_id: (108-11) Siapakah yang akan membawa aku ke kota yang berkubu? Siapakah yang menuntun aku ke Edom?
scripture_data.text_en: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?
scripture_data.text_orig: רת תלפיל ילן יל דל יצחר ריס בם

scripture_data.text_id: (108-12) Bukankah Engkau, ya Allah, yang telah membuang kami, dan yang tidak maju, ya Allah, bersama-sama bala tentara kami?
scripture_data.text_en: [Wilt] not [thou], O God, [who] hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?
scripture_data.text_orig: דד ינחנ ימ רצבמ רי ינלבי ימ

scripture_data.text_id: (108-13) Berikanlah kepada kami pertolongan terhadap lawan, sebab sia-sia penyelamatan dari manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: Give us help from trouble: for vain [is] the help of man.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניתבצ יהל צתלו נחנז יהללה

scripture_data.text_id: (108-14) Dengan Allah akan kita lakukan perbuatan-perbuatan gagah perkasa, sebab Ia sendiri akan menginjak-injak para lawan kita.
scripture_data.text_en: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he [it is that] shall tread down our enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ת וו רמ תרז נהבה

scripture_data.text_id: Untuk pemimpin biduan. Mazmur Daud. Ya Allah pujianku, janganlah berdiam diri!
scripture_data.text_en: <To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David.> Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;
scripture_data.text_orig: רחל יתהת יהל רמזמ דודל חנמל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab mulut orang fasik dan mulut penipu ternganga terhadap aku, mereka berbicara terhadap aku dengan lidah dusta;
scripture_data.text_en: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק ל י ר חת יל המרמיפ ר יפ י

scripture_data.text_id: dengan kata-kata kebencian mereka menyerang aku dan memerangi aku tanpa alasan.
scripture_data.text_en: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.
scripture_data.text_orig: ח ינמחו ינבבס הנ ירבדו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebagai balasan terhadap kasihku mereka menuduh aku, sedang aku mendoakan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: For my love they are my adversaries: but I [give myself unto] prayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: הפת ינו ינני יתבהתח

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka membalas kejahatan kepadaku ganti kebaikan dan kebencian ganti kasihku.
scripture_data.text_en: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתבה תח הנו הב תח הר יל מיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Angkatlah seorang fasik atas dia, dan biarlah seorang pendakwa berdiri di sebelah kanannya;
scripture_data.text_en: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: נימיל דמי ו ר ויל דקפה

scripture_data.text_id: apabila dihakimi, biarlah ia keluar sebagai orang bersalah, dan biarlah doanya menjadi dosa.
scripture_data.text_en: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: החל היה תפת ר צי פה

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah umurnya berkurang, biarlah jabatannya diambil orang lain.
scripture_data.text_en: Let his days be few; [and] let another take his office.
scripture_data.text_orig: רח חי תק ים וימייהי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah anak-anaknya menjadi yatim, dan isterinya menjadi janda.
scripture_data.text_en: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנמל ו ימתי וינביהי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah anak-anaknya mengembara tidak keruan dan mengemis, dan dihalau dari reruntuhan rumahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek [their bread] also out of their desolate places.
scripture_data.text_orig: היתברחמ רדו לו וינב ני נו

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah penagih hutang menyita segala kepunyaannya, dan orang-orang lain menjarah hasil jerih payahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.
scripture_data.text_orig: יגי ירז ביו לרלכל הנ ני

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah ada orang yang tetap menunjukkan kasihnya kepadanya, dan janganlah ada orang yang sayang kepada anak-anaknya yang menjadi yatim.
scripture_data.text_en: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.
scripture_data.text_orig: וימתיל נח יהילו דסח מ ליהיל

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah dilenyapkan keturunannya, dan dihapuskan namanya dalam angkatan yang kemudian.
scripture_data.text_en: Let his posterity be cut off; [and] in the generation following let their name be blotted out.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ חי רח רד תירכהל תירחיהי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah kesalahan nenek moyangnya diingat-ingat di hadapan TUHAN, dan janganlah dihapuskan dosa ibunya.
scripture_data.text_en: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the LORD; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.
scripture_data.text_orig: חל תחו הוהיל ויתב ו רכי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah itu selalu diperhatikan TUHAN, supaya ingatan kepada mereka dilenyapkan dari bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכז שרמ תרכיו דימ הוהידגן יהי

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena ia tidak ingat menunjukkan kasih, tetapi mengejar orang sengsara dan miskin dan orang yang hancur hati sampai mereka mati.
scripture_data.text_en: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: תתמל בבל הכנו יבו יני רו דסח ת רכז ל ר י

scripture_data.text_id: Ia cinta kepada kutuk biarlah itu datang kepadanya; ia tidak suka kepada berkat biarlah itu menjauh dari padanya.
scripture_data.text_en: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ קחרו הכרב שפחלו הבו הללק בהו

scripture_data.text_id: Ia memakai kutuk sebagai bajunya biarlah itu merembes seperti air ke dalam dirinya, dan seperti minyak ke dalam tulang-tulangnya;
scripture_data.text_en: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתמצ מכו רק יך בו מ הללק לו

scripture_data.text_id: biarlah itu baginya seperti pakaian yang dikenakannya, sebagai ikat pinggang yang senantiasa dipakainya.
scripture_data.text_en: Let it be unto him as the garment [which] covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרחי דימ חזמל הי דגב ליה

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah semuanya itu dari pihak TUHAN menjadi upah orang yang mendakwa aku, dan upah orang-orang yang berkata-kata jahat terhadap aku."
scripture_data.text_en: [Let] this [be] the reward of mine adversaries from the LORD, and of them that speak evil against my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפנל ר ירבהו הוהי תמ ינ ת תז

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Engkau, ya ALLAH, Tuhanku, bertindaklah kepadaku oleh karena nama-Mu, lepaskanlah aku oleh sebab kasih setia-Mu yang baik!
scripture_data.text_en: But do thou for me, O GOD the Lord, for thy name's sake: because thy mercy [is] good, deliver thou me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינליה סח בי מ מל יה ינד הוהי הו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab sengsara dan miskin aku, dan hatiku terluka dalam diriku;
scripture_data.text_en: For I [am] poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירק ללח ילו יכנ יבו יני

scripture_data.text_id: aku menghilang seperti bayang-bayang pada waktu memanjang, aku dikebutkan seperti belalang.
scripture_data.text_en: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר ירננ יכלהן תנלצ

scripture_data.text_id: Lututku melentuk oleh sebab berpuasa, dan badanku menjadi kurus, habis lemaknya.
scripture_data.text_en: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ממ ח ירב מ ל יר

scripture_data.text_id: Aku telah menjadi cela bagi mereka; melihat aku, mereka menggelengkan kepalanya.
scripture_data.text_en: I became also a reproach unto them: [when] they looked upon me they shaked their heads.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר יני ינרי הל הרח יתייה ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Tolonglah aku, ya TUHAN, Allahku, selamatkanlah aku sesuai dengan kasih setia-Mu,
scripture_data.text_en: Help me, O LORD my God: O save me according to thy mercy:
scripture_data.text_orig: סחך יניה יהל הוהי ינרז

scripture_data.text_id: supaya mereka tahu, bahwa tangan-Mulah ini, bahwa Engkaulah, ya TUHAN, yang telah melakukannya.
scripture_data.text_en: That they may know that this [is] thy hand; [that] thou, LORD, hast done it.
scripture_data.text_orig: תי הוהי ה ת דיי דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Biar mereka mengutuk, Engkau akan memberkati; biarlah lawan-lawanku mendapat malu, tetapi hamba-Mu ini kiranya bersukacita.
scripture_data.text_en: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.
scripture_data.text_orig: חמי בו בו מק רבת הו ההללקי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah orang-orang yang mendakwa aku berpakaikan noda, dan berselimutkan malunya sebagai jubah.
scripture_data.text_en: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.
scripture_data.text_orig: לימך יו הל ינ לי

scripture_data.text_id: Aku hendak bersyukur sangat kepada TUHAN dengan mulutku, dan aku hendak memuji-muji Dia di tengah-tengah orang banyak.
scripture_data.text_en: I will greatly praise the LORD with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.
scripture_data.text_orig: ללה יר תב יפ דם הוהי הד

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Ia berdiri di sebelah kanan orang miskin untuk menyelamatkannya dari orang-orang yang menghukumnya.
scripture_data.text_en: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save [him] from those that condemn his soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: פן יפמ יהל יב ימיל דמיי

scripture_data.text_id: Mazmur Daud. Demikianlah firman TUHAN kepada tuanku: "Duduklah di sebelah kanan-Ku, sampai Kubuat musuh-musuhmu menjadi tumpuan kakimu."
scripture_data.text_en: <A Psalm of David.> The LORD said unto my Lord, Sit thou at my right hand, until I make thine enemies thy footstool.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילגרל דה יבי תיד ינימיל ב ינדל הוהי ן רמזמ דודל

scripture_data.text_id: Tongkat kekuatanmu akan diulurkan TUHAN dari Sion: memerintahlah di antara musuhmu!
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבי ברק הדר מ הוהי חלי הם

scripture_data.text_id: Pada hari tentaramu bangsamu merelakan diri untuk maju dengan berhiaskan kekudusan; dari kandungan fajar tampil bagimu keremajaanmu seperti embun.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy people [shall be] willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתדלי ל ל רחמ חרמ דקירדה ליח י תבדן

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN telah bersumpah, dan Ia tidak akan menyesal: "Engkau adalah imam untuk selama-lamanya, menurut Melkisedek."
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath sworn, and will not repent, Thou [art] a priest for ever after the order of Melchizedek.
scripture_data.text_orig: קדצילם יתרבל לל הכה חי לו הוהי נ

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN ada di sebelah kananmu; Ia meremukkan raja-raja pada hari murka-Nya,
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord at thy right hand shall strike through kings in the day of his wrath.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכלם י שחמ נימיל ינד

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menghukum bangsa-bangsa, sehingga mayat-mayat bergelimpangan; Ia meremukkan orang-orang yang menjadi kepala di negeri luas.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill [the places] with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר שרל ר שחמ תוג למ י ידי

scripture_data.text_id: Dari sungai di tepi jalan ia minum, oleh sebab itu ia mengangkat kepala.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר ירי ל הי ר לחמ

scripture_data.text_id: Haleluya! Aku mau bersyukur kepada TUHAN dengan segenap hati, dalam lingkungan orang-orang benar dan dalam jemaah.
scripture_data.text_en: Praise ye the LORD. I will praise the LORD with [my] whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and [in] the congregation.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדו ירי דס בבללכ הוהי הד י ללה

scripture_data.text_id: Besar perbuatan-perbuatan TUHAN, layak diselidiki oleh semua orang yang menyukainya.
scripture_data.text_en: The works of the LORD [are] great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.
scripture_data.text_orig: היצפחלכל יר הוהי ים ילד

scripture_data.text_id: Agung dan bersemarak pekerjaan-Nya, dan keadilan-Nya tetap untuk selamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: His work [is] honourable and glorious: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: דל תדמ תקדצו ל רדהודה

scripture_data.text_id: Perbuatan-perbuatan-Nya yang ajaib dijadikan-Nya peringatan; TUHAN itu pengasih dan penyayang.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the LORD [is] gracious and full of compassion.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי חרו ח ויתלפנל ה רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Diberikan-Nya rezeki kepada orang-orang yang takut akan Dia. Ia ingat untuk selama-lamanya akan perjanjian-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיר לל רזי ויריל תנ ר

scripture_data.text_id: Kekuatan perbuatan-Nya diberitakan-Nya kepada umat-Nya, dengan memberikan kepada mereka milik pusaka bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.
scripture_data.text_orig: י תלחן הל תתל ל דיה וימ ח

scripture_data.text_id: Perbuatan tangan-Nya ialah kebenaran dan keadilan, segala titah-Nya teguh,
scripture_data.text_en: The works of his hands [are] verity and judgment; all his commandments [are] sure.
scripture_data.text_orig: וידל ינמנ מ תמ וידי ים

scripture_data.text_id: kokoh untuk seterusnya dan selamanya, dilakukan dalam kebenaran dan kejujuran.
scripture_data.text_en: They stand fast for ever and ever, [and are] done in truth and uprightness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ריו תמ י לל דל יכמס

scripture_data.text_id: Dikirim-Nya kebebasan kepada umat-Nya, diperintahkan-Nya supaya perjanjian-Nya itu untuk selama-lamanya; nama-Nya kudus dan dahsyat.
scripture_data.text_en: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend [is] his name.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ רנו דק תיר ללהצ ל חל תד

scripture_data.text_id: Permulaan hikmat adalah takut akan TUHAN, semua orang yang melakukannya berakal budi yang baik. Puji-pujian kepada-Nya tetap untuk selamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: The fear of the LORD [is] the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do [his commandments]: his praise endureth for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: דל תדמ תה הילכל ב לכ הוהי תרי המכח תיר

scripture_data.text_id: Haleluya! Berbahagialah orang yang takut akan TUHAN, yang sangat suka kepada segala perintah-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Praise ye the LORD. Blessed [is] the man [that] feareth the LORD, [that] delighteth greatly in his commandments.
scripture_data.text_orig: דם שפח ויתוצמ הוהית רי ייר י ללה

scripture_data.text_id: Anak cucunya akan perkasa di bumi; angkatan orang benar akan diberkati.
scripture_data.text_en: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: the generation of the upright shall be blessed.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבי ירי ר רז היהי שר ר

scripture_data.text_id: Harta dan kekayaan ada dalam rumahnya, kebajikannya tetap untuk selamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Wealth and riches [shall be] in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: דל תדמ תקדצו תיב רוה

scripture_data.text_id: Di dalam gelap terbit terang bagi orang benar; pengasih dan penyayang orang yang adil.
scripture_data.text_en: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: [he is] gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיצו חרו ח יריל ר ח חרז

scripture_data.text_id: Mujur orang yang menaruh belas kasihan dan yang memberi pinjaman, yang melakukan urusannya dengan sewajarnya.
scripture_data.text_en: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ וירב ללכי הולמ נח יב

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab ia takkan goyah untuk selama-lamanya; orang benar itu akan diingat selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.
scripture_data.text_orig: קיץ היהי ל רכזל יל ללי

scripture_data.text_id: Ia tidak takut kepada kabar celaka, hatinya tetap, penuh kepercayaan kepada TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ח ל כנ ריי ל הר הממ

scripture_data.text_id: Hatinya teguh, ia tidak takut, sehingga ia memandang rendah para lawannya.
scripture_data.text_en: His heart [is] established, he shall not be afraid, until he see [his desire] upon his enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: וירצב הריר ד ריי ל ל מס

scripture_data.text_id: Ia membagi-bagikan, ia memberikan kepada orang miskin; kebajikannya tetap untuk selama-lamanya, tanduknya meninggi dalam kemuliaan.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath dispersed, he hath given to the poor; his righteousness endureth for ever; his horn shall be exalted with honour.
scripture_data.text_orig: דבכ ר נרק דל תדמ תקדצ יניבל תנ ר

scripture_data.text_id: Orang fasik melihatnya, lalu sakit hati, ia menggertakkan giginya, lalu hancur; keinginan orang fasik akan menuju kebinasaan.
scripture_data.text_en: The wicked shall see [it], and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב יר תו סמנו קרחי וי סכו הרי ר

scripture_data.text_id: Haleluya! Pujilah, hai hamba-hamba TUHAN, pujilah nama TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Praise ye the LORD. Praise, O ye servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ת ללה הוהי ידב ללה י ללה

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya nama TUHAN dimasyhurkan, sekarang ini dan selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Blessed be the name of the LORD from this time forth and for evermore.
scripture_data.text_orig: לדו המ רבם הוהי יהי

scripture_data.text_id: Dari terbitnya sampai kepada terbenamnya matahari terpujilah nama TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name [is] to be praised.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי להמ במד מחרזמ

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN tinggi mengatasi segala bangsa, kemuliaan-Nya mengatasi langit.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] high above all nations, [and] his glory above the heavens.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב ימה ל הוהי ילל ר

scripture_data.text_id: Siapakah seperti TUHAN, Allah kita, yang diam di tempat yang tinggi,
scripture_data.text_en: Who [is] like unto the LORD our God, who dwelleth on high,
scripture_data.text_orig: תבל יהיגה ניהל הוהי ימ

scripture_data.text_id: yang merendahkan diri untuk melihat ke langit dan ke bumi?
scripture_data.text_en: Who humbleth [himself] to behold [the things that are] in heaven, and in the earth!
scripture_data.text_orig: שרב ימ תרל יליה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menegakkan orang yang hina dari dalam debu dan mengangkat orang yang miskin dari lumpur,
scripture_data.text_en: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, [and] lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;
scripture_data.text_orig: יב ירי תמ ל רפמ ימיקם

scripture_data.text_id: untuk mendudukkan dia bersama-sama dengan para bangsawan, bersama-sama dengan para bangsawan bangsanya.
scripture_data.text_en: That he may set [him] with princes, [even] with the princes of his people.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבידן יבידנ יביהל

scripture_data.text_id: Ia mendudukkan perempuan yang mandul di rumah sebagai ibu anak-anak, penuh sukacita. Haleluya!
scripture_data.text_en: He maketh the barren woman to keep house, [and to be] a joyful mother of children. Praise ye the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: יללה החמ ינה תיה תרק יבים

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu Israel keluar dari Mesir, kaum keturunan Yakub dari bangsa yang asing bahasanya,

scripture_data.text_id: Laut melihatnya, lalu melarikan diri, sungai Yordan berbalik ke hulu.

scripture_data.text_id: Gunung-gunung melompat-lompat seperti domba jantan, dan bukit-bukit seperti anak domba.

scripture_data.text_id: Ada apa, hai laut, sehingga engkau melarikan diri, hai sungai Yordan, sehingga engkau berbalik ke hulu,
scripture_data.text_en: What [ailed] thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, [that] thou wast driven back?
scripture_data.text_orig: רחל ב רה סנת י ה הם

scripture_data.text_id: hai gunung-gunung, sehingga kamu melompat-lompat seperti domba jantan, hai bukit-bukit, sehingga kamu seperti anak domba?
scripture_data.text_en: Ye mountains, [that] ye skipped like rams; [and] ye little hills, like lambs?
scripture_data.text_orig: צינב תב יליך דקר ירהה

scripture_data.text_id: Gemetarlah, hai bumi, di hadapan TUHAN, di hadapan Allah Yakub,

scripture_data.text_orig: בקי ל ינפמ שר ילח ד ינפמ

scripture_data.text_id: yang mengubah gunung batu menjadi kolam air, dan batu yang keras menjadi mata air!
scripture_data.text_en: Which turned the rock [into] a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימנימל ימח ימג רה יכפהה

scripture_data.text_id: Bukan kepada kami, ya TUHAN, bukan kepada kami, tetapi kepada nama-Mulah beri kemuliaan, oleh karena kasih-Mu, oleh karena setia-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: Not unto us, O LORD, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, [and] for thy truth's sake.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל סחל דב מלי נל ל הוהי נל ל

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa bangsa-bangsa akan berkata: "Di mana Allah mereka?"
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where [is] now their God?
scripture_data.text_orig: היהל נה יה רמי הל

scripture_data.text_id: Allah kita di sorga; Ia melakukan apa yang dikehendaki-Nya!
scripture_data.text_en: But our God [is] in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה שפחר ל ימב ניהלו

scripture_data.text_id: Berhala-berhala mereka adalah perak dan emas, buatan tangan manusia,
scripture_data.text_en: Their idols [are] silver and gold, the work of men's hands.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ידי המ בהזו ס היצ

scripture_data.text_id: mempunyai mulut, tetapi tidak dapat berkata-kata, mempunyai mata, tetapi tidak dapat melihat,
scripture_data.text_en: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:
scripture_data.text_orig: רי לו הל יני רדי לו הלה

scripture_data.text_id: mempunyai telinga, tetapi tidak dapat mendengar, mempunyai hidung, tetapi tidak dapat mencium,
scripture_data.text_en: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:
scripture_data.text_orig: חירי לו הל מי לו הל ינז

scripture_data.text_id: mempunyai tangan, tetapi tidak dapat meraba-raba, mempunyai kaki, tetapi tidak dapat berjalan, dan tidak dapat memberi suara dengan kerongkongannya.
scripture_data.text_en: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.
scripture_data.text_orig: נרג היל כהי לו הילגר ימי לו הידי

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti itulah jadinya orang-orang yang membuatnya, dan semua orang yang percaya kepadanya.
scripture_data.text_en: They that make them are like unto them; [so is] every one that trusteth in them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה חר ל הי יהי המ

scripture_data.text_id: Hai Israel, percayalah kepada TUHAN! Dialah pertolongan mereka dan perisai mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: O Israel, trust thou in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה גמ רז הוהי ח לרי

scripture_data.text_id: Hai kaum Harun, percayalah kepada TUHAN! Dialah pertolongan mereka dan perisai mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה גמ רז הוהיב ח רה תי

scripture_data.text_id: Hai orang-orang yang takut akan TUHAN, percayalah kepada TUHAN! Dialah pertolongan mereka dan perisai mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Ye that fear the LORD, trust in the LORD: he [is] their help and their shield.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה גמ רז הוהיב ח הוהי ירי

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN telah mengingat kita; Ia akan memberkati, memberkati kaum Israel, memberkati kaum Harun,
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath been mindful of us: he will bless [us]; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

scripture_data.text_id: memberkati orang-orang yang takut akan TUHAN, baik yang kecil maupun yang besar.
scripture_data.text_en: He will bless them that fear the LORD, [both] small and great.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילדה יה הוהי ירי רבי

scripture_data.text_id: Kiranya TUHAN memberi pertambahan kepada kamu, kepada kamu dan kepada anak-anakmu.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD shall increase you more and more, you and your children.
scripture_data.text_orig: כינלו כיל כיל הוהי סי

scripture_data.text_id: Diberkatilah kamu oleh TUHAN, yang menjadikan langit dan bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: Ye [are] blessed of the LORD which made heaven and earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרו ימ ה הוהיל יכר

scripture_data.text_id: Langit itu langit kepunyaan TUHAN, dan bumi itu telah diberikan-Nya kepada anak-anak manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: The heaven, [even] the heavens, [are] the LORD'S: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.
scripture_data.text_orig: דינבל תנ שרהו הוהיל ימ ימה

scripture_data.text_id: Bukan orang-orang mati akan memuji-muji TUHAN, dan bukan semua orang yang turun ke tempat sunyi,

scripture_data.text_orig: המד ידריל לו יללהי יתה ל

scripture_data.text_id: tetapi kita, kita akan memuji TUHAN, sekarang ini dan sampai selama-lamanya. Haleluya!
scripture_data.text_en: But we will bless the LORD from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: יללה לדו המ י רבן נחנו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku mengasihi TUHAN, sebab Ia mendengarkan suaraku dan permohonanku.
scripture_data.text_en: I love the LORD, because he hath heard my voice [and] my supplications.
scripture_data.text_orig: יננח ילקת הוהי מיי יבה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Ia menyendengkan telinga-Nya kepadaku, maka seumur hidupku aku akan berseru kepada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me, therefore will I call upon [him] as long as I live.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק ימיב יל נז ההי

scripture_data.text_id: Tali-tali maut telah meliliti aku, dan kegentaran terhadap dunia orang mati menimpa aku, aku mengalami kesesakan dan kedukaan.
scripture_data.text_en: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.
scripture_data.text_orig: צמ גיו הרצ ינצם ל ירצמ תומילבח ינפפ

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi aku menyerukan nama TUHAN: "Ya TUHAN, luputkanlah kiranya aku!"
scripture_data.text_en: Then called I upon the name of the LORD; O LORD, I beseech thee, deliver my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן הם הוהי ה רק הוהיב

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN adalah pengasih dan adil, Allah kita penyayang.
scripture_data.text_en: Gracious [is] the LORD, and righteous; yea, our God [is] merciful.
scripture_data.text_orig: חרם ניהלו קיצו הוהי ח

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN memelihara orang-orang sederhana; aku sudah lemah, tetapi diselamatkan-Nya aku.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהי ילו ית הוהי ית רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Kembalilah tenang, hai jiwaku, sebab TUHAN telah berbuat baik kepadamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the LORD hath dealt bountifully with thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: יכיל למ הוהיי יכיחנמל יפנ יב

scripture_data.text_id: Ya, Engkau telah meluputkan aku dari pada maut, dan mataku dari pada air mata, dan kakiku dari pada tersandung.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, [and] my feet from falling.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחמ ילגרת הממ ינית תומ יפן צח י

scripture_data.text_id: Aku boleh berjalan di hadapan TUHAN, di negeri orang-orang hidup.
scripture_data.text_en: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחה תצר הוהי ינפל הת

scripture_data.text_id: Aku percaya, sekalipun aku berkata: "Aku ini sangat tertindas."
scripture_data.text_en: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:
scripture_data.text_orig: דם יתינ ינ רד י ינמה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku ini berkata dalam kebingunganku: "Semua manusia pembohong."
scripture_data.text_en: I said in my haste, All men [are] liars.
scripture_data.text_orig: בז דהל יזפחב ירמ ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Bagaimana akan kubalas kepada TUHAN segala kebajikan-Nya kepadaku?
scripture_data.text_en: What shall I render unto the LORD [for] all his benefits toward me?
scripture_data.text_orig: יל יהלמגל הוהיל ביהמ

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mengangkat piala keselamatan, dan akan menyerukan nama TUHAN,
scripture_data.text_en: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: רק הוהי ב תיס

scripture_data.text_id: akan membayar nazarku kepada TUHAN di depan seluruh umat-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: I will pay my vows unto the LORD now in the presence of all his people.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכל הדגן הוהיל ירדנ

scripture_data.text_id: Berharga di mata TUHAN kematian semua orang yang dikasihi-Nya.
