scripture_data.text_id: Dan aku menemukan sesuatu yang lebih pahit dari pada maut: perempuan yang adalah jala, yang hatinya adalah jerat dan tangannya adalah belenggu. Orang yang dikenan Allah terhindar dari padanya, tetapi orang yang berdosa ditangkapnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And I find more bitter than death the woman, whose heart [is] snares and nets, [and] her hands [as] bands: whoso pleaseth God shall escape from her; but the sinner shall be taken by her.

scripture_data.text_en: Which yet my soul seeketh, but I find not: one man among a thousand have I found; but a woman among all those have I not found.

scripture_data.text_id: Siapakah seperti orang berhikmat? Dan siapakah yang mengetahui keterangan setiap perkara? Hikmat manusia menjadikan wajahnya bercahaya dan berubahlah kekerasan wajahnya.

scripture_data.text_en: Be not hasty to go out of his sight: stand not in an evil thing; for he doeth whatsoever pleaseth him.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, ia tak mengetahui apa yang akan terjadi, karena siapakah yang akan mengatakan kepadanya bagaimana itu akan terjadi?

scripture_data.text_id: Tiada seorangpun berkuasa menahan angin dan tiada seorangpun berkuasa atas hari kematian. Tak ada istirahat dalam peperangan, dan kefasikan tidak melepaskan orang yang melakukannya.
scripture_data.text_en: [There is] no man that hath power over the spirit to retain the spirit; neither [hath he] power in the day of death: and [there is] no discharge in [that] war; neither shall wickedness deliver those that are given to it.
scripture_data.text_orig: וילת ר מילו המחל תחלמ יו תוה י ל יו חרהת לכל חר י ד י

scripture_data.text_id: Semua ini telah kulihat dan aku memberi perhatian kepada segala perbuatan yang dilakukan di bawah matahari, ketika orang yang satu menguasai orang yang lain hingga ia celaka.
scripture_data.text_en: All this have I seen, and applied my heart unto every work that is done under the sun: [there is] a time wherein one man ruleth over another to his own hurt.

scripture_data.text_id: Aku melihat juga orang-orang fasik yang akan dikuburkan boleh masuk, sedangkan orang yang berlaku benar harus pergi dari tempat yang kudus dan dilupakan dalam kota. Inipun sia-sia.
scripture_data.text_en: And so I saw the wicked buried, who had come and gone from the place of the holy, and they were forgotten in the city where they had so done: this [is] also vanity.

scripture_data.text_en: Because sentence against an evil work is not executed speedily, therefore the heart of the sons of men is fully set in them to do evil.

scripture_data.text_id: Walaupun orang yang berdosa dan yang berbuat jahat seratus kali hidup lama, namun aku tahu, bahwa orang yang takut akan Allah akan beroleh kebahagiaan, sebab mereka takut terhadap hadirat-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Though a sinner do evil an hundred times, and his [days] be prolonged, yet surely I know that it shall be well with them that fear God, which fear before him:

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi orang yang fasik tidak akan beroleh kebahagiaan dan seperti bayang-bayang ia tidak akan panjang umur, karena ia tidak takut terhadap hadirat Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: But it shall not be well with the wicked, neither shall he prolong [his] days, [which are] as a shadow; because he feareth not before God.

scripture_data.text_id: Ada suatu kesia-siaan yang terjadi di atas bumi: ada orang-orang benar, yang menerima ganjaran yang layak untuk perbuatan orang fasik, dan ada orang-orang fasik yang menerima pahala yang layak untuk perbuatan orang benar. Aku berkata: "Inipun sia-sia!"
scripture_data.text_en: There is a vanity which is done upon the earth; that there be just [men], unto whom it happeneth according to the work of the wicked; again, there be wicked [men], to whom it happeneth according to the work of the righteous: I said that this also [is] vanity.

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu aku memuji kesukaan, karena tak ada kebahagiaan lain bagi manusia di bawah matahari, kecuali makan dan minum dan bersukaria. Itu yang menyertainya di dalam jerih payahnya seumur hidupnya yang diberikan Allah kepadanya di bawah matahari.
scripture_data.text_en: Then I commended mirth, because a man hath no better thing under the sun, than to eat, and to drink, and to be merry: for that shall abide with him of his labour the days of his life, which God giveth him under the sun.

scripture_data.text_en: Then I beheld all the work of God, that a man cannot find out the work that is done under the sun: because though a man labour to seek [it] out, yet he shall not find [it]; yea further; though a wise [man] think to know [it], yet shall he not be able to find [it].

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, semua ini telah kuperhatikan, semua ini telah kuperiksa, yakni bahwa orang-orang yang benar dan orang-orang yang berhikmat dan perbuatan-perbuatan mereka, baik kasih maupun kebencian, ada di tangan Allah; manusia tidak mengetahui apapun yang dihadapinya.
scripture_data.text_en: For all this I considered in my heart even to declare all this, that the righteous, and the wise, and their works, [are] in the hand of God: no man knoweth either love or hatred [by] all [that is] before them.

scripture_data.text_id: Segala sesuatu sama bagi sekalian; nasib orang sama: baik orang yang benar maupun orang yang fasik, orang yang baik maupun orang yang jahat, orang yang tahir maupun orang yang najis, orang yang mempersembahkan korban maupun yang tidak mempersembahkan korban. Sebagaimana orang yang baik, begitu pula orang yang berdosa; sebagaimana orang yang bersumpah, begitu pula orang yang takut untuk bersumpah.
scripture_data.text_en: All [things come] alike to all: [there is] one event to the righteous, and to the wicked; to the good and to the clean, and to the unclean; to him that sacrificeth, and to him that sacrificeth not: as [is] the good, so [is] the sinner; [and] he that sweareth, as [he] that feareth an oath.

scripture_data.text_id: Inilah yang celaka dalam segala sesuatu yang terjadi di bawah matahari; nasib semua orang sama. Hati anak-anak manusiapun penuh dengan kejahatan, dan kebebalan ada dalam hati mereka seumur hidup, dan kemudian mereka menuju alam orang mati.
scripture_data.text_en: This [is] an evil among all [things] that are done under the sun, that [there is] one event unto all: yea, also the heart of the sons of men is full of evil, and madness [is] in their heart while they live, and after that [they go] to the dead.

scripture_data.text_id: Karena orang-orang yang hidup tahu bahwa mereka akan mati, tetapi orang yang mati tak tahu apa-apa, tak ada upah lagi bagi mereka, bahkan kenangan kepada mereka sudah lenyap.
scripture_data.text_en: For the living know that they shall die: but the dead know not any thing, neither have they any more a reward; for the memory of them is forgotten.

scripture_data.text_id: Baik kasih mereka, maupun kebencian dan kecemburuan mereka sudah lama hilang, dan untuk selama-lamanya tak ada lagi bahagian mereka dalam segala sesuatu yang terjadi di bawah matahari.
scripture_data.text_en: Also their love, and their hatred, and their envy, is now perished; neither have they any more a portion for ever in any [thing] that is done under the sun.

scripture_data.text_en: Live joyfully with the wife whom thou lovest all the days of the life of thy vanity, which he hath given thee under the sun, all the days of thy vanity: for that [is] thy portion in [this] life, and in thy labour which thou takest under the sun.
scripture_data.text_orig: מה תח למ הר למב יח קלח ה י לבה ימי ל מה תח לתנ ר לבה יח ימיל בהר ה יח הר

scripture_data.text_id: Segala sesuatu yang dijumpai tanganmu untuk dikerjakan, kerjakanlah itu sekuat tenaga, karena tak ada pekerjaan, pertimbangan, pengetahuan dan hikmat dalam dunia orang mati, ke mana engkau akan pergi.
scripture_data.text_en: Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do [it] with thy might; for [there is] no work, nor device, nor knowledge, nor wisdom, in the grave, whither thou goest.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ה לה ה ר ל המכחו תדו חו הם י י ה חכ תל די צמ ר ל

scripture_data.text_id: Lagi aku melihat di bawah matahari bahwa kemenangan perlombaan bukan untuk yang cepat, dan keunggulan perjuangan bukan untuk yang kuat, juga roti bukan untuk yang berhikmat, kekayaan bukan untuk yang cerdas, dan karunia bukan untuk yang cerdik cendekia, karena waktu dan nasib dialami mereka semua.
scripture_data.text_en: I returned, and saw under the sun, that the race [is] not to the swift, nor the battle to the strong, neither yet bread to the wise, nor yet riches to men of understanding, nor yet favour to men of skill; but time and chance happeneth to them all.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת הרקי גפו תי ח ידל ל גו ר ינבל ל גו חל ימכחל ל גו המחלה ירל לו שרה יל ל י מהתחת הרו יב

scripture_data.text_id: Karena manusia tidak mengetahui waktunya. Seperti ikan yang tertangkap dalam jala yang mencelakakan, dan seperti burung yang tertangkap dalam jerat, begitulah anak-anak manusia terjerat pada waktu yang malang, kalau hal itu menimpa mereka secara tiba-tiba.
scripture_data.text_en: For man also knoweth not his time: as the fishes that are taken in an evil net, and as the birds that are caught in the snare; so [are] the sons of men snared in an evil time, when it falleth suddenly upon them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת היל ל הר תל דה ינ יקי ה ח תזחה ירכו הר הדצמ יזח יג ת דה דיל י

scripture_data.text_id: Hal ini juga kupandang sebagai hikmat di bawah matahari dan nampaknya besar bagiku;

scripture_data.text_en: [There was] a little city, and few men within it; and there came a great king against it, and besieged it, and built great bulwarks against it:

scripture_data.text_en: Now there was found in it a poor wise man, and he by his wisdom delivered the city; yet no man remembered that same poor man.

scripture_data.text_id: Kataku: "Hikmat lebih baik dari pada keperkasaan, tetapi hikmat orang miskin dihina dan perkataannya tidak didengar orang."
scripture_data.text_en: Then said I, Wisdom [is] better than strength: nevertheless the poor man's wisdom [is] despised, and his words are not heard.

scripture_data.text_id: Perkataan orang berhikmat yang didengar dengan tenang, lebih baik dari pada teriakan orang yang berkuasa di antara orang bodoh.
scripture_data.text_en: The words of wise [men are] heard in quiet more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools.
scripture_data.text_orig: יליס לם תקמ ימנ תחנ ימכח ירב

scripture_data.text_id: Moleklah pipimu di tengah perhiasan-perhiasan dan lehermu di tengah kalung-kalung.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy cheeks are comely with rows [of jewels], thy neck with chains [of gold].
scripture_data.text_orig: יזרח רץ יר ייחל ונ

scripture_data.text_id: Kami akan membuat bagimu perhiasan-perhiasan emas dengan manik-manik perak.
scripture_data.text_en: We will make thee borders of gold with studs of silver.
scripture_data.text_orig: סה תקן הן בהז יר

scripture_data.text_id: Sementara sang raja duduk pada mejanya, semerbak bau narwastuku.
scripture_data.text_en: While the king [sitteth] at his table, my spikenard sendeth forth the smell thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: חיר תנ ירנ סמ להד

scripture_data.text_id: Bagiku kekasihku bagaikan sebungkus mur, tersisip di antara buah dadaku.
scripture_data.text_en: A bundle of myrrh [is] my wellbeloved unto me; he shall lie all night betwixt my breasts.
scripture_data.text_orig: ילי יד י יל יד רה ררץ

scripture_data.text_id: Bagiku kekasihku setangkai bunga pacar di kebun-kebun anggur En-Gedi.
scripture_data.text_en: My beloved [is] unto me [as] a cluster of camphire in the vineyards of Engedi.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ידי ימרכ יל יד רפה ל

scripture_data.text_id: Lihatlah, cantik engkau, manisku, sungguh cantik engkau, bagaikan merpati matamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, thou [art] fair, my love; behold, thou [art] fair; thou [hast] doves' eyes.
scripture_data.text_orig: יני יני הפי ה יתיר הפי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Lihatlah, tampan engkau, kekasihku, sungguh menarik; sungguh sejuk petiduran kita.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, thou [art] fair, my beloved, yea, pleasant: also our bed [is] green.
scripture_data.text_orig: הננר נר ינ ידד הפי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Dari kayu aras balok-balok rumah kita, dari kayu eru papan dinding-dinding kita.
scripture_data.text_en: The beams of our house [are] cedar, [and] our rafters of fir.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתר ניהר ניחר יזר ני תרק

scripture_data.text_id: Bunga mawar dari Saron aku, bunga bakung di lembah-lembah.
scripture_data.text_en: I [am] the rose of Sharon, [and] the lily of the valleys.
scripture_data.text_orig: יקמה ת רה תלבח ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti bunga bakung di antara duri-duri, demikianlah manisku di antara gadis-gadis.
scripture_data.text_en: As the lily among thorns, so [is] my love among the daughters.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנה י יתיר יחחה י ה

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti pohon apel di antara pohon-pohon di hutan, demikianlah kekasihku di antara teruna-teruna. Di bawah naungannya aku ingin duduk, buahnya manis bagi langit-langitku.
scripture_data.text_en: As the apple tree among the trees of the wood, so [is] my beloved among the sons. I sat down under his shadow with great delight, and his fruit [was] sweet to my taste.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחל קתמ ירפ יביו ידח צ ינה י יד רה יצ חת

scripture_data.text_id: Telah dibawanya aku ke rumah pesta, dan panjinya di atasku adalah cinta.
scripture_data.text_en: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me [was] love.
scripture_data.text_orig: הבה יל לגדו יה תיל יניבה

scripture_data.text_id: Kuatkanlah aku dengan penganan kismis, segarkanlah aku dengan buah apel, sebab sakit asmara aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Stay me with flagons, comfort me with apples: for I [am] sick of love.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ הבה תלחי יח ינדר תי ינכס

scripture_data.text_id: Tangan kirinya ada di bawah kepalaku, tangan kanannya memeluk aku.
scripture_data.text_en: His left hand [is] under my head, and his right hand doth embrace me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינקח נימיו ירל תח למ

scripture_data.text_id: Kusumpahi kamu, puteri-puteri Yerusalem, demi kijang-kijang atau demi rusa-rusa betina di padang: jangan kamu membangkitkan dan menggerakkan cinta sebelum diingininya!
scripture_data.text_en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake [my] love, till he please.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שח ד הבההת ררו רי הדה תלי תבצ לרי תנ כת יה

scripture_data.text_id: Dengarlah! Kekasihku! Lihatlah, ia datang, melompat-lompat di atas gunung-gunung, meloncat-loncat di atas bukit-bukit.
scripture_data.text_en: The voice of my beloved! behold, he cometh leaping upon the mountains, skipping upon the hills.
scripture_data.text_orig: תבהל שקם ירההל גדם הזהה יד לק

scripture_data.text_id: Kekasihku serupa kijang, atau anak rusa. Lihatlah, ia berdiri di balik dinding kita, sambil menengok-nengok melalui tingkap-tingkap dan melihat dari kisi-kisi.
scripture_data.text_en: My beloved is like a roe or a young hart: behold, he standeth behind our wall, he looketh forth at the windows, shewing himself through the lattice.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירחהמ שיצמ תנחהמ חים נלת רח דמ הזהה ילה רפל יבצל ידד המ

scripture_data.text_id: Kekasihku mulai berbicara kepadaku: "Bangunlah manisku, jelitaku, marilah!
scripture_data.text_en: My beloved spake, and said unto me, Rise up, my love, my fair one, and come away.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליכל יתפי יתיר ל ימק יל רמו ידד הנ

scripture_data.text_id: Karena lihatlah, musim dingin telah lewat, hujan telah berhenti dan sudah lalu.
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, the winter is past, the rain is over [and] gone;
scripture_data.text_orig: ל לה לח ה רב ויתה ותה ההי

scripture_data.text_id: Di ladang telah nampak bunga-bunga, tibalah musim memangkas; bunyi tekukur terdengar di tanah kita.
scripture_data.text_en: The flowers appear on the earth; the time of the singing [of birds] is come, and the voice of the turtle is heard in our land;
scripture_data.text_orig: נצר מנ רה לקו יה רימה ת שרב רנ ינה

scripture_data.text_id: Pohon ara mulai berbuah, dan bunga pohon anggur semerbak baunya. Bangunlah, manisku, jelitaku, marilah!
scripture_data.text_en: The fig tree putteth forth her green figs, and the vines [with] the tender grape give a [good] smell. Arise, my love, my fair one, and come away.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ליכל יתפי יתיר ל יכל ימק חיר נתנ רדמס ינפהו היף הנח הנה

scripture_data.text_id: Merpatiku di celah-celah batu, di persembunyian lereng-lereng gunung, perlihatkanlah wajahmu, perdengarkanlah suaramu! Sebab merdu suaramu dan elok wajahmu!"
scripture_data.text_en: O my dove, [that art] in the clefts of the rock, in the secret [places] of the stairs, let me see thy countenance, let me hear thy voice; for sweet [is] thy voice, and thy countenance [is] comely.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הונ ירמ בר לקי לקת יניימה ירמת ינירה הגרדה רתס לה יוגח יתני

scripture_data.text_id: Tangkaplah bagi kami rubah-rubah itu, rubah-rubah yang kecil, yang merusak kebun-kebun anggur, kebun-kebun anggur kami yang sedang berbunga!
scripture_data.text_en: Take us the foxes, the little foxes, that spoil the vines: for our vines [have] tender grapes.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדמס נימרכ ימר ילחם יק יל יל נלזח

scripture_data.text_id: Kekasihku kepunyaanku, dan aku kepunyaan dia yang menggembalakan domba di tengah-tengah bunga bakung.
scripture_data.text_en: My beloved [is] mine, and I [am] his: he feedeth among the lilies.
scripture_data.text_orig: י הרה ל ינו יל יד

scripture_data.text_id: Sebelum angin senja berembus dan bayang-bayang menghilang, kembalilah, kekasihku, berlakulah seperti kijang, atau seperti anak rusa di atas gunung-gunung tanaman rempah-rempah!
scripture_data.text_en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, turn, my beloved, and be thou like a roe or a young hart upon the mountains of Bether.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רתב ירהל ילה רפל יבצל ידד להמ בס יללה סנו ה חפ ד

scripture_data.text_id: Di atas ranjangku pada malam hari kucari jantung hatiku. Kucari, tetapi tak kutemui dia.
scripture_data.text_en: By night on my bed I sought him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתצם לו וי יפן הבה ת י תלי יבמל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku hendak bangun dan berkeliling di kota; di jalan-jalan dan di lapangan-lapangan kucari dia, jantung hatiku. Kucari, tetapi tak kutemui dia.
scripture_data.text_en: I will rise now, and go about the city in the streets, and in the broad ways I will seek him whom my soul loveth: I sought him, but I found him not.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויתצם לו וי יפן הבה ת הקב תבחרב יקו ריב הבבסו המק

scripture_data.text_id: Aku ditemui peronda-peronda kota. "Apakah kamu melihat jantung hatiku?"
scripture_data.text_en: The watchmen that go about the city found me: [to whom I said], Saw ye him whom my soul loveth?
scripture_data.text_orig: תיר יפן הבה ת רי יבבה ירמה ינצם

scripture_data.text_id: Baru saja aku meninggalkan mereka, kutemui jantung hatiku; kupegang dan tak kulepaskan dia, sampai kubawa dia ke rumah ibuku, ke kamar orang yang melahirkan aku.
scripture_data.text_en: [It was] but a little that I passed from them, but I found him whom my soul loveth: I held him, and would not let him go, until I had brought him into my mother's house, and into the chamber of her that conceived me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתרה רדחלו י תיל ויתיבהד ר לו ויזח יפן הבה ת יתצ ד המ ירב מ

scripture_data.text_id: Kusumpahi kamu, puteri-puteri Yerusalem, demi kijang-kijang atau demi rusa-rusa betina di padang: jangan kamu membangkitkan dan menggerakkan cinta sebelum diingininya!
scripture_data.text_en: I charge you, O ye daughters of Jerusalem, by the roes, and by the hinds of the field, that ye stir not up, nor awake [my] love, till he please.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שח ד הבההת ררו רי הדה תלי תבצ לרי תנ כת יה

scripture_data.text_id: Apakah itu yang membubung dari padang gurun seperti gumpalan-gumpalan asap tersaput dengan harum mur dan kemenyan dan bau segala macam serbuk wangi dari pedagang?
scripture_data.text_en: Who [is] this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?
scripture_data.text_orig: לכר תקב למ הנבל רם תרקם תרמית רדהמ הל תז ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Lihat, itulah joli Salomo, dikelilingi oleh enam puluh pahlawan dari antara pahlawan-pahlawan Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold his bed, which [is] Solomon's; threescore valiant men [are] about it, of the valiant of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי ירמ ל ביבס יר י המל תמ הה

scripture_data.text_id: Semua membawa pedang, terlatih dalam perang, masing-masing dengan pedang pada pinggang karena kedahsyatan malam.
scripture_data.text_en: They all hold swords, [being] expert in war: every man [hath] his sword upon his thigh because of fear in the night.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תלי דחמ כריל רח י המחלמ ידלם ברח יזח

scripture_data.text_id: Raja Salomo membuat bagi dirinya suatu tandu dari kayu Libanon.
scripture_data.text_en: King Solomon made himself a chariot of the wood of Lebanon.
scripture_data.text_orig: נבה יצמ המל לה ל ה יר

scripture_data.text_id: Tiang-tiangnya dibuatnya dari perak, sandarannya dari emas, tempat duduknya berwarna ungu, bagian dalamnya dihiasi dengan kayu arang. Hai puteri-puteri Yerusalem,
scripture_data.text_en: He made the pillars thereof [of] silver, the bottom thereof [of] gold, the covering of it [of] purple, the midst thereof being paved [with] love, for the daughters of Jerusalem.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי תנמ הבה צר כ מר ברם בהז תדיפר סכ ה ויד

scripture_data.text_id: puteri-puteri Sion, keluarlah dan tengoklah raja Salomo dengan mahkota yang dikenakan kepadanya oleh ibunya pada hari pernikahannya, pada hari kesukaan hatinya.
scripture_data.text_en: Go forth, O ye daughters of Zion, and behold king Solomon with the crown wherewith his mother crowned him in the day of his espousals, and in the day of the gladness of his heart.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ל תחמ יב תתח י הר הר המל ל צ תנ הניר הניץ

scripture_data.text_id: Lihatlah, cantik engkau, manisku, sungguh cantik engkau! Bagaikan merpati matamu di balik telekungmu. Rambutmu bagaikan kawanan kambing yang bergelombang turun dari pegunungan Gilead.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, thou [art] fair, my love; behold, thou [art] fair; thou [hast] doves' eyes within thy locks: thy hair [is] as a flock of goats, that appear from mount Gilead.
scripture_data.text_orig: דל רהמ ל יה רד ר תצל דמ יני יני הפי ה יתיר הפי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Gigimu bagaikan kawanan domba yang baru saja dicukur, yang keluar dari tempat pembasuhan, yang beranak kembar semuanya, yang tak beranak tak ada.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy teeth [are] like a flock [of sheep that are even] shorn, which came up from the washing; whereof every one bear twins, and none [is] barren among them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה י הלו תמיתם הצחרהמ ל תבצה רד י

scripture_data.text_id: Bagaikan seutas pita kirmizi bibirmu, dan elok mulutmu. Bagaikan belahan buah delima pelipismu di balik telekungmu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy lips [are] like a thread of scarlet, and thy speech [is] comely: thy temples [are] like a piece of a pomegranate within thy locks.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצל דמ תר רה חלפ הונ ירדמ יתתפ ינה ח

scripture_data.text_id: Lehermu seperti menara Daud, dibangun untuk menyimpan senjata. Seribu perisai tergantung padanya dan gada para pahlawan semuanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy neck [is] like the tower of David builded for an armoury, whereon there hang a thousand bucklers, all shields of mighty men.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירה יל ל ויל יל גה ל תלתל ינ רץ דיו לגמ

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti dua anak rusa buah dadamu, seperti anak kembar kijang yang tengah makan rumput di tengah-tengah bunga bakung.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy two breasts [are] like two young roes that are twins, which feed among the lilies.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ירה הבץ ימ ירפ ינ יד ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebelum angin senja berembus dan bayang-bayang menghilang, aku ingin pergi ke gunung mur dan ke bukit kemenyan.
scripture_data.text_en: Until the day break, and the shadows flee away, I will get me to the mountain of myrrh, and to the hill of frankincense.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנבה תבלו רה רהל יל ל יללה סנו ה חפ ד

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau cantik sekali, manisku, tak ada cacat cela padamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou [art] all fair, my love; [there is] no spot in thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס י מ יתיר הפי

scripture_data.text_id: Turunlah kepadaku dari gunung Libanon, pengantinku, datanglah kepadaku dari gunung Libanon, turunlah dari puncak Amana, dari puncak Senir dan Hermon, dari liang-liang singa, dari pegunungan tempat macan tutul!
scripture_data.text_en: Come with me from Lebanon, [my] spouse, with me from Lebanon: look from the top of Amana, from the top of Shenir and Hermon, from the lions' dens, from the mountains of the leopards.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירמן יררהמ תיר תנמ מרחו רינ רמ הנמ רמ יר יב נבמ י ה נבמ י

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau mendebarkan hatiku, dinda, pengantinku, engkau mendebarkan hati dengan satu kejapan mata, dengan seuntai kalung dari perhiasan lehermu.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast ravished my heart, my sister, [my] spouse; thou hast ravished my heart with one of thine eyes, with one chain of thy neck.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינרמ קנ דח ינימ תח דח יניבל הך יתח ינבל

scripture_data.text_id: Betapa nikmat kasihmu, dinda, pengantinku! Jauh lebih nikmat cintamu dari pada anggur, dan lebih harum bau minyakmu dari pada segala macam rempah.
scripture_data.text_en: How fair is thy love, my sister, [my] spouse! how much better is thy love than wine! and the smell of thine ointments than all spices!
scripture_data.text_orig: ימלמ ינמ חירו ימ ידד בהם הך יתח ידד פהם

scripture_data.text_id: Bibirmu meneteskan madu murni, pengantinku, madu dan susu ada di bawah lidahmu, dan bau pakaianmu seperti bau gunung Libanon.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy lips, O [my] spouse, drop [as] the honeycomb: honey and milk [are] under thy tongue; and the smell of thy garments [is] like the smell of Lebanon.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס נבל חיר יתמל חירו נל תח בלחו ב ה יתתפ הנפ תפנ

scripture_data.text_id: Dinda, pengantinku, kebun tertutup engkau, kebun tertutup dan mata air termeterai.
scripture_data.text_en: A garden inclosed [is] my sister, [my] spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
scripture_data.text_orig: תח ים לנ ל הך יתח לנ

scripture_data.text_id: Tunas-tunasmu merupakan kebun pohon-pohon delima dengan buah-buahnya yang lezat, bunga pacar dan narwastu,
scripture_data.text_en: Thy plants [are] an orchard of pomegranates, with pleasant fruits; camphire, with spikenard,
scripture_data.text_orig: ידרנ ירפ ידגם יר ינר סר יחל

scripture_data.text_id: narwastu dan kunyit, tebu dan kayu manis dengan segala macam pohon kemenyan, mur dan gaharu, beserta pelbagai rempah yang terpilih.
scripture_data.text_en: Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:
scripture_data.text_orig: ימב ירל תלהו רמ הנבל יצל מקו הנק רכו רנ

scripture_data.text_id: O, mata air di kebun, sumber air hidup, yang mengalir dari gunung Libanon!
scripture_data.text_en: A fountain of gardens, a well of living waters, and streams from Lebanon.
scripture_data.text_orig: נבלמ ילזנו יח ימ ר י ים

scripture_data.text_id: Bangunlah, hai angin utara, dan marilah, hai angin selatan, bertiuplah dalam kebunku, supaya semerbaklah bau rempah-rempahnya! Semoga kekasihku datang ke kebunnya dan makan buah-buahnya yang lezat.
scripture_data.text_en: Awake, O north wind; and come, thou south; blow upon my garden, [that] the spices thereof may flow out. Let my beloved come into his garden, and eat his pleasant fruits.
scripture_data.text_orig: וידגם יר לכיו גל ידד בי וימב לי יג יחיפה מית יב פצ יר

scripture_data.text_id: Aku datang ke kebunku, dinda, pengantinku, kukumpulkan mur dan rempah-rempahku, kumakan sambangku dan maduku, kuminum anggurku dan susuku. Makanlah, teman-teman, minumlah, minumlah sampai mabuk cinta!
scripture_data.text_en: I am come into my garden, my sister, [my] spouse: I have gathered my myrrh with my spice; I have eaten my honeycomb with my honey; I have drunk my wine with my milk: eat, O friends; drink, yea, drink abundantly, O beloved.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יד רכו ת יר לכ יבלח יניי יתית יב ירי ילכ ימ ירם יתיר הך יתח יגל ית

scripture_data.text_id: Aku tidur, tetapi hatiku bangun. Dengarlah, kekasihku mengetuk. "Bukalah pintu, dinda, manisku, merpatiku, idam-idamanku, karena kepalaku penuh embun, dan rambutku penuh tetesan embun malam!"
scripture_data.text_en: I sleep, but my heart waketh: [it is] the voice of my beloved that knocketh, [saying], Open to me, my sister, my love, my dove, my undefiled: for my head is filled with dew, [and] my locks with the drops of the night.
scripture_data.text_orig: הליל יסיסר יתק ללמנ י יתת יתני יתיר יתח יליחת קפד יד לק ר ילו הני ינ

scripture_data.text_id: "Bajuku telah kutanggalkan, apakah aku akan mengenakannya lagi? Kakiku telah kubasuh, apakah aku akan mengotorkannya pula?"
scripture_data.text_en: I have put off my coat; how shall I put it on? I have washed my feet; how shall I defile them?
scripture_data.text_orig: פ הככי ילגרת יצחר הל הככי ינת י

scripture_data.text_id: Kekasihku memasukkan tangannya melalui lobang pintu, berdebar-debarlah hatiku.
scripture_data.text_en: My beloved put in his hand by the hole [of the door], and my bowels were moved for him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויל מה ימ רחהמ די חל יד

scripture_data.text_id: Aku bangun untuk membuka pintu bagi kekasihku, tanganku bertetesan mur; bertetesan cairan mur jari-jariku pada pegangan kancing pintu.
scripture_data.text_en: I rose up to open to my beloved; and my hands dropped [with] myrrh, and my fingers [with] sweet smelling myrrh, upon the handles of the lock.
scripture_data.text_orig: לנה ת ל רב רמ יתצו רמפנ ידיו ידדל חפל ינ ימק

scripture_data.text_id: Kekasihku kubukakan pintu, tetapi kekasihku sudah pergi, lenyap. Seperti pingsan aku ketika ia menghilang. Kucari dia, tetapi tak kutemui, kupanggil, tetapi tak disahutnya.
scripture_data.text_en: I opened to my beloved; but my beloved had withdrawn himself, [and] was gone: my soul failed when he spake: I sought him, but I could not find him; I called him, but he gave me no answer.
scripture_data.text_orig: יננ לו ויתרק היתצם לו הי רדב הצי יפן רב קמח ידדו ידדל ינ יחת

scripture_data.text_id: Aku ditemui peronda-peronda kota, dipukulinya aku, dilukainya, selendangku dirampas oleh penjaga-penjaga tembok.
scripture_data.text_en: The watchmen that went about the city found me, they smote me, they wounded me; the keepers of the walls took away my veil from me.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמחה ירמ ילמ ידידרת נ ינצף ינה רי יבבה ירמה ינצם

scripture_data.text_id: Kusumpahi kamu, puteri-puteri Yerusalem: bila kamu menemukan kekasihku, apakah yang akan kamu katakan kepadanya? Katakanlah, bahwa sakit asmara aku!
scripture_data.text_en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, if ye find my beloved, that ye tell him, that I [am] sick of love.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ הבה תלח ל דיהם ידת צמ לרי תנ כת יה

scripture_data.text_id: Apakah kelebihan kekasihmu dari pada kekasih yang lain, hai jelita di antara wanita? Apakah kelebihan kekasihmu dari pada kekasih yang lain, sehingga kausumpahi kami begini?
scripture_data.text_en: What [is] thy beloved more than [another] beloved, O thou fairest among women? what [is] thy beloved more than [another] beloved, that thou dost so charge us?
scripture_data.text_orig: נה הכ דמ דהם י הפה דמ דהם

scripture_data.text_id: Putih bersih dan merah cerah kekasihku, menyolok mata di antara selaksa orang.
scripture_data.text_en: My beloved [is] white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
scripture_data.text_orig: הבברמ לג דו חץ יד

scripture_data.text_id: Bagaikan emas, emas murni, kepalanya, rambutnya mengombak, hitam seperti gagak.
scripture_data.text_en: His head [is as] the most fine gold, his locks [are] bushy, [and] black as a raven.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר תרח יל ויתק ז ת ר

scripture_data.text_id: Matanya bagaikan merpati pada batang air, bermandi dalam susu, duduk pada kolam yang penuh.
scripture_data.text_en: His eyes [are] as [the eyes] of doves by the rivers of waters, washed with milk, [and] fitly set.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמל תבי בלח תצחר ימ יקיפל יני ויני

scripture_data.text_id: Pipinya bagaikan bedeng rempah-rempah, petak-petak rempah-rempah akar. Bunga-bunga bakung bibirnya, bertetesan cairan mur.
scripture_data.text_en: His cheeks [are] as a bed of spices, [as] sweet flowers: his lips [like] lilies, dropping sweet smelling myrrh.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב רמ תפנ י ויתתפ יחקרם תלגמ ה תגר ויחל

scripture_data.text_id: Tangannya bundaran emas, berhiaskan permata Tarsis, tubuhnya ukiran dari gading, bertabur batu nilam.
scripture_data.text_en: His hands [are as] gold rings set with the beryl: his belly [is as] bright ivory overlaid [with] sapphires.
scripture_data.text_orig: יריס תפם ת וימ יר ימם בהז יליל וידי

scripture_data.text_id: Kakinya adalah tiang-tiang marmar putih, bertumpu pada alas emas murni. Perawakannya seperti gunung Libanon, terpilih seperti pohon-pohon aras.
scripture_data.text_en: His legs [are as] pillars of marble, set upon sockets of fine gold: his countenance [is] as Lebanon, excellent as the cedars.
scripture_data.text_orig: יזר רח נב הרם זפינדל ידים יד ויק

scripture_data.text_id: Kata-katanya manis semata-mata, segala sesuatu padanya menarik. Demikianlah kekasihku, demikianlah temanku, hai puteri-puteri Yerusalem.
scripture_data.text_en: His mouth [is] most sweet: yea, he [is] altogether lovely. This [is] my beloved, and this [is] my friend, O daughters of Jerusalem.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי תנ יר הזו ידד הז ימחם כו יתמם ח

scripture_data.text_id: Ke mana perginya kekasihmu, hai jelita di antara wanita? Ke jurusan manakah kekasihmu pergi, supaya kami mencarinya besertamu?
scripture_data.text_en: Whither is thy beloved gone, O thou fairest among women? whither is thy beloved turned aside? that we may seek him with thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: קבנ דד הנ הנ י הפה ד לה הנ

scripture_data.text_id: Kekasihku telah turun ke kebunnya, ke bedeng rempah-rempah untuk menggembalakan domba dalam kebun dan memetik bunga bakung.
scripture_data.text_en: My beloved is gone down into his garden, to the beds of spices, to feed in the gardens, and to gather lilies.
scripture_data.text_orig: י קללו י תרל ה תגרל גל דרי יד

scripture_data.text_id: Aku kepunyaan kekasihku, dan kepunyaanku kekasihku, yang menggembalakan domba di tengah-tengah bunga bakung.
scripture_data.text_en: I [am] my beloved's, and my beloved [is] mine: he feedeth among the lilies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס י הרה יל ידדו ידדל ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Cantik engkau, manisku, seperti kota Tirza, juita seperti Yerusalem, dahsyat seperti bala tentara dengan panji-panjinya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou [art] beautiful, O my love, as Tirzah, comely as Jerusalem, terrible as [an army] with banners.
scripture_data.text_orig: תלד הי לרי הונ הצרת יתיר הפי

scripture_data.text_id: Palingkanlah matamu dari padaku, sebab aku menjadi bingung karenanya. Rambutmu bagaikan kawanan kambing yang bergelombang turun dari Gilead.
scripture_data.text_en: Turn away thine eyes from me, for they have overcome me: thy hair [is] as a flock of goats that appear from Gilead.
scripture_data.text_orig: דלהמ ל יה רד ר ינביהרה ה יגמ יני יסה

scripture_data.text_id: Gigimu bagaikan kawanan domba, yang keluar dari tempat pembasuhan, yang beranak kembar semuanya, yang tak beranak tak ada.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy teeth [are] as a flock of sheep which go up from the washing, whereof every one beareth twins, and [there is] not one barren among them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה י הלו תמיתם הצחרהמ ל ילחרה רד י

scripture_data.text_id: Bagaikan belahan buah delima pelipismu di balik telekungmu.
scripture_data.text_en: As a piece of a pomegranate [are] thy temples within thy locks.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצל דמ תר רה חלפ

scripture_data.text_id: Permaisuri ada enam puluh, selir delapan puluh, dan dara-dara tak terbilang banyaknya.
scripture_data.text_en: There are threescore queens, and fourscore concubines, and virgins without number.
scripture_data.text_orig: רסמ י תמלו יגלי ינמ תכל הה י

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi dialah satu-satunya merpatiku, idam-idamanku, satu-satunya anak ibunya, anak kesayangan bagi yang melahirkannya; puteri-puteri melihatnya dan menyebutnya bahagia, permaisuri-permaisuri dan selir-selir memujinya.
scripture_data.text_en: My dove, my undefiled is [but] one; she [is] the [only] one of her mother, she [is] the choice [one] of her that bare her. The daughters saw her, and blessed her; [yea], the queens and the concubines, and they praised her.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הללהיו יגליפ תכלם הריו תנב הר דליל יה הר ל יה תח יתת יתני יה תח

scripture_data.text_id: "Siapakah dia yang muncul laksana fajar merekah, indah bagaikan bulan purnama, bercahaya bagaikan surya, dahsyat seperti bala tentara dengan panji-panjinya?"
scripture_data.text_en: Who [is] she [that] looketh forth as the morning, fair as the moon, clear as the sun, [and] terrible as [an army] with banners?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תלד הי הח הר הנבך הפי רחמ הפקה תזימ

scripture_data.text_id: Ke kebun kenari aku turun melihat kuntum-kuntum di lembah, melihat apakah pohon anggur berkuncup dan pohon-pohon delima berbunga.
scripture_data.text_en: I went down into the garden of nuts to see the fruits of the valley, [and] to see whether the vine flourished, [and] the pomegranates budded.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינרה צנה פה החרפה תרל לחה י תרל ידרי זג תל

scripture_data.text_id: Tak sadar diri aku; kerinduanku menempatkan aku di atas kereta orang bangsawan.
scripture_data.text_en: Or ever I was aware, my soul made me [like] the chariots of Amminadib.
scripture_data.text_orig: בידני תברם ינתמ יפן ידי ל

scripture_data.text_id: Kembalilah, kembalilah, ya gadis Sulam, kembalilah, kembalilah, supaya kami dapat melihat engkau! Mengapa kamu senang melihat gadis Sulam itu seperti melihat tari-tarian perang?
scripture_data.text_en: Return, return, O Shulamite; return, return, that we may look upon thee. What will ye see in the Shulamite? As it were the company of two armies.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Betapa indah langkah-langkahmu dengan sandal-sandal itu, puteri yang berwatak luhur! Lengkung pinggangmu bagaikan perhiasan, karya tangan seniman.
scripture_data.text_en: How beautiful are thy feet with shoes, O prince's daughter! the joints of thy thighs [are] like jewels, the work of the hands of a cunning workman.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינחה תלחמ תיל זחהם הזחנו יב יב תילה יב יב

scripture_data.text_id: Pusarmu seperti cawan yang bulat, yang tak kekurangan anggur campur. Perutmu timbunan gandum, berpagar bunga-bunga bakung.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy navel [is like] a round goblet, [which] wanteth not liquor: thy belly [is like] an heap of wheat set about with lilies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידי הם ילח מ יכרי יקח בידנת יל ימף פהם

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti dua anak rusa buah dadamu, seperti anak kembar kijang.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy two breasts [are] like two young roes [that are] twins.
scripture_data.text_orig: י הגס יח תמר נ גזה רסחיל רהה רר

scripture_data.text_id: Lehermu bagaikan menara gading, matamu bagaikan telaga di Hesybon, dekat pintu gerbang Batrabim; hidungmu seperti menara di gunung Libanon, yang menghadap ke kota Damsyik.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy neck [is] as a tower of ivory; thine eyes [like] the fishpools in Heshbon, by the gate of Bathrabbim: thy nose [is] as the tower of Lebanon which looketh toward Damascus.
scripture_data.text_orig: הבץ ימ ירפ ינ יד ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Kepalamu seperti bukit Karmel, rambut kepalamu merah lembayung; seorang raja tertawan dalam kepang-kepangnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Thine head upon thee [is] like Carmel, and the hair of thine head like purple; the king [is] held in the galleries.
scripture_data.text_orig: קד ינ הפץ נבה לגמ ירת רל ח תכר יני ה לגמ רץ

scripture_data.text_id: Betapa cantik, betapa jelita engkau, hai tercinta di antara segala yang disenangi.
scripture_data.text_en: How fair and how pleasant art thou, O love, for delights!
scripture_data.text_orig: יהר רס למ מר ר תדו למר יל ר

scripture_data.text_id: Sosok tubuhmu seumpama pohon korma dan buah dadamu gugusannya.
scripture_data.text_en: This thy stature is like to a palm tree, and thy breasts to clusters [of grapes].
scripture_data.text_orig: יגנ הבה מהמ תיפהם

scripture_data.text_id: Kataku: "Aku ingin memanjat pohon korma itu dan memegang gugusan-gugusannya Kiranya buah dadamu seperti gugusan anggur dan nafas hidungmu seperti buah apel.
scripture_data.text_en: I said, I will go up to the palm tree, I will take hold of the boughs thereof: now also thy breasts shall be as clusters of the vine, and the smell of thy nose like apples;
scripture_data.text_orig: תלל ידו רמתל התמ תמק תז

scripture_data.text_id: Kata-katamu manis bagaikan anggur!" Ya, anggur itu mengalir kepada kekasihku dengan tak putus-putusnya, melimpah ke bibir orang-orang yang sedang tidur!
scripture_data.text_en: And the roof of thy mouth like the best wine for my beloved, that goeth [down] sweetly, causing the lips of those that are asleep to speak.
scripture_data.text_orig: יח חירו פה תל יד ניהיו ויסנס הזח רמתב הל ירמ

scripture_data.text_id: Kepunyaan kekasihku aku, kepadaku gairahnya tertuju.
scripture_data.text_en: I [am] my beloved's, and his desire [is] toward me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יני יתפ בב ירימל ידדל לה בה יי חו

scripture_data.text_id: Mari, kekasihku, kita pergi ke padang, bermalam di antara bunga-bunga pacar!
scripture_data.text_en: Come, my beloved, let us go forth into the field; let us lodge in the villages.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תק ילו ידדל ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Mari, kita pergi pagi-pagi ke kebun anggur dan melihat apakah pohon anggur sudah berkuncup, apakah sudah mekar bunganya, apakah pohon-pohon delima sudah berbunga! Di sanalah aku akan memberikan cintaku kepadamu!
scripture_data.text_en: Let us get up early to the vineyards; let us see if the vine flourish, [whether] the tender grape appear, [and] the pomegranates bud forth: there will I give thee my loves.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירפ הנילנ הדה צנ ידד הכל

scripture_data.text_id: Semerbak bau buah dudaim; dekat pintu kita ada pelbagai buah-buah yang lezat, yang telah lama dan yang baru saja dipetik. Itu telah kusimpan bagimu, kekasihku!
scripture_data.text_en: The mandrakes give a smell, and at our gates [are] all manner of pleasant [fruits], new and old, [which] I have laid up for thee, O my beloved.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ידת ינרה צנה רדמה ח פה החר הרנ ימרל המין

scripture_data.text_id: O, seandainya engkau saudaraku laki-laki, yang menyusu pada buah dada ibuku, akan kucium engkau bila kujumpai di luar, karena tak ada orang yang akan menghina aku!
scripture_data.text_en: O that thou [wert] as my brother, that sucked the breasts of my mother! [when] I should find thee without, I would kiss thee; yea, I should not be despised.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל זביל ק שחב צמ י יד קני יל ח ני ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Akan kubimbing engkau dan kubawa ke rumah ibuku, supaya engkau mengajar aku. Akan kuberi kepadamu anggur yang harum untuk diminum, air buah delimaku.
scripture_data.text_en: I would lead thee, [and] bring thee into my mother's house, [who] would instruct me: I would cause thee to drink of spiced wine of the juice of my pomegranate.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינר סיסמ חקרה ימ ק ינדל י תיל יב גהנ

scripture_data.text_id: Tangan kirinya ada di bawah kepalaku, tangan kanannya memeluk aku.
scripture_data.text_en: His left hand [should be] under my head, and his right hand should embrace me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינקח נימיו יר תח למ

scripture_data.text_id: Kusumpahi kamu, puteri-puteri Yerusalem: mengapa kamu membangkitkan dan menggerakkan cinta sebelum diingininya?
scripture_data.text_en: I charge you, O daughters of Jerusalem, that ye stir not up, nor awake [my] love, until he please.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שח ד הבההת ררהמ ריהם לרי תנ כת יה

scripture_data.text_id: Siapakah dia yang muncul dari padang gurun, yang bersandar pada kekasihnya? Di bawah pohon apel kubangunkan engkau, di sanalah ibumu telah mengandung engkau, di sanalah ia mengandung dan melahirkan engkau.
scripture_data.text_en: Who [is] this that cometh up from the wilderness, leaning upon her beloved? I raised thee up under the apple tree: there thy mother brought thee forth: there she brought thee forth [that] bare thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: תדלי הלח ה תלח ה ירר חה תח דל תקרתמ רדהמ הל תז ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Taruhlah aku seperti meterai pada hatimu, seperti meterai pada lenganmu, karena cinta kuat seperti maut, kegairahan gigih seperti dunia orang mati, nyalanya adalah nyala api, seperti nyala api TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Set me as a seal upon thine heart, as a seal upon thine arm: for love [is] strong as death; jealousy [is] cruel as the grave: the coals thereof [are] coals of fire, [which hath a] most vehement flame.
scripture_data.text_orig: היתבהל יר היפר הנק לכ הק הבה תוך הי רזל תח לל תחך ינמי

scripture_data.text_id: Air yang banyak tak dapat memadamkan cinta, sungai-sungai tak dapat menghanyutkannya. Sekalipun orang memberi segala harta benda rumahnya untuk cinta, namun ia pasti akan dihina.
scripture_data.text_en: Many waters cannot quench love, neither can the floods drown it: if [a] man would give all the substance of his house for love, it would utterly be contemned.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ל זבי ז הבה תי הלת י י הפי ל תרהנ הבההת תכל לכי ל יר ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Kami mempunyai seorang adik perempuan, yang belum mempunyai buah dada. Apakah yang akan kami perbuat dengan adik perempuan kami pada hari ia dipinang?
scripture_data.text_en: We have a little sister, and she hath no breasts: what shall we do for our sister in the day when she shall be spoken for?
scripture_data.text_orig: רד נתחל ההם ל י ידו הק נל תח

scripture_data.text_id: Bila ia tembok, akan kami dirikan atap perak di atasnya; bila ia pintu, akan kami palangi dia dengan palang kayu aras.
scripture_data.text_en: If she [be] a wall, we will build upon her a palace of silver: and if she [be] a door, we will inclose her with boards of cedar.
scripture_data.text_orig: זר חל היל רצנ יה תלו ס תרי היל הנבנ יה המח

scripture_data.text_id: Aku adalah suatu tembok dan buah dadaku bagaikan menara. Dalam matanya ketika itu aku bagaikan orang yang telah mendapat kebahagiaan.
scripture_data.text_en: I [am] a wall, and my breasts like towers: then was I in his eyes as one that found favour.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ל תצמ ויניב יתייה ז תלג ידו המח ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Salomo mempunyai kebun anggur di Baal-Hamon. Diserahkannya kebun anggur itu kepada para penjaga, masing-masing memberikan seribu keping perak untuk hasilnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Solomon had a vineyard at Baalhamon; he let out the vineyard unto keepers; every one for the fruit thereof was to bring a thousand [pieces] of silver.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ל ירפ בי י ירל רהת תנ מהלב המלל היה ר

scripture_data.text_id: Kebun anggurku, yang punyaku sendiri, ada di hadapanku; bagimulah seribu keping itu, raja Salomo, dan dua ratus bagi orang-orang yang menjaga hasilnya.
scripture_data.text_en: My vineyard, which [is] mine, [is] before me: thou, O Solomon, [must have] a thousand, and those that keep the fruit thereof two hundred.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירת ירנל יתמ המל ל לה ינפל י ימר

scripture_data.text_id: Hai, penghuni kebun, teman-teman memperhatikan suaramu, perdengarkanlah itu kepadaku!
scripture_data.text_en: Thou that dwellest in the gardens, the companions hearken to thy voice: cause me to hear [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: יניימה לקל יביקם ירבח י תבה

scripture_data.text_id: Cepat, kekasihku, berlakulah seperti kijang, atau seperti anak rusa di atas gunung-gunung tanaman rempah-rempah.
scripture_data.text_en: Make haste, my beloved, and be thou like to a roe or to a young hart upon the mountains of spices.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימב ירה ל ילה רפל יבצל להמד יד חר

title: Nabi-Nabi Besar: Penglihatan Yesaya, Yeremia, Yeheskil

cinematic_properties.image_prompt: Prophet looking at a glowing divine chariot of fire in the sky, mystical wheels within wheels, dramatic cosmic atmosphere --ar 21:9

scripture_data.text_orig: שריכנל לקהל יבצל לחל צי תבץ הוהי

scripture_data.text_id: Kerjakanlah ladangmu seperti di tepi sungai Nil, hai puteri Tarsis, sudah tidak ada lagi galangan-galangan kapal!
scripture_data.text_en: Pass through thy land as a river, O daughter of Tarshish: [there is] no more strength.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד חזמ י ירת רי צר ירב

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN telah mengacungkan tangan-Nya terhadap laut dan membuat kerajaan-kerajaan gemetar; Ia telah memberi perintah mengenai Kanaan untuk memusnahkan benteng-bentengnya.
scripture_data.text_en: He stretched out his hand over the sea, he shook the kingdoms: the LORD hath given a commandment against the merchant [city], to destroy the strong holds thereof.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan ia telah berfirman: "Engkau tidak akan beria-ria lagi, hai anak dara yang digagahi, hai puteri Sidon! Bangkitlah, mengungsilah kepada orang Kitim! Di sanapun juga tidak akan ada tempat yang senang bagimu."
scripture_data.text_en: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin, daughter of Zidon: arise, pass over to Chittim; there also shalt thou have no rest.

scripture_data.text_id: Lihat negeri orang Kasdim! Bangsa itulah yang melakukannya, bukan orang Asyur. Mereka telah menyerahkan Tirus kepada binatang-binatang gurun, mereka telah mendirikan menara-menara pengepungan dan telah meratakan puri-puri kota itu dan membuat kota itu menjadi reruntuhan.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold the land of the Chaldeans; this people was not, [till] the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness: they set up the towers thereof, they raised up the palaces thereof; [and] he brought it to ruin.

scripture_data.text_id: Merataplah, hai kapal-kapal Tarsis, sebab sudah dirusakkan bentengmu!

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu Tirus akan dilupakan tujuh puluh tahun lamanya, sama dengan umur seorang raja. Sesudah lewat tujuh puluh tahun, akan terjadi kepada Tirus seperti terjadi kepada perempuan sundal dalam nyanyian ini:
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years shall Tyre sing as an harlot.

scripture_data.text_id: "Ambillah kecapi, kelilingilah kota, hai sundal yang dilupakan! Petiklah baik-baik, bernyanyilah banyak-banyak, supaya engkau diingat orang."
scripture_data.text_en: Take an harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan sesudah lewat tujuh puluh tahun, TUHAN akan memperhatikan Tirus, sehingga ia kembali mendapat upah sundalnya, dan ia akan bersundal dengan segala kerajaan yang ada di muka bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that the LORD will visit Tyre, and she shall turn to her hire, and shall commit fornication with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

scripture_data.text_id: Labanya dan upah sundalnya akan kudus bagi TUHAN, tidak akan ditahan atau disimpan, tetapi dengan labanya itu akan disediakan makanan yang cukup dan pakaian yang indah bagi orang-orang yang diam di hadapan TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to the LORD: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, TUHAN akan menanduskan bumi dan akan menghancurkannya, akan membalikkan permukaannya, dan akan menyerakkan penduduknya.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, the LORD maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the lender, so with the borrower; as with the taker of usury, so with the giver of usury to him.

scripture_data.text_id: Bumi berkabung dan layu, ya, dunia merana dan layu, langit dan bumi merana bersama.

scripture_data.text_id: Orang menjerit di jalan-jalan karena tiada anggur, segala sukacita sudah lenyap, kegirangan bumi sudah hilang.
scripture_data.text_en: [There is] a crying for wine in the streets; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

scripture_data.text_id: Yang terdapat dalam kota hanya kerusakan, pintu gerbang telah didobrak dan runtuh.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab beginilah akan terjadi di atas bumi, di tengah-tengah bangsa-bangsa, yaitu seperti pada waktu orang menjolok buah zaitun, seperti pada waktu pemetikan susulan, apabila panen buah anggur sudah berakhir.
scripture_data.text_en: When thus it shall be in the midst of the land among the people, [there shall be] as the shaking of an olive tree, [and] as the gleaning grapes when the vintage is done.

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan suara nyaring mereka bersorak-sorai, demi kemegahan TUHAN, mereka memekik dari sebelah barat:

scripture_data.text_id: "Sebab itu permuliakanlah TUHAN di negeri-negeri timur, nama TUHAN, Allah Israel, di tanah-tanah pesisir laut!"
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore glorify ye the LORD in the fires, [even] the name of the LORD God of Israel in the isles of the sea.

scripture_data.text_id: Dari ujung bumi kami dengar nyanyian pujian: "Hormat bagi Yang Mahaadil!" Tetapi aku berkata: "Kurus merana aku, kurus merana aku. Celakalah aku! Sebab para penggarong menggarong, ya, terus-menerus mereka melakukan penggarongannya!"
scripture_data.text_en: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs, [even] glory to the righteous. But I said, My leanness, my leanness, woe unto me! the treacherous dealers have dealt treacherously; yea, the treacherous dealers have dealt very treacherously.

scripture_data.text_id: Hai penduduk bumi, kamu akan dikejutkan, akan masuk pelubang dan jerat!

scripture_data.text_en: And it shall come to pass, [that] he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows from on high are open, and the foundations of the earth do shake.

scripture_data.text_id: Bumi remuk redam, bumi hancur luluh bumi goncang-gancing.

scripture_data.text_id: Bumi terhuyung-huyung sama sekali seperti orang mabuk dan goyang seperti gubuk yang ditiup angin; dosa pemberontakannya menimpa dia dengan sangat, ia rebah dan tidak akan bangkit-bangkit lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: The earth shall reel to and fro like a drunkard, and shall be removed like a cottage; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it; and it shall fall, and not rise again.

scripture_data.text_id: Maka pada hari itu TUHAN akan menghukum tentara langit di langit dan raja-raja bumi di atas bumi.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall come to pass in that day, [that] the LORD shall punish the host of the high ones [that are] on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan dikumpulkan bersama-sama, seperti tahanan dimasukkan dalam liang; mereka akan dimasukkan dalam penjara dan akan dihukum sesudah waktu yang lama.
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall be gathered together, [as] prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.

scripture_data.text_id: Bulan purnama akan tersipu-sipu, dan matahari terik akan mendapat malu, sebab TUHAN semesta alam akan memerintah di gunung Sion dan di Yerusalem, dan Ia akan menunjukkan kemuliaan-Nya di depan tua-tua umat-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed, when the LORD of hosts shall reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem, and before his ancients gloriously.

scripture_data.text_id: Ya TUHAN, Engkaulah Allahku; aku mau meninggikan Engkau, mau menyanyikan syukur bagi nama-Mu; sebab dengan kesetiaan yang teguh Engkau telah melaksanakan rancangan-Mu yang ajaib yang telah ada sejak dahulu.
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD, thou [art] my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful [things; thy] counsels of old [are] faithfulness [and] truth.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkau telah membuat kota itu menjadi timbunan batu, dan kota yang berkubu itu menjadi reruntuhan; puri orang luar tidak lagi menjadi kota, dan tidak dibangunkan lagi untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: For thou hast made of a city an heap; [of] a defenced city a ruin: a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena itu suatu bangsa yang kuat akan memuliakan Engkau; kota bangsa-bangsa yang gagah akan takut kepada-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore shall the strong people glorify thee, the city of the terrible nations shall fear thee.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Engkau menjadi tempat pengungsian bagi orang lemah, tempat pengungsian bagi orang miskin dalam kesesakannya, perlindungan terhadap angin ribut, naungan terhadap panas terik, sebab amarah orang-orang yang gagah sombong itu seperti angin ribut di musim dingin,
scripture_data.text_en: For thou hast been a strength to the poor, a strength to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shadow from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones [is] as a storm [against] the wall.

scripture_data.text_id: seperti panas terik di tempat kering. Kegaduhan orang-orang luar Kaudiamkan; seperti panas terik ditiadakan oleh naungan awan, demikianlah nyanyian orang-orang yang gagah sombong ditiadakan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou shalt bring down the noise of strangers, as the heat in a dry place; [even] the heat with the shadow of a cloud: the branch of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN semesta alam akan menyediakan di gunung Sion ini bagi segala bangsa-bangsa suatu perjamuan dengan masakan yang bergemuk, suatu perjamuan dengan anggur yang tua benar, masakan yang bergemuk dan bersumsum, anggur yang tua yang disaring endapannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And in this mountain shall the LORD of hosts make unto all people a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan di atas gunung ini TUHAN akan mengoyakkan kain perkabungan yang diselubungkan kepada segala suku bangsa dan tudung yang ditudungkan kepada segala bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering cast over all people, and the vail that is spread over all nations.

scripture_data.text_en: He will swallow up death in victory; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for the LORD hath spoken [it].

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu orang akan berkata: "Sesungguhnya, inilah Allah kita, yang kita nanti-nantikan, supaya kita diselamatkan. Inilah TUHAN yang kita nanti-nantikan; marilah kita bersorak-sorak dan bersukacita oleh karena keselamatan yang diadakan-Nya!"
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this [is] our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this [is] the LORD; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab tangan TUHAN akan melindungi gunung ini, tetapi Moab akan diinjak-injak di tempatnya sendiri, sebagai jerami diinjak-injak dalam lobang kotoran.
scripture_data.text_en: For in this mountain shall the hand of the LORD rest, and Moab shall be trodden down under him, even as straw is trodden down for the dunghill.

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu nyanyian ini akan dinyanyikan di tanah Yehuda: "Pada kita ada kota yang kuat, untuk keselamatan kita TUHAN telah memasang tembok dan benteng.
scripture_data.text_en: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah; We have a strong city; salvation will [God] appoint [for] walls and bulwarks.

scripture_data.text_en: Thou wilt keep [him] in perfect peace, [whose] mind [is] stayed [on thee]: because he trusteth in thee.

scripture_data.text_id: Percayalah kepada TUHAN selama-lamanya, sebab TUHAN ALLAH adalah gunung batu yang kekal.
scripture_data.text_en: Trust ye in the LORD for ever: for in the LORD JEHOVAH [is] everlasting strength:

scripture_data.text_en: What shall I say? he hath both spoken unto me, and himself hath done [it]: I shall go softly all my years in the bitterness of my soul.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן רמל יתנלכ ה ה הו ילרמו רדהמ

scripture_data.text_id: Ya Tuhan, karena inilah hatiku mengharapkan Engkau; tenangkanlah rohku, buatlah aku sehat, buatlah aku sembuh!
scripture_data.text_en: O Lord, by these [things men] live, and in all these [things is] the life of my spirit: so wilt thou recover me, and make me to live.
scripture_data.text_orig: יניחהו ינמילחתו יחר יח הלכל יחי היל ינד

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, penderitaan yang pahit menjadi keselamatan bagiku; Engkaulah yang mencegah jiwaku dari lobang kebinasaan. Sebab Engkau telah melemparkan segala dosaku jauh dari hadapan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, for peace I had great bitterness: but thou hast in love to my soul [delivered it] from the pit of corruption: for thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחל וג ירח כלה י יל תחמ יפן קח הו רמ ילרם לל הה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab dunia orang mati tidak dapat mengucap syukur kepada-Mu, dan maut tidak dapat memuji-muji Engkau; orang-orang yang turun ke liang kubur tidak menanti-nanti akan kesetiaan-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: For the grave cannot praise thee, death can [not] celebrate thee: they that go down into the pit cannot hope for thy truth.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל רבידרי ריל שללהי תומ שד ל ל י

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi hanyalah orang yang hidup, dialah yang mengucap syukur kepada-Mu, seperti aku pada hari ini; seorang bapa memberitahukan kesetiaan-Mu kepada anak-anaknya.
scripture_data.text_en: The living, the living, he shall praise thee, as I [do] this day: the father to the children shall make known thy truth.
scripture_data.text_orig: מל ידי ינבל ב ה ינמ די ה יח יח

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN telah datang menyelamatkan aku! Kami hendak main kecapi, seumur hidup kami di rumah TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [was ready] to save me: therefore we will sing my songs to the stringed instruments all the days of our life in the house of the LORD.

scripture_data.text_en: For Isaiah had said, Let them take a lump of figs, and lay [it] for a plaister upon the boil, and he shall recover.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebelum itu Hizkia telah berkata: "Apakah yang akan menjadi tanda, bahwa aku akan pergi ke rumah TUHAN?"

scripture_data.text_id: Pada waktu itu Merodakh-Baladan bin Baladan, raja Babel, menyuruh orang membawa surat dan pemberian kepada Hizkia, sebab telah didengarnya bahwa Hizkia sakit tadinya dan sudah kuat kembali.
scripture_data.text_en: At that time Merodachbaladan, the son of Baladan, king of Babylon, sent letters and a present to Hezekiah: for he had heard that he had been sick, and was recovered.

scripture_data.text_id: Hizkia bersukacita atas kedatangan mereka, lalu diperlihatkannyalah kepada mereka gedung harta bendanya, emas dan perak, rempah-rempah dan minyak yang berharga, segenap gedung persenjataannya dan segala yang terdapat dalam perbendaharaannya. Tidak ada barang yang tidak diperlihatkan Hizkia kepada mereka di istananya dan di seluruh daerah kekuasaannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And Hezekiah was glad of them, and shewed them the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious ointment, and all the house of his armour, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Hezekiah shewed them not.

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah nabi Yesaya kepada raja Hizkia dan bertanya kepadanya: "Apakah yang telah dikatakan orang-orang ini? Dan dari manakah mereka datang?" Jawab Hizkia: "Mereka datang dari negeri yang jauh, dari Babel!"
scripture_data.text_en: Then came Isaiah the prophet unto king Hezekiah, and said unto him, What said these men? and from whence came they unto thee? And Hezekiah said, They are come from a far country unto me, [even] from Babylon.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu tanyanya lagi: "Apakah yang telah dilihat mereka di istanamu?" Jawab Hizkia: "Semua yang ada di istanaku telah mereka lihat. Tidak ada barang yang tidak kuperlihatkan kepada mereka di perbendaharaanku."
scripture_data.text_en: Then said he, What have they seen in thine house? And Hezekiah answered, All that [is] in mine house have they seen: there is nothing among my treasures that I have not shewed them.

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Yesaya berkata kepada Hizkia: "Dengarkanlah firman TUHAN semesta alam!
scripture_data.text_en: Then said Isaiah to Hezekiah, Hear the word of the LORD of hosts:
scripture_data.text_orig: תבץ הוהירב מ הקזחל היי רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, suatu masa akan datang, bahwa segala yang ada dalam istanamu dan yang disimpan oleh nenek moyangmu sampai hari ini akan diangkut ke Babel. Tidak ada barang yang akan ditinggalkan, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, the days come, that all that [is] in thine house, and [that] which thy fathers have laid up in store until this day, shall be carried to Babylon: nothing shall be left, saith the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan dari keturunanmu yang akan kauperoleh, akan diambil orang untuk menjadi sida-sida di istana raja Babel."
scripture_data.text_en: And of thy sons that shall issue from thee, which thou shalt beget, shall they take away; and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.

scripture_data.text_id: Hizkia menjawab kepada Yesaya: "Sungguh baik firman TUHAN yang engkau ucapkan itu!" Tetapi pikirnya: "Asal ada damai dan keamanan seumur hidupku!"
scripture_data.text_en: Then said Hezekiah to Isaiah, Good [is] the word of the LORD which thou hast spoken. He said moreover, For there shall be peace and truth in my days.

scripture_data.text_id: Hiburkanlah, hiburkanlah umat-Ku, demikian firman Allahmu,
scripture_data.text_en: Comfort ye, comfort ye my people, saith your God.

scripture_data.text_id: tenangkanlah hati Yerusalem dan serukanlah kepadanya, bahwa perhambaannya sudah berakhir, bahwa kesalahannya telah diampuni, sebab ia telah menerima hukuman dari tangan TUHAN dua kali lipat karena segala dosanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Speak ye comfortably to Jerusalem, and cry unto her, that her warfare is accomplished, that her iniquity is pardoned: for she hath received of the LORD'S hand double for all her sins.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היתחלכ ילפ הוהי דמ החקל י נו הצרנ י בץ הלמ י היל רקו לרי בלל ר

scripture_data.text_id: Ada suara yang berseru-seru: "Persiapkanlah di padang gurun jalan untuk TUHAN, luruskanlah di padang belantara jalan raya bagi Allah kita!
scripture_data.text_en: The voice of him that crieth in the wilderness, Prepare ye the way of the LORD, make straight in the desert a highway for our God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניהלל הסם הבר רי הוהי ר רד רק לק

scripture_data.text_id: Setiap lembah harus ditutup, dan setiap gunung dan bukit diratakan; tanah yang berbukit-bukit harus menjadi tanah yang rata, dan tanah yang berlekuk-lekuk menjadi dataran;
scripture_data.text_en: Every valley shall be exalted, and every mountain and hill shall be made low: and the crooked shall be made straight, and the rough places plain:

scripture_data.text_id: maka kemuliaan TUHAN akan dinyatakan dan seluruh umat manusia akan melihatnya bersama-sama; sungguh, TUHAN sendiri telah mengatakannya."
scripture_data.text_en: And the glory of the LORD shall be revealed, and all flesh shall see [it] together: for the mouth of the LORD hath spoken [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ר הוהי י י וחי רלכ רו הוהי דב הלגנו

scripture_data.text_id: Ada suara yang berkata: "Berserulah!" Jawabku: "Apakah yang harus kuserukan?" "Seluruh umat manusia adalah seperti rumput dan semua semaraknya seperti bunga di padang.
scripture_data.text_en: The voice said, Cry. And he said, What shall I cry? All flesh [is] grass, and all the goodliness thereof [is] as the flower of the field:

scripture_data.text_id: Rumput menjadi kering, bunga menjadi layu, apabila TUHAN menghembusnya dengan nafas-Nya. Sesungguhnyalah bangsa itu seperti rumput.
scripture_data.text_en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: because the spirit of the LORD bloweth upon it: surely the people [is] grass.

scripture_data.text_id: Rumput menjadi kering, bunga menjadi layu, tetapi firman Allah kita tetap untuk selama-lamanya."
scripture_data.text_en: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.

scripture_data.text_id: Hai Sion, pembawa kabar baik, naiklah ke atas gunung yang tinggi! Hai Yerusalem, pembawa kabar baik, nyaringkanlah suaramu kuat-kuat, nyaringkanlah suaramu, jangan takut! Katakanlah kepada kota-kota Yehuda: "Lihat, itu Allahmu!"
scripture_data.text_en: O Zion, that bringest good tidings, get thee up into the high mountain; O Jerusalem, that bringest good tidings, lift up thy voice with strength; lift [it] up, be not afraid; say unto the cities of Judah, Behold your God!
scripture_data.text_orig: כיהל הה הדהי ירל ירמ יריל ימירה לרי תרבם לק חב ימירה צ תרבם ליל הברה ל

scripture_data.text_id: Lihat, itu Tuhan ALLAH, Ia datang dengan kekuatan dan dengan tangan-Nya Ia berkuasa. Lihat, mereka yang menjadi upah jerih payah-Nya ada bersama-sama Dia, dan mereka yang diperoleh-Nya berjalan di hadapan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, the Lord GOD will come with strong [hand], and his arm shall rule for him: behold, his reward [is] with him, and his work before him.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינפל תפ רכ הה ל הלמ רז בי קזח הוהי ינד הה

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti seorang gembala Ia menggembalakan kawanan ternak-Nya dan menghimpunkannya dengan tangan-Nya; anak-anak domba dipangku-Nya, induk-induk domba dituntun-Nya dengan hati-hati.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall feed his flock like a shepherd: he shall gather the lambs with his arm, and carry [them] in his bosom, [and] shall gently lead those that are with young.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס להני תל י קיחב יל שקי רז הרי רד הר

scripture_data.text_id: Siapa yang menakar air laut dengan lekuk tangannya dan mengukur langit dengan jengkal, menyukat debu tanah dengan takaran, menimbang gunung-gunung dengan dacing, atau bukit-bukit dengan neraca?
scripture_data.text_en: Who hath measured the waters in the hollow of his hand, and meted out heaven with the span, and comprehended the dust of the earth in a measure, and weighed the mountains in scales, and the hills in a balance?
scripture_data.text_orig: ינזמ תבג ירה סל לקו שרה רפ ל לכו תר ימו ימ ל דדמימ

scripture_data.text_id: Siapa yang dapat mengatur Roh TUHAN atau memberi petunjuk kepada-Nya sebagai penasihat?
scripture_data.text_en: Who hath directed the Spirit of the LORD, or [being] his counsellor hath taught him?
scripture_data.text_orig: ידי תצ יו הוהי חרת תימ

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada siapa TUHAN meminta nasihat untuk mendapat pengertian, dan siapa yang mengajar TUHAN untuk menjalankan keadilan, atau siapa mengajar Dia pengetahuan dan memberi Dia petunjuk supaya Ia bertindak dengan pengertian?
scripture_data.text_en: With whom took he counsel, and [who] instructed him, and taught him in the path of judgment, and taught him knowledge, and shewed to him the way of understanding?
scripture_data.text_orig: ידי תנב רדו תד הדליו מ חר הדליו הניביו שן ימת

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, bangsa-bangsa adalah seperti setitik air dalam timba dan dianggap seperti sebutir debu pada neraca. Sesungguhnya, pulau-pulau tidak lebih dari abu halus beratnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, the nations [are] as a drop of a bucket, and are counted as the small dust of the balance: behold, he taketh up the isles as a very little thing.
scripture_data.text_orig: לי ק י ה בחן ינזמ קחכ ילמ רמ י ה

scripture_data.text_id: Libanon tidak mencukupi bagi kayu api dan margasatwanya tidak mencukupi bagi korban bakaran.
scripture_data.text_en: And Lebanon [is] not sufficient to burn, nor the beasts thereof sufficient for a burnt offering.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הל י י תחו ר י י נבל

scripture_data.text_id: Segala bangsa seperti tidak ada di hadapan-Nya mereka dianggap-Nya hampa dan sia-sia saja.
scripture_data.text_en: All nations before him [are] as nothing; and they are counted to him less than nothing, and vanity.
scripture_data.text_orig: לבחן התו ספמ גן י יהל

scripture_data.text_id: Jadi dengan siapa hendak kamu samakan Allah, dan apa yang dapat kamu anggap serupa dengan Dia?
scripture_data.text_en: To whom then will ye liken God? or what likeness will ye compare unto him?
scripture_data.text_orig: ל כר תמהמ ל יד ימלו

scripture_data.text_id: Patungkah? Tukang besi menuangnya, dan pandai emas melapisinya dengan emas, membuat rantai-rantai perak untuknya.
scripture_data.text_en: The workman melteth a graven image, and the goldsmith spreadeth it over with gold, and casteth silver chains.
scripture_data.text_orig: רץ ס תקתר רי בה רצו רח סנ לסה

scripture_data.text_id: Orang yang mendirikan arca, memilih kayu yang tidak lekas busuk, mencari tukang yang ahli untuk menegakkan patung yang tidak lekas goyang.
scripture_data.text_en: He that [is] so impoverished that he hath no oblation chooseth a tree [that] will not rot; he seeketh unto him a cunning workman to prepare a graven image, [that] shall not be moved.
scripture_data.text_orig: י ל לס יכהל לבי כח רח רחבי בקריל ש המר סמה

scripture_data.text_id: Tidakkah kamu tahu? Tidakkah kamu dengar? Tidakkah diberitahukan kepadamu dari mulanya? Tidakkah kamu mengerti dari sejak dasar bumi diletakkan?
scripture_data.text_en: Have ye not known? have ye not heard? hath it not been told you from the beginning? have ye not understood from the foundations of the earth?
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה תדסם תניבה לה כל רמ דה לה מת לה דת לה

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang bertakhta di atas bulatan bumi yang penduduknya seperti belalang; Dia yang membentangkan langit seperti kain dan memasangnya seperti kemah kediaman!
scripture_data.text_en: [It is] he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof [are] as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:
scripture_data.text_orig: תבל לה חמו ימ קך הה יבגח היביו שרה גחל בה

scripture_data.text_id: Dia yang membuat pembesar-pembesar menjadi tidak ada dan yang menjadikan hakim-hakim dunia sia-sia saja!
scripture_data.text_en: That bringeth the princes to nothing; he maketh the judges of the earth as vanity.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה ה שר יפ יל ינזר תה

scripture_data.text_id: Baru saja mereka ditanam, baru saja mereka ditaburkan, baru saja cangkok mereka berakar di dalam tanah, sudah juga Ia meniup kepada mereka, sehingga mereka kering dan diterbangkan oleh badai seperti jerami.
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, they shall not be planted; yea, they shall not be sown: yea, their stock shall not take root in the earth: and he shall also blow upon them, and they shall wither, and the whirlwind shall take them away as stubble.

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan siapa hendak kamu samakan Aku, seakan-akan Aku seperti dia? firman Yang Mahakudus.
scripture_data.text_en: To whom then will ye liken me, or shall I be equal? saith the Holy One.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק רמי הוו ינידת ימלו

scripture_data.text_id: Arahkanlah matamu ke langit dan lihatlah: siapa yang menciptakan semua bintang itu dan menyuruh segenap tentara mereka keluar, sambil memanggil nama mereka sekaliannya? Satupun tiada yang tak hadir, oleh sebab Ia maha kuasa dan maha kuat.
scripture_data.text_en: Lift up your eyes on high, and behold who hath created these [things], that bringeth out their host by number: he calleth them all by names by the greatness of his might, for that [he is] strong in power; not one faileth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רן ל י ח שיו ינ ברמ רקי כל בץ רסמב יצה ה רבימ ר כיני רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapakah engkau berkata demikian, hai Yakub, dan berkata begini, hai Israel: "Hidupku tersembunyi dari TUHAN, dan hakku tidak diperhatikan Allahku?"
scripture_data.text_en: Why sayest thou, O Jacob, and speakest, O Israel, My way is hid from the LORD, and my judgment is passed over from my God?

scripture_data.text_id: Tidakkah kautahu, dan tidakkah kaudengar? TUHAN ialah Allah kekal yang menciptakan bumi dari ujung ke ujung; Ia tidak menjadi lelah dan tidak menjadi lesu, tidak terduga pengertian-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Hast thou not known? hast thou not heard, [that] the everlasting God, the LORD, the Creator of the ends of the earth, fainteth not, neither is weary? [there is] no searching of his understanding.

scripture_data.text_id: Dia memberi kekuatan kepada yang lelah dan menambah semangat kepada yang tiada berdaya.
scripture_data.text_en: He giveth power to the faint; and to [them that have] no might he increaseth strength.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרי המצ ינ יל ח ל תנ

scripture_data.text_id: Orang-orang muda menjadi lelah dan lesu dan teruna-teruna jatuh tersandung,
scripture_data.text_en: Even the youths shall faint and be weary, and the young men shall utterly fall:
scripture_data.text_orig: לי ל ירחב גיו ירן פיו

scripture_data.text_id: tetapi orang-orang yang menanti-nantikan TUHAN mendapat kekuatan baru: mereka seumpama rajawali yang naik terbang dengan kekuatan sayapnya; mereka berlari dan tidak menjadi lesu, mereka berjalan dan tidak menjadi lelah.
scripture_data.text_en: But they that wait upon the LORD shall renew [their] strength; they shall mount up with wings as eagles; they shall run, and not be weary; [and] they shall walk, and not faint.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף פיי לו כלי גיי לו צרי יר רב לי חכ פילחי הוהי יקו

scripture_data.text_id: Dengarkanlah Aku dengan berdiam diri, hai pulau-pulau; hendaklah bangsa-bangsa mendapat kekuatan baru! Biarlah mereka datang mendekat, kemudian berbicara; baiklah kita tampil bersama-sama untuk berperkara!
scripture_data.text_en: Keep silence before me, O islands; and let the people renew [their] strength: let them come near; then let them speak: let us come near together to judgment.
