scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman TUHAN: "Catatlah orang ini sebagai orang yang tak punya anak, sebagai laki-laki yang tidak pernah berhasil dalam hidupnya; sebab seorangpun dari keturunannya tidak akan berhasil duduk di atas takhta Daud dan memerintah kembali di Yehuda."
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the LORD, Write ye this man childless, a man [that] shall not prosper in his days: for no man of his seed shall prosper, sitting upon the throne of David, and ruling any more in Judah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדהי ד למ דוד ל בי י רמ חלצי ל י וימי חלציל רב יריר הה יהת בת הוהי רמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: "Celakalah para gembala yang membiarkan kambing domba gembalaan-Ku hilang dan terserak!" demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Woe be unto the pastors that destroy and scatter the sheep of my pasture! saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין יתירם צת יצפמ ידם יר יה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu beginilah firman TUHAN, Allah Israel, terhadap para gembala yang menggembalakan bangsaku: "Kamu telah membiarkan kambing domba-Ku terserak dan tercerai-berai, dan kamu tidak menjaganya. Maka ketahuilah, Aku akan membalaskan kepadamu perbuatan-perbuatanmu yang jahat, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thus saith the LORD God of Israel against the pastors that feed my people; Ye have scattered my flock, and driven them away, and have not visited them: behold, I will visit upon you the evil of your doings, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין כיללם רת כיל דקפ יננה ת דקף לו חו ינצת תצפה ית ירה ירהל לרי יהל הוהי רמה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Aku sendiri akan mengumpulkan sisa-sisa kambing domba-Ku dari segala negeri ke mana Aku menceraiberaikan mereka, dan Aku akan membawa mereka kembali ke padang mereka: mereka akan berkembang biak dan bertambah banyak.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will gather the remnant of my flock out of all countries whither I have driven them, and will bring them again to their folds; and they shall be fruitful and increase.
scripture_data.text_orig: ברו רפ הונל הת יתבהו ת יחהר תצרה למ ינצ תירת שק ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mengangkat atas mereka gembala-gembala yang akan menggembalakan mereka, sehingga mereka tidak takut lagi, tidak terkejut dan tidak hilang seekorpun, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will set up shepherds over them which shall feed them: and they shall fear no more, nor be dismayed, neither shall they be lacking, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהין דקי לו חילו ד ריילו רו יר היל יתמקהו

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, waktunya akan datang, demikianlah firman TUHAN, bahwa Aku akan menumbuhkan Tunas adil bagi Daud. Ia akan memerintah sebagai raja yang bijaksana dan akan melakukan keadilan dan kebenaran di negeri.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that I will raise unto David a righteous Branch, and a King shall reign and prosper, and shall execute judgment and justice in the earth.
scripture_data.text_orig: שר הקדצ מ הו ליהו לם למ קיץ חמצ דודל יתמקהו הוהין י ימי הה

scripture_data.text_id: Dalam zamannya Yehuda akan dibebaskan, dan Israel akan hidup dengan tenteram; dan inilah namanya yang diberikan orang kepadanya: TUHAN keadilan kita.
scripture_data.text_en: In his days Judah shall be saved, and Israel shall dwell safely: and this [is] his name whereby he shall be called, THE LORD OUR RIGHTEOUSNESS.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס נקדצ הוהי רקיר מהזו חבל י לריו הדהי וימי

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu, demikianlah firman TUHAN, sesungguhnya, waktunya akan datang, bahwa orang tidak lagi mengatakan: Demi TUHAN yang hidup yang menuntun orang Israel keluar dari tanah Mesir!,
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore, behold, the days come, saith the LORD, that they shall no more say, The LORD liveth, which brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt;
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שרמ לרי ינת הלה ר הוהייח ד רמילו הוהין י ימיהה כל

scripture_data.text_id: melainkan: Demi TUHAN yang hidup yang menuntun dan membawa pulang keturunan kaum Israel keluar dari tanah utara dan dari segala negeri ke mana Ia telah menceraiberaikan mereka!, maka mereka akan tinggal di tanahnya sendiri."
scripture_data.text_en: But, The LORD liveth, which brought up and which led the seed of the house of Israel out of the north country, and from all countries whither I had driven them; and they shall dwell in their own land.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמדל ביו יחה ר תצרה למ הנפצ שרמ לרי תי רזת יבה רו הלה ר הוהייח י

scripture_data.text_id: Mengenai nabi-nabi. Hatiku hancur dalam dadaku, segala tulangku goyah. Keadaanku seperti orang mabuk, seperti laki-laki yang terlalu banyak minum anggur, oleh karena TUHAN dan oleh karena firman-Nya yang kudus.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine heart within me is broken because of the prophets; all my bones shake; I am like a drunken man, and like a man whom wine hath overcome, because of the LORD, and because of the words of his holiness.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק ירב ינמ הוהי ינמ יי רב רבגכ ר י יתייה יתמצל פחר ירקב יל רנ יבל

scripture_data.text_id: Negeri telah penuh dengan orang-orang berzinah; sungguh, oleh karena kutuk ini gersanglah negeri dan layulah padang-padang rumput di gurun; apa yang dikejar mereka adalah kejahatan, dan kekuatan mereka adalah ketidakadilan.
scripture_data.text_en: For the land is full of adulterers; for because of swearing the land mourneth; the pleasant places of the wilderness are dried up, and their course is evil, and their force [is] not right.
scripture_data.text_orig: כל תרבג הר תצרם יהו רדמ תן בי שרה הלב הל ינמי שרה הלמ יפנם י

scripture_data.text_id: "Sungguh, baik nabi maupun imam berlaku fasik; di rumah-Kupun juga Aku mendapati kejahatan mereka, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: For both prophet and priest are profane; yea, in my house have I found their wickedness, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין תר יתצמ יתיב פנח הג יבנגי

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu jalan mereka akan seperti jalan-jalan yang licin bagi mereka; di dalam gelap mereka akan terserandung dan akan jatuh di sana; sebab Aku akan mendatangkan malapetaka atas mereka dalam tahun waktu mereka dihukum, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore their way shall be unto them as slippery [ways] in the darkness: they shall be driven on, and fall therein: for I will bring evil upon them, [even] the year of their visitation, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין תק תנ הר היל יבי ב לפנו חי הלפ תלקלח הל רד היהי כל

scripture_data.text_id: Di kalangan para nabi Samaria Aku melihat ada yang kurang pantas: mereka bernubuat demi Baal dan menyesatkan umat-Ku Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: And I have seen folly in the prophets of Samaria; they prophesied in Baal, and caused my people Israel to err.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לרית ית תו לב ה הלפת יתיר רמ ייבנב

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi di kalangan para nabi Yerusalem Aku melihat ada yang mengerikan: mereka berzinah dan berkelakuan tidak jujur; mereka menguatkan hati orang-orang yang berbuat jahat, sehingga tidak ada seorangpun yang bertobat dari kejahatannya; semuanya mereka telah menjadi seperti Sodom bagi-Ku dan penduduknya seperti Gomora."
scripture_data.text_en: I have seen also in the prophets of Jerusalem an horrible thing: they commit adultery, and walk in lies: they strengthen also the hands of evildoers, that none doth return from his wickedness: they are all of them unto me as Sodom, and the inhabitants thereof as Gomorrah.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הרמ היביו דס כ יליה תרמ י בילבל ירם ידי קחו רק להו נ הרר יתיר לרי יבנב

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu beginilah firman TUHAN semesta alam mengenai para nabi itu: "Sesungguhnya, Aku akan memberi mereka makan ipuh dan minum racun, sebab dari para nabi Yerusalem telah meluas kefasikan ke seluruh negeri."
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thus saith the LORD of hosts concerning the prophets; Behold, I will feed them with wormwood, and make them drink the water of gall: for from the prophets of Jerusalem is profaneness gone forth into all the land.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף שרהלכל הנח הצי לרי ייבן תמ י רימ יתקהו הנל ת ליכם יננה יבהל תבץ הוהי רמה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman TUHAN semesta alam: "Janganlah dengarkan perkataan para nabi yang bernubuat kepada kamu! Mereka hanya memberi harapan yang sia-sia kepadamu, dan hanya mengungkapkan penglihatan rekaan hatinya sendiri, bukan apa yang datang dari mulut TUHAN;
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the LORD of hosts, Hearken not unto the words of the prophets that prophesy unto you: they make you vain: they speak a vision of their own heart, [and] not out of the mouth of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ימ ל רדי ל זח כת הה ילהם כל יה יבה ירבל מל תבץ הוהי רמה

scripture_data.text_id: mereka selalu berkata kepada orang-orang yang menista firman TUHAN: Kamu akan selamat! dan kepada setiap orang yang mengikuti kedegilan hatinya mereka berkata: Malapetaka tidak akan menimpa kamu!"
scripture_data.text_en: They say still unto them that despise me, The LORD hath said, Ye shall have peace; and they say unto every one that walketh after the imagination of his own heart, No evil shall come upon you.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר כיל בתל רמ ל תרר לה לכו כל היהי ל הוהי ר יצנמל רמ ירמ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab siapakah yang hadir dalam dewan musyawarah TUHAN, sehingga ia memperhatikan dan mendengar firman-Nya? Siapakah yang memperhatikan firman-Nya dan mendengarnya?
scripture_data.text_en: For who hath stood in the counsel of the LORD, and hath perceived and heard his word? who hath marked his word, and heard [it]?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס מו רב ירב ביקהימ רבת מיו ריו הוהי דס דמ ימ י

scripture_data.text_id: Lihatlah, angin badai TUHAN, yakni kehangatan murka, telah keluar menyambar, angin puting beliung dan turun menimpa kepala orang-orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, a whirlwind of the LORD is gone forth in fury, even a grievous whirlwind: it shall fall grievously upon the head of the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: לחי יר ר ל ללחתמ רסו הצי המח הוהי תרס הה

scripture_data.text_id: Murka TUHAN tidak akan surut, sampai Ia telah melaksanakan dan mewujudkan apa yang dirancang-Nya dalam hati-Nya; pada hari-hari yang terakhir kamu akan benar-benar mengerti hal itu.
scripture_data.text_en: The anger of the LORD shall not return, until he have executed, and till he have performed the thoughts of his heart: in the latter days ye shall consider it perfectly.
scripture_data.text_orig: הני ב ננת ימה תירח ל תזם מיקהדו תד הוהי בי ל

scripture_data.text_id: "Aku tidak mengutus para nabi itu, namun mereka giat; Aku tidak berfirman kepada mereka, namun mereka bernubuat.
scripture_data.text_en: I have not sent these prophets, yet they ran: I have not spoken to them, yet they prophesied.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ הו היל ירדל צר הו יבהת יחלל

scripture_data.text_id: Sekiranya mereka hadir dalam dewan musyawarah-Ku, niscayalah mereka akan mengabarkan firman-Ku kepada umat-Ku, membawa mereka kembali dari tingkah langkahnya yang jahat dan dari perbuatan-perbuatannya yang jahat.
scripture_data.text_en: But if they had stood in my counsel, and had caused my people to hear my words, then they should have turned them from their evil way, and from the evil of their doings.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היללם רמ רה רמ ביו ית ירבד מיו ידס דמו

scripture_data.text_id: Masakan Aku ini hanya Allah yang dari dekat, demikianlah firman TUHAN, dan bukan Allah yang dari jauh juga?
scripture_data.text_en: [Am] I a God at hand, saith the LORD, and not a God afar off?
scripture_data.text_orig: קחרמ יהל לו הוהין ינ ברמ יהלה

scripture_data.text_id: Sekiranya ada seseorang menyembunyikan diri dalam tempat persembunyian, masakan Aku tidak melihat dia? demikianlah firman TUHAN. Tidakkah Aku memenuhi langit dan bumi? demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Can any hide himself in secret places that I shall not see him? saith the LORD. Do not I fill heaven and earth? saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין למ ינ שרהתו ימהת לה הוהין רל ינו ירס י רתי

scripture_data.text_id: Aku telah mendengar apa yang dikatakan oleh para nabi, yang bernubuat palsu demi nama-Ku dengan mengatakan: Aku telah bermimpi, aku telah bermimpi!
scripture_data.text_en: I have heard what the prophets said, that prophesy lies in my name, saying, I have dreamed, I have dreamed.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימלח ימלח רמל רק ימ יה יבה רמר ת ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Sampai bilamana hal itu ada dalam hati para nabi yang bernubuat palsu dan yang menubuatkan tipu rekaan hatinya sendiri,
scripture_data.text_en: How long shall [this] be in the heart of the prophets that prophesy lies? yea, [they are] prophets of the deceit of their own heart;
scripture_data.text_orig: ל תמר ייבנ רקה ינ יבה בל יה יתמד

scripture_data.text_id: yang merancang membuat umat-Ku melupakan nama-Ku dengan mimpi-mimpinya yang mereka ceritakan seorang kepada seorang, sama seperti nenek moyang mereka melupakan nama-Ku oleh karena Baal?
scripture_data.text_en: Which think to cause my people to forget my name by their dreams which they tell every man to his neighbour, as their fathers have forgotten my name for Baal.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ימת תב חכ ר הרל י רסי ר תמלח ימ ית חיהל יבחה

scripture_data.text_id: Nabi yang beroleh mimpi, biarlah menceritakan mimpinya itu, dan nabi yang beroleh firman-Ku, biarlah menceritakan firman-Ku itu dengan benar! Apakah sangkut-paut jerami dengan gandum? demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: The prophet that hath a dream, let him tell a dream; and he that hath my word, let him speak my word faithfully. What [is] the chaff to the wheat? saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין רהת בלהם תמ ירב רדי ירב רו לח רסי לח ר יבה

scripture_data.text_id: Bukankah firman-Ku seperti api, demikianlah firman TUHAN dan seperti palu yang menghancurkan bukit batu?
scripture_data.text_en: [Is] not my word like as a fire? saith the LORD; and like a hammer [that] breaketh the rock in pieces?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לס שצפי יפכ הוהין ירבד הכ לה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu, sesungguhnya, Aku akan menjadi lawan para nabi, demikianlah firman TUHAN, yang mencuri firman-Ku masing-masing dari temannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore, behold, I [am] against the prophets, saith the LORD, that steal my words every one from his neighbour.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר תמ י ירבד יבגם הוהין יבהל יננה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, Aku akan menjadi lawan para nabi, demikianlah firman TUHAN, yang memakai lidahnya sewenang-wenang untuk mengutarakan firman ilahi.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, I [am] against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
scripture_data.text_orig: ן מנו נל יחקה הוהין יבהל יננה

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, Aku akan menjadi lawan mereka yang menubuatkan mimpi-mimpi dusta, demikianlah firman TUHAN, dan yang menceritakannya serta menyesatkan umat-Ku dengan dustanya dan dengan bualnya. Aku ini tidak pernah mengutus mereka dan tidak pernah memerintahkan mereka. Mereka sama sekali tiada berguna untuk bangsa ini, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, I [am] against them that prophesy false dreams, saith the LORD, and do tell them, and cause my people to err by their lies, and by their lightness; yet I sent them not, nor commanded them: therefore they shall not profit this people at all, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין ההל לייל ליהו יתיצ לו יחלל יכנו תזחפב הירק ית תו רסיו הוהין רק תמלח ינל יננה

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila bangsa ini baik nabi ataupun imam bertanya kepadamu: Apakah Sabda yang dibebankan oleh TUHAN?, maka jawablah mereka: Kamulah beban itu! Sebab itu kamu akan Kubuang dari hadapan-Ku, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And when this people, or the prophet, or a priest, shall ask thee, saying, What [is] the burden of the LORD? thou shalt then say unto them, What burden? I will even forsake you, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין כת ינו מהמת היל רמו הוהי מהם רמל הכ יבה הה ה לייכו

scripture_data.text_id: Adapun nabi atau imam atau rakyat yang masih berbicara tentang Sabda yang dibebankan oleh TUHAN, kepada orang itu dan kepada keluarganya akan Kulakukan pembalasan.
scripture_data.text_en: And [as for] the prophet, and the priest, and the people, that shall say, The burden of the LORD, I will even punish that man and his house.
scripture_data.text_orig: תילו הה יהל ידקפ הוהי ם רמי ר הו ההו יבהו

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah harus kamu katakan, masing-masing kepada temannya dan masing-masing kepada saudaranya: Apakah jawab TUHAN? atau: Apakah firman TUHAN?
scripture_data.text_en: Thus shall ye say every one to his neighbour, and every one to his brother, What hath the LORD answered? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי רהמ הוהי הנהם ויחל יו הרל י רמת ה

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Sabda yang dibebankan oleh TUHAN janganlah kamu sebut-sebutkan lagi, sebab yang menjadi beban bagi setiap orang ialah perkataannya sendiri, oleh karena kamu telah memutarbalikkan perkataan-perkataan Allah yang hidup, TUHAN semesta alam, Allah kita.
scripture_data.text_en: And the burden of the LORD shall ye mention no more: for every man's word shall be his burden; for ye have perverted the words of the living God, of the LORD of hosts our God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניהל תבץ הוהי יח יהל ירבת כפהו רב יל היהי ה י דרזת ל הוהי מ

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah engkau harus berkata kepada nabi: Apakah jawab TUHAN kepadamu? atau: Apakah firman TUHAN?
scripture_data.text_en: Thus shalt thou say to the prophet, What hath the LORD answered thee? and, What hath the LORD spoken?
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי רהמ הוהי נהם יבהל רמת ה

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi jika kamu masih berbicara tentang Sabda yang dibebankan oleh TUHAN, maka beginilah firman TUHAN: Oleh karena kamu masih memakai ungkapan Sabda yang dibebankan oleh TUHAN itu, sekalipun Aku mengutus orang kepadamu mengatakan: Janganlah kamu berbicara tentang Sabda yang dibebankan oleh TUHAN,
scripture_data.text_en: But since ye say, The burden of the LORD; therefore thus saith the LORD; Because ye say this word, The burden of the LORD, and I have sent unto you, saying, Ye shall not say, The burden of the LORD;
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ם רמת ל רמל כיל חלו הוהי ם הה רבהת כרמ י הוהי רמ ה כל רמ הוהי מו

scripture_data.text_id: maka sesungguhnya, Aku akan menangkap kamu dan membuang kamu dari hadapan-Ku, kamu serta kota yang telah Kuberikan kepadamu dan kepada nenek moyangmu itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore, behold, I, even I, will utterly forget you, and I will forsake you, and the city that I gave you and your fathers, [and cast you] out of my presence:
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ למ כיתבלו כל יתנ ר ריהתו כת ינו נ כת יתינו יננה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan menimpakan kepadamu aib yang kekal dan noda yang kekal yang tidak akan terlupakan."
scripture_data.text_en: And I will bring an everlasting reproach upon you, and a perpetual shame, which shall not be forgotten.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס חכת ל ר ל תלכ ל תרח כיל יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: Lihatlah, TUHAN memperlihatkan kepadaku dua keranjang buah ara berdiri di hadapan bait TUHAN. Hal itu terjadi sesudah Nebukadnezar, raja Babel, mengangkut ke dalam pembuangan Yekhonya bin Yoyakim, raja Yehuda, beserta para pemuka Yehuda, tukang dan pandai besi dari Yerusalem dan membawa mereka ke Babel.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD shewed me, and, behold, two baskets of figs [were] set before the temple of the LORD, after that Nebuchadrezzar king of Babylon had carried away captive Jeconiah the son of Jehoiakim king of Judah, and the princes of Judah, with the carpenters and smiths, from Jerusalem, and had brought them to Babylon.

scripture_data.text_en: And I will be found of you, saith the LORD: and I will turn away your captivity, and I will gather you from all the nations, and from all the places whither I have driven you, saith the LORD; and I will bring you again into the place whence I caused you to be carried away captive.

scripture_data.text_en: Therefore fear thou not, O my servant Jacob, saith the LORD; neither be dismayed, O Israel: for, lo, I will save thee from afar, and thy seed from the land of their captivity; and Jacob shall return, and shall be in rest, and be quiet, and none shall make [him] afraid.

scripture_data.text_en: Therefore all they that devour thee shall be devoured; and all thine adversaries, every one of them, shall go into captivity; and they that spoil thee shall be a spoil, and all that prey upon thee will I give for a prey.

scripture_data.text_en: And out of them shall proceed thanksgiving and the voice of them that make merry: and I will multiply them, and they shall not be few; I will also glorify them, and they shall not be small.

scripture_data.text_en: And the king of Babylon smote them, and put them to death in Riblah in the land of Hamath. Thus Judah was carried away captive out of his own land.

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian dalam tahun ketiga puluh tujuh sesudah Yoyakhin, raja Yehuda, dibuang, dalam bulan yang kedua belas, pada tanggal dua puluh lima bulan itu, maka Ewil-Merodakh, raja Babel, dalam tahun ia menjadi raja, menunjukkan belas kasihannya kepada Yoyakhin, raja Yehuda, dengan melepaskannya dari penjara.
scripture_data.text_en: And it came to pass in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, in the five and twentieth [day] of the month, [that] Evilmerodach king of Babylon in the [first] year of his reign lifted up the head of Jehoiachin king of Judah, and brought him forth out of prison,
scripture_data.text_orig: לה ילה תימ ת צו הדהילם יכיהי רת תכלם תנ לב למ דרמליו נ דחל המחו יר דח ר ינ הדהילם כיהי תלגל הנ בו ילב יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan tentang belanjanya, raja Babel selalu memberikannya kepadanya, sekadar yang perlu tiap-tiap hari, selama hidupnya, sampai hari matinya.
scripture_data.text_en: And [for] his diet, there was a continual diet given him of the king of Babylon, every day a portion until the day of his death, all the days of his life.

scripture_data.text_id: Ah, betapa terpencilnya kota itu, yang dahulu ramai! Laksana seorang jandalah ia, yang dahulu agung di antara bangsa-bangsa. Yang dahulu ratu di antara kota-kota, sekarang menjadi jajahan.
scripture_data.text_en: How doth the city sit solitary, [that was] full of people! [how] is she become as a widow! she [that was] great among the nations, [and] princess among the provinces, [how] is she become tributary!
scripture_data.text_orig: ס סמל התיה תניד יתר יב יתר הנמל התיה יתר ריה דדב הבי הכי

scripture_data.text_id: Pada malam hari tersedu-sedu ia menangis, air matanya bercucuran di pipi; dari semua kekasihnya, tak ada seorangpun yang menghibur dia. Semua temannya mengkhianatinya, mereka menjadi seterunya.
scripture_data.text_en: She weepeth sore in the night, and her tears [are] on her cheeks: among all her lovers she hath none to comfort [her]: all her friends have dealt treacherously with her, they are become her enemies.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יביל ל יה ב דג הירל היבהלמ חנם לי יחל ל תמדו הלי הבת כ

scripture_data.text_id: Yehuda telah ditinggalkan penduduknya karena sengsara dan karena perbudakan yang berat; ia tinggal di tengah-tengah bangsa-bangsa, namun tidak mendapat ketenteraman; siapa saja yang menyerang dapat memasukinya pada saat ia terdesak.
scripture_data.text_en: Judah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude: she dwelleth among the heathen, she findeth no rest: all her persecutors overtook her between the straits.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירצה י הגיה היפדרל חנמ הצמ ל יב הבי יה הדב ברמ ינמ הדהי התל

scripture_data.text_id: Jalan-jalan ke Sion diliputi dukacita, karena pengunjung-pengunjung perayaan tiada; sunyi senyaplah segala pintu gerbangnya, berkeluh kesahlah imam-imamnya; bersedih pedih dara-daranya; dan dia sendiri pilu hatinya.
scripture_data.text_en: The ways of Zion do mourn, because none come to the solemn feasts: all her gates are desolate: her priests sigh, her virgins are afflicted, and she [is] in bitterness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לרם יהו תג היתלת יחנן הינה יממ הירל דם י ילמ תלב צ יכר

scripture_data.text_id: Lawan-lawan menguasainya, seteru-seterunya berbahagia. Sungguh, TUHAN membuatnya merana, karena banyak pelanggarannya; kanak-kanaknya berjalan di depan lawan sebagai tawanan.
scripture_data.text_en: Her adversaries are the chief, her enemies prosper; for the LORD hath afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her children are gone into captivity before the enemy.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רצינפל יב כלה הילל היבר ל גה הוהיי ל היבי רל הירצ יה

scripture_data.text_id: Lenyaplah dari puteri Sion segala kemuliaannya; pemimpin-pemimpinnya bagaikan rusa yang tidak menemukan padang rumput; mereka berjalan tanpa daya di depan yang mengejarnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And from the daughter of Zion all her beauty is departed: her princes are become like harts [that] find no pasture, and they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס דר ינפל חכלב כלו הרמ צמל יל היר יה רדהל צתמתמ צו

scripture_data.text_id: Terkenanglah Yerusalem, pada hari-hari sengsara dan penderitaannya, akan segala harta benda yang dimilikinya dahulu kala; tatkala penduduknya jatuh ke tangan lawan, dan tak ada penolong baginya, para lawan memandangnya, dan tertawa karena keruntuhannya.
scripture_data.text_en: Jerusalem remembered in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that she had in the days of old, when her people fell into the hand of the enemy, and none did help her: the adversaries saw her, [and] did mock at her sabbaths.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס המ ל קח ירצ הר ל רז יו רצדי לפנ דק ימימ יה ר הידמחם ל הידרמ ינ ימי לרי הרכז

scripture_data.text_id: Yerusalem sangat berdosa, sehingga najis adanya; semua yang dahulu menghormatinya, sekarang menghinanya, karena melihat telanjangnya; dan dia sendiri berkeluh kesah, dan memalingkan mukanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Jerusalem hath grievously sinned; therefore she is removed: all that honoured her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yea, she sigheth, and turneth backward.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רח בו החנן יה תור רי הליה הידכמל התיה הדינל ל לרי הח ח

scripture_data.text_id: Kenajisannya melekat pada ujung kainnya; ia tak berpikir akan akhirnya, sangatlah dalam ia jatuh, tiada orang yang menghiburnya. "Ya, TUHAN, lihatlah sengsaraku, karena si seteru membesarkan dirinya!"
scripture_data.text_en: Her filthiness [is] in her skirts; she remembereth not her last end; therefore she came down wonderfully: she had no comforter. O LORD, behold my affliction: for the enemy hath magnified [himself].
scripture_data.text_orig: ס בי ליגה י יינת הוהי הר ל חנם י יל דרו תירח הרכז ל היל תמ

scripture_data.text_id: Si lawan mengulurkan tangannya kepada segala harta bendanya; bahkan harus dilihatnya bagaimana bangsa-bangsa masuk ke dalam tempat kudusnya, padahal Engkau, ya TUHAN, telah melarang mereka untuk masuk jemaah-Mu.
scripture_data.text_en: The adversary hath spread out his hand upon all her pleasant things: for she hath seen [that] the heathen entered into her sanctuary, whom thou didst command [that] they should not enter into thy congregation.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ל להב ביל התיצ ר קמ יג התרי הימחמל ל רצ ר די

scripture_data.text_id: Berkeluh kesah seluruh penduduknya, sedang mereka mencari roti; harta benda mereka berikan ganti makanan, untuk menyambung hidupnya. "Lihatlah, ya TUHAN, pandanglah, betapa hina aku ini!
scripture_data.text_en: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for meat to relieve the soul: see, O LORD, and consider; for I am become vile.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הללז יתייה י היהו הוהי הר פנ ביהל לכ הימחמ הימחמ נתנ חל יבם יחנן ל

scripture_data.text_id: Acuh tak acuhkah kamu sekalian yang berlalu? Pandanglah dan lihatlah, apakah ada kesedihan seperti kesedihan yang ditimpakan TUHAN kepadaku, untuk membuat aku merana tatkala murka-Nya menyala-nyala!
scripture_data.text_en: [Is it] nothing to you, all ye that pass by? behold, and see if there be any sorrow like unto my sorrow, which is done unto me, wherewith the LORD hath afflicted [me] in the day of his fierce anger.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רח י הוהי הגה ר יל לל ר יבכמ בכם י ר יה רד ירבל כיל ל

scripture_data.text_id: Dari atas dikirim-Nya api masuk ke dalam tulang-tulangku; dihamparkan-Nya jaring di muka kakiku, didesak-Nya aku mundur; aku dibuat-Nya terkejut, kesakitan sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: From above hath he sent fire into my bones, and it prevaileth against them: he hath spread a net for my feet, he hath turned me back: he hath made me desolate [and] faint all the day.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הו הל הממ יננתן רח ינביה ילגרל תר ר הרו יתמצ חל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Segala pelanggaranku adalah kuk yang berat, suatu jalinan yang dibuat tangan Tuhan, yang ditaruh di atas tengkukku, sehingga melumpuhkan kekuatanku; Tuhan telah menyerahkan aku ke tangan orang-orang, yang tidak dapat kutentangi.
scripture_data.text_en: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand: they are wreathed, [and] come up upon my neck: he hath made my strength to fall, the Lord hath delivered me into [their] hands, [from whom] I am not able to rise up.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ק לכל ידי ינד יננתן יח ליכה ירצל ל גרי די י ל דקנ

scripture_data.text_id: Tuhan membuang semua pahlawanku yang ada dalam lingkunganku; Ia menyelenggarakan pesta menentang aku untuk membinasakan teruna-terunaku; Tuhan telah menginjak-injak puteri Yehuda, dara itu, seperti orang mengirik memeras anggur.
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord hath trodden under foot all my mighty [men] in the midst of me: he hath called an assembly against me to crush my young men: the Lord hath trodden the virgin, the daughter of Judah, [as] in a winepress.

scripture_data.text_id: Karena inilah aku menangis, mataku mencucurkan air; karena jauh dari padaku penghibur yang dapat menyegarkan jiwaku; bingunglah anak-anakku, karena terlampau kuat si seteru."
scripture_data.text_en: For these [things] I weep; mine eye, mine eye runneth down with water, because the comforter that should relieve my soul is far from me: my children are desolate, because the enemy prevailed.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס בי רבג י יממ ינב יה יפן בימ חנם ימ קחרי י הדרי יני יני הכב ינ הל

scripture_data.text_id: Sion mengulurkan tangannya, tetapi tak ada orang yang menghiburnya; terhadap Yakub dikerahkan TUHAN tetangga-tetangganya sebagai lawan. Yerusalem telah menjadi najis di tengah-tengah mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Zion spreadeth forth her hands, [and there is] none to comfort her: the LORD hath commanded concerning Jacob, [that] his adversaries [should be] round about him: Jerusalem is as a menstruous woman among them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היני הנל לרי התיה וירצ ויביבס בקיל הוהי הצ ל חנם י הידי צ הר

scripture_data.text_id: "Tuhanlah yang benar, karena aku telah memberontak terhadap firman-Nya; dengarlah hai segala bangsa, dan lihatlah kesedihanku; dara-daraku dan teruna-terunaku pergi sebagai tawanan.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD is righteous; for I have rebelled against his commandment: hear, I pray you, all people, and behold my sorrow: my virgins and my young men are gone into captivity.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יבב כלה ירחב יתלת יבכם ר יה ילכ נמ יתירמ היפ י הוהי ה קיץ

scripture_data.text_id: Aku memanggil kekasih-kekasihku, tetapi mereka memperdayakan aku; imam-imamku dan para tua-tuaku telah mati semuanya di kota, tatkala mencari makan bagi dirinya untuk menyambung hidupnya.
scripture_data.text_en: I called for my lovers, [but] they deceived me: my priests and mine elders gave up the ghost in the city, while they sought their meat to relieve their souls.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס פנת בייו מל לכ קבי ו רי ינקז ינה ינר הה יבהמל יתרק

scripture_data.text_id: Ya, TUHAN, lihatlah, betapa besar ketakutanku, betapa gelisah jiwaku; hatiku terbolak-balik di dalam dadaku, karena sudah melampaui batas aku memberontak; di luar keturunanku dibinasakan oleh pedang, di dalam rumah oleh penyakit sampar.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, O LORD; for I [am] in distress: my bowels are troubled; mine heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: abroad the sword bereaveth, at home [there is] as death.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תו תי ברחהל שחמ יתירמ רמ י ירק יל הן רמרמח ימ ילרצי הוהי הר

scripture_data.text_id: Dengarlah bagaimana keluh kesahku, sedang tiada penghibur bagiku; seteru-seteruku mendengar tentang kecelakaanku, mereka gembira karena Engkau yang mendatangkannya! Datanglah kiranya hari yang telah Engkau umumkan itu, dan biarlah mereka menjadi seperti aku!
scripture_data.text_en: They have heard that I sigh: [there is] none to comfort me: all mine enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that thou hast done [it]: thou wilt bring the day [that] thou hast called, and they shall be like unto me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ינמכ יהיו תרקי תבה תי ה י יתר מ יביל יל חנם י ינ החנן י מ

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah segala kejahatan mereka datang ke hadapan-Mu, dan perbuatlah kepada mereka, seperti Engkau telah perbuat kepadaku oleh karena segala pelanggaranku; karena banyaklah keluh kesahku, dan pedih hatiku."
scripture_data.text_en: Let all their wickedness come before thee; and do unto them, as thou hast done unto me for all my transgressions: for my sighs [are] many, and my heart [is] faint.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף יד ילו יתחנ תרי יל ל יל לל ר מל ללו ינפל תרלכ ב

scripture_data.text_id: Ah, betapa Tuhan menyelubungi puteri Sion dengan awan dalam murka-Nya! Keagungan Israel dilemparkan-Nya dari langit ke bumi. Tak diingat-Nya akan tumpuan kaki-Nya tatkala Ia murka.
scripture_data.text_en: How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, [and] cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel, and remembered not his footstool in the day of his anger!
scripture_data.text_orig: ס י וילגרדה רכזלו לרי תרפ שר יממ ילה צתת ינד ביי הכי

scripture_data.text_id: Tanpa belas kasihan Tuhan memusnahkan segala ladang Yakub. Ia menghancurkan dalam amarah-Nya benteng-benteng puteri Yehuda. Ia mencampakkan ke bumi dan mencemarkan kerajaan dan pemimpin-pemimpinnya.
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord hath swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and hath not pitied: he hath thrown down in his wrath the strong holds of the daughter of Judah; he hath brought [them] down to the ground: he hath polluted the kingdom and the princes thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הירו הכלמם לח שרל יה הדהיתב ירצבמ תרב סרה בקי תנל ת למח לו ל ינד

scripture_data.text_id: Dalam murka yang menyala-nyala Ia mematahkan segala tanduk Israel, menarik kembali tangan kanan-Nya pada waktu si seteru mendekat, membakar Yakub laksana api yang menyala-nyala, yang menjilat ke sekeliling.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath cut off in [his] fierce anger all the horn of Israel: he hath drawn back his right hand from before the enemy, and he burned against Jacob like a flaming fire, [which] devoureth round about.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ביבס הלכ הבהל בקי רבו בי ינמ נימי רח ביה לרי רק ל ירח ד

scripture_data.text_id: Ia membidikkan panah-Nya seperti seorang seteru dengan mengacungkan tangan kanan-Nya seperti seorang lawan; membunuh segala yang menyenangkan mata dalam kemah puteri Sion, memuntahkan geram-Nya seperti api.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath bent his bow like an enemy: he stood with his right hand as an adversary, and slew all [that were] pleasant to the eye in the tabernacle of the daughter of Zion: he poured out his fury like fire.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תמח פ צת לה יימחם ל גרהו רצ נימי בנ בי ק ר

scripture_data.text_id: Tuhan menjadi seperti seorang seteru; Ia menghancurkan Israel, meremukkan segala purinya, mempuingkan benteng-bentengnya, memperbanyak susah dan kesah pada puteri Yehuda.
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord was as an enemy: he hath swallowed up Israel, he hath swallowed up all her palaces: he hath destroyed his strong holds, and hath increased in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הנו הנ הדהיתב ברו וירצבמ תח היתנמרל לרי בי ינד היה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia melanda kemah-Nya seperti kebun, menghancurkan tempat pertemuan-Nya. Di Sion TUHAN menjadikan orang lupa akan perayaan dan sabat, dan menolak dalam kegeraman murka-Nya raja dan imam.
scripture_data.text_en: And he hath violently taken away his tabernacle, as [if it were of] a garden: he hath destroyed his places of the assembly: the LORD hath caused the solemn feasts and sabbaths to be forgotten in Zion, and hath despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הכו למ ז שנו תו דם צ הוהי ח דם תח סמחו

scripture_data.text_id: Tuhan membuang mezbah-Nya, meninggalkan tempat kudus-Nya, menyerahkan ke dalam tangan seteru tembok puri-purinya. Teriakan ramai mereka dalam Bait Allah seperti keramaian pada hari perayaan jemaah.
scripture_data.text_en: The Lord hath cast off his altar, he hath abhorred his sanctuary, he hath given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces; they have made a noise in the house of the LORD, as in the day of a solemn feast.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס דם י הוהיתיב נתנ לק היתנמר תמח בידי ריסה קמ רנ חזמ ינד חנז

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN telah memutuskan untuk mempuingkan tembok puteri Sion. Ia mengukur semuanya dengan tali pengukur, Ia tak menahan tangan-Nya untuk menghancurkannya. Ia menjadikan berkabung tembok luar dan tembok dalam, mereka merana semua.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion: he hath stretched out a line, he hath not withdrawn his hand from destroying: therefore he made the rampart and the wall to lament; they languished together.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ללמ וחי המחו לחלבו מ די ביהל וק הנ צת תמח תיחהל הוהי בח

scripture_data.text_id: Terbenam gapura-gapuranya di dalam tanah; TUHAN menghancurkan dan meluluhkan palang-palang pintunya. Rajanya dan pemimpin-pemimpinnya berada di antara bangsa-bangsa asing. Tak ada petunjuk dari TUHAN, bahkan nabi-nabi tidak menerima lagi wahyu dari pada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he hath destroyed and broken her bars: her king and her princes [are] among the Gentiles: the law [is] no [more]; her prophets also find no vision from the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהימ זח צמל הייבנ הר י יב הירו לם היחיר רו ד היר שרב ב

scripture_data.text_id: Duduklah tertegun di tanah para tua-tua puteri Sion; mereka menabur abu di atas kepala, dan mengenakan kain kabung. Dara-dara Yerusalem menundukkan kepalanya ke tanah.
scripture_data.text_en: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit upon the ground, [and] keep silence: they have cast up dust upon their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: the virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לרי תלת ר שרל דירה י רגח רל רפ לה צתב ינקז מי שרל בי

scripture_data.text_id: Mataku kusam dengan air mata, remuk redam hatiku; hancur habis hatiku karena keruntuhan puteri bangsaku, sebab jatuh pingsan kanak-kanak dan bayi di lapangan-lapangan kota.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eyes do fail with tears, my bowels are troubled, my liver is poured upon the earth, for the destruction of the daughter of my people; because the children and the sucklings swoon in the streets of the city.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הירק תבחר קניו לל ית רבל ידב שרל נ ימ רמרמח יני תמב ל

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada ibunya mereka bertanya: "Mana roti dan anggur?", sedang mereka jatuh pingsan seperti orang yang gugur di lapangan-lapangan kota, ketika menghembuskan nafas di pangkuan ibunya.
scripture_data.text_en: They say to their mothers, Where [is] corn and wine? when they swooned as the wounded in the streets of the city, when their soul was poured out into their mothers' bosom.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ת קיחל פן ה רי תבחר ללח פתה ייו ג ה רמי תל

scripture_data.text_id: Apa yang dapat kunyatakan kepadamu, dengan apa aku dapat menyamakan engkau, ya puteri Yerusalem? Dengan apa aku dapat membandingkan engkau untuk dihibur, ya dara, puteri Sion? Karena luas bagaikan laut reruntuhanmu; siapa yang akan memulihkan engkau?
scripture_data.text_en: What thing shall I take to witness for thee? what thing shall I liken to thee, O daughter of Jerusalem? what shall I equal to thee, that I may comfort thee, O virgin daughter of Zion? for thy breach [is] great like the sea: who can heal thee?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לרי ימ רב לדגי צת תלת מחנו הו המ לרי תה הד המ דיהמ

scripture_data.text_id: Nabi-nabimu melihat bagimu penglihatan yang dusta dan hampa. Mereka tidak menyatakan kesalahanmu, guna memulihkan engkau kembali. Mereka mengeluarkan bagimu ramalan-ramalan yang dusta dan menyesatkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thy prophets have seen vain and foolish things for thee: and they have not discovered thine iniquity, to turn away thy captivity; but have seen for thee false burdens and causes of banishment.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יחמ ו תם ל זחו תב תיב ביהל נול גלו לפתו ו ל זח ייבן

scripture_data.text_id: Sekalian orang yang lewat bertepuk tangan karena engkau. Mereka bersuit-suit dan menggelengkan kepalanya mengenai puteri Yerusalem: "Inikah kota yang disebut orang kota yang paling indah, kesukaan dunia semesta?"
scripture_data.text_en: All that pass by clap [their] hands at thee; they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, [saying, Is] this the city that [men] call The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שרהלכל מ יפי תליל רמ ריה תזה לרי תל ר נו קר רד ירבל י יל קפס

scripture_data.text_id: Terhadap engkau semua seterumu mengangakan mulutnya. Mereka bersuit-suit dan menggertakkan gigi: "Kami telah memusnahkannya!", kata mereka, "Nah, inilah harinya yang kami nanti-nantikan, kami mengalaminya, kami melihatnya!"
scripture_data.text_en: All thine enemies have opened their mouth against thee: they hiss and gnash the teeth: they say, We have swallowed [her] up: certainly this [is] the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ניר נצמ הני ה הז נ רמ קרחו קר יביל הי יל צ

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN telah menjalankan yang dirancangkan-Nya, Ia melaksanakan yang difirmankan-Nya, yang diperintahkan-Nya dahulu kala; Ia merusak tanpa belas kasihan, Ia menjadikan si seteru senang atas kamu, Ia meninggikan tanduk lawan-lawanmu.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath done [that] which he had devised; he hath fulfilled his word that he had commanded in the days of old: he hath thrown down, and hath not pitied: and he hath caused [thine] enemy to rejoice over thee, he hath set up the horn of thine adversaries.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירצ רק ירה בי יל חיו למח לו סרה דקימימ הצ ר תרמ מז ר הוהי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Berteriaklah kepada Tuhan dengan nyaring, hai, puteri Sion, cucurkanlah air mata bagaikan sungai siang dan malam; janganlah kauberikan dirimu istirahat, janganlah matamu tenang!
scripture_data.text_en: Their heart cried unto the Lord, O wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night: give thyself no rest; let not the apple of thine eye cease.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס נית ל ל תגף ינל הלילו מי המ לחך ידירה צת תמח ינדל ל קצ

scripture_data.text_id: Bangunlah, mengeranglah pada malam hari, pada permulaan giliran jaga malam; curahkanlah isi hatimu bagaikan air di hadapan Tuhan, angkatlah tanganmu kepada-Nya demi hidup anak-anakmu, yang jatuh pingsan karena lapar di ujung-ujung jalan!
scripture_data.text_en: Arise, cry out in the night: in the beginning of the watches pour out thine heart like water before the face of the Lord: lift up thy hands toward him for the life of thy young children, that faint for hunger in the top of every street.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תצחל ר בר יפה ילל פנל י ויל י ינד ינ חכנ ל יך יכפ תרמ רל הליב ליב יר ימק

scripture_data.text_id: Lihatlah, TUHAN, dan tiliklah, kepada siapakah Engkau telah berbuat ini? Apakah perempuan harus makan anak kandungnya, anak-anak yang masih dibuai? Apakah dalam tempat kudus Tuhan harus dibunuh imam dan nabi?
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, O LORD, and consider to whom thou hast done this. Shall the women eat their fruit, [and] children of a span long? shall the priest and the prophet be slain in the sanctuary of the Lord?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יבנו ה ינד קמ גרהי יח ילל יר ינ הנלכ ה לל ימל היהו הוהי הר

scripture_data.text_id: Terbaring di debu jalan pemuda dan orang tua; dara-daraku dan teruna-terunaku gugur oleh pedang; Engkau membunuh mereka tatkala Engkau murka, tanpa belas kasihan Engkau menyembelih mereka!
scripture_data.text_en: The young and the old lie on the ground in the streets: my virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword; thou hast slain [them] in the day of thine anger; thou hast killed, [and] not pitied.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס למח ל חב י גרה ברחב לפנ ירחב יתלת קזו רנ תצח שרל בכ

scripture_data.text_id: Seolah-olah pada hari perayaan Engkau mengundang semua yang kutakuti dari sekeliling. Tatkala TUHAN murka tak ada seorang yang luput atau selamat. Mereka yang kubuai dan kubesarkan dibinasakan seteruku.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast called as in a solemn day my terrors round about, so that in the day of the LORD'S anger none escaped nor remained: those that I have swaddled and brought up hath mine enemy consumed.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף כ יבי יתירו יחר דירו יל הוהי י היה לו ביבמ ירגם דם יך רק

scripture_data.text_id: Akulah orang yang melihat sengsara disebabkan cambuk murka-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: I [am] the man [that] hath seen affliction by the rod of his wrath.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרב ב ינ הר רבה ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menghalau dan membawa aku ke dalam kegelapan yang tidak ada terangnya.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath led me, and brought [me into] darkness, but not [into] light.
scripture_data.text_orig: רלו ח לו גהנ ית

scripture_data.text_id: Sesungguhnya, aku dipukul-Nya berulang-ulang dengan tangan-Nya sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand [against me] all the day.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הל די פהי בי י

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menyusutkan dagingku dan kulitku, tulang-tulangku dipatahkan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: My flesh and my skin hath he made old; he hath broken my bones.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתמץ ר ירו ירב ה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia mendirikan tembok sekelilingku, mengelilingi aku dengan kesedihan dan kesusahan.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath builded against me, and compassed [me] with gall and travail.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלת ר ו יל הנ

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menempatkan aku di dalam gelap seperti orang yang sudah lama mati.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath set me in dark places, as [they that be] dead of old.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ל יתמ ינביה יחמ

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menutup segala jalan ke luar bagiku, Ia mengikat aku dengan rantai yang berat.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath hedged me about, that I cannot get out: he hath made my chain heavy.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחן דיכה צ לו יד רד

scripture_data.text_id: Walaupun aku memanggil-manggil dan berteriak minta tolong, tak didengarkan-Nya doaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Also when I cry and shout, he shutteth out my prayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתפ ת ו קז י

scripture_data.text_id: Ia merintangi jalan-jalanku dengan batu pahat, dan menjadikannya tidak terlalui.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath inclosed my ways with hewn stone, he hath made my paths crooked.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ה יתביתן תיזג יכר רד

scripture_data.text_id: Laksana beruang Ia menghadang aku, laksana singa dalam tempat persembunyian.
scripture_data.text_en: He [was] unto me [as] a bear lying in wait, [and as] a lion in secret places.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירסמ יר היר יל ה בר ב

scripture_data.text_id: Ia membelokkan jalan-jalanku, merobek-robek aku dan membuat aku tertegun.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces: he hath made me desolate.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ ינמ ינחפיו ררס יכר

scripture_data.text_id: Ia membidikkan panah-Nya, menjadikan aku sasaran anak panah.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שחל ר ינביו ק ר

scripture_data.text_id: Ia menyusupkan ke dalam hatiku segala anak panah dari tabung-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath caused the arrows of his quiver to enter into my reins.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת ינ יתילכ יבה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku menjadi tertawaan bagi segenap bangsaku, menjadi lagu ejekan mereka sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: I was a derision to all my people; [and] their song all the day.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל תניגן ילכל קח יתייה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia mengenyangkan aku dengan kepahitan, memberi aku minum ipuh.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath filled me with bitterness, he hath made me drunken with wormwood.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הנל ינורה יררב יניה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia meremukkan gigi-gigiku dengan memberi aku makan kerikil; Ia menekan aku ke dalam debu.
scripture_data.text_en: He hath also broken my teeth with gravel stones, he hath covered me with ashes.
scripture_data.text_orig: רפ יניכה י שצח סרגו

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau menceraikan nyawaku dari kesejahteraan, aku lupa akan kebahagiaan.
scripture_data.text_en: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
scripture_data.text_orig: הב יתינ יפן למ חנזו

scripture_data.text_id: Sangkaku: hilang lenyaplah kemasyhuranku dan harapanku kepada TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And I said, My strength and my hope is perished from the LORD:
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהימ ילחתו יחצנ דב רמו

scripture_data.text_id: "Ingatlah akan sengsaraku dan pengembaraanku, akan ipuh dan racun itu."
scripture_data.text_en: Remembering mine affliction and my misery, the wormwood and the gall.
scripture_data.text_orig: רו הנל ידרמ יינרכז

scripture_data.text_id: Jiwaku selalu teringat akan hal itu dan tertekan dalam diriku.
scripture_data.text_en: My soul hath [them] still in remembrance, and is humbled in me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יפן יל חתו חיתו רז רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi hal-hal inilah yang kuperhatikan, oleh sebab itu aku akan berharap:
scripture_data.text_en: This I recall to my mind, therefore have I hope.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ליח ל ילל בי תז

scripture_data.text_id: Tak berkesudahan kasih setia TUHAN, tak habis-habisnya rahmat-Nya,
scripture_data.text_en: [It is of] the LORD'S mercies that we are not consumed, because his compassions fail not.
scripture_data.text_orig: וימחר לכל י נמתל י הוהי ידסח

scripture_data.text_id: selalu baru tiap pagi; besar kesetiaan-Mu!
scripture_data.text_en: [They are] new every morning: great [is] thy faithfulness.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנמ הר ירקל ידח

scripture_data.text_id: "TUHAN adalah bagianku," kata jiwaku, oleh sebab itu aku berharap kepada-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] my portion, saith my soul; therefore will I hope in him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ל ליח ל יפן הרמ הוהי יקלח

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN adalah baik bagi orang yang berharap kepada-Nya, bagi jiwa yang mencari Dia.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD [is] good unto them that wait for him, to the soul [that] seeketh him.
scripture_data.text_orig: רד פנל ווקל הוהי ב

scripture_data.text_id: Adalah baik menanti dengan diam pertolongan TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: [It is] good that [a man] should both hope and quietly wait for the salvation of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי תתל מדו ליחיו ב

scripture_data.text_id: Adalah baik bagi seorang pria memikul kuk pada masa mudanya.
scripture_data.text_en: [It is] good for a man that he bear the yoke in his youth.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס וירנ ל יי רבל ב

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah ia duduk sendirian dan berdiam diri kalau TUHAN membebankannya.
scripture_data.text_en: He sitteth alone and keepeth silence, because he hath borne [it] upon him.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויל לנ י יו דד בי

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah ia merebahkan diri dengan mukanya dalam debu, mungkin ada harapan.
scripture_data.text_en: He putteth his mouth in the dust; if so be there may be hope.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוק י יל הי רפ י

scripture_data.text_id: Biarlah ia memberikan pipi kepada yang menamparnya, biarlah ia kenyang dengan cercaan.
scripture_data.text_en: He giveth [his] cheek to him that smiteth him: he is filled full with reproach.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הרח י יחל המל י

scripture_data.text_id: Karena tidak untuk selama-lamanya Tuhan mengucilkan.
scripture_data.text_en: For the Lord will not cast off for ever:
scripture_data.text_orig: ינד לל חנזי ל י

scripture_data.text_id: Karena walau Ia mendatangkan susah, Ia juga menyayangi menurut kebesaran kasih setia-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: But though he cause grief, yet will he have compassion according to the multitude of his mercies.
scripture_data.text_orig: וידסח סח בר חרו הגה י

scripture_data.text_id: Karena tidak dengan rela hati Ia menindas dan merisaukan anak-anak manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: For he doth not afflict willingly nor grieve the children of men.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יינ הו מ ה ל י

scripture_data.text_id: Kalau dipijak-pijak dengan kaki tawanan-tawanan di dunia,
scripture_data.text_en: To crush under his feet all the prisoners of the earth,
scripture_data.text_orig: שר יריס ל וילגר תח דל

scripture_data.text_id: kalau hak orang dibelokkan di hadapan Yang Mahatinggi,
scripture_data.text_en: To turn aside the right of a man before the face of the most High,
scripture_data.text_orig: יל ינ דגנ רבמ תהל

scripture_data.text_id: atau orang diperlakukan tidak adil dalam perkaranya, masakan Tuhan tidak melihatnya?
scripture_data.text_en: To subvert a man in his cause, the Lord approveth not.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הר ל ינד ביר ד תל

scripture_data.text_id: Siapa berfirman, maka semuanya jadi? Bukankah Tuhan yang memerintahkannya?
scripture_data.text_en: Who [is] he [that] saith, and it cometh to pass, [when] the Lord commandeth [it] not?
scripture_data.text_orig: הצ ל ינד יהו רמ הז ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Bukankah dari mulut Yang Mahatinggi keluar apa yang buruk dan apa yang baik?
scripture_data.text_en: Out of the mouth of the most High proceedeth not evil and good?
scripture_data.text_orig: בהו תרה צת ל יל ימ

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa orang hidup mengeluh? Biarlah setiap orang mengeluh tentang dosanya!
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore doth a living man complain, a man for the punishment of his sins?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ויח חל רב יח ד נתהם

scripture_data.text_id: Marilah kita menyelidiki dan memeriksa hidup kita, dan berpaling kepada TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Let us search and try our ways, and turn again to the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהיד הבנו הרקחנו ניכרד החן

scripture_data.text_id: Marilah kita mengangkat hati dan tangan kita kepada Allah di sorga:
scripture_data.text_en: Let us lift up our heart with [our] hands unto God in the heavens.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ לל יל נבבל נ

scripture_data.text_id: Kami telah mendurhaka dan memberontak, Engkau tidak mengampuni.
scripture_data.text_en: We have transgressed and have rebelled: thou hast not pardoned.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס חלס ל ה נירמ נפ נחנ

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau menyelubungi diri-Mu dengan murka, mengejar kami dan membunuh kami tanpa belas kasihan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast covered with anger, and persecuted us: thou hast slain, thou hast not pitied.
scripture_data.text_orig: למח ל גרה נפרו ב התס

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau menyelubungi diri-Mu dengan awan, sehingga doa tak dapat menembus.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast covered thyself with a cloud, that [our] prayer should not pass through.
scripture_data.text_orig: הפ רבמ ל נב התס

scripture_data.text_id: Kami Kaujadikan kotor dan keji di antara bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast made us [as] the offscouring and refuse in the midst of the people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יה ברק נמי סמ יחס

scripture_data.text_id: Terhadap kami semua seteru kami mengangakan mulutnya.
scripture_data.text_en: All our enemies have opened their mouths against us.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניביל הי ניל צ

scripture_data.text_id: Kejut dan jerat menimpa kami, kemusnahan dan kehancuran.
scripture_data.text_en: Fear and a snare is come upon us, desolation and destruction.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבהו תה נל היה תחפו דח

scripture_data.text_id: Air mataku mengalir bagaikan batang air, karena keruntuhan puteri bangsaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eye runneth down with rivers of water for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ית רבל יני דר ימיגל

scripture_data.text_id: Air mataku terus-menerus bercucuran, dengan tak henti-hentinya,
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eye trickleth down, and ceaseth not, without any intermission,
scripture_data.text_orig: תגפה ימ המדת לו הרנ יני

scripture_data.text_id: sampai TUHAN memandang dari atas dan melihat dari sorga.
scripture_data.text_en: Till the LORD look down, and behold from heaven.
scripture_data.text_orig: יממ הוהי ריו יקיד

scripture_data.text_id: Mataku terasa pedih oleh sebab keadaan puteri-puteri kotaku.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine eye affecteth mine heart because of all the daughters of my city.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירי תנ למ יפנל הלל יני

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti burung aku diburu-buru oleh mereka yang menjadi seteruku tanpa sebab.
scripture_data.text_en: Mine enemies chased me sore, like a bird, without cause.
scripture_data.text_orig: ח יבי ר ינדצ דצ

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka melemparkan aku hidup-hidup dalam lobang, melontari aku dengan batu.
scripture_data.text_en: They have cut off my life in the dungeon, and cast a stone upon me.
scripture_data.text_orig: י בו יח רב תמצ

scripture_data.text_id: Air membanjir di atas kepalaku, kusangka: "Binasa aku!"
scripture_data.text_en: Waters flowed over mine head; [then] I said, I am cut off.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירזגנ ירמ ירל ימפצ

scripture_data.text_id: "Ya TUHAN, aku memanggil nama-Mu dari dasar lobang yang dalam.
scripture_data.text_en: I called upon thy name, O LORD, out of the low dungeon.
scripture_data.text_orig: תח רמ הוהי מ יתרק

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau mendengar suaraku! Janganlah Kaututupi telinga-Mu terhadap kesahku dan teriak tolongku!
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast heard my voice: hide not thine ear at my breathing, at my cry.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתול יתחורל נז לל מ ילק

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau dekat tatkala aku memanggil-Mu, Engkau berfirman: Jangan takut!"
scripture_data.text_en: Thou drewest near in the day [that] I called upon thee: thou saidst, Fear not.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ריל רמ שרק י ברק

scripture_data.text_id: "Ya Tuhan, Engkau telah memperjuangkan perkaraku, Engkau telah menyelamatkan hidupku.
scripture_data.text_en: O Lord, thou hast pleaded the causes of my soul; thou hast redeemed my life.
scripture_data.text_orig: יח ל יפן יביר ינד בר

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau telah melihat ketidakadilan terhadap aku, ya TUHAN; berikanlah keadilan!
scripture_data.text_en: O LORD, thou hast seen my wrong: judge thou my cause.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימ הפ יתת הוהי התיר

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau telah melihat segala dendam mereka, segala rancangan mereka terhadap aku."
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast seen all their vengeance [and] all their imaginations against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יל תבחמל תמקנל התיר

scripture_data.text_id: "Engkau telah mendengar cercaan mereka, ya TUHAN, segala rancangan mereka terhadap aku,
scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast heard their reproach, O LORD, [and] all their imaginations against me;
scripture_data.text_orig: יל תבחמל הוהי תרח מ

scripture_data.text_id: percakapan orang-orang yang melawan aku, dan rencana mereka terhadap aku sepanjang hari.
scripture_data.text_en: The lips of those that rose up against me, and their device against me all the day.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל יל ניגהו ימק יתפ

scripture_data.text_id: Amatilah duduk bangun mereka! Aku menjadi lagu ejekan mereka."
scripture_data.text_en: Behold their sitting down, and their rising up; I [am] their musick.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תנינם ינ היה תמיקו ב

scripture_data.text_id: "Engkau akan mengadakan pembalasan terhadap mereka, ya TUHAN, menurut perbuatan tangan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.
scripture_data.text_orig: הידי המ הוהי למ הל בי

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau akan mengeraskan hati mereka; kiranya kutuk-Mu menimpa mereka!
scripture_data.text_en: Give them sorrow of heart, thy curse unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל תל בלתגם הל

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau akan mengejar mereka dengan murka dan memunahkan mereka dari bawah langit, ya TUHAN!"
scripture_data.text_en: Persecute and destroy them in anger from under the heavens of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ימ תחמ דימתו ר

scripture_data.text_id: Ah, sungguh pudar emas itu, emas murni itu berubah; batu-batu suci itu terbuang di pojok tiap jalan.
scripture_data.text_en: How is the gold become dim! [how] is the most fine gold changed! the stones of the sanctuary are poured out in the top of every street.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תצחל ר דקינב הנכ בה תה ני בהז י הכי

scripture_data.text_id: Anak-anak Sion yang berharga, yang setimbang dengan emas tua, sungguh mereka dianggap belanga-belanga tanah buatan tangan tukang periuk.
scripture_data.text_en: The precious sons of Zion, comparable to fine gold, how are they esteemed as earthen pitchers, the work of the hands of the potter!
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רצי ידי הם רחילבנל בחן הכי ז יסמה ירקיה צ ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Serigalapun memberikan teteknya dan menyusui anak-anaknya, tetapi puteri bangsaku telah menjadi kejam seperti burung unta di padang pasir.
scripture_data.text_en: Even the sea monsters draw out the breast, they give suck to their young ones: the daughter of my people [is become] cruel, like the ostriches in the wilderness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רד יני ינ י רזכל ית היר קיניה ד צלח י י

scripture_data.text_id: Lidah bayi melekat pada langit-langit karena haus; kanak-kanak meminta roti, tetapi tak seorangpun yang memberi.
scripture_data.text_en: The tongue of the sucking child cleaveth to the roof of his mouth for thirst: the young children ask bread, [and] no man breaketh [it] unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הל י ר חל ל ילל מ חל קני ל קב

scripture_data.text_id: Yang biasa makan yang sedap-sedap mati bulur di jalan-jalan; yang biasa duduk di atas bantal kirmizi terbaring di timbunan sampah.
scripture_data.text_en: They that did feed delicately are desolate in the streets: they that were brought up in scarlet embrace dunghills.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ת קח לת יל ינמה תצח נ ידמל ילכה

scripture_data.text_id: Kedurjanaan puteri bangsaku melebihi dosa Sodom, yang sekejap mata dibongkar-bangkir tanpa ada tangan yang memukulnya.
scripture_data.text_en: For the punishment of the iniquity of the daughter of my people is greater than the punishment of the sin of Sodom, that was overthrown as in a moment, and no hands stayed on her.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ידי ב לחלו גרמך הכפהה דס תחמ ית ו לגו

scripture_data.text_id: Pemimpin-pemimpin lebih bersih dari salju dan lebih putih dari susu, tubuh mereka lebih merah dari pada merjan, seperti batu nilam rupa mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Her Nazarites were purer than snow, they were whiter than milk, they were more ruddy in body than rubies, their polishing [was] of sapphire:
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תרז ריס ינינמ צ מד בלחמ חץ גלמ היריזן ז

scripture_data.text_id: Sekarang rupa mereka lebih hitam dari pada jelaga, mereka tidak dikenal di jalan-jalan, kulit mereka berkerut pada tulang-tulangnya, mengering seperti kayu.
scripture_data.text_en: Their visage is blacker than a coal; they are not known in the streets: their skin cleaveth to their bones; it is withered, it is become like a stick.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס שכ היה בי מצל ר דפצ תצח רנ ל ר רחמ ח

scripture_data.text_id: Lebih bahagia mereka yang gugur karena pedang dari pada mereka yang tewas karena lapar, yang merana dan mati sebab tak ada hasil ladang.
scripture_data.text_en: [They that be] slain with the sword are better than [they that be] slain with hunger: for these pine away, stricken through for [want of] the fruits of the field.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יד תבנמ ירדם בזי ה בר יללחמ ברחיללח יה יב

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan tangan sendiri wanita yang lemah lembut memasak kanak-kanak mereka, untuk makanan mereka tatkala runtuh puteri bangsaku.
scripture_data.text_en: The hands of the pitiful women have sodden their own children: they were their meat in the destruction of the daughter of my people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ית רב מל תרבל יה הידלי ל תנמחר ינ ידי

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN melepaskan segenap amarah-Nya, mencurahkan murka-Nya yang menyala-nyala, dan menyalakan api di Sion, yang memakan dasar-dasarnya.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath accomplished his fury; he hath poured out his fierce anger, and hath kindled a fire in Zion, and it hath devoured the foundations thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היתדסי לכו צ תו רח פ תמחת הוהי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Tidak percaya raja-raja di bumi, pun seluruh penduduk dunia, bahwa lawan dan seteru dapat masuk ke dalam gapura-gapura Yerusalem.
scripture_data.text_en: The kings of the earth, and all the inhabitants of the world, would not have believed that the adversary and the enemy should have entered into the gates of Jerusalem.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לרי יר ביו רצ בי י לבת יבי ל לכו שריכלם נימה ל

scripture_data.text_id: Hal itu terjadi oleh sebab dosa nabi-nabinya dan kedurjanaan imam-imamnya yang di tengah-tengahnya mencurahkan darah orang yang tidak bersalah.
scripture_data.text_en: For the sins of her prophets, [and] the iniquities of her priests, that have shed the blood of the just in the midst of her,
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יקיץ רק יכפה הינה תנו הייבן תחמ

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka terhuyung-huyung seperti orang buta di jalan-jalan, cemar oleh darah, sehingga orang tak dapat menyentuh pakaian mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: They have wandered [as] blind [men] in the streets, they have polluted themselves with blood, so that men could not touch their garments.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היבל י לכי ל לגן תצח ירו נ

scripture_data.text_id: "Singkir! Najis!", kata orang kepada mereka, "Singkir! Singkir! Jangan sentuh!"; lalu mereka lari dan mengembara, maka berkatalah bangsa-bangsa: "Mereka tak boleh tinggal lebih lama di sini."
scripture_data.text_en: They cried unto them, Depart ye; [it is] unclean; depart, depart, touch not: when they fled away and wandered, they said among the heathen, They shall no more sojourn [there].
scripture_data.text_orig: ס רגל פיסי ל י רמ נ צנ י ל רס רס מל רק מ רס

scripture_data.text_id: TUHAN sendiri mencerai-beraikan mereka, tak mau lagi Ia memandang mereka. Para imam tidak mereka hormati, dan orang-orang tua tidak mereka kasihani.
scripture_data.text_en: The anger of the LORD hath divided them; he will no more regard them: they respected not the persons of the priests, they favoured not the elders.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ננח ל ינקז ינקז נ ל ינהכ ינ יהל יסי ל קח הוהי ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Selalu mata kami merindukan pertolongan, tetapi sia-sia; dari menara penjagaan kami menanti-nantikan suatu bangsa yang tak dapat menolong.
scripture_data.text_en: As for us, our eyes as yet failed for our vain help: in our watching we have watched for a nation [that] could not save [us].
scripture_data.text_orig: ס י ל יל ניצ נתצ לבה נתרזל ניני הנילכ ניד הניד

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka mengintai langkah-langkah kami, sehingga kami tak dapat berjalan di lapangan-lapangan kami; akhir hidup kami mendekat, hari-hari kami sudah genap, ya, akhir hidup kami sudah tiba.
scripture_data.text_en: They hunt our steps, that we cannot go in our streets: our end is near, our days are fulfilled; for our end is come.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ניק בי נימי למ ניק ברק ניתבחר תכמ נידץ דצ

scripture_data.text_id: Pengejar-pengejar kami lebih cepat dari pada burung rajawali di angkasa mereka memburu kami di atas gunung-gunung, menghadang kami di padang gurun.
scripture_data.text_en: Our persecutors are swifter than the eagles of the heaven: they pursued us upon the mountains, they laid wait for us in the wilderness.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס נל בר רד נקל ירההל ימ ירמ ניפדר יה יק

scripture_data.text_id: Orang yang diurapi TUHAN, nafas hidup kami, tertangkap dalam pelubang mereka, dia yang kami sangka: "Dalam naungannya kami akan hidup di antara bangsa-bangsa."
scripture_data.text_en: The breath of our nostrils, the anointed of the LORD, was taken in their pits, of whom we said, Under his shadow we shall live among the heathen.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יב היחנ צ נרמ ר תתיח דלנ הוהי חים ני חר

scripture_data.text_id: Bergembira dan bersukacitalah, hai puteri Edom, engkau yang mendiami tanah Us, juga kepadamu piala akan sampai, engkau akan jadi mabuk lalu menelanjangi dirimu!
scripture_data.text_en: Rejoice and be glad, O daughter of Edom, that dwellest in the land of Uz; the cup also shall pass through unto thee: thou shalt be drunken, and shalt make thyself naked.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירתתו יר סרב יל ש שר תבי יבי דת יחמו יי

scripture_data.text_id: Telah hapus kesalahanmu, puteri Sion, tak akan lagi TUHAN membawa engkau ke dalam pembuangan, tetapi kesalahanmu, puteri Edom, akan dibalas-Nya, dan dosa-dosamu akan disingkapkan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: The punishment of thine iniquity is accomplished, O daughter of Zion; he will no more carry thee away into captivity: he will visit thine iniquity, O daughter of Edom; he will discover thy sins.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף יתחל ה דת נו דק תלגהל יסי ל צת נו

scripture_data.text_id: Ingatlah, ya TUHAN, apa yang terjadi atas kami, pandanglah dan lihatlah akan kehinaan kami.
scripture_data.text_en: Remember, O LORD, what is come upon us: consider, and behold our reproach.
scripture_data.text_orig: נתרחת הר היה יה נל היההם הוהי רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Milik pusaka kami beralih kepada orang lain, rumah-rumah kami kepada orang asing.
scripture_data.text_en: Our inheritance is turned to strangers, our houses to aliens.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירכנל ני ירזל הכפהן נתלחן

scripture_data.text_id: Kami menjadi anak yatim, tak punya bapa, dan ibu kami seperti janda.
scripture_data.text_en: We are orphans and fatherless, our mothers [are] as widows.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנמל נית ב יו י נייה ימתי

scripture_data.text_id: Air kami kami minum dengan membayar, kami mendapat kayu dengan bayaran.
scripture_data.text_en: We have drunken our water for money; our wood is sold unto us.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי ריחמ ניצ נית סכ נימימ

scripture_data.text_id: Kami dikejar dekat-dekat, kami lelah, bagi kami tak ada istirahat.
scripture_data.text_en: Our necks [are] under persecution: we labour, [and] have no rest.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלחנה לו ל נגי נפרנ נרץ ל

scripture_data.text_id: Kami mengulurkan tangan kepada Mesir, dan kepada Asyur untuk menjadi kenyang dengan roti.
scripture_data.text_en: We have given the hand [to] the Egyptians, [and to] the Assyrians, to be satisfied with bread.
scripture_data.text_orig: חל ל ר די תנ ירצמ

scripture_data.text_id: Bapak-bapak kami berbuat dosa, mereka tak ada lagi, dan kami yang menanggung kedurjanaan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Our fathers have sinned, [and are] not; and we have borne their iniquities.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלבס היתנו נחנו נחנ ניו ני ח ניתב

scripture_data.text_id: Pelayan-pelayan memerintah atas kami; yang melepaskan kami dari tangan mereka tak ada.
scripture_data.text_en: Servants have ruled over us: [there is] none that doth deliver [us] out of their hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: דמ י קר נב למ ידב

scripture_data.text_id: Dengan bahaya maut karena serangan pedang di padang gurun, kami harus mengambil makanan kami.
scripture_data.text_en: We gat our bread with [the peril of] our lives because of the sword of the wilderness.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדה ברח ינמ נמחל יבנ נפנ

scripture_data.text_id: Kulit kami membara laksana perapian, karena nyerinya kelaparan.
scripture_data.text_en: Our skin was black like an oven because of the terrible famine.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר תפלז ינמ רמכנ רת נר

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka memperkosa wanita-wanita di Sion dan gadis-gadis di kota-kota Yehuda.
scripture_data.text_en: They ravished the women in Zion, [and] the maids in the cities of Judah.
scripture_data.text_orig: הדהי יר תלת צ ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Pemimpin-pemimpin digantung oleh tangan mereka, para tua-tua tidak dihormati.
scripture_data.text_en: Princes are hanged up by their hand: the faces of elders were not honoured.
scripture_data.text_orig: רהן ל ינקז ינ לתנ די יר

scripture_data.text_id: Pemuda-pemuda harus memikul batu kilangan, anak-anak terjatuh karena beratnya pikulan kayu.
scripture_data.text_en: They took the young men to grind, and the children fell under the wood.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ש ירנ נ ח ירח

scripture_data.text_id: Para tua-tua tidak berkumpul lagi di pintu gerbang, para teruna berhenti main kecapi.
scripture_data.text_en: The elders have ceased from the gate, the young men from their musick.
scripture_data.text_orig: תניגמ ירח תב רמ ינקז

scripture_data.text_id: Lenyaplah kegirangan hati kami, tari-tarian kami berubah menjadi perkabungan.
scripture_data.text_en: The joy of our heart is ceased; our dance is turned into mourning.
scripture_data.text_orig: נלחם לבל הן נל ם תב

scripture_data.text_id: Mahkota telah jatuh dari kepala kami. Wahai kami, karena kami telah berbuat dosa!
scripture_data.text_en: The crown is fallen [from] our head: woe unto us, that we have sinned!
scripture_data.text_orig: נח י נל ני נר תר הלפנ

scripture_data.text_id: Karena inilah hati kami sakit, karena inilah mata kami jadi kabur:
scripture_data.text_en: For this our heart is faint; for these [things] our eyes are dim.
scripture_data.text_orig: ניני כח הל נל הוד היה הזל

scripture_data.text_id: karena bukit Sion yang tandus, di mana anjing-anjing hutan berkeliaran.
scripture_data.text_en: Because of the mountain of Zion, which is desolate, the foxes walk upon it.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף בכה יל מ צרה ל

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau, ya TUHAN, bertakhta selama-lamanya, takhta-Mu tetap dari masa ke masa!
scripture_data.text_en: Thou, O LORD, remainest for ever; thy throne from generation to generation.
scripture_data.text_orig: רדו רדל ס ב לל הוהי ה

scripture_data.text_id: Mengapa Engkau melupakan kami selama-lamanya, meninggalkan kami demikian lama?
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore dost thou forget us for ever, [and] forsake us so long time?
scripture_data.text_orig: ימי רל נבז נח חצנל הל

scripture_data.text_id: Bawalah kami kembali kepada-Mu, ya TUHAN, maka kami akan kembali, baharuilah hari-hari kami seperti dahulu kala!
scripture_data.text_en: Turn thou us unto thee, O LORD, and we shall be turned; renew our days as of old.
scripture_data.text_orig: דק נימי ח הבנו בנו יל הוהי נביה

scripture_data.text_id: Atau, apa Engkau sudah membuang kami sama sekali? Sangat murkakah Engkau terhadap kami?
scripture_data.text_en: But thou hast utterly rejected us; thou art very wroth against us.
scripture_data.text_orig: דמד ניל פצק נסם סמ י

scripture_data.text_id: Pada tahun ketiga puluh, dalam bulan yang keempat, pada tanggal lima bulan itu, ketika aku bersama-sama dengan para buangan berada di tepi sungai Kebar, terbukalah langit dan aku melihat penglihatan-penglihatan tentang Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: Now it came to pass in the thirtieth year, in the fourth [month], in the fifth [day] of the month, as I [was] among the captives by the river of Chebar, [that] the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהל תרם הרו ימה חפנ רברהנל הלהתב ינו דחל המח ייבר הנ יל יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Pada tanggal lima bulan itu, yaitu tahun kelima sesudah raja Yoyakhin dibuang,
scripture_data.text_en: In the fifth [day] of the month, which [was] the fifth year of king Jehoiachin's captivity,
scripture_data.text_orig: יכיי לה תלגל תיימחה הנה יה דחל המח

scripture_data.text_id: datanglah firman TUHAN kepada imam Yehezkiel, anak Busi, di negeri orang Kasdim di tepi sungai Kebar, dan di sana kekuasaan TUHAN meliputi dia.
scripture_data.text_en: The word of the LORD came expressly unto Ezekiel the priest, the son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar; and the hand of the LORD was there upon him.
