scripture_data.text_orig: ס יתבל י ד המכ הלר תו יתיל ר ת ב יתיו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu di tengah-tengahmu ayah-ayah akan memakan anak-anaknya dan anak-anak memakan ayahnya dan Aku akan menjatuhkan hukuman kepadamu, sedang semua yang masih tinggal lagi dari padamu akan Kuhamburkan ke semua penjuru angin.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore the fathers shall eat the sons in the midst of thee, and the sons shall eat their fathers; and I will execute judgments in thee, and the whole remnant of thee will I scatter into all the winds.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף חרלכל תירלת יתירזו יפ ב יתיו תב לכי ינב כת ינב לכי תב כל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu, demi Aku yang hidup, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH, sesungguhnya, oleh karena engkau menajiskan tempat kudus-Ku dengan segala dewamu yang menjijikkan dan dengan segala perbuatanmu yang keji, Aku sendiri akan meruntuhkan engkau; Aku tidak akan merasa sayang dan tidak akan kenal belas kasihan.
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD; Surely, because thou hast defiled my sanctuary with all thy detestable things, and with all thine abominations, therefore will I also diminish [thee]; neither shall mine eye spare, neither will I have any pity.
scripture_data.text_orig: למח ל ינגו יני סחתלו רג ינגו יתבלכב יצלכ ת יקמת י ל הוהי ינד ן יניח כל

scripture_data.text_id: Sepertiga dari padamu akan mati kena sampar dan mati kelaparan di tengah-tengahmu; sepertiga akan tewas dimakan pedang di sekitarmu; dan sepertiga lagi akan Kuhamburkan ke semua mata angin dan Aku akan menghunus pedang dari belakang mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: A third part of thee shall die with the pestilence, and with famine shall they be consumed in the midst of thee: and a third part shall fall by the sword round about thee; and I will scatter a third part into all the winds, and I will draw out a sword after them.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירח קיר ברחו הרז חרלכל תיילהו יתביבס לי ברח תילהו כתב לכי ברב תמי רב יתל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan melampiaskan murka-Ku kepada mereka, sehingga hati-Ku yang panas tenang kembali dan Aku merasa puas; dan mereka akan mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN yang mengatakannya di dalam cemburu-Ku, tatkala Aku melampiaskan amarah-Ku kepada mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus shall mine anger be accomplished, and I will cause my fury to rest upon them, and I will be comforted: and they shall know that I the LORD have spoken [it] in my zeal, when I have accomplished my fury in them.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתמח יתכ יתנק יר הוהי יני דיו ימחהו יתמח יתחנהו י הלכו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan membuat engkau menjadi reruntuhan dan buah celaan di antara bangsa-bangsa yang di sekitarmu di hadapan semua orang yang lintas dari padamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover I will make thee waste, and a reproach among the nations that [are] round about thee, in the sight of all that pass by.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבל יניל יתביבס ר י הרחל הרחל נו

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau akan menjadi buah celaan dan cercaan, menjadi peringatan dan suatu kengerian bagi bangsa-bangsa yang di sekitarmu, tatkala Aku menjatuhkan hukuman kepadamu di dalam kemurkaan dan kemarahan dan di dalam penghajaran-penghajaran kemarahan Aku, TUHAN, yang mengatakannya
scripture_data.text_en: So it shall be a reproach and a taunt, an instruction and an astonishment unto the nations that [are] round about thee, when I shall execute judgments in thee in anger and in fury and in furious rebukes. I the LORD have spoken [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: יר הוהי ינ המח תחכתב המחב יפ ב ית יתביבס ר יל המ רסם הפדג הרח התיהו

scripture_data.text_id: tatkala Aku mendatangkan atasmu kelaparan yang dahsyat, yang membinasakan, dan Aku mendatangkannya untuk membinasakan kamu, tatkala Aku memperdahsyat bencana kelaparan atasmu dan memusnahkan persediaan makananmu.
scripture_data.text_en: When I shall send upon them the evil arrows of famine, which shall be for [their] destruction, [and] which I will send to destroy you: and I will increase the famine upon you, and will break your staff of bread:
scripture_data.text_orig: חלהם כל ירבו כיל ס ברו כתחל ת חר תיחמל יה ר ה ירה ברה יחת יח

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mendatangkan kelaparan atasmu dan binatang-binatang buas di tengah-tengahmu, yang akan memunahkan anak-anakmu; sampar akan berkecamuk dan darah akan mengalir di tengah-tengahmu dan Aku akan mendatangkan pedang atasmu, Aku, TUHAN, yang mengatakannya."
scripture_data.text_en: So will I send upon you famine and evil beasts, and they shall bereave thee; and pestilence and blood shall pass through thee; and I will bring the sword upon thee. I the LORD have spoken [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ף יר הוהי ינ יל יב ברחו רבי דו רבדו לו הר החו בר כיל יחו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, tujukanlah mukamu ke gunung-gunung Israel dan bernubuatlah melawan mereka!
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, set thy face toward the mountains of Israel, and prophesy against them,
scripture_data.text_orig: היל בהו לרי ירהל ינ י ד

scripture_data.text_id: Katakanlah: Hai gunung-gunung Israel, dengarkanlah firman Tuhan ALLAH! Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH kepada gunung-gunung dan bukit-bukit, kepada alur-alur sungai dan lembah-lembah: Sungguh, Aku akan mendatangkan perang atasmu dan Aku akan membinasakan bukit-bukit pengorbananmu.
scripture_data.text_en: And say, Ye mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord GOD; Thus saith the Lord GOD to the mountains, and to the hills, to the rivers, and to the valleys; Behold, I, [even] I, will bring a sword upon you, and I will destroy your high places.
scripture_data.text_orig: כיתמ ידו ברח כיל יבמ ינ יננה תילו תילו יקיפל תבלו ירהל הוהי ינד רמה הוהי ינדרב מ לרי ירה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Mezbah-mezbahmu akan menjadi sunyi sepi dan pedupaan-pedupaanmu akan dirusak; dan Aku akan merebahkan orang-orangmu yang terbunuh di hadapan berhala-berhalamu.
scripture_data.text_en: And your altars shall be desolate, and your images shall be broken: and I will cast down your slain [men] before your idols.
scripture_data.text_orig: כיל ינפל כיללח ילהו כינח רנו כיתחזמ נו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mencampakkan mayat-mayat orang Israel di hadapan berhala-berhala mereka dan menghamburkan tulang-tulangmu keliling mezbah-mezbahmu.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will lay the dead carcases of the children of Israel before their idols; and I will scatter your bones round about your altars.
scripture_data.text_orig: כיתחזמ תביבס כיתמצת יתירזו היל ינפל לרי ינ ירגת יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: Di mana saja kamu diam, kota-kotamu akan menjadi reruntuhan dan bukit-bukit pengorbananmu akan menjadi sunyi sepi, supaya mezbah-mezbahmu dihancurkan dan ditinggalkan sunyi sepi, berhala-berhalamu diremukkan dan ditiadakan, pedupaan-pedupaanmu diluluhkan dan buatan-buatan tanganmu dihapuskan.
scripture_data.text_en: In all your dwellingplaces the cities shall be laid waste, and the high places shall be desolate; that your altars may be laid waste and made desolate, and your idols may be broken and cease, and your images may be cut down, and your works may be abolished.
scripture_data.text_orig: כים חמנו כינח גנו כיל תנו רנו כיתחזמ מיו ברחי מל הנמי תמהו הנברח ירה כיתבם לכ

scripture_data.text_id: Dan orang-orangmu yang terbunuh akan berebahan di tengah-tengahmu dan kamu akan mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And the slain shall fall in the midst of you, and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יני דיו ככת ללח לפנו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi sebagian, yaitu yang terluput dari pedang, akan Kutinggalkan hidup di antara bangsa-bangsa, bilamana kamu dihamburkan ke negeri-negeri itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Yet will I leave a remnant, that ye may have [some] that shall escape the sword among the nations, when ye shall be scattered through the countries.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצר כיתרה י ברח ייל כל תיה ירתהו

scripture_data.text_id: Di sana, di tengah-tengah bangsa-bangsa, ke mana mereka dibawa tertawan, orang-orang yang terluput dari antara kamu akan mengingat kepada-Ku, tatkala Aku mengembalikan hati mereka yang berzinah itu, yang sudah menjauh dari pada-Ku dan mengalihkan mata mereka, yang selalu berzinah dengan mengikuti berhala-berhala mereka; maka mereka sendiri akan merasa mual melihat kejahatan yang mereka lakukan dan melihat segala perbuatan mereka yang keji.
scripture_data.text_en: And they that escape of you shall remember me among the nations whither they shall be carried captives, because I am broken with their whorish heart, which hath departed from me, and with their eyes, which go a whoring after their idols: and they shall lothe themselves for the evils which they have committed in all their abominations.
scripture_data.text_orig: היתב לכל ר תרהל הינפ קנו היל ירח תנה היני תו ילמ רסר הנה לת ירנ ר נ ר י ית כיילף רכזו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan mereka akan mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN dan bukan cakap angin, kalau Aku berfirman hendak menjatuhkan malapetaka ini atas mereka."
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, [and that] I have not said in vain that I would do this evil unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף תה הרה הל תל יר חל ל הוהי יני דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: "Bertepuklah dan entakkanlah kakimu ke tanah dan serukanlah: Awas! Oleh sebab segala perbuatan kaum Israel yang keji dan jahat, mereka akan rebah mati karena pedang, kelaparan dan penyakit sampar.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Smite with thine hand, and stamp with thy foot, and say, Alas for all the evil abominations of the house of Israel! for they shall fall by the sword, by the famine, and by the pestilence.
scripture_data.text_orig: לי רבב בר ברח ר לרי תי תר תבל ל חרמו לגר קר כב הה הוהי ינד רמה

scripture_data.text_id: Yang jauh akan mati karena sampar, yang dekat akan rebah karena pedang dan yang terluput serta terpelihara akan mati karena kelaparan. Demikianlah Aku akan melampiaskan amarah-Ku kepada mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: He that is far off shall die of the pestilence; and he that is near shall fall by the sword; and he that remaineth and is besieged shall die by the famine: thus will I accomplish my fury upon them.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתמח יתיכו תמי בר רצהו רהו לי ברח ברהו תמי רב קחרה

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kamu akan mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN, tatkala orang-orang mereka yang terbunuh berebahan di tengah-tengah berhala-berhala mereka keliling mezbah-mezbahnya, di atas setiap bukit yang tinggi dan di atas semua puncak-puncak gunung, di bawah setiap pohon yang rimbun dan setiap pohon keramat yang penuh cabang-cabang, di tempat mana mereka membawa korban persembahan yang harum bagi semua berhala-berhala mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Then shall ye know that I [am] the LORD, when their slain [men] shall be among their idols round about their altars, upon every high hill, in all the tops of the mountains, and under every green tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they did offer sweet savour to all their idols.
scripture_data.text_orig: היל לכל חחינ חיר נתנ ר קם הב הלל תחתו נר של תחתו ירהה יר לכ המר הבל ל היתחזמ תביבס היל ת היללח תיה הוהי יני דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mengacungkan tangan-Ku melawan mereka dan tanahnya, di mana saja mereka diam, akan Kubuat menjadi musnah dan sunyi sepi mulai dari padang gurun sampai ke Ribla dan mereka akan mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: So will I stretch out my hand upon them, and make the land desolate, yea, more desolate than the wilderness toward Diblath, in all their habitations: and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי יני דיו היתבם לכ התלב רדמ המ הממ שרהת יתנו היל ידית יתינו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Engkau, anak manusia, katakanlah: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH kepada tanah Israel: Berakhir! Berakhirlah keempat penjuru tanah itu.
scripture_data.text_en: Also, thou son of man, thus saith the Lord GOD unto the land of Israel; An end, the end is come upon the four corners of the land.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרה תפנ ר תרל שה שק לרי תמדל הוהי ינד רמה דב הו

scripture_data.text_id: Kini kesudahanmu tiba dan Aku akan mencurahkan murka-Ku atasmu dan Aku akan menghakimi engkau selaras dengan tingkah lakumu dan Aku akan membalaskan kepadamu segala perbuatanmu yang keji.
scripture_data.text_en: Now [is] the end [come] upon thee, and I will send mine anger upon thee, and will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense upon thee all thine abominations.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתבל ת יל יתנו יכרד יפ י יחו יל שה ה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku tidak akan merasa sayang kepadamu dan tidak akan kenal belas kasihan, tetapi Aku akan membalaskan kepadamu selaras dengan tingkah lakumu dan perbuatan-perbuatanmu yang keji akan tertimpa atasmu. Maka kamu akan mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And mine eye shall not spare thee, neither will I have pity: but I will recompense thy ways upon thee, and thine abominations shall be in the midst of thee: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי יני דיו ייה כת יתבתו יל יכרד י למח לו יל יני סחתלו

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Lihat, bencana demi bencana akan datang!
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; An evil, an only evil, behold, is come.
scripture_data.text_orig: הב הה הר תח הר הוהי ינד רמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Kesudahan datang, kesudahanmu tiba, seakan-akan ia terbangun melawan engkau, lihat datangnya!
scripture_data.text_en: An end is come, the end is come: it watcheth for thee; behold, it is come.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה הה יל שיקה שה שק

scripture_data.text_id: Malapetaka datang atasmu, hai penduduk negeri! Waktunya datang, saatnya tiba! Hari huru-hara, bukan tempik sorak di atas gunung-gunung.
scripture_data.text_en: The morning is come unto thee, O thou that dwellest in the land: the time is come, the day of trouble [is] near, and not the sounding again of the mountains.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירה דהלו המהם ה ברק תה שרה בי יל הריפה ה

scripture_data.text_id: Sekarang dengan segera Aku akan mencurahkan amarah-Ku atasmu dan melampiaskan murka-Ku kepadamu, Aku akan menghakimi engkau selaras dengan tingkah lakumu dan membalaskan kepadamu segala perbuatan-perbuat yang keji.
scripture_data.text_en: Now will I shortly pour out my fury upon thee, and accomplish mine anger upon thee: and I will judge thee according to thy ways, and will recompense thee for all thine abominations.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתבל ת יל יתנו יכרד יפ י יתיכו יל יתמח ברמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku tidak akan merasa sayang dan tidak akan kenal belas kasihan; selaras dengan tingkah lakumu akan Kubalaskan kepadamu dan perbuatan-perbuatanm yang keji akan tertimpa atasmu. Maka kamu akan mengetahui, bahwa Aku, Tuhanlah, yang memusnahkan.
scripture_data.text_en: And mine eye shall not spare, neither will I have pity: I will recompense thee according to thy ways and thine abominations [that] are in the midst of thee; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD that smiteth.
scripture_data.text_orig: הם הוהי ינ י דיו ייה כת יתבתו יל יכרד למח לו יני סחתלו

scripture_data.text_id: Lihat, harinya sungguh datang: malapetaka akan menimpa, kelaliman bertunas, keangkuhan bertaruk.
scripture_data.text_en: Behold the day, behold, it is come: the morning is gone forth; the rod hath blossomed, pride hath budded.
scripture_data.text_orig: דה חר הה שצ הרפה הצי הב הה ה הה

scripture_data.text_id: Kekerasan bersimaharajalela, yang menjadi penopang segala kejahatan. Tidak ada dari mereka yang tertinggal, baik dari kelimpahan mereka maupun dari kemewahannya; kemolekannyapun akan terhapus.
scripture_data.text_en: Violence is risen up into a rod of wickedness: none of them [shall remain], nor of their multitude, nor of any of theirs: neither [shall there be] wailing for them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה נלו המהם לו נמהמ לו המל רהמל ק סמחה

scripture_data.text_id: Waktunya datang, harinya mendekat! Biarlah si pembeli jangan bergembira dan biarlah si penjual jangan berdukacita, karena kehangatan murka tertimpa atas segala kegemparan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: The time is come, the day draweth near: let not the buyer rejoice, nor the seller mourn: for wrath [is] upon all the multitude thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: נמהלל רח י לתיל רכהו חמיל הנה ה יה תה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab si penjual tidak akan kembali kepada jualannya, kalaupun mereka masih di tengah-tengah orang hidup, karena kehangatan murka tertimpa atas segala kegemparan mereka dan tidak dapat ditahan lagi, dan seorangpun tidak dapat mempertahankan hidupnya oleh karena kesalahannya.
scripture_data.text_en: For the seller shall not return to that which is sold, although they were yet alive: for the vision [is] touching the whole multitude thereof, [which] shall not return; neither shall any strengthen himself in the iniquity of his life.
scripture_data.text_orig: קחתי ל תח נו יו בי ל נמהלל זחי תח יח דו בי ל רמהל רכה י

scripture_data.text_id: Tiuplah sangkakala dan sediakanlah segala sesuatu! Tetapi seorangpun tidak maju berperang, sebab kehangatan murka-Ku tertimpa atas segala kegemparan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: They have blown the trumpet, even to make all ready; but none goeth to the battle: for my wrath [is] upon all the multitude thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: נמהלל ינרח י המחלל לה יו לה יכהו קב ק

scripture_data.text_id: Pedang ada di luar kota, sampar dan kelaparan ada di dalam. Barangsiapa yang di luar kota akan mati karena pedang, dan barangsiapa yang di dalam kota akan binasa oleh kelaparan dan sampar.
scripture_data.text_en: The sword [is] without, and the pestilence and the famine within: he that [is] in the field shall die with the sword; and he that [is] in the city, famine and pestilence shall devour him.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכי רבדו בר רי רו תמי ברח הד ר תימ ברהו רבהו שח ברחה

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kalaupun ada yang terluput dari antara mereka, mereka akan tinggal di gunung-gunung seperti burung perkutut di lembah-lembah, semuanya mengerang, masing-masing karena kesalahannya sendiri.
scripture_data.text_en: But they that escape of them shall escape, and shall be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them mourning, every one for his iniquity.
scripture_data.text_orig: נו י תמה תיה יני ירההל יהו הייל לפ

scripture_data.text_id: Semua tangan terkulai dan semua orang terkencing ketakutan.
scripture_data.text_en: All hands shall be feeble, and all knees shall be weak [as] water.
scripture_data.text_orig: י הנכל ירלכו הניר ידהל

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan mengenakan kain kabung, kekejutan akan meliputi mereka, semuanya akan kehilangan muka dan semua kepala akan digundul sebagai tanda perkabungan.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall also gird [themselves] with sackcloth, and horror shall cover them; and shame [shall be] upon all faces, and baldness upon all their heads.
scripture_data.text_orig: החרק הירלכב ה ינל לו תצ ת התכו י רגחו

scripture_data.text_id: Perak mereka akan dicampakkan ke luar dan emas mereka akan dianggap cemar. Emas dan peraknya tidak akan dapat menyelamatkan mereka pada hari kemurkaan TUHAN. Mereka tidak akan kenyang karenanya dan perut mereka tidak akan terisi dengannya. Sebab hal itu menjadi batu sandungan, yang menjatuhkan mereka ke dalam kesalahan.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall cast their silver in the streets, and their gold shall be removed: their silver and their gold shall not be able to deliver them in the day of the wrath of the LORD: they shall not satisfy their souls, neither fill their bowels: because it is the stumblingblock of their iniquity.

scripture_data.text_id: Maka engkau, anak manusia, sediakanlah bagimu barang-barang seorang buangan dan berjalanlah seperti seorang buangan pada siang hari di hadapan mata mereka; pergilah dari tempatmu sekarang ke tempat yang lain seperti seorang buangan di hadapan mata mereka. Barangkali mereka akan insaf bahwa mereka adalah kaum pemberontak.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore, thou son of man, prepare thee stuff for removing, and remove by day in their sight; and thou shalt remove from thy place to another place in their sight: it may be they will consider, though they [be] a rebellious house.
scripture_data.text_orig: הה ירם תי י רי יל היניל רח קמל מקמ תילגו היניל מי הלג הלג יל ל ה דב הו

scripture_data.text_id: Bawalah barang-barangmu itu ke luar seperti barang-barang seorang buangan pada siang hari di hadapan mata mereka; dan engkau sendiri harus keluar pada malam hari di hadapan mata mereka, seperti seorang yang harus keluar dan pergi ke pembuangan.
scripture_data.text_en: Then shalt thou bring forth thy stuff by day in their sight, as stuff for removing: and thou shalt go forth at even in their sight, as they that go forth into captivity.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל יצמ היניל ברב צ הו היניל מי הלג ילכ ילכ תצהו

scripture_data.text_id: Di hadapan mata mereka perbuatlah sebuah lobang di tembok dan keluarlah dari situ.
scripture_data.text_en: Dig thou through the wall in their sight, and carry out thereby.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצהו ריב לרתח היניל

scripture_data.text_id: Di hadapan mata mereka taruhlah barang-barangmu ke atas bahumu, dan bawalah itu ke luar pada malam gelap; engkau harus menutupi mukamu, sehingga engkau tidak melihat tanah; sebab Aku membuat engkau menjadi lambang bagi kaum Israel."
scripture_data.text_en: In their sight shalt thou bear [it] upon [thy] shoulders, [and] carry [it] forth in the twilight: thou shalt cover thy face, that thou see not the ground: for I have set thee [for] a sign unto the house of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי תיבל יתן תפמי שרהת הרת לו הכת ינ יצת הל תל היניל

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu kulakukan seperti diperintahkan kepadaku: aku membawa pada siang hari barang-barang seperti barang-barang seorang buangan dan pada malam hari aku membuat dengan tanganku sebuah lobang di tembok, pada malam gelap aku keluar dan di hadapan mata mereka aku menaruh barang-barangku ke atas bahuku.
scripture_data.text_en: And I did so as I was commanded: I brought forth my stuff by day, as stuff for captivity, and in the even I digged through the wall with mine hand; I brought [it] forth in the twilight, [and] I bare [it] upon [my] shoulder in their sight.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף היניל יתנ תל יתצה הל די ריב ילירתח ברב מי הלג ילכ יתצה יל יתיצ ר ו

scripture_data.text_id: Pada hari besoknya datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And in the morning came the word of the LORD unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל רק יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, bukankah ditanya oleh kaum Israel, kaum pemberontak itu kepadamu: Apakah yang kaulakukan ini?
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, hath not the house of Israel, the rebellious house, said unto thee, What doest thou?
scripture_data.text_orig: ה ה המ ירה תי לרי תי יל רמ לה ד

scripture_data.text_id: Katakanlah kepada mereka: beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Ucapan ilahi ini mengenai raja di Yerusalem dan seluruh kaum Israel yang tinggal di sana.
scripture_data.text_en: Say thou unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; This burden [concerneth] the prince in Jerusalem, and all the house of Israel that [are] among them.
scripture_data.text_orig: כתב ההר לרי תילכו לרי הה ה יה הוהי ינד רמ ה היל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Katakanlah: Aku menjadi lambang bagimu; seperti yang kulakukan ini begitulah akan berlaku kepada mereka: sebagai orang buangan mereka akan pergi ke pembuangan.
scripture_data.text_en: Say, I [am] your sign: like as I have done, so shall it be done unto them: they shall remove [and] go into captivity.
scripture_data.text_orig: כלי יבב הל הל הי יתי ר כתפם ינ רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Dan raja yang di tengah-tengah mereka akan menaruh barang-barangnya ke atas bahunya pada malam gelap dan akan pergi ke luar; orang akan membuat sebuah lobang di tembok supaya ada baginya jalan keluar; ia akan menutupi mukanya supaya ia tidak akan melihat tanah itu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the prince that [is] among them shall bear upon [his] shoulder in the twilight, and shall go forth: they shall dig through the wall to carry out thereby: he shall cover his face, that he see not the ground with [his] eyes.
scripture_data.text_orig: שרהת ה יל הריל ר י הכי וינ ב יצהל רחי רי ציו הל י תל כתר יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan memasang jaring-Ku untuk menangkap dia dan di dalam perangkap-Ku dia akan terjebak dan Aku akan membawa dia ke Babel, tanah orang Kasdim, tetapi tanah itu sendiri tidak akan dilihatnya; ia akan mati di sana.
scripture_data.text_en: My net also will I spread upon him, and he shall be taken in my snare: and I will bring him to Babylon [to] the land of the Chaldeans; yet shall he not see it, though he shall die there.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמי ו הריל תו י שר הלבב ת יתבהו יתדצמ תנו ויל ירת ירפ

scripture_data.text_id: Dan semua yang di sekitarnya, para pembantunya dan bala tentaranya, akan Kuhamburkan ke semua mata angin dan Aku akan menghunus pedang dari belakang mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will scatter toward every wind all that [are] about him to help him, and all his bands; and I will draw out the sword after them.
scripture_data.text_orig: הירח קיר ברחו חרלכל הרז ויגלכו רז הרז ויתביבס ר לכו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka mereka akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN, apabila aku menyerakkan mereka di antara bangsa-bangsa dan menghamburkan mereka ke semua negeri.
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I shall scatter them among the nations, and disperse them in the countries.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצר ת יתירזו י ת יציפה הוהי יני דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Aku akan meninggalkan sedikit dari mereka yang luput dari pedang, dari kelaparan dan dari sampar, supaya mereka menceriterakan segala perbuatan-perbuatan mereka yang keji di antara bangsa-bangsa, di mana mereka datang; dan mereka akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the pestilence; that they may declare all their abominations among the heathen whither they come; and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי יני דיו ר י היתבלת רסי מל רבמ ברמ ברחמ רסמ ינ המ ירתהו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, makanlah makananmu dengan gemetar dan minumlah air dengan menggigil dan dengan hati yang cemas,
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, eat thy bread with quaking, and drink thy water with trembling and with carefulness;
scripture_data.text_orig: ה הגדב הזגר ימימ לכ ר מחל ד

scripture_data.text_id: dan katakanlah kepada penduduk negeri ini: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH tentang penduduk Yerusalem yang di tanah Israel: Mereka akan makan makanannya dengan hati yang cemas dan minum air dengan hati yang gundah-gulana supaya tanah mereka menjadi sunyi sepi lantaran isinya sudah lenyap, oleh karena kekerasan yang dilakukan oleh semua yang tinggal di sana.
scripture_data.text_en: And say unto the people of the land, Thus saith the Lord GOD of the inhabitants of Jerusalem, [and] of the land of Israel; They shall eat their bread with carefulness, and drink their water with astonishment, that her land may be desolate from all that is therein, because of the violence of all them that dwell therein.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבהל סמחמ למ צר מל י מ הימימ לכי הגד מחל לרי תמדל לרי יביל הוהי ינד רמה שרה ל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Kota-kota yang masih didiami orang akan menjadi reruntuhan dan tanah itu akan menjadi sunyi sepi; dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: And the cities that are inhabited shall be laid waste, and the land shall be desolate; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי יני דיו היהת הממ שרהו הנברח תבה ירהו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, sindiran apakah itu yang hidup di antara kamu di tanah Israel, yang berbunyi: Sudah lama berselang, tetapi satu penglihatanpun tak jadi?
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, what [is] that proverb [that] ye have in the land of Israel, saying, The days are prolonged, and every vision faileth?
scripture_data.text_orig: זחל דבו ימה כרי רמל לרי תמדל כל הה לההמ ד

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena itu katakanlah kepada mereka: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Aku akan menghentikan sindiran ini dan orang tidak akan mengucapkannya lagi di tanah Israel. Sebaliknya, katakanlah kepada mereka: Waktunya sudah dekat dan tiap penglihatan akan jadi.
scripture_data.text_en: Tell them therefore, Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will make this proverb to cease, and they shall no more use it as a proverb in Israel; but say unto them, The days are at hand, and the effect of every vision.
scripture_data.text_orig: זחל רבד ימה ברק היל ר י לרי ד ת למילו הה להת יה הוהי ינד רמה היל רמ כל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab tidak akan ada lagi penglihatan yang menipu ataupun tenungan yang menyesatkan di tengah-tengah kaum Israel,
scripture_data.text_en: For there shall be no more any vain vision nor flattering divination within the house of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי תי ת קלח סקמ ו זחל ד היהי ל י

scripture_data.text_id: sebab Aku, TUHAN, akan berfirman dan apa yang Kufirmankan akan terjadi, dan firman itu tidak akan ditunda-tunda lagi, sebab pada masa hidupmu, hai kaum pemberontak, Aku akan mengucapkan suatu firman dan Aku akan menggenapinya, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH."
scripture_data.text_en: For I [am] the LORD: I will speak, and the word that I shall speak shall come to pass; it shall be no more prolonged: for in your days, O rebellious house, will I say the word, and will perform it, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ינד ן ויתיו רב רד ירה תי כימיב י ד ת ל היו רב רד ר ת רד הוהי ינ י

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: Again the word of the LORD came to me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, lihatlah, kaum Israel berkata: Penglihatan yang dilihatnya itu, harinya masih jauh, nubuatan yang diucapkannya, waktunya masih lama.
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, behold, [they of] the house of Israel say, The vision that he seeth [is] for many days [to come], and he prophesieth of the times [that are] far off.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ ה תקחר יל יר ימיל הזח הר זחה ירמ לריתיב הה ד

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena itu katakanlah kepada mereka: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Tidak satupun dari firman-Ku akan ditunda-tunda. Apa yang Kufirmankan akan terjadi, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH."
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; There shall none of my words be prolonged any more, but the word which I have spoken shall be done, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהי ינד ן היו רב רד ר ירבל ד תל הוהי ינד רמ ה היל רמ כל

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, bernubuatlah melawan nabi-nabi Israel, bernubuatlah dan katakanlah kepada mereka yang bernubuat sesuka hatinya saja: Dengarlah firman TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel that prophesy, and say thou unto them that prophesy out of their own hearts, Hear ye the word of the LORD;
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהירב מ מ ייבנל רמו יה לרי ייבנל בה ד

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Celakalah nabi-nabi yang bebal yang mengikuti bisikan hatinya sendiri dan yang tidak melihat sesuatu penglihatan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe unto the foolish prophets, that follow their own spirit, and have seen nothing!
scripture_data.text_orig: ר ילבל חר רח יכלה ר ילבה ייבהל יה הוהי ינד רמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti anjing hutan di tengah-tengah reruntuhan, begitulah nabi-nabimu, hai Israel!
scripture_data.text_en: O Israel, thy prophets are like the foxes in the deserts.
scripture_data.text_orig: יה לרי ייבן תברח יל

scripture_data.text_id: Kamu tidak mempertahankan lobang-lobang pada tembokmu dan tidak mendirikan tembok sekeliling rumah Israel, supaya mereka dapat tetap berdiri di dalam peperangan pada hari TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Ye have not gone up into the gaps, neither made up the hedge for the house of Israel to stand in the battle in the day of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי י המחל דמל לרי תיל רדג רגו תצר תיל ל

scripture_data.text_id: Penglihatan mereka menipu dan tenungan mereka adalah bohong; mereka berkata: Demikianlah firman TUHAN, padahal TUHAN tidak mengutus mereka, dan mereka menanti firman itu digenapi-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: They have seen vanity and lying divination, saying, The LORD saith: and the LORD hath not sent them: and they have made [others] to hope that they would confirm the word.
scripture_data.text_orig: רב קל לחיו חל ל הוהיו הוהין ירמה בז סקו ו זח

scripture_data.text_id: Bukankah penglihatan tipuan yang kamu lihat dan tenungan bohong yang kamu katakan, kalau kamu berkata: Demikianlah firman TUHAN, padahal Aku tidak berbicara?
scripture_data.text_en: Have ye not seen a vain vision, and have ye not spoken a lying divination, whereas ye say, The LORD saith [it]; albeit I have not spoken?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ירד ל ינו הוהין ירמו רמ בז סקמ תיזח והזחם לה

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu, beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH, oleh karena kamu mengatakan kata-kata dusta dan melihat perkara-perkara bohong, maka Aku akan menjadi lawanmu, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have spoken vanity, and seen lies, therefore, behold, I [am] against you, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ינד ן כיל יננה כל בז תיזחו ו כר י הוהי ינד רמ ה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mengacungkan tangan-Ku melawan nabi-nabi yang melihat perkara-perkara yang menipu dan yang mengucapkan tenungan-tenungan bohong; mereka tidak termasuk perkumpulan umat-Ku dan tidak akan tercatat dalam daftar kaum Israel, dan tidak akan masuk lagi di tanah Israel; dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah Tuhan ALLAH.
scripture_data.text_en: And mine hand shall be upon the prophets that see vanity, and that divine lies: they shall not be in the assembly of my people, neither shall they be written in the writing of the house of Israel, neither shall they enter into the land of Israel; and ye shall know that I [am] the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי ינד ינ י דיו בי ל לרי תמדלו בתי ל לריתי בתכב יהיל י דס בז ימסהו ו יזחה ייבהל ידי התיהו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena, ya sungguh karena mereka menyesatkan umat-Ku dengan mengatakan: Damai sejahtera!, padahal sama sekali tidak ada damai sejahtera mereka itu mendirikan tembok dan lihat, mereka mengapurnya
scripture_data.text_en: Because, even because they have seduced my people, saying, Peace; and [there was] no peace; and one built up a wall, and, lo, others daubed it with untempered [morter]:
scripture_data.text_orig: לפ ת יח הו שיח הנ הו ל יו ל רמל ית ה יב י

scripture_data.text_id: katakanlah kepada mereka yang mengapur tembok itu: Hujan lebat akan membanjir, rambun akan jatuh dan angin tofan akan bertiup!
scripture_data.text_en: Say unto them which daub [it] with untempered [morter], that it shall fall: there shall be an overflowing shower; and ye, O great hailstones, shall fall; and a stormy wind shall rend [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ב תרס חרו הנל יבל ינב הנו היה ליו לפת יחל רמ

scripture_data.text_id: Kalau tembok itu sudah runtuh, apakah orang tidak akan berkata kepadamu: Di mana sekarang kapur, yang kamu oleskan itu?
scripture_data.text_en: Lo, when the wall is fallen, shall it not be said unto you, Where [is] the daubing wherewith ye have daubed [it]?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ח ר חיה ה כיל רמי לה ריה לפנ ההו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Di dalam amarah-Ku Aku akan membuat angin tofan bertiup dan di dalam murka-Ku hujan lebat akan membanjir, dan di dalam amarah-Ku rambun yang membinasakan akan jatuh.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; I will even rend [it] with a stormy wind in my fury; and there shall be an overflowing shower in mine anger, and great hailstones in [my] fury to consume [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: הלכל המח יבל ינבו היהי י גו יתמח תרסחר יב הוהי ינד רמ ה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Aku akan meruntuhkan tembok yang kamu kapur itu dan merobohkannya ke tanah, supaya dasarnya menjadi kelihatan; tembok kota itu akan runtuh dan kamu akan tewas di dalamnya. Dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: So will I break down the wall that ye have daubed with untempered [morter], and bring it down to the ground, so that the foundation thereof shall be discovered, and it shall fall, and ye shall be consumed in the midst thereof: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יני דיו כת תילכ הלפנו דסי הלגנו שרהל היהו לפ חר ריהת יסרהו

scripture_data.text_id: Begitulah Aku akan melampiaskan amarah-Ku atas tembok itu dan kepada mereka yang mengapurnya dan Aku akan berkata kepadamu: Lenyap temboknya dan lenyap orang-orang yang mengapurnya,
scripture_data.text_en: Thus will I accomplish my wrath upon the wall, and upon them that have daubed it with untempered [morter], and will say unto you, The wall [is] no [more], neither they that daubed it;
scripture_data.text_orig: ת יחה יו ריה י כל רמו לפ ת יחב רי יתמחת יתיכו

scripture_data.text_id: yaitu nabi-nabi Israel yang bernubuat tentang Yerusalem dan melihat baginya suatu penglihatan mengenai damai sejahtera, padahal sama sekali tidak ada damai sejahtera, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH."
scripture_data.text_en: [To wit], the prophets of Israel which prophesy concerning Jerusalem, and which see visions of peace for her, and [there is] no peace, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ינד ן ל יו ל זח ל יזחהו לריל ינה לרי ייבן

scripture_data.text_id: "Engkau anak manusia, tujukanlah mukamu kepada kaum perempuan bangsamu yang bernubuat sesuka hatinya saja dan bernubuatlah melawan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Likewise, thou son of man, set thy face against the daughters of thy people, which prophesy out of their own heart; and prophesy thou against them,
scripture_data.text_orig: היל בהו המ תנתה תנל ינ י דב הו

scripture_data.text_id: Katakanlah: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Celakalah dukun-dukun perempuan, yang mengikatkan tali-tali azimat pada semua pergelangan dan mengenakan selubung pada kepala semua orang, tua atau muda, untuk menangkap jiwa orang. Apakah kamu hendak menangkap jiwa orang yang termasuk umat-Ku dan membiarkan orang-orang lain hidup untuk kepentinganmu?
scripture_data.text_en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Woe to the [women] that sew pillows to all armholes, and make kerchiefs upon the head of every stature to hunt souls! Will ye hunt the souls of my people, and will ye save the souls alive [that come] unto you?
scripture_data.text_orig: הניחת הנכל תפנ יל הנדדצ תפה תפן דדצל המקל רל תחסה תו ידי יליל ל תתס תרתמל יה הוהי ינד רמה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Kamu melanggar kekudusan-Ku di tengah-tengah umat-Ku hanya demi beberapa genggam jelai dan beberapa potong roti, dengan membunuh orang-orang yang tidak patut mati, dan membiarkan hidup orang-orang yang tidak patut hidup, dalam hal kamu berbohong kepada umat-Ku yang sedia mendengar bohong.
scripture_data.text_en: And will ye pollute me among my people for handfuls of barley and for pieces of bread, to slay the souls that should not die, and to save the souls alive that should not live, by your lying to my people that hear [your] lies?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס בזכ ימ יל כבכ הנייחתל ר תפן תחל הנתמתל ר תפן תימהל חל יתתפב יר יל יל ית הנלחו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Aku akan menentang tali-tali azimatmu, dengan mana kamu menangkap jiwa orang dan Aku akan mengoyakkannya dari tanganmu dan melepaskan seperti burung-burung, orang-orang yang kamu tangkap.
scripture_data.text_en: Wherefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I [am] against your pillows, wherewith ye there hunt the souls to make [them] fly, and I will tear them from your arms, and will let the souls go, [even] the souls that ye hunt to make [them] fly.
scripture_data.text_orig: תחרפל יפנת תדדצם ר תפהת יחו כיתרז למ ת ירקו תחרפל תפהת תדדצם הנ ר הנכיתתל יננה הוהי ינד רמה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mengoyakkan selubungmu dan akan melepaskan umat-Ku dari tanganmu dan mereka tidak lagi menjadi mangsa di dalam tanganmu. Dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: Your kerchiefs also will I tear, and deliver my people out of your hand, and they shall be no more in your hand to be hunted; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יני דיו הדצמל כדי ד יהילו כדמ ית ילהו כיתחסמת ירקו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena kamu melemahkan hati orang benar dengan dusta, sedang Aku tidak mendukakan hatinya, dan sebaliknya kamu mengeraskan hati orang fasik, sehingga ia tidak bertobat dari kelakuannya yang fasik itu, dan kamu membiarkan dia hidup.
scripture_data.text_en: Because with lies ye have made the heart of the righteous sad, whom I have not made sad; and strengthened the hands of the wicked, that he should not return from his wicked way, by promising him life:
scripture_data.text_orig: תיחהל רה רמ בילבל ר ידי קחל ויבכה ל ינו רק קיצבל תכה י

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu kamu tidak lagi melihat perkara-perkara yang menipu dan mengucapkan tenungan-tenungan bohong; Aku akan melepaskan umat-Ku dari tanganmu dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore ye shall see no more vanity, nor divine divinations: for I will deliver my people out of your hand: and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יני דיו כדמ ית ילהו ד הנמסקתל סקו הניזחת ל ו כל

scripture_data.text_id: Sesudah itu datanglah kepadaku beberapa orang dari tua-tua Israel dan duduk di hadapanku.
scripture_data.text_en: Then came certain of the elders of Israel unto me, and sat before me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ינפל בו לרי ינקמ ינ יל בו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, orang-orang ini menjunjung berhala-berhala mereka dalam hatinya dan menempatkan di hadapan mereka batu sandungan, yang menjatuhkan mereka ke dalam kesalahan. Apakah Aku mau mereka meminta petunjuk dari pada-Ku?
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, these men have set up their idols in their heart, and put the stumblingblock of their iniquity before their face: should I be enquired of at all by them?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הל ר רה הינ חכנ נתנ נו לכמ לל הילג לה הה ינה ד

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu berbicaralah kepada mereka dan katakan: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Setiap orang dari kaum Israel yang menjunjung berhala-berhalanya dalam hatinya dan menempatkan di hadapannya batu sandungan yang menjatuhkannya ke dalam kesalahan, lalu datang menemui nabi Aku, TUHAN sendiri akan menjawab dia oleh karena berhala-berhalanya yang banyak itu,
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore speak unto them, and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Every man of the house of Israel that setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to the prophet; I the LORD will answer him that cometh according to the multitude of his idols;
scripture_data.text_orig: ויל בר ב ב ל יתינן הוהי ינ יבהל ב וינ חכנ יי נו לכמ לל וילת הלי ר לרי תימ י י הוהי ינד רמה היל רמו תר כל

scripture_data.text_id: supaya Aku memikat hati kaum Israel, yang seluruhnya sudah menyimpang dari pada-Ku dengan mengikuti segala berhala-berhala mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: That I may take the house of Israel in their own heart, because they are all estranged from me through their idols.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הילג ילמ רזנ ר ל לריתית פ מל

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena itu katakanlah kepada kaum Israel: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Bertobatlah dan berpalinglah dari berhala-berhalamu dan palingkanlah mukamu dari segala perbuatan-perbuatanmu yang keji.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore say unto the house of Israel, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Repent, and turn [yourselves] from your idols; and turn away your faces from all your abominations.
scripture_data.text_orig: כינף ביה כיתבל למ כיל למ ביהו ב הוהי ינד רמ ה לרי תיל רמ כל

scripture_data.text_id: Karena setiap orang, baik dari kaum Israel maupun dari orang-orang asing yang tinggal di tengah-tengah Israel, yang menyimpang dari pada-Ku dan menjunjung berhala-berhalanya dalam hatinya dan menempatkan di hadapannya batu sandungan, yang menjatuhkannya ke dalam kesalahan, lalu datang menemui nabi untuk meminta petunjuk dari pada-Ku baginya Aku, TUHAN sendiri akan menjawab dia.
scripture_data.text_en: For every one of the house of Israel, or of the stranger that sojourneth in Israel, which separateth himself from me, and setteth up his idols in his heart, and putteth the stumblingblock of his iniquity before his face, and cometh to a prophet to enquire of him concerning me; I the LORD will answer him by myself:

scripture_data.text_id: Aku sendiri akan menentang orang itu dan Aku akan membuat dia menjadi lambang dan kiasan dan melenyapkannya dari tengah-tengah umat-Ku. Dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will set my face against that man, and will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will cut him off from the midst of my people; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Jikalau nabi itu membiarkan dirinya tergoda dengan mengatakan suatu ucapan Aku, TUHAN yang menggoda nabi itu maka Aku akan mengacungkan tangan-Ku melawan dia dan memunahkannya dari tengah-tengah umat-Ku Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: And if the prophet be deceived when he hath spoken a thing, I the LORD have deceived that prophet, and I will stretch out my hand upon him, and will destroy him from the midst of my people Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי י מ וידמהו ויל ידית יתינו הה יבה ת יתי הוהי ינ רב רדו הפייכ יבהו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan menanggung kesalahannya sendiri, baik yang meminta petunjuk maupun nabi,
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall bear the punishment of their iniquity: the punishment of the prophet shall be even as the punishment of him that seeketh [unto him];
scripture_data.text_orig: היהי יבה ו רה ו נו נו

scripture_data.text_id: supaya kaum Israel jangan lagi sesat dari pada-Ku dan jangan lagi menajiskan dirinya dengan segala pelanggaran mereka; dengan demikian mereka akan menjadi umat-Ku dan Aku akan menjadi Allah mereka, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH."
scripture_data.text_en: That the house of Israel may go no more astray from me, neither be polluted any more with all their transgressions; but that they may be my people, and I may be their God, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ינד ן יהלל הל היה ינו ל יל יהו הילכ ד ילו ירחמ לריתי ד תיל מל

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: The word of the LORD came again to me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, kalau sesuatu negeri berdosa kepada-Ku dengan berobah setia dan Aku mengacungkan tangan-Ku melawannya dengan memusnahkan persediaan makanannya dan mendatangkan kelaparan atasnya dan melenyapkan dari negeri itu manusia dan binatang,
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, when the land sinneth against me by trespassing grievously, then will I stretch out mine hand upon it, and will break the staff of the bread thereof, and will send famine upon it, and will cut off man and beast from it:
scripture_data.text_orig: המהב ד המ ירכהו בר ביחלהו חלהם ל ירבו היל ידי יתינו למלמל ילחת י שר ד

scripture_data.text_id: biarpun di tengah-tengahnya berada ketiga orang ini, yaitu Nuh, Daniel dan Ayub, mereka akan menyelamatkan hanya nyawanya sendiri karena kebenaran mereka, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH.
scripture_data.text_en: Though these three men, Noah, Daniel, and Job, were in it, they should deliver [but] their own souls by their righteousness, saith the Lord GOD.

scripture_data.text_id: Atau jikalau Aku membuat binatang buas berkeliaran di negeri itu, yang memunahkan penduduknya, sehingga negeri itu menjadi sunyi sepi, dan tidak seorangpun berani melintasinya karena binatang buas itu,
scripture_data.text_en: If I cause noisome beasts to pass through the land, and they spoil it, so that it be desolate, that no man may pass through because of the beasts:

scripture_data.text_id: dan biarpun di tengah-tengahnya berada ketiga orang tadi, demi Aku yang hidup, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH, mereka tidak akan menyelamatkan baik anak-anak lelaki maupun anak-anak perempuan; hanya mereka sendiri akan diselamatkan, tetapi negeri itu akan menjadi sunyi sepi.
scripture_data.text_en: [Though] these three men [were] in it, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters; they only shall be delivered, but the land shall be desolate.

scripture_data.text_id: Atau jikalau Aku membawa pedang atas negeri itu dan Aku berfirman: Hai pedang, jelajahilah negeri itu!, dan Aku melenyapkan dari negeri itu manusia dan binatang,
scripture_data.text_en: Or [if] I bring a sword upon that land, and say, Sword, go through the land; so that I cut off man and beast from it:

scripture_data.text_id: dan biarpun di tengah-tengahnya berada ketiga orang tadi, demi Aku yang hidup, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH, mereka tidak akan menyelamatkan baik anak-anak lelaki maupun anak-anak perempuan, tetapi hanya mereka sendiri akan diselamatkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Though these three men [were] in it, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither sons nor daughters, but they only shall be delivered themselves.

scripture_data.text_en: Or [if] I send a pestilence into that land, and pour out my fury upon it in blood, to cut off from it man and beast:

scripture_data.text_id: dan biarpun Nuh, Daniel dan Ayub berada di tengah-tengahnya, demi Aku yang hidup, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH, mereka tidak akan menyelamatkan baik anak laki-laki maupun anak perempuan, melainkan mereka akan menyelamatkan hanya nyawanya sendiri karena kebenaran mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Though Noah, Daniel, and Job, [were] in it, [as] I live, saith the Lord GOD, they shall deliver neither son nor daughter; they shall [but] deliver their own souls by their righteousness.

scripture_data.text_id: Ya, beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Jauh lebih dari itu, kalau Aku mendatangkan keempat hukuman-Ku yang berat-berat, yaitu pedang, kelaparan, binatang buas dan sampar, atas Yerusalem untuk melenyapkan dari padanya manusia dan binatang!
scripture_data.text_en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; How much more when I send my four sore judgments upon Jerusalem, the sword, and the famine, and the noisome beast, and the pestilence, to cut off from it man and beast?
scripture_data.text_orig: המהב ד המ תירכהל לריל יח רבדו הר החו ברו ברח ירה יפ תרי הוהי ינד רמ הכ י

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi sungguh, akan tertinggal di sana orang yang terluput, yang mengiring ke luar anak-anak lelaki dan perempuan; lihat, mereka akan datang kepadamu dan kamu akan melihat tingkah laku mereka dan kamu akan merasa terhibur tentang malapetaka yang Kudatangkan atas Yerusalem, ya tentang segala-galanya yang Kudatangkan atasnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Yet, behold, therein shall be left a remnant that shall be brought forth, [both] sons and daughters: behold, they shall come forth unto you, and ye shall see their way and their doings: and ye shall be comforted concerning the evil that I have brought upon Jerusalem, [even] concerning all that I have brought upon it.
scripture_data.text_orig: היל יתבה רל ת לריל יתבה ר הרהל מחנו תלילתו רת תיר כיל יצי ה תנב ינ יצה הל הרתן ההו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan menghibur kamu, kalau kamu melihat tingkah lakunya, dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa bukan tanpa alasan Kuperbuat segala sesuatu yang Kuperbuat atas Yerusalem, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH."
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall comfort you, when ye see their ways and their doings: and ye shall know that I have not done without cause all that I have done in it, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ינד ן ב יתירל ת יתי ח ל י דיו תלילתו רת רתי כת מחנו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, apakah kelebihan kayu anggur dari semua kayu yang buahnya seperti anggur yang tumbuh di antara kayu-kayu di hutan?
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, What is the vine tree more than any tree, [or than] a branch which is among the trees of the forest?

scripture_data.text_id: Apakah orang mengambil kayunya untuk membuat sesuatu dari padanya ataukah membuat gantungan dari padanya untuk menggantungkan segala macam perkakas padanya?
scripture_data.text_en: Shall wood be taken thereof to do any work? or will [men] take a pin of it to hang any vessel thereon?
scripture_data.text_orig: ילל ויל תלתל דתי מ חקי הכלמל תל ש מ חיה

scripture_data.text_id: Sungguh, kayu itu dilemparkan ke dalam api untuk dibakar; kedua ujungnya habis dimakan api dan tengah-tengahnya sedang menyala, bergunakah lagi itu untuk membuat sesuatu?
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, it is cast into the fire for fuel; the fire devoureth both the ends of it, and the midst of it is burned. Is it meet for [any] work?
scripture_data.text_orig: הכלמל חלציה רחנ כתו ה הלכ ויתצק ינ ת הלכל נ ל הה

scripture_data.text_id: Lihat, sedangkan waktu ia masih utuh, tidak dipakai untuk sesuatu, apalagi sesudah dimakan api dan terbakar; apakah masih dapat lagi dipakai untuk sesuatu?
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, when it was whole, it was meet for no work: how much less shall it be meet yet for [any] work, when the fire hath devoured it, and it is burned?
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הכלמל ד הנו רחו התלכ י הכלמל הי ל ימת תיה הה

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Seperti kayu anggur di antara kayu-kayu di hutan, yang Kulemparkan ke dalam api untuk dibakar, begitulah Aku lakukan terhadap penduduk Yerusalem.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; As the vine tree among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for fuel, so will I give the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי יבית יתנ הלכל ל ויתנר רה ש פהש ר הוהי ינד רמ ה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Aku sendiri akan menentang mereka. Walaupun mereka luput dari api, tetapi api akan memakan mereka. Dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN, pada saat Aku menentang mereka
scripture_data.text_en: And I will set my face against them; they shall go out from [one] fire, and [another] fire shall devour them; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I set my face against them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה ינת ימ הוהי יני דיו לכ הו צי המ ה ינת יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: dan Aku menjadikan negeri itu sunyi sepi, oleh karena mereka berobah setia, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH."
scripture_data.text_en: And I will make the land desolate, because they have committed a trespass, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ינד ן למ למ י הממ שרהת יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, beritahukanlah kepada Yerusalem perbuatan-perbuatannya yang keji
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, cause Jerusalem to know her abominations,
scripture_data.text_orig: היתבת לרית דה ד

scripture_data.text_id: dan katakanlah: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH kepada Yerusalem: Asalmu dan kelahiranmu ialah dari tanah Kanaan; ayahmu ialah orang Amori dan ibumu orang Heti.
scripture_data.text_en: And say, Thus saith the Lord GOD unto Jerusalem; Thy birth and thy nativity [is] of the land of Canaan; thy father [was] an Amorite, and thy mother an Hittite.
scripture_data.text_orig: תיח ו ירמה יב יננה שרמ יתדלמ יתרכם לריל הוהי ינד רמה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Kelahiranmu begini: Waktu engkau dilahirkan, pusatmu tidak dipotong dan engkau tidak dibasuh dengan air supaya bersih; juga dengan garampun engkau tidak digosok atau dibedungi dengan lampin.
scripture_data.text_en: And [as for] thy nativity, in the day thou wast born thy navel was not cut, neither wast thou washed in water to supple [thee]; thou wast not salted at all, nor swaddled at all.

scripture_data.text_id: Tidak seorangpun merasa sayang kepadamu sehingga diperbuatnya hal-hal itu kepadamu dari rasa belas kasihan; malahan engkau dibuang ke ladang, oleh karena orang pandang enteng kepadamu pada hari lahirmu.
scripture_data.text_en: None eye pitied thee, to do any of these unto thee, to have compassion upon thee; but thou wast cast out in the open field, to the lothing of thy person, in the day that thou wast born.

scripture_data.text_en: And thy renown went forth among the heathen for thy beauty: for it [was] perfect through my comeliness, which I had put upon thee, saith the Lord GOD.

scripture_data.text_en: But thou didst trust in thine own beauty, and playedst the harlot because of thy renown, and pouredst out thy fornications on every one that passed by; his it was.

scripture_data.text_en: And of thy garments thou didst take, and deckedst thy high places with divers colours, and playedst the harlot thereupon: [the like things] shall not come, neither shall it be [so].

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau mengambil dari pakaianmu yang berwarna-warni untuk menutupi mereka dan engkau mempersembahkan kepada mereka minyak-Ku dan ukupan-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: And tookest thy broidered garments, and coveredst them: and thou hast set mine oil and mine incense before them.

scripture_data.text_en: My meat also which I gave thee, fine flour, and oil, and honey, [wherewith] I fed thee, thou hast even set it before them for a sweet savour: and [thus] it was, saith the Lord GOD.

scripture_data.text_id: Bahkan, engkau mengambil anak-anakmu lelaki dan perempuan yang engkau lahirkan bagi-Ku dan mempersembahkannya kepada mereka menjadi makanan mereka. Apakah persundalanmu ini masih perkara enteng
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover thou hast taken thy sons and thy daughters, whom thou hast borne unto me, and these hast thou sacrificed unto them to be devoured. [Is this] of thy whoredoms a small matter,

scripture_data.text_en: And in all thine abominations and thy whoredoms thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, when thou wast naked and bare, [and] wast polluted in thy blood.

scripture_data.text_en: Thou hast also committed fornication with the Egyptians thy neighbours, great of flesh; and hast increased thy whoredoms, to provoke me to anger.

scripture_data.text_en: How weak is thine heart, saith the Lord GOD, seeing thou doest all these [things], the work of an imperious whorish woman;

scripture_data.text_en: They give gifts to all whores: but thou givest thy gifts to all thy lovers, and hirest them, that they may come unto thee on every side for thy whoredom.

scripture_data.text_id: Maka dalam persundalanmu engkau adalah kebalikan dari perempuan-perempuan yang lain; bukan orang yang mengejar engkau hendak bersundal; tetapi engkau yang memberi upah persundalan, sedang engkau tidak diberi apa-apa; itulah kebalikannya padamu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the contrary is in thee from [other] women in thy whoredoms, whereas none followeth thee to commit whoredoms: and in that thou givest a reward, and no reward is given unto thee, therefore thou art contrary.

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena itu, hai perempuan sundal, dengarkanlah firman TUHAN!

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Oleh karena engkau menghamburkan kemesumanmu dan auratmu disingkapkan dalam persundalanmu dengan orang yang mencintaimu dan dengan berhala-berhalamu yang keji dan oleh karena darah anak-anakmu yang engkau persembahkan kepada mereka,
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Because thy filthiness was poured out, and thy nakedness discovered through thy whoredoms with thy lovers, and with all the idols of thy abominations, and by the blood of thy children, which thou didst give unto them;

scripture_data.text_en: Behold, therefore I will gather all thy lovers, with whom thou hast taken pleasure, and all [them] that thou hast loved, with all [them] that thou hast hated; I will even gather them round about against thee, and will discover thy nakedness unto them, that they may see all thy nakedness.

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan menghakimi engkau seperti orang menghakimi perempuan-perempuan yang berzinah dan yang menumpahkan darah dan Aku akan melampiaskan atasmu murka dan cemburuan-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will judge thee, as women that break wedlock and shed blood are judged; and I will give thee blood in fury and jealousy.

scripture_data.text_en: They shall also bring up a company against thee, and they shall stone thee with stones, and thrust thee through with their swords.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan membakar rumah-rumahmu dan menjatuhkan hukuman kepadamu di hadapan banyak perempuan. Dengan demikian Aku membuat engkau berhenti bersundal dan upah sundal tidak akan kauberikan lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall burn thine houses with fire, and execute judgments upon thee in the sight of many women: and I will cause thee to cease from playing the harlot, and thou also shalt give no hire any more.

scripture_data.text_id: Demikianlah Aku melampiaskan murka-Ku kepadamu sehingga cemburu-Ku kepadamu reda kembali; barulah Aku merasa tenang dan tidak sakit hati lagi.
scripture_data.text_en: So will I make my fury toward thee to rest, and my jealousy shall depart from thee, and I will be quiet, and will be no more angry.

Bukankah engkau melakukan kemesuman ini lagi di samping segala perbuatan-perbuatanmu yang keji?
scripture_data.text_en: Because thou hast not remembered the days of thy youth, but hast fretted me in all these [things]; behold, therefore I also will recompense thy way upon [thine] head, saith the Lord GOD: and thou shalt not commit this lewdness above all thine abominations.

scripture_data.text_id: Lihat, setiap penyair akan mengatakan sindiran ini mengenai engkau: Begitu ibu, begitu anak!
scripture_data.text_en: Behold, every one that useth proverbs shall use [this] proverb against thee, saying, As [is] the mother, [so is] her daughter.

scripture_data.text_en: Thou [art] thy mother's daughter, that lotheth her husband and her children; and thou [art] the sister of thy sisters, which lothed their husbands and their children: your mother [was] an Hittite, and your father an Amorite.

scripture_data.text_en: And thine elder sister [is] Samaria, she and her daughters that dwell at thy left hand: and thy younger sister, that dwelleth at thy right hand, [is] Sodom and her daughters.

scripture_data.text_id: Bukankah engkau hidup menurut perbuatan mereka dan engkau lakukan seperti perbuatan-perbuatan mereka yang keji; sebentar lagi saja engkau berbuat lebih jahat dari mereka dalam seluruh hidupmu.
scripture_data.text_en: Yet hast thou not walked after their ways, nor done after their abominations: but, as [if that were] a very little [thing], thou wast corrupted more than they in all thy ways.

scripture_data.text_en: [As] I live, saith the Lord GOD, Sodom thy sister hath not done, she nor her daughters, as thou hast done, thou and thy daughters.

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Aku berkata kepada mereka: Biarlah setiap orang membuangkan dewa-dewanya yang menjijikkan, ke mana ia selalu melihat dan janganlah menajiskan dirimu dengan berhala-berhala Mesir; Akulah TUHAN, Allahmu.

scripture_data.text_en: But they rebelled against me, and would not hearken unto me: they did not every man cast away the abominations of their eyes, neither did they forsake the idols of Egypt: then I said, I will pour out my fury upon them, to accomplish my anger against them in the midst of the land of Egypt.

scripture_data.text_en: But I wrought for my name's sake, that it should not be polluted before the heathen, among whom they [were], in whose sight I made myself known unto them, in bringing them forth out of the land of Egypt.

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, tujukanlah mukamu ke selatan dan ucapkanlah banyak tegoran terhadap tanah selatan dan bernubuatlah terhadap tanah kehutanan di sebelah selatan;
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, set thy face toward the south, and drop [thy word] toward the south, and prophesy against the forest of the south field;
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: dan katakanlah kepada hutan di sebelah selatan: Dengarlah firman TUHAN: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Lihat, Aku akan menyalakan api di dalammu yang akan memakan habis setiap pohon yang hidup padamu dan setiap pohon yang layu kering. Apinya yang sedang bernyala-nyala tidak akan padam dan semua muka dari selatan sampai utara akan terbakar kepanasan olehnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And say to the forest of the south, Hear the word of the LORD; Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will kindle a fire in thee, and it shall devour every green tree in thee, and every dry tree: the flaming flame shall not be quenched, and all faces from the south to the north shall be burned therein.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Dan setiap manusia akan melihat, bahwa Aku, Tuhanlah yang memasangnya; api itu tidak akan padam."
scripture_data.text_en: And all flesh shall see that I the LORD have kindled it: it shall not be quenched.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu aku berkata: "Aduh, Tuhan ALLAH, mereka berkata tentang aku: Apakah ia tidak hanya mengucapkan kata-kata sindiran?"
scripture_data.text_en: Then said I, Ah Lord GOD! they say of me, Doth he not speak parables?
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: Datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, tujukanlah mukamu ke Yerusalem dan ucapkanlah banyak tegoran terhadap tempat kudusnya dan bernubuatlah melawan tanah Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, set thy face toward Jerusalem, and drop [thy word] toward the holy places, and prophesy against the land of Israel,
scripture_data.text_orig: בגן הדה ריל בהו רל הו הנמי ר ינ י ד

scripture_data.text_id: Katakanlah kepada tanah Israel: Beginilah firman TUHAN: Lihat, Aku akan menjadi lawanmu dan akan mencabut pedang-Ku dari sarungnya dan melenyapkan dari tengah-tengahmu orang benar dan orang fasik.
scripture_data.text_en: And say to the land of Israel, Thus saith the LORD; Behold, I [am] against thee, and will draw forth my sword out of his sheath, and will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked.
scripture_data.text_orig: הנפצ בגמ ינל בברצנו תבהל תבהל הכתל בי שלכו חלשלכ ב הלכו תים יננה הוהי ינד רמה הוהירב מ בגה ריל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh karena Aku hendak melenyapkan dari tengah-tengahmu orang benar dan orang fasik, maka pedang-Ku akan terhunus dari sarungnya terhadap semua manusia dari selatan sampai utara.
scripture_data.text_en: Seeing then that I will cut off from thee the righteous and the wicked, therefore shall my sword go forth out of his sheath against all flesh from the south to the north:
scripture_data.text_orig: הכ ל היר הוהי ינ י רל רו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan semua manusia akan mengetahui bahwa Aku, TUHAN, mencabut pedang-Ku dari sarungnya, sehingga tidak akan kembali lagi ke situ.
scripture_data.text_en: That all flesh may know that I the LORD have drawn forth my sword out of his sheath: it shall not return any more.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף ה ילם למם לה יל ירמ הה הוהי ינד ה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan engkau anak manusia, mengeranglah! Mengeranglah di hadapan mereka seperti seorang yang tulang pinggangnya patah dan yang berada dalam kesengsaraan yang pahit.
scripture_data.text_en: Sigh therefore, thou son of man, with the breaking of [thy] loins; and with bitterness sigh before their eyes.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kalau mereka bertanya kepadamu: Mengapa engkau mengeluh? jawablah: Karena suatu berita! Kalau berita itu sudah tersiar, setiap hati akan menjadi tawar dan semua tangan menjadi lemah lesu, segala semangat menghilang dan semua orang terkencing ketakutan. Sungguh, pasti datang dan terjadi! demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH."
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be, when they say unto thee, Wherefore sighest thou? that thou shalt answer, For the tidings; because it cometh: and every heart shall melt, and all hands shall be feeble, and every spirit shall faint, and all knees shall be weak [as] water: behold, it cometh, and shall be brought to pass, saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי תמדל בהו יקמל הו לריל ינ י ד

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: Again the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רו קיץ מ ירכהו רמ ירח יתצהו יל יננה הוהי רמ ה לרי תמדל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai anak manusia, bernubuatlah dan katakan: Beginilah firman TUHAN: Pedang! Pedang! Yang sudah diasah dan juga digosok!
scripture_data.text_en: Son of man, prophesy, and say, Thus saith the LORD; Say, A sword, a sword is sharpened, and also furbished:
scripture_data.text_orig: פצ בגמ רלל רמ ירח צ כל רו קיץ מ ירכהר י

scripture_data.text_id: Diasah untuk menumpahkan darah dan digosok supaya mengkilap seperti petir. Apakah kita akan bersukacita? Tongkat anakku menghina segala macam kayu.
scripture_data.text_en: It is sharpened to make a sore slaughter; it is furbished that it may glitter: should we then make mirth? it contemneth the rod of my son, [as] every tree.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ד בת ל רמ ירח יתצה הוהי ינ י רל דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Pedang itu diberikan supaya digosok, supaya sedia dipergunakan; pedang itu diasah dan digosok, supaya diberikan ke tangan si pembunuh.
scripture_data.text_en: And he hath given it to be furbished, that it may be handled: this sword is sharpened, and it is furbished, to give it into the hand of the slayer.
scripture_data.text_orig: היניל חנ תרירמב ינתמ רב חנה דב הו

scripture_data.text_id: Berserulah dan merataplah, hai anak manusia! Sebab pedang itu ditujukan melawan umat-Ku, ditujukan melawan semua pemimpin Israel; mereka dan umat-Ku sama-sama dibiarkan dimakan pedang. Oleh sebab itu tepuklah pinggangmu sebagai tanda perkabungan.
scripture_data.text_en: Cry and howl, son of man: for it shall be upon my people, it [shall be] upon all the princes of Israel: terrors by reason of the sword shall be upon my people: smite therefore upon [thy] thigh.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ינד ן התיהנו הב הה י הנכל ירלכו חרלכ התהכו ידילכ פרו בלל סמנו הביכ המל רמו חנן ה המל יל רמיי היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab percobaan datang dan tidak suatupun yang dapat tahan, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH.
scripture_data.text_en: Because [it is] a trial, and what if [the sword] contemn even the rod? it shall be no [more], saith the Lord GOD.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan engkau anak manusia, bernubuatlah dan tepuklah tanganmu, biarlah pedang itu menjadi dua kali lipat, tiga kali lipat. Itu pedang pembunuh, pedang untuk pembunuhan besar-besaran, yang berkeliling menghabiskan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Thou therefore, son of man, prophesy, and smite [thine] hands together, and let the sword be doubled the third time, the sword of the slain: it [is] the sword of the great [men that are] slain, which entereth into their privy chambers.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרמגו החה ברח ברח רמ ינד רמ ה רמו בה ד

scripture_data.text_id: Supaya hati mereka hancur dan yang jatuh berebahan bertambah-tambah di tiap pintu gerbang mereka, Aku memerintahkan penumpahan darah dengan pedang itu. Aduh, pedang itu dibuat menyamai petir dan digosok untuk menumpahkan darah.
scripture_data.text_en: I have set the point of the sword against all their gates, that [their] heart may faint, and [their] ruins be multiplied: ah! [it is] made bright, [it is] wrapped up for the slaughter.
scripture_data.text_orig: של תסמ ינ ב ינ הרמ קר להיהמל החה חב חב מל

scripture_data.text_id: Pancung yang di kanan dan di kiri, ke mana saja matamu menetak.
scripture_data.text_en: Go thee one way or other, [either] on the right hand, [or] on the left, whithersoever thy face [is] set.
scripture_data.text_orig: גרהדי ת תתל הרמ יהו ברח החהיה תל הרמל ת ו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan Aku juga akan bertepuk tangan dan hati-Ku yang panas menjadi tenang kembali. Aku, TUHAN, yang mengatakannya."
scripture_data.text_en: I will also smite mine hands together, and I will cause my fury to rest: I the LORD have said [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ריל קפס כל ית יה ברחל ירגם לרי יינלכ יה יב התיה יהי ד לליהו קז

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: The word of the LORD came unto me again, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהי ינד ן היהי ל תסמ ב המ חב י

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai engkau anak manusia, gambarlah dua jalan yang akan dilalui oleh pedang raja Babel; keduanya mulai dari satu negeri. Buatlah sebuah papan penunjuk jalan pada awal jalan yang menuju ke masing-masing kota.
scripture_data.text_en: Also, thou son of man, appoint thee two ways, that the sword of the king of Babylon may come: both twain shall come forth out of one land: and choose thou a place, choose [it] at the head of the way to the city.
scripture_data.text_orig: הל תרדחה לדה ללח ברח יה יללח ברח התיל ברח לפתו ל הו בה דב הו

scripture_data.text_id: Gambarlah dari jalan mana pedang itu datang melawan Raba, ibukota bani Amon dan melawan Yehuda, yang bentengnya ada di Yerusalem.
scripture_data.text_en: Appoint a way, that the sword may come to Rabbath of the Ammonites, and to Judah in Jerusalem the defenced.
scripture_data.text_orig: חבל הם קרבל הי ח ברחתחב יתנ הירל ל ילכה הרהו בל גמל מל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab raja Babel berdiri pada persimpangan jalan itu, pada awal kedua jalan itu untuk melakukan tenungan; ia mengocok panah, meminta petunjuk dari terafim dan menilik hati binatang.
scripture_data.text_en: For the king of Babylon stood at the parting of the way, at the head of the two ways, to use divination: he made [his] arrows bright, he consulted with images, he looked in the liver.
scripture_data.text_orig: תדמ ינ הנ ילימה ימיה ינמיה ידחתה

scripture_data.text_id: Ke dalam tangan kanannya terjatuh panah tenungan mengenai Yerusalem: supaya diperdengarkannya suara orang yang membunuh dan menyerukan pekik pertempuran, supaya menyusun alat-alat pendobrak pintu gerbang dan menimbun tanah menjadi tembok pengepungan dan mendirikan benteng pengepungan.
scripture_data.text_en: At his right hand was the divination for Jerusalem, to appoint captains, to open the mouth in the slaughter, to lift up the voice with shouting, to appoint [battering] rams against the gates, to cast a mount, [and] to build a fort.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף יר הוהי ינ יתמח יתחנהו יל יך ה ינגו

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi bagi mereka, itu adalah tenungan yang menipu, walaupun mereka mengangkat sumpah yang muluk-muluk; tetapi ia mengingat kesalahan mereka, sehingga mereka ditangkap.
scripture_data.text_en: And it shall be unto them as a false divination in their sight, to them that have sworn oaths: but he will call to remembrance the iniquity, that they may be taken.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Oleh karena kamu membuat kesalahanmu itu teringat kembali dengan tersingkapnya pelanggaranmu, sehingga kentara dosa-dosamu dalam segala perbuatanmu, oleh karena kamu menjadi teringat kembali, kamu akan ditangkap dengan kekerasan.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thus saith the Lord GOD; Because ye have made your iniquity to be remembered, in that your transgressions are discovered, so that in all your doings your sins do appear; because, [I say], that ye are come to remembrance, ye shall be taken with the hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר ריר ר ר דיו הינ צי דח שרמ לבלם ברח בל יכר ינ לי דב הו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan hai engkau, raja Israel, orang fasik yang durhaka, yang saatmu sudah tiba untuk penghakiman terakhir,
scripture_data.text_en: And thou, profane wicked prince of Israel, whose day is come, when iniquity [shall have] an end,
scripture_data.text_orig: הרצ לריב הדהיתו ינ תר ת ברח בל י ר

scripture_data.text_id: beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Jauhkanlah serbanmu dan buangkanlah mahkotamu! Tiada yang tetap seperti keadaannya sekarang. Yang rendah harus ditinggikan, yang tinggi harus direndahkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; Remove the diadem, and take off the crown: this [shall] not [be] the same: exalt [him that is] low, and abase [him that is] high.
scripture_data.text_orig: דב הר יפר ל יח לקלק סקסקל יכרה ינ ר רה ל לבלם דמי

scripture_data.text_id: Puing, puing, puing akan Kujadikan dia! Inipun tidak akan tetap. Sampai ia datang yang berhak atasnya, dan kepadanya akan Kuberikan itu."
scripture_data.text_en: I will overturn, overturn, overturn, it: and it shall be no [more], until he come whose right it is; and I will give it [him].
