scripture_data.text_orig: כתמדל כת יתבהו תצרהלמ כת יצקו יהמ כת יחקלו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mencurahkan kepadamu air jernih, yang akan mentahirkan kamu; dari segala kenajisanmu dan dari semua berhala-berhalamu Aku akan mentahirkan kamu.
scripture_data.text_en: Then will I sprinkle clean water upon you, and ye shall be clean: from all your filthiness, and from all your idols, will I cleanse you.
scripture_data.text_orig: כת רה כיללמ כיתמ למ רה ירה ימ כיל יקרזו

scripture_data.text_id: Kamu akan Kuberikan hati yang baru, dan roh yang baru di dalam batinmu dan Aku akan menjauhkan dari tubuhmu hati yang keras dan Kuberikan kepadamu hati yang taat.
scripture_data.text_en: A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you: and I will take away the stony heart out of your flesh, and I will give you an heart of flesh.
scripture_data.text_orig: ר בל כל יתנו כרמ בה בלת יתרסהו כרק הדח חרו דח בל כל יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: Roh-Ku akan Kuberikan diam di dalam batinmu dan Aku akan membuat kamu hidup menurut segala ketetapan-Ku dan tetap berpegang pada peraturan-peraturan-Ku dan melakukannya.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will put my spirit within you, and cause you to walk in my statutes, and ye shall keep my judgments, and do [them].
scripture_data.text_orig: תיו רמ ימ כל יחר ת יתיו כרק יחרתו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kamu akan diam di dalam negeri yang telah Kuberikan kepada nenek moyangmu dan kamu akan menjadi umat-Ku dan Aku akan menjadi Allahmu.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall dwell in the land that I gave to your fathers; and ye shall be my people, and I will be your God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל כל היה יכנו ל יל תייהו כיתבל יתנ ר שר ביו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan melepaskan kamu dari segala dosa kenajisanmu dan Aku akan menumbuhkan gandum serta memperbanyaknya, dan Aku tidak lagi mendatangkan kelaparan atasmu.
scripture_data.text_en: I will also save you from all your uncleannesses: and I will call for the corn, and will increase it, and lay no famine upon you.
scripture_data.text_orig: בר כיל לו ת יתירהו גהל יתרקו כיתמ למ כת יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku juga memperbanyak buah pohon-pohonanmu dan hasil ladangmu, supaya kamu jangan lagi menanggung noda kelaparan di tengah bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will multiply the fruit of the tree, and the increase of the field, that ye shall receive no more reproach of famine among the heathen.
scripture_data.text_orig: י בר תרח ד חקת ל ר מל הדה תבנת שה ירת יתירהו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kamu akan teringat-ingat kepada kelakuanmu yang jahat dan perbuatan-perbuatanmu yang tidak baik dan kamu akan merasa mual melihat dirimu sendiri karena kesalahan-kesalahanmu dan perbuatan-perbuata yang keji.
scripture_data.text_en: Then shall ye remember your own evil ways, and your doings that [were] not good, and shall lothe yourselves in your own sight for your iniquities and for your abominations.
scripture_data.text_orig: כיתב לו כיתנו ל כינפ תקנ יבל ר כיללמ ירה כיכרת רכז

scripture_data.text_id: Bukan karena kamu Aku bertindak, demikianlah firman Tuhan ALLAH, ketahuilah itu. Merasa malulah kamu dan biarlah kamu dipermalukan karena kelakuanmu, hai kaum Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: Not for your sakes do I [this], saith the Lord GOD, be it known unto you: be ashamed and confounded for your own ways, O house of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לרי תי כיכרמ מלהו כל די הוהי ינד ן הינ כנמל ל

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Pada hari Aku mentahirkan kamu dari segala kesalahanmu, Aku akan membuat kota-kota didiami lagi dan reruntuhan-reruntuhan akan dibangun kembali.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; In the day that I shall have cleansed you from all your iniquities I will also cause [you] to dwell in the cities, and the wastes shall be builded.
scripture_data.text_orig: תברחה נבנו ירהת יבהו כיתנו למ כת ירה י הוהי ינד רמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Tanah yang sudah lama tinggal tandus akan dikerjakan kembali, supaya jangan lagi tetap tandus di hadapan semua orang yang lintas dari padamu.
scripture_data.text_en: And the desolate land shall be tilled, whereas it lay desolate in the sight of all that passed by.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבל יניל הממ התיה ר תח דב הה שרהו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebaliknya mereka akan berkata: Tanah ini yang sudah lama tinggal tandus menjadi seperti taman Eden dan kota-kota yang sudah runtuh, sunyi sepi dan musnah, sekarang didiami dan menjadi kubu.
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall say, This land that was desolate is become like the garden of Eden; and the waste and desolate and ruined cities [are become] fenced, [and] are inhabited.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי תרצ תסרההו תנהו תברחה ירהו דג התיה הה זה שרה רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Dan bangsa-bangsa yang tertinggal, yang ada di sekitarmu akan mengetahui, bahwa Akulah TUHAN, yang membangun kembali yang sudah musnah dan menanami kembali yang sudah tandus. Aku, TUHAN, yang mengatakannya dan akan membuatnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Then the heathen that are left round about you shall know that I the LORD build the ruined [places, and] plant that that was desolate: I the LORD have spoken [it], and I will do [it].
scripture_data.text_orig: ס יתיו יר הוהי ינ הה ינ תסרהה יתינ הוהי ינ י כיתביבס רי ר יה דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Dalam hal ini juga Aku menginginkan, supaya kaum Israel meminta dari pada-Ku apa yang hendak Kulakukan bagi mereka, yaitu membuat mereka banyak seperti lautan manusia.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD; I will yet [for] this be enquired of by the house of Israel, to do [it] for them; I will increase them with men like a flock.
scripture_data.text_orig: ד ת הר הל תל לריתיבל ר תז ד הוהי ינד רמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti domba-domba persembahan kudus, dan seumpama domba-domba Yerusalem pada waktu-waktu perayaannya, begitulah kota-kota yang sudah runtuh penuh dengan lautan manusia. Dengan begitu mereka akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: As the holy flock, as the flock of Jerusalem in her solemn feasts; so shall the waste cities be filled with flocks of men: and they shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהי יני דיו ד צ תלם תברחה ירה הנייה הידמ לרי צ ידק צ

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu kekuasaan TUHAN meliputi aku dan Ia membawa aku ke luar dengan perantaraan Roh-Nya dan menempatkan aku di tengah-tengah lembah, dan lembah ini penuh dengan tulang-tulang.
scripture_data.text_en: The hand of the LORD was upon me, and carried me out in the spirit of the LORD, and set me down in the midst of the valley which [was] full of bones,
scripture_data.text_orig: תמצ הלם יהו הקה ת ינחיניו הוהי חרב ינצו הוהידי יל התיה

scripture_data.text_id: Ia membawa aku melihat tulang-tulang itu berkeliling-keliling dan sungguh, amat banyak bertaburan di lembah itu; lihat, tulang-tulang itu amat kering.
scripture_data.text_en: And caused me to pass by them round about: and, behold, [there were] very many in the open valley; and, lo, [they were] very dry.
scripture_data.text_orig: דם תבי ההו הקה ינל דם תר ההו ביבס ביבס היל ינריבהו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu Ia berfirman kepadaku: "Hai anak manusia, dapatkah tulang-tulang ini dihidupkan kembali?" Aku menjawab: "Ya Tuhan ALLAH, Engkaulah yang mengetahui!"
scripture_data.text_en: And he said unto me, Son of man, can these bones live? And I answered, O Lord GOD, thou knowest.
scripture_data.text_orig: די ה הוהי ינד רמו הה תמצה הנייחתה ד יל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu firman-Nya kepadaku: "Bernubuatlah mengenai tulang-tulang ini dan katakanlah kepadanya: Hai tulang-tulang yang kering, dengarlah firman TUHAN!
scripture_data.text_en: Again he said unto me, Prophesy upon these bones, and say unto them, O ye dry bones, hear the word of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהירב מ תביה תמצה היל רמו הה תמצהל בה יל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH kepada tulang-tulang ini: Aku memberi nafas hidup di dalammu, supaya kamu hidup kembali.
scripture_data.text_en: Thus saith the Lord GOD unto these bones; Behold, I will cause breath to enter into you, and ye shall live:
scripture_data.text_orig: תייחו חר כב יבמ ינ הה הה תמצל הוהי ינד רמ ה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan memberi urat-urat padamu dan menumbuhkan daging padamu, Aku akan menutupi kamu dengan kulit dan memberikan kamu nafas hidup, supaya kamu hidup kembali. Dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: And I will lay sinews upon you, and will bring up flesh upon you, and cover you with skin, and put breath in you, and ye shall live; and ye shall know that I [am] the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי יני דיו תייחו חר כב יתנו ר כיל ימרקו ר כיל יתלהו יד כיל יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu aku bernubuat seperti diperintahkan kepadaku; dan segera sesudah aku bernubuat, kedengaranlah suara, sungguh, suatu suara berderak-derak, dan tulang-tulang itu bertemu satu sama lain.
scripture_data.text_en: So I prophesied as I was commanded: and as I prophesied, there was a noise, and behold a shaking, and the bones came together, bone to his bone.
scripture_data.text_orig: מצל צ תמצ ברקו רההו יבה לקיהיו יתיצ ר יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: Sedang aku mengamat-amatinya, lihat, urat-urat ada dan daging tumbuh padanya, kemudian kulit menutupinya, tetapi mereka belum bernafas.
scripture_data.text_en: And when I beheld, lo, the sinews and the flesh came up upon them, and the skin covered them above: but [there was] no breath in them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ה י חרו הלמלמ ר היל רקו הל רב יד הילההו יתירו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka firman-Nya kepadaku: "Bernubuatlah kepada nafas hidup itu, bernubuatlah, hai anak manusia, dan katakanlah kepada nafas hidup itu: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Hai nafas hidup, datanglah dari keempat penjuru angin, dan berembuslah ke dalam orang-orang yang terbunuh ini, supaya mereka hidup kembali."
scripture_data.text_en: Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.
scripture_data.text_orig: יחיו הה יגרה יחפ חרה י תחר רמ הוהי ינד רמה חרהל רמו דב בה חרהל בה יל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Lalu aku bernubuat seperti diperintahkan-Nya kepadaku. Dan nafas hidup itu masuk di dalam mereka, sehingga mereka hidup kembali. Mereka menjejakkan kakinya, suatu tentara yang sangat besar.
scripture_data.text_en: So I prophesied as he commanded me, and the breath came into them, and they lived, and stood up upon their feet, an exceeding great army.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס דמדם לד ליח הילגרל דמו יחו חרה הב בו ינצ ר יתהו

scripture_data.text_id: Firman-Nya kepadaku: "Hai anak manusia, tulang-tulang ini adalah seluruh kaum Israel. Sungguh, mereka sendiri mengatakan: Tulang-tulang kami sudah menjadi kering, dan pengharapan kami sudah lenyap, kami sudah hilang.
scripture_data.text_en: Then he said unto me, Son of man, these bones are the whole house of Israel: behold, they say, Our bones are dried, and our hope is lost: we are cut off for our parts.
scripture_data.text_orig: נל נרזגנ נתוקת הדבו ניתמץ בי ירמ הה הה לרי תיל הה תמצה ד יל רמו

scripture_data.text_id: Oleh sebab itu, bernubuatlah dan katakan kepada mereka: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Sungguh, Aku membuka kubur-kuburmu dan membangkitkan kamu, hai umat-Ku, dari dalamnya, dan Aku akan membawa kamu ke tanah Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore prophesy and say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, O my people, I will open your graves, and cause you to come up out of your graves, and bring you into the land of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לרי תמדל כת יתבהו י כיתרבמ כת יתילהו כיתרבקת חתפ ינ הה הוהי ינד רמה היל רמו בה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Akulah TUHAN, pada saat Aku membuka kubur-kuburmu dan membangkitkan kamu, hai umat-Ku, dari dalamnya.
scripture_data.text_en: And ye shall know that I [am] the LORD, when I have opened your graves, O my people, and brought you up out of your graves,
scripture_data.text_orig: י כיתרבמ כת יתלהב כיתרבקת יחתפ הוהי יני דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan memberikan Roh-Ku ke dalammu, sehingga kamu hidup kembali dan Aku akan membiarkan kamu tinggal di tanahmu. Dan kamu akan mengetahui bahwa Aku, TUHAN, yang mengatakannya dan membuatnya, demikianlah firman TUHAN."
scripture_data.text_en: And shall put my spirit in you, and ye shall live, and I shall place you in your own land: then shall ye know that I the LORD have spoken [it], and performed [it], saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף הוהין יתיו יר הוהי יני דיו כתמדל כת יחהו תייחו כב יחר יתנו

scripture_data.text_id: Kemudian datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: The word of the LORD came again unto me, saying,
scripture_data.text_orig: רמל יל הוהירבד יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: "Hai engkau anak manusia, ambillah sepotong papan dan tulis di atasnya: Untuk Yehuda dan orang-orang Israel yang bersekutu dengan dia. Kemudian ambillah papan yang lain dan tulis di atasnya: Untuk Yusuf papan Efraim dan seluruh kaum Israel yang bersekutu dengan dia.
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover, thou son of man, take thee one stick, and write upon it, For Judah, and for the children of Israel his companions: then take another stick, and write upon it, For Joseph, the stick of Ephraim, and [for] all the house of Israel his companions:
scripture_data.text_orig: וירבח רבח לרי תילכו ירפ ש סיל ויל בתכ דח ש חקל וירבח רבח לרי ינבלו הדהיל ויל בתכ דח ש לחק דב הו

scripture_data.text_id: Gabungkanlah keduanya menjadi satu papan, sehingga keduanya menjadi satu dalam tanganmu.
scripture_data.text_en: And join them one to another into one stick; and they shall become one in thine hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: די ידחל יהו דח של ל דחל דח ת ברקו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka kalau teman-teman sebangsamu bertanya kepadamu: Tidakkah engkau bersedia memberitahukan kepada kami, apa artinya ini
scripture_data.text_en: And when the children of thy people shall speak unto thee, saying, Wilt thou not shew us what thou [meanest] by these?
scripture_data.text_orig: ההמ נל דיתלה רמל ינ יל רמי רכו

scripture_data.text_id: katakanlah kepada mereka: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Aku mengambil papan Yusuf yang dalam tangan Efraim beserta suku-suku Israel yang bersekutu dengan dia dan menggabungkannya dengan papan Yehuda dan Aku akan menjadikan mereka satu papan, sehingga mereka menjadi satu dalam tangan-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: Say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the stick of Joseph, which [is] in the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel his fellows, and will put them with him, [even] with the stick of Judah, and make them one stick, and they shall be one in mine hand.
scripture_data.text_orig: ידי דח יהו דח של תיו הדהי שת ויל ת יתנו וירבח רבח לרי יבו ירפדי ר סי שת חקל ינ הה הוהי ינד רמה הל ר

scripture_data.text_id: Dan sedang engkau memegang papan-papan yang kautulisi itu dalam tanganmu di hadapan mereka,
scripture_data.text_en: And the sticks whereon thou writest shall be in thine hand before their eyes.
scripture_data.text_orig: היניל די היל בכר יצה יהו

scripture_data.text_id: katakanlah kepadanya: Beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH: Sungguh, Aku menjemput orang Israel dari tengah bangsa-bangsa, ke mana mereka pergi; Aku akan mengumpulkan mereka dari segala penjuru dan akan membawa mereka ke tanah mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And say unto them, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Behold, I will take the children of Israel from among the heathen, whither they be gone, and will gather them on every side, and bring them into their own land:
scripture_data.text_orig: תמדל ת יתבהו ביבמ ת יצקו כלה ר יה ימ לרי ינת חקל ינ הה הוהי ינד רמה היל רדו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan menjadikan mereka satu bangsa di tanah mereka, di atas gunung-gunung Israel, dan satu raja memerintah mereka seluruhnya; mereka tidak lagi menjadi dua bangsa dan tidak lagi terbagi menjadi dua kerajaan.
scripture_data.text_en: And I will make them one nation in the land upon the mountains of Israel; and one king shall be king to them all: and they shall be no more two nations, neither shall they be divided into two kingdoms any more at all:
scripture_data.text_orig: ד תכלמם יל ד צחי לו יג ינל דיהיהיהי לו למל כל היהי דח למ לרי ירה שר דח יגל ת יתיו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka tidak lagi menajiskan dirinya dengan berhala-berhalanya atau dewa-dewa mereka yang menjijikkan atau dengan semua pelanggaran mereka. Tetapi Aku akan melepaskan mereka dari segala penyelewengan mereka, dengan mana mereka berbuat dosa, dan mentahirkan mereka, sehingga mereka akan menjadi umat-Ku dan Aku akan menjadi Allahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: Neither shall they defile themselves any more with their idols, nor with their detestable things, nor with any of their transgressions: but I will save them out of all their dwellingplaces, wherein they have sinned, and will cleanse them: so shall they be my people, and I will be their God.
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלל הל היה ינו ל יליהו ת ירהו הב ח ר היתבם למ ת יהו הי לכב היצב הילג ד י לו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka hamba-Ku Daud akan menjadi rajanya, dan mereka semuanya akan mempunyai satu gembala. Mereka akan hidup menurut peraturan-peraturan-Ku dan melakukan ketetapan-ketetapan-Ku dengan setia.
scripture_data.text_en: And David my servant [shall be] king over them; and they all shall have one shepherd: they shall also walk in my judgments, and observe my statutes, and do them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ת ו רמי יתחו כלי ימב כל היהי דח הרו היל למ דוד יבו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan tinggal di tanah yang Kuberikan kepada hamba-Ku Yakub, di mana nenek moyang mereka tinggal, ya, mereka, anak-anak mereka maupun cucu cicit mereka akan tinggal di sana untuk selama-lamanya dan hamba-Ku Daud menjadi raja mereka untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: And they shall dwell in the land that I have given unto Jacob my servant, wherein your fathers have dwelt; and they shall dwell therein, [even] they, and their children, and their children's children for ever: and my servant David [shall be] their prince for ever.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל הל ינ יב דודו לד הינב ינב הינב הה היל ביו כיתב בבי ר בקיל יבל יתנ ר שרהל ביו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan mengadakan perjanjian damai dengan mereka, dan itu akan menjadi perjanjian yang kekal dengan mereka. Aku akan memberkati mereka dan membuat mereka banyak dan memberikan tempat kudus-Ku di tengah-tengah mereka untuk selama-lamanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Moreover I will make a covenant of peace with them; it shall be an everlasting covenant with them: and I will place them, and multiply them, and will set my sanctuary in the midst of them for evermore.
scripture_data.text_orig: לל כת יקמת יתנו ת יתירהו יתנ ת היהי ל תיר ל תיר הל ירכו

scripture_data.text_id: Tempat kediaman-Kupun akan ada pada mereka dan Aku akan menjadi Allah mereka dan mereka akan menjadi umat-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: My tabernacle also shall be with them: yea, I will be their God, and they shall be my people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ל יליהי ההו יהלל הל יתייהו היל ינמ היהו

scripture_data.text_id: Maka bangsa-bangsa akan mengetahui bahwa Aku, TUHAN, menguduskan Israel, pada waktu tempat kudus-Ku berada di tengah-tengah mereka untuk selama-lamanya."
scripture_data.text_en: And the heathen shall know that I the LORD do sanctify Israel, when my sanctuary shall be in the midst of them for evermore.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס לל כת יקמ תיה לרית קם הוהי ינ י יה דיו

scripture_data.text_id: Datanglah firman TUHAN kepadaku:
scripture_data.text_en: And the word of the LORD came unto me, saying,

scripture_data.text_en: And I will sow her unto me in the earth; and I will have mercy upon her that had not obtained mercy; and I will say to [them which were] not my people, Thou [art] my people; and they shall say, [Thou art] my God.

scripture_data.text_en: Then said the LORD unto me, Go yet, love a woman beloved of [her] friend, yet an adulteress, according to the love of the LORD toward the children of Israel, who look to other gods, and love flagons of wine.

scripture_data.text_id: Aku berkata kepadanya: "Lama engkau harus diam padaku dengan tidak bersundal dan dengan tidak menjadi kepunyaan seorang laki-laki; juga aku ini tidak akan bersetubuh dengan engkau."
scripture_data.text_en: And I said unto her, Thou shalt abide for me many days; thou shalt not play the harlot, and thou shalt not be for [another] man: so [will] I also [be] for thee.

scripture_data.text_en: Afterward shall the children of Israel return, and seek the LORD their God, and David their king; and shall fear the LORD and his goodness in the latter days.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu negeri ini akan berkabung, dan seluruh penduduknya akan merana; juga binatang-binatang di padang dan burung-burung di udara, bahkan ikan-ikan di laut akan mati lenyap.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore shall the land mourn, and every one that dwelleth therein shall languish, with the beasts of the field, and with the fowls of heaven; yea, the fishes of the sea also shall be taken away.

scripture_data.text_id: Hanya janganlah ada orang mengadu, dan janganlah ada orang menegor, sebab terhadap engkaulah pengaduan-Ku itu, hai imam!
scripture_data.text_en: Yet let no man strive, nor reprove another: for thy people [are] as they that strive with the priest.

scripture_data.text_id: Engkau akan tergelincir jatuh pada siang hari, juga nabi akan tergelincir jatuh bersama-sama engkau pada malam hari; dan Aku akan membinasakan ibumu.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore shalt thou fall in the day, and the prophet also shall fall with thee in the night, and I will destroy thy mother.

scripture_data.text_id: Umat-Ku binasa karena tidak mengenal Allah; karena engkaulah yang menolak pengenalan itu maka Aku menolak engkau menjadi imam-Ku; dan karena engkau melupakan pengajaran Allahmu, maka Aku juga akan melupakan anak-anakmu.
scripture_data.text_en: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge: because thou hast rejected knowledge, I will also reject thee, that thou shalt be no priest to me: seeing thou hast forgotten the law of thy God, I will also forget thy children.

scripture_data.text_id: Makin bertambah banyak mereka, makin berdosa mereka kepada-Ku, kemuliaan mereka akan Kutukar dengan kehinaan.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka mendapat rezeki dari dosa umat-Ku dan mengharapkan umat-Ku itu berbuat salah.

scripture_data.text_en: For they shall eat, and not have enough: they shall commit whoredom, and shall not increase: because they have left off to take heed to the LORD.

scripture_data.text_id: Umat-Ku bertanya kepada pohonnya, dan tongkatnya akan memberitahu kepadanya, sebab roh perzinahan menyesatkan mereka, dan mereka berzinah meninggalkan Allah mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: My people ask counsel at their stocks, and their staff declareth unto them: for the spirit of whoredoms hath caused [them] to err, and they have gone a whoring from under their God.

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka mempersembahkan korban di puncak gunung-gunung dan membakar korban di atas bukit-bukit, di bawah pohon besar dan pohon hawar dan pohon rimbun, sebab naungannya baik. Itulah sebabnya anak-anakmu perempuan berzinah dan menantu-menantumu perempuan bersundal.
scripture_data.text_en: They sacrifice upon the tops of the mountains, and burn incense upon the hills, under oaks and poplars and elms, because the shadow thereof [is] good: therefore your daughters shall commit whoredom, and your spouses shall commit adultery.

scripture_data.text_id: Aku tidak akan menghukum anak-anak perempuanmu sekalipun mereka berzinah, atau menantu-menantumu perempuan, sekalipun mereka bersundal; sebab mereka sendiri mengasingkan diri bersama-sama dengan perempuan-perempuan sundal dan mempersembahkan korban bersama-sama dengan sundal-sundal bakti, dan umat yang tidak berpengertian akan runtuh.
scripture_data.text_en: I will not punish your daughters when they commit whoredom, nor your spouses when they commit adultery: for themselves are separated with whores, and they sacrifice with harlots: therefore the people [that] doth not understand shall fall.

scripture_data.text_en: Their drink is sour: they have committed whoredom continually: her rulers [with] shame do love, Give ye.

scripture_data.text_id: Perbuatan-perbuatan mereka tidak mengizinkan mereka berbalik kepada Allah mereka, sebab roh perzinahan ada di antara mereka, dan mereka tidak mengenal TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: They will not frame their doings to turn unto their God: for the spirit of whoredoms [is] in the midst of them, and they have not known the LORD.

scripture_data.text_en: And the pride of Israel doth testify to his face: therefore shall Israel and Ephraim fall in their iniquity; Judah also shall fall with them.

scripture_data.text_en: They have dealt treacherously against the LORD: for they have begotten strange children: now shall a month devour them with their portions.

scripture_data.text_id: Tiuplah sangkakala di Gibea, dan nafiri di Rama. Berteriaklah di Bet-Awen, gemetarlah, hai Benyamin!

scripture_data.text_id: Para pemuka Yehuda adalah seperti orang-orang yang menggeser batas; ke atas mereka akan Kucurahkan gemas-Ku seperti air.
scripture_data.text_en: The princes of Judah were like them that remove the bound: [therefore] I will pour out my wrath upon them like water.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu Aku ini akan seperti ngengat bagi Efraim dan seperti belatung bagi kaum Yehuda.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore [will] I [be] unto Ephraim as a moth, and to the house of Judah as rottenness.

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Efraim melihat penyakitnya, dan Yehuda melihat bisulnya, maka pergilah Efraim ke Asyur dan mengutus orang kepada Raja 'Agung'. Tetapi iapun tidak dapat menyembuhkan kamu dan tidak dapat melenyapkan bisul itu dari padamu.
scripture_data.text_en: When Ephraim saw his sickness, and Judah [saw] his wound, then went Ephraim to the Assyrian, and sent to king Jareb: yet could he not heal you, nor cure you of your wound.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Aku ini seperti singa bagi Efraim, dan seperti singa muda bagi kaum Yehuda. Aku, Aku ini akan menerkam, lalu pergi, Aku akan membawa lari dan tidak ada yang melepaskan.
scripture_data.text_en: For I [will be] unto Ephraim as a lion, and as a young lion to the house of Judah: I, [even] I, will tear and go away; I will take away, and none shall rescue [him].

scripture_data.text_id: Aku akan pergi pulang ke tempat-Ku, sampai mereka mengaku bersalah dan mencari wajah-Ku. Dalam kesesakannya mereka akan merindukan Aku:
scripture_data.text_en: I will go [and] return to my place, till they acknowledge their offence, and seek my face: in their affliction they will seek me early.

scripture_data.text_id: "Mari, kita akan berbalik kepada TUHAN, sebab Dialah yang telah menerkam dan yang akan menyembuhkan kita, yang telah memukul dan yang akan membalut kita.
scripture_data.text_en: Come, and let us return unto the LORD: for he hath torn, and he will heal us; he hath smitten, and he will bind us up.

scripture_data.text_id: Ia akan menghidupkan kita sesudah dua hari, pada hari yang ketiga Ia akan membangkitkan kita, dan kita akan hidup di hadapan-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: After two days will he revive us: in the third day he will raise us up, and we shall live in his sight.

scripture_data.text_id: Marilah kita mengenal dan berusaha sungguh-sungguh mengenal TUHAN; Ia pasti muncul seperti fajar, Ia akan datang kepada kita seperti hujan, seperti hujan pada akhir musim yang mengairi bumi."
scripture_data.text_en: Then shall we know, [if] we follow on to know the LORD: his going forth is prepared as the morning; and he shall come unto us as the rain, as the latter [and] former rain unto the earth.

scripture_data.text_id: Apakah yang akan Kulakukan kepadamu, hai Efraim? Apakah yang akan Kulakukan kepadamu, hai Yehuda? Kasih setiamu seperti kabut pagi, dan seperti embun yang hilang pagi-pagi benar.
scripture_data.text_en: O Ephraim, what shall I do unto thee? O Judah, what shall I do unto thee? for your goodness [is] as a morning cloud, and as the early dew it goeth away.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu Aku telah meremukkan mereka dengan perantaraan nabi-nabi, Aku telah membunuh mereka dengan perkataan mulut-Ku, dan hukum-Ku keluar seperti terang.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore have I hewed [them] by the prophets; I have slain them by the words of my mouth: and thy judgments [are as] the light [that] goeth forth.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab Aku menyukai kasih setia, dan bukan korban sembelihan, dan menyukai pengenalan akan Allah, lebih dari pada korban-korban bakaran.
scripture_data.text_en: For I desired mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of God more than burnt offerings.

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi mereka itu telah melangkahi perjanjian di Adam, di sana mereka telah berkhianat terhadap Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: But they like men have transgressed the covenant: there have they dealt treacherously against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יב דג תירב רב ד ההו

scripture_data.text_id: Gilead adalah kota para penjahat, penuh dengan jejak darah.
scripture_data.text_en: Gilead [is] a city of them that work iniquity, [and is] polluted with blood.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ הק ו יל תירק דל

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti gerombolan menghadang demikianlah persekutuan para imam; mereka membunuh di jalan ke Sikhem, sungguh, mereka melakukan perbuatan mesum.
scripture_data.text_en: And as troops of robbers wait for a man, [so] the company of priests murder in the way by consent: for they commit lewdness.
scripture_data.text_orig: הז י המכחרי ר ינה רבח ידד י יחכ

scripture_data.text_id: Di antara kaum Israel telah Kulihat hal-hal yang mengerikan; di sana ada Efraim bersundal dan Israel telah menajiskan diri.
scripture_data.text_en: I have seen an horrible thing in the house of Israel: there [is] the whoredom of Ephraim, Israel is defiled.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי מנ ירפל תנז הרר הריר יתיר לרי תיב

scripture_data.text_id: Juga bagimu, hai Yehuda, telah ditentukan penuaian: Apabila Aku memulihkan keadaan umat-Ku,
scripture_data.text_en: Also, O Judah, he hath set an harvest for thee, when I returned the captivity of my people.
scripture_data.text_orig: ף י תב יב ל ריצק ת הדהי

scripture_data.text_id: apabila Aku menyembuhkan Israel, maka tersingkaplah kesalahan Efraim dan kejahatan-kejahatan Samaria: sebab mereka melakukan penipuan: pencuri mendobrak masuk, gerombolan merampas di luar.
scripture_data.text_en: When I would have healed Israel, then the iniquity of Ephraim was discovered, and the wickedness of Samaria: for they commit falsehood; and the thief cometh in, [and] the troop of robbers spoileth without.
scripture_data.text_orig: שח דד בי בגו רק לפ י רמ תרו ירפ ו הלגנו לריל יפר

scripture_data.text_id: Dan tidak terpikir mereka bahwa Aku mengingat segala kejahatan mereka. Sekarangpun perbuatan-perbuatan mereka mengepung mereka, semuanya ada di hadapan wajah-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: And they consider not in their hearts [that] I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
scripture_data.text_orig: יה ינ דגנ היללם בבס ה ירכז תרל בבלל רמילב

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka menyukakan raja dengan kejahatan mereka, dan para pemuka dengan kebohongan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר היחכב למחי תר

scripture_data.text_id: Sekaliannya mereka orang-orang berzinah, bagaikan dapur perapian yang menyala terus, ketika tukang bakar roti berhenti membesarkan apinya, sementara ia meremas adonan sampai menjadi muai oleh ragi.
scripture_data.text_en: They [are] all adulterers, as an oven heated by the baker, [who] ceaseth from raising after he hath kneaded the dough, until it be leavened.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצמחד קצ מ רימ תי הפמ הר רת מ יפנם

scripture_data.text_id: Pada pesta raja kita mereka membuat sakit para pemuka dengan anggur yang menghangatkan; ia bersekutu dengan para pencemooh.
scripture_data.text_en: In the day of our king the princes have made [him] sick with bottles of wine; he stretched out his hand with scorners.
scripture_data.text_orig: יצצלת די מ ימ תמח יר לחה נלם י

scripture_data.text_id: Batin mereka seperti dapur perapian; hati mereka menyala-nyala; semalam-malaman murka mereka surut, pada waktu pagi menyala kembali seperti api yang menjilat.
scripture_data.text_en: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, whiles they lie in wait: their baker sleepeth all the night; in the morning it burneth as a flaming fire.
scripture_data.text_orig: הבהל רב ה רק הפ י הליהל ר ל רך ברקי

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka semua sudah panas seperti dapur perapian, dan memakan habis para hakim mereka. Semua raja mereka sudah tewas, tidak ada seorang di antara mereka yang berseru kepada-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: They are all hot as an oven, and have devoured their judges; all their kings are fallen: [there is] none among them that calleth unto me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל הב רקי לפנ היכלמל היפת לכו ר חי

scripture_data.text_id: Efraim mencampurkan dirinya di antara bangsa-bangsa, Efraim telah menjadi roti bundar yang tidak dibalik.
scripture_data.text_en: Ephraim, he hath mixed himself among the people; Ephraim is a cake not turned.
scripture_data.text_orig: הכפה יל הג היה ירפ ללתי ה י ירפ

scripture_data.text_id: Orang-orang luar memakan habis kekuatannya, tetapi ia sendiri tidak mengetahuinya; juga ia sudah banyak beruban, tetapi ia sendiri tidak mengetahuinya.
scripture_data.text_en: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he knoweth [it] not: yea, gray hairs are here and there upon him, yet he knoweth not.
scripture_data.text_orig: די ל הו הקרז הבי די ל הו ח ירז לכ

scripture_data.text_id: Kecongkakan Israel menjadi saksi terhadap dirinya, namun mereka tidak berbalik kepada TUHAN, Allah mereka, dan tidak mencari Dia kendati semuanya ini.
scripture_data.text_en: And the pride of Israel testifieth to his face: and they do not return to the LORD their God, nor seek him for all this.
scripture_data.text_orig: תזלכ הקב לו היהל הוהיל בלו וינפ לריג הנו

scripture_data.text_id: Efraim telah menjadi merpati tolol, tidak berakal, dengan memanggil kepada Mesir, dengan pergi kepada Asyur.
scripture_data.text_en: Ephraim also is like a silly dove without heart: they call to Egypt, they go to Assyria.
scripture_data.text_orig: כלה ר רק ירצמ בל י התף הני ירפ יהיו

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila mereka pergi, Aku akan membentangkan jaring-Ku ke atas mereka; Aku akan menurunkan mereka seperti burung-burung di udara, Aku akan menghajar mereka karena kejahatan-kejahatan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: When they shall go, I will spread my net upon them; I will bring them down as the fowls of the heaven; I will chastise them, as their congregation hath heard.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תדל מ רסי דיר ימה יר היל רפ כלי ר

scripture_data.text_id: Celakalah mereka, sebab mereka melarikan diri dari pada-Ku! Binasalah mereka, sebab mereka memberontak terhadap Aku! Aku ini mau menebus mereka, tetapi mereka berdusta terhadap Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Woe unto them! for they have fled from me: destruction unto them! because they have transgressed against me: though I have redeemed them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבז יל ר ההו פ יכנו יב פי הל ד ימ דדני הל י

scripture_data.text_id: Seruan mereka kepada-Ku tidak keluar dari hatinya, tetapi mereka meratap di pembaringan mereka. Mereka menoreh-noreh diri karena gandum dan anggur, dan mereka berontak terhadap Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: And they have not cried unto me with their heart, when they howled upon their beds: they assemble themselves for corn and wine, [and] they rebel against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יב רסי ררתי ריתו גל תבמל ליליי י ל יל קזלו

scripture_data.text_id: Sekalipun Aku telah melatih dan menguatkan lengan-lengan mereka, namun mereka merancang kejahatan terhadap Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Though I have bound [and] strengthened their arms, yet do they imagine mischief against me.
scripture_data.text_orig: רבחי ילו תרז יקח ירי ינו

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka berbalik kepada Baal, mereka adalah seperti busur tipu; pemuka-pemuka mereka akan tewas oleh pedang karena ucapan mereka yang kasar. Inilah yang akan menjadi olok-olok kepada mereka di tanah Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: They return, [but] not to the most High: they are like a deceitful bow: their princes shall fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue: this [shall be] their derision in the land of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירצמ שר ל ז נל מ היר ברחב לי המר תק יה ל ל בי

scripture_data.text_id: Tiuplah sangkakala! Serangan laksana rajawali atas rumah TUHAN! Oleh karena mereka telah melangkahi perjanjian-Ku dan telah mendurhaka terhadap pengajaran-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: [Set] the trumpet to thy mouth. [He shall come] as an eagle against the house of the LORD, because they have transgressed my covenant, and trespassed against my law.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתרלו יתירב רב י הוהי תיל ר רפ חל

scripture_data.text_id: Kepada-Ku mereka berseru-seru: "Ya Allahku, kami, Israel mengenal Engkau!"
scripture_data.text_en: Israel shall cry unto me, My God, we know thee.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי נדי יהל קזי יל

scripture_data.text_id: Israel telah menolak yang baik biarlah musuh mengejar dia!
scripture_data.text_en: Israel hath cast off [the thing that is] good: the enemy shall pursue him.
scripture_data.text_orig: פרי בי ב לרי חנז

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka telah mengangkat raja, tetapi tanpa persetujuan-Ku; mereka mengangkat pemuka, tetapi dengan tidak setahu-Ku. Dari emas dan peraknya mereka membuat berhala-berhala bagi dirinya sendiri, sehingga mereka dilenyapkan.
scripture_data.text_en: They have set up kings, but not by me: they have made princes, and I knew [it] not: of their silver and their gold have they made them idols, that they may be cut off.
scripture_data.text_orig: תרי מל יץ הל בהז ס ידי לו ריה ימ לו כילמה ה

scripture_data.text_id: Aku menolak anak lembumu, hai Samaria; murka-Ku menyala terhadap mereka! Sampai berapa lama tidak dapat disucikan,
scripture_data.text_en: Thy calf, O Samaria, hath cast [thee] off; mine anger is kindled against them: how long [will it be] ere they attain to innocency?
scripture_data.text_orig: ינ לכי ל יתמד י הרח רמ לג חנז

scripture_data.text_id: orang-orang Israel itu? Itu dibuat oleh tukang, dan itu bukan Allah! Sungguh, akan menjadi serpih anak lembu Samaria itu!
scripture_data.text_en: For from Israel [was] it also: the workman made it; therefore it [is] not God: but the calf of Samaria shall be broken in pieces.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ לג היהי יבבי ה יהל לו ה רח הו לרמ י

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab mereka menabur angin, maka mereka akan menuai puting beliung; gandum yang belum menguning tidak ada pada mereka; tumbuh-tumbuhan itu tidak menghasilkan tepung; dan jika memberi hasil, maka orang-orang lain menelannya.
scripture_data.text_en: For they have sown the wind, and they shall reap the whirlwind: it hath no stalk: the bud shall yield no meal: if so be it yield, the strangers shall swallow it up.
scripture_data.text_orig: הלבי ירז הי יל חמהי יל חמצ לי המק רצקי התפסו רזי חר י

scripture_data.text_id: Israel sudah ditelan; sekarang mereka itu ada di antara bangsa-bangsa seperti barang yang tidak disukai orang.
scripture_data.text_en: Israel is swallowed up: now shall they be among the Gentiles as a vessel wherein [is] no pleasure.
scripture_data.text_orig: שפחי ילכ יב יה ה לרי לבנ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab mereka telah pergi ke Asyur, bagaikan keledai hutan yang memencilkan diri; Efraim telah membagi-bagi hadiah cinta.
scripture_data.text_en: For they are gone up to Assyria, a wild ass alone by himself: Ephraim hath hired lovers.
scripture_data.text_orig: יבה נתה ירפ ל דד ר ר ל ההי

scripture_data.text_id: Sekalipun mereka membagi-bagi hadiah itu di antara bangsa-bangsa, sekarang ini Aku akan mengumpulkan mereka, dan sebentar lagi mereka akan berhenti mengurapi raja dan para pemuka.
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, though they have hired among the nations, now will I gather them, and they shall sorrow a little for the burden of the king of princes.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר למ מ חו צק ה יב נתיי

scripture_data.text_id: Sungguh, Efraim telah memperbanyak mezbah; mezbah-mezbah itu menjadikan mereka berdosa.
scripture_data.text_en: Because Ephraim hath made many altars to sin, altars shall be unto him to sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: חל תחזמ ליה חל תחזמ ירפ הרהי

scripture_data.text_id: Sekalipun Kutuliskan baginya banyak pengajaran-Ku, itu akan dianggap mereka sebagai sesuatu yang asing.
scripture_data.text_en: I have written to him the great things of my law, [but] they were counted as a strange thing.
scripture_data.text_orig: בחן רזמ יתר יר ר לבכבכ

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka mencintai korban sembelihan; mereka mempersembahkan daging dan memakannya; tetapi TUHAN tidak berkenan kepada mereka. Sekarang Ia akan mengingat kesalahan mereka dan akan menghukum dosa mereka; mereka harus kembali ke Mesir!
scripture_data.text_en: They sacrifice flesh [for] the sacrifices of mine offerings, and eat [it; but] the LORD accepteth them not; now will he remember their iniquity, and visit their sins: they shall return to Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי ירצמ הה תוח דקפיו נו רזי ה צר ל הוהי לכו רב חזי יבהבה יחבז

scripture_data.text_id: Israel telah melupakan Pembuatnya dan telah mendirikan istana-istana; Yehuda telah memperbanyak kota-kota yang berkubu; tetapi Aku akan melepas api ke dalam kota-kota mereka, sehingga puri mereka dimakan habis.
scripture_data.text_en: For Israel hath forgotten his Maker, and buildeth temples; and Judah hath multiplied fenced cities: but I will send a fire upon his cities, and it shall devour the palaces thereof.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס היתנמר הלכו ויר יחו תרצ יר הרה הדהיו תלכיה בו הת לרי חו

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah bersukacita, hai Israel! Janganlah bersorak-sorak seperti bangsa-bangsa! Sebab engkau telah berzinah dengan meninggalkan Allahmu, engkau telah mencintai upah sundal di segala tempat pengirikan gandum.
scripture_data.text_en: Rejoice not, O Israel, for joy, as [other] people: for thou hast gone a whoring from thy God, thou hast loved a reward upon every cornfloor.
scripture_data.text_orig: ג תנרל ל נת בה יהל למ תינז י י ליל לרי חמל

scripture_data.text_id: Tempat pengirikan gandum dan tempat pemerasan anggur tidak akan memberi mereka makan, dan anggur akan mengecewakan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: The floor and the winepress shall not feed them, and the new wine shall fail in her.
scripture_data.text_orig: חכי ריתו רי ל בקיו ר

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka tidak akan tetap diam di tanah TUHAN, tetapi Efraim harus kembali ke Mesir, dan di Asyur mereka akan memakan makanan najis.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall not dwell in the LORD'S land; but Ephraim shall return to Egypt, and they shall eat unclean [things] in Assyria.
scripture_data.text_orig: לכי מ רב ירצמ ירפ בו הוהי שר בי ל

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka tidak akan mempersembahkan korban curahan anggur kepada TUHAN dan korban-korban sembelihan mereka tidak akan menyenangkan hati-Nya. Roti mereka adalah seperti roti perkabungan, semua orang yang memakannya akan menjadi najis, sebab roti mereka adalah untuk dirinya sendiri, tidak boleh dibawa ke dalam rumah TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall not offer wine [offerings] to the LORD, neither shall they be pleasing unto him: their sacrifices [shall be] unto them as the bread of mourners; all that eat thereof shall be polluted: for their bread for their soul shall not come into the house of the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהי תי בי ל פנל מחלי י וילכל הל ינ חל היחבז לברי לו יי הוהיל כיל

scripture_data.text_id: Apakah yang hendak kamu perbuat pada waktu pertemuan raya dan pada waktu hari raya TUHAN?
scripture_data.text_en: What will ye do in the solemn day, and in the day of the feast of the LORD?
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהיגח יל דם יל הם

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab walaupun mereka mengelakkan diri dari pemusnahan, Mesir akan mengumpulkan mereka, Memfis akan menguburkan mereka. Rumput akan menutupi barang-barang perak mereka yang berharga; onak akan tumbuh dalam kemah-kemah mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, they are gone because of destruction: Egypt shall gather them up, Memphis shall bury them: the pleasant [places] for their silver, nettles shall possess them: thorns [shall be] in their tabernacles.
scripture_data.text_orig: הילה חח ריי ק סכל דמחם רק מ צק ירצמ דמ כלה ההי

scripture_data.text_id: Sudah datang hari-hari penghukuman, sudah datang hari-hari pembalasan, Israel akan mengalaminya, "Nabi adalah seorang pandir, orang yang penuh roh adalah orang gila!", oleh karena besarnya kesalahanmu dan besarnya permusuhan:
scripture_data.text_en: The days of visitation are come, the days of recompence are come; Israel shall know [it]: the prophet [is] a fool, the spiritual man [is] mad, for the multitude of thine iniquity, and the great hatred.
scripture_data.text_orig: המם הרו נו בר ל חרה י ם יבה ליו לרי די ה ימי הקה ימי

scripture_data.text_id: Efraim, umat Allahku, sedang mengintai nabi, jerat penangkap burung ada di sepanjang jalannya, permusuhan ada di rumah Allahnya.
scripture_data.text_en: The watchman of Ephraim [was] with my God: [but] the prophet [is] a snare of a fowler in all his ways, [and] hatred in the house of his God.
scripture_data.text_orig: ויהל תיב המם ויכרלל קי ח יבנ יהל ירפ הפצ

scripture_data.text_id: Busuk sangat perbuatan mereka seperti pada hari-hari Gibea; Ia akan mengingat kesalahan mereka dan akan menghukum dosa mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: They have deeply corrupted [themselves], as in the days of Gibeah: [therefore] he will remember their iniquity, he will visit their sins.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס תוח דקפי נו רזי הבה ימי תחקימה

scripture_data.text_id: Seperti buah-buah anggur di padang gurun Aku mendapati Israel dahulu; seperti buah sulung sebagai hasil pertama pohon ara Aku melihat nenek moyangmu. Tetapi mereka itu telah pergi kepada Baal-Peor dan telah membaktikan diri kepada dewa keaiban, sehingga mereka menjadi kejijikan sama seperti apa yang mereka cintai itu.
scripture_data.text_en: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness; I saw your fathers as the firstripe in the fig tree at her first time: [but] they went to Baalpeor, and separated themselves unto [that] shame; and [their] abominations were according as they loved.
scripture_data.text_orig: בה יצ יהו תל רזו רלב הה כיתב יתיר תיר הנתב הרב לרי יתצמ רד יבנ

scripture_data.text_id: Kemuliaan Efraim terbang seperti burung: tiada yang melahirkan, yang hamil dan yang mengandung!
scripture_data.text_en: [As for] Ephraim, their glory shall fly away like a bird, from the birth, and from the womb, and from the conception.
scripture_data.text_orig: ירהמ מ הדמ דב פתי ירפ

scripture_data.text_id: Sekalipun mereka membesarkan anak-anaknya, Aku akan membuat mereka bulus, sehingga tidak ada manusia lagi. Sungguh, celakalah juga mereka pada waktu Aku menjauh dari pada mereka!
scripture_data.text_en: Though they bring up their children, yet will I bereave them, [that there shall] not [be] a man [left]: yea, woe also to them when I depart from them!
scripture_data.text_orig: המ יר הל יגי דמ ילו הינת לגי י

scripture_data.text_id: Efraim, seperti yang Aku lihat, telah membuat anak-anaknya menjadi binatang perburuan; Efraim terpaksa menyerahkan anak-anaknya kepada si pembunuh.
scripture_data.text_en: Ephraim, as I saw Tyrus, [is] planted in a pleasant place: but Ephraim shall bring forth his children to the murderer.
scripture_data.text_orig: וינ גרהל יצהל ירפו הונב הלת רצל יתירר ירפ

scripture_data.text_id: Berilah kepada mereka, ya TUHAN apakah yang hendak Kauberi? Berilah kepada mereka kandungan yang mandul dan buah dada yang kering.
scripture_data.text_en: Give them, O LORD: what wilt thou give? give them a miscarrying womb and dry breasts.
scripture_data.text_orig: יקמצ ידו לים חר הל הם הוהי הל

scripture_data.text_id: Segala kejahatan mereka terjadi di Gilgal, sungguh, di sana Aku mulai membenci mereka. Oleh karena jahatnya perbuatan-perbuatan mereka Aku akan menghalau mereka dari rumah-Ku. Aku tidak akan mengasihi mereka lagi, semua pemuka mereka adalah pemberontak.
scripture_data.text_en: All their wickedness [is] in Gilgal: for there I hated them: for the wickedness of their doings I will drive them out of mine house, I will love them no more: all their princes [are] revolters.
scripture_data.text_orig: יררס הירל תבה ס ל רג יתימ היללם ר ל יתנ י לל תרל

scripture_data.text_id: Efraim telah dipukul, akarnya telah menjadi kering, mereka tidak akan menghasilkan buah. Bahkan sekalipun mereka melahirkan anak, Aku akan mematikan buah kandungannya yang berharga.
scripture_data.text_en: Ephraim is smitten, their root is dried up, they shall bear no fruit: yea, though they bring forth, yet will I slay [even] the beloved [fruit] of their womb.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס נב ימחם ימהו דלי י ילבילב יר בי ר ירפ הה

scripture_data.text_id: Allahku akan membuang mereka, sebab mereka tidak mendengarkan Dia, maka mereka akan mengembara di antara bangsa-bangsa.
scripture_data.text_en: My God will cast them away, because they did not hearken unto him: and they shall be wanderers among the nations.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס י ידדנ יהיו ל מ ל י יהל סמי

scripture_data.text_id: Israel adalah pohon anggur yang riap tumbuhnya, yang menghasilkan buah. Makin banyak buahnya, makin banyak dibuatnya mezbah-mezbah. Makin baik tanahnya, makin baik dibuatnya tugu-tugu berhala.
scripture_data.text_en: Israel [is] an empty vine, he bringeth forth fruit unto himself: according to the multitude of his fruit he hath increased the altars; according to the goodness of his land they have made goodly images.
scripture_data.text_orig: תבם בייה צרל ב תחזל הרה ירפל בר הי יר לרי קק פ

scripture_data.text_id: Hati mereka licik, sekarang mereka harus menanggung akibat kesalahannya: Dia akan menghancurkan mezbah-mezbah mereka, akan meruntuhkan tugu-tugu berhala mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: Their heart is divided; now shall they be found faulty: he shall break down their altars, he shall spoil their images.
scripture_data.text_orig: תבם דדי תחזמ רי ה מי ה ל קלח

scripture_data.text_id: Sungguh, sekarang mereka berkata: "Kita tidak mempunyai raja lagi, sebab kita tidak takut kepada TUHAN. Apakah yang dapat dilakukan raja bagi kita?"
scripture_data.text_en: For now they shall say, We have no king, because we feared not the LORD; what then should a king do to us?
scripture_data.text_orig: נההם להו הוהית נרי ל י נל למ י רמי ה י

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka membual, mengangkat sumpah dusta, mengikat perjanjian, sehingga tumbuh hukum seperti pohon upas di alur-alur ladang.
scripture_data.text_en: They have spoken words, swearing falsely in making a covenant: thus judgment springeth up as hemlock in the furrows of the field.
scripture_data.text_orig: יד ימל ל מ ר חרפ תיר תר ו תל ירבד ר

scripture_data.text_id: Penduduk Samaria gentar mengenai anak lembu Bet-Awen. Sungguh, rakyatnya akan berkabung oleh karenanya, dan imam-imamnya akan meratap oleh karenanya, oleh sebab kemuliaannya telah beralih dari padanya.
scripture_data.text_en: The inhabitants of Samaria shall fear because of the calves of Bethaven: for the people thereof shall mourn over it, and the priests thereof [that] rejoiced on it, for the glory thereof, because it is departed from it.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ הלגי דבל ליגי ויל וירמכ ויל לבי רמ כ רגי ותי תלגל

scripture_data.text_id: Anak lembu itu sendiri akan dibawa ke Asyur sebagai persembahan kepada Raja 'Agung'. Efraim akan menanggung malu, Israel akan mendapat malu karena rancangannya.
scripture_data.text_en: It shall be also carried unto Assyria [for] a present to king Jareb: Ephraim shall receive shame, and Israel shall be ashamed of his own counsel.
scripture_data.text_orig: תצמ לרי ביו חי ירפ הנ ברי למל החנמ לבי רל ת

scripture_data.text_id: Samaria akan dihancurkan; rajanya seperti sepotong ranting yang terapung di air.
scripture_data.text_en: [As for] Samaria, her king is cut off as the foam upon the water.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימינל צק לם רמ המדנ

scripture_data.text_id: Bukit-bukit pengorbanan Awen, yakni dosa Israel, akan dimusnahkan. Semak duri dan rumput duri akan tumbuh di atas mezbah-mezbahnya. Dan mereka akan berkata kepada gunung-gunung: "Timbunilah kami!" dan kepada bukit-bukit: "Runtuhlah menimpa kami!"
scripture_data.text_en: The high places also of Aven, the sin of Israel, shall be destroyed: the thorn and the thistle shall come up on their altars; and they shall say to the mountains, Cover us; and to the hills, Fall on us.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס ניל לפנ תבלו נ ירהל רמו תחזמל הלי ררדו שק לרי תח ו תמ דמנו

scripture_data.text_id: Sejak hari Gibea engkau telah berdosa, hai Israel; di sana mereka bangkit melawan. Tidakkah perang melawan orang-orang curang akan mencapai mereka di Gibea?
scripture_data.text_en: O Israel, thou hast sinned from the days of Gibeah: there they stood: the battle in Gibeah against the children of iniquity did not overtake them.
scripture_data.text_orig: הול ינל המחלמ הב גיתל דמ לרי תח הבה ימימ

scripture_data.text_id: Aku telah datang untuk menghajar mereka; bangsa-bangsa akan berkumpul melawan mereka, apabila mereka dihajar karena salahnya yang berganda.
scripture_data.text_en: [It is] in my desire that I should chastise them; and the people shall be gathered against them, when they shall bind themselves in their two furrows.
scripture_data.text_orig: תנ תני יל רס י היל פו רו ית

scripture_data.text_id: Efraim dahulu seekor anak lembu yang terlatih, yang suka mengirik, dan Aku ini menyayangi tengkuknya yang elok, Aku memasang Efraim; Yehuda harus membajak, Yakub harus menyisir tanah baginya sendiri.
scripture_data.text_en: And Ephraim [is as] an heifer [that is] taught, [and] loveth to tread out [the corn]; but I passed over upon her fair neck: I will make Ephraim to ride; Judah shall plow, [and] Jacob shall break his clods.
scripture_data.text_orig: בקי לדי הדהי רחי ירפ ביר רץ בל ירב ינו דל יבה הדלם הלג ירפו

scripture_data.text_id: Menaburlah bagimu sesuai dengan keadilan, menuailah menurut kasih setia! Bukalah bagimu tanah baru, sebab sudah waktunya untuk mencari TUHAN, sampai Ia datang dan menghujani kamu dengan keadilan.
scripture_data.text_en: Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap in mercy; break up your fallow ground: for [it is] time to seek the LORD, till he come and rain righteousness upon you.
scripture_data.text_orig: כל קדצ הריו ביד הוהית רדל תו רינ כל רינ דסחיפל רצק הקדצל כל רז

scripture_data.text_id: Kamu telah membajak kefasikan, telah menuai kecurangan, telah memakan buah kebohongan. Oleh karena engkau telah mengandalkan diri pada keretamu, pada banyaknya pahlawan-pahlawanmu,
scripture_data.text_en: Ye have plowed wickedness, ye have reaped iniquity; ye have eaten the fruit of lies: because thou didst trust in thy way, in the multitude of thy mighty men.
scripture_data.text_orig: יר בר רדב חבי חכיר לכ רצק התלו ררח

scripture_data.text_id: maka keriuhan perang akan timbul di antara bangsamu, dan segala kubumu akan dihancurkan seperti Salman menghancurkan Bet-Arbel pada hari pertempuran: ibu beserta anak-anak diremukkan.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore shall a tumult arise among thy people, and all thy fortresses shall be spoiled, as Shalman spoiled Betharbel in the day of battle: the mother was dashed in pieces upon [her] children.
scripture_data.text_orig: הר ינל המחלמ י לברתי מל ד די ירצבמלכו קו

scripture_data.text_id: Demikianlah akan Kulakukan kepadamu, hai kaum Israel, oleh karena dahsyatnya kejahatanmu. Pada waktu fajar akan dilenyapkan sama sekali raja Israel.
scripture_data.text_en: So shall Bethel do unto you because of your great wickedness: in a morning shall the king of Israel utterly be cut off.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי למ המדנ המדנ רח כתר תר ינמ לתי כל ה הכ

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika Israel masih muda, Kukasihi dia, dan dari Mesir Kupanggil anak-Ku itu.
scripture_data.text_en: When Israel [was] a child, then I loved him, and called my son out of Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינבל יתרק ירצמ הבהו לרי רנ י

scripture_data.text_id: Makin Kupanggil mereka, makin pergi mereka itu dari hadapan-Ku; mereka mempersembahkan korban kepada para Baal, dan membakar korban kepada patung-patung.
scripture_data.text_en: [As] they called them, so they went from them: they sacrificed unto Baalim, and burned incense to graven images.
scripture_data.text_orig: רקי ילסלו חזי ילל הינמ כלה הל רק

scripture_data.text_id: Padahal Akulah yang mengajar Efraim berjalan dan mengangkat mereka di tangan-Ku, tetapi mereka tidak mau insaf, bahwa Aku menyembuhkan mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: I taught Ephraim also to go, taking them by their arms; but they knew not that I healed them.
scripture_data.text_orig: יתפר י די לו ויתרזל חק ירפל ילרת יכנו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku menarik mereka dengan tali kesetiaan, dengan ikatan kasih. Bagi mereka Aku seperti orang yang mengangkat kuk dari tulang rahang mereka; Aku membungkuk kepada mereka untuk memberi mereka makan.
scripture_data.text_en: I drew them with cords of a man, with bands of love: and I was to them as they that take off the yoke on their jaws, and I laid meat unto them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ליכ ויל ו היחל ל ל ימירמ הל היהו הבה תתב כמ ד ילבח

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka harus kembali ke tanah Mesir, dan Asyur akan menjadi raja mereka, sebab mereka menolak untuk bertobat.
scripture_data.text_en: He shall not return into the land of Egypt, but the Assyrian shall be his king, because they refused to return.
scripture_data.text_orig: בל נמ י לם ה רו ירצמ שרל בי ל

scripture_data.text_id: Pedang akan mengamuk di kota-kota mereka, akan memusnahkan palang-palang pintu mereka, dan akan memakan mereka di benteng-benteng mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: And the sword shall abide on his cities, and shall consume his branches, and devour [them], because of their own counsels.
scripture_data.text_orig: היתצמ הלכו ויב התכו ויר ברח הלחו

scripture_data.text_id: Umat-Ku betah dalam membelakangi Aku; mereka memanggil kepada Baal dan berhenti meninggikan nama-Ku.
scripture_data.text_en: And my people are bent to backsliding from me: though they called them to the most High, none at all would exalt [him].
scripture_data.text_orig: מרי ל דחי הרקי ללו יתבמל ילת יו

scripture_data.text_id: Masakan Aku membiarkan engkau, hai Efraim, menyerahkan engkau, hai Israel? Masakan Aku membiarkan engkau seperti Adma, membuat engkau seperti Zeboim? Hati-Ku berbalik dalam diri-Ku, belas kasihan-Ku bangkit serentak.
scripture_data.text_en: How shall I give thee up, Ephraim? [how] shall I deliver thee, Israel? how shall I make thee as Admah? [how] shall I set thee as Zeboim? mine heart is turned within me, my repentings are kindled together.
scripture_data.text_orig: ימחנ רמכנ דחי יל יל הן יבצ מי המדך נ י לרי נמ ירפ נ י

scripture_data.text_id: Aku tidak akan melaksanakan murka-Ku yang bernyala-nyala itu, tidak akan membinasakan Efraim kembali. Sebab Aku ini Allah dan bukan manusia, Yang Kudus di tengah-tengahmu, dan Aku tidak datang untuk menghanguskan.
scripture_data.text_en: I will not execute the fierceness of mine anger, I will not return to destroy Ephraim: for I [am] God, and not man; the Holy One in the midst of thee: and I will not enter into the city.
scripture_data.text_orig: רי ב לו דק רק ילו יכנ ל י ירפ תחל ב ל י רח ה ל

scripture_data.text_id: Mereka akan mengikuti TUHAN, Ia akan mengaum seperti singa. Sungguh, Ia akan mengaum, maka anak-anak akan datang dengan gemetar dari barat,
scripture_data.text_en: They shall walk after the LORD: he shall roar like a lion: when he shall roar, then the children shall tremble from the west.
scripture_data.text_orig: מ ינב דרחיו גי הי גי היר כלי הוהי ירח

scripture_data.text_id: seperti burung dengan gemetar datang dari Mesir, dan seperti merpati dari tanah Asyur, lalu Aku akan menempatkan mereka lagi di rumah-rumah mereka, demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: They shall tremble as a bird out of Egypt, and as a dove out of the land of Assyria: and I will place them in their houses, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהין היל יבהו ר שרמ הניכ ירצמ רצך דרחי

scripture_data.text_id: (12-1) Dengan kebohongan Aku telah dikepung oleh Efraim, dengan tipu oleh kaum Israel; sedang Yehuda menghilang dari dekat Allah, dari dekat Yang Mahakudus yang setia.
scripture_data.text_en: Ephraim compasseth me about with lies, and the house of Israel with deceit: but Judah yet ruleth with God, and is faithful with the saints.
scripture_data.text_orig: בְּרֵאשִׁית בָּרָא אֱלֹהִים

scripture_data.text_id: (12-2) Efraim menjaga angin, dan mengejar angin timur sehari suntuk, memperbanyak dusta dan pemusnahan; mereka mengadakan perjanjian dengan Asyur, dan membawa minyak kepada Mesir.
scripture_data.text_en: Ephraim feedeth on wind, and followeth after the east wind: he daily increaseth lies and desolation; and they do make a covenant with the Assyrians, and oil is carried into Egypt.
scripture_data.text_orig: מן ידקו ל דר ד הדהיו לרי תי המרמב ירפ חכב ינבבס

scripture_data.text_id: (12-3) TUHAN mempunyai perbantahan dengan Yehuda, Ia akan menghukum Yakub sesuai dengan tingkah lakunya, dan akan memberi balasan kepadanya sesuai dengan perbuatan-perbuatannya.
scripture_data.text_en: The LORD hath also a controversy with Judah, and will punish Jacob according to his ways; according to his doings will he recompense him.
scripture_data.text_orig: לבי ירצמל מו תרכי ר תירב הרי דו בז הל ידק דרו חר הר ירפ

scripture_data.text_id: (12-4) Di dalam kandungan ia menipu saudaranya, dan dalam kegagahannya ia bergumul dengan Allah.
scripture_data.text_en: He took his brother by the heel in the womb, and by his strength he had power with God:
scripture_data.text_orig: ל ביי ויללמ ויכרד בקיל דקפלו הדהי הוהיל בירו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-5) Ia bergumul dengan Malaikat dan menang; ia menangis dan memohon belas kasihan kepada-Nya. Di Betel ia bertemu dengan Dia, dan di sanalah Dia berfirman kepadanya:
scripture_data.text_en: Yea, he had power over the angel, and prevailed: he wept, and made supplication unto him: he found him [in] Bethel, and there he spake with us;
scripture_data.text_orig: יהלת הר נב ויחת בק

scripture_data.text_id: (12-6) yakni TUHAN, Allah semesta alam, TUHAN nama-Nya
scripture_data.text_en: Even the LORD God of hosts; the LORD [is] his memorial.
scripture_data.text_orig: נ רדי ו צמי לתי לחתו הכ לכו למל רו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-7) "Engkau ini harus berbalik kepada Allahmu, peliharalah kasih setia dan hukum, dan nantikanlah Allahmu senantiasa."
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore turn thou to thy God: keep mercy and judgment, and wait on thy God continually.
scripture_data.text_orig: רכז הוהי תבה יהל הוהיו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-8) Sama seperti Kanaan, dengan neraca palsu di tangannya, dan suka memeras,
scripture_data.text_en: [He is] a merchant, the balances of deceit [are] in his hand: he loveth to oppress.
scripture_data.text_orig: דימ יהלל הקו רמ מ דסח בת יהל הו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-9) berkatalah Efraim: "Bukankah aku telah menjadi kaya, telah mendapat harta benda bagiku! Tetapi segala hasil jerih payahku tidak mendatangkan kesalahan yang merupakan dosa bagiku."
scripture_data.text_en: And Ephraim said, Yet I am become rich, I have found me out substance: [in] all my labours they shall find none iniquity in me that [were] sin.
scripture_data.text_orig: בה קל המרמ ינזמ די נ

scripture_data.text_id: (12-10) Tetapi Aku adalah TUHAN, Allahmu sejak di tanah Mesir; Aku masih mau membuat engkau diam kembali di kemah-kemah seperti di hari-hari pertemuan raya.
scripture_data.text_en: And I [that am] the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt will yet make thee to dwell in tabernacles, as in the days of the solemn feast.
scripture_data.text_orig: חר ו ילצמי ל ייגיל יל יתצמ יר ירפ רמו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-11) Aku berbicara kepada para nabi dan banyak kali memberi penglihatan dan memberi perumpamaan dengan perantaraan para nabi.
scripture_data.text_en: I have also spoken by the prophets, and I have multiplied visions, and used similitudes, by the ministry of the prophets.
scripture_data.text_orig: דם ימי ילהב בי ד ירצמ שרמ יהל הוהי יכנו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-12) Bila di Gilead ada kejahatan, maka mereka menjadi kesia-siaan belaka; di Gilgal mereka mempersembahkan lembu-lembu jantan, maka mezbah-mezbah mereka juga menjadi seperti timbunan batu di alur-alur ladang.
scripture_data.text_en: [Is there] iniquity [in] Gilead? surely they are vanity: they sacrifice bullocks in Gilgal; yea, their altars [are] as heaps in the furrows of the fields.
scripture_data.text_orig: הד ייבה דיב יתירה זח יכנו ייבהל ירדו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-13) Yakub melarikan diri ke tanah Aram, dan Israel memperhambakan diri untuk mendapat isteri, ya, untuk mendapat isteri ia menjadi gembala.
scripture_data.text_en: And Jacob fled into the country of Syria, and Israel served for a wife, and for a wife he kept [sheep].
scripture_data.text_orig: יד ימל ל יג תחזמ חז ירו לל יה ו ו דל

scripture_data.text_id: (12-14) Israel dituntun oleh TUHAN keluar dari Mesir dengan perantaraan seorang nabi, ya, ia dijaga oleh seorang nabi.
scripture_data.text_en: And by a prophet the LORD brought Israel out of Egypt, and by a prophet was he preserved.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמ הב ה לרי דבו ר הד בקי חרבו

scripture_data.text_id: (12-15) Efraim telah menimbulkan sakit hati-Nya secara pahit, maka Tuhannya akan membiarkan hutang darahnya menimpa dia, dan akan membalas celanya kepadanya.
scripture_data.text_en: Ephraim provoked [him] to anger most bitterly: therefore shall he leave his blood upon him, and his reproach shall his Lord return unto him.
scripture_data.text_orig: רמנ יבנב ירצמ לרית הוהי הלה יבנב

scripture_data.text_id: Apabila Efraim berbicara, gemetarlah orang; ia diangkat-angkat di Israel, tetapi ia bersalah dengan menyembah Baal, sehingga matilah ia.
scripture_data.text_en: When Ephraim spake trembling, he exalted himself in Israel; but when he offended in Baal, he died.
scripture_data.text_orig: תמו ל ו לרי ה נ תתר ירפ רד

scripture_data.text_id: Sekarangpun mereka terus berdosa, dan membuat baginya patung tuangan dari perak dan berhala-berhala sesuai dengan kecakapan mereka; semuanya itu buatan tukang-tukang. Persembahkanlah korban kepadanya!, kata mereka. Baiklah manusia mencium anak-anak lembu!
scripture_data.text_en: And now they sin more and more, and have made them molten images of their silver, [and] idols according to their own understanding, all of it the work of the craftsmen: they say of them, Let the men that sacrifice kiss the calves.
scripture_data.text_orig: קי ילג ד יחבז ירמ ה הל ה ירח הם יץ נבת סמ הכם הל ו חל פסי הו

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab itu mereka akan seperti kabut pagi atau seperti embun yang hilang pagi-pagi benar, seperti debu jerami yang diterbangkan badai dari tempat pengirikan atau seperti asap dari tingkap.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore they shall be as the morning cloud, and as the early dew that passeth away, as the chaff [that] is driven with the whirlwind out of the floor, and as the smoke out of the chimney.
scripture_data.text_orig: הרמ כ רמ רסי שמ לה ים לכו רקנ יהי כל

scripture_data.text_id: Tetapi Aku adalah TUHAN, Allahmu sejak di tanah Mesir; engkau tidak mengenal allah kecuali Aku, dan tidak ada juruselamat selain dari Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: Yet I [am] the LORD thy God from the land of Egypt, and thou shalt know no god but me: for [there is] no saviour beside me.
scripture_data.text_orig: יל י ימ דת ל יתלז יהלו ירצמ שרמ יהל הוהי יכנו

scripture_data.text_id: Akulah yang mengenal engkau di padang gurun, di tanah yang gersang.
scripture_data.text_en: I did know thee in the wilderness, in the land of great drought.
scripture_data.text_orig: תבל שר רד ידי ינ

scripture_data.text_id: Ketika mereka makan rumput, maka mereka kenyang; setelah mereka kenyang, maka hati mereka meninggi; itulah sebabnya mereka melupakan Aku.
scripture_data.text_en: According to their pasture, so were they filled; they were filled, and their heart was exalted; therefore have they forgotten me.
scripture_data.text_orig: ינחכ ל ל רו ב ו תירמ

scripture_data.text_id: Maka Aku menjadi seperti singa bagi mereka, seperti macan tutul Aku mengintip-intip di pinggir jalan.
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore I will be unto them as a lion: as a leopard by the way will I observe [them]:
scripture_data.text_orig: ר רל רמנ לחמ הל יהו

scripture_data.text_id: Aku mau mendatangi mereka seperti beruang yang kehilangan anak, Aku mau mengoyakkan dada mereka. Di sana Aku memakan mereka seperti singa; binatang liar di padang akan merobek mereka.
scripture_data.text_en: I will meet them as a bear [that is] bereaved [of her whelps], and will rend the caul of their heart, and there will I devour them like a lion: the wild beast shall tear them.
scripture_data.text_orig: ב הדה תח יבל לכו ל רגס רקו ל בד פ

scripture_data.text_id: Aku membinasakan engkau, hai Israel, siapakah yang dapat menolong engkau?
scripture_data.text_en: O Israel, thou hast destroyed thyself; but in me [is] thine help.

scripture_data.text_en: And offer a sacrifice of thanksgiving with leaven, and proclaim [and] publish the free offerings: for this liketh you, O ye children of Israel, saith the Lord GOD.

scripture_data.text_id: "Sekalipun Aku ini telah memberi kepadamu gigi yang tidak disentuh makanan di segala kotamu dan kekurangan roti di segala tempat kediamanmu, namun kamu tidak berbalik kepada-Ku," demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: And I also have given you cleanness of teeth in all your cities, and want of bread in all your places: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין יד בלו כיתמקם לכ חל רסחו כירלכ י יקנ כל יתנ ינגו

scripture_data.text_id: "Akupun telah menahan hujan dari padamu, ketika tiga bulan lagi sebelum panen; Aku menurunkan hujan ke atas kota yang satu dan tidak menurunkan hujan ke atas kota yang lain; ladang yang satu kehujanan, dan ladang, yang tidak kena hujan, menjadi kering;
scripture_data.text_en: And also I have withholden the rain from you, when [there were] yet three months to the harvest: and I caused it to rain upon one city, and caused it not to rain upon another city: one piece was rained upon, and the piece whereupon it rained not withered.
scripture_data.text_orig: בי היל רימתלר הקלחו ר תח הקלח רימ ל תח רילו תח ריל ירמהו ריצל ידח הל ד הת מ ינמ יכנ גו

scripture_data.text_id: penduduk dua tiga kota pergi terhuyung-huyung ke satu kota untuk minum air, tetapi mereka tidak menjadi puas; namun kamu tidak berbalik kepada-Ku," demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: So two [or] three cities wandered unto one city, to drink water; but they were not satisfied: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין יד בלו י לו ימ תל תח ריל יר ל י נו

scripture_data.text_id: "Aku telah memukul kamu dengan hama dan penyakit gandum, telah melayukan taman-tamanmu dan kebun-kebun anggurmu, pohon-pohon ara dan pohon-pohon zaitunmu dimakan habis oleh belalang, namun kamu tidak berbalik kepada-Ku," demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: I have smitten you with blasting and mildew: when your gardens and your vineyards and your fig trees and your olive trees increased, the palmerworm devoured [them]: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהין יד בלו זה לכי כיתיזו כינת כימרכו כית תרה קרב פ כת יתיה

scripture_data.text_id: "Aku telah melepas penyakit sampar ke antaramu seperti kepada orang Mesir; Aku telah membunuh terunamu dengan pedang pada waktu kudamu dijarah; Aku telah membuat bau busuk perkemahanmu tercium oleh hidungmu; namun kamu tidak berbalik kepada-Ku," demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: I have sent among you the pestilence after the manner of Egypt: your young men have I slain with the sword, and have taken away your horses; and I have made the stink of your camps to come up unto your nostrils: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: הוהין יד בלו כב כינחם הלו כיסס יב כירח ברחב יגרה ירצמ רד רב כב יח

scripture_data.text_id: "Aku telah menjungkirbalikkan kota-kota di antara kamu, seperti Allah menjungkirbalikkan Sodom dan Gomora, sehingga kamu menjadi seperti puntung yang ditarik dari kebakaran, namun kamu tidak berbalik kepada-Ku," demikianlah firman TUHAN.
scripture_data.text_en: I have overthrown [some] of you, as God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah, and ye were as a firebrand plucked out of the burning: yet have ye not returned unto me, saith the LORD.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס הוהין יד בלו הפרמ למ ד יהו הרמתו דסת יהל תכהמ כב יכפה

scripture_data.text_id: "Sebab itu demikianlah akan Kulakukan kepadamu, hai Israel. Oleh karena Aku akan melakukan yang demikian kepadamu, maka bersiaplah untuk bertemu dengan Allahmu, hai Israel!"
scripture_data.text_en: Therefore thus will I do unto thee, O Israel: [and] because I will do this unto thee, prepare to meet thy God, O Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי יהלתרקל ה ה תזי בק לרי ה ה כל

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab sesungguhnya, Dia yang membentuk gunung-gunung dan menciptakan angin, yang memberitahukan kepada manusia apa yang dipikirkan-Nya, yang membuat fajar dan kegelapan dan yang berjejak di atas bukit-bukit bumi TUHAN, Allah semesta alam, itulah nama-Nya.
scripture_data.text_en: For, lo, he that formeth the mountains, and createth the wind, and declareth unto man what [is] his thought, that maketh the morning darkness, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, The LORD, The God of hosts, [is] his name.
scripture_data.text_orig: ס מ תבציהל הוהי שר יתמל רדו הפי רח ה חהם דל דימ חר רב ירה רצי הה י

scripture_data.text_id: Dengarlah perkataan ini yang kuucapkan tentang kamu sebagai ratapan, hai kaum Israel:
scripture_data.text_en: Hear ye this word which I take up against you, [even] a lamentation, O house of Israel.
scripture_data.text_orig: לרי תי הניק כיל נ יכנ ר הה רבהת מ

scripture_data.text_id: "Telah rebah, tidak akan bangkit-bangkit lagi anak dara Israel, terkapar di atas tanahnya, tidak ada yang membangkitkannya."
scripture_data.text_en: The virgin of Israel is fallen; she shall no more rise: she is forsaken upon her land; [there is] none to raise her up.
scripture_data.text_orig: מיקם י תמדל הנ לרי תלת ק יסתל הלפנ

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab beginilah firman Tuhan ALLAH kepada kaum Israel: "Kota yang maju berperang dengan seribu orang, dari padanya akan tersisa seratus orang, dan yang maju berperang dengan seratus orang, dari padanya akan tersisa sepuluh orang."
scripture_data.text_en: For thus saith the Lord GOD; The city that went out [by] a thousand shall leave an hundred, and that which went forth [by] an hundred shall leave ten, to the house of Israel.

scripture_data.text_id: Sebab beginilah firman TUHAN kepada kaum Israel: "Carilah Aku, maka kamu akan hidup!
scripture_data.text_en: For thus saith the LORD unto the house of Israel, Seek ye me, and ye shall live:
scripture_data.text_orig: יחו ינר לרי תיבל הוהי רמ הכ י

scripture_data.text_id: Janganlah kamu mencari Betel, janganlah pergi ke Gilgal dan janganlah menyeberang ke Bersyeba, sebab Gilgal pasti masuk ke dalam pembuangan dan Betel akan lenyap."
scripture_data.text_en: But seek not Bethel, nor enter into Gilgal, and pass not to Beersheba: for Gilgal shall surely go into captivity, and Bethel shall come to nought.
